verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If someone leaves some property, it will be for the inheritors, and if he leaves some weak offspring, it will be for us to support them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — Loans, Payment of Loans, Freezing of Property, Bankruptcy
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مُؤْمِنٍ إِلاَّ وَأَنَا أَوْلَى بِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏النَّبِيُّ أَوْلَى بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ‏}‏ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ مَاتَ وَتَرَكَ مَالاً فَلْيَرِثْهُ عَصَبَتُهُ مَنْ كَانُوا، وَمَنْ تَرَكَ دَيْنًا أَوْ ضَيَاعًا فَلْيَأْتِنِي فَأَنَا مَوْلاَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin, haddathanaa fulayhun, 'an hilaali bni 'aliyyin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy 'amraaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ maa min muuminin iilaaa waaanaa aawlaa bihi fiy alddunyaa waalakhiraai aqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏alnnabiyyu aawlaa bialmuuminiyna min aanfusihim‏}‏ faaayyumaa muuminin maata wataraka maalaan falyarithhu 'asabatuhu man kaanuwa, waman taraka daynana aaw dayaa'ana falyaatiniy faaanaa mawlaahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am closer to the believers than their selves in this world and in the Hereafter, and if you like, you can read Allah's Statement: "The Prophet (ﷺ) is closer to the believers than their own selves." (33.6) So, if a true believer dies and leaves behind some property, it will be for his inheritors (from the father's side), and if he leaves behind some debt to be paid or needy offspring, then they should come to me as I am the guardian of the deceased
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — Loans, Payment of Loans, Freezing of Property, Bankruptcy
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، أَخِي وَهْبِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَطْلُ الْغَنِيِّ ظُلْمٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, 'an ma'marin, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, aakhiy wahbi bni munabbihin aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ matlu alghaniyyi zulmun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Procrastination (delay) in repaying debts by a wealthy person is injustice
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — Loans, Payment of Loans, Freezing of Property, Bankruptcy
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ يَتَقَاضَاهُ فَأَغْلَظَ لَهُ فَهَمَّ بِهِ أَصْحَابُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ دَعُوهُ فَإِنَّ لِصَاحِبِ الْحَقِّ مَقَالاً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an salamaaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun yataqaadaahu faaaghlaza lahu fahamma bihi aashaabuhu‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ da'uwhu faiinna lisaahibi alhaqqi maqaalaan ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and demanded his debts and used harsh words. The companions of the Prophet wanted to harm him, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave him, as the creditor (owner of the right) has the right to speak
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — Loans, Payment of Loans, Freezing of Property, Bankruptcy
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مَالَهُ بِعَيْنِهِ عِنْدَ رَجُلٍ أَوْ إِنْسَانٍ قَدْ أَفْلَسَ، فَهْوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ مِنْ غَيْرِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw bakri bnu muhammadi bni 'amriw bni hazmin, aanna 'umara bna 'abdi al'aziyzi, aakhbarahu aanna aabaa bakri bna 'abdi alrrahmani bni alhaarithi bni hishaamin aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaw qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man aadraka maalahu bi'aynihi 'inda rajulin aaw iinsaanin qad aaflasa, fahwa aahaqqu bihi min ghayrihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a man finds his very things with a bankrupt, he has more right to take them back than anyone else
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — Loans, Payment of Loans, Freezing of Property, Bankruptcy
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَعْتَقَ رَجُلٌ غُلاَمًا لَهُ عَنْ دُبُرٍ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ يَشْتَرِيهِ مِنِّي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَاشْتَرَاهُ نُعَيْمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، فَأَخَذَ ثَمَنَهُ، فَدَفَعَهُ إِلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa husaynun almu'allimu, haddathanaa 'ataa'u bnu aabiy rabaahin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala aa'taqa rajulun ghulaamana lahu 'an duburin faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man yashtariyhi minniy ‏"‏‏.‏ faashtaraahu nu'aymu bnu 'abdi alllahi, faaakhadha thamanahu, fadafa'ahu iilayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:A man pledged that his slave would be manumitted after his death. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Who will buy the slave from me?" Nu'aim bin `Abdullah bought the slave and the Prophet (ﷺ) took its price and gave it to the owner
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — Loans, Payment of Loans, Freezing of Property, Bankruptcy
verses.original: وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ رَجُلاً مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، سَأَلَ بَعْضَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَنْ يُسْلِفَهُ، فَدَفَعَهَا إِلَيْهِ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala allaaythu hadaathaniy ja'faru bnu rabiy'aaa, 'an 'abdi alraahmani bni hurmuza, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'an rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanaahu dhakara rajulaan min baniy iisraaiiyla, saaala ba'da baniy iisraaiiyla aan yuslifahu, fadafa'ahaa iilayhi iilaa aajalin musamanna‏.‏ fadhakara alhadiytha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned an Israeli man who asked another Israeli to lend him money, and the latter gave it to him for a fixed period. (Abu Hurairah mentioned the rest of narration) [See chapter: Kafala in loans and debts. Hadith]
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — Loans, Payment of Loans, Freezing of Property, Bankruptcy
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أُصِيبَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَتَرَكَ عِيَالاً وَدَيْنًا، فَطَلَبْتُ إِلَى أَصْحَابِ الدَّيْنِ أَنْ يَضَعُوا بَعْضًا مِنْ دَيْنِهِ فَأَبَوْا، فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَشْفَعْتُ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ فَأَبَوْا، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ صَنِّفْ تَمْرَكَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ مِنْهُ عَلَى حِدَتِهِ، عِذْقَ ابْنِ زَيْدٍ عَلَى حِدَةٍ، وَاللِّينَ عَلَى حِدَةٍ، وَالْعَجْوَةَ عَلَى حِدَةٍ، ثُمَّ أَحْضِرْهُمْ حَتَّى آتِيَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَفَعَلْتُ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَعَدَ عَلَيْهِ، وَكَالَ لِكُلِّ رَجُلٍ حَتَّى اسْتَوْفَى، وَبَقِيَ التَّمْرُ كَمَا هُوَ كَأَنَّهُ لَمْ يُمَسَّ‏.‏ وَغَزَوْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى نَاضِحٍ لَنَا، فَأَزْحَفَ الْجَمَلُ فَتَخَلَّفَ عَلَىَّ فَوَكَزَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ خَلْفِهِ، قَالَ ‏"‏ بِعْنِيهِ وَلَكَ ظَهْرُهُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا دَنَوْنَا اسْتَأْذَنْتُ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي حَدِيثُ عَهْدٍ بِعُرْسٍ‏.‏ قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَمَا تَزَوَّجْتَ بِكْرًا أَمْ ثَيِّبًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثَيِّبًا، أُصِيبَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَتَرَكَ جَوَارِيَ صِغَارًا، فَتَزَوَّجْتُ ثَيِّبًا تُعَلِّمُهُنَّ وَتُؤَدِّبُهُنَّ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْتِ أَهْلَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَدِمْتُ فَأَخْبَرْتُ خَالِي بِبَيْعِ الْجَمَلِ فَلاَمَنِي، فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِإِعْيَاءِ الْجَمَلِ، وَبِالَّذِي كَانَ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَوَكْزِهِ إِيَّاهُ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَدَوْتُ إِلَيْهِ بِالْجَمَلِ، فَأَعْطَانِي ثَمَنَ الْجَمَلِ وَالْجَمَلَ وَسَهْمِي مَعَ الْقَوْمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an mughiyraaa, 'an 'aamirin, 'an jaabirin rda allh 'nh qaala ausiyba 'abdu alllahi wataraka 'iyaalaan wadaynana, fatalabtu iilaa aashaabi alddayni aan yada'uwa ba'dana min daynihi faaabawa, faaataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faastashfa'tu bihi 'alayhim faaabawa, faqaala ‏"‏ sannif tamraka kulla shaa'in minhu 'alaa hidatihi, 'idhqa abni zaydin 'alaa hidaain, waallliyna 'alaa hidaain, waal'ajwaaa 'alaa hidaain, thumma aahdirhum hattaa atiyaka ‏"‏‏.‏ fafa'altu, thumma jaa'a sla allh 'lyh wslm faqa'ada 'alayhi, wakaala likulli rajulin hattaa astawfaa, wabaqiya alttamru kamaa huwa kaaannahu lam yumassa‏.‏ waghazawtu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa naadihin lanaa, faaazhafa aljamalu fatakhallafa 'alaaaa fawakazahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm min khalfihi, qaala ‏"‏ bi'niyhi walaka zahruhu iilaa almadiynaai ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa danawnaa astaadhantu qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy hadiythu 'ahdin bi'ursin‏.‏ qaala sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ famaa tazawwajta bikrana aam thayyibana ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu thayyibana, ausiyba 'abdu alllahi wataraka jawaariya sighaarana, fatazawwajtu thayyibana tu'allimuhunna watuuaddibuhunna, thumma qaala ‏"‏ aiti aahlaka ‏"‏‏.‏ faqadimtu faaakhbartu khaaliy bibay'i aljamali falaamaniy, faaakhbartuhu biii'yaa'i aljamali, wabialladhiy kaana mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wawakzihi iiyyaahu, falammaa qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ghadawtu iilayhi bialjamali, faaa'taaniy thamana aljamali waaljamala wasahmiy ma'a alqawmi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:When `Abdullah (my father) died, he left behind children and debts. I asked the lenders to put down some of his debt, but they refused, so I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) to intercede with them, yet they refused. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to me), "Classify your dates into their different kinds: 'Adha bin Zaid, Lean and 'Ajwa, each kind alone and call all the creditors and wait till I come to you." I did so and the Prophet (ﷺ) came and sat beside the dates and started measuring to each his due till he paid them fully, and the amount of dates remained as it was before, as if he had not touched them. (On another occasion) I took part in one of Ghazawat along with the Prophet (ﷺ) and I was riding one of our camels. The camel got tired and was lagging behind the others. The Prophet (ﷺ) hit it on its back. He said, "Sell it to me, and you have the right to ride it till Medina.'' When we approached Medina, I took the permission from the Prophet (ﷺ) to go to my house, saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have newly married." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Have you married a virgin or a matron (a widow or divorcee)?" I said, "I have married a matron, as `Abdullah (my father) died and left behind daughters small in their ages, so I married a matron who may teach them and bring them up with good manners." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said (to me), "Go to your family." When I went there and told my maternal uncle about the selling of the camel, he admonished me for it. On that I told him about its slowness and exhaustion and about what the Prophet (ﷺ) had done to the camel and his hitting it. When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived, I went to him with the camel in the morning and he gave me its price, the camel itself, and my share from the war booty as he gave the other people
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — Loans, Payment of Loans, Freezing of Property, Bankruptcy
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنِّي أُخْدَعُ فِي الْبُيُوعِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا بَايَعْتَ فَقُلْ لاَ خِلاَبَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَانَ الرَّجُلُ يَقُولُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, sami'tu abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rajulun lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinniy aukhda'u fiy albuyuw'i‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa baaya'ta faqul laa khilaabaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fakaana alrrajulu yaquwluhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I am often betrayed in bargaining." The Prophet (ﷺ) advised him, "When you buy something, say (to the seller), 'No deception." The man used to say so afterwards
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — Loans, Payment of Loans, Freezing of Property, Bankruptcy
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ، مَوْلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ عُقُوقَ الأُمَّهَاتِ، وَوَأْدَ الْبَنَاتِ، وَمَنَعَ وَهَاتِ، وَكَرِهَ لَكُمْ قِيلَ وَقَالَ، وَكَثْرَةَ السُّؤَالِ، وَإِضَاعَةَ الْمَالِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an warraadin, mawlaa almughiyraai bni shu'baaa 'ani almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha harrama 'alaykum 'uquwqa alaummahaati, wawaada albanaati, wamana'a wahaati, wakariha lakum qiyla waqaala, wakathraaa alssuuaali, waiidaa'aaa almaali ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has forbidden for you, (1) to be undutiful to your mothers, (2) to bury your daughters alive, (3) to not to pay the rights of the others (e.g. charity, etc.) and (4) to beg of men (begging). And Allah has hated for you (1) vain, useless talk, or that you talk too much about others, (2) to ask too many questions, (in disputed religious matters) and (3) to waste the wealth (by extravagance)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — Loans, Payment of Loans, Freezing of Property, Bankruptcy
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَمَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، فَالإِمَامُ رَاعٍ، وَهْوَ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، وَالرَّجُلُ فِي أَهْلِهِ رَاعٍ، وَهْوَ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، وَالْمَرْأَةُ فِي بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا رَاعِيَةٌ وَهْىَ مَسْئُولَةٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهَا، وَالْخَادِمُ فِي مَالِ سَيِّدِهِ رَاعٍ، وَهْوَ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَمِعْتُ هَؤُلاَءِ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَحْسِبُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالرَّجُلُ فِي مَالِ أَبِيهِ رَاعٍ، وَهْوَ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، فَكُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ، وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ kullukum raa'in wamasiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi, faaliimaamu raa'in, wahwa masiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi, waalrrajulu fiy aahlihi raa'in, wahwa masiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi, waalmaraaau fiy bayti zawjihaa raa'iyaaun wahaa masiuwlaaun 'an ra'iyyatihaa, waalkhaadimu fiy maali sayyidihi raa'in, wahwa masiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fasami'tu hauulaa'i min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaahsibu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ waalrrajulu fiy maali aabiyhi raa'in, wahwa masiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi, fakullukum raa'in, wakullukum masiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Everyone of you is a guardian, and responsible for what is in his custody. The ruler is a guardian of his subjects and responsible for them; a husband is a guardian of his family and is responsible for it; a lady is a guardian of her husband's house and is responsible for it, and a servant is a guardian of his master's property and is responsible for it." I heard that from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I think that the Prophet (ﷺ) also said, "A man is a guardian of his father's property and is responsible for it, so all of you are guardians and responsible for your wards and things under your care
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ أَخْبَرَنِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّزَّالَ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَجُلاً، قَرَأَ آيَةً سَمِعْتُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم خِلاَفَهَا، فَأَخَذْتُ بِيَدِهِ، فَأَتَيْتُ بِهِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كِلاَكُمَا مُحْسِنٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ أَظُنُّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَخْتَلِفُوا فَإِنَّ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمُ اخْتَلَفُوا فَهَلَكُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala 'abdu almaliki bnu maysaraaa aakhbaraniy qaala sami'tu alnnazzaala, sami'tu 'abda alllahi, yaquwlu sami'tu rajulaan, qaraaa ayaaan sami'tu mina alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm khilaafahaa, faaakhadhtu biyadihi, faaataytu bihi rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ kilaakumaa muhsinun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala shu'baau aazunnuhu qaala ‏"‏ laa takhtalifuwa faiinna man kaana qablakumu akhtalafuwa fahalakuwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:I heard a man reciting a verse (of the Holy Qur'an) but I had heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting it differently. So, I caught hold of the man by the hand and took him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, "Both of you are right." Shu`ba, the sub-narrator said, "I think he said to them, "Don't differ, for the nations before you differed and perished (because of their differences)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ اسْتَبَّ رَجُلاَنِ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَرَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ، قَالَ الْمُسْلِمُ وَالَّذِي اصْطَفَى مُحَمَّدًا عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ، فَقَالَ الْيَهُودِيُّ وَالَّذِي اصْطَفَى مُوسَى عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ الْمُسْلِمُ يَدَهُ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ فَلَطَمَ وَجْهَ الْيَهُودِيِّ، فَذَهَبَ الْيَهُودِيُّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ بِمَا كَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ وَأَمْرِ الْمُسْلِمِ، فَدَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمُسْلِمَ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَأَخْبَرَهُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تُخَيِّرُونِي عَلَى مُوسَى، فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ يَصْعَقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، فَأَصْعَقُ مَعَهُمْ، فَأَكُونُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ يُفِيقُ، فَإِذَا مُوسَى بَاطِشٌ جَانِبَ الْعَرْشِ، فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَكَانَ فِيمَنْ صَعِقَ فَأَفَاقَ قَبْلِي، أَوْ كَانَ مِمَّنِ اسْتَثْنَى اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, wa'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala astabba rajulaani rajulun mina almuslimiyna warajulun mina alyahuwdi, qaala almuslimu waalladhiy astafaa muhammadana 'alaa al'aalamiyna, faqaala alyahuwdiyyu waalladhiy astafaa muwsaa 'alaa al'aalamiyna‏.‏ farafa'a almuslimu yadahu 'inda dhalika falatama wajha alyahuwdiyyi, fadhahaba alyahuwdiyyu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarahu bimaa kaana min aamrihi waaamri almuslimi, fada'aa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almuslima fasaaalahu 'an dhalika, faaakhbarahu faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tukhayyiruwniy 'alaa muwsaa, faiinna alnnaasa yas'aquwna yawma alqiyaamaai, faaas'aqu ma'ahum, faaakuwnu aawwala man yufiyqu, faiidhaa muwsaa baatishun jaaniba al'arshi, falaa aadriy aakaana fiyman sa'iqa faaafaaqa qabliy, aaw kaana mimmani astathnaa alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Two persons, a Muslim and a Jew, quarreled. The Muslim said, "By Him Who gave Muhammad superiority over all the people! The Jew said, "By Him Who gave Moses superiority over all the people!" At that the Muslim raised his hand and slapped the Jew on the face. The Jew went to the Prophet and informed him of what had happened between him and the Muslim. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for the Muslim and asked him about it. The Muslim informed him of the event. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not give me superiority over Moses, for on the Day of Resurrection all the people will fall unconscious and I will be one of them, but I will. be the first to gain consciousness, and will see Moses standing and holding the side of the Throne (of Allah). I will not know whether (Moses) has also fallen unconscious and got up before me, or Allah has exempted him from that stroke
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسٌ جَاءَ يَهُودِيٌّ، فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ضَرَبَ وَجْهِي رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ادْعُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَضَرَبْتَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ بِالسُّوقِ يَحْلِفُ وَالَّذِي اصْطَفَى مُوسَى عَلَى الْبَشَرِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَىْ خَبِيثُ، عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخَذَتْنِي غَضْبَةٌ ضَرَبْتُ وَجْهَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُخَيِّرُوا بَيْنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ، فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ يَصْعَقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، فَأَكُونُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ تَنْشَقُّ عَنْهُ الأَرْضُ، فَإِذَا أَنَا بِمُوسَى آخِذٌ بِقَائِمَةٍ مِنْ قَوَائِمِ الْعَرْشِ، فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَكَانَ فِيمَنْ صَعِقَ، أَمْ حُوسِبَ بِصَعْقَةِ الأُولَى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu yahyaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh qaala baynamaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaalisun jaa'a yahuwdiyyun, faqaala yaa aabaa alqaasimi daraba wajhiy rajulun min aashaabika‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ man ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala rajulun mina alaansaari‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ ad'uwhu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aadarabtahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala sami'tuhu bialssuwqi yahlifu waalladhiy astafaa muwsaa 'alaa albashari‏.‏ qultu aaa khabiythu, 'alaa muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhadhatniy ghadbaaun darabtu wajhahu‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tukhayyiruwa bayna alaanbiyaa'i, faiinna alnnaasa yas'aquwna yawma alqiyaamaai, faaakuwnu aawwala man tanshaqqu 'anhu alaardu, faiidhaa aanaa bimuwsaa akhidhun biqaaiimaain min qawaaiimi al'arshi, falaa aadriy aakaana fiyman sa'iqa, aam huwsiba bisa'qaai alauwlaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting, a Jew came and said, "O Abul Qasim! One of your companions has slapped me on my face." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked who that was. He replied that he was one of the Ansar. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for him, and on his arrival, he asked him whether he had beaten the Jew. He (replied in the affirmative and) said, "I heard him taking an oath in the market saying, 'By Him Who gave Moses superiority over all the human beings.' I said, 'O wicked man! (Has Allah given Moses superiority) even over Muhammad I became furious and slapped him over his face." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not give a prophet superiority over another, for on the Day of Resurrection all the people will fall unconscious and I will be the first to emerge from the earth, and will see Moses standing and holding one of the legs of the Throne. I will not know whether Moses has fallen unconscious or the first unconsciousness was sufficient for him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ يَهُودِيًّا، رَضَّ رَأْسَ جَارِيَةٍ بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ، قِيلَ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا بِكِ أَفُلاَنٌ، أَفُلاَنٌ حَتَّى سُمِّيَ الْيَهُودِيُّ فَأَوْمَتْ بِرَأْسِهَا، فَأُخِذَ الْيَهُودِيُّ فَاعْتَرَفَ، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرُضَّ رَأْسُهُ بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna yahuwdiyyana, radda raasa jaariyaain bayna hajarayni, qiyla man fa'ala hadhaa biki aafulaanun, aafulaanun hattaa summiya alyahuwdiyyu faaawmat biraasihaa, faaukhidha alyahuwdiyyu faa'tarafa, faaamara bihi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm farudda raasuhu bayna hajarayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:A Jew crushed the head of a girl between two stones. The girl was asked who had crushed her head, and some names were mentioned before her, and when the name of the Jew was mentioned, she nodded agreeing. The Jew was captured and when he confessed, the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that his head be crushed between two stones
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ رَجُلٌ يُخْدَعُ فِي الْبَيْعِ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا بَايَعْتَ فَقُلْ لاَ خِلاَبَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَانَ يَقُولُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muslimin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu diynaarin, qaala sami'tu abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana rajulun yukhda'u fiy albay'i faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa baaya'ta faqul laa khilaabaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fakaana yaquwluhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A man was often cheated in buying. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "When you buy something, say (to the seller), No cheating." The man used to say so thenceforward
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَعْتَقَ عَبْدًا لَهُ، لَيْسَ لَهُ مَالٌ غَيْرُهُ، فَرَدَّهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَابْتَاعَهُ مِنْهُ نُعَيْمُ بْنُ النَّحَّامِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aasimu bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an jaabirin rda allh 'nh aanna rajulaan, aa'taqa 'abdana lahu, laysa lahu maalun ghayruhu, faraddahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm, faabtaa'ahu minhu nu'aymu bnu alnnahhaami‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:A man manumitted a slave and he had no other property than that, so the Prophet (ﷺ) canceled the manumission (and sold the slave for him). Nu'aim bin Al-Nahham bought the slave from him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ وَهْوَ فِيهَا فَاجِرٌ لِيَقْتَطِعَ بِهَا مَالَ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ لَقِيَ اللَّهَ وَهْوَ عَلَيْهِ غَضْبَانُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ الأَشْعَثُ فِيَّ وَاللَّهِ كَانَ ذَلِكَ، كَانَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ أَرْضٌ فَجَحَدَنِي، فَقَدَّمْتُهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلَكَ بَيِّنَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ لِلْيَهُودِيِّ ‏"‏ احْلِفْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِذًا يَحْلِفَ، وَيَذْهَبَ بِمَالِي، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلاً‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man halafa 'alaa yamiynin wahwa fiyhaa faajirun liyaqtati'a bihaa maala amriiin muslimin laqiya alllaha wahwa 'alayhi ghadbaanu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faqaala alaash'athu fiyya waalllahi kaana dhalika, kaana bayniy wabayna rajulin mina alyahuwdi aardun fajahadaniy, faqaddamtuhu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aalaka bayyinaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu laa‏.‏ qaala faqaala lilyahuwdiyyi ‏"‏ ahlif ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iidhana yahlifa, wayadhhaba bimaaliy, faaanzala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏iinna alladhiyna yashtaruwna bi'ahdi alllahi waaaymaanihim thamanana qaliylaan‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever takes a false oath so as to take the property of a Muslim (illegally) will meet Allah while He will be angry with him." Al-Ash'ath said: By Allah, that saying concerned me. I had common land with a Jew, and the Jew later on denied my ownership, so I took him to the Prophet who asked me whether I had a proof of my ownership. When I replied in the negative, the Prophet asked the Jew to take an oath. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He will take an oath and deprive me of my property." So, Allah revealed the following verse: "Verily! Those who purchase a little gain at the cost of Allah's covenant and their oaths
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ تَقَاضَى ابْنَ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ دَيْنًا كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمَا حَتَّى سَمِعَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ فِي بَيْتِهِ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمَا، حَتَّى كَشَفَ سِجْفَ حُجْرَتِهِ فَنَادَى ‏"‏ يَا كَعْبُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ضَعْ مِنْ دَيْنِكَ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ، أَىِ الشَّطْرَ‏.‏ قَالَ لَقَدْ فَعَلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُمْ فَاقْضِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an ka'bin rda allh 'nh aannahu taqaadaa abna aabiy hadradin daynana kaana lahu 'alayhi fiy almasjidi, faartafa'at aaswaatuhumaa hattaa sami'ahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa fiy baytihi, fakharaja iilayhimaa, hattaa kashafa sijfa hujratihi fanaadaa ‏"‏ yaa ka'bu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala labbayka yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ da' min daynika hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faaawmaaa iilayhi, aaai alshhatra‏.‏ qaala laqad fa'altu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ qum faaqdihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b bin Malik:Ka`b demanded his debt back from Ibn Abi Hadrad in the Mosque and their voices grew louder till Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard them while he was in his house. He came out to them raising the curtain of his room and addressed Ka`b, "O Ka`b!" Ka`b replied, "Labaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." (He said to him), "Reduce your debt to one half," gesturing with his hand. Ka`b said, "I have done so, O Allah's Apostle!" On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to Ibn Abi Hadrad, "Get up and repay the debt, to him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ بْنَ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ، يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ عَلَى غَيْرِ مَا أَقْرَؤُهَا، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقْرَأَنِيهَا، وَكِدْتُ أَنْ أَعْجَلَ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَمْهَلْتُهُ حَتَّى انْصَرَفَ، ثُمَّ لَبَّبْتُهُ بِرِدَائِهِ فَجِئْتُ بِهِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ هَذَا يَقْرَأُ عَلَى غَيْرِ مَا أَقْرَأْتَنِيهَا، فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ أَرْسِلْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَرَأَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَكَذَا أُنْزِلَتْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَرَأْتُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَكَذَا أُنْزِلَتْ‏.‏ إِنَّ الْقُرْآنَ أُنْزِلَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَحْرُفٍ فَاقْرَءُوا مِنْهُ مَا تَيَسَّرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdin alqaariyyi, aannahu qaala sami'tu 'umara bna alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh yaquwlu sami'tu hishaama bna hakiymi bni hizaamin, yaqraau suwraaa alfurqaani 'alaa ghayri maa aaqrauuhaa, wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaqraaaniyhaa, wakidtu aan aa'jala 'alayhi, thumma aamhaltuhu hattaa ansarafa, thumma labbabtuhu biridaaiihi fajiitu bihi rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu iinniy sami'tu hadhaa yaqraau 'alaa ghayri maa aaqraataniyhaa, faqaala liy ‏"‏ aarsilhu ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala lahu ‏"‏ aqraa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaraaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ hakadhaa aunzilat ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala liy ‏"‏ aqraa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaraatu faqaala ‏"‏ hakadhaa aunzilat‏.‏ iinna alqurana aunzila 'alaa sab'aai aahrufin faaqra'uwa minhu maa tayassara ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:I heard Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam reciting Surat-al-Furqan in a way different to that of mine. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had taught it to me (in a different way). So, I was about to quarrel with him (during the prayer) but I waited till he finished, then I tied his garment round his neck and seized him by it and brought him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I have heard him reciting Surat-al-Furqan in a way different to the way you taught it to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to release him and asked Hisham to recite it. When he recited it, Allah's Apostle said, "It was revealed in this way." He then asked me to recite it. When I recited it, he said, "It was revealed in this way. The Qur'an has been revealed in seven different ways, so recite it in the way that is easier for you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ آمُرَ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَتُقَامَ ثُمَّ أُخَالِفَ إِلَى مَنَازِلِ قَوْمٍ لاَ يَشْهَدُونَ الصَّلاَةَ فَأُحَرِّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laqad hamamtu aan amura bialssalaaai fatuqaama thumma aukhaalifa iilaa manaazili qawmin laa yashhaduwna alssalaaaa faauharriqa 'alayhim ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No doubt, I intended to order somebody to pronounce the Iqama of the (compulsory congregational) prayer and then I would go to the houses of those who do not attend the prayer and burn their houses over them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ عَبْدَ بْنَ زَمْعَةَ، وَسَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، اخْتَصَمَا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ابْنِ أَمَةِ زَمْعَةَ فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَوْصَانِي أَخِي إِذَا قَدِمْتُ أَنْ أَنْظُرَ ابْنَ أَمَةِ زَمْعَةَ فَأَقْبِضَهُ، فَإِنَّهُ ابْنِي‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ بْنُ زَمْعَةَ أَخِي وَابْنُ أَمَةِ أَبِي، وُلِدَ عَلَى فِرَاشِ أَبِي‏.‏ فَرَأَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَبَهًا بَيِّنًا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هُوَ لَكَ يَا عَبْدُ بْنَ زَمْعَةَ، الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ، وَاحْتَجِبِي مِنْهُ يَا سَوْدَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna 'abda bna zam'aaa, wasa'da bna aabiy waqqaasin, akhtasamaa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy abni aamaai zam'aaa faqaala sa'dun yaa rasuwla alllahi aawsaaniy aakhiy iidhaa qadimtu aan aanzura abna aamaai zam'aaa faaaqbidahu, faiinnahu abniy‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu bnu zam'aaa aakhiy waabnu aamaai aabiy, wulida 'alaa firaashi aabiy‏.‏ faraaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm shabahana bayyinana faqaala ‏ "‏ huwa laka yaa 'abdu bna zam'aaa, alwaladu lilfiraashi, waahtajibiy minhu yaa sawdaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Abu bin Zam`a and Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas carried the case of their claim of the (ownership) of the son of a slave-girl of Zam`a before the Prophet. Sa`d said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My brother, before his death, told me that when I would return (to Mecca), I should search for the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a and take him into my custody as he was his son." 'Abu bin Zam`a said, 'He is my brother and the son of the slave-girl of my father, and was born on my father's bed." The Prophet (ﷺ) noticed a resemblance between `Utba and the boy but he said, "O 'Abu bin Zam`a! You will get this boy, as the son goes to the owner of the bed. You, Sauda, screen yourself from the boy
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْلاً قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ، فَجَاءَتْ بِرَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي حَنِيفَةَ يُقَالُ لَهُ ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ أُثَالٍ سَيِّدُ أَهْلِ الْيَمَامَةِ، فَرَبَطُوهُ بِسَارِيَةٍ مِنْ سَوَارِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا عِنْدَكَ يَا ثُمَامَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عِنْدِي يَا مُحَمَّدُ خَيْرٌ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَطْلِقُوا ثُمَامَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khaylaan qibala najdin, fajaa'at birajulin min baniy haniyfaaa yuqaalu lahu thumaamaau bnu authaalin sayyidu aahli alyamaamaai, farabatuwhu bisaariyaain min sawaariy almasjidi, fakharaja iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ maa 'indaka yaa thumaamaau ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'indiy yaa muhammadu khayrun‏.‏ fadhakara alhadiytha qaala ‏"‏ aatliquwa thumaamaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent horsemen to Najd and they arrested and brought a man called Thumama bin Uthal, the chief of Yamama, and they fastened him to one of the pillars of the Mosque. When Allah's Apostle came up to him; he asked, "What have you to say, O Thumama?" He replied, "I have good news, O Muhammad!" Abu Huraira narrated the whole narration which ended with the order of the Prophet "Release him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْلاً قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ، فَجَاءَتْ بِرَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي حَنِيفَةَ يُقَالُ لَهُ ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ أُثَالٍ فَرَبَطُوهُ بِسَارِيَةٍ مِنْ سَوَارِي الْمَسْجِدِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu aabiy sa'iydin, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala ba'atha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khaylaan qibala najdin, fajaa'at birajulin min baniy haniyfaaa yuqaalu lahu thumaamaau bnu authaalin farabatuwhu bisaariyaain min sawaariy almasjidi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent some horsemen to Najd and they arrested and brought a man called Thumama bin Uthal from the tribe of Bani Hanifa, and they fastened him to one of the pillars of the Mosque
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَهُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ الأَسْلَمِيِّ دَيْنٌ، فَلَقِيَهُ فَلَزِمَهُ، فَتَكَلَّمَا حَتَّى ارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمَا، فَمَرَّ بِهِمَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا كَعْبُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ كَأَنَّهُ يَقُولُ النِّصْفَ، فَأَخَذَ نِصْفَ مَا عَلَيْهِ وَتَرَكَ نِصْفًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, haddathanaa ja'faru bnu rabiy'aaa, ‏.‏ waqaala ghayruhu haddathaniy alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy ja'faru bnu rabiy'aaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni hurmuza, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni ka'bi bni maalikin alaansaariyyi, 'an ka'bi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aannahu kaana lahu 'alaa 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy hadradin alaaslamiyyi daynun, falaqiyahu falazimahu, fatakallamaa hattaa artafa'at aaswaatuhumaa, famarra bihimaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa ka'bu ‏"‏‏.‏ waaashaara biyadihi kaaannahu yaquwlu alnnisfa, faaakhadha nisfa maa 'alayhi wataraka nisfana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b bin Malik Al-Ansari from Ka`b bin Malik:That `Abdullah bin Abi Hadrad Al-Aslami owed him some debt. Ka`b met him and caught hold of him and they started talking and their voices grew loudest. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by them and addressed Ka`b, pointing out to him to reduce the debt to one half. So, Ka`b got one half of the debt and exempted the debtor from the other half
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — Khusoomaat
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ خَبَّابٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ قَيْنًا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَكَانَ لِي عَلَى الْعَاصِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ دَرَاهِمُ، فَأَتَيْتُهُ أَتَقَاضَاهُ فَقَالَ لاَ أَقْضِيكَ حَتَّى تَكْفُرَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ، فَقُلْتُ لاَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَكْفُرُ بِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى يُمِيتَكَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثَكَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَعْنِي حَتَّى أَمُوتَ ثُمَّ أُبْعَثَ فَأُوتَى مَالاً وَوَلَدًا، ثُمَّ أَقْضِيَكَ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَقَالَ لأُوتَيَنَّ مَالاً وَوَلَدًا‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyri bni haazimin, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an khabbaabin, qaala kuntu qaynana fiy aljaahiliyyaai wakaana liy 'alaa al'aasi bni waaiilin daraahimu, faaataytuhu aataqaadaahu faqaala laa aaqdiyka hattaa takfura bimuhammadin, faqultu laa waalllahi laa aakfuru bimuhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa yumiytaka alllahu thumma yab'athaka‏.‏ qaala fada'niy hattaa aamuwta thumma aub'atha faauwtaa maalaan wawaladana, thumma aaqdiyaka‏.‏ fanazalat ‏{‏aafaraaayta alladhiy kafara biayaatinaa waqaala lauwtayanna maalaan wawaladana‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Khabbab:I was a blacksmith In the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance, and 'Asi bin Wail owed me some money. I went to him to demand it, but he said to me, "I will not pay you unless you reject faith in Muhammad." I replied, "By Allah, I will never disbelieve Muhammad till Allah lets you die and then resurrects you." He said, "Then wait till I die and come to life again, for then I will be given property and offspring and will pay your right." So, thus revelation came: "Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our signs and yet says, 'I will be given property and offspring?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، سَمِعْتُ سُوَيْدَ بْنَ غَفَلَةَ، قَالَ لَقِيتُ أُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَقَالَ أَخَذْتُ صُرَّةً مِائَةَ دِينَارٍ فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا حَوْلاً‏"‏‏.‏ فَعَرَّفْتُهَا حَوْلَهَا فَلَمْ أَجِدْ مَنْ يَعْرِفُهَا، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا حَوْلاً ‏"‏ فَعَرَّفْتُهَا فَلَمْ أَجِدْ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ ثَلاَثًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ احْفَظْ وِعَاءَهَا وَعَدَدَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا، فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا، وَإِلاَّ فَاسْتَمْتِعْ بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَاسْتَمْتَعْتُ فَلَقِيتُهُ بَعْدُ بِمَكَّةَ فَقَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي ثَلاَثَةَ أَحْوَالٍ أَوْ حَوْلاً وَاحِدًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, ‏.‏ wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an salamaaa, sami'tu suwayda bna ghafalaaa, qaala laqiytu aubaaaa bna ka'bin rda allh 'nh faqaala aakhadhtu surraaan miaiaaa diynaarin faaataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ 'arrifhaa hawlaan‏"‏‏.‏ fa'arraftuhaa hawlahaa falam aajid man ya'rifuhaa, thumma aataytuhu faqaala ‏"‏ 'arrifhaa hawlaan ‏"‏ fa'arraftuhaa falam aajid, thumma aataytuhu thalaathana faqaala ‏"‏ ahfaz wi'aa'ahaa wa'adadahaa wawikaa'ahaa, faiin jaa'a saahibuhaa, waiilaaa faastamti' bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faastamta'tu falaqiytuhu ba'du bimakkaaa faqaala laa aadriy thalaathaaa aahwaalin aaw hawlaan waahidana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ubai bin Ka`b:I found a purse containing one hundred Diners. So I went to the Prophet (and informed him about it), he said, "Make public announcement about it for one year" I did so, but nobody turned up to claim it, so I again went to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "Make public announcement for another year." I did, but none turned up to claim it. I went to him for the third time and he said, "Keep the container and the string which is used for its tying and count the money it contains and if its owner comes, give it to him; otherwise, utilize it." The sub-narrator Salama said, "I met him (Suwaid, another sub-narrator) in Mecca and he said, 'I don't know whether Ubai made the announcement for three years or just one year
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ عَمَّا يَلْتَقِطُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً، ثُمَّ احْفَظْ عِفَاصَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا، فَإِنْ جَاءَ أَحَدٌ يُخْبِرُكَ بِهَا، وَإِلاَّ فَاسْتَنْفِقْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَضَالَّةُ الْغَنَمِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَكَ أَوْ لأَخِيكَ أَوْ لِلذِّئْبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ضَالَّةُ الإِبِلِ فَتَمَعَّرَ وَجْهُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ وَلَهَا، مَعَهَا حِذَاؤُهَا وَسِقَاؤُهَا، تَرِدُ الْمَاءَ وَتَأْكُلُ الشَّجَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'abbaasin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an rabiy'aaa, haddathaniy yaziydu, mawlaa almunba'ithi 'an zaydi bni khaalidin aljuhaniyyi rda allh 'nh qaala jaa'a aa'raabiyyun alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahu 'ammaa yaltaqituhu faqaala ‏"‏ 'arrifhaa sanaaan, thumma ahfaz 'ifaasahaa wawikaa'ahaa, faiin jaa'a aahadun yukhbiruka bihaa, waiilaaa faastanfiqhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi fadaallaau alghanami qaala ‏"‏ laka aaw laakhiyka aaw lildhhiibi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala daallaau aliibili fatama''ara wajhu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ maa laka walahaa, ma'ahaa hidhaauuhaa wasiqaauuhaa, taridu almaa'a wataakulu alshhajara ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:A bedouin went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him about picking up a lost thing. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Make public announcement about it for one year. Remember the description of its container and the string with which it is tied; and if somebody comes and claims it and describes it correctly, (give it to him); otherwise, utilize it." He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What about a lost sheep?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is for you, for your brother (i.e. its owner), or for the wolf." He further asked, "What about a lost camel?" On that the face of the Prophet (ﷺ) became red (with anger) and said, "You have nothing to do with it, as it has its feet, its water reserve and can reach places of water and drink, and eat trees
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ زَيْدَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ فَزَعَمَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ اعْرِفْ عِفَاصَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا، ثُمَّ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً ‏"‏‏.‏ يَقُولُ يَزِيدُ إِنْ لَمْ تُعْتَرَفِ اسْتَنْفَقَ بِهَا صَاحِبُهَا وَكَانَتْ وَدِيعَةً، عِنْدَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى فَهَذَا الَّذِي لاَ أَدْرِي أَفِي حَدِيثِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هُوَ أَمْ شَىْءٌ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ ـ ثُمَّ قَالَ كَيْفَ تَرَى فِي ضَالَّةِ الْغَنَمِ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ خُذْهَا فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ لَكَ أَوْ لأَخِيكَ أَوْ لِلذِّئْبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَزِيدُ وَهْىَ تُعَرَّفُ أَيْضًا‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ كَيْفَ تَرَى فِي ضَالَّةِ الإِبِلِ قَالَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دَعْهَا فَإِنَّ مَعَهَا حِذَاءَهَا وَسِقَاءَهَا، تَرِدُ الْمَاءَ وَتَأْكُلُ الشَّجَرَ، حَتَّى يَجِدَهَا رَبُّهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy sulaymaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an yaziyda, mawlaa almunba'ithi aannahu sami'a zayda bna khaalidin rda allh 'nh yaquwlu suiila alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani allluqataai faza'ama aannahu qaala ‏"‏ a'rif 'ifaasahaa wawikaa'ahaa, thumma 'arrifhaa sanaaan ‏"‏‏.‏ yaquwlu yaziydu iin lam tu'tarafi astanfaqa bihaa saahibuhaa wakaanat wadiy'aaan, 'indahu‏.‏ qaala yahyaa fahadhaa alladhiy laa aadriy aafiy hadiythi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm huwa aam shaa'un min 'indihi thumma qaala kayfa taraa fiy daallaai alghanami qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ khudhhaa faiinnamaa hiya laka aaw laakhiyka aaw lildhhiibi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaziydu wahaa tu'arrafu aaydana‏.‏ thumma qaala kayfa taraa fiy daallaai aliibili qaala faqaala ‏"‏ da'haa faiinna ma'ahaa hidhaa'ahaa wasiqaa'ahaa, taridu almaa'a wataakulu alshhajara, hattaa yajidahaa rabbuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sulaiman bin Bilal from Yahya:Yazid Maula Al-Munba'ith heard Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about Luqata. He said, 'Remember the description of its container and the string it is tied with, and announce it publicly for one year.' " Yazid added, "If nobody claims then the person who has found it can spend it, and it is regarded as a trust entrusted to him." Yahya said, "I do not know whether the last sentences were said by the Prophet (ﷺ) or by Yazid." Zaid further said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked, 'What about a lost sheep?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Take it, for it is for you or for your brother (i.e. its owner) or for the wolf." Yazid added that it should also be announced publicly. The man then asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about a lost camel. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave it, as it has its feet, water container (reservoir), and it will reach a place of water and eat trees till its owner finds it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اعْرِفْ عِفَاصَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا، ثُمَّ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً، فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا، وَإِلاَّ فَشَأْنَكَ بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَضَالَّةُ الْغَنَمِ قَالَ ‏"‏ هِيَ لَكَ أَوْ لأَخِيكَ أَوْ لِلذِّئْبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَضَالَّةُ الإِبِلِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ وَلَهَا، مَعَهَا سِقَاؤُهَا وَحِذَاؤُهَا، تَرِدُ الْمَاءَ وَتَأْكُلُ الشَّجَرَ، حَتَّى يَلْقَاهَا رَبُّهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an yaziyda, mawlaa almunba'ithi 'an zaydi bni khaalidin rda allh 'nh qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahu 'ani allluqataai‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ a'rif 'ifaasahaa wawikaa'ahaa, thumma 'arrifhaa sanaaan, faiin jaa'a saahibuhaa, waiilaaa fashaanaka bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fadaallaau alghanami qaala ‏"‏ hiya laka aaw laakhiyka aaw lildhhiibi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fadaallaau aliibili qaala ‏"‏ maa laka walahaa, ma'ahaa siqaauuhaa wahidhaauuhaa, taridu almaa'a wataakulu alshhajara, hattaa yalqaahaa rabbuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid:A man came and asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about picking a lost thing. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Remember the description of its container and the string it is tied with, and make public announcement about it for one year. If the owner shows up, give it to him; otherwise, do whatever you like with it." He then asked, "What about a lost sheep?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is for you, for your brother (i.e. its owner), or for the wolf." He further asked, "What about a lost camel?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is none of your concern. It has its water-container (reservoir) and its feet, and it will reach water and drink it and eat the trees till its owner finds it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ رَجُلاً مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ ـ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ ـ ‏ "‏فَخَرَجَ يَنْظُرُ لَعَلَّ مَرْكَبًا قَدْ جَاءَ بِمَالِهِ، فَإِذَا هُوَ بِالْخَشَبَةِ فَأَخَذَهَا لأَهْلِهِ حَطَبًا، فَلَمَّا نَشَرَهَا وَجَدَ الْمَالَ وَالصَّحِيفَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy ja'faru bnu rabiy'aaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni hurmuza, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu dhakara rajulaan min baniy iisraaiiyla wasaaqa alhadiytha ‏ "‏fakharaja yanzuru la'alla markabana qad jaa'a bimaalihi, faiidhaa huwa bialkhashabaai faaakhadhahaa laahlihi hatabana, falammaa nasharahaa wajada almaala waalssahiyfaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdur-Rahman bin Hurmuz:Abu Hurairah (ra) said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned an Israeli man." Abu Hurairah then told the whole narration). (At the end of the narration it was mentioned that the creditor) went out to the sea, hoping that a boat might have brought his money. Suddenly he saw a piece of wood and he took it to his house to use as firewood. When he sawed it, he found his money and a letter in it. [See hadith No. 2291 for details]
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِتَمْرَةٍ فِي الطَّرِيقِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْلاَ أَنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الصَّدَقَةِ لأَكَلْتُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ حَدَّثَنِي مَنْصُورٌ وَقَالَ زَائِدَةُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an talhaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala marra alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bitamraain fiy alttariyqi qaala ‏ "‏ lawlaa aanniy aakhaafu aan takuwna mina alssadaqaai laakaltuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala yahyaa haddathanaa sufyaanu haddathaniy mansuwrun waqaala zaaiidaau 'an mansuwrin 'an talhaaa haddathanaa aanasun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed a date fallen on the way and said, "Were I not afraid that it may be from a Sadaqa (charitable gifts), I would have eaten it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لأَنْقَلِبُ إِلَى أَهْلِي، فَأَجِدُ التَّمْرَةَ سَاقِطَةً عَلَى فِرَاشِي فَأَرْفَعُهَا لآكُلَهَا، ثُمَّ أَخْشَى أَنْ تَكُونَ صَدَقَةً فَأُلْفِيَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy laanqalibu iilaa aahliy, faaajidu alttamraaa saaqitaaan 'alaa firaashiy faaarfa'uhaa lakulahaa, thumma aakhshaa aan takuwna sadaqaaan faaulfiyahaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sometimes when I return home and find a date fallen on my bed, I pick it up in order to eat it, but I fear that it might be from a Sadaqa, so I throw it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: وَقَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يُعْضَدُ عِضَاهُهَا، وَلاَ يُنَفَّرُ صَيْدُهَا، وَلاَ تَحِلُّ لُقَطَتُهَا إِلاَّ لِمُنْشِدٍ، وَلاَ يُخْتَلَى خَلاَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبَّاسٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala aahmadu bnu sa'iydin haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu diynaarin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa yu'dadu 'idaahuhaa, walaa yunaffaru sayduhaa, walaa tahillu luqatatuhaa iilaaa limunshidin, walaa yukhtalaa khalaahaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala 'abbaasun yaa rasuwla alllahi iilaaa aliidhkhira‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iilaaa aliidhkhira ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas (ra):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also said, "It (i.e., Makkah's) thorny bushes should not be uprooted and its game should not be chased, and picking up its fallen things is illegal except by him who makes public announcement about it, and its grass should not be cut." 'Abbas said, "O Allah's Messenger ! Except Idhkhir (a kind of grass)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Except Idhkhir
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَّةَ قَامَ فِي النَّاسِ، فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ، وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَبَسَ عَنْ مَكَّةَ الْفِيلَ، وَسَلَّطَ عَلَيْهَا رَسُولَهُ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ، فَإِنَّهَا لاَ تَحِلُّ لأَحَدٍ كَانَ قَبْلِي، وَإِنَّهَا أُحِلَّتْ لِي سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ، وَإِنَّهَا لاَ تَحِلُّ لأَحَدٍ بَعْدِي، فَلاَ يُنَفَّرُ صَيْدُهَا وَلاَ يُخْتَلَى شَوْكُهَا، وَلاَ تَحِلُّ سَاقِطَتُهَا إِلاَّ لِمُنْشِدٍ، وَمَنْ قُتِلَ لَهُ قَتِيلٌ فَهْوَ بِخَيْرِ النَّظَرَيْنِ، إِمَّا أَنْ يُفْدَى، وَإِمَّا أَنْ يُقِيدَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْعَبَّاسُ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ، فَإِنَّا نَجْعَلُهُ لِقُبُورِنَا وَبُيُوتِنَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ أَبُو شَاهٍ ـ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ ـ فَقَالَ اكْتُبُوا لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اكْتُبُوا لأَبِي شَاهٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِلأَوْزَاعِيِّ مَا قَوْلُهُ اكْتُبُوا لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ هَذِهِ الْخُطْبَةَ الَّتِي سَمِعَهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, qaala haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala haddathaniy aabuw hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa fataha alllahu 'alaa rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm makkaaa qaama fiy alnnaasi, fahamida alllaha, waaathnaa 'alayhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha habasa 'an makkaaa alfiyla, wasallata 'alayhaa rasuwlahu waalmuuminiyna, faiinnahaa laa tahillu laahadin kaana qabliy, waiinnahaa auhillat liy saa'aaan min nahaarin, waiinnahaa laa tahillu laahadin ba'diy, falaa yunaffaru sayduhaa walaa yukhtalaa shawkuhaa, walaa tahillu saaqitatuhaa iilaaa limunshidin, waman qutila lahu qatiylun fahwa bikhayri alnnazarayni, iimmaa aan yufdaa, waiimmaa aan yuqiyda ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala al'abbaasu iilaaa aliidhkhira, faiinnaa naj'aluhu liqubuwrinaa wabuyuwtinaa‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iilaaa aliidhkhira ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaama aabuw shaahin rajulun min aahli alyamani faqaala aktubuwa liy yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aktubuwa laabiy shaahin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu lilaawzaa'iyyi maa qawluhu aktubuwa liy yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala hadhihi alkhutbaaa allatiy sami'ahaa min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:When Allah gave victory to His Apostle over the people of Mecca, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up among the people and after glorifying Allah, said, "Allah has prohibited fighting in Mecca and has given authority to His Apostle and the believers over it, so fighting was illegal for anyone before me, and was made legal for me for a part of a day, and it will not be legal for anyone after me. Its game should not be chased, its thorny bushes should not be uprooted, and picking up its fallen things is not allowed except for one who makes public announcement for it, and he whose relative is murdered has the option either to accept a compensation for it or to retaliate." Al-`Abbas said, "Except Al-Idhkhir, for we use it in our graves and houses." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Except Al-Idhkhir." Abu Shah, a Yemenite, stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Get it written for me." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Write it for Abu Shah." (The sub-narrator asked Al-Auza'i): What did he mean by saying, "Get it written, O Allah's Apostle?" He replied, "The speech which he had heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحْلُبَنَّ أَحَدٌ مَاشِيَةَ امْرِئٍ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِ، أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ تُؤْتَى مَشْرُبَتُهُ فَتُكْسَرَ خِزَانَتُهُ، فَيُنْتَقَلَ طَعَامُهُ فَإِنَّمَا تَخْزُنُ لَهُمْ ضُرُوعُ مَوَاشِيهِمْ أَطْعِمَاتِهِمْ، فَلاَ يَحْلُبَنَّ أَحَدٌ مَاشِيَةَ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yahlubanna aahadun maashiyaaa amriiin bighayri iidhnihi, aayuhibbu aahadukum aan tuutaa mashrubatuhu fatuksara khizaanatuhu, fayuntaqala ta'aamuhu faiinnamaa takhzunu lahum duruw'u mawaashiyhim aat'imaatihim, falaa yahlubanna aahadun maashiyaaa aahadin iilaaa biiidhnihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "An animal should not be milked without the permission of its owner. Does any of you like that somebody comes to his store and breaks his container and takes away his food? The udders of the animals are the stores of their owners where their provision is kept, so nobody should milk the animals of somebody else, without the permission of its owner
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً، ثُمَّ اعْرِفْ وِكَاءَهَا وَعِفَاصَهَا، ثُمَّ اسْتَنْفِقْ بِهَا، فَإِنْ جَاءَ رَبُّهَا فَأَدِّهَا إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَضَالَّةُ الْغَنَمِ قَالَ ‏"‏ خُذْهَا فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ لَكَ أَوْ لأَخِيكَ أَوْ لِلذِّئْبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَضَالَّةُ الإِبِلِ قَالَ فَغَضِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى احْمَرَّتْ وَجْنَتَاهُ ـ أَوِ احْمَرَّ وَجْهُهُ ـ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ وَلَهَا، مَعَهَا حِذَاؤُهَا وَسِقَاؤُهَا، حَتَّى يَلْقَاهَا رَبُّهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an yaziyda, mawlaa almunba'ithi 'an zaydi bni khaalidin aljuhaniyyi rda allh 'nh aanna rajulaan saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani allluqataai qaala ‏"‏ 'arrifhaa sanaaan, thumma a'rif wikaa'ahaa wa'ifaasahaa, thumma astanfiq bihaa, faiin jaa'a rabbuhaa faaaddihaa iilayhi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi fadaallaau alghanami qaala ‏"‏ khudhhaa faiinnamaa hiya laka aaw laakhiyka aaw lildhhiibi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, fadaallaau aliibili qaala faghadiba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa ahmarrat wajnataahu aawi ahmarra wajhuhu thumma qaala ‏"‏ maa laka walahaa, ma'ahaa hidhaauuhaa wasiqaauuhaa, hattaa yalqaahaa rabbuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:A man asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the Luqata. He said, "Make public announcement of it for one year, then remember the description of its container and the string it is tied with, utilize the money, and if its owner comes back after that, give it to him." The people asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What about a lost sheep?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Take it, for it is for you, for your brother, or for the wolf." The man asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What about a lost camel?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got angry and his cheeks or face became red, and said, "You have no concern with it as it has its feet, and its watercontainer, till its owner finds it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُوَيْدَ بْنَ غَفَلَةَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ سَلْمَانَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ صُوحَانَ فِي غَزَاةٍ، فَوَجَدْتُ سَوْطًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِي أَلْقِهِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لاَ، وَلَكِنْ إِنْ وَجَدْتُ صَاحِبَهُ، وَإِلاَّ اسْتَمْتَعْتُ بِهِ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا رَجَعْنَا حَجَجْنَا فَمَرَرْتُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ، فَسَأَلْتُ أُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَقَالَ وَجَدْتُ صُرَّةً عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهَا مِائَةُ دِينَارٍ، فَأَتَيْتُ بِهَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا حَوْلاً ‏"‏‏.‏ فَعَرَّفْتُهَا حَوْلاً ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا حَوْلاً ‏"‏‏.‏ فَعَرَّفْتُهَا حَوْلاً ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا حَوْلاً ‏"‏‏.‏ فَعَرَّفْتُهَا حَوْلاً ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ الرَّابِعَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اعْرِفْ عِدَّتَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا وَوِعَاءَهَا، فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا وَإِلاَّ اسْتَمْتِعْ بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an salamaaa bni kuhaylin, qaala sami'tu suwayda bna ghafalaaa, qaala kuntu ma'a salmaana bni rabiy'aaa, wazaydi bni suwhaana fiy ghazaaain, fawajadtu sawtana‏.‏ faqaala liy aalqihi‏.‏ qultu laa, walakin iin wajadtu saahibahu, waiilaaa astamta'tu bihi‏.‏ falammaa raja'naa hajajnaa famarartu bialmadiynaai, fasaaaltu aubaaaa bna ka'bin rda allh 'nh faqaala wajadtu surraaan 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhaa miaiaau diynaarin, faaataytu bihaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ 'arrifhaa hawlaan ‏"‏‏.‏ fa'arraftuhaa hawlaan thumma aataytu, faqaala ‏"‏ 'arrifhaa hawlaan ‏"‏‏.‏ fa'arraftuhaa hawlaan thumma aataytuhu, faqaala ‏"‏ 'arrifhaa hawlaan ‏"‏‏.‏ fa'arraftuhaa hawlaan thumma aataytuhu alrraabi'aaa faqaala ‏"‏ a'rif 'iddatahaa wawikaa'ahaa wawi'aa'ahaa, faiin jaa'a saahibuhaa waiilaaa astamti' bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Suwaid bin Ghafala:While I was in the company of Salman bin Rabi`a and Suhan, in one of the holy battles, I found a whip. One of them told me to drop it but I refused to do so and said that I would give it to its owner if I found him, otherwise I would utilize it. On our return we performed Hajj and on passing by Medina, I asked Ubai bin Ka`b about it. He said, "I found a bag containing a hundred Dinars in the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) and took it to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said to me, 'Make public announcement about it for one year.' So, I announced it for one year and went to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, 'Announce it publicly for another year.' So, I announced it for another year. I went to him again and he said, "Announce for another year." So I announced for still another year. I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) for the fourth time, and he said, 'Remember the amount of money, the description of its container and the string it is tied with, and if the owner comes, give it to him; otherwise, utilize it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، بِهَذَا قَالَ فَلَقِيتُهُ بَعْدُ بِمَكَّةَ، فَقَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي أَثَلاَثَةَ أَحْوَالٍ أَوْ حَوْلاً وَاحِدًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an shu'baaa, 'an salamaaa, bihadhaa qaala falaqiytuhu ba'du bimakkaaa, faqaala laa aadriy aathalaathaaa aahwaalin aaw hawlaan waahidana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salama:the above narration (Hadith 616) from Ubai bin Ka`b: adding, "I met the sub-narrator at Mecca later on, but he did not remember whether Ka`b had announced what he had found one year or three years
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً، فَإِنْ جَاءَ أَحَدٌ يُخْبِرُكَ بِعِفَاصِهَا وَوِكَائِهَا، وَإِلاَّ فَاسْتَنْفِقْ بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ضَالَّةِ الإِبِلِ فَتَمَعَّرَ وَجْهُهُ، قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ وَلَهَا مَعَهَا سِقَاؤُهَا وَحِذَاؤُهَا، تَرِدُ الْمَاءَ وَتَأْكُلُ الشَّجَرَ، دَعْهَا حَتَّى يَجِدَهَا رَبُّهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ضَالَّةِ الْغَنَمِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هِيَ لَكَ أَوْ لأَخِيكَ، أَوْ لِلذِّئْبِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an rabiy'aaa, 'an yaziyda, mawlaa almunba'ithi 'an zaydi bni khaalidin rda allh 'nh aanna aa'raabiyyana, saaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani allluqataai qaala ‏"‏ 'arrifhaa sanaaan, faiin jaa'a aahadun yukhbiruka bi'ifaasihaa wawikaaiihaa, waiilaaa faastanfiq bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ wasaaalahu 'an daallaai aliibili fatama''ara wajhuhu, qaala ‏"‏ maa laka walahaa ma'ahaa siqaauuhaa wahidhaauuhaa, taridu almaa'a wataakulu alshhajara, da'haa hattaa yajidahaa rabbuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ wasaaalahu 'an daallaai alghanami‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ hiya laka aaw laakhiyka, aaw lildhhiibi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid:A bedouin asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the Luqata. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Make public announcement about it for one year and if then somebody comes and describes the container of the Luqata and the string it was tied with, (give it to him); otherwise, spend it." He then asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about a lost camel. The face of the Prophet (ﷺ) became red and he said, "You have no concern with it as it has its water reservoir and feet and it will reach water and drink and eat trees. Leave it till its owner finds it." He then asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about a lost sheep. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is for you, for your brother, or for the wolf
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْبَرَاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ، فَإِذَا أَنَا بِرَاعِي غَنَمٍ يَسُوقُ غَنَمَهُ فَقُلْتُ لِمَنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ‏.‏ فَسَمَّاهُ فَعَرَفْتُهُ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ هَلْ فِي غَنَمِكَ مِنْ لَبَنٍ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ هَلْ أَنْتَ حَالِبٌ لِي قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَأَمَرْتُهُ فَاعْتَقَلَ شَاةً مِنْ غَنَمِهِ، ثُمَّ أَمَرْتُهُ أَنْ يَنْفُضَ ضَرْعَهَا مِنَ الْغُبَارِ، ثُمَّ أَمَرْتُهُ أَنْ يَنْفُضَ كَفَّيْهِ، فَقَالَ هَكَذَا ـ ضَرَبَ إِحْدَى كَفَّيْهِ بِالأُخْرَى ـ فَحَلَبَ كُثْبَةً مِنْ لَبَنٍ وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِدَاوَةً عَلَى فَمِهَا خِرْقَةٌ، فَصَبَبْتُ عَلَى اللَّبَنِ، حَتَّى بَرَدَ أَسْفَلُهُ، فَانْتَهَيْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ اشْرَبْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَشَرِبَ حَتَّى رَضِيتُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alnnadru, aakhbaranaa iisraaiiylu, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala aakhbaraniy albaraa'u, 'an aabiy bakrin rda allh 'nhma ‏.‏ haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu rajaa'in, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i, 'an aabiy bakrin rda allh 'nhma qaala antalaqtu, faiidhaa aanaa biraa'iy ghanamin yasuwqu ghanamahu faqultu liman aanta qaala lirajulin min qurayshin‏.‏ fasammaahu fa'araftuhu‏.‏ faqultu hal fiy ghanamika min labanin faqaala na'am‏.‏ faqultu hal aanta haalibun liy qaala na'am‏.‏ faaamartuhu faa'taqala shaaaan min ghanamihi, thumma aamartuhu aan yanfuda dar'ahaa mina alghubaari, thumma aamartuhu aan yanfuda kaffayhi, faqaala hakadhaa daraba iihdaa kaffayhi bialaukhraa fahalaba kuthbaaan min labanin waqad ja'altu lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidaawaaan 'alaa famihaa khirqaaun, fasababtu 'alaa alllabani, hattaa barada aasfaluhu, faantahaytu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu ashrab yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ fashariba hattaa radiytu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakr:While I was on my way, all of a sudden I saw a shepherd driving his sheep, I asked him whose servant he was. He replied that he was the servant of a man from Quraish, and then he mentioned his name and I recognized him. I asked, "Do your sheep have some milk?" He replied in the affirmative. I said, "Are you going to milk for me?" He replied in the affirmative. I ordered him and he tied the legs of one of the sheep. Then I told him to clean the udder (teats) of dust and to remove dust off his hands. He removed the dust off his hands by clapping his hands. He then milked a little milk. I put the milk for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a pot and closed its mouth with a piece of cloth and poured water over it till it became cold. I took it to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Drink, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He drank it till I was pleased
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 46 — Oppressions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا خَلَصَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ حُبِسُوا بِقَنْطَرَةٍ بَيْنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ، فَيَتَقَاصُّونَ مَظَالِمَ كَانَتْ بَيْنَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا، حَتَّى إِذَا نُقُّوا وَهُذِّبُوا أُذِنَ لَهُمْ بِدُخُولِ الْجَنَّةِ، فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ لأَحَدُهُمْ بِمَسْكَنِهِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَدَلُّ بِمَنْزِلِهِ كَانَ فِي الدُّنْيَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُتَوَكِّلِ‏.‏
