verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شِهَابُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا أَقْبَلَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَمَعَهُ غُلاَمُهُ وَهْوَ يَطْلُبُ الإِسْلاَمَ، فَأَضَلَّ أَحَدُهُمَا صَاحِبَهُ بِهَذَا، وَقَالَ أَمَا إِنِّي أُشْهِدُكَ أَنَّهُ لِلَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shihaabu bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu humaydin, 'an iismaa'iyla, 'an qaysin, qaala lammaa aaqbala aabuw hurayraaa rda allh 'nh wama'ahu ghulaamuhu wahwa yatlubu aliislaama, faaadalla aahaduhumaa saahibahu bihadhaa, waqaala aamaa iinniy aushhiduka aannahu lillahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qais:When Abu Huraira accompanied by his slave came intending to embrace Islam, they lost each other on the way. (When the slave showed up) Abu Huraira said (to the Prophet), "I make you witness that the slave is free for Allah's Cause
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ إِنَّ عُتْبَةَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَهِدَ إِلَى أَخِيهِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ أَنْ يَقْبِضَ إِلَيْهِ ابْنَ وَلِيدَةِ زَمْعَةَ، قَالَ عُتْبَةُ إِنَّهُ ابْنِي‏.‏ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَمَنَ الْفَتْحِ أَخَذَ سَعْدٌ ابْنَ وَلِيدَةِ زَمْعَةَ‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ بِهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَقْبَلَ مَعَهُ بِعَبْدِ بْنِ زَمْعَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا ابْنُ أَخِي عَهِدَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ابْنُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ بْنُ زَمْعَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا أَخِي ابْنُ وَلِيدَةِ زَمْعَةَ، وُلِدَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ‏.‏ فَنَظَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى ابْنِ وَلِيدَةِ زَمْعَةَ، فَإِذَا هُوَ أَشْبَهُ النَّاسِ بِهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هُوَ لَكَ يَا عَبْدُ بْنَ زَمْعَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُ وُلِدَ عَلَى فِرَاشِ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ احْتَجِبِي مِنْهُ يَا سَوْدَةُ بِنْتَ زَمْعَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ مِمَّا رَأَى مِنْ شَبَهِهِ بِعُتْبَةَ‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ سَوْدَةُ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat iinna 'utbaaa bna aabiy waqqaasin 'ahida iilaa aakhiyhi sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin aan yaqbida iilayhi abna waliydaai zam'aaa, qaala 'utbaau iinnahu abniy‏.‏ falammaa qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm zamana alfathi aakhadha sa'dun abna waliydaai zam'aaa‏.‏ faaaqbala bihi iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaaqbala ma'ahu bi'abdi bni zam'aaa‏.‏ faqaala sa'dun yaa rasuwla alllahi hadhaa abnu aakhiy 'ahida iilaaaa aannahu abnuhu‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu bnu zam'aaa yaa rasuwla alllahi hadhaa aakhiy abnu waliydaai zam'aaa, wulida 'alaa firaashihi‏.‏ fanazara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa abni waliydaai zam'aaa, faiidhaa huwa aashbahu alnnaasi bihi, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ huwa laka yaa 'abdu bna zam'aaa ‏"‏‏.‏ min aajli aannahu wulida 'alaa firaashi aabiyhi, qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ ahtajibiy minhu yaa sawdaau binta zam'aaa ‏"‏‏.‏ mimmaa raaaa min shabahihi bi'utbaaa‏.‏ wakaanat sawdaau zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:`Utba bin Abi Waqqas authorized his brother Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas to take the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a into his custody, telling him that the boy was his own (illegal) son. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went (to Mecca) at the time of the Conquest, Sa`d took the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and also brought 'Abu bin Zam`a with him and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is the son of my brother `Utba who authorized me to take him into my custody." 'Abu bin Zam`a said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He is my brother, the son of Zam`a's slave-girl and he was born on his bed." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked at the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a and noticed much resemblance (to `Utba). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is for you, O 'Abu bin Zam`a as he was born on the bed of your father." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then told Sauda bint Zam`a to observe veil in the presence of the boy as he noticed the boy's resemblance to `Utba and Sauda was the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَعْتَقَ رَجُلٌ مِنَّا عَبْدًا لَهُ عَنْ دُبُرٍ، فَدَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهِ فَبَاعَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ جَابِرٌ مَاتَ الْغُلاَمُ عَامَ أَوَّلَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu bnu aabiy iiyaasin, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu diynaarin, sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala aa'taqa rajulun minnaa 'abdana lahu 'an duburin, fada'aa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bihi fabaa'ahu‏.‏ qaala jaabirun maata alghulaamu 'aama aawwala‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:A man amongst us declared that his slave would be freed after his death. The Prophet (ﷺ) called for that slave and sold him. The slave died the same year
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعِ الْوَلاَءِ، وَعَنْ هِبَتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu diynaarin, sami'tu abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an bay'i alwalaa'i, wa'an hibatihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the selling or donating the Wala' of a freed slave
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتِ اشْتَرَيْتُ بَرِيرَةَ فَاشْتَرَطَ أَهْلُهَا وَلاَءَهَا، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَعْتِقِيهَا، فَإِنَّ الْوَلاَءَ لِمَنْ أَعْطَى الْوَرِقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَعْتَقْتُهَا، فَدَعَاهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَيَّرَهَا مِنْ زَوْجِهَا فَقَالَتْ لَوْ أَعْطَانِي كَذَا وَكَذَا مَا ثَبَتُّ عِنْدَهُ‏.‏ فَاخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalati ashtaraytu bariyraaa faashtarata aahluhaa walaa'ahaa, fadhakartu dhalika lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ aa'tiqiyhaa, faiinna alwalaa'a liman aa'taa alwariqa ‏"‏‏.‏ faaa'taqtuhaa, fada'aahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fakhayyarahaa min zawjihaa faqaalat law aa'taaniy kadhaa wakadhaa maa thabattu 'indahu‏.‏ faakhtaarat nafsahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I bought Barirah but her masters put the condition that her Wala' would be for them. I told the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. He said (to me), "Manumit (free) her as her Wala' will be for the one who pays the price." So, I manumitted (freed) her. The Prophet (ﷺ) called Barirah and gave her the option of either staying with her husband or leaving him. She said, "Even if he gave me so much money, I would not stay with him," and so she preferred her freedom to her husband
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسٌ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رِجَالاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ اسْتَأْذَنُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا ائْذَنْ فَلْنَتْرُكْ لاِبْنِ أُخْتِنَا عَبَّاسٍ فِدَاءَهُ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَدَعُونَ مِنْهُ دِرْهَمًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma bni 'uqbaaa, 'an muwsaa, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy aanasun rda allh 'nh aanna rijaalaan, mina alaansaari astaadhanuwa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa aidhan falnatruk laibni aukhtinaa 'abbaasin fidaa'ahu, faqaala ‏ "‏ laa tada'uwna minhu dirhamana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Some men of the Ansar asked for the permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "Allow us to give up the ransom from our nephew Al-`Abbas. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to them), "Do not leave (even) a Dirham (of his ransom)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي أَنَّ حَكِيمَ بْنَ حِزَامٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَعْتَقَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ مِائَةَ رَقَبَةٍ، وَحَمَلَ عَلَى مِائَةِ بَعِيرٍ، فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَ حَمَلَ عَلَى مِائَةِ بَعِيرٍ وَأَعْتَقَ مِائَةَ رَقَبَةٍ، قَالَ فَسَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَرَأَيْتَ أَشْيَاءَ كُنْتُ أَصْنَعُهَا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، كُنْتُ أَتَحَنَّثُ بِهَا، يَعْنِي أَتَبَرَّرُ بِهَا، قَالَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَسْلَمْتَ عَلَى مَا سَلَفَ لَكَ مِنْ خَيْرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, aakhbaraniy aabiy aanna hakiyma bna hizaamin rda allh 'nh aa'taqa fiy aljaahiliyyaai miaiaaa raqabaain, wahamala 'alaa miaiaai ba'iyrin, falammaa aaslama hamala 'alaa miaiaai ba'iyrin waaa'taqa miaiaaa raqabaain, qaala fasaaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, aaraaayta aashyaa'a kuntu aasna'uhaa fiy aljaahiliyyaai, kuntu aatahannathu bihaa, ya'niy aatabarraru bihaa, qaala faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aaslamta 'alaa maa salafa laka min khayrin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hisham:My father told me that Hakim bin Hizam manumitted one-hundred slaves in the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance and slaughtered one-hundred camels (and distributed them in charity). When he embraced Islam he again slaughtered one-hundred camels and manumitted one-hundred slaves. Hakim said, "I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do you think about some good deeds I used to practice in the Pre-Islamic period of ignorance regarding them as deeds of righteousness?' Allah's Apostle said, "You have embraced Islam along with all those good deeds you did
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، ذَكَرَ عُرْوَةُ أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ، وَالْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَاهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ حِينَ جَاءَهُ وَفْدُ هَوَازِنَ، فَسَأَلُوهُ أَنْ يَرُدَّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَسَبْيَهُمْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ مَعِي مَنْ تَرَوْنَ، وَأَحَبُّ الْحَدِيثِ إِلَىَّ أَصْدَقُهُ، فَاخْتَارُوا إِحْدَى الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ إِمَّا الْمَالَ، وَإِمَّا السَّبْىَ، وَقَدْ كُنْتُ اسْتَأْنَيْتُ بِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم انْتَظَرَهُمْ بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ لَيْلَةً حِينَ قَفَلَ مِنَ الطَّائِفِ، فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرُ رَادٍّ إِلَيْهِمْ إِلاَّ إِحْدَى الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ قَالُوا فَإِنَّا نَخْتَارُ سَبْيَنَا‏.‏ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي النَّاسِ، فَأَثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنَّ إِخْوَانَكُمْ جَاءُونَا تَائِبِينَ، وَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُ أَنْ أَرُدَّ إِلَيْهِمْ سَبْيَهُمْ، فَمَنْ أَحَبَّ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يُطَيِّبَ ذَلِكَ فَلْيَفْعَلْ، وَمَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ عَلَى حَظِّهِ حَتَّى نُعْطِيَهُ إِيَّاهُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ مَا يُفِيءُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا فَلْيَفْعَلْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّاسُ طَيَّبْنَا ذَلِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّا لاَ نَدْرِي مَنْ أَذِنَ مِنْكُمْ مِمَّنْ لَمْ يَأْذَنْ فَارْجِعُوا حَتَّى يَرْفَعَ إِلَيْنَا عُرَفَاؤُكُمْ أَمْرَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ النَّاسُ، فَكَلَّمَهُمْ عُرَفَاؤُهُمْ، ثُمَّ رَجَعُوا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرُوهُ أَنَّهُمْ طَيَّبُوا وَأَذِنُوا، فَهَذَا الَّذِي بَلَغَنَا عَنْ سَبْىِ هَوَازِنَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَنَسٌ قَالَ عَبَّاسٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَادَيْتُ نَفْسِي، وَفَادَيْتُ عَقِيلاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy maryama, qaala aakhbaraniy alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, dhakara 'urwaau aanna marwaana, waalmiswara bna makhramaaa, aakhbaraahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama hiyna jaa'ahu wafdu hawaazina, fasaaaluwhu aan yarudda iilayhim aamwaalahum wasabyahum faqaala ‏"‏ iinna ma'iy man tarawna, waaahabbu alhadiythi iilaaaa aasdaquhu, faakhtaaruwa iihdaa alttaaiifatayni iimmaa almaala, waiimmaa alssabaa, waqad kuntu astaanaytu bihim ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm antazarahum bid'a 'ashraaa laylaaan hiyna qafala mina alttaaiifi, falammaa tabayyana lahum aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ghayru raaddin iilayhim iilaaa iihdaa alttaaiifatayni qaaluwa faiinnaa nakhtaaru sabyanaa‏.‏ faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alnnaasi, faaathnaa 'alaa alllahi bimaa huwa aahluhu, thumma qaala ‏"‏ aammaa ba'du faiinna iikhwaanakum jaa'uwnaa taaiibiyna, waiinniy raaaytu aan aarudda iilayhim sabyahum, faman aahabba minkum aan yutayyiba dhalika falyaf'al, waman aahabba aan yakuwna 'alaa hazzihi hattaa nu'tiyahu iiyyaahu min aawwali maa yufiy'u alllahu 'alaynaa falyaf'al ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala alnnaasu tayyabnaa dhalika‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinnaa laa nadriy man aadhina minkum mimman lam yaadhan faarji'uwa hattaa yarfa'a iilaynaa 'urafaauukum aamrakum ‏"‏‏.‏ faraja'a alnnaasu, fakallamahum 'urafaauuhum, thumma raja'uwa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbaruwhu aannahum tayyabuwa waaadhinuwa, fahadhaa alladhiy balaghanaa 'an sabai hawaazina‏.‏ waqaala aanasun qaala 'abbaasun lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faadaytu nafsiy, wafaadaytu 'aqiylaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Marwan and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:When the delegates of the tribe of Hawazin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and they requested him to return their properties and captives. The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up and said to them, "I have other people with me in this matter (as you see) and the most beloved statement to me is the true one; you may choose either the properties or the prisoners as I have delayed their distribution." The Prophet (ﷺ) had waited for them for more than ten days since his arrival from Ta'if. So, when it became evident to them that the Prophet (ﷺ) was not going to return them except one of the two, they said, "We choose our prisoners." The Prophet got up amongst the people and glorified and praised Allah as He deserved and said, "Then after, these brethren of yours have come to us with repentance, and I see it logical to return them the captives. So, whoever amongst you likes to do that as a favor, then he can do it, and whoever of you likes to stick to his share till we recompense him from the very first war booty which Allah will give us, then he can do so (i.e. give up the present captives)." The people unanimously said, "We do that (return the captives) willingly." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We do not know which of you has agreed to it and which have not, so go back and let your leaders forward us your decision." So, all the people then went back and discussed the matter with their leaders who returned and informed the Prophet (ﷺ) that all the people had willingly given their consent to return the captives. This is what has reached us about the captives of Hawazin. Narrated Anas that `Abbas said to the Prophet, "I paid for my ransom and `Aqil's ransom
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، قَالَ كَتَبْتُ إِلَى نَافِعٍ فَكَتَبَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَغَارَ عَلَى بَنِي الْمُصْطَلِقِ وَهُمْ غَارُّونَ وَأَنْعَامُهُمْ تُسْقَى عَلَى الْمَاءِ، فَقَتَلَ مُقَاتِلَتَهُمْ، وَسَبَى ذَرَارِيَّهُمْ، وَأَصَابَ يَوْمَئِذٍ جُوَيْرِيَةَ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنِي بِهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَكَانَ فِي ذَلِكَ الْجَيْشِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu alhasani, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa abnu 'awnin, qaala katabtu iilaa naafi'in fakataba iilaaaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aaghaara 'alaa baniy almustaliqi wahum ghaarruwna waaan'aamuhum tusqaa 'alaa almaa'i, faqatala muqaatilatahum, wasabaa dharaariyyahum, waaasaaba yawmaiidhin juwayriyaaa‏.‏ haddathaniy bihi 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara, wakaana fiy dhalika aljayshi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Aun:I wrote a letter to Nafi` and Nafi` wrote in reply to my letter that the Prophet (ﷺ) had suddenly attacked Bani Mustaliq without warning while they were heedless and their cattle were being watered at the places of water. Their fighting men were killed and their women and children were taken as captives; the Prophet (ﷺ) got Juwairiya on that day. Nafi` said that Ibn `Umar had told him the above narration and that Ibn `Umar was in that army
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةِ بَنِي الْمُصْطَلِقِ فَأَصَبْنَا سَبْيًا مِنْ سَبْىِ الْعَرَبِ، فَاشْتَهَيْنَا النِّسَاءَ فَاشْتَدَّتْ عَلَيْنَا الْعُزْبَةُ وَأَحْبَبْنَا الْعَزْلَ، فَسَأَلْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ لاَ تَفْعَلُوا، مَا مِنْ نَسَمَةٍ كَائِنَةٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلاَّ وَهْىَ كَائِنَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an muhammadi bni yahyaa bni habbaana, 'ani abni muhayriyzin, qaala raaaytu aabaa sa'iydin rda allh 'nh fasaaaltuhu faqaala kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazwaai baniy almustaliqi faaasabnaa sabyana min sabai al'arabi, faashtahaynaa alnnisaa'a faashtaddat 'alaynaa al'uzbaau waaahbabnaa al'azla, fasaaalnaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ maa 'alaykum aan laa taf'aluwa, maa min nasamaain kaaiinaain iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai iilaaa wahaa kaaiinaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Muhairiz:I saw Abu Sa`id and asked him about coitus interruptus. Abu Sa`id said, "We went with Allah's Apostle, in the Ghazwa of Bani Al-Mustaliq and we captured some of the 'Arabs as captives, and the long separation from our wives was pressing us hard and we wanted to practice coitus interruptus. We asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (whether it was permissible). He said, "It is better for you not to do so. No soul, (that which Allah has) destined to exist, up to the Day of Resurrection, but will definitely come, into existence
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لاَ أَزَالُ أُحِبُّ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ سَلاَمٍ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ‏.‏ وَعَنْ عُمَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ مَا زِلْتُ أُحِبُّ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ مُنْذُ ثَلاَثٍ سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِيهِمْ، سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ هُمْ أَشَدُّ أُمَّتِي عَلَى الدَّجَّالِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَجَاءَتْ صَدَقَاتُهُمْ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَذِهِ صَدَقَاتُ قَوْمِنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ سَبِيَّةٌ مِنْهُمْ عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَعْتِقِيهَا فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an 'umaaraaa bni alqa'qaa'i, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala laa aazaalu auhibbu baniy tamiymin‏.‏ wahaddathaniy abnu salaamin aakhbaranaa jariyru bnu 'abdi alhamiydi 'ani almughiyraai 'ani alhaarithi 'an aabiy zur'aaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa‏.‏ wa'an 'umaaraaa 'an aabiy zur'aaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa qaala maa ziltu auhibbu baniy tamiymin mundhu thalaathin sami'tu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu fiyhim, sami'tuhu yaquwlu ‏"‏ hum aashaddu aummatiy 'alaa alddajjaali ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala wajaa'at sadaqaatuhum, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hadhihi sadaqaatu qawminaa ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaanat sabiyyaaun minhum 'inda 'aaiishaaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aa'tiqiyhaa faiinnahaa min waladi iismaa'iyla ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I have loved the people of the tribe of Bani Tamim ever since I heard, three things, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said about them. I heard him saying, These people (of the tribe of Bani Tamim) would stand firm against Ad-Dajjal." When the Sadaqat (gifts of charity) from that tribe came, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "These are the Sadaqat (i.e. charitable gifts) of our folk." `Aisha had a slave-girl from that tribe, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to `Aisha, "Manumit her as she is a descendant of Ishmael (the Prophet)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، سَمِعَ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ جَارِيَةٌ فَعَالَهَا، فَأَحْسَنَ إِلَيْهَا ثُمَّ أَعْتَقَهَا وَتَزَوَّجَهَا، كَانَ لَهُ أَجْرَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, sami'a muhammada bna fudaylin, 'an mutarrifin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man kaanat lahu jaariyaaun fa'aalahaa, faaahsana iilayhaa thumma aa'taqahaa watazawwajahaa, kaana lahu aajraani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He who has a slave-girl and educates and treats her nicely and then manumits and marries her, will get a double reward
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا وَاصِلٌ الأَحْدَبُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْمَعْرُورَ بْنَ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ الْغِفَارِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَعَلَيْهِ حُلَّةٌ وَعَلَى غُلاَمِهِ حُلَّةٌ فَسَأَلْنَاهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَابَبْتُ رَجُلاً فَشَكَانِي إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ لِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَعَيَّرْتَهُ بِأُمِّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ إِخْوَانَكُمْ خَوَلُكُمْ جَعَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ تَحْتَ أَيْدِيكُمْ، فَمَنْ كَانَ أَخُوهُ تَحْتَ يَدِهِ فَلْيُطْعِمْهُ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ، وَلْيُلْبِسْهُ مِمَّا يَلْبَسُ، وَلاَ تُكَلِّفُوهُمْ مَا يَغْلِبُهُمْ، فَإِنْ كَلَّفْتُمُوهُمْ مَا يَغْلِبُهُمْ فَأَعِينُوهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu bnu aabiy iiyaasin, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa waasilun alaahdabu, qaala sami'tu alma'ruwra bna suwaydin, qaala raaaytu aabaa dharrin alghifaariyya rda allh 'nh wa'alayhi hullaaun wa'alaa ghulaamihi hullaaun fasaaalnaahu 'an dhalika faqaala iinniy saababtu rajulaan fashakaaniy iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, faqaala liya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aa'ayyartahu biaummihi ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinna iikhwaanakum khawalukum ja'alahumu alllahu tahta aaydiykum, faman kaana aakhuwhu tahta yadihi falyut'imhu mimmaa yaakulu, walyulbishu mimmaa yalbasu, walaa tukallifuwhum maa yaghlibuhum, faiin kallaftumuwhum maa yaghlibuhum faaa'iynuwhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Ma'rur bin Suwaid:I saw Abu Dhar Al-Ghifari wearing a cloak, and his slave, too, was wearing a cloak. We asked him about that (i.e. how both were wearing similar cloaks). He replied, "Once I abused a man and he complained of me to the Prophet (ﷺ) . The Prophet (ﷺ) asked me, 'Did you abuse him by slighting his mother?' He added, 'Your slaves are your brethren upon whom Allah has given you authority. So, if one has one's brethren under one's control, one should feed them with the like of what one eats and clothe them with the like of what one wears. You should not overburden them with what they cannot bear, and if you do so, help them (in their hard job)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْعَبْدُ إِذَا نَصَحَ سَيِّدَهُ وَأَحْسَنَ عِبَادَةَ رَبِّهِ كَانَ لَهُ أَجْرُهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ al'abdu iidhaa nasaha sayyidahu waaahsana 'ibaadaaa rabbihi kaana lahu aajruhu marratayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a slave is honest and faithful to his master and worships his Lord (Allah) in a perfect manner, he will get a double reward
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ كَانَتْ لَهُ جَارِيَةٌ فَأَدَّبَهَا فَأَحْسَنَ تَأْدِيبَهَا، وَأَعْتَقَهَا وَتَزَوَّجَهَا، فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ، وَأَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ أَدَّى حَقَّ اللَّهِ وَحَقَّ مَوَالِيهِ، فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an saalihin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi rda allh 'nh qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aayyumaa rajulin kaanat lahu jaariyaaun faaaddabahaa faaahsana taadiybahaa, waaa'taqahaa watazawwajahaa, falahu aajraani, waaayyumaa 'abdin aaddaa haqqa alllahi wahaqqa mawaaliyhi, falahu aajraani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has a slave-girl and teaches her good manners and improves her education and then manumits and marries her, will get a double reward; and any slave who observes Allah's right and his master's right will get a double reward
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لِلْعَبْدِ الْمَمْلُوكِ الصَّالِحِ أَجْرَانِ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَوْلاَ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالْحَجُّ وَبِرُّ أُمِّي، لأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أَمُوتَ وَأَنَا مَمْلُوكٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa bishru bnu muhammadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, sami'tu sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, yaquwlu qaala aabuw hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ lil'abdi almamluwki alssaalihi aajraani, waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi lawlaa aljihaadu fiy sabiyli alllahi waalhajju wabirru aummiy, laahbabtu aan aamuwta waaanaa mamluwkun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A pious slave gets a double reward." Abu Huraira added: By Him in Whose Hands my soul is but for Jihad (i.e. holy battles), Hajj, and my duty to serve my mother, I would have loved to die as a slave
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نِعْمَ مَا لأَحَدِهِمْ يُحْسِنُ عِبَادَةَ رَبِّهِ وَيَنْصَحُ لِسَيِّدِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu nasrin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, haddathanaa aabuw saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ni'ma maa laahadihim yuhsinu 'ibaadaaa rabbihi wayansahu lisayyidihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Goodness and comfort are for him who worships his Lord in a perfect manner and serves his master sincerely
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا نَصَحَ الْعَبْدُ سَيِّدَهُ، وَأَحْسَنَ عِبَادَةَ رَبِّهِ، كَانَ لَهُ أَجْرُهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, haddathaniy naafi'un, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa nasaha al'abdu sayyidahu, waaahsana 'ibaadaaa rabbihi, kaana lahu aajruhu marratayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a slave serves his Saiyid (i.e. master) sincerely and worships his Lord (Allah) perfectly, he will get a double reward
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمَمْلُوكُ الَّذِي يُحْسِنُ عِبَادَةَ رَبِّهِ، وَيُؤَدِّي إِلَى سَيِّدِهِ الَّذِي لَهُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ وَالنَّصِيحَةِ وَالطَّاعَةِ، لَهُ أَجْرَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ almamluwku alladhiy yuhsinu 'ibaadaaa rabbihi, wayuuaddiy iilaa sayyidihi alladhiy lahu 'alayhi mina alhaqqi waalnnasiyhaai waalttaa'aai, lahu aajraani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Mamluk (slave) who worships his Lord in a perfect manner, and is dutiful, sincere and obedient to his Saiyid (master), will get a double reward
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَقُلْ أَحَدُكُمْ أَطْعِمْ رَبَّكَ، وَضِّئْ رَبَّكَ، اسْقِ رَبَّكَ‏.‏ وَلْيَقُلْ سَيِّدِي مَوْلاَىَ‏.‏ وَلاَ يَقُلْ أَحَدُكُمْ عَبْدِي أَمَتِي‏.‏ وَلْيَقُلْ فَتَاىَ وَفَتَاتِي وَغُلاَمِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh yuhaddithu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ laa yaqul aahadukum aat'im rabbaka, waddii rabbaka, asqi rabbaka‏.‏ walyaqul sayyidiy mawlaaaa‏.‏ walaa yaqul aahadukum 'abdiy aamatiy‏.‏ walyaqul fataaaa wafataatiy waghulaamiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You should not say, 'Feed your lord (Rabbaka), help your lord in performing ablution, or give water to your lord, but should say, 'my master (e.g. Feed your master instead of lord etc.) (Saiyidi), or my guardian (Maulai), and one should not say, my slave (Abdi), or my girl-slave (Amati), but should say, my lad (Fatai), my lass (Fatati), and 'my boy (Ghulami)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ نَصِيبًا لَهُ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ، فَكَانَ لَهُ مِنَ الْمَالِ مَا يَبْلُغُ قِيمَتَهُ، يُقَوَّمُ عَلَيْهِ قِيمَةَ عَدْلٍ، وَأُعْتِقَ مِنْ مَالِهِ، وَإِلاَّ فَقَدْ عَتَقَ مِنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aa'taqa nasiybana lahu mina al'abdi, fakaana lahu mina almaali maa yablughu qiymatahu, yuqawwamu 'alayhi qiymaaa 'adlin, waau'tiqa min maalihi, waiilaaa faqad 'ataqa minhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If one manumits his share of a common slave (Abd), and he has money sufficient to free the remaining portion of the price of the slave (justly estimated), then he should free the slave completely by paying the rest of his price; otherwise the slave is freed partly
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ فَمَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، فَالأَمِيرُ الَّذِي عَلَى النَّاسِ رَاعٍ وَهْوَ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْهُمْ، وَالرَّجُلُ رَاعٍ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَهْوَ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْهُمْ، وَالْمَرْأَةُ رَاعِيَةٌ عَلَى بَيْتِ بَعْلِهَا وَوَلَدِهِ وَهْىَ مَسْئُولَةٌ عَنْهُمْ، وَالْعَبْدُ رَاعٍ عَلَى مَالِ سَيِّدِهِ وَهْوَ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْهُ، أَلاَ فَكُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy naafi'un, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ kullukum raa'in famasiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi, faalaamiyru alladhiy 'alaa alnnaasi raa'in wahwa masiuwlun 'anhum, waalrrajulu raa'in 'alaa aahli baytihi wahwa masiuwlun 'anhum, waalmaraaau raa'iyaaun 'alaa bayti ba'lihaa wawaladihi wahaa masiuwlaaun 'anhum, waal'abdu raa'in 'alaa maali sayyidihi wahwa masiuwlun 'anhu, aalaa fakullukum raa'in wakullukum masiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Everyone of you is a guardian and is responsible for his charges. The ruler who has authority over people, is a guardian and is responsible for them, a man is a guardian of his family and is responsible for them; a woman is a guardian of her husband's house and children and is responsible for them; a slave ('Abu) is a guardian of his master's property and is responsible for it; so all of you are guardians and are responsible for your charges
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، وَزَيْدَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ، رضى الله عنهما عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا زَنَتِ الأَمَةُ فَاجْلِدُوهَا، ثُمَّ إِذَا زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا، ثُمَّ إِذَا زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا، فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوِ الرَّابِعَةِ بِيعُوهَا وَلَوْ بِضَفِيرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi, sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, wazayda bna khaalidin, rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa zanati alaamaau faajliduwhaa, thumma iidhaa zanat faajliduwhaa, thumma iidhaa zanat faajliduwhaa, fiy althhaalithaai aawi alrraabi'aai biy'uwhaa walaw bidafiyrin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a slave-girl (Ama) commits illegal sexual intercourse, scourge her; if she does it again, scourge her again; if she repeats it, scourge her again." The narrator added that on the third or the fourth offense, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sell her even for a hair rope
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَتَى أَحَدَكُمْ خَادِمُهُ بِطَعَامِهِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يُجْلِسْهُ مَعَهُ، فَلْيُنَاوِلْهُ لُقْمَةً أَوْ لُقْمَتَيْنِ أَوْ أُكْلَةً أَوْ أُكْلَتَيْنِ، فَإِنَّهُ وَلِيَ عِلاَجَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy muhammadu bnu ziyaadin, sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aataa aahadakum khaadimuhu bita'aamihi, faiin lam yujlishu ma'ahu, falyunaawilhu luqmaaan aaw luqmatayni aaw auklaaan aaw auklatayni, faiinnahu waliya 'ilaajahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When your servant brings your meals to you then if he does not let him sit and share the meals, then he should at least give him a mouthful or two mouthfuls of that meal or a meal or two meals, as he has prepared it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَمَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، فَالإِمَامُ رَاعٍ وَمَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، وَالرَّجُلُ فِي أَهْلِهِ رَاعٍ وَهْوَ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، وَالْمَرْأَةُ فِي بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا رَاعِيَةٌ وَهْىَ مَسْئُولَةٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهَا، وَالْخَادِمُ فِي مَالِ سَيِّدِهِ رَاعٍ وَهْوَ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَمِعْتُ هَؤُلاَءِ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَحْسِبُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالرَّجُلُ فِي مَالِ أَبِيهِ رَاعٍ وَمَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، فَكُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ kullukum raa'in wamasiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi, faaliimaamu raa'in wamasiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi, waalrrajulu fiy aahlihi raa'in wahwa masiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi, waalmaraaau fiy bayti zawjihaa raa'iyaaun wahaa masiuwlaaun 'an ra'iyyatihaa, waalkhaadimu fiy maali sayyidihi raa'in wahwa masiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fasami'tu hauulaa'i mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaahsibu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ waalrrajulu fiy maali aabiyhi raa'in wamasiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi, fakullukum raa'in wakullukum masiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Everyone of you is a guardian and is responsible for his charge; the ruler is a guardian and is responsible for his subjects; the man is a guardian in his family and responsible for his charges; a woman is a guardian of her husband's house and responsible for her charges; and the servant is a guardian of his master's property and is responsible for his charge." I definitely heard the above from the Prophet (ﷺ) and think that the Prophet (ﷺ) also said, "A man is a guardian of his father's property and responsible for his charges; so everyone of you is a guardian and responsible for his charges
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — Manumission of Slaves
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ فُلاَنٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا قَاتَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَجْتَنِبِ الْوَجْهَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydi alllahi, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, qaala haddathaniy maaliku bnu aanasin, qaala waaakhbaraniy abnu fulaanin, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaamin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa qaatala aahadukum falyajtanibi alwajha ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody fights (or beats somebody) then he should avoid the face
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 50 — Makaatib
verses.original: وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ عُرْوَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ إِنَّ بَرِيرَةَ دَخَلَتْ عَلَيْهَا تَسْتَعِينُهَا فِي كِتَابَتِهَا وَعَلَيْهَا خَمْسَةُ أَوَاقٍ، نُجِّمَتْ عَلَيْهَا فِي خَمْسِ سِنِينَ، فَقَالَتْ لَهَا عَائِشَةُ وَنَفِسَتْ فِيهَا أَرَأَيْتِ إِنْ عَدَدْتُ لَهُمْ عَدَّةً وَاحِدَةً، أَيَبِيعُكِ أَهْلُكِ، فَأُعْتِقَكِ، فَيَكُونَ وَلاَؤُكِ لِي فَذَهَبَتْ بَرِيرَةُ إِلَى أَهْلِهَا، فَعَرَضَتْ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالُوا لاَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَنَا الْوَلاَءُ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اشْتَرِيهَا فَأَعْتِقِيهَا، فَإِنَّمَا الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ رِجَالٍ يَشْتَرِطُونَ شُرُوطًا لَيْسَتْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، مَنِ اشْتَرَطَ شَرْطًا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَهْوَ بَاطِلٌ، شَرْطُ اللَّهِ أَحَقُّ وَأَوْثَقُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala 'urwaau qaalat 'aaiishaau rda allh 'nha iinna bariyraaa dakhalat 'alayhaa tasta'iynuhaa fiy kitaabatihaa wa'alayhaa khamsaau aawaaqin, nujjimat 'alayhaa fiy khamsi siniyna, faqaalat lahaa 'aaiishaau wanafisat fiyhaa aaraaayti iin 'adadtu lahum 'addaaan waahidaaan, aayabiy'uki aahluki, faau'tiqaki, fayakuwna walaauuki liy fadhahabat bariyraau iilaa aahlihaa, fa'aradat dhalika 'alayhim faqaaluwa laa iilaaa aan yakuwna lanaa alwalaa'u‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau fadakhaltu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakartu dhalika lahu‏.‏ faqaala lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ ashtariyhaa faaa'tiqiyhaa, faiinnamaa alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ maa baalu rijaalin yashtarituwna shuruwtana laysat fiy kitaabi alllahi, mani ashtarata shartana laysa fiy kitaabi alllahi fahwa baatilun, shartu alllahi aahaqqu waaawthaqu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Aishah (ra) that Barira came to seek her help in writing of emancipation and she had to pay five Uqiya (of gold) by five yearly installments. 'Aishah said to her, "Do you think that if I pay the whole sum at once, your masters will sell you to me, and I will free you and your Wala' will be for me." Barira went to her masters and told them about that offer. They said that they would not agree to it unless her Wala' would be for them. 'Aishah further said, "I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him about it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to her, "Buy Barira and manumit her and the Wala' will be for the liberator." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then got up and said, "What about those people who stipulate conditions that are not present in Allah's Laws? If anybody stipulates a condition which is not in Allah's Laws, then what he stipulates is invalid. Allah's Condition (Laws) are the truth and are more solid
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 50 — Makaatib
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ بَرِيرَةَ جَاءَتْ تَسْتَعِينُهَا فِي كِتَابَتِهَا، وَلَمْ تَكُنْ قَضَتْ مِنْ كِتَابَتِهَا شَيْئًا، قَالَتْ لَهَا عَائِشَةُ ارْجِعِي إِلَى أَهْلِكِ، فَإِنْ أَحَبُّوا أَنْ أَقْضِيَ عَنْكِ كِتَابَتَكِ، وَيَكُونَ وَلاَؤُكِ لِي فَعَلْتُ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ بَرِيرَةُ لأَهْلِهَا فَأَبَوْا وَقَالُوا إِنْ شَاءَتْ أَنْ تَحْتَسِبَ عَلَيْكِ فَلْتَفْعَلْ، وَيَكُونَ وَلاَؤُكِ لَنَا، فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ابْتَاعِي فَأَعْتِقِي، فَإِنَّمَا الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ أُنَاسٍ يَشْتَرِطُونَ شُرُوطًا لَيْسَتْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مَنِ اشْتَرَطَ شَرْطًا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ لَهُ، وَإِنْ شَرَطَ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ، شَرْطُ اللَّهِ أَحَقُّ وَأَوْثَقُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aakhbarathu aanna bariyraaa jaa'at tasta'iynuhaa fiy kitaabatihaa, walam takun qadat min kitaabatihaa shayiana, qaalat lahaa 'aaiishaau arji'iy iilaa aahliki, faiin aahabbuwa aan aaqdiya 'anki kitaabataki, wayakuwna walaauuki liy fa'altu‏.‏ fadhakarat dhalika bariyraau laahlihaa faaabawa waqaaluwa iin shaa'at aan tahtasiba 'alayki faltaf'al, wayakuwna walaauuki lanaa, fadhakarat dhalika lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ abtaa'iy faaa'tiqiy, faiinnamaa alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala thumma qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ maa baalu aunaasin yashtarituwna shuruwtana laysat fiy kitaabi alllahi mani ashtarata shartana laysa fiy kitaabi alllahi falaysa lahu, waiin sharata miaiaaa marraain, shartu alllahi aahaqqu waaawthaqu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa:That `Aisha told him that Barirah came to seek her help in her writing of emancipation (for a certain sum) and that time she had not paid anything of it. `Aisha said to her, "Go back to your masters, and if they agree that I will pay the amount of your writing of emancipation and get your Wala', I will do so." Barirah informed her masters of that but they refused and said, "If she (i.e. `Aisha) is seeking Allah's reward, then she can do so, but your Wala' will be for us." `Aisha mentioned that to Allah's Apostle who said to her, "Buy and manumit (free) her, as the Wala' is for the liberator." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then got up and said, "What about the people who stipulate conditions which are not present in Allah's Laws? Whoever imposes conditions which are not present in Allah's Laws, then those conditions will be invalid, even if he imposed these conditions a hundred times. Allah's conditions (Laws) are the truth and are more solid
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 50 — Makaatib
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَرَادَتْ عَائِشَةُ أُمُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنْ تَشْتَرِيَ جَارِيَةً لِتُعْتِقَهَا، فَقَالَ أَهْلُهَا عَلَى أَنَّ وَلاَءَهَا لَنَا‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَمْنَعُكِ ذَلِكِ، فَإِنَّمَا الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala aaraadat 'aaiishaau aummu almuuminiyna aan tashtariya jaariyaaan litu'tiqahaa, faqaala aahluhaa 'alaa aanna walaa'ahaa lanaa‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yamna'uki dhaliki, faiinnamaa alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Aisha wanted to buy a slave-girl in order to manumit her. The girl's masters stipulated that her Wala' would be for them. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to `Aisha), "What they stipulate should not stop you, for the Wala' is for the liberator
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 50 — Makaatib
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ جَاءَتْ بَرِيرَةُ فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي كَاتَبْتُ أَهْلِي عَلَى تِسْعِ أَوَاقٍ، فِي كُلِّ عَامٍ وَقِيَّةٌ، فَأَعِينِينِي‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ إِنْ أَحَبَّ أَهْلُكِ أَنْ أَعُدَّهَا لَهُمْ عَدَّةً وَاحِدَةً، وَأُعْتِقَكِ فَعَلْتُ، وَيَكُونَ وَلاَؤُكِ لِي‏.‏ فَذَهَبَتْ إِلَى أَهْلِهَا، فَأَبَوْا ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهَا، فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي قَدْ عَرَضْتُ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَأَبَوْا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ الْوَلاَءُ لَهُمْ‏.‏ فَسَمِعَ بِذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَنِي فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ خُذِيهَا، فَأَعْتِقِيهَا، وَاشْتَرِطِي لَهُمُ الْوَلاَءَ، فَإِنَّمَا الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي النَّاسِ، فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ، وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ، فَمَا بَالُ رِجَالٍ مِنْكُمْ يَشْتَرِطُونَ شُرُوطًا لَيْسَتْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَأَيُّمَا شَرْطٍ لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَهْوَ بَاطِلٌ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مِائَةَ شَرْطٍ، فَقَضَاءُ اللَّهِ أَحَقُّ، وَشَرْطُ اللَّهِ أَوْثَقُ، مَا بَالُ رِجَالٍ مِنْكُمْ يَقُولُ أَحَدُهُمْ أَعْتِقْ يَا فُلاَنُ وَلِيَ الْوَلاَءُ إِنَّمَا الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat jaa'at bariyraau faqaalat iinniy kaatabtu aahliy 'alaa tis'i aawaaqin, fiy kulli 'aamin waqiyyaaun, faaa'iyniyniy‏.‏ faqaalat 'aaiishaau iin aahabba aahluki aan aa'uddahaa lahum 'addaaan waahidaaan, waau'tiqaki fa'altu, wayakuwna walaauuki liy‏.‏ fadhahabat iilaa aahlihaa, faaabawa dhalika 'alayhaa, faqaalat iinniy qad 'aradtu dhalika 'alayhim, faaabawa iilaaa aan yakuwna alwalaa'u lahum‏.‏ fasami'a bidhalika rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalaniy faaakhbartuhu, faqaala ‏"‏ khudhiyhaa, faaa'tiqiyhaa, waashtaritiy lahumu alwalaa'a, faiinnamaa alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alnnaasi, fahamida alllaha, waaathnaa 'alayhi, thumma qaala ‏"‏ aammaa ba'du, famaa baalu rijaalin minkum yashtarituwna shuruwtana laysat fiy kitaabi alllahi faaayyumaa shartin laysa fiy kitaabi alllahi fahwa baatilun, waiin kaana miaiaaa shartin, faqadaa'u alllahi aahaqqu, washartu alllahi aawthaqu, maa baalu rijaalin minkum yaquwlu aahaduhum aa'tiq yaa fulaanu waliya alwalaa'u iinnamaa alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Barirah came (to `Aisha) and said, "I have made a contract of emancipation with my masters for nine Uqiyas (of gold) to be paid in yearly installments. Therefore, I seek your help." `Aisha said, "If your masters agree, I will pay them the sum at once and free you on condition that your Wala' will be for me." Barirah went to her masters but they refused that offer. She (came back) and said, "I presented to them the offer but they refused, unless the Wala' was for them." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard of that and asked me about it, and I told him about it. On that he said, "Buy and manumit her and stipulate that the Wala' should be for you, as Wala' is for the liberator." `Aisha added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then got up amongst the people, Glorified and Praised Allah, and said, 'Then after: What about some people who impose conditions which are not present in Allah's Laws? So, any condition which is not present in Allah's Laws is invalid even if they were one-hundred conditions. Allah's ordinance is the truth, and Allah's condition is stronger and more solid. Why do some men from you say, O so-and-so! manumit the slave but the Wala will be for me? Verily, the Wala is for the liberator
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 50 — Makaatib
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ بَرِيرَةَ، جَاءَتْ تَسْتَعِينُ عَائِشَةَ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فَقَالَتْ لَهَا إِنْ أَحَبَّ أَهْلُكِ أَنْ أَصُبَّ لَهُمْ ثَمَنَكِ صَبَّةً وَاحِدَةً فَأُعْتِقَكِ فَعَلْتُ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَتْ بَرِيرَةُ ذَلِكَ لأَهْلِهَا، فَقَالُوا لاَ‏.‏ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ وَلاَؤُكِ لَنَا‏.‏ قَالَ مَالِكٌ قَالَ يَحْيَى فَزَعَمَتْ عَمْرَةُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اشْتَرِيهَا وَأَعْتِقِيهَا، فَإِنَّمَا الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna bariyraaa, jaa'at tasta'iynu 'aaiishaaa aumma almuuminiyna rda allh 'nha faqaalat lahaa iin aahabba aahluki aan aasubba lahum thamanaki sabbaaan waahidaaan faau'tiqaki fa'altu‏.‏ fadhakarat bariyraau dhalika laahlihaa, faqaaluwa laa‏.‏ iilaaa aan yakuwna walaauuki lanaa‏.‏ qaala maalikun qaala yahyaa faza'amat 'amraau aanna 'aaiishaaa dhakarat dhalika lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ ashtariyhaa waaa'tiqiyhaa, faiinnamaa alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amra bint `Abdur-Rahman:Barirah went to Aisha, the mother of the faithful believers to seek her help in her emancipation Aisha said to her, "If your masters agree, I will pay them your price in a lump sum and manumit (free) you." Barirah mentioned that offer to her masters but they refused to sell her unless the Wala' was for them. `Aisha told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it. He said, "Buy and manumit her as the Wala' is for the liberator
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 50 — Makaatib
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ أَيْمَنَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي أَيْمَنُ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فَقُلْتُ كُنْتُ غُلاَمًا لِعُتْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي لَهَبٍ، وَمَاتَ وَوَرِثَنِي بَنُوهُ، وَإِنَّهُمْ بَاعُونِي مِنَ ابْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو، فَأَعْتَقَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي عَمْرٍو، وَاشْتَرَطَ بَنُو عُتْبَةَ الْوَلاَءَ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ دَخَلَتْ بَرِيرَةُ وَهْىَ مُكَاتَبَةٌ فَقَالَتِ اشْتَرِينِي وَأَعْتِقِينِي‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَتْ لاَ يَبِيعُونِي حَتَّى يَشْتَرِطُوا وَلاَئِي‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ لاَ حَاجَةَ لِي بِذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَسَمِعَ بِذَلِكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ بَلَغَهُ، فَذَكَرَ لِعَائِشَةَ، فَذَكَرَتْ عَائِشَةُ مَا قَالَتْ لَهَا، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اشْتَرِيهَا وَأَعْتِقِيهَا، وَدَعِيهِمْ يَشْتَرِطُونَ مَا شَاءُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَاشْتَرَتْهَا عَائِشَةُ فَأَعْتَقَتْهَا وَاشْتَرَطَ أَهْلُهَا الْوَلاَءَ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ، وَإِنِ اشْتَرَطُوا مِائَةَ شَرْطٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu aaymana, qaala haddathaniy aabiy aaymanu, qaala dakhaltu 'alaa 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha faqultu kuntu ghulaamana li'utbaaa bni aabiy lahabin, wamaata wawarithaniy banuwhu, waiinnahum baa'uwniy mina abni aabiy 'amrinw, faaa'taqaniy abnu aabiy 'amrinw, waashtarata banuw 'utbaaa alwalaa'a‏.‏ faqaalat dakhalat bariyraau wahaa mukaatabaaun faqaalati ashtariyniy waaa'tiqiyniy‏.‏ qaalat na'am‏.‏ qaalat laa yabiy'uwniy hattaa yashtarituwa walaaiiy‏.‏ faqaalat laa haajaaa liy bidhalika‏.‏ fasami'a bidhalika alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aaw balaghahu, fadhakara li'aaiishaaa, fadhakarat 'aaiishaau maa qaalat lahaa, faqaala ‏"‏ ashtariyhaa waaa'tiqiyhaa, wada'iyhim yashtarituwna maa shaa'uwa ‏"‏‏.‏ faashtarathaa 'aaiishaau faaa'taqathaa waashtarata aahluhaa alwalaa'a, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alwalaa'u liman aa'taqa, waiini ashtaratuwa miaiaaa shartin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdul Wahid bin Aiman:I went to `Aisha and said, "I was the slave of `Utba bin Abu Lahab. "Utba died and his sons became my masters who sold me to Ibn Abu `Amr who manumitted me. The sons of `Utba stipulated that my Wala' should be for them." `Aisha said, "Barirah came to me and she was given the writing of emancipation by her masters and she asked me to buy and manumit her. I agreed to it, but Barirah told me that her masters would not sell her unless her Wala' was for them." `Aisha said, "I am not in need of that." When the Prophet (ﷺ) heard that, or he was told about it, he asked `Aisha about it. `Aisha mentioned what Barirah had told her. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Buy and manumit (free) her and let them stipulate whatever they like." So, `Aisha bought and manumitted her and her masters stipulated that her Wala' should be for them." The Prophet;, said, "The Wala' will be for the liberator even if they stipulated a hundred conditions
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 51 — Gifts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، ‏{‏عَنْ أَبِيهِ،‏}‏ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا نِسَاءَ الْمُسْلِمَاتِ لاَ تَحْقِرَنَّ جَارَةٌ لِجَارَتِهَا، وَلَوْ فِرْسِنَ شَاةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aasimu bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'ani almaqburiyyi, ‏{‏'an aabiyhi, ‏}‏ 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yaa nisaa'a almuslimaati laa tahqiranna jaaraaun lijaaratihaa, walaw firsina shaaain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Muslim women! None of you should look down upon the gift sent by her female neighbor even if it were the trotters of the sheep (fleshless part of legs)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 51 — Gifts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأُوَيْسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُومَانَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لِعُرْوَةَ ابْنَ أُخْتِي، إِنْ كُنَّا لَنَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْهِلاَلِ ثُمَّ الْهِلاَلِ، ثَلاَثَةَ أَهِلَّةٍ فِي شَهْرَيْنِ، وَمَا أُوقِدَتْ فِي أَبْيَاتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَارٌ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا خَالَةُ مَا كَانَ يُعِيشُكُمْ قَالَتِ الأَسْوَدَانِ التَّمْرُ وَالْمَاءُ، إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَدْ كَانَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جِيرَانٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ مَنَائِحُ، وَكَانُوا يَمْنَحُونَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَلْبَانِهِمْ، فَيَسْقِينَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi alauwaysiyyu, haddathanaa abnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an yaziyda bni ruwmaana, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aannahaa qaalat li'urwaaa abna aukhtiy, iin kunnaa lananzuru iilaa alhilaali thumma alhilaali, thalaathaaa aahillaain fiy shahrayni, wamaa auwqidat fiy aabyaati rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm naarun‏.‏ faqultu yaa khaalaau maa kaana yu'iyshukum qaalati alaaswadaani alttamru waalmaa'u, iilaaa aannahu qad kaana lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jiyraanun mina alaansaari kaanat lahum manaaiihu, wakaanuwa yamnahuwna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min aalbaanihim, fayasqiynaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa:Aisha said to me, "O my nephew! We used to see the crescent, and then the crescent and then the crescent in this way we saw three crescents in two months and no fire (for cooking) used to be made in the houses of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I said, "O my aunt! Then what use to sustain you?" `Aisha said, "The two black things: dates and water, our neighbors from Ansar had some Manaih and they used to present Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) some of their milk and he used to make us drink
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 51 — Gifts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْ دُعِيتُ إِلَى ذِرَاعٍ أَوْ كُرَاعٍ لأَجَبْتُ، وَلَوْ أُهْدِيَ إِلَىَّ ذِرَاعٌ أَوْ كُرَاعٌ لَقَبِلْتُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an sulaymaana, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ law du'iytu iilaa dhiraa'in aaw kuraa'in laajabtu, walaw auhdiya iilaaaa dhiraa'un aaw kuraa'un laqabiltu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I shall accept the invitation even if I were invited to a meal of a sheep's trotter, and I shall accept the gift even if it were an arm or a trotter of a sheep
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 51 — Gifts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْسَلَ إِلَى امْرَأَةٍ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ، وَكَانَ لَهَا غُلاَمٌ نَجَّارٌ قَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ مُرِي عَبْدَكِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ لَنَا أَعْوَادَ الْمِنْبَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَمَرَتْ عَبْدَهَا، فَذَهَبَ فَقَطَعَ مِنَ الطَّرْفَاءِ، فَصَنَعَ لَهُ مِنْبَرًا، فَلَمَّا قَضَاهُ أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَدْ قَضَاهُ، قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرْسِلِي بِهِ إِلَىَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَاءُوا بِهِ فَاحْتَمَلَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَضَعَهُ حَيْثُ تَرَوْنَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy maryama, haddathanaa aabuw ghassaana, qaala haddathaniy aabuw haazimin, 'an sahlin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aarsala iilaa amraaaain mina almuhaajiriyna, wakaana lahaa ghulaamun najjaarun qaala lahaa ‏"‏ muriy 'abdaki falya'mal lanaa aa'waada alminbari ‏"‏‏.‏ faaamarat 'abdahaa, fadhahaba faqata'a mina alttarfaa'i, fasana'a lahu minbarana, falammaa qadaahu aarsalat iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qad qadaahu, qaala sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aarsiliy bihi iilaaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fajaa'uwa bihi faahtamalahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fawada'ahu haythu tarawna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for a woman from the emigrants and she had a slave who was a carpenter. The Prophet said to her "Order your slave to prepare the wood (pieces) for the pulpit." So, she ordered her slave who went and cut the wood from the tamarisk and prepared the pulpit, for the Prophet. When he finished the pulpit, the woman informed the Prophet (ﷺ) that it had been finished. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked her to send that pulpit to him, so they brought it. The Prophet (ﷺ) lifted it and placed it at the place in which you see now
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 51 — Gifts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ السَّلَمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنْتُ يَوْمًا جَالِسًا مَعَ رِجَالٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَنْزِلٍ فِي طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَازِلٌ أَمَامَنَا وَالْقَوْمُ مُحْرِمُونَ، وَأَنَا غَيْرُ مُحْرِمٍ، فَأَبْصَرُوا حِمَارًا وَحْشِيًّا، وَأَنَا مَشْغُولٌ أَخْصِفُ نَعْلِي، فَلَمْ يُؤْذِنُونِي بِهِ، وَأَحَبُّوا لَوْ أَنِّي أَبْصَرْتُهُ، وَالْتَفَتُّ فَأَبْصَرْتُهُ، فَقُمْتُ إِلَى الْفَرَسِ فَأَسْرَجْتُهُ ثُمَّ رَكِبْتُ وَنَسِيتُ السَّوْطَ وَالرُّمْحَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُمْ نَاوِلُونِي السَّوْطَ وَالرُّمْحَ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لاَ وَاللَّهِ، لاَ نُعِينُكَ عَلَيْهِ بِشَىْءٍ‏.‏ فَغَضِبْتُ فَنَزَلْتُ فَأَخَذْتُهُمَا، ثُمَّ رَكِبْتُ، فَشَدَدْتُ عَلَى الْحِمَارِ فَعَقَرْتُهُ، ثُمَّ جِئْتُ بِهِ وَقَدْ مَاتَ، فَوَقَعُوا فِيهِ يَأْكُلُونَهُ، ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ شَكُّوا فِي أَكْلِهِمْ إِيَّاهُ، وَهُمْ حُرُمٌ، فَرُحْنَا وَخَبَأْتُ الْعَضُدَ مَعِي، فَأَدْرَكْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلْنَاهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَعَكُمْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَنَاوَلْتُهُ الْعَضُدَ فَأَكَلَهَا، حَتَّى نَفَّدَهَا وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ‏.‏ فَحَدَّثَنِي بِهِ زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ ‏عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi allaahi, qaala hadaathaniy muhamaadu bnu ja'farin, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an 'abdi allaahi bni aabiy qataadaaa alsaalamiyii, 'an aabiyhi rda allh 'nh qaala kuntu yawmana jaalisana ma'a rijaalin min aashaabi alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy manzilin fiy tariyqi makaaaa warasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm naazilun aamaamanaa waalqawmu muhrimuwna, waaanaa ghayru muhrimin, faaabsaruwa himaarana wahshiyanna, waaanaa mashghuwlun aakhsifu na'liy, falam yuudhinuwniy bihi, waaahabuuwa law aaniiy aabsartuhu, waaltafatuu faaabsartuhu, faqumtu iilaa alfarasi faaasrajtuhu thumaa rakibtu wanasiytu alsaawta waalruumha faqultu lahum naawiluwniy alsaawta waalruumha‏.‏ faqaaluwa laa waallaahi, laa nu'iynuka 'alayhi bishaa'in‏.‏ faghadibtu fanazaltu faaakhadhtuhumaa, thumaa rakibtu, fashadadtu 'alaa alhimaari fa'aqartuhu, thumaa jiitu bihi waqad maata, fawaqa'uwa fiyhi yaakuluwnahu, thumaa iinaahum shakuuwa fiy aaklihim iiyaaahu, wahum hurumun, faruhnaa wakhabaatu al'aduda ma'iy, faaadraknaa rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalnaahu 'an dhalika faqaala ‏ "‏ ma'akum minhu shaa'un ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu na'am‏.‏ fanaawaltuhu al'aduda faaakalahaa, hataaa nafaadahaa wahwa muhrimun‏.‏ fahadaathaniy bihi zaydu bnu aaslama 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin 'an aabiy qataadaaa ‏'an alnaabiyii salaaa allaahu 'alayhi wasalaama.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu Qatada Al-Aslami:That his father said, "One day I was sitting with some of the Prophet's companions on the way to Mecca. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was ahead of us. All of my companions were in the state of Ihram while I was a non-Muhrim. They saw an onager while I was busy repairing my shoes, so they did not tell me about it but they wished I had seen it. By chance I looked up and saw it. So, I turned to the horse, saddled it and rode on it, forgetting to take the spear and the whip. I asked them if they could hand over to me the whip and the spear but they said, 'No, by Allah, we shall not help you in that in any way.' I became angry and got down from the horse, picked up both the things and rode the horse again. I attacked the onager and slaughtered it, and brought it (after it had been dead). They took it (cooked some of it) and started eating it, but they doubted whether it was allowed for them to eat it or not, as they were in the state of Ihram. So, we proceeded and I hid with me one of its fore-legs. When we met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and asked him about the case, he asked, 'Do you have a portion of it with you?' I replied in the affirmative and gave him that fleshy foreleg which he ate completely while he was in the state of Ihram
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 51 — Gifts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو طَوَالَةَ ـ اسْمُهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ أَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي دَارِنَا هَذِهِ، فَاسْتَسْقَى، فَحَلَبْنَا لَهُ شَاةً لَنَا، ثُمَّ شُبْتُهُ مِنْ مَاءِ بِئْرِنَا هَذِهِ، فَأَعْطَيْتُهُ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، وَعُمَرُ تُجَاهَهُ وَأَعْرَابِيٌّ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَالَ عُمَرُ هَذَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ‏.‏ فَأَعْطَى الأَعْرَابِيَّ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الأَيْمَنُونَ، الأَيْمَنُونَ، أَلاَ فَيَمِّنُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَهْىَ سُنَّةٌ فَهْىَ سُنَّةٌ‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, qaala haddathaniy aabuw tawaalaaa asmuhu 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani qaala sami'tu aanasana rda allh 'nh yaquwlu aataanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy daarinaa hadhihi, faastasqaa, fahalabnaa lahu shaaaan lanaa, thumma shubtuhu min maa'i biirinaa hadhihi, faaa'taytuhu waaabuw bakrin 'an yasaarihi, wa'umaru tujaahahu waaa'raabiyyun 'an yamiynihi falammaa faragha qaala 'umaru hadhaa aabuw bakrin‏.‏ faaa'taa alaa'raabiyya, thumma qaala ‏ "‏ alaaymanuwna, alaaymanuwna, aalaa fayamminuwa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aanasun fahaa sunnaaun fahaa sunnaaun‏.‏ thalaatha marraatin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited us in this house of ours and asked for something to drink. We milked one of our sheep and mixed it with water from this well of ours and gave it to him. Abu Bakr was sitting on his left side and `Umar in front of him and a bedouin on his right side. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished, `Umar said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Here is Abu Bakr." But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave the remaining milk to the bedouin and said twice, "The (persons on the) right side! So, start from the right side." Anas added, "It is a Sunna (the Prophet's traditions)" and repeated it thrice
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 51 — Gifts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَنْفَجْنَا أَرْنَبًا بِمَرِّ الظَّهْرَانِ، فَسَعَى الْقَوْمُ فَلَغَبُوا، فَأَدْرَكْتُهَا فَأَخَذْتُهَا، فَأَتَيْتُ بِهَا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ فَذَبَحَهَا، وَبَعَثَ بِهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِوَرِكِهَا ـ أَوْ فَخِذَيْهَا قَالَ فَخِذَيْهَا لاَ شَكَّ فِيهِ ـ فَقَبِلَهُ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَأَكَلَ مِنْهُ قَالَ وَأَكَلَ مِنْهُ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ بَعْدُ قَبِلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an hishaami bni zaydi bni aanasi bni maalikin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala aanfajnaa aarnabana bimarri alzzahraani, fasa'aa alqawmu falaghabuwa, faaadraktuhaa faaakhadhtuhaa, faaataytu bihaa aabaa talhaaa fadhabahahaa, waba'atha bihaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biwarikihaa aaw fakhidhayhaa qaala fakhidhayhaa laa shakka fiyhi faqabilahu‏.‏ qultu waaakala minhu qaala waaakala minhu‏.‏ thumma qaala ba'du qabilahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:We chased a rabbit at Mar-al-Zahran and the people ran after it but were exhausted. I overpowered and caught it, and gave it to Abu Talha who slaughtered it and sent its hip or two thighs to Allah's Apostle. (The narrator confirms that he sent two thighs). The Prophet (ﷺ) accepted that. (The sub-narrator asked Anas, "Did the Prophet; eat from it?" Anas replied, "He ate from it)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 51 — Gifts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ الصَّعْبِ بْنِ جَثَّامَةَ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ أَنَّهُ أَهْدَى لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِمَارًا وَحْشِيًّا وَهْوَ بِالأَبْوَاءِ أَوْ بِوَدَّانَ فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَمَّا رَأَى مَا فِي وَجْهِهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَمَا إِنَّا لَمْ نَرُدَّهُ عَلَيْكَ إِلاَّ أَنَّا حُرُمٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, 'ani alssa'bi bni jathhaamaaa rda allh 'nhm aannahu aahdaa lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm himaarana wahshiyyana wahwa bialaabwaa'i aaw biwaddaana faradda 'alayhi, falammaa raaaa maa fiy wajhihi qaala ‏ "‏ aamaa iinnaa lam naruddahu 'alayka iilaaa aannaa hurumun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated As-Sa'b bin Jath-thama:An onager was presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the place called Al-Abwa' or Waddan, but Allah's Apostle rejected it. When the Prophet (ﷺ) noticed the signs of sorrow on the giver's face he said, "We have not rejected your gift, but we are in the state of Ihram." (i.e. if we were not in a state of Ihram we would have accepted your gift, Fath-ul-Bari page 130, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 51 — Gifts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ النَّاسَ، كَانُوا يَتَحَرَّوْنَ بِهَدَايَاهُمْ يَوْمَ عَائِشَةَ، يَبْتَغُونَ بِهَا ـ أَوْ يَبْتَغُونَ بِذَلِكَ ـ مَرْضَاةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna alnnaasa, kaanuwa yataharrawna bihadaayaahum yawma 'aaiishaaa, yabtaghuwna bihaa aaw yabtaghuwna bidhalika mardaaaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:The people used to look forward for the days of my (`Aisha's) turn to send gifts to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in order to please him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 51 — Gifts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ إِيَاسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَهْدَتْ أُمُّ حُفَيْدٍ خَالَةُ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقِطًا وَسَمْنًا وَأَضُبًّا، فَأَكَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الأَقِطِ وَالسَّمْنِ، وَتَرَكَ الضَّبَّ تَقَذُّرًا‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَأُكِلَ عَلَى مَائِدَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَلَوْ كَانَ حَرَامًا مَا أُكِلَ عَلَى مَائِدَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa ja'faru bnu iiyaasin, qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala aahdat aummu hufaydin khaalaau abni 'abbaasin iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaqitana wasamnana waaadubbana, faaakala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alaaqiti waalssamni, wataraka alddabba taqadhhurana‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin faaukila 'alaa maaiidaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, walaw kaana haraamana maa aukila 'alaa maaiidaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Ibn `Abbas said: Um Hufaid, Ibn `Abbas's aunt sent some dried yogurt (butter free), ghee (butter) and a mastigar to the Prophet (ﷺ) as a gift. The Prophet (ﷺ) ate the dried yogurt and butter but left the mastigar because he disliked it. Ibn `Abbas said, "The mastigar was eaten at the table of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and if it had been illegal to eat, it could not have been eaten at the table of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 51 — Gifts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏إِذَا أُتِيَ بِطَعَامٍ سَأَلَ عَنْهُ أَهَدِيَّةٌ أَمْ صَدَقَةٌ فَإِنْ قِيلَ صَدَقَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ لأَصْحَابِهِ كُلُوا‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَأْكُلْ، وَإِنْ قِيلَ هَدِيَّةٌ‏.‏ ضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَكَلَ مَعَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa ma'nun, qaala haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu tahmaana, 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏iidhaa autiya bita'aamin saaala 'anhu aahadiyyaaun aam sadaqaaun faiin qiyla sadaqaaun‏.‏ qaala laashaabihi kuluwa‏.‏ walam yaakul, waiin qiyla hadiyyaaun‏.‏ daraba biyadihi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakala ma'ahum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Whenever a meal was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he would ask whether it was a gift or Sadaqa (something given in charity). If he was told that it was Sadaqa, he would tell his companions to eat it, but if it was a gift, he would hurry to share it with them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 51 — Gifts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِلَحْمٍ فَقِيلَ تُصُدِّقَ عَلَى بَرِيرَةَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ هُوَ لَهَا صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَنَا هَدِيَّةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala autiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bilahmin faqiyla tusuddiqa 'alaa bariyraaa qaala ‏ "‏ huwa lahaa sadaqaaun, walanaa hadiyyaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Some meat was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and it was said that the meat had been given in charity to Barirah. He said, "It was Sadaqa for Barirah but a gift for us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 51 — Gifts
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْهُ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا أَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَشْتَرِيَ بَرِيرَةَ، وَأَنَّهُمُ اشْتَرَطُوا وَلاَءَهَا، فَذُكِرَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اشْتَرِيهَا فَأَعْتِقِيهَا، فَإِنَّمَا الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأُهْدِيَ لَهَا لَحْمٌ، فَقِيلَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَذَا تُصُدِّقَ عَلَى بَرِيرَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هُوَ لَهَا صَدَقَةٌ وَلَنَا هَدِيَّةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَخُيِّرَتْ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ زَوْجُهَا حُرٌّ أَوْ عَبْدٌ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ زَوْجِهَا‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي أَحُرٌّ أَمْ عَبْدٌ
