verses.translit: waqaala iismaa'iylu aakhbaraniy 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy salamaaa, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, , laa aa'lamuhu iilaaa 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa nazalat ‏{‏lan tanaaluwa albirra hattaa tunfiquwa mimmaa tuhibbuwna‏}‏ jaa'a aabuw talhaaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi yaquwlu alllahu tabaaraka wata'aalaa fiy kitaabihi ‏{‏lan tanaaluwa albirra hattaa tunfiquwa mimmaa tuhibbuwna‏}‏ waiinna aahabba aamwaaliy iilaaaa biyruhaa'a qaala wakaanat hadiyqaaan kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadkhuluhaa wayastazillu bihaa wayashrabu min maaiihaa fahiya iilaa alllahi 'azza wajalla waiilaa rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm aarjuw birrahu wadhukhrahu, fada'haa aaa rasuwla alllahi haythu aaraaka alllahu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ bakh yaa aabaa talhaaa, dhalika maalun raabihun, qabilnaahu minka waradadnaahu 'alayka, faaj'alhu fiy alaaqrabiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ fatasaddaqa bihi aabuw talhaaa 'alaa dhawiy rahimihi, qaala wakaana minhum aubaaaun wahassaanu, qaala wabaa'a hassaanu hissatahu minhu min mu'aawiyaaa, faqiyla lahu tabiy'u sadaqaaa aabiy talhaaa faqaala aalaa aabiy'u saa'ana min tamrin bisaa'in min daraahima qaala wakaanat tilka alhadiyqaau fiy mawdi'i qasri baniy hudaylaaa alladhiy banaahu mu'aawiyaau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas (ra):When the Holy Verse: 'By no means shall you attain Al-Birr (piety, righteousness, it means here Allah's Reward i.e., Paradise), unless you spend of that which you love..', (V 3:92) was revealed, Abu Talha went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger ! Allah, the Blessed, the Superior stated in His book: 'By no means shall you attain Birr, unless you spend of that which you love....' (V 3:92) and the most beloved property to me is Bairuha' (which was a garden where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to go to sit in its shade and drink from its water). I give it to Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ) hoping for Allah's Reward in the Hereafter. So, O Allah's Messenger! Use it as Allah orders you to use it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Bravo! O Abu Talha, it is fruitful property. We have accepted it from you and now we return it to you. Distribute it amongst your relatives." So, Abu Talha distributed it amongst his relatives, amongst whom were Ubai and Hassan. When Hassan sold his share of that garden to Mu'awiyya, he was asked, "How do you sell Abu Talha's Sadaqa?" He replied, "Why should not I sell a Sa' of date for Sa' of money?" The garden was situated on the courtyard of the palace of Bani Hudailah built by Mu'awiya
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ إِنَّ نَاسًا يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ نُسِخَتْ، وَلاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا نُسِخَتْ، وَلَكِنَّهَا مِمَّا تَهَاوَنَ النَّاسُ، هُمَا وَالِيَانِ وَالٍ يَرِثُ، وَذَاكَ الَّذِي يَرْزُقُ، وَوَالٍ لاَ يَرِثُ، فَذَاكَ الَّذِي يَقُولُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ، يَقُولُ لاَ أَمْلِكُ لَكَ أَنْ أُعْطِيَكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu alfadli aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala iinna naasana yaz'umuwna aanna hadhihi alayaaa nusikhat, walaa waalllahi maa nusikhat, walakinnahaa mimmaa tahaawana alnnaasu, humaa waaliyaani waalin yarithu, wadhaaka alladhiy yarzuqu, wawaalin laa yarithu, fadhaaka alladhiy yaquwlu bialma'ruwfi, yaquwlu laa aamliku laka aan au'tiyaka‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Some people claim that the order in the above Verse is cancelled, by Allah, it is not cancelled, but the people have stopped acting on it. There are two kinds of guardians (who are in charge of the inheritance): One is that who inherits; such a person should give (of what he inherits to the relatives, the orphans and the needy, etc.), the other is that who does not inherit (e.g. the guardian of the orphans): such a person should speak kindly and say (to those who are present at the time of distribution), "I can not give it to you (as the wealth belongs to the orphans)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ أُمِّي افْتُلِتَتْ نَفْسَهَا، وَأُرَاهَا لَوْ تَكَلَّمَتْ تَصَدَّقَتْ، أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ عَنْهَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ، تَصَدَّقْ عَنْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, rda allh 'nha aanna rajulaan, qaala lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinna aummiy aftulitat nafsahaa, waauraahaa law takallamat tasaddaqat, aafaaatasaddaqu 'anhaa qaala ‏ "‏ na'am, tasaddaq 'anhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:A man said to the Prophet, "My mother died suddenly, and I think that if she could speak, she would have given in charity. May I give in charity on her behalf?" He said, "Yes! Give in charity on her behalf
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ اسْتَفْتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّ أُمِّي مَاتَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا نَذْرٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اقْضِهِ عَنْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna sa'da bna 'ubaadaaa rda allh 'nh astaftaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala iinna aummiy maatat wa'alayhaa nadhrun‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ aqdihi 'anhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Sa`d bin Ubada consulted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "My mother died and she had an unfulfilled vow." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fulfill it on her behalf
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يَعْلَى، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عِكْرِمَةَ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ أَخَا بَنِي سَاعِدَةَ تُوُفِّيَتْ أُمُّهُ وَهْوَ غَائِبٌ، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أُمِّي تُوُفِّيَتْ وَأَنَا غَائِبٌ عَنْهَا، فَهَلْ يَنْفَعُهَا شَىْءٌ إِنْ تَصَدَّقْتُ بِهِ عَنْهَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنِّي أُشْهِدُكَ أَنَّ حَائِطِي الْمِخْرَافَ صَدَقَةٌ عَلَيْهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu yuwsufa, aanna abna jurayjin, aakhbarahum qaala aakhbaraniy ya'laa, aannahu sami'a 'ikrimaaa, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin yaquwlu aanbaaanaa abnu 'abbaasin, aanna sa'da bna 'ubaadaaa rda allh 'nhm aakhaa baniy saa'idaaa tuwuffiyat aummuhu wahwa ghaaiibun, faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aummiy tuwuffiyat waaanaa ghaaiibun 'anhaa, fahal yanfa'uhaa shaa'un iin tasaddaqtu bihi 'anhaa qaala ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faiinniy aushhiduka aanna haaiitiy almikhraafa sadaqaaun 'alayhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:That the mother of Sa`d bin Ubada the brother of Bani Saida died in Sa`d's absence, so he came to the Prophet saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My mother died in my absence, will it benefit her if I give in charity on her behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." Sa`d said, "I take you as my witness that I give my garden Al-Makhraf in charity on her behalf
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها – ‏{‏وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى فَانْكِحُوا مَا طَابَ لَكُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ‏}‏ قَالَتْ هِيَ الْيَتِيمَةُ فِي حَجْرِ وَلِيِّهَا، فَيَرْغَبُ فِي جَمَالِهَا وَمَالِهَا، وَيُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَهَا بِأَدْنَى مِنْ سُنَّةِ نِسَائِهَا، فَنُهُوا عَنْ نِكَاحِهِنَّ، إِلاَّ أَنْ يُقْسِطُوا لَهُنَّ فِي إِكْمَالِ الصَّدَاقِ، وَأُمِرُوا بِنِكَاحِ مَنْ سِوَاهُنَّ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ ثُمَّ اسْتَفْتَى النَّاسُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدُ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏وَيَسْتَفْتُونَكَ فِي النِّسَاءِ قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِيهِنَّ‏}‏ قَالَتْ فَبَيَّنَ اللَّهُ فِي هَذِهِ أَنَّ الْيَتِيمَةَ إِذَا كَانَتْ ذَاتَ جَمَالٍ وَمَالٍ رَغِبُوا فِي نِكَاحِهَا، وَلَمْ يُلْحِقُوهَا بِسُنَّتِهَا بِإِكْمَالِ الصَّدَاقِ، فَإِذَا كَانَتْ مَرْغُوبَةً عَنْهَا فِي قِلَّةِ الْمَالِ وَالْجَمَالِ تَرَكُوهَا وَالْتَمَسُوا غَيْرَهَا مِنَ النِّسَاءِ، قَالَ فَكَمَا يَتْرُكُونَهَا حِينَ يَرْغَبُونَ عَنْهَا فَلَيْسَ لَهُمْ أَنْ يَنْكِحُوهَا إِذَا رَغِبُوا فِيهَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يُقْسِطُوا لَهَا الأَوْفَى مِنَ الصَّدَاقِ وَيُعْطُوهَا حَقَّهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala kaana 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri yuhaddithu aannahu saaala 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha – ‏{‏waiin khiftum aan laa tuqsituwa fiy alyataamaa faankihuwa maa taaba lakum mina alnnisaa'i‏}‏ qaalat hiya alyatiymaau fiy hajri waliyyihaa, fayarghabu fiy jamaalihaa wamaalihaa, wayuriydu aan yatazawwajahaa biaadnaa min sunnaai nisaaiihaa, fanuhuwa 'an nikaahihinna, iilaaa aan yuqsituwa lahunna fiy iikmaali alssadaaqi, waaumiruwa binikaahi man siwaahunna mina alnnisaa'i qaalat 'aaiishaau thumma astaftaa alnnaasu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'du faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏wayastaftuwnaka fiy alnnisaa'i quli alllahu yuftiykum fiyhinna‏}‏ qaalat fabayyana alllahu fiy hadhihi aanna alyatiymaaa iidhaa kaanat dhaata jamaalin wamaalin raghibuwa fiy nikaahihaa, walam yulhiquwhaa bisunnatihaa biiikmaali alssadaaqi, faiidhaa kaanat marghuwbaaan 'anhaa fiy qillaai almaali waaljamaali tarakuwhaa waaltamasuwa ghayrahaa mina alnnisaa'i, qaala fakamaa yatrukuwnahaa hiyna yarghabuwna 'anhaa falaysa lahum aan yankihuwhaa iidhaa raghibuwa fiyhaa iilaaa aan yuqsituwa lahaa alaawfaa mina alssadaaqi wayu'tuwhaa haqqahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Az-Zuhri:`Urwa bin Az-Zubair said that he asked `Aisha about the meaning of the Qur'anic Verse:-- "And if you fear that you will not deal fairly with the orphan girls then marry (other) women of your choice." (4.2-3) Aisha said, "It is about a female orphan under the guardianship of her guardian who is inclined towards her because of her beauty and wealth, and likes to marry her with a Mahr less than what is given to women of her standard. So they (i.e. guardians) were forbidden to marry the orphans unless they paid them a full appropriate Mahr (otherwise) they were ordered to marry other women instead of them. Later on the people asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it. So Allah revealed the following Verse:-- "They ask your instruction (O Muhammad!) regarding women. Say: Allah instructs you regarding them..." (4.127) and in this Verse Allah indicated that if the orphan girl was beautiful and wealthy, her guardian would have the desire to marry her without giving her an appropriate Mahr equal to what her peers could get, but if she was undesirable for lack of beauty or wealth, then he would not marry her, but seek to marry some other woman instead of her. So, since he did not marry her when he had no inclination towards her, he had not the right to marry her when he had an interest in her, unless he treated her justly by giving her a full Mahr and securing all her rights
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ، مَوْلَى بَنِي هَاشِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا صَخْرُ بْنُ جُوَيْرِيَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ عُمَرَ، تَصَدَّقَ بِمَالٍ لَهُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ يُقَالُ لَهُ ثَمْغٌ، وَكَانَ نَخْلاً، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي اسْتَفَدْتُ مَالاً وَهُوَ عِنْدِي نَفِيسٌ فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَتَصَدَّقَ بِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَصَدَّقْ بِأَصْلِهِ، لاَ يُبَاعُ وَلاَ يُوهَبُ وَلاَ يُورَثُ، وَلَكِنْ يُنْفَقُ ثَمَرُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَتَصَدَّقَ بِهِ عُمَرُ، فَصَدَقَتُهُ ذَلِكَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَفِي الرِّقَابِ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَالضَّيْفِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ وَلِذِي الْقُرْبَى، وَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَى مَنْ وَلِيَهُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْهُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ، أَوْ يُوكِلَ صَدِيقَهُ غَيْرَ مُتَمَوِّلٍ بِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa haaruwnu, hadaathanaa aabuw sa'iydin, mawlaa baniy haashimin hadaathanaa sakhru bnu juwayriyaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanaa 'umara, tasadaaqa bimaalin lahu 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaana yuqaalu lahu thamghun, wakaana nakhlaan, faqaala 'umaru yaa rasuwla allaahi iiniiy astafadtu maalaan wahuwa 'indiy nafiysun faaaradtu aan aatasadaaqa bihi‏.‏ faqaala alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tasadaaq biaaslihi, laa yubaa'u walaa yuwhabu walaa yuwrathu, walakin yunfaqu thamaruhu ‏"‏‏.‏ fatasadaaqa bihi 'umaru, fasadaqatuhu dhalika fiy sabiyli allaahi wafiy alriiqaabi waalmasaakiyni waaldaayfi waabni alsaabiyli walidhiy alqurbaa, walaa junaaha 'alaa man waliyahu aan yaakula minhu bialma'ruwfi, aaw yuwkila sadiyqahu ghayra mutamawiilin bihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , `Umar gave in charity some of his property, a garden of date-palms called Thamgh. `Umar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have some property which I prize highly and I want to give it in charity." The Prophet; said, "Give it in charity (i.e. as an endowment) with its land and trees on the condition that the land and trees will neither be sold nor given as a present, nor bequeathed, but the fruits are to be spent in charity." So `Umar gave it in charity, and it was for Allah's Cause, the emancipation of slaves, for the poor, for guests, for travelers, and for kinsmen. The person acting as its administrator could eat from it reasonably and fairly, and could let a friend of his eat from it provided he had no intention of becoming wealthy by its means
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها – ‏{‏وَمَنْ كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ وَمَنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ أُنْزِلَتْ فِي وَالِي الْيَتِيمِ أَنْ يُصِيبَ مِنْ مَالِهِ إِذَا كَانَ مُحْتَاجًا بِقَدْرِ مَالِهِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, hadaathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha – ‏{‏waman kaana ghaniyanna falyasta'fif waman kaana faqiyrana falyaakul bialma'ruwfi‏}‏‏.‏ qaalat aunzilat fiy waaliy alyatiymi aan yusiyba min maalihi iidhaa kaana muhtaajana biqadri maalihi bialma'ruwfi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The following Verse:-- "If a guardian is well-off, let him claim no remuneration (i.e. wages), but if he is poor, let him have for himself what is just and reasonable." (4.6) was revealed in connection with the guardian of an orphan, and it means that if he is poor he can have for himself (from the orphan's wealth) what is just and reasonable according to the orphan's share of the inheritance
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الْمَدَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ اجْتَنِبُوا السَّبْعَ الْمُوبِقَاتِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَمَا هُنَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ الشِّرْكُ بِاللَّهِ، وَالسِّحْرُ، وَقَتْلُ النَّفْسِ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ، وَأَكْلُ الرِّبَا، وَأَكْلُ مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ، وَالتَّوَلِّي يَوْمَ الزَّحْفِ، وَقَذْفُ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ الْغَافِلاَتِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an thawri bni zaydin almadaniyyi, 'an aabiy alghaythi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ ajtanibuwa alssab'a almuwbiqaati ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi, wamaa hunna qaala ‏"‏ alshhirku bialllahi, waalssihru, waqatlu alnnafsi allatiy harrama alllahu iilaaa bialhaqqi, waaaklu alrribaa, waaaklu maali alyatiymi, waalttawalliy yawma alzzahfi, waqadhfu almuhsanaati almuuminaati alghaafilaati ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Avoid the seven great destructive sins." The people enquired, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What are they?" He said, "To join others in worship along with Allah, to practice sorcery, to kill the life which Allah has forbidden except for a just cause, (according to Islamic law), to eat up Riba (usury), to eat up an orphan's wealth, to give back to the enemy and fleeing from the battlefield at the time of fighting, and to accuse, chaste women, who never even think of anything touching chastity and are good believers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: وَقَالَ لَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ مَا رَدَّ ابْنُ عُمَرَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ وَصِيَّةً‏.‏ وَكَانَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ أَحَبَّ الأَشْيَاءِ إِلَيْهِ فِي مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ أَنْ يَجْتَمِعَ إِلَيْهِ نُصَحَاؤُهُ وَأَوْلِيَاؤُهُ فَيَنْظُرُوا الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَهُ‏.‏ وَكَانَ طَاوُسٌ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنْ شَىْءٍ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْيَتَامَى قَرَأَ ‏{‏وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْمُفْسِدَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِ‏}‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَطَاءٌ فِي يَتَامَى الصَّغِيرُ وَالْكَبِيرُ يُنْفِقُ الْوَلِيُّ عَلَى كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ بِقَدْرِهِ مِنْ حِصَّتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala lanaa sulaymaanu haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, qaala maa radda abnu 'umara 'alaa aahadin wasiyyaaan‏.‏ wakaana abnu siyriyna aahabba alaashyaa'i iilayhi fiy maali alyatiymi aan yajtami'a iilayhi nusahaauuhu waaawliyaauuhu fayanzuruwa alladhiy huwa khayrun lahu‏.‏ wakaana taawusun iidhaa suiila 'an shaa'in min aamri alyataamaa qaraaa ‏{‏waalllahu ya'lamu almufsida mina almuslihi‏}‏‏.‏ waqaala 'ataa'un fiy yataamaa alssaghiyru waalkabiyru yunfiqu alwaliyyu 'alaa kulli iinsaanin biqadrihi min hissatihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' said:"Ibn 'Umar never refused to be appointed as guardian." The most beloved thing to Ibn Sirin concerning an orphan's wealth was that the orphan's advisor and guardians would assemble to decide what is best for him. When Tawus was asked about something concerning an orphan's affairs, he would recite: '...And Allah knows him who means mischief from him who means good...' (V 2:220). 'Ata said concerning some orphans, "The guardian is to provide for the young and the old orphans according to their needs from their shares
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ لَيْسَ لَهُ خَادِمٌ، فَأَخَذَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ بِيَدِي، فَانْطَلَقَ بِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَنَسًا غُلاَمٌ كَيِّسٌ، فَلْيَخْدُمْكَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَدَمْتُهُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْحَضَرِ، مَا قَالَ لِي لِشَىْءٍ صَنَعْتُهُ لِمَ صَنَعْتَ هَذَا هَكَذَا وَلاَ لِشَىْءٍ لَمْ أَصْنَعْهُ لِمَ لَمْ تَصْنَعْ هَذَا هَكَذَا
verses.translit: haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni kathiyrin, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa laysa lahu khaadimun, faaakhadha aabuw talhaaa biyadiy, faantalaqa biy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aanasana ghulaamun kayyisun, falyakhdumka‏.‏ qaala fakhadamtuhu fiy alssafari waalhadari, maa qaala liy lishaa'in sana'tuhu lima sana'ta hadhaa hakadhaa walaa lishaa'in lam aasna'hu lima lam tasna' hadhaa hakadhaa
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina; he did not have any servant. Abu Talha (Anas' step-father) took me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Anas is a wise boy, so let him serve you." So, I served him at home and on journeys. If I did anything, he never asked me why I did it, and if I refrained from doing anything, he never asked me why I refrained from doing it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ كَانَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَكْثَرَ أَنْصَارِيٍّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ مَالاً مِنْ نَخْلٍ، وَكَانَ أَحَبُّ مَالِهِ إِلَيْهِ بَيْرَحَاءَ مُسْتَقْبِلَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْخُلُهَا وَيَشْرَبُ مِنْ مَاءٍ فِيهَا طَيِّبٍ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّى تُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ‏}‏ قَامَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ ‏{‏لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّى تُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ‏}‏ وَإِنَّ أَحَبَّ أَمْوَالِي إِلَىَّ بِيرُحَاءَ، وَإِنَّهَا صَدَقَةٌ لِلَّهِ أَرْجُو بِرَّهَا وَذُخْرَهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ، فَضَعْهَا حَيْثُ أَرَاكَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ بَخْ، ذَلِكَ مَالٌ رَابِحٌ ـ أَوْ رَايِحٌ ـ شَكَّ ابْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ مَا قُلْتَ، وَإِنِّي أَرَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَهَا فِي الأَقْرَبِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَسَمَهَا أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فِي أَقَارِبِهِ وَفِي بَنِي عَمِّهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ وَيَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مَالِكٍ ‏"‏ رَايِحٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh yaquwlu kaana aabuw talhaaa aakthara aansaariyyin bialmadiynaai maalaan min nakhlin, wakaana aahabbu maalihi iilayhi bayrahaa'a mustaqbilaaa almasjidi, wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yadkhuluhaa wayashrabu min maa'in fiyhaa tayyibin‏.‏ qaala aanasun falammaa nazalat ‏{‏lan tanaaluwa albirra hattaa tunfiquwa mimmaa tuhibbuwna‏}‏ qaama aabuw talhaaa faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna alllaha yaquwlu ‏{‏lan tanaaluwa albirra hattaa tunfiquwa mimmaa tuhibbuwna‏}‏ waiinna aahabba aamwaaliy iilaaaa biyruhaa'a, waiinnahaa sadaqaaun lillahi aarjuw birrahaa wadhukhrahaa 'inda alllahi, fada'haa haythu aaraaka alllahu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ bakh, dhalika maalun raabihun aaw raayihun shakka abnu maslamaaa waqad sami'tu maa qulta, waiinniy aaraa aan taj'alahaa fiy alaaqrabiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw talhaaa aaf'alu dhalika yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ faqasamahaa aabuw talhaaa fiy aaqaaribihi wafiy baniy 'ammihi‏.‏ waqaala iismaa'iylu wa'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa wayahyaa bnu yahyaa 'an maalikin ‏"‏ raayihun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Talha had the greatest wealth of date-palms amongst the Ansar in Medina, and he prized above all his wealth (his garden) Bairuha', which was situated opposite the Mosque (of the Prophet (ﷺ) ). The Prophet used to enter It and drink from its fresh water. When the following Divine Verse came:-- "By no means shall you attain piety until you spend of what you love," (3.92) Abu Talha got up saying. "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah says, 'You will not attain piety until you spend of what you love,' and I prize above all my wealth, Bairuha' which I want to give in charity for Allah's Sake, hoping for its reward from Allah. So you can use it as Allah directs you." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Bravo! It is a profitable (or perishable) property. (Ibn Maslama is not sure as to which word is right, i.e. profitable or perishable.) I have heard what you have said, and I recommend that you distribute this amongst your relatives." On that Abu Talha said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I will do (as you have suggested)." So, Abu Talha distributed that garden amongst his relatives and cousins
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ أُمَّهُ تُوُفِّيَتْ أَيَنْفَعُهَا إِنْ تَصَدَّقْتُ عَنْهَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّ لِي مِخْرَافًا وَأُشْهِدُكَ أَنِّي قَدْ تَصَدَّقْتُ عَنْهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahiymi, aakhbaranaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu iishaaqa, qaala haddathaniy 'amruw bnu diynaarin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna rajulaan, qaala lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinna aummahu tuwuffiyat aayanfa'uhaa iin tasaddaqtu 'anhaa qaala ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faiinna liy mikhraafana waaushhiduka aanniy qad tasaddaqtu 'anhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , "My mother died, will it benefit her if I give in charity on her behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative. The man said, "I have a garden and I make you a witness that I give it in charity on her behalf
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِبِنَاءِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا بَنِي النَّجَّارِ ثَامِنُونِي بِحَائِطِكُمْ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ‏.‏ وَاللَّهِ لاَ نَطْلُبُ ثَمَنَهُ إِلاَّ إِلَى اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala aamara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bibinaa'i almasjidi faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa baniy alnnajjaari thaaminuwniy bihaaiitikum hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa laa‏.‏ waalllahi laa natlubu thamanahu iilaaa iilaa alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that the mosque be built, he said, "O Bani An-Najjar! Suggest to me a price for this garden of yours." They replied, "By Allah! We will demand its price from none but Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَصَابَ عُمَرُ بِخَيْبَرَ أَرْضًا فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَصَبْتُ أَرْضًا لَمْ أُصِبْ مَالاً قَطُّ أَنْفَسَ مِنْهُ، فَكَيْفَ تَأْمُرُنِي بِهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ شِئْتَ حَبَّسْتَ أَصْلَهَا، وَتَصَدَّقْتَ بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَتَصَدَّقَ عُمَرُ أَنَّهُ لاَ يُبَاعُ أَصْلُهَا وَلاَ يُوهَبُ وَلاَ يُورَثُ، فِي الْفُقَرَاءِ وَالْقُرْبَى وَالرِّقَابِ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالضَّيْفِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ، وَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَى مَنْ وَلِيَهَا أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْهَا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ، أَوْ يُطْعِمَ صَدِيقًا غَيْرَ مُتَمَوِّلٍ فِيهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa abnu 'awnin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala aasaaba 'umaru bikhaybara aardana faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aasabtu aardana lam ausib maalaan qattu aanfasa minhu, fakayfa taamuruniy bihi qaala ‏ "‏ iin shiita habbasta aaslahaa, watasaddaqta bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fatasaddaqa 'umaru aannahu laa yubaa'u aasluhaa walaa yuwhabu walaa yuwrathu, fiy alfuqaraa'i waalqurbaa waalrriqaabi wafiy sabiyli alllahi waalddayfi waabni alssabiyli, walaa junaaha 'alaa man waliyahaa aan yaakula minhaa bialma'ruwfi, aaw yut'ima sadiyqana ghayra mutamawwilin fiyhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When `Umar got a piece of land in Khaibar, he came to the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "I have got a piece of land, better than which I have never got. So what do you advise me regarding it?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you wish you can keep it as an endowment to be used for charitable purposes." So, `Umar gave the land in charity (i.e. as an endowment) on the condition that the land would neither be sold nor given as a present, nor bequeathed, (and its yield) would be used for the poor, the kinsmen, the emancipation of slaves, Jihad, and for guests and travelers; and its administrator could eat in a reasonable just manner, and he also could feed his friends without intending to be wealthy by its means
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، رضى الله عنه وَجَدَ مَالاً بِخَيْبَرَ، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ، قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ شِئْتَ تَصَدَّقْتَ بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَتَصَدَّقَ بِهَا فِي الْفُقَرَاءِ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَذِي الْقُرْبَى وَالضَّيْفِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, haddathanaa abnu 'awnin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna 'umara, rda allh 'nh wajada maalaan bikhaybara, faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarahu, qaala ‏ "‏ iin shiita tasaddaqta bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fatasaddaqa bihaa fiy alfuqaraa'i waalmasaakiyni wadhiy alqurbaa waalddayfi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar got some property in Khaibar and he came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him about it. The Prophet said to him, "If you wish you can give it in charity." So `Umar gave it in charity (i.e. as an endowment) the yield of which was to be used for the good of the poor, the needy, the kinsmen and the guests
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ لَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ أَمَرَ بِالْمَسْجِدِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا بَنِي النَّجَّارِ ثَامِنُونِي بِحَائِطِكُمْ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ نَطْلُبُ ثَمَنَهُ إِلاَّ إِلَى اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, qaala sami'tu aabiy, haddathanaa aabuw alttayyaahi, qaala haddathaniy aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh lammaa qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa aamara bialmasjidi waqaala ‏ "‏ yaa baniy alnnajjaari thaaminuwniy bihaaiitikum hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa laa waalllahi laa natlubu thamanahu iilaaa iilaa alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina, he ordered that a mosque be built. He said, "O Bani An- Najjar! Suggest me a price for the garden of yours." They replied, "By Allah, we will not ask its price except from Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ عُمَرَ، حَمَلَ عَلَى فَرَسٍ لَهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَعْطَاهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيَحْمِلَ عَلَيْهَا رَجُلاً، فَأُخْبِرَ عُمَرُ أَنَّهُ قَدْ وَقَفَهَا يَبِيعُهَا، فَسَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَبْتَاعَهَا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَبْتَعْهَا، وَلاَ تَرْجِعَنَّ فِي صَدَقَتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, qaala haddathaniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna 'umara, hamala 'alaa farasin lahu fiy sabiyli alllahi aa'taahaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm liyahmila 'alayhaa rajulaan, faaukhbira 'umaru aannahu qad waqafahaa yabiy'uhaa, fasaaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yabtaa'ahaa faqaala ‏ "‏ laa tabta'haa, walaa tarji'anna fiy sadaqatika ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Once `Umar gave a horse in charity to be used in holy fighting. It had been given to him by Allah's Apostle . `Umar gave it to another man to ride. Then `Umar was informed that the man put the horse for sale, so he asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whether he could buy it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "You should not buy it, for you should not take back what you have given in charity
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَقْتَسِمْ وَرَثَتِي دِينَارًا، مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدَ نَفَقَةِ نِسَائِي وَمَئُونَةِ عَامِلِي فَهْوَ صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yaqtasim warathatiy diynaarana, maa taraktu ba'da nafaqaai nisaaiiy wamaiuwnaai 'aamiliy fahwa sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "My heirs will not inherit a Dinar or a Dirham (i.e. money), for whatever I leave (excluding the adequate support of my wives and the wages of my employees) is given in charity
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ عُمَرَ، اشْتَرَطَ فِي وَقْفِهِ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مَنْ وَلِيَهُ وَيُوكِلَ صَدِيقَهُ غَيْرَ مُتَمَوِّلٍ مَالاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna 'umara, ashtarata fiy waqfihi aan yaakula man waliyahu wayuwkila sadiyqahu ghayra mutamawwilin maalaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When `Umar founded an endowment he stipulated that its administrator could eat from it and also feed his friend on the condition that he would not store anything for himself from it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: وَقَالَ عَبْدَانُ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَيْثُ حُوصِرَ أَشْرَفَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكُمْ وَلاَ أَنْشُدُ إِلاَّ أَصْحَابَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، أَلَسْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ حَفَرَ رُومَةَ فَلَهُ الْجَنَّةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَحَفَرْتُهَا، أَلَسْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ جَهَّزَ جَيْشَ الْعُسْرَةِ فَلَهُ الْجَنَّةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَهَّزْتُهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَصَدَّقُوهُ بِمَا قَالَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُمَرُ فِي وَقْفِهِ لاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَى مَنْ وَلِيَهُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ‏.‏ وَقَدْ يَلِيهِ الْوَاقِفُ وَغَيْرُهُ فَهْوَ وَاسِعٌ لِكُلٍّ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala 'abdaanu aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an shu'baaa, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna 'uthmaana rda allh 'nh haythu huwsira aashrafa 'alayhim waqaala aanshudukum walaa aanshudu iilaaa aashaaba alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, aalastum ta'lamuwna aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man hafara ruwmaaa falahu aljannaau ‏"‏‏.‏ fahafartuhaa, aalastum ta'lamuwna aannahu qaala ‏"‏ man jahhaza jaysha al'usraai falahu aljannaau ‏"‏‏.‏ fajahhaztuhum‏.‏ qaala fasaddaquwhu bimaa qaala‏.‏ waqaala 'umaru fiy waqfihi laa junaaha 'alaa man waliyahu aan yaakula‏.‏ waqad yaliyhi alwaaqifu waghayruhu fahwa waasi'un likullin‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu 'Abdur-Rahman narrated:When 'Uthman (ra) was circled (by the rebels), he looked upon them from above and said, "I ask you by Allah, I ask nobody but the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ), don't you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever will (buy and) dig the well of Ruma will be granted Paradise,' and I (bought and) dug it? Don't you know that he said. 'Whoever equip the army of 'Usra (i.e., Tabuk's Ghazwa) will be granted Paradise,' and I equipped it ?" They attested whatever he said. When 'Umar founded his endowment he said, "Its administrator can eat from it." The management of the endowment can be taken over by the founder himself or any other person, for both cases are permissible
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا بَنِي النَّجَّارِ ثَامِنُونِي بِحَائِطِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ نَطْلُبُ ثَمَنَهُ إِلاَّ إِلَى اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa baniy alnnajjaari thaaminuwniy bihaaiitikum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa laa natlubu thamanahu iilaaa iilaa alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said (at the time of building the Mosque), "O Bani An-Najjar! Suggest to me a price for your garden." They replied, "We do not ask its price except from Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: وَقَالَ لِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ خَرَجَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي سَهْمٍ مَعَ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ وَعَدِيِّ بْنِ بَدَّاءٍ فَمَاتَ السَّهْمِيُّ بِأَرْضٍ لَيْسَ بِهَا مُسْلِمٌ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَا بِتَرِكَتِهِ فَقَدُوا جَامًا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ مُخَوَّصًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَأَحْلَفَهُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ وُجِدَ الْجَامُ بِمَكَّةَ فَقَالُوا ابْتَعْنَاهُ مِنْ تَمِيمٍ وَعَدِيٍّ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلاَنِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِهِ، فَحَلَفَا لَشَهَادَتُنَا أَحَقُّ مِنْ شَهَادَتِهِمَا، وَإِنَّ الْجَامَ لِصَاحِبِهِمْ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفِيهِمْ نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا شَهَادَةُ بَيْنِكُمْ ‏إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ}‏
verses.translit: waqaala liy 'aliyuu bnu 'abdi allaahi hadaathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, hadaathanaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an muhamaadi bni aabiy alqaasimi, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abaaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kharaja rajulun min baniy sahmin ma'a tamiymin aldaaariyii wa'adiyii bni badaaa'in famaata alsaahmiyuu biaardin laysa bihaa muslimun, falamaaa qadimaa bitarikatihi faqaduwa jaamana min fidaaain mukhawaasana min dhahabin, faaahlafahumaa rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, thumaa wujida aljaamu bimakaaaa faqaaluwa abta'naahu min tamiymin wa'adiyinn‏.‏ faqaama rajulaani min aawliyaaiihi, fahalafaa lashahaadatunaa aahaquu min shahaadatihimaa, waiinaa aljaama lisaahibihim‏.‏ qaala wafiyhim nazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏yaa aayuuhaa alaadhiyna amanuwa shahaadaau baynikum ‏iidhaa hadara aahadakumu almawtu}‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas (ra) said, "A man from the tribe of Bani Sahm went out in the company of Tamim Ad-Dari and 'Adi bin Badda'. The man of Bani Sahm died in a land where there was no Muslim. When Tamim and 'Adi returned conveying the property of the deceased, they claimed that they had lost a silver bowl with gold engraving. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made them take an oath (to confirm their claim), and then the bowl was found in Makkah with some people who claimed that they had bought it from Tamim and 'Adi. Then two witnesses from the relatives of the deceased got up and swore that their witnesses were more valid than the witnesses of 'Adi and Tamim, and that the bowl belonged to their deceased fellow. So, this verse was revealed in connection with this case: 'O you who believe! When death approached any of you ...'," (V 5:)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 55 — Wills and Testaments (Wasaayaa)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَابِقٍ، أَوِ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْهُ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ اسْتُشْهِدَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ، وَتَرَكَ سِتَّ بَنَاتٍ، وَتَرَكَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنًا، فَلَمَّا حَضَرَ جِدَادُ النَّخْلِ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ وَالِدِي اسْتُشْهِدَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ وَتَرَكَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنًا كَثِيرًا، وَإِنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ يَرَاكَ الْغُرَمَاءُ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ فَبَيْدِرْ كُلَّ تَمْرٍ عَلَى نَاحِيَتِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَفَعَلْتُ ثُمَّ دَعَوْتُهُ، فَلَمَّا نَظَرُوا إِلَيْهِ أُغْرُوا بِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةَ، فَلَمَّا رَأَى مَا يَصْنَعُونَ أَطَافَ حَوْلَ أَعْظَمِهَا بَيْدَرًا ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ جَلَسَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ادْعُ أَصْحَابَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَمَا زَالَ يَكِيلُ لَهُمْ حَتَّى أَدَّى اللَّهُ أَمَانَةَ وَالِدِي، وَأَنَا وَاللَّهِ رَاضٍ أَنْ يُؤَدِّيَ اللَّهُ أَمَانَةَ وَالِدِي وَلاَ أَرْجِعَ إِلَى أَخَوَاتِي بِتَمْرَةٍ، فَسَلِمَ وَاللَّهِ الْبَيَادِرُ كُلُّهَا حَتَّى أَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْبَيْدَرِ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَأَنَّهُ لَمْ يَنْقُصْ تَمْرَةً وَاحِدَةً‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْد اللَّهِ أُغْرُوا بِي يَعْنِي هِيجُوا بِي فَأَغْرَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ الْعَدَاوَةَ وَالْبَغْضَاءَ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu saabiqin, aawi alfadlu bnu ya'quwba 'anhu hadaathanaa shaybaanu aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'an firaasin, qaala qaala alshaa'biyuu hadaathaniy jaabiru bnu 'abdi allaahi alaansaariyuu rda allh 'nhma aanaa aabaahu astushhida yawma auhudin, wataraka sitaa banaatin, wataraka 'alayhi daynana, falamaaa hadara jidaadu alnaakhli aataytu rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu yaa rasuwla allaahi qad 'alimta aanaa waalidiy astushhida yawma auhudin wataraka 'alayhi daynana kathiyrana, waiiniiy auhibuu aan yaraaka alghuramaa'u qaala ‏"‏ adhhab fabaydir kulaa tamrin 'alaa naahiyatihi ‏"‏‏.‏ fafa'altu thumaa da'awtuhu, falamaaa nazaruwa iilayhi aughruwa biy tilka alsaaa'aaa, falamaaa raaaa maa yasna'uwna aataafa hawla aa'zamihaa baydarana thalaatha maraaatin thumaa jalasa 'alayhi thumaa qaala ‏"‏ ad'u aashaabaka ‏"‏‏.‏ famaa zaala yakiylu lahum hataaa aadaaa allaahu aamaanaaa waalidiy, waaanaa waallaahi raadin aan yuuadiiya allaahu aamaanaaa waalidiy walaa aarji'a iilaa aakhawaatiy bitamraain, fasalima waallaahi albayaadiru kuluuhaa hataaa aaniiy aanzuru iilaa albaydari alaadhiy 'alayhi rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaaanaahu lam yanqus tamraaan waahidaaan‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abd allaahi aughruwa biy ya'niy hiyjuwa biy faaaghraynaa baynahum al'adaawaaa waalbaghdaa'a
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari:My father was martyred on the day (of the Ghazwa) of Uhud and left six daughters and some debts to be paid. When the time of plucking the date-fruits came, I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Apostle! you know that my father was martyred on Uhud's day and owed much debt, and I wish that the creditors would see you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go and collect the various kinds of dates and place them separately in heaps"' I did accordingly and called him. On seeing him, the creditors started claiming their rights pressingly at that time. When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw how they behaved, he went round the biggest heap for three times and sat over it and said, "Call your companions (i.e. the creditors)." Then he kept on measuring and giving them, till Allah cleared all my father's debts. By Allah, it would have pleased me that Allah would clear the debts of my father even though I had not taken a single date to my sisters. But by Allah, all the heaps were complete, (as they were) and I looked at the heap where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting and noticed as if not a single date had been taken thereof
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَبَّاحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَابِقٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ الْعَيْزَارِ، ذَكَرَ عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الْعَمَلِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَى مِيقَاتِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ بِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَسَكَتُّ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَوِ اسْتَزَدْتُهُ لَزَادَنِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu sabbaahin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu saabiqin, haddathanaa maaliku bnu mighwalin, qaala sami'tu alwaliyda bna al'ayzaari, dhakara 'an aabiy 'amrinw alshhaybaaniyyi, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu mas'uwdin rda allh 'nh saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aaaau al'amali aafdalu qaala ‏"‏ alssalaaau 'alaa miyqaatihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu thumma aaaaun‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ thumma birru alwaalidayni ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu thumma aaaaun qaala ‏"‏ aljihaadu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ fasakattu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walawi astazadtuhu lazaadaniy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is the best deed?" He replied, "To offer the prayers at their early stated fixed times." I asked, "What is next in goodness?" He replied, "To be good and dutiful to your parents." I further asked, what is next in goodness?" He replied, "To participate in Jihad in Allah's Cause." I did not ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) anymore and if I had asked him more, he would have told me more
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏لاَ هِجْرَةَ بَعْدَ الْفَتْحِ وَلَكِنْ جِهَادٌ وَنِيَّةٌ، وَإِذَا اسْتُنْفِرْتُمْ فَانْفِرُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala haddathaniy mansuwrun, 'an mujaahidin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏laa hijraaa ba'da alfathi walakin jihaadun waniyyaaun, waiidhaa astunfirtum faanfiruwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is no Hijra (i.e. migration) (from Mecca to Medina) after the Conquest (of Mecca), but Jihad and good intention remain; and if you are called (by the Muslim ruler) for fighting, go forth immediately
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بِنْتِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تُرَى الْجِهَادَ أَفْضَلَ الْعَمَلِ، أَفَلاَ نُجَاهِدُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَكِنَّ أَفْضَلَ الْجِهَادِ حَجٌّ مَبْرُورٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa khaalidun, haddathanaa habiybu bnu aabiy 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa binti talhaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aannahaa qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi turaa aljihaada aafdala al'amali, aafalaa nujaahidu qaala ‏ "‏ lakinna aafdala aljihaadi hajjun mabruwrun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(That she said), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We consider Jihad as the best deed. Should we not fight in Allah's Cause?" He said, "The best Jihad (for women) is Hajj-Mabrur (i.e. Hajj which is done according to the Prophet's tradition and is accepted by Allah)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُحَادَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو حَصِينٍ، أَنَّ ذَكْوَانَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ دُلَّنِي عَلَى عَمَلٍ يَعْدِلُ الْجِهَادَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ أَجِدُهُ ـ قَالَ ـ هَلْ تَسْتَطِيعُ إِذَا خَرَجَ الْمُجَاهِدُ أَنْ تَدْخُلَ مَسْجِدَكَ فَتَقُومَ وَلاَ تَفْتُرَ وَتَصُومَ وَلاَ تُفْطِرَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَنْ يَسْتَطِيعُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ إِنَّ فَرَسَ الْمُجَاهِدِ لَيَسْتَنُّ فِي طِوَلِهِ فَيُكْتَبُ لَهُ حَسَنَاتٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu juhaadaaa, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw hasiynin, aanna dhakwaana, haddathahu aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh haddathahu qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala dullaniy 'alaa 'amalin ya'dilu aljihaada‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ laa aajiduhu qaala hal tastatiy'u iidhaa kharaja almujaahidu aan tadkhula masjidaka fataquwma walaa taftura watasuwma walaa tuftira ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala waman yastatiy'u dhalika qaala aabuw hurayraaa iinna farasa almujaahidi layastannu fiy tiwalihi fayuktabu lahu hasanaatin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "Instruct me as to such a deed as equals Jihad (in reward)." He replied, "I do not find such a deed." Then he added, "Can you, while the Muslim fighter is in the battle-field, enter your mosque to perform prayers without cease and fast and never break your fast?" The man said, "But who can do that?" Abu Huraira added, "The Mujahid (i.e. Muslim fighter) is rewarded even for the footsteps of his horse while it wanders about (for grazing) tied in a long rope
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيُّ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَىُّ النَّاسِ أَفْضَلُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مُؤْمِنٌ يُجَاهِدُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا ثُمَّ مَنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ مُؤْمِنٌ فِي شِعْبٍ مِنَ الشِّعَابِ يَتَّقِي اللَّهَ، وَيَدَعُ النَّاسَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'ataa'u bnu yaziyda alllaythiyyu, aanna aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya rda allh 'nh haddathahu qaala qiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi, aaaau alnnaasi aafdalu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ muuminun yujaahidu fiy sabiyli alllahi binafsihi wamaalihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa thumma man qaala ‏"‏ muuminun fiy shi'bin mina alshhi'aabi yattaqiy alllaha, wayada'u alnnaasa min sharrihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Somebody asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Who is the best among the people?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied "A believer who strives his utmost in Allah's Cause with his life and property." They asked, "Who is next?" He replied, "A believer who stays in one of the mountain paths worshipping Allah and leaving the people secure from his mischief
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَثَلُ الْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ـ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ يُجَاهِدُ فِي سَبِيلِهِ ـ كَمَثَلِ الصَّائِمِ الْقَائِمِ، وَتَوَكَّلَ اللَّهُ لِلْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِهِ بِأَنْ يَتَوَفَّاهُ أَنْ يُدْخِلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ، أَوْ يَرْجِعَهُ سَالِمًا مَعَ أَجْرٍ أَوْ غَنِيمَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ mathalu almujaahidi fiy sabiyli alllahi waalllahu aa'lamu biman yujaahidu fiy sabiylihi kamathali alssaaiimi alqaaiimi, watawakkala alllahu lilmujaahidi fiy sabiylihi biaan yatawaffaahu aan yudkhilahu aljannaaa, aaw yarji'ahu saalimana ma'a aajrin aaw ghaniymaain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The example of a Mujahid in Allah's Cause-- and Allah knows better who really strives in His Cause----is like a person who fasts and prays continuously. Allah guarantees that He will admit the Mujahid in His Cause into Paradise if he is killed, otherwise He will return him to his home safely with rewards and war booty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْخُلُ عَلَى أُمِّ حَرَامٍ بِنْتِ مِلْحَانَ، فَتُطْعِمُهُ، وَكَانَتْ أُمُّ حَرَامٍ تَحْتَ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَطْعَمَتْهُ وَجَعَلَتْ تَفْلِي رَأْسَهُ، فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ وَمَا يُضْحِكُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عُرِضُوا عَلَىَّ، غُزَاةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، يَرْكَبُونَ ثَبَجَ هَذَا الْبَحْرِ، مُلُوكًا عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ، أَوْ مِثْلُ الْمُلُوكِ عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ شَكَّ إِسْحَاقُ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ فَدَعَا لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ وَضَعَ رَأْسَهُ، ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ فَقُلْتُ وَمَا يُضْحِكُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عُرِضُوا عَلَىَّ، غُزَاةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ كَمَا قَالَ فِي الأَوَّلِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْتِ مِنَ الأَوَّلِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَكِبَتِ الْبَحْرَ فِي زَمَانِ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، فَصُرِعَتْ عَنْ دَابَّتِهَا حِينَ خَرَجَتْ مِنَ الْبَحْرِ، فَهَلَكَتْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, 'an maalikin, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aannahu sami'ahu yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadkhulu 'alaa aummi haraamin binti milhaana, fatut'imuhu, wakaanat aummu haraamin tahta 'ubaadaaa bni alssaamiti, fadakhala 'alayhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaat'amathu waja'alat tafliy raasahu, fanaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma astayqaza wahuwa yadhaku‏.‏ qaalat faqultu wamaa yudhikuka yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ naasun min aummatiy 'uriduwa 'alaaaa, ghuzaaaan fiy sabiyli alllahi, yarkabuwna thabaja hadhaa albahri, muluwkana 'alaa alaasirraai, aaw mithlu almuluwki 'alaa alaasirraai ‏"‏‏.‏ shakka iishaaqu‏.‏ qaalat faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ fada'aa lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma wada'a raasahu, thumma astayqaza wahuwa yadhaku faqultu wamaa yudhikuka yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ naasun min aummatiy 'uriduwa 'alaaaa, ghuzaaaan fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ kamaa qaala fiy alaawwali‏.‏ qaalat faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aanti mina alaawwaliyna ‏"‏‏.‏ farakibati albahra fiy zamaani mu'aawiyaaa bni aabiy sufyaana, fasuri'at 'an daabbatihaa hiyna kharajat mina albahri, fahalakat‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to visit Umm Haram bint Milhan, who would offer him meals. Umm Haram was the wife of Ubada bin As-Samit. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), once visited her and she provided him with food and started looking for lice in his head. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept, and afterwards woke up smiling. Umm Haram asked, "What causes you to smile, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said. "Some of my followers who (in a dream) were presented before me as fighters in Allah's cause (on board a ship) amidst this sea caused me to smile; they were as kings on the thrones (or like kings on the thrones)." (Ishaq, a sub-narrator is not sure as to which expression the Prophet (ﷺ) used.) Umm Haram said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah that he makes me one of them. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked Allah for her and slept again and woke up smiling. Once again Umm Haram asked, "What makes you smile, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He replied, "Some of my followers were presented to me as fighters in Allah's Cause," repeating the same dream. Umm Haram said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah that He makes me one of them." He said, "You are amongst the first ones." It happened that she sailed on the sea during the Caliphate of Mu'awiya bin Abi Sufyan, and after she disembarked, she fell down from her riding animal and died
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَبِرَسُولِهِ وَأَقَامَ الصَّلاَةَ وَصَامَ رَمَضَانَ، كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يُدْخِلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ جَاهَدَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، أَوْ جَلَسَ فِي أَرْضِهِ الَّتِي وُلِدَ فِيهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفَلاَ نُبَشِّرُ النَّاسَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ مِائَةَ دَرَجَةٍ أَعَدَّهَا اللَّهُ لِلْمُجَاهِدِينَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، مَا بَيْنَ الدَّرَجَتَيْنِ كَمَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ، فَإِذَا سَأَلْتُمُ اللَّهَ فَاسْأَلُوهُ الْفِرْدَوْسَ، فَإِنَّهُ أَوْسَطُ الْجَنَّةِ وَأَعْلَى الْجَنَّةِ، أُرَاهُ فَوْقَهُ عَرْشُ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَمِنْهُ تَفَجَّرُ أَنْهَارُ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُلَيْحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ ‏"‏ وَفَوْقَهُ عَرْشُ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu saalihin, haddathanaa fulayhun, 'an hilaali bni 'aliyyin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man amana bialllahi wabirasuwlihi waaaqaama alssalaaaa wasaama ramadaana, kaana haqqana 'alaa alllahi aan yudkhilahu aljannaaa jaahada fiy sabiyli alllahi, aaw jalasa fiy aardihi allatiy wulida fiyhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi aafalaa nubashhiru alnnaasa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinna fiy aljannaai miaiaaa darajaain aa'addahaa alllahu lilmujaahidiyna fiy sabiyli alllahi, maa bayna alddarajatayni kamaa bayna alssamaa'i waalaardi, faiidhaa saaaltumu alllaha faasaaluwhu alfirdawsa, faiinnahu aawsatu aljannaai waaa'laa aljannaai, auraahu fawqahu 'arshu alrrahmani, waminhu tafajjaru aanhaaru aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala muhammadu bnu fulayhin 'an aabiyhi ‏"‏ wafawqahu 'arshu alrrahmani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever believes in Allah and His Apostle, offers prayer perfectly and fasts the month of Ramadan, will rightfully be granted Paradise by Allah, no matter whether he fights in Allah's Cause or remains in the land where he is born." The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! Shall we acquaint the people with this good news?" He said, "Paradise has one-hundred grades which Allah has reserved for the Mujahidin who fight in His Cause, and the distance between each of two grades is like the distance between the Heaven and the Earth. So, when you ask Allah (for something), ask for Al-firdaus which is the best and highest part of Paradise." (The sub-narrator added, "I think the Prophet also said, 'Above it (i.e. Al-Firdaus) is the Throne of Beneficent (i.e. Allah), and from it originate the rivers of Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ رَأَيْتُ اللَّيْلَةَ رَجُلَيْنِ أَتَيَانِي فَصَعِدَا بِي الشَّجَرَةَ، فَأَدْخَلاَنِي دَارًا هِيَ أَحْسَنُ وَأَفْضَلُ، لَمْ أَرَ قَطُّ أَحْسَنَ مِنْهَا قَالاَ أَمَّا هَذِهِ الدَّارُ فَدَارُ الشُّهَدَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, haddathanaa aabuw rajaa'in, 'an samuraaa, qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ raaaytu alllaylaaa rajulayni aatayaaniy fasa'idaa biy alshhajaraaa, faaadkhalaaniy daarana hiya aahsanu waaafdalu, lam aara qattu aahsana minhaa qaalaa aammaa hadhihi alddaaru fadaaru alshhuhadaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Samura:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Last night two men came to me (in a dream) and made me ascend a tree and then admitted me into a better and superior house, better of which I have never seen. One of them said, 'This house is the house of martyrs
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَغَدْوَةٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوْ رَوْحَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa humaydun, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laghadwaaun fiy sabiyli alllahi aaw rawhaaun khayrun mina alddunyaa wamaa fiyhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A single endeavor (of fighting) in Allah's Cause in the forenoon or in the afternoon is better than the world and whatever is in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُلَيْحٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏لَقَابُ قَوْسٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا تَطْلُعُ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ وَتَغْرُبُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَغَدْوَةٌ أَوْ رَوْحَةٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا تَطْلُعُ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ وَتَغْرُبُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fulayhin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an hilaali bni 'aliyyin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy 'amraaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏laqaabu qawsin fiy aljannaai khayrun mimmaa tatlu'u 'alayhi alshhamsu wataghrubu ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ laghadwaaun aaw rawhaaun fiy sabiyli alllahi khayrun mimmaa tatlu'u 'alayhi alshhamsu wataghrubu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A place in Paradise as small as a bow is better than all that on which the sun rises and sets (i.e. all the world)." He also said, "A single endeavor in Allah's Cause in the afternoon or in the forenoon is better than all that on which the sun rises and sets
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الرَّوْحَةُ وَالْغَدْوَةُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alrrawhaau waalghadwaau fiy sabiyli alllahi aafdalu mina alddunyaa wamaa fiyhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A single endeavor in Allah's Cause in the afternoon and in the forenoon is better than the world and whatever is in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَمُوتُ لَهُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ، يَسُرُّهُ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا، وَأَنَّ لَهُ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا، إِلاَّ الشَّهِيدَ، لِمَا يَرَى مِنْ فَضْلِ الشَّهَادَةِ، فَإِنَّهُ يَسُرُّهُ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا فَيُقْتَلَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, 'an humaydin, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa min 'abdin yamuwtu lahu 'inda alllahi khayrun, yasurruhu aan yarji'a iilaa alddunyaa, waaanna lahu alddunyaa wamaa fiyhaa, iilaaa alshhahiyda, limaa yaraa min fadli alshhahaadaai, faiinnahu yasurruhu aan yarji'a iilaa alddunyaa fayuqtala marraaan aukhraa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Nobody who dies and finds good from Allah (in the Hereafter) would wish to come back to this world even if he were given the whole world and whatever is in it, except the martyr who, on seeing the superiority of martyrdom, would like to come back to the world and get killed again (in Allah's Cause)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: وَسَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَرَوْحَةٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوْ غَدْوَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا، وَلَقَابُ قَوْسِ أَحَدِكُمْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ أَوْ مَوْضِعُ قِيدٍ ـ يَعْنِي سَوْطَهُ ـ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا، وَلَوْ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ اطَّلَعَتْ إِلَى أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ لأَضَاءَتْ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَلَمَلأَتْهُ رِيحًا، وَلَنَصِيفُهَا عَلَى رَأْسِهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wasami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ larawhaaun fiy sabiyli alllahi aaw ghadwaaun khayrun mina alddunyaa wamaa fiyhaa, walaqaabu qawsi aahadikum mina aljannaai aaw mawdi'u qiydin ya'niy sawtahu khayrun mina alddunyaa wamaa fiyhaa, walaw aanna amraaaaan min aahli aljannaai attala'at iilaa aahli alaardi laadaa'at maa baynahumaa walamalaathu riyhana, walanasiyfuhaa 'alaa raasihaa khayrun mina alddunyaa wamaa fiyhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A single endeavor (of fighting) in Allah's Cause in the afternoon or in the forenoon is better than all the world and whatever is in it. A place in Paradise as small as the bow or lash of one of you is better than all the world and whatever is in it. And if a houri from Paradise appeared to the people of the earth, she would fill the space between Heaven and the Earth with light and pleasant scent and her head cover is better than the world and whatever is in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَوْلاَ أَنَّ رِجَالاً مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لاَ تَطِيبُ أَنْفُسُهُمْ أَنْ يَتَخَلَّفُوا عَنِّي، وَلاَ أَجِدُ مَا أَحْمِلُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ، مَا تَخَلَّفْتُ عَنْ سَرِيَّةٍ تَغْزُو فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَوَدِدْتُ أَنِّي أُقْتَلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ أُحْيَا، ثُمَّ أُقْتَلُ ثُمَّ أُحْيَا، ثُمَّ أُقْتَلُ ثُمَّ أُحْيَا، ثُمَّ أُقْتَلُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi lawlaa aanna rijaalaan mina almuuminiyna laa tatiybu aanfusuhum aan yatakhallafuwa 'anniy, walaa aajidu maa aahmiluhum 'alayhi, maa takhallaftu 'an sariyyaain taghzuw fiy sabiyli alllahi, waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi lawadidtu aanniy auqtalu fiy sabiyli alllahi thumma auhyaa, thumma auqtalu thumma auhyaa, thumma auqtalu thumma auhyaa, thumma auqtalu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hands my life is! Were it not for some men amongst the believers who dislike to be left behind me and whom I cannot provide with means of conveyance, I would certainly never remain behind any Sariya' (army-unit) setting out in Allah's Cause. By Him in Whose Hands my life is! I would love to be martyred in Allah's Cause and then get resurrected and then get martyred, and then get resurrected again and then get martyred and then get resurrected again and then get martyred
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الصَّفَّارُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ خَطَبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَخَذَ الرَّايَةَ زَيْدٌ فَأُصِيبَ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا جَعْفَرٌ فَأُصِيبَ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَوَاحَةَ فَأُصِيبَ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ غَيْرِ إِمْرَةٍ فَفُتِحَ لَهُ ـ وَقَالَ ـ مَا يَسُرُّنَا أَنَّهُمْ عِنْدَنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَيُّوبُ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا يَسُرُّهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ عِنْدَنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَيْنَاهُ تَذْرِفَانِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yuwsufu bnu ya'quwba alssaffaaru, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an aayyuwba, 'an humaydi bni hilaalin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala khataba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aakhadha alrraayaaa zaydun faausiyba, thumma aakhadhahaa ja'farun faausiyba, thumma aakhadhahaa 'abdu alllahi bnu rawaahaaa faausiyba, thumma aakhadhahaa khaalidu bnu alwaliydi 'an ghayri iimraain fafutiha lahu waqaala maa yasurrunaa aannahum 'indanaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aayyuwbu aaw qaala ‏"‏ maa yasurruhum aannahum 'indanaa ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'aynaahu tadhrifaani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered a sermon and said, "Zaid took the flag and was martyred, and then Ja`far took the flag and was martyred, and then `Abdullah bin Rawaha took the flag and was martyred too, and then Khalid bin Al-Walid took the flag though he was not appointed as a commander and Allah made him victorious." The Prophet (ﷺ) further added, "It would not please us to have them with us." Aiyub, a sub-narrator, added, "Or the Prophet, shedding tears, said, 'It would not please them to be with us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ خَالَتِهِ أُمِّ حَرَامٍ بِنْتِ مِلْحَانَ، قَالَتْ نَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا قَرِيبًا مِنِّي، ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ يَتَبَسَّمُ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ مَا أَضْحَكَكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ أُنَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عُرِضُوا عَلَىَّ يَرْكَبُونَ هَذَا الْبَحْرَ الأَخْضَرَ، كَالْمُلُوكِ عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ فَدَعَا لَهَا، ثُمَّ نَامَ الثَّانِيَةَ، فَفَعَلَ مِثْلَهَا، فَقَالَتْ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهَا، فَأَجَابَهَا مِثْلَهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَتِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْتِ مِنَ الأَوَّلِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَخَرَجَتْ مَعَ زَوْجِهَا عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ غَازِيًا أَوَّلَ مَا رَكِبَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ الْبَحْرَ مَعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفُوا مِنْ غَزْوِهِمْ قَافِلِينَ فَنَزَلُوا الشَّأْمَ، فَقُرِّبَتْ إِلَيْهَا دَابَّةٌ لِتَرْكَبَهَا فَصَرَعَتْهَا فَمَاتَتْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathaniy alllaythu, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an muhammadi bni yahyaa bni habbaana, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'an khaalatihi aummi haraamin binti milhaana, qaalat naama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana qariybana minniy, thumma astayqaza yatabassamu‏.‏ faqultu maa aadhakaka qaala ‏"‏ aunaasun min aummatiy 'uriduwa 'alaaaa yarkabuwna hadhaa albahra alaakhdara, kaalmuluwki 'alaa alaasirraai ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat faad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ fada'aa lahaa, thumma naama althhaaniyaaa, fafa'ala mithlahaa, faqaalat mithla qawlihaa, faaajaabahaa mithlahaa‏.‏ faqaalati ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aanti mina alaawwaliyna ‏"‏‏.‏ fakharajat ma'a zawjihaa 'ubaadaaa bni alssaamiti ghaaziyana aawwala maa rakiba almuslimuwna albahra ma'a mu'aawiyaaa, falammaa ansarafuwa min ghazwihim qaafiliyna fanazaluwa alshhaama, faqurribat iilayhaa daabbaaun litarkabahaa fasara'athaa famaatat‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Um Haram said, "Once the Prophet (ﷺ) slept in my house near to me and got up smiling. I said, 'What makes you smile?' He replied, 'Some of my followers who (i.e. in a dream) were presented to me sailing on this green sea like kings on thrones.' I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to make me one of them." So the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah for her and went to sleep again. He did the same (i.e. got up and told his dream) and Um Haram repeated her question and he gave the same reply. She said, "Invoke Allah to make me one of them." He said, "You are among the first batch." Later on it happened that she went out in the company of her husband 'Ubada bin As-Samit who went for Jihad and it was the first time the Muslims undertook a naval expedition led by Mu'awiya. When the expedition came to an end and they were returning to Sham, a riding animal was presented to her to ride, but the animal let her fall and thus she died
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْحَوْضِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقْوَامًا مِنْ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ إِلَى بَنِي عَامِرٍ فِي سَبْعِينَ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمُوا، قَالَ لَهُمْ خَالِي أَتَقَدَّمُكُمْ، فَإِنْ أَمَّنُونِي حَتَّى أُبَلِّغَهُمْ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَإِلاَّ كُنْتُمْ مِنِّي قَرِيبًا‏.‏ فَتَقَدَّمَ، فَأَمَّنُوهُ، فَبَيْنَمَا يُحَدِّثُهُمْ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ أَوْمَئُوا إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ، فَطَعَنَهُ فَأَنْفَذَهُ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، فُزْتُ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ‏.‏ ثُمَّ مَالُوا عَلَى بَقِيَّةِ أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَتَلُوهُمْ، إِلاَّ رَجُلاً أَعْرَجَ صَعِدَ الْجَبَلَ‏.‏ قَالَ هَمَّامٌ فَأُرَاهُ آخَرَ مَعَهُ، فَأَخْبَرَ جِبْرِيلُ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ لَقُوا رَبَّهُمْ، فَرَضِيَ عَنْهُمْ وَأَرْضَاهُمْ، فَكُنَّا نَقْرَأُ أَنْ بَلِّغُوا قَوْمَنَا أَنْ قَدْ لَقِينَا رَبَّنَا فَرَضِيَ عَنَّا وَأَرْضَانَا‏.‏ ثُمَّ نُسِخَ بَعْدُ، فَدَعَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَرْبَعِينَ صَبَاحًا، عَلَى رِعْلٍ وَذَكْوَانَ وَبَنِي لِحْيَانَ وَبَنِي عُصَيَّةَ الَّذِينَ عَصَوُا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara alhawdiyyu, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an iishaaqa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala ba'atha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aaqwaamana min baniy sulaymin iilaa baniy 'aamirin fiy sab'iyna, falammaa qadimuwa, qaala lahum khaaliy aataqaddamukum, faiin aammanuwniy hattaa auballighahum 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waiilaaa kuntum minniy qariybana‏.‏ fataqaddama, faaammanuwhu, fabaynamaa yuhaddithuhum 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh aawmaiuwa iilaa rajulin minhum, fata'anahu faaanfadhahu faqaala alllahu aakbaru, fuztu warabbi alka'baai‏.‏ thumma maaluwa 'alaa baqiyyaai aashaabihi faqataluwhum, iilaaa rajulaan aa'raja sa'ida aljabala‏.‏ qaala hammaamun faauraahu akhara ma'ahu, faaakhbara jibriylu 'alayhi alssalaamu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahum qad laquwa rabbahum, faradiya 'anhum waaardaahum, fakunnaa naqraau aan ballighuwa qawmanaa aan qad laqiynaa rabbanaa faradiya 'annaa waaardaanaa‏.‏ thumma nusikha ba'du, fada'aa 'alayhim aarba'iyna sabaahana, 'alaa ri'lin wadhakwaana wabaniy lihyaana wabaniy 'usayyaaa alladhiyna 'asawua alllaha warasuwlahu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent seventy men from the tribe of Bani Sulaim to the tribe of Bani Amir. When they reached there, my maternal uncle said to them, "I will go ahead of you, and if they allow me to convey the message of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (it will be all right); otherwise you will remain close to me." So he went ahead of them and the pagans granted him security But while he was reporting the message of the Prophet (ﷺ) , they beckoned to one of their men who stabbed him to death. My maternal uncle said, "Allah is Greater! By the Lord of the Ka`ba, I am successful." After that they attacked the rest of the party and killed them all except a lame man who went up to the top of the mountain. (Hammam, a sub-narrator said, "I think another man was saved along with him)." Gabriel informed the Prophet (ﷺ) that they (i.e the martyrs) met their Lord, and He was pleased with them and made them pleased.
