verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ خَرَجَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَخَلَّفَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ مَعَ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ وَهْوَ غَيْرُ مُحْرِمٍ، فَرَأَوْا حِمَارًا وَحْشِيًّا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرَاهُ، فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ تَرَكُوهُ حَتَّى رَآهُ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ، فَرَكِبَ فَرَسًا لَهُ يُقَالُ لَهُ الْجَرَادَةُ، فَسَأَلَهُمْ أَنْ يُنَاوِلُوهُ سَوْطَهُ فَأَبَوْا، فَتَنَاوَلَهُ فَحَمَلَ فَعَقَرَهُ، ثُمَّ أَكَلَ فَأَكَلُوا، فَنَدِمُوا فَلَمَّا أَدْرَكُوهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ هَلْ مَعَكُمْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مَعَنَا رِجْلُهُ، فَأَخَذَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَكَلَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin, haddathanaa fudaylu bnu sulaymaana, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu kharaja ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatakhallafa aabuw qataadaaa ma'a ba'di aashaabihi wahum muhrimuwna wahwa ghayru muhrimin, faraaawa himaarana wahshiyyana qabla aan yaraahu, falammaa raaawhu tarakuwhu hattaa raahu aabuw qataadaaa, farakiba farasana lahu yuqaalu lahu aljaraadaau, fasaaalahum aan yunaawiluwhu sawtahu faaabawa, fatanaawalahu fahamala fa'aqarahu, thumma aakala faaakaluwa, fanadimuwa falammaa aadrakuwhu qaala ‏ "‏ hal ma'akum minhu shaa'un ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala ma'anaa rijluhu, faaakhadhahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakalahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:(from his father) Abu Qatada went out (on a journey) with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) but he was left behind with some of his companions who were in the state of Ihram. He himself was not in the state of Ihram. They saw an onager before he could see it. When they saw the onager, they did not speak anything till Abu Qatada saw it. So, he rode over his horse called Al-Jarada and requested them to give him his lash, but they refused. So, he himself took it and then attacked the onager and slaughtered it. He ate of its meat and his companions ate, too, but they regretted their eating. When they met the Prophet (they asked him about it) and he asked, "Have you some of its meat (left) with you?" Abu Qatada replied, "Yes, we have its leg with us." So, the Prophet (ﷺ) took and ate it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أُبَىُّ بْنُ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَائِطِنَا فَرَسٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ اللُّحَيْفُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْد اللَّهِ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمُ اللُّخَيْفُ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'aliyuu bnu 'abdi allaahi bni ja'farin, hadaathanaa ma'nu bnu 'iysaa, hadaathanaa aubaauu bnu 'abaaasi bni sahlin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jadiihi, qaala kaana lilnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy haaiitinaa farasun yuqaalu lahu alluuhayfu‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abd allaahi waqaala ba'duhumu alluukhayfu
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl:In our garden there was a horse belonging to the Prophet (ﷺ) called Al-Luhaif or Al-Lukhaif
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، سَمِعَ يَحْيَى بْنَ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ مُعَاذٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنْتُ رِدْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى حِمَارٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ عُفَيْرٌ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ، هَلْ تَدْرِي حَقَّ اللَّهِ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ وَمَا حَقُّ الْعِبَادِ عَلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ حَقَّ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْعِبَادِ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهُ وَلاَ يُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا، وَحَقَّ الْعِبَادِ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ لاَ يُعَذِّبَ مَنْ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَفَلاَ أُبَشِّرُ بِهِ النَّاسَ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تُبَشِّرْهُمْ فَيَتَّكِلُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, sami'a yahyaa bna adama, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an 'amriw bni maymuwnin, 'an mu'aadhin rda allh 'nh qaala kuntu ridfa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa himaarin yuqaalu lahu 'ufayrun, faqaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu, hal tadriy haqqa alllahi 'alaa 'ibaadihi wamaa haqqu al'ibaadi 'alaa alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinna haqqa alllahi 'alaa al'ibaadi aan ya'buduwhu walaa yushrikuwa bihi shayiana, wahaqqa al'ibaadi 'alaa alllahi aan laa yu'adhhiba man laa yushriku bihi shayiana ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, aafalaa aubashhiru bihi alnnaasa qaala ‏"‏ laa tubashhirhum fayattakiluwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mu`adh:I was a companion rider of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a donkey called 'Ufair. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "O Mu`adh! Do you know what Allah's right on His slaves is, and what the right of His slaves on Him is?" I replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He said, "Allah's right on His slaves is that they should worship Him (Alone) and should not worship any besides Him. And slave's right on Allah is that He should not punish him who worships none besides Him." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Should I not inform the people of this good news?" He said, "Do not inform them of it, lest they should depend on it (absolutely)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ فَزَعٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ، فَاسْتَعَارَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَسًا لَنَا يُقَالُ لَهُ مَنْدُوبٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا رَأَيْنَا مِنْ فَزَعٍ، وَإِنْ وَجَدْنَاهُ لَبَحْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, sami'tu qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala kaana faza'un bialmadiynaai, faasta'aara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm farasana lanaa yuqaalu lahu manduwbun‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ maa raaaynaa min faza'in, waiin wajadnaahu labahrana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once there was a feeling of fright in Medina, so the Prophet (ﷺ) borrowed a horse belonging to us called Mandub (and he rode away on it). (When the Prophet (ﷺ) returned) he said, "I have not seen anything of fright and I found it (i.e. this horse) very fast
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا الشُّؤْمُ فِي ثَلاَثَةٍ فِي الْفَرَسِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ وَالدَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinnamaa alshhuumu fiy thalaathaain fiy alfarasi waalmaraaai waalddaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying. "Evil omen is in three things: The horse, the woman and the house
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ كَانَ فِي شَىْءٍ فَفِي الْمَرْأَةِ وَالْفَرَسِ وَالْمَسْكَنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an aabiy haazimi bni diynaarin, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iin kaana fiy shaa'in fafiy almaraaai waalfarasi waalmaskani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Saidi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If there is any evil omen in anything, then it is in the woman, the horse and the house
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْخَيْلُ لِثَلاَثَةٍ لِرَجُلٍ أَجْرٌ، وَلِرَجُلٍ سِتْرٌ، وَعَلَى رَجُلٍ وِزْرٌ، فَأَمَّا الَّذِي لَهُ أَجْرٌ فَرَجُلٌ رَبَطَهَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، فَأَطَالَ فِي مَرْجٍ أَوْ رَوْضَةٍ، فَمَا أَصَابَتْ فِي طِيَلِهَا ذَلِكَ مِنَ الْمَرْجِ أَوِ الرَّوْضَةِ كَانَتْ لَهُ حَسَنَاتٍ، وَلَوْ أَنَّهَا قَطَعَتْ طِيَلَهَا فَاسْتَنَّتْ شَرَفًا أَوْ شَرَفَيْنِ كَانَتْ أَرْوَاثُهَا وَآثَارُهَا حَسَنَاتٍ لَهُ، وَلَوْ أَنَّهَا مَرَّتْ بِنَهَرٍ فَشَرِبَتْ مِنْهُ وَلَمْ يُرِدْ أَنْ يَسْقِيَهَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ حَسَنَاتٍ لَهُ، وَرَجُلٌ رَبَطَهَا فَخْرًا وَرِئَاءً وَنِوَاءً لأَهْلِ الإِسْلاَمِ فَهْىَ وِزْرٌ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَسُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْحُمُرِ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَىَّ فِيهَا إِلاَّ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ الْجَامِعَةُ الْفَاذَّةُ ‏{‏فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ * وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ ‏}‏‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an aabiy saalihin alssammaani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ alkhaylu lithalaathaain lirajulin aajrun, walirajulin sitrun, wa'alaa rajulin wizrun, faaammaa alladhiy lahu aajrun farajulun rabatahaa fiy sabiyli alllahi, faaataala fiy marjin aaw rawdaain, famaa aasaabat fiy tiyalihaa dhalika mina almarji aawi alrrawdaai kaanat lahu hasanaatin, walaw aannahaa qata'at tiyalahaa faastannat sharafana aaw sharafayni kaanat aarwaathuhaa waathaaruhaa hasanaatin lahu, walaw aannahaa marrat binaharin fasharibat minhu walam yurid aan yasqiyahaa kaana dhalika hasanaatin lahu, warajulun rabatahaa fakhrana wariiaa'an waniwaa'an laahli aliislaami fahaa wizrun 'alaa dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏ wasuiila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alhumuri, faqaala ‏"‏ maa aunzila 'alaaaa fiyhaa iilaaa hadhihi alayaau aljaami'aau alfaadhhaau ‏{‏faman ya'mal mithqaala dharraain khayrana yarahu * waman ya'mal mithqaala dharraain sharrana yarahu ‏}‏‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, " Horses are kept for one of three purposes; for some people they are a source of reward, for some others they are a means of shelter and for some others they are a source of sins. The one for whom they are a source of reward, is he who keeps a horse for Allah's Cause (i.e. Jihad) tying it with a long tether on a meadow or in a garden with the result that whatever it eats from the area of the meadow or the garden where it is tied will be counted as good deeds for his benefit, and if it should break its rope and jump over one or two hillocks then all its dung and its foot marks will be written as good deeds for him; and if it passes by a river and drinks water from it even though he had no intention of watering it, even then he will get the reward for its drinking. As for the man for whom horses are a source of sins, he is the one who keeps a horse for the sake of pride and pretense and showing enmity for Muslims: such a horse will be a source of sins for him. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about donkeys, he replied, "Nothing has been revealed to me about them except this unique, comprehensive Verse: "Then anyone who does an atom's (or a small ant's) weight of good shall see it; And anyone who does an atom's (or a small ant's) weight of evil, shall see it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَقِيلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيُّ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ حَدِّثْنِي بِمَا، سَمِعْتَ مِنْ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ سَافَرْتُ مَعَهُ فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ ـ قَالَ أَبُو عَقِيلٍ لاَ أَدْرِي غَزْوَةً أَوْ عُمْرَةً ـ فَلَمَّا أَنْ أَقْبَلْنَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَتَعَجَّلَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَلْيُعَجِّلْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ جَابِرٌ فَأَقْبَلْنَا وَأَنَا عَلَى جَمَلٍ لِي أَرْمَكَ لَيْسَ فِيهِ شِيَةٌ، وَالنَّاسُ خَلْفِي، فَبَيْنَا أَنَا كَذَلِكَ إِذْ قَامَ عَلَىَّ، فَقَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا جَابِرُ اسْتَمْسِكْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَضَرَبَهُ بِسَوْطِهِ ضَرْبَةً، فَوَثَبَ الْبَعِيرُ مَكَانَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَبِيعُ الْجَمَلَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ وَدَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسْجِدَ فِي طَوَائِفِ أَصْحَابِهِ، فَدَخَلْتُ إِلَيْهِ، وَعَقَلْتُ الْجَمَلَ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْبَلاَطِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ هَذَا جَمَلُكَ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ، فَجَعَلَ يُطِيفُ بِالْجَمَلِ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ الْجَمَلُ جَمَلُنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَبَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوَاقٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَعْطُوهَا جَابِرًا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اسْتَوْفَيْتَ الثَّمَنَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ الثَّمَنُ وَالْجَمَلُ لَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, haddathanaa aabuw 'aqiylin, haddathanaa aabuw almutawakkili alnnaajiyyu, qaala aataytu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyya, faqultu lahu haddithniy bimaa, sami'ta min, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala saafartu ma'ahu fiy ba'di aasfaarihi qaala aabuw 'aqiylin laa aadriy ghazwaaan aaw 'umraaan falammaa aan aaqbalnaa qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man aahabba aan yata'ajjala iilaa aahlihi falyu'ajjil ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala jaabirun faaaqbalnaa waaanaa 'alaa jamalin liy aarmaka laysa fiyhi shiyaaun, waalnnaasu khalfiy, fabaynaa aanaa kadhalika iidh qaama 'alaaaa, faqaala liy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa jaabiru astamsik ‏"‏‏.‏ fadarabahu bisawtihi darbaaan, fawathaba alba'iyru makaanahu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aatabiy'u aljamala ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ falammaa qadimnaa almadiynaaa wadakhala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almasjida fiy tawaaiifi aashaabihi, fadakhaltu iilayhi, wa'aqaltu aljamala fiy naahiyaai albalaati‏.‏ faqultu lahu hadhaa jamaluka‏.‏ fakharaja, faja'ala yutiyfu bialjamali wayaquwlu ‏"‏ aljamalu jamalunaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faba'atha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aawaaqin min dhahabin faqaala ‏"‏ aa'tuwhaa jaabirana ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ astawfayta althhamana ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ althhamanu waaljamalu laka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muslim from Abu `Aqil from Abu Al-Mutawakkil An-Naji:I called on Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari and said to him, "Relate to me what you have heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." He said, "I accompanied him on one of the journeys." (Abu `Aqil said, "I do not know whether that journey was for the purpose of Jihad or `Umra.") "When we were returning," Jabir continued, "the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever wants to return earlier to his family, should hurry up.' We set off and I was on a black red tainted camel having no defect, and the people were behind me. While I was in that state the camel stopped suddenly (because of exhaustion). On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, 'O Jabir, wait!' Then he hit it once with his lash and it started moving on a fast pace. He then said, 'Will you sell the camel?' I replied in the affirmative when we reached Medina, and the Prophet (ﷺ) went to the Mosque along with his companions. I, too, went to him after tying the camel on the pavement at the Mosque gate. Then I said to him, 'This is your camel.' He came out and started examining the camel and saying, 'The camel is ours.' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) sent some Awaq (i.e. an amount) of gold saying, 'Give it to Jabir.' Then he asked, 'Have you taken the full price (of the camel)?' I replied in the affirmative. He said, 'Both the price and the camel are for you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَزَعٌ، فَاسْتَعَارَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَسًا لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ، يُقَالُ لَهُ مَنْدُوبٌ فَرَكِبَهُ، وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا رَأَيْنَا مِنْ فَزَعٍ، وَإِنْ وَجَدْنَاهُ لَبَحْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu muhammadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala kaana bialmadiynaai faza'un, faasta'aara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm farasana laabiy talhaaa, yuqaalu lahu manduwbun farakibahu, waqaala ‏ "‏ maa raaaynaa min faza'in, waiin wajadnaahu labahrana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:There was a feeling of fright in Medina, so the Prophet (ﷺ) borrowed a horse called Mandub belonging 'to Abu Talha and mounted it. (On his return), he said, "I did not see anything of fright and I found this horse very fast
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَعَلَ لِلْفَرَسِ سَهْمَيْنِ وَلِصَاحِبِهِ سَهْمًا‏.‏ وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ يُسْهَمُ لِلْخَيْلِ وَالْبَرَاذِينِ مِنْهَا لِقَوْلِهِ ‏{‏وَالْخَيْلَ وَالْبِغَالَ وَالْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا‏}‏ وَلاَ يُسْهَمُ لأَكْثَرَ مِنْ فَرَسٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, 'an aabiy ausaamaaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ja'ala lilfarasi sahmayni walisaahibihi sahmana‏.‏ waqaala maalikun yushamu lilkhayli waalbaraadhiyni minhaa liqawlihi ‏{‏waalkhayla waalbighaala waalhamiyra litarkabuwhaa‏}‏ walaa yushamu laakthara min farasin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fixed two shares for the horse and one share for its rider (from the war booty)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ،‏.‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِلْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَفَرَرْتُمْ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ قَالَ لَكِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَفِرَّ، إِنَّ هَوَازِنَ كَانُوا قَوْمًا رُمَاةً، وَإِنَّا لَمَّا لَقِينَاهُمْ حَمَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فَانْهَزَمُوا، فَأَقْبَلَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ عَلَى الْغَنَائِمِ وَاسْتَقْبَلُونَا بِالسِّهَامِ، فَأَمَّا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَفِرَّ، فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ وَإِنَّهُ لَعَلَى بَغْلَتِهِ الْبَيْضَاءِ وَإِنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ آخِذٌ بِلِجَامِهَا، وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَنَا النَّبِيُّ لاَ كَذِبْ أَنَا ابْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa sahlu bnu yuwsufa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, ‏.‏ qaala rajulun lilbaraa'i bni 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma aafarartum 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma hunaynin qaala lakinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yafirra, iinna hawaazina kaanuwa qawmana rumaaaan, waiinnaa lammaa laqiynaahum hamalnaa 'alayhim faanhazamuwa, faaaqbala almuslimuwna 'alaa alghanaaiimi waastaqbaluwnaa bialssihaami, faaammaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falam yafirra, falaqad raaaytuhu waiinnahu la'alaa baghlatihi albaydaa'i waiinna aabaa sufyaana akhidhun bilijaamihaa, waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ aanaa alnnabiyyu laa kadhib aanaa abnu 'abdi almuttalib ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:Somebody asked Al-Bar-a bin `Azib, "Did you flee deserting Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during the battle of Hunain?" Al-Bara replied, "But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not flee. The people of the Tribe of Hawazin were good archers. When we met them, we attacked them, and they fled. When the Muslims started collecting the war booty, the pagans faced us with arrows, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not flee. No doubt, I saw him on his white mule and Abu Sufyan was holding its reins and the Prophet (ﷺ) was saying, 'I am the Prophet (ﷺ) in truth: I am the son of `Abdul Muttalib
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا أَدْخَلَ رِجْلَهُ فِي الْغَرْزِ وَاسْتَوَتْ بِهِ نَاقَتُهُ قَائِمَةً، أَهَلَّ مِنْ عِنْدِ مَسْجِدِ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, 'an aabiy ausaamaaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ aannahu kaana iidhaa aadkhala rijlahu fiy algharzi waastawat bihi naaqatuhu qaaiimaaan, aahalla min 'indi masjidi dhiy alhulayfaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn'`Umar:When the Prophet (ﷺ) put his feet in the stirrup and the she-camel got up carrying him he would start reciting Talbiya at the mosque of Dhul-Hulaifa
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه اسْتَقْبَلَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى فَرَسٍ عُرْىٍ، مَا عَلَيْهِ سَرْجٌ، فِي عُنُقِهِ سَيْفٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'awnin, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh astaqbalahumu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa farasin 'urain, maa 'alayhi sarjun, fiy 'unuqihi sayfun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) met them (i.e. the people) while he was riding an unsaddled horse with his sword slung over his shoulder
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ أَهْلَ، الْمَدِينَةِ فَزِعُوا مَرَّةً، فَرَكِبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَسًا لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ كَانَ يَقْطِفُ ـ أَوْ كَانَ فِيهِ قِطَافٌ ـ فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَجَدْنَا فَرَسَكُمْ هَذَا بَحْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ لاَ يُجَارَى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna aahla, almadiynaai fazi'uwa marraaan, farakiba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm farasana laabiy talhaaa kaana yaqtifu aaw kaana fiyhi qitaafun falammaa raja'a qaala ‏ "‏ wajadnaa farasakum hadhaa bahrana ‏"‏‏.‏ fakaana ba'da dhalika laa yujaaraa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once the people of Medina were frightened, so the Prophet (ﷺ) rode a horse belonging to Abu Talha and it ran slowly, or was of narrow paces. When he returned, he said, "I found your (i.e. Abu Talha's) horse very fast. After that the horse could not be surpassed in running
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَجْرَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا ضُمِّرَ مِنَ الْخَيْلِ مِنَ الْحَفْيَاءِ إِلَى ثَنِيَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، وَأَجْرَى مَا لَمْ يُضَمَّرْ مِنَ الثَّنِيَّةِ إِلَى مَسْجِدِ بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَكُنْتُ فِيمَنْ أَجْرَى‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ بَيْنَ الْحَفْيَاءِ إِلَى ثَنِيَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ خَمْسَةُ أَمْيَالٍ أَوْ سِتَّةٌ، وَبَيْنَ ثَنِيَّةِ إِلَى مَسْجِدِ بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ مِيلٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala aajraa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm maa dummira mina alkhayli mina alhafyaa'i iilaa thaniyyaai alwadaa'i, waaajraa maa lam yudammar mina althhaniyyaai iilaa masjidi baniy zurayqin‏.‏ qaala abnu 'umara wakuntu fiyman aajraa‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi haddathanaa sufyaanu qaala haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu bayna alhafyaa'i iilaa thaniyyaai alwadaa'i khamsaau aamyaalin aaw sittaaun, wabayna thaniyyaai iilaa masjidi baniy zurayqin miylun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated (`Abdullah) bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) arranged for a horse race amongst the horses that had been made lean to take place between Al-Hafya'' and Thaniyat Al-Wada` (i.e. names of two places) and the horses which had not been made lean from Ath-Thaniyat to the mosque of Bani Zuraiq. I was also amongst those who took part in that horse race. Sufyan, a sub-narrator, said, "The distance between Al-Hafya and Thaniya Al- Wada` is five or six miles; and between Thaniya and the mosque of Bani Zuraiq is one mile
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَابَقَ بَيْنَ الْخَيْلِ الَّتِي لَمْ تُضَمَّرْ، وَكَانَ أَمَدُهَا مِنَ الثَّنِيَّةِ إِلَى مَسْجِدِ بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ‏.‏ وَأَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ سَابَقَ بِهَا‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْد اللَّهِ أَمَدًا غَايَةً فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمْ الْأَمَدُ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, hadaathanaa allaaythu, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi allaahi rda allh 'nh aanaa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm saabaqa bayna alkhayli alaatiy lam tudamaar, wakaana aamaduhaa mina althaaniyaaai iilaa masjidi baniy zurayqin‏.‏ waaanaa 'abda allaahi bna 'umara kaana saabaqa bihaa‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abd allaahi aamadana ghaayaaan fataala 'alayhim alaamadu
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) arranged for a horse race of the horses which had not been made lean; the area of the race was from Ath-Thaniya to the mosque of Bani Zuraiq. (The sub-narrator said, "`Abdullah bin `Umar was amongst those who participated in that horse race)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَابَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ الْخَيْلِ الَّتِي قَدْ أُضْمِرَتْ فَأَرْسَلَهَا مِنَ الْحَفْيَاءِ، وَكَانَ أَمَدُهَا ثَنِيَّةَ الْوَدَاعِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لِمُوسَى فَكَمْ كَانَ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ سِتَّةُ أَمْيَالٍ أَوْ سَبْعَةٌ‏.‏ وَسَابَقَ بَيْنَ الْخَيْلِ الَّتِي لَمْ تُضَمَّرْ، فَأَرْسَلَهَا مِنْ ثَنِيَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، وَكَانَ أَمَدُهَا مَسْجِدَ بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ، قُلْتُ فَكَمْ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ مِيلٌ أَوْ نَحْوُهُ‏.‏ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ مِمَّنْ سَابَقَ فِيهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala saabaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna alkhayli allatiy qad audmirat faaarsalahaa mina alhafyaa'i, wakaana aamaduhaa thaniyyaaa alwadaa'i‏.‏ faqultu limuwsaa fakam kaana bayna dhalika qaala sittaau aamyaalin aaw sab'aaun‏.‏ wasaabaqa bayna alkhayli allatiy lam tudammar, faaarsalahaa min thaniyyaai alwadaa'i, wakaana aamaduhaa masjida baniy zurayqin, qultu fakam bayna dhalika qaala miylun aaw nahwuhu‏.‏ wakaana abnu 'umara mimman saabaqa fiyhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq from Musa bin `Uqba from Nafi` from Ibn `Umar who said:"Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arranged a horse race amongst the horses that had been made lean, letting them start from Al-Hafya' and their limit (distance of running) was up to Thaniyat-al-Wada`. I asked Musa, 'What was the distance between the two places?' Musa replied, 'Six or seven miles. He arranged a race of the horses which had not been made lean sending them from Thaniyat-al-Wada`, and their limit was up to the mosque of Bani Zuraiq.' I asked, 'What was the distance between those two places?' He replied 'One mile or so.' Ibn `Umar was amongst those who participated in that horse race
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ كَانَتْ نَاقَةُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُقَالُ لَهَا الْعَضْبَاءُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, 'an humaydin, qaala sami'tu aanasana rda allh 'nh yaquwlu kaanat naaqaau alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuqaalu lahaa al'adbaa'u‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The she camel of the Prophet (ﷺ) was called Al-Adba
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَاقَةٌ تُسَمَّى الْعَضْبَاءَ لاَ تُسْبَقُ ـ قَالَ حُمَيْدٌ أَوْ لاَ تَكَادُ تُسْبَقُ ـ فَجَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ عَلَى قَعُودٍ فَسَبَقَهَا، فَشَقَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ، حَتَّى عَرَفَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ حَقٌّ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ لاَ يَرْتَفِعَ شَىْءٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا إِلاَّ وَضَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ طَوَّلَهُ مُوسَى عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa zuhayrun, 'an humaydin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala kaana lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm naaqaaun tusammaa al'adbaa'a laa tusbaqu qaala humaydun aaw laa takaadu tusbaqu fajaa'a aa'raabiyyun 'alaa qa'uwdin fasabaqahaa, fashaqqa dhalika 'alaa almuslimiyna, hattaa 'arafahu faqaala ‏ "‏ haqqun 'alaa alllahi aan laa yartafi'a shaa'un mina alddunyaa iilaaa wada'ahu ‏"‏‏.‏ tawwalahu muwsaa 'an hammaadin 'an thaabitin 'an aanasin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had a she camel called Al-Adba which could not be excelled in a race. (Humaid, a subnarrator said, "Or could hardly be excelled.") Once a bedouin came riding a camel below six years of age which surpassed it (i.e. Al-`Adba') in the race. The Muslims felt it so much that the Prophet (ﷺ) noticed their distress. He then said, "It is Allah's Law that He brings down whatever rises high in the world
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ مَا تَرَكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ بَغْلَتَهُ الْبَيْضَاءَ وَسِلاَحَهُ وَأَرْضًا تَرَكَهَا صَدَقَةً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala haddathaniy aabuw iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu 'amraw bna alhaarithi, qaala maa taraka alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa baghlatahu albaydaa'a wasilaahahu waaardana tarakahaa sadaqaaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr bin Al-Harith:The Prophet (ﷺ) did not leave anything behind him after his death except a white mule, his arms and a piece of land which he left to be given in charity
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ يَا أَبَا عُمَارَةَ وَلَّيْتُمْ يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ قَالَ لاَ، وَاللَّهِ مَا وَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَكِنْ وَلَّى سَرَعَانُ النَّاسِ، فَلَقِيَهُمْ هَوَازِنُ بِالنَّبْلِ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى بَغْلَتِهِ الْبَيْضَاءِ، وَأَبُو سُفْيَانَ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ آخِذٌ بِلِجَامِهَا، وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَنَا النَّبِيُّ لاَ كَذِبْ أَنَا ابْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبْ‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an sufyaana, qaala haddathaniy aabuw iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i rda allh 'nh qaala lahu rajulun yaa aabaa 'umaaraaa wallaytum yawma hunaynin qaala laa, waalllahi maa wallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm walakin wallaa sara'aanu alnnaasi, falaqiyahum hawaazinu bialnnabli waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa baghlatihi albaydaa'i, waaabuw sufyaana bnu alhaarithi akhidhun bilijaamihaa, waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ aanaa alnnabiyyu laa kadhib aanaa abnu 'abdi almuttalib‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:that a man asked him. "O Abu '`Umara! Did you flee on the day (of the battle) of Hunain?" He replied, "No, by Allah, the Prophet (ﷺ) did not flee but the hasty people fled and the people of the Tribe of Hawazin attacked them with arrows, while the Prophet (ﷺ) was riding his white mule and Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith was holding its reins, and the Prophet (ﷺ) was saying, 'I am the Prophet (ﷺ) in truth, I am the son of `Abdul Muttalib
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بِنْتِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتِ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْجِهَادِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ جِهَادُكُنَّ الْحَجُّ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni iishaaqa, 'an 'aaiishaaa binti talhaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa aummi almuuminiyna rda allh 'nha qaalati astaadhantu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy aljihaadi‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ jihaadukunna alhajju ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu alwaliydi haddathanaa sufyaanu 'an mu'aawiyaaa bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:the mother of the faithful believers, I requested the Prophet (ﷺ) to permit me to participate in Jihad, but he said, "Your Jihad is the performance of Hajj
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ، بِهَذَا‏.‏ وَعَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بِنْتِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَأَلَهُ نِسَاؤُهُ عَنِ الْجِهَادِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ نِعْمَ الْجِهَادُ الْحَجُّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an mu'aawiyaaa, bihadhaa‏.‏ wa'an habiybi bni aabiy 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa binti talhaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa aummi almuuminiyna, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm saaalahu nisaauuhu 'ani aljihaadi faqaala ‏ "‏ ni'ma aljihaadu alhajju ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:the mother of the faithful believers: The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked by his wives about Jihad and he replied, "The best Jihad (for you) is (the performance of) Hajj
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى ابْنَةِ مِلْحَانَ فَاتَّكَأَ عِنْدَهَا، ثُمَّ ضَحِكَ فَقَالَتْ لِمَ تَضْحَكُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي يَرْكَبُونَ الْبَحْرَ الأَخْضَرَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، مَثَلُهُمْ مَثَلُ الْمُلُوكِ عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ عَادَ فَضَحِكَ، فَقَالَتْ لَهُ مِثْلَ أَوْ مِمَّ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لَهَا مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَتِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْتِ مِنَ الأَوَّلِينَ، وَلَسْتِ مِنَ الآخِرِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَتَزَوَّجَتْ عُبَادَةَ بْنَ الصَّامِتِ، فَرَكِبَتِ الْبَحْرَ مَعَ بِنْتِ قَرَظَةَ، فَلَمَّا قَفَلَتْ رَكِبَتْ دَابَّتَهَا فَوَقَصَتْ بِهَا، فَسَقَطَتْ عَنْهَا فَمَاتَتْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani alaansaariyyi, qaala sami'tu aanasana rda allh 'nh yaquwlu dakhala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa abnaai milhaana faattakaaa 'indahaa, thumma dahika faqaalat lima tadhaku yaa rasuwla alllahi faqaala ‏"‏ naasun min aummatiy yarkabuwna albahra alaakhdara fiy sabiyli alllahi, mathaluhum mathalu almuluwki 'alaa alaasirraai ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi, ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aj'alhaa minhum ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma 'aada fadahika, faqaalat lahu mithla aaw mimma dhalika faqaala lahaa mithla dhalika, faqaalati ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aanti mina alaawwaliyna, walasti mina alakhiriyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qaala aanasun fatazawwajat 'ubaadaaa bna alssaamiti, farakibati albahra ma'a binti qarazaaa, falammaa qafalat rakibat daabbatahaa fawaqasat bihaa, fasaqatat 'anhaa famaatat‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to the daughter of Milhan and reclined there (and slept) and then (woke up) smiling. She asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What makes you smile?" He replied, (I dreamt that) some people amongst my followers were sailing on the green sea in Allah's Cause, resembling kings on thrones." She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to make me one of them." He said, "O Allah! Let her be one of them." Then he (slept again and woke up and) smiled. She asked him the same question and he gave the same reply. She said, "Invoke Allah to make me one of them." He replied, ''You will be amongst the first group of them; you will not be amongst the last." Later on she married 'Ubada bin As-Samit and then she sailed on the sea with bint Qaraza, Mu'awiya's wife (for Jihad). On her return, she mounted her riding animal, which threw her down breaking her neck, and she died on falling down
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ النُّمَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَسَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَعَلْقَمَةَ بْنَ وَقَّاصٍ، وَعُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ حَدِيثِ، عَائِشَةَ، كُلٌّ حَدَّثَنِي طَائِفَةً، مِنَ الْحَدِيثِ قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ أَقْرَعَ بَيْنَ نِسَائِهِ، فَأَيَّتُهُنَّ يَخْرُجُ سَهْمُهَا خَرَجَ بِهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَقْرَعَ بَيْنَنَا فِي غَزْوَةٍ غَزَاهَا، فَخَرَجَ فِيهَا سَهْمِي، فَخَرَجْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ مَا أُنْزِلَ الْحِجَابُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara alnnumayriyyu, haddathanaa yuwnusu, qaala sami'tu alzzuhriyya, qaala sami'tu 'urwaaa bna alzzubayri, wasa'iyda bna almusayyabi, wa'alqamaaa bna waqqaasin, wa'ubayda alllahi bna 'abdi alllahi, 'an hadiythi, 'aaiishaaa, kullun haddathaniy taaiifaaan, mina alhadiythi qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aaraada aan yakhruja aaqra'a bayna nisaaiihi, faaayyatuhunna yakhruju sahmuhaa kharaja bihaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm, faaaqra'a baynanaa fiy ghazwaain ghazaahaa, fakharaja fiyhaa sahmiy, fakharajtu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da maa aunzila alhijaabu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to proceed on a journey, he used to draw lots amongst his wives and would take the one upon whom the lot fell. Once, before setting out for Jihad, he drew lots amongst us and the lot came to me; so I went with the Prophet; and that happened after the revelation of the Verse of Hijab (i.e. veiling)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ أُحُدٍ انْهَزَمَ النَّاسُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ عَائِشَةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَأُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَمُشَمِّرَتَانِ أَرَى خَدَمَ سُوقِهِمَا، تَنْقُزَانِ الْقِرَبَ ـ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ تَنْقُلاَنِ الْقِرَبَ ـ عَلَى مُتُونِهِمَا، ثُمَّ تُفْرِغَانِهِ فِي أَفْوَاهِ الْقَوْمِ، ثُمَّ تَرْجِعَانِ فَتَمْلآنِهَا، ثُمَّ تَجِيئَانِ فَتُفْرِغَانِهَا فِي أَفْوَاهِ الْقَوْمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa kaana yawmu auhudin anhazama alnnaasu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala walaqad raaaytu 'aaiishaaa binta aabiy bakrin waaumma sulaymin waiinnahumaa lamushammirataani aaraa khadama suwqihimaa, tanquzaani alqiraba waqaala ghayruhu tanqulaani alqiraba 'alaa mutuwnihimaa, thumma tufrighaanihi fiy aafwaahi alqawmi, thumma tarji'aani fatamlanihaa, thumma tajiyiaani fatufrighaanihaa fiy aafwaahi alqawmi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:On the day (of the battle) of Uhud when (some) people retreated and left the Prophet, I saw `Aisha bint Abu Bakr and Um Sulaim, with their robes tucked up so that the bangles around their ankles were visible hurrying with their water skins (in another narration it is said, "carrying the water skins on their backs"). Then they would pour the water in the mouths of the people, and return to fill the water skins again and come back again to pour water in the mouths of the people
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ ثَعْلَبَةُ بْنُ أَبِي مَالِكٍ إِنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَسَمَ مُرُوطًا بَيْنَ نِسَاءٍ مِنْ نِسَاءِ الْمَدِينَةِ، فَبَقِيَ مِرْطٌ جَيِّدٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُ مَنْ عِنْدَهُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَعْطِ هَذَا ابْنَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّتِي عِنْدَكَ‏.‏ يُرِيدُونَ أُمَّ كُلْثُومٍ بِنْتَ عَلِيٍّ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أُمُّ سَلِيطٍ أَحَقُّ‏.‏ وَأُمُّ سَلِيطٍ مِنْ نِسَاءِ الأَنْصَارِ، مِمَّنْ بَايَعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ فَإِنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَزْفِرُ لَنَا الْقِرَبَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ تَزْفِرُ تَخِيطُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala tha'labaau bnu aabiy maalikin iinna 'umara bna alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh qasama muruwtana bayna nisaa'in min nisaa'i almadiynaai, fabaqiya mirtun jayyidun faqaala lahu ba'du man 'indahu yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna aa'ti hadhaa abnaaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm allatiy 'indaka‏.‏ yuriyduwna aumma kulthuwmin binta 'aliyyin‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru aummu saliytin aahaqqu‏.‏ waaummu saliytin min nisaa'i alaansaari, mimman baaya'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaala 'umaru faiinnahaa kaanat tazfiru lanaa alqiraba yawma auhudin‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi tazfiru takhiytu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Tha`laba bin Abi Malik:`Umar bin Al-Khattab distributed some garments amongst the women of Medina. One good garment remained, and one of those present with him said, "O chief of the believers! Give this garment to your wife, the (grand) daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." They meant Um Kulthum, the daughter of `Ali. `Umar said, Um Salit has more right (to have it)." Um Salit was amongst those Ansari women who had given the pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).' `Umar said, "She (i.e. Um Salit) used to carry the water skins for us on the day of Uhud
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنِ الرُّبَيِّعِ بِنْتِ مُعَوِّذٍ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَسْقِي، وَنُدَاوِي الْجَرْحَى، وَنَرُدُّ الْقَتْلَى إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu dhakwaana, 'ani alrrubayyi'i binti mu'awwidhin, qaalat kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm nasqiy, wanudaawiy aljarhaa, wanaruddu alqatlaa iilaa almadiynaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ar-Rubayyi 'bint Mu'auwidh:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) providing the wounded with water and treating them and bringing the killed to Medina (from the battle field)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنِ الرُّبَيِّعِ بِنْتِ مُعَوِّذٍ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا نَغْزُو مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَسْقِي الْقَوْمَ وَنَخْدُمُهُمْ، وَنَرُدُّ الْجَرْحَى وَالْقَتْلَى إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, 'an khaalidi bni dhakwaana, 'ani alrrubayyi'i binti mu'awwidhin, qaalat kunnaa naghzuw ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fanasqiy alqawma wanakhdumuhum, wanaruddu aljarhaa waalqatlaa iilaa almadiynaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ar-Rubai' bint Mu'auwidh:We used to take part in holy battles with the Prophet (ﷺ) by providing the people with water and serving them and bringing the killed and the wounded back to Medina
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رُمِيَ أَبُو عَامِرٍ فِي رُكْبَتِهِ، فَانْتَهَيْتُ إِلَيْهِ قَالَ انْزِعْ هَذَا السَّهْمَ‏.‏ فَنَزَعْتُهُ، فَنَزَا مِنْهُ الْمَاءُ، فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِعُبَيْدٍ أَبِي عَامِرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh qaala rumiya aabuw 'aamirin fiy rukbatihi, faantahaytu iilayhi qaala anzi' hadhaa alssahma‏.‏ fanaza'tuhu, fanazaa minhu almaa'u, fadakhaltu 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbartuhu, faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma aghfir li'ubaydin aabiy 'aamirin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:Abu 'Amir was hit with an arrow in his knee, so I went to him and he asked me to remove the arrow. When I removed it, the water started dribbling from it. Then I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and told him about it. He said, "O Allah! Forgive `Ubaid Abu 'Amir
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ خَلِيلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ تَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَهِرَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيْتَ رَجُلاً مِنْ أَصْحَابِي صَالِحًا يَحْرُسُنِي اللَّيْلَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ إِذْ سَمِعْنَا صَوْتَ سِلاَحٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، جِئْتُ لأَحْرُسَكَ‏.‏ وَنَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu khaliylin, aakhbaranaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'aamiri bni rabiy'aaa, qaala sami'tu 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha taquwlu kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm sahira falammaa qadima almadiynaaa qaala ‏"‏ layta rajulaan min aashaabiy saalihana yahrusuniy alllaylaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ iidh sami'naa sawta silaahin faqaala ‏"‏ man hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aanaa sa'du bnu aabiy waqqaasin, jiitu laahrusaka‏.‏ wanaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) was vigilant one night and when he reached Medina, he said, "Would that a pious man from my companions guard me tonight!" Suddenly we heard the clatter of arms. He said, "Who is that? " He (The new comer) replied, " I am Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas and have come to guard you." So, the Prophet (ﷺ) slept (that night)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ تَعِسَ عَبْدُ الدِّينَارِ وَالدِّرْهَمِ وَالْقَطِيفَةِ وَالْخَمِيصَةِ، إِنْ أُعْطِيَ رَضِيَ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يُعْطَ لَمْ يَرْضَ ‏"‏‏.‏ لَمْ يَرْفَعْهُ إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa aabuw bakrin, 'an aabiy hasiynin, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ta'isa 'abdu alddiynaari waalddirhami waalqatiyfaai waalkhamiysaai, iin au'tiya radiya, waiin lam yu'ta lam yarda ‏"‏‏.‏ lam yarfa'hu iisraaiiylu 'an aabiy hasiynin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let the slave of Dinar and Dirham, and of Qatifah and Khamisa (i.e. money and luxurious clothes) perish for he is pleased if these things are given to him, and if not, he is displeased
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: وَزَادَنَا عَمْرٌو قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ تَعِسَ عَبْدُ الدِّينَارِ وَعَبْدُ الدِّرْهَمِ وَعَبْدُ الْخَمِيصَةِ، إِنْ أُعْطِيَ رَضِيَ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يُعْطَ سَخِطَ، تَعِسَ وَانْتَكَسَ، وَإِذَا شِيكَ فَلاَ انْتَقَشَ، طُوبَى لِعَبْدٍ آخِذٍ بِعِنَانِ فَرَسِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، أَشْعَثَ رَأْسُهُ مُغْبَرَّةٍ قَدَمَاهُ، إِنْ كَانَ فِي الْحِرَاسَةِ كَانَ فِي الْحِرَاسَةِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ فِي السَّاقَةِ كَانَ فِي السَّاقَةِ، إِنِ اسْتَأْذَنَ لَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لَهُ، وَإِنْ شَفَعَ لَمْ يُشَفَّعْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ لَمْ يَرْفَعْهُ إِسْرَائِيلُ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُحَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ وَقَالَ تَعْسًا‏.‏ كَأَنَّهُ يَقُولُ فَأَتْعَسَهُمُ اللَّهُ‏.‏ طُوبَى فُعْلَى مِنْ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ طَيِّبٍ، وَهْىَ يَاءٌ حُوِّلَتْ إِلَى الْوَاوِ وَهْىَ مِنْ يَطِيبُ‏.‏
verses.translit: wazaadanaa 'amrunw qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ta'isa 'abdu alddiynaari wa'abdu alddirhami wa'abdu alkhamiysaai, iin au'tiya radiya, waiin lam yu'ta sakhita, ta'isa waantakasa, waiidhaa shiyka falaa antaqasha, tuwbaa li'abdin akhidhin bi'inaani farasihi fiy sabiyli alllahi, aash'atha raasuhu mughbarraain qadamaahu, iin kaana fiy alhiraasaai kaana fiy alhiraasaai, waiin kaana fiy alssaaqaai kaana fiy alssaaqaai, iini astaadhana lam yuudhan lahu, waiin shafa'a lam yushaffa' ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi lam yarfa'hu iisraaiiylu wamuhammadu bnu juhaadaaa 'an aabiy hasiynin waqaala ta'sana‏.‏ kaaannahu yaquwlu faaat'asahumu alllahu‏.‏ tuwbaa fu'laa min kulli shaa'in tayyibin, wahaa yaa'un huwwilat iilaa alwaawi wahaa min yatiybu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " Let the slave of Dinar and Dirham, of Qatifah and Khamisa perish as he is pleased if these things are given to him, and if not, he is displeased. Let such a person perish and relapse, and if he is pierced with a thorn, let him not find anyone to take it out for him. Paradise is for him who holds the reins of his horse to strive in Allah's Cause, with his hair unkempt and feet covered with dust: if he is appointed in the vanguard, he is perfectly satisfied with his post of guarding, and if he is appointed in the rearward, he accepts his post with satisfaction; (he is so simple and unambiguous that) if he asks for permission he is not permitted, and if he intercedes, his intercession is not accepted
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ صَحِبْتُ جَرِيرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، فَكَانَ يَخْدُمُنِي‏.‏ وَهْوَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ جَرِيرٌ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ الأَنْصَارَ يَصْنَعُونَ شَيْئًا لاَ أَجِدُ أَحَدًا مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ أَكْرَمْتُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ar'araaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an yuwnusa bni 'ubaydin, 'an thaabitin albunaaniyyi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala sahibtu jariyra bna 'abdi alllahi, fakaana yakhdumuniy‏.‏ wahwa aakbaru min aanasin qaala jariyrun iinniy raaaytu alaansaara yasna'uwna shayiana laa aajidu aahadana minhum iilaaa aakramtuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:I was in the company of Jabir bin `Abdullah on a journey and he used to serve me though he was older than I. Jarir said, "I saw the Ansar doing a thing (i.e. showing great reverence to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) for which I have vowed that whenever I meet any of them, I will serve him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو، مَوْلَى الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ حَنْطَبٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى خَيْبَرَ أَخْدُمُهُ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَاجِعًا، وَبَدَا لَهُ أُحُدٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحَرِّمُ مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَيْهَا كَتَحْرِيمِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مَكَّةَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا وَمُدِّنَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, 'an 'amriw bni aabiy 'amrinw, mawlaa almuttalibi bni hantabin, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh yaquwlu kharajtu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa khaybara aakhdumuhu, falammaa qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm raaji'ana, wabadaa lahu auhudun qaala ‏"‏ hadhaa jabalun yuhibbunaa wanuhibbuhu ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma aashaara biyadihi iilaa almadiynaai qaala alllahumma iinniy auharrimu maa bayna laabatayhaa katahriymi iibraahiyma makkaaa ‏"‏ alllahumma baarik lanaa fiy saa'inaa wamuddinaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I went along with the Prophet (ﷺ) to Khaibar so as to serve him. (Later on) when the Prophet (ﷺ) returned he, on seeing the Uhud mountain, said, "This is a mountain that loves us and is loved by us." Then he pointed to Medina with his hand saying, "O Allah! I make the area which is in between Medina's two mountains a sanctuary, as Abraham made Mecca a sanctuary. O Allah! Bless us in our Sa` and Mudd (i.e. units of measuring)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ مُوَرِّقٍ الْعِجْلِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكْثَرُنَا ظِلاًّ الَّذِي يَسْتَظِلُّ بِكِسَائِهِ، وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ صَامُوا فَلَمْ يَعْمَلُوا شَيْئًا، وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ أَفْطَرُوا فَبَعَثُوا الرِّكَابَ وَامْتَهَنُوا وَعَالَجُوا فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ذَهَبَ الْمُفْطِرُونَ الْيَوْمَ بِالأَجْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu daawuda aabuw alrrabiy'i, 'an iismaa'iyla bni zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa 'aasimun, 'an muwarriqin al'ijliyyi, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaktharunaa zilaaan alladhiy yastazillu bikisaaiihi, waaammaa alladhiyna saamuwa falam ya'maluwa shayiana, waaammaa alladhiyna aaftaruwa faba'athuwa alrrikaaba waamtahanuwa wa'aalajuwa faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ dhahaba almuftiruwna alyawma bialaajri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:We were with the Prophet (on a journey) and the only shade one could have was the shade made by one's own garment. Those who fasted did not do any work and those who did not fast served the camels and brought the water on them and treated the sick and (wounded). So, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Today, those who were not fasting took (all) the reward
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُّ سُلاَمَى عَلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، يُعِينُ الرَّجُلَ فِي دَابَّتِهِ يُحَامِلُهُ عَلَيْهَا أَوْ يَرْفَعُ عَلَيْهَا مَتَاعَهُ صَدَقَةٌ، وَالْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ، وَكُلُّ خَطْوَةٍ يَمْشِيهَا إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ صَدَقَةٌ، وَدَلُّ الطَّرِيقِ صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu nasrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, 'an hammaamin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ kullu sulaamaa 'alayhi sadaqaaun kulla yawmin, yu'iynu alrrajula fiy daabbatihi yuhaamiluhu 'alayhaa aaw yarfa'u 'alayhaa mataa'ahu sadaqaaun, waalkalimaau alttayyibaau, wakullu khatwaain yamshiyhaa iilaa alssalaaai sadaqaaun, wadallu alttariyqi sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Charity is obligatory everyday on every joint of a human being. If one helps a person in matters concerning his riding animal by helping him to ride it or by lifting his luggage on to it, all this will be regarded as charity. A good word, and every step one takes to offer the compulsory Congregational prayer, is regarded as charity; and guiding somebody on the road is regarded as charity
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُنِيرٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ رِبَاطُ يَوْمٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا عَلَيْهَا، وَمَوْضِعُ سَوْطِ أَحَدِكُمْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا عَلَيْهَا، وَالرَّوْحَةُ يَرُوحُهَا الْعَبْدُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوِ الْغَدْوَةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muniyrin, sami'a aabaa alnnadri, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ribaatu yawmin fiy sabiyli alllahi khayrun mina alddunyaa wamaa 'alayhaa, wamawdi'u sawti aahadikum mina aljannaai khayrun mina alddunyaa wamaa 'alayhaa, waalrrawhaau yaruwhuhaa al'abdu fiy sabiyli alllahi aawi alghadwaau khayrun mina alddunyaa wamaa 'alayhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa'idi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "To guard Muslims from infidels in Allah's Cause for one day is better than the world and whatever is on its surface, and a place in Paradise as small as that occupied by the whip of one of you is better than the world and whatever is on its surface; and a morning's or an evening's journey which a slave (person) travels in Allah's Cause is better than the world and whatever is on its surface
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ ‏"‏ الْتَمِسْ غُلاَمًا مِنْ غِلْمَانِكُمْ يَخْدُمُنِي حَتَّى أَخْرُجَ إِلَى خَيْبَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ بِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ مُرْدِفِي، وَأَنَا غُلاَمٌ رَاهَقْتُ الْحُلُمَ، فَكُنْتُ أَخْدُمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا نَزَلَ، فَكُنْتُ أَسْمَعُهُ كَثِيرًا يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَدِمْنَا خَيْبَرَ، فَلَمَّا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْحِصْنَ ذُكِرَ لَهُ جَمَالُ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ حُيَىِّ بْنِ أَخْطَبَ، وَقَدْ قُتِلَ زَوْجُهَا وَكَانَتْ عَرُوسًا، فَاصْطَفَاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِنَفْسِهِ، فَخَرَجَ بِهَا حَتَّى بَلَغْنَا سَدَّ الصَّهْبَاءِ حَلَّتْ، فَبَنَى بِهَا، ثُمَّ صَنَعَ حَيْسًا فِي نِطَعٍ صَغِيرٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ آذِنْ مَنْ حَوْلَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ وَلِيمَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى صَفِيَّةَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ خَرَجْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَوِّي لَهَا وَرَاءَهُ بِعَبَاءَةٍ، ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ عِنْدَ بَعِيرِهِ فَيَضَعُ رُكْبَتَهُ، فَتَضَعُ صَفِيَّةُ رِجْلَهَا عَلَى رُكْبَتِهِ حَتَّى تَرْكَبَ، فَسِرْنَا حَتَّى إِذَا أَشْرَفْنَا عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ نَظَرَ إِلَى أُحُدٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ نَظَرَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحَرِّمُ مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَيْهَا بِمِثْلِ مَا حَرَّمَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ مَكَّةَ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مُدِّهِمْ وَصَاعِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala laabiy talhaaa ‏"‏ altamis ghulaamana min ghilmaanikum yakhdumuniy hattaa aakhruja iilaa khaybara ‏"‏‏.‏ fakharaja biy aabuw talhaaa murdifiy, waaanaa ghulaamun raahaqtu alhuluma, fakuntu aakhdumu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa nazala, fakuntu aasma'uhu kathiyrana yaquwlu ‏"‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika mina alhammi waalhazani waal'ajzi waalkasali waalbukhli waaljubni wadala'i alddayni waghalabaai alrrijaali ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qadimnaa khaybara, falammaa fataha alllahu 'alayhi alhisna dhukira lahu jamaalu safiyyaaa binti huyaaai bni aakhtaba, waqad qutila zawjuhaa wakaanat 'aruwsana, faastafaahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm linafsihi, fakharaja bihaa hattaa balaghnaa sadda alssahbaa'i hallat, fabanaa bihaa, thumma sana'a haysana fiy nita'in saghiyrin, thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ adhin man hawlaka ‏"‏‏.‏ fakaanat tilka waliymaaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa safiyyaaa‏.‏ thumma kharajnaa iilaa almadiynaai qaala faraaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhawwiy lahaa waraa'ahu bi'abaa'aain, thumma yajlisu 'inda ba'iyrihi fayada'u rukbatahu, fatada'u safiyyaau rijlahaa 'alaa rukbatihi hattaa tarkaba, fasirnaa hattaa iidhaa aashrafnaa 'alaa almadiynaai nazara iilaa auhudin faqaala ‏"‏ hadhaa jabalun yuhibbunaa wanuhibbuhu ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma nazara iilaa almadiynaai faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma iinniy auharrimu maa bayna laabatayhaa bimithli maa harrama iibraahiymu makkaaa, alllahumma baarik lahum fiy muddihim wasaa'ihim ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Abu Talha, "Choose one of your boy servants to serve me in my expedition to Khaibar." So, Abu Talha took me letting me ride behind him while I was a boy nearing the age of puberty. I used to serve Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he stopped to rest. I heard him saying repeatedly, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from distress and sorrow, from helplessness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from being heavily in debt and from being overcome by men." Then we reached Khaibar; and when Allah enabled him to conquer the Fort (of Khaibar), the beauty of Safiya bint Huyai bin Akhtab was described to him. Her husband had been killed while she was a bride. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) selected her for himself and took her along with him till we reached a place called Sa`d-As-Sahba,' where her menses were over and he took her for his wife. Hais (a kind of dish) was served on a small leather sheet. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told me to call those who were around me. So, that was the marriage banquet of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Safiya. Then we left for Medina. I saw Allah's Apostle folding a cloak round the hump of the camel so as to make a wide space for Safiya (to sit on behind him) He sat beside his camel letting his knees for Safiya to put her feet on so as to mount the camel. Then, we proceeded till we approached Medina; he looked at Uhud (mountain) and said, "This is a mountain which loves us and is loved by us." Then he looked at Medina and said, "O Allah! I make the area between its (i.e. Medina's) two mountains a sanctuary as Abraham made Mecca a sanctuary. O Allah! Bless them (i.e. the people of Medina) in their Mudd and Sa (i.e. measures)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ حَرَامٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ يَوْمًا فِي بَيْتِهَا، فَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَهْوَ يَضْحَكُ، قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا يُضْحِكُكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ عَجِبْتُ مِنْ قَوْمٍ مِنْ أُمَّتِي يَرْكَبُونَ الْبَحْرَ، كَالْمُلُوكِ عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْتِ مَعَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ نَامَ، فَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَهْوَ يَضْحَكُ فَقَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَنْتِ مِنَ الأَوَّلِينَ ‏"‏ فَتَزَوَّجَ بِهَا عُبَادَةُ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ، فَخَرَجَ بِهَا إِلَى الْغَزْوِ، فَلَمَّا رَجَعَتْ قُرِّبَتْ دَابَّةٌ لِتَرْكَبَهَا، فَوَقَعَتْ فَانْدَقَّتْ عُنُقُهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an yahyaa, 'an muhammadi bni yahyaa bni habbaana, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala haddathatniy aummu haraamin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala yawmana fiy baytihaa, faastayqaza wahwa yadhaku, qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi, maa yudhikuka qaala ‏"‏ 'ajibtu min qawmin min aummatiy yarkabuwna albahra, kaalmuluwki 'alaa alaasirraai ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aanti ma'ahum ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma naama, faastayqaza wahwa yadhaku faqaala mithla dhalika marratayni aaw thalaathana‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum‏.‏ fayaquwlu ‏"‏ aanti mina alaawwaliyna ‏"‏ fatazawwaja bihaa 'ubaadaau bnu alssaamiti, fakharaja bihaa iilaa alghazwi, falammaa raja'at qurribat daabbaaun litarkabahaa, fawaqa'at faandaqqat 'unuquhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Um Haram told me that the Prophet (ﷺ) one day took a midday nap in her house. Then he woke up smiling. Um Haram asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What makes you smile?" He replied "I was astonished to see (in my dream) some people amongst my followers on a sea-voyage looking like kings on the thrones." She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to make me one of them." He replied, "You are amongst them." He slept again and then woke up smiling and said the same as before twice or thrice. And she said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to make me one of them." And he said, "You are amongst the first batch." 'Ubada bin As-Samit married her (i.e. Um Haram) and then he took her for Jihad. When she returned, an animal was presented to her to ride, but she fell down and her neck was broken
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ رَأَى سَعْدٌ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ لَهُ فَضْلاً عَلَى مَنْ دُونَهُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ هَلْ تُنْصَرُونَ وَتُرْزَقُونَ إِلاَّ بِضُعَفَائِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu talhaaa, 'an talhaaa, 'an mus'abi bni sa'din, qaala raaaa sa'dun rda allh 'nh aanna lahu fadlaan 'alaa man duwnahu, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ hal tunsaruwna waturzaquwna iilaaa bidu'afaaiikum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mus`ab bin Sa`d:Once Sa`d (bin Abi Waqqas) thought that he was superior to those who were below him in rank. On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You gain no victory or livelihood except through (the blessings and invocations of) the poor amongst you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعَ جَابِرًا، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَأْتِي زَمَانٌ يَغْزُو فِئَامٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، فَيُقَالُ فِيكُمْ مَنْ صَحِبَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيُقَالُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَيُفْتَحُ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ يَأْتِي زَمَانٌ فَيُقَالُ فِيكُمْ مَنْ صَحِبَ أَصْحَابَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيُقَالُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَيُفْتَحُ، ثُمَّ يَأْتِي زَمَانٌ فَيُقَالُ فِيكُمْ مَنْ صَحِبَ صَاحِبَ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيُقَالُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَيُفْتَحُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, sami'a jaabirana, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nhm 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yaatiy zamaanun yaghzuw fiiaamun mina alnnaasi, fayuqaalu fiykum man sahiba alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fayuqaalu na'am‏.‏ fayuftahu 'alayhi, thumma yaatiy zamaanun fayuqaalu fiykum man sahiba aashaaba alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fayuqaalu na'am‏.‏ fayuftahu, thumma yaatiy zamaanun fayuqaalu fiykum man sahiba saahiba aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fayuqaalu na'am‏.‏ fayuftahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A time will come when groups of people will go for Jihad and it will be asked, 'Is there anyone amongst you who has enjoyed the company of the Prophet?' The answer will be, 'Yes.' Then they will be given victory (by Allah) (because of him). Then a time will come when it will be asked. 'Is there anyone amongst you who has enjoyed the company of the companions of the Prophet?' It will be said, 'Yes,' and they will be given victory (by Allah). Then a time will come when it will be said. 'Is there anyone amongst you who has enjoyed the company of the companions of the companions of the Prophet?' It will be said, 'Yes,' and they will be given victory (by Allah)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْتَقَى هُوَ وَالْمُشْرِكُونَ فَاقْتَتَلُوا، فَلَمَّا مَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى عَسْكَرِهِ، وَمَالَ الآخَرُونَ إِلَى عَسْكَرِهِمْ، وَفِي أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّه�� صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ لاَ يَدَعُ لَهُمْ شَاذَّةً وَلاَ فَاذَّةً إِلاَّ اتَّبَعَهَا يَضْرِبُهَا بِسَيْفِهِ، فَقَالَ مَا أَجْزَأَ مِنَّا الْيَوْمَ أَحَدٌ كَمَا أَجْزَأَ فُلاَنٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمَا إِنَّهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ أَنَا صَاحِبُهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَرَجَ مَعَهُ كُلَّمَا وَقَفَ وَقَفَ مَعَهُ، وَإِذَا أَسْرَعَ أَسْرَعَ مَعَهُ قَالَ فَجُرِحَ الرَّجُلُ جُرْحًا شَدِيدًا، فَاسْتَعْجَلَ الْمَوْتَ، فَوَضَعَ نَصْلَ سَيْفِهِ بِالأَرْضِ وَذُبَابَهُ بَيْنَ ثَدْيَيْهِ، ثُمَّ تَحَامَلَ عَلَى سَيْفِهِ، فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ، فَخَرَجَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي ذَكَرْتَ آنِفًا أَنَّهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، فَأَعْظَمَ النَّاسُ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا لَكُمْ بِهِ‏.‏ فَخَرَجْتُ فِي طَلَبِهِ، ثُمَّ جُرِحَ جُرْحًا شَدِيدًا، فَاسْتَعْجَلَ الْمَوْتَ، فَوَضَعَ نَصْلَ سَيْفِهِ فِي الأَرْضِ وَذُبَابَهُ بَيْنَ ثَدْيَيْهِ، ثُمَّ تَحَامَلَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فِيمَا يَبْدُو لِلنَّاسِ، وَهْوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ فِيمَا يَبْدُو لِلنَّاسِ، وَهْوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm altaqaa huwa waalmushrikuwna faaqtataluwa, falammaa maala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa 'askarihi, wamaala alakharuwna iilaa 'askarihim, wafiy aashaabi rasuwli alllah�� sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun laa yada'u lahum shaadhhaaan walaa faadhhaaan iilaaa attaba'ahaa yadribuhaa bisayfihi, faqaala maa aajzaaa minnaa alyawma aahadun kamaa aajzaaa fulaanun‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aamaa iinnahu min aahli alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala rajulun mina alqawmi aanaa saahibuhu‏.‏ qaala fakharaja ma'ahu kullamaa waqafa waqafa ma'ahu, waiidhaa aasra'a aasra'a ma'ahu qaala fajuriha alrrajulu jurhana shadiydana, faasta'jala almawta, fawada'a nasla sayfihi bialaardi wadhubaabahu bayna thadyayhi, thumma tahaamala 'alaa sayfihi, faqatala nafsahu, fakharaja alrrajulu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aashhadu aannaka rasuwlu alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ wamaa dhaaka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala alrrajulu alladhiy dhakarta anifana aannahu min aahli alnnaari, faaa'zama alnnaasu dhalika‏.‏ faqultu aanaa lakum bihi‏.‏ fakharajtu fiy talabihi, thumma juriha jurhana shadiydana, faasta'jala almawta, fawada'a nasla sayfihi fiy alaardi wadhubaabahu bayna thadyayhi, thumma tahaamala 'alayhi, faqatala nafsahu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'inda dhalika ‏"‏ iinna alrrajula laya'malu 'amala aahli aljannaai fiymaa yabduw lilnnaasi, wahwa min aahli alnnaari, waiinna alrrajula laya'malu 'amala aahli alnnaari fiymaa yabduw lilnnaasi, wahwa min aahli aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the pagans faced each other and started fighting. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned to his camp and when the pagans returned to their camp, somebody talked about a man amongst the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who would follow and kill with his sword any pagan going alone. He said, "Nobody did his job (i.e. fighting) so properly today as that man." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Indeed, he is amongst the people of the (Hell) Fire." A man amongst the people said, "I shall accompany him (to watch what he does)" Thus he accompanied him, and wherever he stood, he would stand with him, and wherever he ran, he would run with him. Then the (brave) man got wounded seriously and he decided to bring about his death quickly. He planted the blade of the sword in the ground directing its sharp end towards his chest between his two breasts. Then he leaned on the sword and killed himself. The other man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I testify that you are Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What has happened?" He replied, "(It is about) the man whom you had described as one of the people of the (Hell) Fire. The people were greatly surprised at what you said, and I said, 'I will find out his reality for you.' So, I came out seeking him. He got severely wounded, and hastened to die by slanting the blade of his sword in the ground directing its sharp end towards his chest between his two breasts. Then he eased on his sword and killed himself." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A man may seem to the people as if he were practising the deeds of the people of Paradise while in fact he is from the people of the Hell) Fire, another may seem to the people as if he were practicing the deeds of the people of Hell (Fire), while in fact he is from the people of Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَلَمَةَ بْنَ الأَكْوَعِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى نَفَرٍ مِنْ أَسْلَمَ يَنْتَضِلُونَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ارْمُوا بَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ، فَإِنَّ أَبَاكُمْ كَانَ رَامِيًا ارْمُوا وَأَنَا مَعَ بَنِي فُلاَنٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَمْسَكَ أَحَدُ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا لَكُمْ لاَ تَرْمُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا كَيْفَ نَرْمِي وَأَنْتَ مَعَهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ارْمُوا فَأَنَا مَعَكُمْ كُلِّكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
