To judge justly between two persons is regarded as Sadaqa, and to help a man concerning his riding animal by helping him to ride it or by lifting his luggage on to it, is also regarded as Sadaqa, and (saying) a good word is also Sadaqa, and every step taken on one's way to offer the compulsory prayer (in the mosque) is also Sadaqa and to remove a harmful thing from the way is also Sadaqa
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يُسَافَرَ بِالْقُرْآنِ إِلَى أَرْضِ الْعَدُوِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa aan yusaafara bialqurani iilaa aardi al'aduwwi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the people to travel to a hostile country carrying (copies of) the Qur'an
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ صَبَّحَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْبَرَ وَقَدْ خَرَجُوا بِالْمَسَاحِي عَلَى أَعْنَاقِهِمْ، فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ قَالُوا هَذَا مُحَمَّدٌ وَالْخَمِيسُ، مُحَمَّدٌ وَالْخَمِيسُ‏.‏ فَلَجَئُوا إِلَى الْحِصْنِ، فَرَفَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَيْهِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، خَرِبَتْ خَيْبَرُ، إِنَّا إِذَا نَزَلْنَا بِسَاحَةِ قَوْمٍ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَصَبْنَا حُمُرًا فَطَبَخْنَاهَا، فَنَادَى مُنَادِي النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يَنْهَيَانِكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ، فَأُكْفِئَتِ الْقُدُورُ بِمَا فِيهَا‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَلِيٌّ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ رَفَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala sabbaha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khaybara waqad kharajuwa bialmasaahiy 'alaa aa'naaqihim, falammaa raaawhu qaaluwa hadhaa muhammadun waalkhamiysu, muhammadun waalkhamiysu‏.‏ falajaiuwa iilaa alhisni, farafa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yadayhi waqaala ‏ "‏ alllahu aakbaru, kharibat khaybaru, iinnaa iidhaa nazalnaa bisaahaai qawmin fasaa'a sabaahu almundhariyna ‏"‏‏.‏ waaasabnaa humurana fatabakhnaahaa, fanaadaa munaadiy alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinna alllaha warasuwlahu yanhayaanikum 'an luhuwmi alhumuri, faaukfiiati alquduwru bimaa fiyhaa‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'aliyyun 'an sufyaana rafa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yadayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) reached Khaibar in the morning, while the people were coming out carrying their spades over their shoulders. When they saw him they said, "This is Muhammad and his army! Muhammad and his army!" So, they took refuge in the fort. The Prophet (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, "Allahu Akbar, Khaibar is ruined, for when we approach a nation (i.e. enemy to fight) then miserable is the morning of the warned ones." Then we found some donkeys which we (killed and) cooked: The announcer of the Prophet (ﷺ) announced: "Allah and His Apostle forbid you to eat donkey's meat." So, all the pots including their contents were turned upside down
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَكُنَّا إِذَا أَشْرَفْنَا عَلَى وَادٍ هَلَّلْنَا وَكَبَّرْنَا ارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُنَا، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، ارْبَعُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ، فَإِنَّكُمْ لاَ تَدْعُونَ أَصَمَّ وَلاَ غَائِبًا، إِنَّهُ مَعَكُمْ، إِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ، تَبَارَكَ اسْمُهُ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'aasimin, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi rda allh 'nh qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fakunnaa iidhaa aashrafnaa 'alaa waadin hallalnaa wakabbarnaa artafa'at aaswaatunaa, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa aayyuhaa alnnaasu, arba'uwa 'alaa aanfusikum, faiinnakum laa tad'uwna aasamma walaa ghaaiibana, iinnahu ma'akum, iinnahu samiy'un qariybun, tabaaraka asmuhu wata'aalaa jadduhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (during Hajj). Whenever we went up a high place we used to say: "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and Allah is Greater," and our voices used to rise, so the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people! Be merciful to yourselves (i.e. don't raise your voice), for you are not calling a deaf or an absent one, but One Who is with you, no doubt He is All-Hearer, ever Near (to all things)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كُنَّا إِذَا صَعِدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا نَزَلْنَا سَبَّحْنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an husayni bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala kunnaa iidhaa sa'idnaa kabbarnaa, waiidhaa nazalnaa sabbahnaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Whenever we went up a place we would say, "Allahu--Akbar (i.e. Allah is Greater)", and whenever we went down a place we would say, "Subhan Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا إِذَا صَعِدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا تَصَوَّبْنَا سَبَّحْنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an husaynin, 'an saalimin, 'an jaabirin rda allh 'nh qaala kunnaa iidhaa sa'idnaa kabbarnaa, waiidhaa tasawwabnaa sabbahnaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:Whenever we went up a place we would say Takbir, and whenever we went down we would say, "Subhan Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَفَلَ مِنَ الْحَجِّ أَوِ الْعُمْرَةِ ـ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُهُ إِلاَّ قَالَ الْغَزْوِ ـ يَقُولُ كُلَّمَا أَوْفَى عَلَى ثَنِيَّةٍ أَوْ فَدْفَدٍ كَبَّرَ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهْوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ سَاجِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ صَالِحٌ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَلَمْ يَقُلْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ قَالَ لاَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy salamaaa, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa qafala mina alhajji aawi al'umraai walaa aa'lamuhu iilaaa qaala alghazwi yaquwlu kullamaa aawfaa 'alaa thaniyyaain aaw fadfadin kabbara thalaathana thumma qaala ‏ "‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu, wahdahu laa shariyka lahu, lahu almulku, walahu alhamdu, wahwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun, ayibuwna taaiibuwna 'aabiduwna saajiduwna lirabbinaa haamiduwna, sadaqa alllahu wa'dahu, wanasara 'abdahu, wahazama alaahzaaba wahdahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala saalihun faqultu lahu aalam yaqul 'abdu alllahi iin shaa'a alllahu qaala laa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from the Hajj or the `Umra or a Ghazwa, he would say Takbir thrice. Whenever he came upon a mountain path or wasteland, then he would say, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah Alone Who has no partner. All the Kingdom belongs to Him and all the praises are for Him and He is Omnipotent. We are returning with repentance, worshipping, prostrating ourselves and praising our Lord. Allah fulfilled His Promise, granted victory to His slave and He Alone defeated all the clans
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَطَرُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْعَوَّامُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَبُو إِسْمَاعِيلَ السَّكْسَكِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا بُرْدَةَ، وَاصْطَحَبَ، هُوَ وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي كَبْشَةَ فِي سَفَرٍ، فَكَانَ يَزِيدُ يَصُومُ فِي السَّفَرِ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو بُرْدَةَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا مُوسَى مِرَارًا يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا مَرِضَ الْعَبْدُ أَوْ سَافَرَ، كُتِبَ لَهُ مِثْلُ مَا كَانَ يَعْمَلُ مُقِيمًا صَحِيحًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mataru bnu alfadli, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, haddathanaa al'awwaamu, haddathanaa iibraahiymu aabuw iismaa'iyla alssaksakiyyu, qaala sami'tu aabaa burdaaa, waastahaba, huwa wayaziydu bnu aabiy kabshaaa fiy safarin, fakaana yaziydu yasuwmu fiy alssafari faqaala lahu aabuw burdaaa sami'tu aabaa muwsaa miraarana yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa marida al'abdu aaw saafara, kutiba lahu mithlu maa kaana ya'malu muqiymana sahiyhana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibrahim Abu Isma`il As-Saksaki:I heard Abu Burda who accompanied Yazid bin Abi Kabsha on a journey. Yazid used to observe fasting on journeys. Abu Burda said to him, "I heard Abu Musa several times saying that Allah's Apostle said, 'When a slave falls ill or travels, then he will get reward similar to that he gets for good deeds practiced at home when in good health
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ نَدَبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم النَّاسَ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ، فَانْتَدَبَ الزُّبَيْرُ، ثُمَّ نَدَبَهُمْ فَانْتَدَبَ الزُّبَيْرُ، ثُمَّ نَدَبَهُمْ فَانْتَدَبَ الزُّبَيْرُ، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ حَوَارِيًّا، وَحَوَارِيَّ الزُّبَيْرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ الْحَوَارِيُّ النَّاصِرُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almunkadiri, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu nadaba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alnnaasa yawma alkhandaqi, faantadaba alzzubayru, thumma nadabahum faantadaba alzzubayru, thumma nadabahum faantadaba alzzubayru, qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna likulli nabiyyin hawaariyyana, wahawaariyya alzzubayru ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu alhawaariyyu alnnaasiru‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of the battle of the Trench, the Prophet (ﷺ) wanted somebody from amongst the people to volunteer to be a reconnoitre. Az-Zubair volunteered. He demanded the same again and Az-Zubair volunteered again. Then he repeated the same demand (thrice) and Az-Zubair volunteered once more. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, " Every prophet has a disciple and my disciple is Az-Zubair
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْ يَعْلَمُ النَّاسُ مَا فِي الْوَحْدَةِ مَا أَعْلَمُ مَا سَارَ رَاكِبٌ بِلَيْلٍ وَحْدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa 'aasimu bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'aasimu bnu muhammadi bni zaydi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ law ya'lamu alnnaasu maa fiy alwahdaai maa aa'lamu maa saara raakibun bilaylin wahdahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn' `Umar:from the Prophet (ﷺ) the following Hadith (No. 242). Narrated Ibn `Umar: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the people knew what I know about traveling alone, then nobody would travel alone at night
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، سُئِلَ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانَ يَحْيَى يَقُولُ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ فَسَقَطَ عَنِّي ـ عَنْ مَسِيرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، قَالَ فَكَانَ يَسِيرُ الْعَنَقَ، فَإِذَا وَجَدَ فَجْوَةً نَصَّ‏.‏ وَالنَّصُّ فَوْقَ الْعَنَقِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an hishaamin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabiy qaala, suiila ausaamaau bnu zaydin rda allh 'nhma kaana yahyaa yaquwlu waaanaa aasma'u fasaqata 'anniy 'an masiyri alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i, qaala fakaana yasiyru al'anaqa, faiidhaa wajada fajwaaan nassa‏.‏ waalnnassu fawqa al'anaqi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hisham's father:Usama bin Zaid was asked at what pace the Prophet (ﷺ) rode during Hajjat-ul-Wada`. He said, "He rode at a medium pace, but when he came upon an open way he would go at full pace
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدٌ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ أَسْلَمَ ـ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ بِطَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ، فَبَلَغَهُ عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ شِدَّةُ وَجَعٍ، فَأَسْرَعَ السَّيْرَ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بَعْدَ غُرُوبِ الشَّفَقِ، ثُمَّ نَزَلَ فَصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعَتَمَةَ، يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَهُمَا، وَقَالَ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا جَدَّ بِهِ السَّيْرُ أَخَّرَ الْمَغْرِبَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَهُمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala aakhbaraniy zaydun huwa abnu aaslama 'an aabiyhi, qaala kuntu ma'a 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma bitariyqi makkaaa, fabalaghahu 'an safiyyaaa binti aabiy 'ubaydin shiddaau waja'in, faaasra'a alssayra hattaa iidhaa kaana ba'da ghuruwbi alshhafaqi, thumma nazala fasallaa almaghriba waal'atamaaa, yajma'u baynahumaa, waqaala iinniy raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa jadda bihi alssayru aakhhara almaghriba wajama'a baynahumaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aslam:While I was in the company of `Abdullah bin `Umar on the way to Mecca, he received the news of the severe illness of Safiya bint Abi Ubaid (i.e. his wife), so he proceeded at greater speed, and when the twilight disappeared, he dismounted and offered the Maghrib and `Isha 'prayers together and said, " I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) delaying the Maghrib prayer to offer it along with the `Isha' when he was in a hurry on a journey
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ السَّفَرُ قِطْعَةٌ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ، يَمْنَعُ أَحَدَكُمْ نَوْمَهُ وَطَعَامَهُ وَشَرَابَهُ، فَإِذَا قَضَى أَحَدُكُمْ نَهْمَتَهُ فَلْيُعَجِّلْ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an sumaaain, mawlaa aabiy bakrin 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alssafaru qit'aaun mina al'adhaabi, yamna'u aahadakum nawmahu wata'aamahu washaraabahu, faiidhaa qadaa aahadukum nahmatahu falyu'ajjil iilaa aahlihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Journey is a piece of torture, for it disturbs one's sleep, eating and drinking. So, when you fulfill your job, you should hurry up to your family
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، حَمَلَ عَلَى فَرَسٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَوَجَدَهُ يُبَاعُ، فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَبْتَاعَهُ، فَسَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَبْتَعْهُ، وَلاَ تَعُدْ فِي صَدَقَتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, hamala 'alaa farasin fiy sabiyli alllahi fawajadahu yubaa'u, faaaraada aan yabtaa'ahu, fasaaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ laa tabta'hu, walaa ta'ud fiy sadaqatika ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab gave a horse to be ridden in Allah's Cause and then he found it being sold. He intended to purchase it. So, he consulted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, "Don't buy it and don't take back your gift of charity
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ حَمَلْتُ عَلَى فَرَسٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَابْتَاعَهُ ـ أَوْ فَأَضَاعَهُ ـ الَّذِي كَانَ عِنْدَهُ، فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَشْتَرِيَهُ، وَظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ بَائِعُهُ بِرُخْصٍ، فَسَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَشْتَرِهِ وَإِنْ بِدِرْهَمٍ، فَإِنَّ الْعَائِدَ فِي هِبَتِهِ كَالْكَلْبِ يَعُودُ فِي قَيْئِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathaniy maalikun, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu 'umara bna alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh yaquwlu hamaltu 'alaa farasin fiy sabiyli alllahi faabtaa'ahu aaw faaadaa'ahu alladhiy kaana 'indahu, faaaradtu aan aashtariyahu, wazanantu aannahu baaii'uhu birukhsin, fasaaaltu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ laa tashtarihi waiin bidirhamin, faiinna al'aaiida fiy hibatihi kaalkalbi ya'uwdu fiy qayiihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aslam:I heard `Umar bin Al-Khattab saying, "I gave a horse to be ridden in Allah's Cause and the person who got it intended to sell it or neglected it. So, I wanted to buy it as I thought he would sell it cheap. I consulted the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "Do not buy it even if for one Dirham, because he who takes back his gift is like a dog swallowing its vomit
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْعَبَّاسِ الشَّاعِرَ ـ وَكَانَ لاَ يُتَّهَمُ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَأْذَنَهُ فِي الْجِهَادِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَحَىٌّ وَالِدَاكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَفِيهِمَا فَجَاهِدْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa habiybu bnu aabiy thaabitin, qaala sami'tu aabaa al'abbaasi alshhaa'ira wakaana laa yuttahamu fiy hadiythihi qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna 'amrinw rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu jaa'a rajulun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faastaadhanahu fiy aljihaadi faqaala ‏"‏ aahaaaun waalidaaka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fafiyhimaa fajaahid ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) asking his permission to take part in Jihad. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Are your parents alive?" He replied in the affirmative. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Then exert yourself in their service
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَشِيرٍ الأَنْصَارِيّ َ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، كَانَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ ـ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ حَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ـ وَالنَّاسُ فِي مَبِيتِهِمْ، فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَسُولاً أَنْ لاَ يَبْقَيَنَّ فِي رَقَبَةِ بَعِيرٍ قِلاَدَةٌ مِنْ وَتَرٍ أَوْ قِلاَدَةٌ إِلاَّ قُطِعَتْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, aanna aabaa bashiyrin alaansaariyy a rda allh 'nh aakhbarahu aannahu, kaana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ba'di aasfaarihi qaala 'abdu alllahi hasibtu aannahu qaala waalnnaasu fiy mabiytihim, faaarsala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rasuwlaan aan laa yabqayanna fiy raqabaai ba'iyrin qilaadaaun min watarin aaw qilaadaaun iilaaa quti'at‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bashir Al-Ansari:That he was in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on some of his journeys. (The sub-narrator `Abdullah adds, "I think that Abu Bashir also said, 'And the people were at their sleeping places.") Allah's Apostle sent a messenger ordering: "There shall not remain any necklace of string or any other kind of necklace round the necks of camels except it is cut off
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْبَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَخْلُوَنَّ رَجُلٌ بِامْرَأَةٍ، وَلاَ تُسَافِرَنَّ امْرَأَةٌ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا مَحْرَمٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، اكْتُتِبْتُ فِي غَزْوَةِ كَذَا وَكَذَا، وَخَرَجَتِ امْرَأَتِي حَاجَّةً‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ فَحُجَّ مَعَ امْرَأَتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an aabiy ma'badin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa yakhluwanna rajulun biamraaaain, walaa tusaafiranna amraaaaun iilaaa wama'ahaa mahramun ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaama rajulun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, aktutibtu fiy ghazwaai kadhaa wakadhaa, wakharajati amraaatiy haajjaaan‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ adhhab fahujja ma'a amraaatika ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "It is not permissible for a man to be alone with a woman, and no lady should travel except with a Mahram (i.e. her husband or a person whom she cannot marry in any case for ever; e.g. her father, brother, etc.)." Then a man got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have enlisted in the army for such-and-such Ghazwa and my wife is proceeding for Hajj." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Go, and perform the Hajj with your wife
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْهُ، مَرَّ��َيْنِ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي حَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَا وَالزُّبَيْرَ وَالْمِقْدَادَ بْنَ الأَسْوَدِ قَالَ ‏"‏ انْطَلِقُوا حَتَّى تَأْتُوا رَوْضَةَ خَاخٍ، فَإِنَّ بِهَا ظَعِينَةً وَمَعَهَا كِتَابٌ، فَخُذُوهُ مِنْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْنَا تَعَادَى بِنَا خَيْلُنَا حَتَّى انْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى الرَّوْضَةِ، فَإِذَا نَحْنُ بِالظَّعِينَةِ فَقُلْنَا أَخْرِجِي الْكِتَابَ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ مَا مَعِي مِنْ كِتَابٍ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا لَتُخْرِجِنَّ الْكِتَابَ أَوْ لَنُلْقِيَنَّ الثِّيَابَ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَتْهُ مِنْ عِقَاصِهَا، فَأَتَيْنَا بِهِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَإِذَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَاطِبِ بْنِ أَبِي بَلْتَعَةَ إِلَى أُنَاسٍ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ مِنْ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ، يُخْبِرُهُمْ بِبَعْضِ أَمْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا حَاطِبُ، مَا هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لاَ تَعْجَلْ عَلَىَّ، إِنِّي كُنْتُ امْرَأً مُلْصَقًا فِي قُرَيْشٍ، وَلَمْ أَكُنْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهَا، وَكَانَ مَنْ مَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ لَهُمْ قَرَابَاتٌ بِمَكَّةَ، يَحْمُونَ بِهَا أَهْلِيهِمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ، فَأَحْبَبْتُ إِذْ فَاتَنِي ذَلِكَ مِنَ النَّسَبِ فِيهِمْ أَنْ أَتَّخِذَ عِنْدَهُمْ يَدًا يَحْمُونَ بِهَا قَرَابَتِي، وَمَا فَعَلْتُ كُفْرًا وَلاَ ارْتِدَادًا وَلاَ رِضًا بِالْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ الإِسْلاَمِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَقَدْ صَدَقَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ دَعْنِي أَضْرِبْ عُنُقَ هَذَا الْمُنَافِقِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ قَدْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا، وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَكُونَ قَدِ اطَّلَعَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَدْرٍ فَقَالَ اعْمَلُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ، فَقَدْ غَفَرْتُ لَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَأَىُّ إِسْنَادٍ هَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu diynaarin, sami'tuhu minhu, marra��ayni qaala aakhbaraniy hasanu bnu muhammadin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu aabiy raafi'in, qaala sami'tu 'aliyyana rda allh 'nh yaquwlu ba'athaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanaa waalzzubayra waalmiqdaada bna alaaswadi qaala ‏"‏ antaliquwa hattaa taatuwa rawdaaa khaakhin, faiinna bihaa za'iynaaan wama'ahaa kitaabun, fakhudhuwhu minhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faantalaqnaa ta'aadaa binaa khaylunaa hattaa antahaynaa iilaa alrrawdaai, faiidhaa nahnu bialzza'iynaai faqulnaa aakhrijiy alkitaaba‏.‏ faqaalat maa ma'iy min kitaabin‏.‏ faqulnaa latukhrijinna alkitaaba aaw lanulqiyanna althhiyaaba‏.‏ faaakhrajathu min 'iqaasihaa, faaataynaa bihi rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, faiidhaa fiyhi min haatibi bni aabiy balta'aaa iilaa aunaasin mina almushrikiyna min aahli makkaaa, yukhbiruhum biba'di aamri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa haatibu, maa hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, laa ta'jal 'alaaaa, iinniy kuntu amraaan mulsaqana fiy qurayshin, walam aakun min aanfusihaa, wakaana man ma'aka mina almuhaajiriyna lahum qaraabaatun bimakkaaa, yahmuwna bihaa aahliyhim waaamwaalahum, faaahbabtu iidh faataniy dhalika mina alnnasabi fiyhim aan aattakhidha 'indahum yadana yahmuwna bihaa qaraabatiy, wamaa fa'altu kufrana walaa artidaadana walaa ridana bialkufri ba'da aliislaami‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laqad sadaqakum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'umaru yaa rasuwla alllahi da'niy aadrib 'unuqa hadhaa almunaafiqi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinnahu qad shahida badrana, wamaa yudriyka la'alla alllaha aan yakuwna qadi attala'a 'alaa aahli badrin faqaala a'maluwa maa shiitum, faqad ghafartu lakum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu waaaaau iisnaadin hadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin Abi Rafi`:I heard `Ali saying, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me, Az-Zubair and Al-Miqdad somewhere saying, 'Proceed till you reach Rawdat Khakh. There you will find a lady with a letter. Take the letter from her.' " So, we set out and our horses ran at full pace till we got at Ar-Rawda where we found the lady and said (to her). "Take out the letter." She replied, "I have no letter with me." We said, "Either you take out the letter or else we will take off your clothes." So, she took it out of her braid. We brought the letter to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and it contained a statement from Hatib bin Abi Balta'a to some of the Meccan pagans informing them of some of the intentions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Hatib! What is this?" Hatib replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Don't hasten to give your judgment about me. I was a man closely connected with the Quraish, but I did not belong to this tribe, while the other emigrants with you, had their relatives in Mecca who would protect their dependents and property . So, I wanted to recompense for my lacking blood relation to them by doing them a favor so that they might protect my dependents. I did this neither because of disbelief nor apostasy nor out of preferring Kufr (disbelief) to Islam." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), said, "Hatib has told you the truth." `Umar said, O Allah's Apostle! Allow me to chop off the head of this hypocrite." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Hatib participated in the battle of Badr, and who knows, perhaps Allah has already looked at the Badr warriors and said, 'Do whatever you like, for I have forgiven you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ أُتِيَ بِأُسَارَى، وَأُتِيَ بِالْعَبَّاسِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ ثَوْبٌ، فَنَظَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَهُ قَمِيصًا فَوَجَدُوا قَمِيصَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُبَىٍّ يَقْدُرُ عَلَيْهِ، فَكَسَاهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِيَّاهُ، فَلِذَلِكَ نَزَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَمِيصَهُ الَّذِي أَلْبَسَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ كَانَتْ لَهُ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدٌ فَأَحَبَّ أَنْ يُكَافِئَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amrinw, sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala lammaa kaana yawma badrin autiya biausaaraa, waautiya bial'abbaasi walam yakun 'alayhi thawbun, fanazara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm lahu qamiysana fawajaduwa qamiysa 'abdi alllahi bni aubaaain yaqduru 'alayhi, fakasaahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iiyyaahu, falidhalika naza'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qamiysahu alladhiy aalbasahu‏.‏ qaala abnu 'uyaynaaa kaanat lahu 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadun faaahabba aan yukaafiiahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:When it was the day (of the battle) of Badr, prisoners of war were brought including Al-Abbas who was undressed. The Prophet (ﷺ) looked for a shirt for him. It was found that the shirt of `Abdullah bin Ubai would do, so the Prophet (ﷺ) let him wear it. That was the reason why the Prophet (ﷺ) took off and gave his own shirt to `Abdullah. (The narrator adds, "He had done the Prophet (ﷺ) some favor for which the Prophet liked to reward him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَهْلٌ ـ رضى الله عنه يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ ‏"‏ لأُعْطِيَنَّ الرَّايَةَ غَدًا رَجُلاً يُفْتَحُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ، يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ، وَيُحِبُّهُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَبَاتَ النَّاسُ لَيْلَتَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يُعْطَى فَغَدَوْا كُلُّهُمْ يَرْجُوهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ عَلِيٌّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقِيلَ يَشْتَكِي عَيْنَيْهِ، فَبَصَقَ فِي عَيْنَيْهِ وَدَعَا لَهُ، فَبَرَأَ كَأَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِهِ وَجَعٌ، فَأَعْطَاهُ فَقَالَ أُقَاتِلُهُمْ حَتَّى يَكُونُوا مِثْلَنَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ انْفُذْ عَلَى رِسْلِكَ حَتَّى تَنْزِلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ، ثُمَّ ادْعُهُمْ إِلَى الإِسْلاَمِ، وَأَخْبِرْهُمْ بِمَا يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَوَاللَّهِ لأَنْ يَهْدِيَ اللَّهُ بِكَ رَجُلاً خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنْ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَكَ حُمْرُ النَّعَمِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni muhammadi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdin alqaariyyu, 'an aabiy haazimin, qaala aakhbaraniy sahlun rda allh 'nh ya'niy abna sa'din qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma khaybara ‏"‏ lau'tiyanna alrraayaaa ghadana rajulaan yuftahu 'alaa yadayhi, yuhibbu alllaha warasuwlahu, wayuhibbuhu alllahu warasuwluhu ‏"‏‏.‏ fabaata alnnaasu laylatahum aayyuhum yu'taa faghadawa kulluhum yarjuwhu faqaala ‏"‏ aayna 'aliyyun ‏"‏‏.‏ faqiyla yashtakiy 'aynayhi, fabasaqa fiy 'aynayhi wada'aa lahu, fabaraaa kaaan lam yakun bihi waja'un, faaa'taahu faqaala auqaatiluhum hattaa yakuwnuwa mithlanaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ anfudh 'alaa rislika hattaa tanzila bisaahatihim, thumma ad'uhum iilaa aliislaami, waaakhbirhum bimaa yajibu 'alayhim, fawaalllahi laan yahdiya alllahu bika rajulaan khayrun laka min aan yakuwna laka humru alnna'ami ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl:On the day (of the battle) of Khaibar the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Tomorrow I will give the flag to somebody who will be given victory (by Allah) and who loves Allah and His Apostle and is loved by Allah and His Apostle." So, the people wondered all that night as to who would receive the flag and in the morning everyone hoped that he would be that person. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "Where is `Ali?" He was told that `Ali was suffering from eye-trouble, so he applied saliva to his eyes and invoked Allah to cure him. He at once got cured as if he had no ailment. The Prophet (ﷺ) gave him the flag. `Ali said, "Should I fight them till they become like us (i.e. Muslim)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go to them patiently and calmly till you enter the land. Then, invite them to Islam, and inform them what is enjoined upon them, for, by Allah, if Allah gives guidance to somebody through you, it is better for you than possessing red camels
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ عَجِبَ اللَّهُ مِنْ قَوْمٍ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ فِي السَّلاَسِلِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ 'ajiba alllahu min qawmin yadkhuluwna aljannaaa fiy alssalaasili ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah wonders at those people who will enter Paradise in chains
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحُ بْنُ حَىٍّ أَبُو حَسَنٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَاهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثَةٌ يُؤْتَوْنَ أَجْرَهُمْ مَرَّتَيْنِ الرَّجُلُ تَكُونُ لَهُ الأَمَةُ فَيُعَلِّمُهَا فَيُحْسِنُ تَعْلِيمَهَا، وَيُؤَدِّبُهَا فَيُحْسِنُ أَدَبَهَا، ثُمَّ يُعْتِقُهَا فَيَتَزَوَّجُهَا، فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ، وَمُؤْمِنُ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ الَّذِي كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا، ثُمَّ آمَنَ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ، وَالْعَبْدُ الَّذِي يُؤَدِّي حَقَّ اللَّهِ وَيَنْصَحُ لِسَيِّدِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ وَأَعْطَيْتُكَهَا بِغَيْرِ شَىْءٍ وَقَدْ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ يَرْحَلُ فِي أَهْوَنَ مِنْهَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, haddathanaa saalihu bnu haaain aabuw hasanin, qaala sami'tu alshha'biyya, yaquwlu haddathaniy aabuw burdaaa, aannahu sami'a aabaahu, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ thalaathaaun yuutawna aajrahum marratayni alrrajulu takuwnu lahu alaamaau fayu'allimuhaa fayuhsinu ta'liymahaa, wayuuaddibuhaa fayuhsinu aadabahaa, thumma yu'tiquhaa fayatazawwajuhaa, falahu aajraani, wamuuminu aahli alkitaabi alladhiy kaana muuminana, thumma amana bialnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm falahu aajraani, waal'abdu alladhiy yuuaddiy haqqa alllahi wayansahu lisayyidihi ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala alshha'biyyu waaa'taytukahaa bighayri shaa'in waqad kaana alrrajulu yarhalu fiy aahwana minhaa iilaa almadiynaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda's father:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Three persons will get their reward twice. (One is) a person who has a slave girl and he educates her properly and teaches her good manners properly (without violence) and then manumits and marries her. Such a person will get a double reward. (Another is) a believer from the people of the scriptures who has been a true believer and then he believes in the Prophet (ﷺ) (Muhammad). Such a person will get a double reward. (The third is) a slave who observes Allah's Rights and Obligations and is sincere to his master
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ الصَّعْبِ بْنِ جَثَّامَةَ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ قَالَ مَرَّ بِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالأَبْوَاءِ ـ أَوْ بِوَدَّانَ ـ وَسُئِلَ عَنْ أَهْلِ الدَّارِ يُبَيَّتُونَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، فَيُصَابُ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ وَذَرَارِيِّهِمْ قَالَ ‏"‏ هُمْ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ حِمَى إِلاَّ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alssa'bi bni jathhaamaaa rda allh 'nhm qaala marra biya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bialaabwaa'i aaw biwaddaana wasuiila 'an aahli alddaari yubayyatuwna mina almushrikiyna, fayusaabu min nisaaiihim wadharaariyyihim qaala ‏"‏ hum minhum ‏"‏‏.‏ wasami'tuhu yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa himaa iilaaa lillahi walirasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated As-Sab bin Jaththama:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by me at a place called Al-Abwa or Waddan, and was asked whether it was permissible to attack the pagan warriors at night with the probability of exposing their women and children to danger. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "They (i.e. women and children) are from them (i.e. pagans)." I also heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The institution of Hima is invalid except for Allah and His Apostle
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: وَعَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الصَّعْبُ، فِي الذَّرَارِيِّ كَانَ عَمْرٌو يُحَدِّثُنَا عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَمِعْنَاهُ مِنَ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ الصَّعْبِ، قَالَ ‏"‏ هُمْ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ كَمَا قَالَ عَمْرٌو ‏"‏ هُمْ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wa'ani alzzuhriyyi, aannahu sami'a 'ubayda alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, haddathanaa alssa'bu, fiy aldhharaariyyi kaana 'amrunw yuhaddithunaa 'ani abni shihaabin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasami'naahu mina alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alssa'bi, qaala ‏"‏ hum minhum ‏"‏ walam yaqul kamaa qaala 'amrunw ‏"‏ hum min abaaiihim ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: As above (hadith)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً وُجِدَتْ فِي بَعْضِ مَغَازِي النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَقْتُولَةً، فَأَنْكَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَتْلَ النِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi rda allh 'nh aakhbarahu aanna amraaaaan wujidat fiy ba'di maghaaziy alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm maqtuwlaaan, faaankara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qatla alnnisaa'i waalssibyaani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:During some of the Ghazawat of the Prophet (ﷺ) a woman was found killed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disapproved the killing of women and children
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَبِي أُسَامَةَ حَدَّثَكُمْ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ وُجِدَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مَقْتُولَةً فِي بَعْضِ مَغَازِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَنَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ قَتْلِ النِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala qultu laabiy ausaamaaa haddathakum 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala wujidati amraaaaun maqtuwlaaan fiy ba'di maghaaziy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fanahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an qatli alnnisaa'i waalssibyaani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:During some of the Ghazawat of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a woman was found killed, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the killing of women and children
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْثٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنْ وَجَدْتُمْ فُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا فَأَحْرِقُوهُمَا بِالنَّارِ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ أَرَدْنَا الْخُرُوجَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي أَمَرْتُكُمْ أَنْ تُحْرِقُوا فُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا، وَإِنَّ النَّارَ لاَ يُعَذِّبُ بِهَا إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، فَإِنْ وَجَدْتُمُوهُمَا فَاقْتُلُوهُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an bukayrin, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aannahu qaala ba'athanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ba'thin faqaala ‏"‏ iin wajadtum fulaanana wafulaanana faaahriquwhumaa bialnnaari ‏"‏ thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna aaradnaa alkhuruwja ‏"‏ iinniy aamartukum aan tuhriquwa fulaanana wafulaanana, waiinna alnnaara laa yu'adhhibu bihaa iilaaa alllahu, faiin wajadtumuwhumaa faaqtuluwhumaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent us in a mission (i.e., an army-unit) and said, "If you find so-and-so and so-and-so, burn both of them with fire." When we intended to depart, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have ordered you to burn so-and-so and so-and-so, and it is none but Allah Who punishes with fire, so, if you find them, kill them (i.e., don't burn them)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، أَنَّ عَلِيًّا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَرَّقَ قَوْمًا، فَبَلَغَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ لَوْ كُنْتُ أَنَا لَمْ أُحَرِّقْهُمْ، لأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تُعَذِّبُوا بِعَذَابِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَلَقَتَلْتُهُمْ كَمَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ بَدَّلَ دِينَهُ فَاقْتُلُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an 'ikrimaaa, aanna 'aliyyana rda allh 'nh harraqa qawmana, fabalagha abna 'abbaasin faqaala law kuntu aanaa lam auharriqhum, laanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa tu'adhhibuwa bi'adhaabi alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ walaqataltuhum kamaa qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man baddala diynahu faaqtuluwhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ikrima:`Ali burnt some people and this news reached Ibn `Abbas, who said, "Had I been in his place I would not have burnt them, as the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Don't punish (anybody) with Allah's Punishment.' No doubt, I would have killed them, for the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'If somebody (a Muslim) discards his religion, kill him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَهْطًا، مِنْ عُكْلٍ ثَمَانِيَةً قَدِمُوا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاجْتَوَوُا الْمَدِينَةَ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ابْغِنَا رِسْلاً‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا أَجِدُ لَكُمْ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَلْحَقُوا بِالذَّوْدِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقُوا فَشَرِبُوا مِنْ أَبْوَالِهَا وَأَلْبَانِهَا حَتَّى صَحُّوا وَسَمِنُوا، وَقَتَلُوا الرَّاعِيَ، وَاسْتَاقُوا الذَّوْدَ، وَكَفَرُوا بَعْدَ إِسْلاَمِهِمْ، فَأَتَى الصَّرِيخُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَبَعَثَ الطَّلَبَ، فَمَا تَرَجَّلَ النَّهَارُ حَتَّى أُتِيَ بِهِمْ، فَقَطَّعَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ، ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِمَسَامِيرَ فَأُحْمِيَتْ فَكَحَلَهُمْ بِهَا، وَطَرَحَهُمْ بِالْحَرَّةِ، يَسْتَسْقُونَ فَمَا يُسْقَوْنَ حَتَّى مَاتُوا‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ قَتَلُوا وَسَرَقُوا وَحَارَبُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَعَوْا فِي الأَرْضِ فَسَادًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna rahtana, min 'uklin thamaaniyaaan qadimuwa 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faajtawawua almadiynaaa faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi, abghinaa rislaan‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ maa aajidu lakum iilaaa aan talhaquwa bialdhhawdi ‏"‏‏.‏ faantalaquwa fasharibuwa min aabwaalihaa waaalbaanihaa hattaa sahhuwa wasaminuwa, waqataluwa alrraa'iya, waastaaquwa aldhhawda, wakafaruwa ba'da iislaamihim, faaataa alssariykhu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm, faba'atha alttalaba, famaa tarajjala alnnahaaru hattaa autiya bihim, faqatta'a aaydiyahum waaarjulahum, thumma aamara bimasaamiyra faauhmiyat fakahalahum bihaa, watarahahum bialharraai, yastasquwna famaa yusqawna hattaa maatuwa‏.‏ qaala aabuw qilaabaaa qataluwa wasaraquwa wahaarabuwa alllaha warasuwlahu sla allh 'lyh wslm wasa'awa fiy alaardi fasaadana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A group of eight men from the tribe of 'Ukl came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and then they found the climate of Medina unsuitable for them. So, they said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Provide us with some milk." Allah's Apostle said, "I recommend that you should join the herd of camels." So they went and drank the urine and the milk of the camels (as a medicine) till they became healthy and fat. Then they killed the shepherd and drove away the camels, and they became unbelievers after they were Muslims. When the Prophet (ﷺ) was informed by a shouter for help, he sent some men in their pursuit, and before the sun rose high, they were brought, and he had their hands and feet cut off. Then he ordered for nails which were heated and passed over their eyes, and they were left in the Harra (i.e. rocky land in Medina). They asked for water, and nobody provided them with water till they died (Abu Qilaba, a sub-narrator said, "They committed murder and theft and fought against Allah and His Apostle, and spread evil in the land)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ قَرَصَتْ نَمْلَةٌ نَبِيًّا مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ، فَأَمَرَ بِقَرْيَةِ النَّمْلِ فَأُحْرِقَتْ، فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ أَنْ قَرَصَتْكَ نَمْلَةٌ أَحْرَقْتَ أُمَّةً مِنَ الأُمَمِ تُسَبِّحُ اللَّهِ.‏"‏‏‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, hadaathanaa allaaythu, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayaabi, waaabiy, salamaaa aanaa aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ qarasat namlaaun nabiyanna mina alaanbiyaa'i, faaamara biqaryaai alnaamli faauhriqat, faaawhaa allaahu iilayhi aan qarasatka namlaaun aahraqta aumaaaan mina alaumami tusabiihu allaahi.‏"‏‏‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "An ant bit a Prophet amongst the Prophets, and he ordered that the place of the ants be burnt. So, Allah inspired to him, 'It is because one ant bit you that you burnt a nation amongst the nations that glorify Allah?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي قَيْسُ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي جَرِيرٌ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلاَ تُرِيحُنِي مِنْ ذِي الْخَلَصَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ بَيْتًا فِي خَثْعَمَ يُسَمَّى كَعْبَةَ الْيَمَانِيَةَ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقْتُ فِي خَمْسِينَ وَمِائَةِ فَارِسٍ مِنْ أَحْمَسَ، وَكَانُوا أَصْحَابَ خَيْلٍ ـ قَالَ ـ وَكُنْتُ لاَ أَثْبُتُ عَلَى الْخَيْلِ، فَضَرَبَ فِي صَدْرِي حَتَّى رَأَيْتُ أَثَرَ أَصَابِعِهِ فِي صَدْرِي وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ وَاجْعَلْهُ هَادِيًا مَهْدِيًّا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ إِلَيْهَا فَكَسَرَهَا وَحَرَّقَهَا، ثُمَّ بَعَثَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُخْبِرُهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ جَرِيرٍ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ، مَا جِئْتُكَ حَتَّى تَرَكْتُهَا كَأَنَّهَا جَمَلٌ أَجْوَفُ أَوْ أَجْرَبُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَبَارَكَ فِي خَيْلِ أَحْمَسَ وَرِجَالِهَا خَمْسَ مَرَّاتٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathaniy qaysu bnu aabiy haazimin, qaala qaala liy jariyrun qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aalaa turiyhuniy min dhiy alkhalasaai ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana baytana fiy khath'ama yusammaa ka'baaa alyamaaniyaaa qaala faantalaqtu fiy khamsiyna wamiaiaai faarisin min aahmasa, wakaanuwa aashaaba khaylin qaala wakuntu laa aathbutu 'alaa alkhayli, fadaraba fiy sadriy hattaa raaaytu aathara aasaabi'ihi fiy sadriy waqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma thabbithu waaj'alhu haadiyana mahdiyyana ‏"‏‏.‏ faantalaqa iilayhaa fakasarahaa waharraqahaa, thumma ba'atha iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yukhbiruhu faqaala rasuwlu jariyrin waalladhiy ba'athaka bialhaqqi, maa jiituka hattaa taraktuhaa kaaannahaa jamalun aajwafu aaw aajrabu‏.‏ qaala fabaaraka fiy khayli aahmasa warijaalihaa khamsa marraatin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jarir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Will you relieve me from Dhul-Khalasa? Dhul-Khalasa was a house (of an idol) belonging to the tribe of Khath'am called Al-Ka`ba Al-Yama-niya. So, I proceeded with one hundred and fifty cavalry men from the tribe of Ahmas, who were excellent knights. It happened that I could not sit firm on horses, so the Prophet (ﷺ) , stroke me over my chest till I saw his finger-marks over my chest, he said, 'O Allah! Make him firm and make him a guiding and rightly guided man.' " Jarir proceeded towards that house, and dismantled and burnt it. Then he sent a messenger to Allah's Apostle informing him of that. Jarir's messenger said, "By Him Who has sent you with the Truth, I did not come to you till I had left it like an emancipated or gabby camel (i.e. completely marred and spoilt)." Jarir added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for Allah's Blessings for the horses and the men of Ahmas five times
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ حَرَّقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَخْلَ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala harraqa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm nakhla baniy alnnadiyri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) burnt the date-palms of Bani An-Nadir
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَهْطًا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ إِلَى أَبِي رَافِعٍ لِيَقْتُلُوهُ، فَانْطَلَقَ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ فَدَخَلَ حِصْنَهُمْ قَالَ فَدَخَلْتُ فِي مَرْبِطِ دَوَابَّ لَهُمْ، قَالَ وَأَغْلَقُوا باب الْحِصْنِ، ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ فَقَدُوا حِمَارًا لَهُمْ، فَخَرَجُوا يَطْلُبُونَهُ، فَخَرَجْتُ فِيمَنْ خَرَجَ أُرِيهِمْ أَنَّنِي أَطْلُبُهُ مَعَهُمْ، فَوَجَدُوا الْحِمَارَ، فَدَخَلُوا وَدَخَلْتُ، وَأَغْلَقُوا باب الْحِصْنِ لَيْلاً، فَوَضَعُوا الْمَفَاتِيحَ فِي كَوَّةٍ حَيْثُ أَرَاهَا، فَلَمَّا نَامُوا أَخَذْتُ الْمَفَاتِيحَ، فَفَتَحْتُ باب الْحِصْنِ ثُمَّ دَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا رَافِعٍ‏.‏ فَأَجَابَنِي، فَتَعَمَّدْتُ الصَّوْتَ، فَضَرَبْتُهُ فَصَاحَ، فَخَرَجْتُ ثُمَّ جِئْتُ، ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ كَأَنِّي مُغِيثٌ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا رَافِعٍ، وَغَيَّرْتُ صَوْتِي، فَقَالَ مَا لَكَ لأُمِّكَ الْوَيْلُ قُلْتُ مَا شَأْنُكَ قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي مَنْ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ فَضَرَبَنِي‏.‏ قَالَ فَوَضَعْتُ سَيْفِي فِي بَطْنِهِ، ثُمَّ تَحَامَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى قَرَعَ الْعَظْمَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجْتُ وَأَنَا دَهِشٌ، فَأَتَيْتُ سُلَّمًا لَهُمْ لأَنْزِلَ مِنْهُ فَوَقَعْتُ فَوُثِئَتْ رِجْلِي، فَخَرَجْتُ إِلَى أَصْحَابِي فَقُلْتُ مَا أَنَا بِبَارِحٍ حَتَّى أَسْمَعَ النَّاعِيَةَ، فَمَا بَرِحْتُ حَتَّى سَمِعْتُ نَعَايَا أَبِي رَافِعٍ تَاجِرِ أَهْلِ الْحِجَازِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُمْتُ وَمَا بِي قَلَبَةٌ حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْنَاهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu zakariyyaa'a bni aabiy zaaiidaaa, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma qaala ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rahtana mina alaansaari iilaa aabiy raafi'in liyaqtuluwhu, faantalaqa rajulun minhum fadakhala hisnahum qaala fadakhaltu fiy marbiti dawaabba lahum, qaala waaaghlaquwa bab alhisni, thumma iinnahum faqaduwa himaarana lahum, fakharajuwa yatlubuwnahu, fakharajtu fiyman kharaja auriyhim aannaniy aatlubuhu ma'ahum, fawajaduwa alhimaara, fadakhaluwa wadakhaltu, waaaghlaquwa bab alhisni laylaan, fawada'uwa almafaatiyha fiy kawwaain haythu aaraahaa, falammaa naamuwa aakhadhtu almafaatiyha, fafatahtu bab alhisni thumma dakhaltu 'alayhi faqultu yaa aabaa raafi'in‏.‏ faaajaabaniy, fata'ammadtu alssawta, fadarabtuhu fasaaha, fakharajtu thumma jiitu, thumma raja'tu kaaanniy mughiythun faqultu yaa aabaa raafi'in, waghayyartu sawtiy, faqaala maa laka laummika alwaylu qultu maa shaanuka qaala laa aadriy man dakhala 'alaaaa fadarabaniy‏.‏ qaala fawada'tu sayfiy fiy batnihi, thumma tahaamaltu 'alayhi hattaa qara'a al'azma, thumma kharajtu waaanaa dahishun, faaataytu sullamana lahum laanzila minhu fawaqa'tu fawuthiiat rijliy, fakharajtu iilaa aashaabiy faqultu maa aanaa bibaarihin hattaa aasma'a alnnaa'iyaaa, famaa barihtu hattaa sami'tu na'aayaa aabiy raafi'in taajiri aahli alhijaazi‏.‏ qaala faqumtu wamaa biy qalabaaun hattaa aataynaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarnaahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a group of Ansari men to kill Abu-Rafi`. One of them set out and entered their (i.e. the enemies) fort. That man said, "I hid myself in a stable for their animals. They closed the fort gate. Later they lost a donkey of theirs, so they went out in its search. I, too, went out along with them, pretending to look for it. They found the donkey and entered their fort. And I, too, entered along with them. They closed the gate of the fort at night, and kept its keys in a small window where I could see them. When those people slept, I took the keys and opened the gate of the fort and came upon Abu Rafi` and said, 'O Abu Rafi`. When he to replied me, I proceeded towards the voice and hit him. He shouted and I came out to come back, pretending to be a helper. I said, 'O Abu Rafi`,' changing the tone of my voice. He asked me, 'What do you want; woe to your mother?' I asked him, 'What has happened to you?' He said, 'I don't know who came to me and hit me.' Then I drove my sword into his belly and pushed it forcibly till it touched the bone. Then I came out, filled with puzzlement and went towards a ladder of theirs in order to get down but I fell down and sprained my foot. I came to my companions and said, 'I will not leave till I hear the wailing of the women.' So, I did not leave till I heard the women bewailing Abu Rafi`, the merchant of Hijaz. Then I got up, feeling no ailment, (and we proceeded) till we came upon the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَهْطًا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ إِلَى أَبِي رَافِعٍ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَتِيكٍ بَيْتَهُ لَيْلاً، فَقَتَلَهُ وَهْوَ نَائِمٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma qaala ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rahtana mina alaansaari iilaa aabiy raafi'in fadakhala 'alayhi 'abdu alllahi bnu 'atiykin baytahu laylaan, faqatalahu wahwa naaiimun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a group of the Ansar to Abu Rafi`. `Abdullah bin Atik entered his house at night and killed him while he was sleeping
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الْيَرْبُوعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمٌ أَبُو النَّضْرِ، مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ كُنْتُ كَاتِبًا لَهُ قَالَ كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي أَوْفَى حِينَ خَرَجَ إِلَى الْحَرُورِيَّةِ فَقَرَأْتُهُ فَإِذَا فِيهِ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ أَيَّامِهِ الَّتِي لَقِيَ فِيهَا الْعَدُوَّ انْتَظَرَ حَتَّى مَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ فِي النَّاسِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ لاَ تَمَنَّوْا لِقَاءَ الْعَدُوِّ وَسَلُوا اللَّهَ الْعَافِيَةَ، فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُوهُمْ فَاصْبِرُوا وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ تَحْتَ ظِلاَلِ السُّيُوفِ ـ ثُمَّ قَالَ ـ اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ وَمُجْرِيَ السَّحَابِ وَهَازِمَ الأَحْزَابِ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِم أَبُو النَّضْرِ كُنْتُ كَاتِبًا لِعُمَرَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ فَأَتَاهُ كِتَابُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَمَنَّوْا لِقَاءَ الْعَدُو ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yuwsufu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa 'aasimu bnu yuwsufa alyarbuw'iyyu, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa alfazaariyyu, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, qaala haddathaniy saalimun aabuw alnnadri, mawlaa 'umara bni 'ubaydi alllahi kuntu kaatibana lahu qaala kataba iilayhi 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy aawfaa hiyna kharaja iilaa alharuwriyyaai faqaraatuhu faiidhaa fiyhi iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ba'di aayyaamihi allatiy laqiya fiyhaa al'aduwwa antazara hattaa maalati alshhamsu‏.‏ thumma qaama fiy alnnaasi faqaala ‏"‏ aayyuhaa alnnaasu laa tamannawa liqaa'a al'aduwwi wasaluwa alllaha al'aafiyaaa, faiidhaa laqiytumuwhum faasbiruwa waa'lamuwa aanna aljannaaa tahta zilaali alssuyuwfi thumma qaala alllahumma munzila alkitaabi wamujriya alssahaabi wahaazima alaahzaabi ahzimhum waansurnaa 'alayhim ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa haddathaniy saalim aabuw alnnadri kuntu kaatibana li'umara bni 'ubaydi alllahi faaataahu kitaabu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy aawfaa rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa tamannawa liqaa'a al'aduw ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salim Abu An-Nadr: (the freed slave of 'Umar bin 'Ubaidullah) I was Umar's clerk. Once Abdullah bin Abi Aufa wrote a letter to 'Umar when he proceeded to Al-Haruriya. I read in it that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in one of his military expeditions against the enemy, waited till the sun declined and then he got up amongst the people saying, "O people! Do not wish to meet the enemy, and ask Allah for safety, but when you face the enemy, be patient, and remember that Paradise is under the shades of swords." Then he said, "O Allah, the Revealer of the Holy Book, and the Mover of the clouds and the Defeater of the clans, defeat them, and grant us victory over them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: وَقَالَ أَبُو عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَمَنَّوْا لِقَاءَ الْعَدُوِّ، فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُوهُمْ فَاصْبِرُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala aabuw 'aamirin haddathanaa mughiyraau bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tamannawa liqaa'a al'aduwwi, faiidhaa laqiytumuwhum faasbiruwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Do not wish to meet the enemy, but when you meet face) the enemy, be patient
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ هَلَكَ كِسْرَى ثُمَّ لاَ يَكُونُ كِسْرَى بَعْدَهُ، وَقَيْصَرٌ لَيَهْلِكَنَّ ثُمَّ لاَ يَكُونُ قَيْصَرٌ بَعْدَهُ، وَلَتُقْسَمَنَّ كُنُوزُهَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَسَمَّى الْحَرْبَ خَدْعَةً
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu allaahi bnu muhamaadin, hadaathanaa 'abdu alraazaaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hamaaamin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ halaka kisraa thumaa laa yakuwnu kisraa ba'dahu, waqaysarun layahlikanaa thumaa laa yakuwnu qaysarun ba'dahu, walatuqsamanaa kunuwzuhaa fiy sabiyli allaahi ‏"‏‏.‏ wasamaaa alharba khad'aaan
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Khosrau will be ruined, and there will be no Khosrau after him, and Caesar will surely be ruined and there will be no Caesar after him, and you will spend their treasures in Allah's Cause." He called, "War is deceit
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَصْرَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْحَرْبَ خُدْعَةً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aasrama, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala sammaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alharba khud'aaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called,: "War is deceit
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْحَرْبُ خُدْعَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sadaqaau bnu alfadli, aakhbaranaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amrinw, sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alharbu khud'aaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "War is deceit
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ لِكَعْبِ بْنِ الأَشْرَفِ، فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ آذَى اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ أَتُحِبُّ أَنْ أَقْتُلَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّ هَذَا ـ يَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَدْ عَنَّانَا وَسَأَلَنَا الصَّدَقَةَ، قَالَ وَأَيْضًا وَاللَّهِ قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدِ اتَّبَعْنَاهُ فَنَكْرَهُ أَنْ نَدَعَهُ حَتَّى نَنْظُرَ إِلَى مَا يَصِيرُ أَمْرُهُ قَالَ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يُكَلِّمُهُ حَتَّى اسْتَمْكَنَ مِنْهُ فَقَتَلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man lika'bi bni alaashrafi, faiinnahu qad adhaa alllaha warasuwlahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala muhammadu bnu maslamaaa aatuhibbu aan aaqtulahu yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faaataahu faqaala iinna hadhaa ya'niy alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qad 'annaanaa wasaaalanaa alssadaqaaa, qaala waaaydana waalllahi qaala faiinnaa qadi attaba'naahu fanakrahu aan nada'ahu hattaa nanzura iilaa maa yasiyru aamruhu qaala falam yazal yukallimuhu hattaa astamkana minhu faqatalahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who is ready to kill Ka`b bin Al-Ashraf who has really hurt Allah and His Apostle?" Muhammad bin Maslama said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you like me to kill him?" He replied in the affirmative. So, Muhammad bin Maslama went to him (i.e. Ka`b) and said, "This person (i.e. the Prophet) has put us to task and asked us for charity." Ka`b replied, "By Allah, you will get tired of him." Muhammad said to him, "We have followed him, so we dislike to leave him till we see the end of his affair." Muhammad bin Maslama went on talking to him in this way till he got the chance to kill him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ لِكَعْبِ بْنِ الأَشْرَفِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ أَتُحِبُّ أَنْ أَقْتُلَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَأْذَنْ لِي فَأَقُولَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ فَعَلْتُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man lika'bi bni alaashrafi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala muhammadu bnu maslamaaa aatuhibbu aan aaqtulahu qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faadhan liy faaaquwla‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ qad fa'altu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who is ready to kill Ka`b bin Ashraf (i.e. a Jew)." Muhammad bin Maslama replied, "Do you like me to kill him?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative. Muhammad bin Maslama said, "Then allow me to say what I like." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "I do (i.e. allow you)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: قَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ انْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَعَهُ أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ قِبَلَ ابْنِ صَيَّادٍ، فَحُدِّثَ بِهِ فِي نَخْلٍ، فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم النَّخْلَ، طَفِقَ يَتَّقِي بِجُذُوعِ النَّخْلِ، وَابْنُ صَيَّادٍ فِي قَطِيفَةٍ لَهُ فِيهَا رَمْرَمَةٌ، فَرَأَتْ أُمُّ ابْنِ صَيَّادٍ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا صَافِ، هَذَا مُحَمَّدٌ، فَوَثَبَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ تَرَكَتْهُ بَيَّنَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala alllaythu haddathaniy 'uqaylun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aannahu qaala antalaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wama'ahu aubaaau bnu ka'bin qibala abni sayyaadin, fahudditha bihi fiy nakhlin, falammaa dakhala 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alnnakhla, tafiqa yattaqiy bijudhuw'i alnnakhli, waabnu sayyaadin fiy qatiyfaain lahu fiyhaa ramramaaun, faraaat aummu abni sayyaadin rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa saafi, hadhaa muhammadun, fawathaba abnu sayyaadin, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ law tarakathu bayyana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Umar (ra):Once, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) accompanied by Ubai bin Ka'b set out to Ibn Saiyyad. He was informed that Ibn Saiyyad was in a garden of date palms. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered the garden of date-palms, he started hiding himself behind the trunks of the palms while Ibn Saiyyad was covered with a velvet sheet with murmurs emanating from under it. Ibn Saiyyad's mother saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Saf! This is Muhammad." So Ibn Saiyyad got up. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If she had left him (in his state), the truth would have been clear
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ وَهُوَ يَنْقُلُ التُّرَابَ حَتَّى وَارَى التُّرَابُ شَعَرَ صَدْرِهِ، وَكَانَ رَجُلاً كَثِيرَ الشَّعَرِ وَهْوَ يَرْتَجِزُ بِرَجَزِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ لَوْلاَ أَنْتَ مَا اهْتَدَيْنَا وَلاَ تَصَدَّقْنَا وَلاَ صَلَّيْنَا فَأَنْزِلَنْ سَكِينَةً عَلَيْنَا وَثَبِّتِ الأَقْدَامَ إِنْ لاَقَيْنَا إِنَّ الأَعْدَاءَ قَدْ بَغَوْا عَلَيْنَا إِذَا أَرَادُوا فِتْنَةً أَبَيْنَا يَرْفَعُ بِهَا صَوْتَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i rda allh 'nh qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alkhandaqi wahuwa yanqulu altturaaba hattaa waaraa altturaabu sha'ara sadrihi, wakaana rajulaan kathiyra alshha'ari wahwa yartajizu birajazi 'abdi alllahi alllahumma lawlaa aanta maa ahtadaynaa walaa tasaddaqnaa walaa sallaynaa faaanzilan sakiynaaan 'alaynaa wathabbiti alaaqdaama iin laaqaynaa iinna alaa'daa'a qad baghawa 'alaynaa iidhaa aaraaduwa fitnaaan aabaynaa yarfa'u bihaa sawtahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day (of the battle) of the Trench carrying earth till the hair of his chest were covered with dust and he was a hairy man. He was reciting the following verses of `Abdullah (bin Rawaha): "O Allah, were it not for You, We would not have been guided, Nor would we have given in charity, nor prayed. So, bestow on us calmness, and when we meet the enemy. Then make our feet firm, for indeed, Yet if they want to put us in affliction, (i.e. want to fight against us) we would not (flee but withstand them)." The Prophet (ﷺ) used to raise his voice while reciting these verses. (See Hadith No. 432, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ مَا حَجَبَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُنْذُ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَلاَ رَآنِي إِلاَّ تَبَسَّمَ فِي وَجْهِي‏.‏ وَلَقَدْ شَكَوْتُ إِلَيْهِ إِنِّي لاَ أَثْبُتُ عَلَى الْخَيْلِ‏.‏ فَضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ فِي صَدْرِي وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ وَاجْعَلْهُ هَادِيًا مَهْدِيًّا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa abnu iidriysa, 'an iismaa'iyla, 'an qaysin, 'an jariyrin rda allh 'nh qaala maa hajabaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm mundhu aaslamtu, walaa raaniy iilaaa tabassama fiy wajhiy‏.‏ walaqad shakawtu iilayhi iinniy laa aathbutu 'alaa alkhayli‏.‏ fadaraba biyadihi fiy sadriy waqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma thabbithu waaj'alhu haadiyana mahdiyyana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jarir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not screen himself from me since my embracing Islam, and whenever he saw me he would receive me with a smile. Once I told him that I could not sit firm on horses. He stroke me on the chest with his hand and said, "O Allah! Make him firm and make him a guiding and a rightly guided man
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ، قَالَ سَأَلُوا سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ بِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ دُووِيَ جُرْحُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ النَّاسِ أَحَدٌ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، كَانَ عَلِيٌّ يَجِيءُ بِالْمَاءِ فِي تُرْسِهِ، وَكَانَتْ ـ يَعْنِي فَاطِمَةَ ـ تَغْسِلُ الدَّمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، وَأُخِذَ حَصِيرٌ فَأُحْرِقَ، ثُمَّ حُشِيَ بِهِ جُرْحُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa aabuw haazimin, qaala saaaluwa sahla bna sa'din alssaa'idiyya rda allh 'nh biaaaai shaa'in duwwiya jurhu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala maa baqiya mina alnnaasi aahadun aa'lamu bihi minniy, kaana 'aliyyun yajiy'u bialmaa'i fiy tursihi, wakaanat ya'niy faatimaaa taghsilu alddama 'an wajhihi, waaukhidha hasiyrun faauhriqa, thumma hushiya bihi jurhu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Hazim:The people asked Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa' idi "With what thing (medicine) was the wound of Allah's Apostle treated?" He replied, "There is none left (living) amongst the people who knows it better than me. `Ali used to bring water in his shield and Fatima (i.e. the Prophet's daughter) used to wash the blood off his face. Then a mat (of palm leaves) was burnt and its ash was inserted in the wound of Allah's Apostle
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ مُعَاذًا وَأَبَا مُوسَى إِلَى الْيَمَنِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَسِّرَا وَلاَ تُعَسِّرَا، وَبَشِّرَا وَلاَ تُنَفِّرَا، وَتَطَاوَعَا وَلاَ تَخْتَلِفَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an shu'baaa, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaddihi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha mu'aadhana waaabaa muwsaa iilaa alyamani qaala ‏ "‏ yassiraa walaa tu'assiraa, wabashhiraa walaa tunaffiraa, watataawa'aa walaa takhtalifaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda:That his father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) sent Mu`adh and Abu Musa to Yemen telling them. 'Treat the people with ease and don't be hard on them; give them glad tidings and don't fill them with aversion; and love each other, and don't differ
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يُحَدِّثُ قَالَ جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الرَّجَّالَةِ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ ـ وَكَانُوا خَمْسِينَ رَجُلاً ـ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنْ رَأَيْتُمُونَا تَخْطَفُنَا الطَّيْرُ، فَلاَ تَبْرَحُوا مَكَانَكُمْ هَذَا حَتَّى أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ، وَإِنْ رَأَيْتُمُونَا هَزَمْنَا الْقَوْمَ وَأَوْطَأْنَاهُمْ فَلاَ تَبْرَحُوا حَتَّى أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏ فَهَزَمُوهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَنَا وَاللَّهِ رَأَيْتُ النِّسَاءَ يَشْتَدِدْنَ قَدْ بَدَتْ خَلاَخِلُهُنَّ وَأَسْوُقُهُنَّ رَافِعَاتٍ ثِيَابَهُنَّ، فَقَالَ أَصْحَابُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ الْغَنِيمَةَ ـ أَىْ قَوْمِ ـ الْغَنِيمَةَ، ظَهَرَ أَصْحَابُكُمْ فَمَا تَنْتَظِرُونَ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ أَنَسِيتُمْ مَا قَالَ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالُوا وَاللَّهِ لَنَأْتِيَنَّ النَّاسَ فَلَنُصِيبَنَّ مِنَ الْغَنِيمَةِ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَتَوْهُمْ صُرِفَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فَأَقْبَلُوا مُنْهَزِمِينَ، فَذَاكَ إِذْ يَدْعُوهُمُ الرَّسُولُ فِي أُخْرَاهُمْ، فَلَمْ يَبْقَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرُ اثْنَىْ عَشَرَ رَجُلاً، فَأَصَابُوا مِنَّا سَبْعِينَ، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابُهُ أَصَابَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ أَرْبَعِينَ وَمِائَةً سَبْعِينَ أَسِيرًا وَسَبْعِينَ قَتِيلاً، فَقَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ أَفِي الْقَوْمِ مُحَمَّدٌ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، فَنَهَاهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُجِيبُوهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَفِي الْقَوْمِ ابْنُ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ أَفِي
