verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an aabiy hayyaana, qaala haddathaniy aabuw zur'aaa, qaala haddathaniy aabuw hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaama fiynaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara alghuluwla fa'azzamahu wa'azzama aamrahu qaala ‏ "‏ laa aulfiyanna aahadakum yawma alqiyaamaai 'alaa raqabatihi shaaaun lahaa thughaa'un 'alaa raqabatihi farasun lahu hamhamaaun yaquwlu yaa rasuwla alllahi, aaghithniy‏.‏ faaaquwlu laa aamliku laka shayiana, qad aablaghtuka‏.‏ wa'alaa raqabatihi ba'iyrun lahu rughaa'un, yaquwlu yaa rasuwla alllahi aaghithniy‏.‏ faaaquwlu laa aamliku laka shayiana, qad aablaghtuka‏.‏ wa'alaa raqabatihi saamitun, fayaquwlu yaa rasuwla alllahi aaghithniy‏.‏ faaaquwlu laa aamliku laka shayiana, qad aablaghtuka‏.‏ aaw 'alaa raqabatihi riqaa'un takhfiqu, fayaquwlu yaa rasuwla alllahi aaghithniy‏.‏ faaaquwlu laa aamliku laka shayiana, qad aablaghtuka ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala aayyuwbu 'an aabiy hayyaana farasun lahu hamhamaaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) got up amongst us and mentioned Al Ghulul, emphasized its magnitude and declared that it was a great sin saying, "Don't commit Ghulul for I should not like to see anyone amongst you on the Day of Resurrection, carrying over his neck a sheep that will be bleating, or carrying over his neck a horse that will be neighing. Such a man will be saying: 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Intercede with Allah for me,' and I will reply, 'I can't help you, for I have conveyed Allah's Message to you Nor should I like to see a man carrying over his neck, a camel that will be grunting. Such a man will say, 'O Allah's Apostle! Intercede with Allah for me, and I will say, 'I can't help you for I have conveyed Allah's Message to you,' or one carrying over his neck gold and silver and saying, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Intercede with Allah for me,' and I will say, 'I can't help you for I have conveyed Allah's Message to you,' or one carrying clothes that will be fluttering, and the man will say, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Intercede with Allah for me.' And I will say, 'I can't help you, for I have conveyed Allah's Message to you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ كَانَ عَلَى ثَقَلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ كِرْكِرَةُ فَمَاتَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ هُوَ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَذَهَبُوا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَوَجَدُوا عَبَاءَةً قَدْ غَلَّهَا‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ ابْنُ سَلاَمٍ كَرْكَرَةُ، يَعْنِي بِفَتْحِ الْكَافِ، وَهْوَ مَضْبُوطٌ كَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, qaala kaana 'alaa thaqali alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun yuqaalu lahu kirkiraau famaata, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ huwa fiy alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ fadhahabuwa yanzuruwna iilayhi fawajaduwa 'abaa'aaan qad ghallahaa‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi qaala abnu salaamin karkaraau, ya'niy bifathi alkaafi, wahwa madbuwtun kadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:There was a man who looked after the family and the belongings of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he was called Karkara. The man died and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He is in the '(Hell) Fire." The people then went to look at him and found in his place, a cloak he had stolen from the war booty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، رَافِعٍ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ، فَأَصَابَ النَّاسَ جُوعٌ وَأَصَبْنَا إِبِلاً وَغَنَمًا، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أُخْرَيَاتِ النَّاسِ، فَعَجِلُوا فَنَصَبُوا الْقُدُورَ، فَأَمَرَ بِالْقُدُورِ فَأُكْفِئَتْ، ثُمَّ قَسَمَ فَعَدَلَ عَشَرَةً مِنَ الْغَنَمِ بِبَعِيرٍ، فَنَدَّ مِنْهَا بَعِيرٌ، وَفِي الْقَوْمِ خَيْلٌ يَسِيرٌ فَطَلَبُوهُ فَأَعْيَاهُمْ، فَأَهْوَى إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ بِسَهْمٍ، فَحَبَسَهُ اللَّهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ الْبَهَائِمُ لَهَا أَوَابِدُ كَأَوَابِدِ الْوَحْشِ، فَمَا نَدَّ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاصْنَعُوا بِهِ هَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ جَدِّي إِنَّا نَرْجُو ـ أَوْ نَخَافُ ـ أَنْ نَلْقَى الْعَدُوَّ غَدًا وَلَيْسَ مَعَنَا مُدًى، أَفَنَذْبَحُ بِالْقَصَبِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَنْهَرَ الدَّمَ وَذُكِرَ اسْمُ اللَّهِ فَكُلْ، لَيْسَ السِّنَّ وَالظُّفُرَ، وَسَأُحَدِّثُكُمْ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، أَمَّا السِّنُّ فَعَظْمٌ، وَأَمَّا الظُّفُرُ فَمُدَى الْحَبَشَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni masruwqin, 'an 'abaayaaa bni rifaa'aaa, 'an jaddihi, raafi'in qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bidhiy alhulayfaai, faaasaaba alnnaasa juw'un waaasabnaa iibilaan waghanamana, wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy aukhrayaati alnnaasi, fa'ajiluwa fanasabuwa alquduwra, faaamara bialquduwri faaukfiiat, thumma qasama fa'adala 'asharaaan mina alghanami biba'iyrin, fanadda minhaa ba'iyrun, wafiy alqawmi khaylun yasiyrun fatalabuwhu faaa'yaahum, faaahwaa iilayhi rajulun bisahmin, fahabasahu alllahu faqaala ‏"‏ hadhihi albahaaiimu lahaa aawaabidu kaaawaabidi alwahshi, famaa nadda 'alaykum faasna'uwa bihi hakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala jaddiy iinnaa narjuw aaw nakhaafu aan nalqaa al'aduwwa ghadana walaysa ma'anaa mudana, aafanadhbahu bialqasabi faqaala ‏"‏ maa aanhara alddama wadhukira asmu alllahi fakul, laysa alssinna waalzzufura, wasaauhaddithukum 'an dhalika, aammaa alssinnu fa'azmun, waaammaa alzzufuru famudaa alhabashaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abaya bin Rifaa:My grandfather, Rafi` said, "We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) at DhulHulaifa, and the people suffered from hunger. We got some camels and sheep (as booty) and the Prophet (ﷺ) was still behind the people. They hurried and put the cooking pots on the fire. (When he came) he ordered that the cooking pots should be upset and then he distributed the booty (amongst the people) regarding ten sheep as equal to one camel. Then a camel fled and the people chased it till they got tired, as they had a few horses (for chasing it). So a man threw an arrow at it and caused it to stop (with Allah's Permission). On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Some of these animals behave like wild beasts, so, if any animal flees from you, deal with it in the same way." My grandfather asked (the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "We hope (or are afraid) that we may meet the enemy tomorrow and we have no knives. Can we slaughter our animals with canes?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "If the instrument used for killing causes the animal to bleed profusely and if Allah's Name is mentioned on killing it, then eat its meat (i.e. it is lawful) but don't use a tooth or a nail and I am telling you the reason: A tooth is a bone (and slaughtering with a bone is forbidden ), and a nail is the slaughtering instrument of the Ethiopians
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي قَيْسٌ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلاَ تُرِيحُنِي مِنْ ذِي الْخَلَصَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ بَيْتًا فِيهِ خَثْعَمُ يُسَمَّى كَعْبَةَ الْيَمَانِيَةَ، فَانْطَلَقْتُ فِي خَمْسِينَ وَمِائَةٍ مِنْ أَحْمَسَ، وَكَانُوا أَصْحَابَ خَيْلٍ، فَأَخْبَرْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِّي لاَ أَثْبُتُ عَلَى الْخَيْلِ، فَضَرَبَ فِي صَدْرِي حَتَّى رَأَيْتُ أَثَرَ أَصَابِعِهِ فِي صَدْرِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ وَاجْعَلْهُ هَادِيًا مَهْدِيًّا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ إِلَيْهَا فَكَسَرَهَا وَحَرَّقَهَا، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُبَشِّرُهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ جَرِيرٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ، مَا جِئْتُكَ حَتَّى تَرَكْتُهَا كَأَنَّهَا جَمَلٌ أَجْرَبُ، فَبَارَكَ عَلَى خَيْلِ أَحْمَسَ وَرِجَالِهَا خَمْسَ مَرَّاتٍ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسَدَّدٌ بَيْتٌ فِي خَثْعَمَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy qaysun, qaala qaala liy jariyru bnu 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aalaa turiyhuniy min dhiy alkhalasaai ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana baytana fiyhi khath'amu yusammaa ka'baaa alyamaaniyaaa, faantalaqtu fiy khamsiyna wamiaiaain min aahmasa, wakaanuwa aashaaba khaylin, faaakhbartu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aanniy laa aathbutu 'alaa alkhayli, fadaraba fiy sadriy hattaa raaaytu aathara aasaabi'ihi fiy sadriy faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma thabbithu waaj'alhu haadiyana mahdiyyana ‏"‏‏.‏ faantalaqa iilayhaa fakasarahaa waharraqahaa, faaarsala iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yubashhiruhu faqaala rasuwlu jariyrin yaa rasuwla alllahi, waalladhiy ba'athaka bialhaqqi, maa jiituka hattaa taraktuhaa kaaannahaa jamalun aajrabu, fabaaraka 'alaa khayli aahmasa warijaalihaa khamsa marraatin‏.‏ qaala musaddadun baytun fiy khath'ama‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qais:Jarir bin `Abdullah said to me, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, 'Won't you relieve me from Dhul- Khalasa?' Dhul-Khalasa was a house where the tribe of Khatham used to stay, and it used to be called Ka`bat-ul Yamaniya. So I proceeded with one hundred-and-fifty (men) from the tribe of Ahmas who were good cavalry. I informed the Prophet (ﷺ) that I could not sit firm on horses, so he stroke me on the chest with his hand and I noticed his finger marks on my chest. He invoked, 'O Allah! Make him firm and a guiding and rightly-guided man." Jarir set out towards that place, dismantled and burnt it, and then sent the good news to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . The messenger of Jarir said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). "O Allah's Apostle! By Him Who has sent you with the Truth, I did not come to you till it (i.e. the house) had been turned (black) like a scabby camel (covered with tar)." So the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah to Bless the horses of the men of Ahmas five times
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ ‏ "‏ لاَ هِجْرَةَ وَلَكِنْ جِهَادٌ وَنِيَّةٌ، وَإِذَا اسْتُنْفِرْتُمْ فَانْفِرُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu bnu aabiy iiyaasin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an mujaahidin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma fathi makkaaa ‏ "‏ laa hijraaa walakin jihaadun waniyyaaun, waiidhaa astunfirtum faanfiruwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, on the day of the Conquest of Mecca, "There is no migration (after the Conquest), but Jihad and good intentions, and when you are called for Jihad, you should immediately respond to the call
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ مُجَاشِعِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ مُجَاشِعٌ بِأَخِيهِ مُجَالِدِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ هَذَا مُجَالِدٌ يُبَايِعُكَ عَلَى الْهِجْرَةِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ هِجْرَةَ بَعْدَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ، وَلَكِنْ أُبَايِعُهُ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'an khaalidin, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana alnnahdiyyi, 'an mujaashi'i bni mas'uwdin, qaala jaa'a mujaashi'un biaakhiyhi mujaalidi bni mas'uwdin iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala hadhaa mujaalidun yubaayi'uka 'alaa alhijraai‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ laa hijraaa ba'da fathi makkaaa, walakin aubaayi'uhu 'alaa aliislaami ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu `Uthman An-Nahdi:Mujashi (bin Mas`ud) took his brother Mujalid bin Mas`ud to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "This is Mujalid and he will give a pledge of allegiance to you for migration." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no migration after the Conquest of Mecca, but I will take his pledge of allegiance for Islam
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو وَابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءً، يَقُولُ ذَهَبْتُ مَعَ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ وَهْىَ مُجَاوِرَةٌ بِثَبِيرٍ فَقَالَتْ لَنَا انْقَطَعَتِ الْهِجْرَةُ مُنْذُ فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَى نَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَّةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala 'amrunw waabnu jurayjin sami'tu 'ataa'an, yaquwlu dhahabtu ma'a 'ubaydi bni 'umayrin iilaa 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha wahaa mujaawiraaun bithabiyrin faqaalat lanaa anqata'ati alhijraau mundhu fataha alllahu 'alaa nabiyyihi sla allh 'lyh wslm makkaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ata':I and 'Ubai bin `Umar went to `Aisha while she was staying near Thabir (i.e. a mountain). She said, "There is no Migration after Allah gave His Prophet victory over Mecca
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ الطَّائِفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُصَيْنٌ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَكَانَ، عُثْمَانِيًّا فَقَالَ لاِبْنِ عَطِيَّةَ وَكَانَ عَلَوِيًّا إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ مَا الَّذِي جَرَّأَ صَاحِبَكَ عَلَى الدِّمَاءِ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ بَعَثَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالزُّبَيْرَ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ائْتُوا رَوْضَةَ كَذَا، وَتَجِدُونَ بِهَا امْرَأَةً أَعْطَاهَا حَاطِبٌ كِتَابًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَتَيْنَا الرَّوْضَةَ فَقُلْنَا الْكِتَابَ‏.‏ قَالَتْ لَمْ يُعْطِنِي‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا لَتُخْرِجِنَّ أَوْ لأُجَرِّدَنَّكِ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَتْ مِنْ حُجْزَتِهَا، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى حَاطِبٍ فَقَالَ لاَ تَعْجَلْ، وَاللَّهِ مَا كَفَرْتُ وَلاَ ازْدَدْتُ لِلإِسْلاَمِ إِلاَّ حُبًّا، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِكَ إِلاَّ وَلَهُ بِمَكَّةَ مَنْ يَدْفَعُ اللَّهُ بِهِ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لِي أَحَدٌ، فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أَتَّخِذَ عِنْدَهُمْ يَدًا‏.‏ فَصَدَّقَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ دَعْنِي أَضْرِبْ عُنُقَهُ، فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ نَافَقَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ اطَّلَعَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَدْرٍ، فَقَالَ اعْمَلُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَهَذَا الَّذِي جَرَّأَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni hawshabin alttaaiifiyyu, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa husaynun, 'an sa'di bni 'ubaydaaa, 'an aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, wakaana, 'uthmaaniyyana faqaala laibni 'atiyyaaa wakaana 'alawiyyana iinniy laa'lamu maa alladhiy jarraaa saahibaka 'alaa alddimaa'i sami'tuhu yaquwlu ba'athaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waalzzubayra, faqaala ‏"‏ aituwa rawdaaa kadhaa, watajiduwna bihaa amraaaaan aa'taahaa haatibun kitaabana ‏"‏‏.‏ faaataynaa alrrawdaaa faqulnaa alkitaaba‏.‏ qaalat lam yu'tiniy‏.‏ faqulnaa latukhrijinna aaw laujarridannaki‏.‏ faaakhrajat min hujzatihaa, faaarsala iilaa haatibin faqaala laa ta'jal, waalllahi maa kafartu walaa azdadtu liliislaami iilaaa hubbana, walam yakun aahadun min aashaabika iilaaa walahu bimakkaaa man yadfa'u alllahu bihi 'an aahlihi wamaalihi, walam yakun liy aahadun, faaahbabtu aan aattakhidha 'indahum yadana‏.‏ fasaddaqahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaala 'umaru da'niy aadrib 'unuqahu, faiinnahu qad naafaqa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ maa yudriyka la'alla alllaha attala'a 'alaa aahli badrin, faqaala a'maluwa maa shiitum ‏"‏‏.‏ fahadhaa alladhiy jarraaahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d bin 'Ubaida:Abu `Abdur-Rahman who was one of the supporters of `Uthman said to Abu Talha who was one of the supporters of `Ali, "I perfectly know what encouraged your leader (i.e. `Ali) to shed blood. I heard him saying: Once the Prophet (ﷺ) sent me and Az-Zubair saying, 'Proceed to such-and-such Ar-Roudah (place) where you will find a lady whom Hatib has given a letter. So when we arrived at Ar-Roudah, we requested the lady to hand over the letter to us. She said, 'Hatib has not given me any letter.' We said to her. 'Take out the letter or else we will strip off your clothes.' So she took it out of her braid. So the Prophet (ﷺ) sent for Hatib, (who came) and said, 'Don't hurry in judging me, for, by Allah, I have not become a disbeliever, and my love to Islam is increasing. (The reason for writing this letter was) that there is none of your companions but has relatives in Mecca who look after their families and property, while I have nobody there, so I wanted to do them some favor (so that they might look after my family and property).' The Prophet (ﷺ) believed him. `Umar said, 'Allow me to chop off his (i.e. Hatib's) neck as he has done hypocrisy.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, (to `Umar), 'Who knows, perhaps Allah has looked at the warriors of Badr and said (to them), 'Do whatever you like, for I have forgiven you.' " Abu `Abdur-Rahman added, "So this is what encouraged him (i.e. `Ali)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، وَحُمَيْدُ بْنُ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ الشَّهِيدِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ لاِبْنِ جَعْفَرٍ ـ رضى الله عنهم أَتَذْكُرُ إِذْ تَلَقَّيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَا وَأَنْتَ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ، فَحَمَلَنَا وَتَرَكَكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy alaaswadi, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, wahumaydu bnu alaaswadi, 'an habiybi bni alshhahiydi, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, qaala abnu alzzubayri laibni ja'farin rda allh 'nhm aatadhkuru iidh talaqqaynaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanaa waaanta waabnu 'abbaasin qaala na'am, fahamalanaa watarakaka‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:Ibn Az-Zubair said to Ibn Ja`far "Do you remember when I, you and Ibn `Abbas went out to receive Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Ibn Ja`far replied in the affirmative. Ibn Az-Zubair added, "And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made us (i.e. I and Ibn `Abbas) ride along with him and left you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ السَّائِبُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ـ رضى الله عنه ذَهَبْنَا نَتَلَقَّى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ الصِّبْيَانِ إِلَى ثَنِيَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala qaala alssaaiibu bnu yaziyda rda allh 'nh dhahabnaa natalaqqaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ma'a alssibyaani iilaa thaniyyaai alwadaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:I along with some boys went out to receive Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Thaniyatal-Wada
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا قَفَلَ كَبَّرَ ثَلاَثًا قَالَ ‏ "‏ آيِبُونَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ حَامِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا سَاجِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa qafala kabbara thalaathana qaala ‏ "‏ ayibuwna iin shaa'a alllahu taaiibuwna 'aabiduwna haamiduwna lirabbinaa saajiduwna, sadaqa alllahu wa'dahu, wanasara 'abdahu, wahazama alaahzaaba wahdahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:When the Prophet (ﷺ) returned (from Jihad), he would say Takbir thrice and add, "We are returning, if Allah wishes, with repentance and worshipping and praising (our Lord) and prostrating ourselves before our Lord. Allah fulfilled His Promise and helped His Slave, and He Alone defeated the (infidel) clans
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَقْفَلَهُ مِنْ عُسْفَانَ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ، وَقَدْ أَرْدَفَ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتَ حُيَىٍّ، فَعَثَرَتْ نَاقَتُهُ فَصُرِعَا جَمِيعًا، فَاقْتَحَمَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، جَعَلَنِي اللَّهُ فِدَاءَكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ عَلَيْكَ الْمَرْأَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَلَبَ ثَوْبًا عَلَى وَجْهِهِ وَأَتَاهَا، فَأَلْقَاهَا عَلَيْهَا وَأَصْلَحَ لَهُمَا مَرْكَبَهُمَا فَرَكِبَا، وَاكْتَنَفْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمَّا أَشْرَفْنَا عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ الْمَدِينَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa bnu aabiy iishaaqa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm maqfalahu min 'usfaana, warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa raahilatihi, waqad aardafa safiyyaaa binta huyaaain, fa'atharat naaqatuhu fasuri'aa jamiy'ana, faaqtahama aabuw talhaaa faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, ja'alaniy alllahu fidaa'aka‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ 'alayka almaraaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqalaba thawbana 'alaa wajhihi waaataahaa, faaalqaahaa 'alayhaa waaaslaha lahumaa markabahumaa farakibaa, waaktanafnaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, falammaa aashrafnaa 'alaa almadiynaai qaala ‏"‏ ayibuwna taaiibuwna 'aabiduwna lirabbinaa haamiduwna ‏"‏‏.‏ falam yazal yaquwlu dhalika hattaa dakhala almadiynaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) while returning from 'Usfan, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was riding his she-camel keeping Safiya bint Huyay riding behind him. His she-camel slipped and both of them fell down. Abu Talha jumped from his camel and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! May Allah sacrifice me for you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Take care of the lady." So, Abu Talha covered his face with a garment and went to Safiya and covered her with it, and then he set right the condition of their she-camel so that both of them rode, and we were encircling Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) like a cover. When we approached Medina, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We are returning with repentance and worshipping and praising our Lord." He kept on saying this till he entered Medina
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّهُ أَقْبَلَ هُوَ وَأَبُو طَلْحَةَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَفِيَّةُ مُرْدِفَهَا عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ، فَلَمَّا كَانُوا بِبَعْضِ الطَّرِيقِ عَثَرَتِ النَّاقَةُ، فَصُرِعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْمَرْأَةُ، وَإِنَّ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ ـ قَالَ أَحْسِبُ قَالَ ـ اقْتَحَمَ عَنْ بَعِيرِهِ فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ جَعَلَنِي اللَّهُ فِدَاءَكَ، هَلْ أَصَابَكَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ، وَلَكِنْ عَلَيْكَ بِالْمَرْأَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَلْقَى أَبُو طَلْحَةَ ثَوْبَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ، فَقَصَدَ قَصْدَهَا فَأَلْقَى ثَوْبَهُ عَلَيْهَا، فَقَامَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ، فَشَدَّ لَهُمَا عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِمَا فَرَكِبَا، فَسَارُوا حَتَّى إِذَا كَانُوا بِظَهْرِ الْمَدِينَةِ ـ أَوْ قَالَ أَشْرَفُوا عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ـ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَقُولُهَا حَتَّى دَخَلَ الْمَدِينَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy iishaaqa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aannahu aaqbala huwa waaabuw talhaaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wama'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm safiyyaau murdifahaa 'alaa raahilatihi, falammaa kaanuwa biba'di alttariyqi 'atharati alnnaaqaau, fasuri'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waalmaraaau, waiinna aabaa talhaaa qaala aahsibu qaala aqtahama 'an ba'iyrihi faaataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa nabiyya alllahi ja'alaniy alllahu fidaa'aka, hal aasaabaka min shaa'in qaala ‏"‏ laa, walakin 'alayka bialmaraaai ‏"‏‏.‏ faaalqaa aabuw talhaaa thawbahu 'alaa wajhihi, faqasada qasdahaa faaalqaa thawbahu 'alayhaa, faqaamati almaraaau, fashadda lahumaa 'alaa raahilatihimaa farakibaa, fasaaruwa hattaa iidhaa kaanuwa bizahri almadiynaai aaw qaala aashrafuwa 'alaa almadiynaai qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ ayibuwna taaiibuwna 'aabiduwna lirabbinaa haamiduwna ‏"‏‏.‏ falam yazal yaquwluhaa hattaa dakhala almadiynaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:That he and Abu Talha came in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and Safiya was accompanying the Prophet, who let her ride behind him on his she-camel. During the journey, the she-camel slipped and both the Prophet (ﷺ) and (his) wife fell down. Abu Talha (the sub-narrator thinks that Anas said that Abu Talha jumped from his camel quickly) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! May Allah sacrifice me for your sake! Did you get hurt?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied,"No, but take care of the lady." Abu Talha covered his face with his garment and proceeded towards her and covered her with his garment, and she got up. He then set right the condition of their she-camel and both of them (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) and his wife) rode and proceeded till they approached Medina. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "We are returning with repentance and worshipping and praising our Lord." The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on saying this statement till he entered Medina
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، رضى الله عنهما قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ قَالَ لِي ‏ "‏ ادْخُلِ الْمَسْجِدَ فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhaaribi bni dithaarin, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, rda allh 'nhma qaala kuntu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy safarin falammaa qadimnaa almadiynaaa qaala liy ‏ "‏ adkhuli almasjida fasalli rak'atayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I was on a journey in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and when we reached Medina, he said to me, "Enter the Mosque and offer two rak`at
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، وَعَمِّهِ، عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ عَنْ كَعْبٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ ضُحًى دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdi alllahi bni ka'bin, 'an aabiyhi, wa'ammihi, 'ubaydi alllahi bni ka'bin 'an ka'bin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa qadima min safarin duhana dakhala almasjida, fasallaa rak'atayni qabla aan yajlisa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ka`b:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from a journey in the forenoon, he would enter the Mosque and offer two rak`at before sitting
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ نَحَرَ جَزُورًا أَوْ بَقَرَةً‏.‏ زَادَ مُعَاذ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ اشْتَرَى مِنى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعِيرًا بِوَقِيَّتَيْنِ وَدِرْهَمٍ أَوْ دِرْهَمَيْنِ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ صِرَارًا أَمَرَ بِبَقَرَةٍ فَذُبِحَتْ فَأَكَلُوا مِنْهَا، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ آتِيَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَأُصَلىَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَوَزَنَ لِي ثَمَنَ الْبَعِيرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadun, aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, 'an shu'baaa, 'an muhaaribi bni dithaarin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lammaa qadima almadiynaaa nahara jazuwrana aaw baqaraaan‏.‏ zaada mu'aadh 'an shu'baaa 'an muhaaribin sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi ashtaraa mina alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'iyrana biwaqiyyatayni wadirhamin aaw dirhamayni, falammaa qadima siraarana aamara bibaqaraain fadhubihat faaakaluwa minhaa, falammaa qadima almadiynaaa aamaraniy aan atiya almasjida faausalaa rak'atayni, wawazana liy thamana alba'iyri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muharib bin Dithar:Jabir bin `Abdullah said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived at Medina, he slaughtered a camel or a cow." Jabir added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) bought a camel from me for two Uqiyas (of gold) and one or two Dirhams. When he reached Sirar, he ordered that a cow be slaughtered and they ate its meat. When he arrived at Medina, he ordered me to go to the Mosque and offer two rak`at, and weighed (and gave) me the price of the camel
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 56 — Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَدِمْتُ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ صِرَارٌ مَوْضِعٌ نَاحِيَةً بِالْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhaaribi bni dithaarin, 'an jaabirin, qaala qadimtu min safarin faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ salli rak'atayni ‏"‏‏.‏ siraarun mawdi'un naahiyaaan bialmadiynaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:Once I returned from a journey and the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to me) "Offer two rak`at." (Sirar is a place near Medina)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ، أَنَّ حُسَيْنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ، عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا قَالَ كَانَتْ لِي شَارِفٌ مِنْ نَصِيبِي مِنَ الْمَغْنَمِ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْطَانِي شَارِفًا مِنَ الْخُمُسِ، فَلَمَّا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبْتَنِيَ بِفَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاعَدْتُ رَجُلاً صَوَّاغًا مِنْ بَنِي قَيْنُقَاعَ، أَنْ يَرْتَحِلَ مَعِيَ فَنَأْتِيَ بِإِذْخِرٍ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبِيعَهُ الصَّوَّاغِينَ، وَأَسْتَعِينَ بِهِ فِي وَلِيمَةِ عُرْسِي، فَبَيْنَا أَنَا أَجْمَعُ لِشَارِفَىَّ مَتَاعًا مِنَ الأَقْتَابِ وَالْغَرَائِرِ وَالْحِبَالِ، وَشَارِفَاىَ مُنَاخَانِ إِلَى جَنْبِ حُجْرَةِ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ، رَجَعْتُ حِينَ جَمَعْتُ مَا جَمَعْتُ، فَإِذَا شَارِفَاىَ قَدِ اجْتُبَّ أَسْنِمَتُهُمَا وَبُقِرَتْ خَوَاصِرُهُمَا، وَأُخِذَ مِنْ أَكْبَادِهِمَا، فَلَمْ أَمْلِكْ عَيْنَىَّ حِينَ رَأَيْتُ ذَلِكَ الْمَنْظَرَ مِنْهُمَا، فَقُلْتُ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا فَقَالُوا فَعَلَ حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، وَهْوَ فِي هَذَا الْبَيْتِ فِي شَرْبٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْتُ حَتَّى أَدْخُلَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدَهُ زَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ، فَعَرَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي وَجْهِي الَّذِي لَقِيتُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا لَكَ ‏"‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهَ، مَا رَأَيْتُ كَالْيَوْمِ قَطُّ، عَدَا حَمْزَةُ عَلَى نَاقَتَىَّ، فَأَجَبَّ أَسْنِمَتَهُمَا وَبَقَرَ خَوَاصِرَهُمَا، وَهَا هُوَ ذَا فِي بَيْتٍ مَعَهُ شَرْبٌ‏.‏ فَدَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرِدَائِهِ فَارْتَدَى ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ يَمْشِي، وَاتَّبَعْتُهُ أَنَا وَزَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ حَتَّى جَاءَ الْبَيْتَ الَّذِي فِيهِ حَمْزَةُ، فَاسْتَأْذَنَ فَأَذِنُوا لَهُمْ فَإِذَا هُمْ شَرْبٌ، فَطَفِقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَلُومُ حَمْزَةَ فِيمَا فَعَلَ، فَإِذَا حَمْزَةُ قَدْ ثَمِلَ مُحْمَرَّةً عَيْنَاهُ، فَنَظَرَ حَمْزَةُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى رُكْبَتِهِ، ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى سُرَّتِهِ، ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى وَجْهِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ حَمْزَةُ هَلْ أَنْتُمْ إِلاَّ عَبِيدٌ لأَبِي فَعَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَدْ ثَمِلَ، فَنَكَصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ الْقَهْقَرَى وَخَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'aliyyu bnu alhusayni, aanna husayna bna 'aliyyin, 'alayhimaa alssalaamu aakhbarahu aanna 'aliyyana qaala kaanat liy shaarifun min nasiybiy mina almaghnami yawma badrin, wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aa'taaniy shaarifana mina alkhumusi, falammaa aaradtu aan aabtaniya bifaatimaaa binti rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waa'adtu rajulaan sawwaaghana min baniy qaynuqaa'a, aan yartahila ma'iya fanaatiya biiidhkhirin aaradtu aan aabiy'ahu alssawwaaghiyna, waaasta'iyna bihi fiy waliymaai 'ursiy, fabaynaa aanaa aajma'u lishaarifaaaa mataa'ana mina alaaqtaabi waalgharaaiiri waalhibaali, washaarifaaaa munaakhaani iilaa janbi hujraai rajulin mina alaansaari, raja'tu hiyna jama'tu maa jama'tu, faiidhaa shaarifaaaa qadi ajtubba aasnimatuhumaa wabuqirat khawaasiruhumaa, waaukhidha min aakbaadihimaa, falam aamlik 'aynaaaa hiyna raaaytu dhalika almanzara minhumaa, faqultu man fa'ala hadhaa faqaaluwa fa'ala hamzaau bnu 'abdi almuttalibi, wahwa fiy hadhaa albayti fiy sharbin mina alaansaari‏.‏ faantalaqtu hattaa aadkhula 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'indahu zaydu bnu haarithaaa, fa'arafa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy wajhiy alladhiy laqiytu, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa laka ‏"‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla alllaha, maa raaaytu kaalyawmi qattu, 'adaa hamzaau 'alaa naaqataaaa, faaajabba aasnimatahumaa wabaqara khawaasirahumaa, wahaa huwa dhaa fiy baytin ma'ahu sharbun‏.‏ fada'aa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biridaaiihi faartadaa thumma antalaqa yamshiy, waattaba'tuhu aanaa wazaydu bnu haarithaaa hattaa jaa'a albayta alladhiy fiyhi hamzaau, faastaadhana faaadhinuwa lahum faiidhaa hum sharbun, fatafiqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaluwmu hamzaaa fiymaa fa'ala, faiidhaa hamzaau qad thamila muhmarraaan 'aynaahu, fanazara hamzaau iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, thumma sa''ada alnnazara fanazara iilaa rukbatihi, thumma sa''ada alnnazara fanazara iilaa surratihi, thumma sa''ada alnnazara fanazara iilaa wajhihi thumma qaala hamzaau hal aantum iilaaa 'abiydun laabiy fa'arafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qad thamila, fanakasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa 'aqibayhi alqahqaraa wakharajnaa ma'ahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:I got a she-camel in my share of the war booty on the day (of the battle) of Badr, and the Prophet (ﷺ) had given me a she-camel from the Khumus. When I intended to marry Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Apostle, I had an appointment with a goldsmith from the tribe of Bani Qainuqa' to go with me to bring Idhkhir (i.e. grass of pleasant smell) and sell it to the goldsmiths and spend its price on my wedding party. I was collecting for my she-camels equipment of saddles, sacks and ropes while my two shecamels were kneeling down beside the room of an Ansari man. I returned after collecting whatever I collected, to see the humps of my two she-camels cut off and their flanks cut open and some portion of their livers was taken out. When I saw that state of my two she-camels, I could not help weeping. I asked, "Who has done this?" The people replied, "Hamza bin `Abdul Muttalib who is staying with some Ansari drunks in this house." I went away till I reached the Prophet (ﷺ) and Zaid bin Haritha was with him. The Prophet (ﷺ) noticed on my face the effect of what I had suffered, so the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What is wrong with you?" I replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have never seen such a day as today. Hamza attacked my two she-camels, cut off their humps, and ripped open their flanks, and he is sitting there in a house in the company of some drunks." The Prophet (ﷺ) then asked for his covering sheet, put it on, and set out walking followed by me and Zaid bin Haritha till he came to the house where Hamza was. He asked permission to enter, and they allowed him, and they were drunk. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started rebuking Hamza for what he had done, but Hamza was drunk and his eyes were red. Hamza looked at Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and then he raised his eyes, looking at his knees, then he raised up his eyes looking at his umbilicus, and again he raised up his eyes looking at his face. Hamza then said, "Aren't you but the slaves of my father?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) realized that he was drunk, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) retreated, and we went out with him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ ابْنَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَأَلَتْ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَقْسِمَ لَهَا مِيرَاثَهَا، مَا تَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِمَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ نُورَثُ مَا تَرَكْنَا صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَغَضِبَتْ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَهَجَرَتْ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، فَلَمْ تَزَلْ مُهَاجِرَتَهُ حَتَّى تُوُفِّيَتْ وَعَاشَتْ بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِتَّةَ أَشْهُرٍ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَكَانَتْ فَاطِمَةُ تَسْأَلُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ نَصِيبَهَا مِمَّا تَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ خَيْبَرَ وَفَدَكٍ وَصَدَقَتِهِ بِالْمَدِينَةِ، فَأَبَى أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَلَيْهَا ذَلِكَ، وَقَالَ لَسْتُ تَارِكًا شَيْئًا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْمَلُ بِهِ إِلاَّ عَمِلْتُ بِهِ، فَإِنِّي أَخْشَى إِنْ تَرَكْتُ شَيْئًا مِنْ أَمْرِهِ أَنْ أَزِيغَ‏.‏ فَأَمَّا صَدَقَتُهُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَدَفَعَهَا عُمَرُ إِلَى عَلِيٍّ وَعَبَّاسٍ، فَأَمَّا خَيْبَرُ وَفَدَكٌ فَأَمْسَكَهَا عُمَرُ وَقَالَ هُمَا صَدَقَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَتَا لِحُقُوقِهِ الَّتِي تَعْرُوهُ وَنَوَائِبِهِ، وَأَمْرُهُمَا إِلَى مَنْ وَلِيَ الأَمْرَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَهُمَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ إِلَى الْيَوْمِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْد اللَّهِ اعْتَرَاكَ افْتَعَلْتَ مِنْ عَرَوْتُهُ فَأَصَبْتُهُ وَمِنْهُ يَعْرُوهُ وَاعْتَرَانِي
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi allaahi, hadaathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzuubayri, aanaa 'aaiishaaa aumaa almuuminiyna rda allh 'nha aakhbarathu aanaa faatimaaa 'alayhaa alsaalaamu abnaaa rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm saaalat aabaa bakrin alsiidiiyqa ba'da wafaaai rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yaqsima lahaa miyraathahaa, maa taraka rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mimaaa aafaa'a allaahu 'alayhi‏.‏ faqaala lahaa aabuw bakrin iinaa rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa nuwrathu maa taraknaa sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ faghadibat faatimaau bintu rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fahajarat aabaa bakrin, falam tazal muhaajiratahu hataaa tuwufiiyat wa'aashat ba'da rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sitaaaa aashhurin‏.‏ qaalat wakaanat faatimaau tasaalu aabaa bakrin nasiybahaa mimaaa taraka rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min khaybara wafadakin wasadaqatihi bialmadiynaai, faaabaa aabuw bakrin 'alayhaa dhalika, waqaala lastu taarikana shayiana kaana rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'malu bihi iilaaa 'amiltu bihi, faiiniiy aakhshaa iin taraktu shayiana min aamrihi aan aaziygha‏.‏ faaamaaa sadaqatuhu bialmadiynaai fadafa'ahaa 'umaru iilaa 'aliyinn wa'abaaasin, faaamaaa khaybaru wafadakun faaamsakahaa 'umaru waqaala humaa sadaqaau rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaanataa lihuquwqihi alaatiy ta'ruwhu wanawaaiibihi, waaamruhumaa iilaa man waliya alaamra‏.‏ qaala fahumaa 'alaa dhalika iilaa alyawmi‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abd allaahi a'taraaka afta'alta min 'arawtuhu faaasabtuhu waminhu ya'ruwhu waa'taraaniy
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(mother of the believers) After the death of Allah's Apostle Fatima the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked Abu Bakr As-Siddiq to give her, her share of inheritance from what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had left of the Fai (i.e. booty gained without fighting) which Allah had given him. Abu Bakr said to her, "Allah's Apostle said, 'Our property will not be inherited, whatever we (i.e. prophets) leave is Sadaqa (to be used for charity)." Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got angry and stopped speaking to Abu Bakr, and continued assuming that attitude till she died. Fatima remained alive for six months after the death of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She used to ask Abu Bakr for her share from the property of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which he left at Khaibar, and Fadak, and his property at Medina (devoted for charity). Abu Bakr refused to give her that property and said, "I will not leave anything Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do, because I am afraid that if I left something from the Prophet's tradition, then I would go astray." (Later on) `Umar gave the Prophet's property (of Sadaqa) at Medina to `Ali and `Abbas, but he withheld the properties of Khaibar and Fadak in his custody and said, "These two properties are the Sadaqa which Allah's Apostle used to use for his expenditures and urgent needs. Now their management is to be entrusted to the ruler." (Az-Zuhri said, "They have been managed in this way till today)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْفَرْوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ الْحَدَثَانِ،، وَكَانَ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ ذَكَرَ لِي ذِكْرًا مِنْ حَدِيثِهِ ذَلِكَ، فَانْطَلَقْتُ حَتَّى أَدْخُلَ عَلَى مَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ، فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ الْحَدِيثِ فَقَالَ مَالِكٌ بَيْنَا أَنَا جَالِسٌ فِي أَهْلِي حِينَ مَتَعَ النَّهَارُ، إِذَا رَسُولُ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ يَأْتِينِي فَقَالَ أَجِبْ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ حَتَّى أَدْخُلَ عَلَى عُمَرَ، فَإِذَا هُوَ جَالِسٌ عَلَى رِمَالِ سَرِيرٍ، لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُ فِرَاشٌ مُتَّكِئٌ عَلَى وِسَادَةٍ مِنْ أَدَمٍ، فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ جَلَسْتُ فَقَالَ يَا مَالِ، إِنَّهُ قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ قَوْمِكَ أَهْلُ أَبْيَاتٍ، وَقَدْ أَمَرْتُ فِيهِمْ بِرَضْخٍ فَاقْبِضْهُ فَاقْسِمْهُ بَيْنَهُمْ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، لَوْ أَمَرْتَ بِهِ غَيْرِي‏.‏ قَالَ اقْبِضْهُ أَيُّهَا الْمَرْءُ‏.‏ فَبَيْنَا أَنَا جَالِسٌ عِنْدَهُ أَتَاهُ حَاجِبُهُ يَرْفَا فَقَالَ هَلْ لَكَ فِي عُثْمَانَ وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ وَالزُّبَيْرِ وَسَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ يَسْتَأْذِنُونَ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ فَدَخَلُوا فَسَلَّمُوا وَجَلَسُوا، ثُمَّ جَلَسَ يَرْفَا يَسِيرًا ثُمَّ قَالَ هَلْ لَكَ فِي عَلِيٍّ وَعَبَّاسٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمَا، فَدَخَلاَ فَسَلَّمَا فَجَلَسَا، فَقَالَ عَبَّاسٌ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، اقْضِ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ هَذَا‏.‏ وَهُمَا يَخْتَصِمَانِ فِيمَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الرَّهْطُ عُثْمَانُ وَأَصْحَابُهُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، اقْضِ بَيْنَهُمَا وَأَرِحْ أَحَدَهُمَا مِنَ الآخَرِ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ تَيْدَكُمْ، أَنْشُدُكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي بِإِذْنِهِ تَقُومُ السَّمَاءُ وَالأَرْضُ، هَلْ تَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ نُورَثُ مَا تَرَكْنَا صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُرِيدُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَفْسَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ الرَّهْطُ قَدْ قَالَ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ عُمَرُ عَلَى عَلِيٍّ وَعَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكُمَا اللَّهَ، أَتَعْلَمَانِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ قَالَ ذَلِكَ قَالاَ قَدْ قَالَ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ فَإِنِّي أُحَدِّثُكُمْ عَنْ هَذَا الأَمْرِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ خَصَّ رَسُولَهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هَذَا الْفَىْءِ بِشَىْءٍ لَمْ يُعْطِهِ أَحَدًا غَيْرَهُ ـ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏وَمَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ مِنْهُمْ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏قَدِيرٌ‏}‏ ـ فَكَانَتْ هَذِهِ خَالِصَةً لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَاللَّهِ مَا احْتَازَهَا دُونَكُمْ، وَلاَ اسْتَأْثَرَ بِهَا عَلَيْكُمْ قَدْ أَعْطَاكُمُوهُ، وَبَثَّهَا فِيكُمْ حَتَّى بَقِيَ مِنْهَا هَذَا الْمَالُ، فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُنْفِقُ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ نَفَقَةَ سَنَتِهِمْ مِنْ هَذَا الْمَالِ، ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُ مَا بَقِيَ فَيَجْعَلُهُ مَجْعَلَ مَالِ اللَّهِ، فَعَمِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَلِكَ حَيَاتَهُ، أَنْشُدُكُمْ بِاللَّهِ هَلْ تَعْلَمُونَ ذَلِكَ قَالُوا نَعَمْ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِعَلِيٍّ وَعَبَّاسٍ أَنْشُدُكُمَا بِاللَّهِ هَلْ تَعْلَمَانِ ذَلِكَ قَالَ عُمَرُ ثُمَّ تَوَفَّى اللَّهُ نَبِيَّهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَنَا وَلِيُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَقَبَضَهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، فَعَمِلَ فِيهَا بِمَا عَمِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُ فِيهَا لَصَادِقٌ بَارٌّ رَاشِدٌ تَابِعٌ لِلْحَقِّ، ثُمَّ تَوَفَّى اللَّهُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، فَكُنْتُ أَنَا وَلِيَّ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، فَقَبَضْتُهَا سَنَتَيْنِ مِنْ إِمَارَتِي، أَعْمَلُ فِيهَا بِمَا عَمِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَا عَمِلَ فِيهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنِّي فِيهَا لَصَادِقٌ بَارٌّ رَاشِدٌ تَابِعٌ لِلْحَقِّ، ثُمَّ جِئْتُمَانِي تُكَلِّمَانِي وَكَلِمَتُكُمَا وَاحِدَةٌ، وَأَمْرُكُمَا وَاحِدٌ، جِئْتَنِي يَا عَبَّاسُ تَسْأَلُنِي نَصِيبَكَ مِنِ ابْنِ أَخِيكَ، وَجَاءَنِي هَذَا ـ يُرِيدُ عَلِيًّا ـ يُرِيدُ نَصِيبَ امْرَأَتِهِ مِنْ أَبِيهَا، فَقُلْتُ لَكُمَا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ نُورَثُ مَا تَرَكْنَا صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا بَدَا لِي أَنْ أَدْفَعَهُ إِلَيْكُمَا قُلْتُ إِنْ شِئْتُمَا دَفَعْتُهَا إِلَيْكُمَا عَلَى أَنَّ عَلَيْكُمَا عَهْدَ اللَّهِ وَمِيثَاقَهُ لَتَعْمَلاَنِ فِيهَا بِمَا عَمِلَ فِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَبِمَا عَمِلَ فِيهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَبِمَا عَمِلْتُ فِيهَا مُنْذُ وَلِيتُهَا، فَقُلْتُمَا ادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْنَا‏.‏ فَبِذَلِكَ دَفَعْتُهَا إِلَيْكُمَا، فَأَنْشُدُكُمْ بِاللَّهِ، هَلْ دَفَعْتُهَا إِلَيْهِمَا بِذَلِكَ قَالَ الرَّهْطُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَى عَلِيٍّ وَعَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكُمَا بِاللَّهِ هَلْ دَفَعْتُهَا إِلَيْكُمَا بِذَلِكَ قَالاَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَلْتَمِسَانِ مِنِّي قَضَاءً غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ فَوَاللَّهِ الَّذِي بِإِذْنِهِ تَقُومُ السَّمَاءُ وَالأَرْضُ، لاَ أَقْضِي فِيهَا قَضَاءً غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ، فَإِنْ عَجَزْتُمَا عَنْهَا فَادْفَعَاهَا إِلَىَّ، فَإِنِّي أَكْفِيكُمَاهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu muhammadin alfarwiyyu, haddathanaa maaliku bnu aanasin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an maaliki bni aawsi bni alhadathaani, , wakaana, muhammadu bnu jubayrin dhakara liy dhikrana min hadiythihi dhalika, faantalaqtu hattaa aadkhula 'alaa maaliki bni aawsin, fasaaaltuhu 'an dhalika alhadiythi faqaala maalikun baynaa aanaa jaalisun fiy aahliy hiyna mata'a alnnahaaru, iidhaa rasuwlu 'umara bni alkhattaabi yaatiyniy faqaala aajib aamiyra almuuminiyna‏.‏ faantalaqtu ma'ahu hattaa aadkhula 'alaa 'umara, faiidhaa huwa jaalisun 'alaa rimaali sariyrin, laysa baynahu wabaynahu firaashun muttakiiun 'alaa wisaadaain min aadamin, fasallamtu 'alayhi thumma jalastu faqaala yaa maali, iinnahu qadima 'alaynaa min qawmika aahlu aabyaatin, waqad aamartu fiyhim biradkhin faaqbidhu faaqsimhu baynahum‏.‏ faqultu yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna, law aamarta bihi ghayriy‏.‏ qaala aqbidhu aayyuhaa almar'u‏.‏ fabaynaa aanaa jaalisun 'indahu aataahu haajibuhu yarfaa faqaala hal laka fiy 'uthmaana wa'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin waalzzubayri wasa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin yastaadhinuwna qaala na'am‏.‏ faaadhina lahum fadakhaluwa fasallamuwa wajalasuwa, thumma jalasa yarfaa yasiyrana thumma qaala hal laka fiy 'aliyyin wa'abbaasin qaala na'am‏.‏ faaadhina lahumaa, fadakhalaa fasallamaa fajalasaa, faqaala 'abbaasun yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna, aqdi bayniy wabayna hadhaa‏.‏ wahumaa yakhtasimaani fiymaa aafaa'a alllahu 'alaa rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm min baniy alnnadiyri‏.‏ faqaala alrrahtu 'uthmaanu waaashaabuhu yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna, aqdi baynahumaa waaarih aahadahumaa mina alakhari‏.‏ qaala 'umaru taydakum, aanshudukum bialllahi alladhiy biiidhnihi taquwmu alssamaa'u waalaardu, hal ta'lamuwna aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa nuwrathu maa taraknaa sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ yuriydu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nafsahu‏.‏ qaala alrrahtu qad qaala dhalika‏.‏ faaaqbala 'umaru 'alaa 'aliyyin wa'abbaasin faqaala aanshudukumaa alllaha, aata'lamaani aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad qaala dhalika qaalaa qad qaala dhalika‏.‏ qaala 'umaru faiinniy auhaddithukum 'an hadhaa alaamri, iinna alllaha qad khassa rasuwlahu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hadhaa alfaa'i bishaa'in lam yu'tihi aahadana ghayrahu thumma qaraaa ‏{‏wamaa aafaa'a alllahu 'alaa rasuwlihi minhum‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏qadiyrun‏}‏ fakaanat hadhihi khaalisaaan lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waalllahi maa ahtaazahaa duwnakum, walaa astaathara bihaa 'alaykum qad aa'taakumuwhu, wabathhahaa fiykum hattaa baqiya minhaa hadhaa almaalu, fakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yunfiqu 'alaa aahlihi nafaqaaa sanatihim min hadhaa almaali, thumma yaakhudhu maa baqiya fayaj'aluhu maj'ala maali alllahi, fa'amila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bidhalika hayaatahu, aanshudukum bialllahi hal ta'lamuwna dhalika qaaluwa na'am‏.‏ thumma qaala li'aliyyin wa'abbaasin aanshudukumaa bialllahi hal ta'lamaani dhalika qaala 'umaru thumma tawaffaa alllahu nabiyyahu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aabuw bakrin aanaa waliyyu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faqabadahaa aabuw bakrin, fa'amila fiyhaa bimaa 'amila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, waalllahu ya'lamu iinnahu fiyhaa lasaadiqun baarrun raashidun taabi'un lilhaqqi, thumma tawaffaa alllahu aabaa bakrin, fakuntu aanaa waliyya aabiy bakrin, faqabadtuhaa sanatayni min iimaaratiy, aa'malu fiyhaa bimaa 'amila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wamaa 'amila fiyhaa aabuw bakrin, waalllahu ya'lamu iinniy fiyhaa lasaadiqun baarrun raashidun taabi'un lilhaqqi, thumma jiitumaaniy tukallimaaniy wakalimatukumaa waahidaaun, waaamrukumaa waahidun, jiitaniy yaa 'abbaasu tasaaluniy nasiybaka mini abni aakhiyka, wajaa'aniy hadhaa yuriydu 'aliyyana yuriydu nasiyba amraaatihi min aabiyhaa, faqultu lakumaa iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa nuwrathu maa taraknaa sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa badaa liy aan aadfa'ahu iilaykumaa qultu iin shiitumaa dafa'tuhaa iilaykumaa 'alaa aanna 'alaykumaa 'ahda alllahi wamiythaaqahu lata'malaani fiyhaa bimaa 'amila fiyhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, wabimaa 'amila fiyhaa aabuw bakrin, wabimaa 'amiltu fiyhaa mundhu waliytuhaa, faqultumaa adfa'haa iilaynaa‏.‏ fabidhalika dafa'tuhaa iilaykumaa, faaanshudukum bialllahi, hal dafa'tuhaa iilayhimaa bidhalika qaala alrrahtu na'am‏.‏ thumma aaqbala 'alaa 'aliyyin wa'abbaasin faqaala aanshudukumaa bialllahi hal dafa'tuhaa iilaykumaa bidhalika qaalaa na'am‏.‏ qaala fataltamisaani minniy qadaa'an ghayra dhalika fawaalllahi alladhiy biiidhnihi taquwmu alssamaa'u waalaardu, laa aaqdiy fiyhaa qadaa'an ghayra dhalika, faiin 'ajaztumaa 'anhaa faadfa'aahaa iilaaaa, faiinniy aakfiykumaahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Malik bin Aus:While I was at home, the sun rose high and it got hot. Suddenly the messenger of `Umar bin Al-Khattab came to me and said, "The chief of the believers has sent for you." So, I went along with him till I entered the place where `Umar was sitting on a bedstead made of date-palm leaves and covered with no mattress, and he was leaning over a leather pillow. I greeted him and sat down. He said, "O Mali! Some persons of your people who have families came to me and I have ordered that a gift should be given to them, so take it and distribute it among them." I said, "O chief of the believers! I wish that you order someone else to do it." He said, "O man! Take it." While I was sitting there with him, his doorman Yarfa' came saying, "`Uthman, `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf, Az-Zubair and Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas are asking your permission (to see you); may I admit them?" `Umar said, "Yes", So they were admitted and they came in, greeted him, and sat down. After a while Yarfa' came again and said, "May I admit `Ali and `Abbas?" `Umar said, "yes." So, they were admitted and they came in and greeted (him) and sat down. Then `Abbas said, "O chief of the believers! Judge between me and this (i.e. `Ali)." They had a dispute regarding the property of Bani An-Nadir which Allah had given to His Apostle as Fai. The group (i.e. `Uthman and his companions) said, "O chief of the believers! Judge between them and relieve both of them from each other." `Umar said, "Be patient! I beseech you by Allah by Whose Permission the Heaven and the Earth exist, do you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Our (i.e. prophets') property will not be inherited, and whatever we leave, is Sadaqa (to be used for charity),' and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) meant himself (by saying "we'')?" The group said, "He said so." `Umar then turned to `Ali and `Abbas and said, "I beseech you by Allah, do you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said so?" They replied, " He said so." `Umar then said, "So, I will talk to you about this matter. Allah bestowed on His Apostle with a special favor of something of this Fai (booty) which he gave to nobody else." `Umar then recited the Holy Verses: "What Allah bestowed as (Fai) Booty on his Apostle (Muhammad) from them --- for this you made no expedition with either cavalry or camelry: But Allah gives power to His Apostles over whomever He will 'And Allah is able to do all things." 9:6) `Umar added "So this property was especially given to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), but, by Allah, neither did he take possession of it and leave you, nor did he favor himself with it to your exclusion, but he gave it to all of you and distributed it amongst you till this property remained out of it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to spend the yearly expenses of his family out of this property and used to keep the rest of its revenue to be spent on Allah's Cause. Allah's Apostle kept on doing this during all his lifetime. I ask you by Allah do you know this?" They replied in the affirmative. `Umar then said to `Ali and `Abbas. "I ask you by Allah, do you know this?" `Umar added, "When Allah had taken His Prophet unto Him, 'Abu Bakr said, 'I am the successor of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so, Abu Bakr took over that property and managed it in the same way as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do, and Allah knows that he was true, pious and rightly-guided, and he was a follower of what was right. Then Allah took Abu Bakr unto Him and I became Abu Bakr's successor, and I kept that property in my possession for the first two years of my Caliphate, managing it in the same way as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do and as Abu Bakr used to do, and Allah knows that I have been true, pious, rightly guided, and a follower of what is right. Now you both (i.e. 'Ali and `Abbas) came to talk to me, bearing the same claim and presenting the same case; you, `Abbas, came to me asking for your share from your nephew's property, and this man, i.e. `Ali, came to me asking for his wife's share from her father's property. I told you both that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Our (prophets') properties are not to be inherited, but what we leave is Sadaqa (to be used for charity).' When I thought it right that I should hand over this property to you, I said to you, 'I am ready to hand over this property to you if you wish, on the condition that you would take Allah's Pledge and Covenant that you would manage it in the same way as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to, and as Abu Bakr used to do, and as I have done since I was in charge of it.' So, both of you said (to me), 'Hand it over to us,' and on that condition I handed it over to you. So, I ask you by Allah, did I hand it over to them on this condition?" The group said, "Yes." Then `Umar faced `Ali and `Abbas saying, "I ask you by Allah, did I hand it over to you on this condition?" They said, "Yes. " He said, " Do you want now to give a different decision? By Allah, by Whose Leave both the Heaven and the Earth exist, I will never give any decision other than that (I have already given). And if you are unable to manage it, then return it to me, and I will do the job on your behalf
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ الضُّبَعِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ قَدِمَ وَفْدُ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا هَذَا الْحَىَّ مِنْ رَبِيعَةَ، بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ كُفَّارُ مُضَرَ، فَلَسْنَا نَصِلُ إِلَيْكَ إِلاَّ فِي الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ، فَمُرْنَا بِأَمْرٍ نَأْخُذُ مِنْهُ وَنَدْعُو إِلَيْهِ مَنْ وَرَاءَنَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ آمُرُكُمْ بِأَرْبَعٍ، وَأَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْ أَرْبَعٍ، الإِيمَانِ بِاللَّهِ شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ـ وَعَقَدَ بِيَدِهِ ـ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلاَةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ وَصِيَامِ رَمَضَانَ، وَأَنْ تُؤَدُّوا لِلَّهِ خُمُسَ مَا غَنِمْتُمْ، وَأَنْهَاكُمْ عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالنَّقِيرِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aabiy hamzaaa aldduba'iyyi, qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu qadima wafdu 'abdi alqaysi faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi, iinnaa hadhaa alhaaaa min rabiy'aaa, baynanaa wabaynaka kuffaaru mudara, falasnaa nasilu iilayka iilaaa fiy alshhahri alharaami, famurnaa biaamrin naakhudhu minhu wanad'uw iilayhi man waraa'anaa‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ amurukum biaarba'in, waaanhaakum 'an aarba'in, aliiymaani bialllahi shahaadaai aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wa'aqada biyadihi waiiqaami alssalaaai waiiytaa'i alzzakaaai wasiyaami ramadaana, waaan tuuadduwa lillahi khumusa maa ghanimtum, waaanhaakum 'ani alddubbaa'i waalnnaqiyri waalhantami waalmuzaffati ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The delegates of the tribe of `Abdul-Qais came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are from the tribe of Rabi`a, and there is the infidels of the tribe of Mudar intervening between you and us, so we cannot come to you except in the Sacred Months. So please order us some instructions that we may apply it to ourselves and also invite our people whom we left behind us to observe as well." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I order you (to do) four (things) and forbid you (to do) four: I order you to believe in Allah, that is, to testify that None has the right to be worshipped but Allah (the Prophet (ﷺ) pointed with his hand); to offer prayers perfectly; to pay Zakat; to fast the month of Ramadan, and to pay the Khumus (i.e. one-fifth) of the war booty to Allah and I forbid you to use Ad-dubba', An-Naqir, Al-Hantam and Al-Muzaffat (i.e. utensils used for preparing alcoholic drinks)." (See Hadith No. 50, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَقْتَسِمُ وَرَثَتِي دِينَارًا، مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدَ نَفَقَةِ نِسَائِي وَمَئُونَةِ عَامِلِي فَهْوَ صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yaqtasimu warathatiy diynaarana, maa taraktu ba'da nafaqaai nisaaiiy wamaiuwnaai 'aamiliy fahwa sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "My heirs should not take even a single Dinar (i.e. anything from my property), and whatever I leave, excluding the expenditure of my wives and my laborers, will be Sadaqa (i.e. be used for charity)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَا فِي بَيْتِي مِنْ شَىْءٍ يَأْكُلُهُ ذُو كَبِدٍ، إِلاَّ شَطْرُ شَعِيرٍ فِي رَفٍّ لِي، فَأَكَلْتُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى طَالَ عَلَىَّ، فَكِلْتُهُ فَفَنِيَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat tuwuffiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wamaa fiy baytiy min shaa'in yaakuluhu dhuw kabidin, iilaaa shatru sha'iyrin fiy raffin liy, faaakaltu minhu hattaa taala 'alaaaa, fakiltuhu fafaniya‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, and there was nothing in my house that a living being could eat, except some barley Lying on a shelf. So, I ate of it for a long period and measured it, and (after a short period) it was consumed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ مَا تَرَكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ سِلاَحَهُ وَبَغْلَتَهُ الْبَيْضَاءَ، وَأَرْضًا تَرَكَهَا صَدَقَةً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, qaala haddathaniy aabuw iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu 'amraw bna alhaarithi, qaala maa taraka alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa silaahahu wabaghlatahu albaydaa'a, waaardana tarakahaa sadaqaaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr bin Al-Harith:The Prophet (ﷺ) did not leave anything (after his death) except his arms, a white mule, and a (piece of) land which he had given as Sadaqa
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ بْنُ مُوسَى، وَمُحَمَّدٌ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، وَيُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ لَمَّا ثَقُلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَأْذَنَ أَزْوَاجَهُ أَنْ يُمَرَّضَ فِي بَيْتِي فَأَذِنَّ لَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hibbaanu bnu muwsaa, wamuhammadun, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, wayuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat lammaa thaqula rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm astaadhana aazwaajahu aan yumarrada fiy baytiy faaadhinna lahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) When the sickness of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got aggravated, he asked the permission of his wives that he should be treated in my house, and they permitted him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعٌ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ ـ رضى الله عنها تُوُفِّيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِي، وَفِي نَوْبَتِي، وَبَيْنَ سَحْرِي وَنَحْرِي، وَجَمَعَ اللَّهُ بَيْنَ رِيقِي وَرِيقِهِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بِسِوَاكٍ، فَضَعُفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْهُ، فَأَخَذْتُهُ فَمَضَغْتُهُ ثُمَّ سَنَنْتُهُ بِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy maryama, haddathanaa naafi'un, sami'tu abna aabiy mulaykaaa, qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau rda allh 'nha tuwuffiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy baytiy, wafiy nawbatiy, wabayna sahriy wanahriy, wajama'a alllahu bayna riyqiy wariyqihi‏.‏ qaalat dakhala 'abdu alrrahmani bisiwaakin, fada'ufa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'anhu, faaakhadhtuhu famadaghtuhu thumma sanantuhu bihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Abu Mulaika:`Aisha said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) died in my house on the day of my turn while he was leaning on my chest closer to my neck, and Allah made my saliva mix with his Saliva." `Aisha added, "`AbdurRahman came with a Siwak and the Prophet (ﷺ) was too weak to use it so I took it, chewed it and then (gave it to him and he) cleaned his teeth with it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، أَنَّ صَفِيَّةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا جَاءَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَزُورُهُ، وَهْوَ مُعْتَكِفٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ قَامَتْ تَنْقَلِبُ فَقَامَ مَعَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَ قَرِيبًا مِنْ باب الْمَسْجِدِ عِنْدَ باب أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ بِهِمَا رَجُلاَنِ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ، فَسَلَّمَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ نَفَذَا فَقَالَ لَهُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عَلَى رِسْلِكُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالاَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ وَكَبُرَ عَلَيْهِمَا ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَبْلُغُ مِنَ الإِنْسَانِ مَبْلَغَ الدَّمِ، وَإِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَنْ يَقْذِفَ فِي قُلُوبِكُمَا شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ufayrin, qaala haddathaniy alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu khaalidin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'aliyyi bni husaynin, aanna safiyyaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathu aannahaa jaa'at rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tazuwruhu, wahwa mu'takifun fiy almasjidi fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri min ramadaana thumma qaamat tanqalibu faqaama ma'ahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa iidhaa balagha qariybana min bab almasjidi 'inda bab aummi salamaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm marra bihimaa rajulaani mina alaansaari, fasallamaa 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, thumma nafadhaa faqaala lahumaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ 'alaa rislikumaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalaa subhaana alllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ wakabura 'alayhimaa dhalika‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinna alshhaytaana yablughu mina aliinsaani mablagha alddami, waiinniy khashiytu aan yaqdhifa fiy quluwbikumaa shayiana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Safiya:(the wife of the Prophet) That she came to visit Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was in I`tikaf (i.e. seclusion in the Mosque during the last ten days of Ramadan). When she got up to return, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up with her and accompanied her, and when he reached near the gate of the Mosque close to the door (of the house) of Um Salama, the wife of the Prophet, two Ansari men passed by them and greeted Allah's Apostle and then went away. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed them saying, "Don't hurry! (She is my wife)," They said, "Glorified be Allah! O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (You are far away from any suspicion)," and his saying was hard on them. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Satan circulates in the mind of a person as blood does (in his body). I was afraid that Satan might put some (evil) thoughts in your minds
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ وَاسِعِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ ارْتَقَيْتُ فَوْقَ بَيْتِ حَفْصَةَ، فَرَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْضِي حَاجَتَهُ، مُسْتَدْبِرَ الْقِبْلَةِ، مُسْتَقْبِلَ الشَّأْمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa aanasu bnu 'iyaadin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an muhammadi bni yahyaa bni habbaana, 'an waasi'i bni habbaana, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala artaqaytu fawqa bayti hafsaaa, faraaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqdiy haajatahu, mustadbira alqiblaai, mustaqbila alshhaami‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Once I went upstairs in Hafsa's house and saw the Prophet (ﷺ) answering the call of nature with his back towards the Qibla and facing Sham
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ وَالشَّمْسُ لَمْ تَخْرُجْ مِنْ حُجْرَتِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa aanasu bnu 'iyaadin, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy al'asra waalshhamsu lam takhruj min hujratihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the `Asr prayer while the sun was still shining in her Hujra (i.e. her dwelling place)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطِيبًا فَأَشَارَ نَحْوَ مَسْكَنِ عَائِشَةَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هُنَا الْفِتْنَةُ ـ ثَلاَثًا ـ مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنُ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala qaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khatiybana faaashaara nahwa maskani 'aaiishaaa faqaala ‏ "‏ hunaa alfitnaau thalaathana min haythu yatlu'u qarnu alshhaytaani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up and delivered a sermon, and pointing to `Aisha's house (i.e. eastwards), he said thrice, "Affliction (will appear from) here," and, "from where the side of the Satan's head comes out (i.e. from the East)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ ابْنَةِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ عِنْدَهَا، وَأَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ صَوْتَ إِنْسَانٍ يَسْتَأْذِنُ فِي بَيْتِ حَفْصَةَ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَذَا رَجُلٌ يَسْتَأْذِنُ فِي بَيْتِكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أُرَاهُ فُلاَنًا، لِعَمِّ حَفْصَةَ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ، الرَّضَاعَةُ تُحَرِّمُ مَا تُحَرِّمُ الْوِلاَدَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an 'amraaa abnaai 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana 'indahaa, waaannahaa sami'at sawta iinsaanin yastaadhinu fiy bayti hafsaaa faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, hadhaa rajulun yastaadhinu fiy baytika‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ auraahu fulaanana, li'ammi hafsaaa mina alrradaa'aai, alrradaa'aau tuharrimu maa tuharrimu alwilaadaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amra bint `Abdur-Rahman:`Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) told her that once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was with her and she heard somebody asking permission to enter Hafsa's house. She said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This man is asking permission to enter your house." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "I think he is so-and-so (meaning the foster uncle of Hafsa). What is rendered illegal because of blood relations, is also rendered illegal because of the corresponding foster-relations
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ لَمَّا اسْتُخْلِفَ بَعَثَهُ إِلَى الْبَحْرَيْنِ، وَكَتَبَ لَهُ هَذَا الْكِتَابَ وَخَتَمَهُ، وَكَانَ نَقْشُ الْخَاتَمِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَسْطُرٍ مُحَمَّدٌ سَطْرٌ، وَرَسُولُ سَطْرٌ، وَاللَّهِ سَطْرٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyu, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an thumaamaaa, 'an aanasin, aanna aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nh lammaa astukhlifa ba'athahu iilaa albahrayni, wakataba lahu hadhaa alkitaaba wakhatamahu, wakaana naqshu alkhaatami thalaathaaa aasturin muhammadun satrun, warasuwlu satrun, waalllahi satrun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:That when Abu Bakr became the Caliph, he sent him to Bahrain and wrote this letter for him, and stamped it with the Ring of the Prophet. Three lines were engraved on the Ring, (the word) 'Muhammad' was in a line, 'Apostle' was in another line, and 'Allah' in a third
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَسَدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ طَهْمَانَ، قَالَ أَخْرَجَ إِلَيْنَا أَنَسٌ نَعْلَيْنِ جَرْدَاوَيْنِ لَهُمَا قِبَالاَنِ، فَحَدَّثَنِي ثَابِتٌ الْبُنَانِيُّ بَعْدُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ أَنَّهُمَا نَعْلاَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alaasadiyyu, haddathanaa 'iysaa bnu tahmaana, qaala aakhraja iilaynaa aanasun na'layni jardaawayni lahumaa qibaalaani, fahaddathaniy thaabitun albunaaniyyu ba'du 'an aanasin aannahumaa na'laa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Isa bin Tahman:Anas brought out to us two worn out leather shoes without hair and with pieces of leather straps. Later on Thabit Al-Bunani told me that Anas said that they were the shoes of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، قَالَ أَخْرَجَتْ إِلَيْنَا عَائِشَةُ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ كِسَاءً مُلَبَّدًا وَقَالَتْ فِي هَذَا نُزِعَ رُوحُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَزَادَ سُلَيْمَانُ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ قَالَ أَخْرَجَتْ إِلَيْنَا عَائِشَةُ إِزَارًا غَلِيظًا مِمَّا يُصْنَعُ بِالْيَمَنِ، وَكِسَاءً مِنْ هَذِهِ الَّتِي يَدْعُونَهَا الْمُلَبَّدَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an humaydi bni hilaalin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, qaala aakhrajat iilaynaa 'aaiishaau rda allh 'nha kisaa'an mulabbadana waqaalat fiy hadhaa nuzi'a ruwhu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ wazaada sulaymaanu 'an humaydin 'an aabiy burdaaa qaala aakhrajat iilaynaa 'aaiishaau iizaarana ghaliyzana mimmaa yusna'u bialyamani, wakisaa'an min hadhihi allatiy yad'uwnahaa almulabbadaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda:`Aisha brought out to us a patched woollen garment, and she said, "(It chanced that) the soul of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was taken away while he was wearing this." Abu-Burda added, "Aisha brought out to us a thick waist sheet like the ones made by the Yemenites, and also a garment of the type called Al-Mulabbada
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ قَدَحَ، النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم انْكَسَرَ، فَاتَّخَذَ مَكَانَ الشَّعْبِ سِلْسِلَةً مِنْ فِضَّةٍ‏.‏ قَالَ عَاصِمٌ رَأَيْتُ الْقَدَحَ وَشَرِبْتُ فِيهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, 'an aabiy hamzaaa, 'an 'aasimin, 'ani abni siyriyna, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna qadaha, alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ankasara, faattakhadha makaana alshha'bi silsilaaan min fiddaain‏.‏ qaala 'aasimun raaaytu alqadaha washaribtu fiyhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When the cup of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got broken, he fixed it with a silver wire at the crack. (The subnarrator, `Asim said, "I saw the cup and drank (water) in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
