verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْجَرْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي أَنَّ الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَلْحَلَةَ الدُّؤَلِيِّ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ حُسَيْنٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُمْ، حِينَ قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ مِنْ عِنْدِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ مَقْتَلَ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ لَقِيَهُ الْمِسْوَرُ بْنُ مَخْرَمَةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ هَلْ لَكَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ تَأْمُرُنِي بِهَا فَقُلْتُ لَهُ لاَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ فَهَلْ أَنْتَ مُعْطِيَّ سَيْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يَغْلِبَكَ الْقَوْمُ عَلَيْهِ، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ، لَئِنْ أَعْطَيْتَنِيهِ لاَ يُخْلَصُ إِلَيْهِمْ أَبَدًا حَتَّى تُبْلَغَ نَفْسِي، إِنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ خَطَبَ ابْنَةَ أَبِي جَهْلٍ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ فَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ النَّاسَ فِي ذَلِكَ عَلَى مِنْبَرِهِ هَذَا وَأَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ مُحْتَلِمٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فَاطِمَةَ مِنِّي، وَأَنَا أَتَخَوَّفُ أَنْ تُفْتَنَ فِي دِينِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ صِهْرًا لَهُ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ شَمْسٍ، فَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ فِي مُصَاهَرَتِهِ إِيَّاهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَدَّثَنِي فَصَدَقَنِي، وَوَعَدَنِي فَوَفَى لِي، وَإِنِّي لَسْتُ أُحَرِّمُ حَلاَلاً وَلاَ أُحِلُّ حَرَامًا، وَلَكِنْ وَاللَّهِ لاَ تَجْتَمِعُ بِنْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِنْتُ عَدُوِّ اللَّهِ أَبَدًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu muhammadin aljarmiyyu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabiy aanna alwaliyda bna kathiyrin, haddathahu 'an muhammadi bni 'amriw bni halhalaaa aldduualiyyi, haddathahu aanna abna shihaabin haddathahu aanna 'aliyya bna husaynin haddathahu aannahum, hiyna qadimuwa almadiynaaa min 'indi yaziyda bni mu'aawiyaaa maqtala husayni bni 'aliyyin rahmaau alllahi 'alayhi laqiyahu almiswaru bnu makhramaaa faqaala lahu hal laka iilaaaa min haajaain taamuruniy bihaa faqultu lahu laa‏.‏ faqaala lahu fahal aanta mu'tiyya sayfa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faiinniy aakhaafu aan yaghlibaka alqawmu 'alayhi, waaymu alllahi, laiin aa'taytaniyhi laa yukhlasu iilayhim aabadana hattaa tublagha nafsiy, iinna 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin khataba abnaaa aabiy jahlin 'alaa faatimaaa 'alayhaa alssalaamu fasami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu alnnaasa fiy dhalika 'alaa minbarihi hadhaa waaanaa yawmaiidhin muhtalimun faqaala ‏"‏ iinna faatimaaa minniy, waaanaa aatakhawwafu aan tuftana fiy diynihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma dhakara sihrana lahu min baniy 'abdi shamsin, faaathnaa 'alayhi fiy musaaharatihi iiyyaahu qaala ‏"‏ haddathaniy fasadaqaniy, wawa'adaniy fawafaa liy, waiinniy lastu auharrimu halaalaan walaa auhillu haraamana, walakin waalllahi laa tajtami'u bintu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wabintu 'aduwwi alllahi aabadana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali bin Al-Husain:That when they reached Medina after returning from Yazid bin Mu'awiya after the martyrdom of Husain bin `Ali (may Allah bestow His Mercy upon him), Al-Miswar bin Makhrama met him and said to him, "Do you have any need you may order me to satisfy?" `Ali said, "No." Al-Miswar said, Will you give me the sword of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for I am afraid that people may take it from you by force? By Allah, if you give it to me, they will never be able to take it till I die." When `Ali bin Abu Talib demanded the hand of the daughter of Abi Jahal to be his wife besides Fatima, I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on his pulpit delivering a sermon in this connection before the people, and I had then attained my age of puberty. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Fatima is from me, and I am afraid she will be subjected to trials in her religion (because of jealousy)." The Prophet (ﷺ) then mentioned one of his son-in-law who was from the tribe of 'Abdi Shams, and he praised him as a good son-in-law, saying, "Whatever he said was the truth, and he promised me and fulfilled his promise. I do not make a legal thing illegal, nor do I make an illegal thing legal, but by Allah, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the daughter of the enemy of Allah, (i.e. Abu Jahl) can never get together (as the wives of one man) (See Hadith No. 76, Vo)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ، عَنْ مُنْذِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ، قَالَ لَوْ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ ذَاكِرًا عُثْمَانَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ ذَكَرَهُ يَوْمَ جَاءَهُ نَاسٌ فَشَكَوْا سُعَاةَ عُثْمَانَ، فَقَالَ لِي عَلِيٌّ اذْهَبْ إِلَى عُثْمَانَ فَأَخْبِرْهُ أَنَّهَا صَدَقَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَمُرْ سُعَاتَكَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِيهَا‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِهَا فَقَالَ أَغْنِهَا عَنَّا‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُ بِهَا عَلِيًّا فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ ضَعْهَا حَيْثُ أَخَذْتَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an muhammadi bni suwqaaa, 'an mundhirin, 'ani abni alhanafiyyaai, qaala law kaana 'aliyyun rda allh 'nh dhaakirana 'uthmaana rda allh 'nh dhakarahu yawma jaa'ahu naasun fashakawa su'aaaa 'uthmaana, faqaala liy 'aliyyun adhhab iilaa 'uthmaana faaakhbirhu aannahaa sadaqaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, famur su'aataka ya'maluwna fiyhaa‏.‏ faaataytuhu bihaa faqaala aaghnihaa 'annaa‏.‏ faaataytu bihaa 'aliyyana faaakhbartuhu faqaala da'haa haythu aakhadhtahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Al-Hanafiya:If `Ali had spoken anything bad about `Uthman then he would have mentioned the day when some persons came to him and complained about the Zakat officials of `Uthman. `Ali then said to me, "Go to `Uthman and say to him, 'This document contains the regulations of spending the Sadaqa of Allah's Apostle so order your Zakat officials to act accordingly." I took the document to `Uthman. `Uthman said, "Take it away, for we are not in need of it." I returned to `Ali with it and informed him of that. He said, "Put it whence you took it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: قَالَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سُوقَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُنْذِرًا الثَّوْرِيَّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ، قَالَ أَرْسَلَنِي أَبِي، خُذْ هَذَا الْكِتَابَ فَاذْهَبْ بِهِ إِلَى عُثْمَانَ، فَإِنَّ فِيهِ أَمْرَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الصَّدَقَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala alhumaydiyyu haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu suwqaaa, qaala sami'tu mundhirana althhawriyya, 'ani abni alhanafiyyaai, qaala aarsalaniy aabiy, khudh hadhaa alkitaaba faadhhab bihi iilaa 'uthmaana, faiinna fiyhi aamra alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alssadaqaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad bin Suqa:I heard Mundhir at-Tawri reporting Ibn Hanafiya who said, "My father sent me saying, 'Take this letter to `Uthman for it contains the orders of the Prophet (ﷺ) concerning the Sadaqa
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا بَدَلُ بْنُ الْمُحَبَّرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَكَمُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ اشْتَكَتْ مَا تَلْقَى مِنَ الرَّحَى مِمَّا تَطْحَنُ، فَبَلَغَهَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِسَبْىٍ، فَأَتَتْهُ تَسْأَلُهُ خَادِمًا فَلَمْ تُوَافِقْهُ، فَذَكَرَتْ لِعَائِشَةَ، فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ عَائِشَةُ لَهُ، فَأَتَانَا وَقَدْ دَخَلْنَا مَضَاجِعَنَا، فَذَهَبْنَا لِنَقُومَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَلَى مَكَانِكُمَا ‏"‏ حَتَّى وَجَدْتُ بَرْدَ قَدَمَيْهِ عَلَى صَدْرِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكُمَا عَلَى خَيْرٍ مِمَّا سَأَلْتُمَاهُ، إِذَا أَخَذْتُمَا مَضَاجِعَكُمَا فَكَبِّرَا اللَّهَ أَرْبَعًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَاحْمَدَا ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَسَبِّحَا ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمَا مِمَّا سَأَلْتُمَاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa badalu bnu almuhabbari, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy alhakamu, qaala sami'tu abna aabiy laylaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyun, aanna faatimaaa 'alayhaa alssalaamu ashtakat maa talqaa mina alrrahaa mimmaa tathanu, fabalaghahaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm autiya bisabain, faaatathu tasaaluhu khaadimana falam tuwaafiqhu, fadhakarat li'aaiishaaa, fajaa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakarat dhalika 'aaiishaau lahu, faaataanaa waqad dakhalnaa madaaji'anaa, fadhahabnaa linaquwma faqaala ‏"‏ 'alaa makaanikumaa ‏"‏ hattaa wajadtu barda qadamayhi 'alaa sadriy faqaala ‏"‏ aalaa aadullukumaa 'alaa khayrin mimmaa saaaltumaahu, iidhaa aakhadhtumaa madaaji'akumaa fakabbiraa alllaha aarba'ana wathalaathiyna, waahmadaa thalaathana wathalaathiyna, wasabbihaa thalaathana wathalaathiyna, faiinna dhalika khayrun lakumaa mimmaa saaaltumaahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:Fatima complained of what she suffered from the hand mill and from grinding, when she got the news that some slave girls of the booty had been brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She went to him to ask for a maid-servant, but she could not find him, and told `Aisha of her need. When the Prophet (ﷺ) came, Aisha informed him of that. The Prophet (ﷺ) came to our house when we had gone to our beds. (On seeing the Prophet) we were going to get up, but he said, 'Keep at your places,' I felt the coolness of the Prophet's feet on my chest. Then he said, "Shall I tell you a thing which is better than what you asked me for? When you go to your beds, say: 'Allahu Akbar (i.e. Allah is Greater)' for 34 times, and 'Al hamdu Li llah (i.e. all the praises are for Allah)' for 33 times, and Subhan Allah (i.e. Glorified be Allah) for 33 times. This is better for you than what you have requested
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَمَنْصُورٍ، وَقَتَادَةَ، سَمِعُوا سَالِمَ بْنَ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ وُلِدَ لِرَجُلٍ مِنَّا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ غُلاَمٌ، فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يُسَمِّيَهُ مُحَمَّدًا ـ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ فِي حَدِيثِ مَنْصُورٍ إِنَّ الأَنْصَارِيَّ قَالَ حَمَلْتُهُ عَلَى عُنُقِي فَأَتَيْتُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سُلَيْمَانَ وُلِدَ لَهُ غُلاَمٌ، فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يُسَمِّيَهُ مُحَمَّدًا ـ قَالَ ‏"‏ سَمُّوا بِاسْمِي، وَلاَ تَكَنَّوْا بِكُنْيَتِي، فَإِنِّي إِنَّمَا جُعِلْتُ قَاسِمًا أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ حُصَيْنٌ ‏"‏ بُعِثْتُ قَاسِمًا أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمًا عَنْ جَابِرٍ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُسَمِّيَهُ الْقَاسِمَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَمُّوا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكْتَنُوا بِكُنْيَتِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sulaymaana, wamansuwrin, waqataadaaa, sami'uwa saalima bna aabiy alja'di, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala wulida lirajulin minnaa mina alaansaari ghulaamun, faaaraada aan yusammiyahu muhammadana qaala shu'baau fiy hadiythi mansuwrin iinna alaansaariyya qaala hamaltuhu 'alaa 'unuqiy faaataytu bihi alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi sulaymaana wulida lahu ghulaamun, faaaraada aan yusammiyahu muhammadana qaala ‏"‏ sammuwa biasmiy, walaa takannawa bikunyatiy, faiinniy iinnamaa ju'iltu qaasimana aaqsimu baynakum ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala husaynun ‏"‏ bu'ithtu qaasimana aaqsimu baynakum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw aakhbaranaa shu'baau 'an qataadaaa qaala sami'tu saalimana 'an jaabirin aaraada aan yusammiyahu alqaasima faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ sammuwa biasmiy walaa taktanuwa bikunyatiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah (ra):A boy was born to one of our men, the Ansar, and he wanted to name him Muhammad. The Ansari man said, "I took the boy to the Prophet (ﷺ). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Name your child by my name, but do not name (them) by my Kunya, for I have been made Qasim (i.e., a distributor) to distribute (the booty etc.) amongst you." The narrator, Husain said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been sent as a Qasim (i.e., distributor) to distribute (things) amongst you." [The Sub narrator Salim said that he heard Jabir saying that the man wanted to name the boy Al-Qasim, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Call (your sons) by my name, but do not name (them) by my Kunya
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ وُلِدَ لِرَجُلٍ مِنَّا غُلاَمٌ فَسَمَّاهُ الْقَاسِمَ فَقَالَتِ الأَنْصَارُ لاَ نَكْنِيكَ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ وَلاَ نُنْعِمُكَ عَيْنًا، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وُلِدَ لِي غُلاَمٌ، فَسَمَّيْتُهُ الْقَاسِمَ فَقَالَتِ الأَنْصَارُ لاَ نَكْنِيكَ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ وَلاَ نُنْعِمُكَ عَيْنًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَحْسَنَتِ الأَنْصَارُ، سَمُّوا بِاسْمِي، وَلاَ تَكَنَّوْا بِكُنْيَتِي، فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا قَاسِمٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyi, qaala wulida lirajulin minnaa ghulaamun fasammaahu alqaasima faqaalati alaansaaru laa nakniyka aabaa alqaasimi walaa nun'imuka 'aynana, faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi wulida liy ghulaamun, fasammaytuhu alqaasima faqaalati alaansaaru laa nakniyka aabaa alqaasimi walaa nun'imuka 'aynana‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aahsanati alaansaaru, sammuwa biasmiy, walaa takannawa bikunyatiy, faiinnamaa aanaa qaasimun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari:A man amongst us begot a boy whom he named Al-Qasim. On that the Ansar said, (to the man), "We will never call you Abu-al-Qasim and will never please you with this blessed title." So, he went to the Prophet and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have begotten a boy whom I named Al-Qasim and the Ansar said, 'We will never call you Abu-al-Qasim, nor will we please you with this title.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Ansar have done well. Name by my name, but do not name by my Kunya, for I am Qasim
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ، وَاللَّهُ الْمُعْطِي وَأَنَا الْقَاسِمُ، وَلاَ تَزَالُ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةُ ظَاهِرِينَ عَلَى مَنْ خَالَفَهُمْ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَهُمْ ظَاهِرُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hibbaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahu sami'a mu'aawiyaaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man yuridi alllahu bihi khayrana yufaqqihhu fiy alddiyni, waalllahu almu'tiy waaanaa alqaasimu, walaa tazaalu hadhihi alaummaau zaahiriyna 'alaa man khaalafahum hattaa yaatiya aamru alllahi wahum zaahiruwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muawiya:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If Allah wants to do good for somebody, he makes him comprehend the Religion (i.e. Islam), and Allah is the Giver and I am Al-Qasim (i.e. the distributor), and this (Muslim) nation will remain victorious over their opponents, till Allah's Order comes and they will still be victorious
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِلاَلٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا أُعْطِيكُمْ وَلاَ أَمْنَعُكُمْ، أَنَا قَاسِمٌ أَضَعُ حَيْثُ أُمِرْتُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu sinaanin, haddathanaa fulayhun, haddathanaa hilaalun, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy 'amraaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa au'tiykum walaa aamna'ukum, aanaa qaasimun aada'u haythu aumirtu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Neither do I give you (anything) nor withhold (anything) from you, but I am just a distributor (i.e. Qasim), and I give as I am ordered
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الأَسْوَدِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ ـ وَاسْمُهُ نُعْمَانُ ـ عَنْ خَوْلَةَ الأَنْصَارِيَّةِ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ رِجَالاً يَتَخَوَّضُونَ فِي مَالِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ، فَلَهُمُ النَّارُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy aayyuwba, qaala haddathaniy aabuw alaaswadi, 'ani abni aabiy 'ayyaashin waasmuhu nu'maanu 'an khawlaaa alaansaariyyaai rda allh 'nha qaalat sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna rijaalaan yatakhawwaduwna fiy maali alllahi bighayri haqqin, falahumu alnnaaru yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Khaula Al-Ansariya:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Some people spend Allah's Wealth (i.e. Muslim's wealth) in an unjust manner; such people will be put in the (Hell) Fire on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ الْبَارِقِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْخَيْلُ مَعْقُودٌ فِي نَوَاصِيهَا الْخَيْرُ الأَجْرُ وَالْمَغْنَمُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa khaalidun, haddathanaa husaynun, 'an 'aamirin, 'an 'urwaaa albaariqiyyi rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alkhaylu ma'quwdun fiy nawaasiyhaa alkhayru alaajru waalmaghnamu iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa-al-Bariqi:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Horses are always the source of good, namely, rewards (in the Hereafter) and booty, till the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا هَلَكَ كِسْرَى فَلاَ كِسْرَى بَعْدَهُ، وَإِذَا هَلَكَ قَيْصَرُ فَلاَ قَيْصَرَ بَعْدَهُ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لَتُنْفِقُنَّ كُنُوزَهُمَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa halaka kisraa falaa kisraa ba'dahu, waiidhaa halaka qaysaru falaa qaysara ba'dahu, waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi, latunfiqunna kunuwzahumaa fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When Khosrau is ruined, there will be no Khosrau after him; and when Caesar is ruined, there will be no Caesar after him. By Him in Whose Hands my life is, you will spend their treasures in Allah's Cause
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، سَمِعَ جَرِيرًا، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا هَلَكَ كِسْرَى فَلاَ كِسْرَى بَعْدَهُ، وَإِذَا هَلَكَ قَيْصَرُ فَلاَ قَيْصَرَ بَعْدَهُ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لَتُنْفَقَنَّ كُنُوزُهُمَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, sami'a jariyrana, 'an 'abdi almaliki, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa halaka kisraa falaa kisraa ba'dahu, waiidhaa halaka qaysaru falaa qaysara ba'dahu, waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi, latunfaqanna kunuwzuhumaa fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin Samura:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When Khosrau is ruined, there will be no Khosrau after him; and when Caesar is ruined, their will be no Caesar after him. By Him in Whose Hands my life is, you will spend their treasures in Allah's Cause
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَيَّارٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ الْفَقِيرُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أُحِلَّتْ لِي الْغَنَائِمُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu sinaanin, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa sayyaarun, haddathanaa yaziydu alfaqiyru, haddathanaa jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ auhillat liy alghanaaiimu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Booty has been made legal for me
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ تَكَفَّلَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ جَاهَدَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ، لاَ يُخْرِجُهُ إِلاَّ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِهِ وَتَصْدِيقُ كَلِمَاتِهِ، بِأَنْ يُدْخِلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ، أَوْ يَرْجِعَهُ إِلَى مَسْكَنِهِ الَّذِي خَرَجَ مِنْهُ ‏{‏مَعَ مَا نَالَ‏}‏ مِنْ أَجْرٍ أَوْ غَنِيمَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ takaffala alllahu liman jaahada fiy sabiylihi, laa yukhrijuhu iilaaa aljihaadu fiy sabiylihi watasdiyqu kalimaatihi, biaan yudkhilahu aljannaaa, aaw yarji'ahu iilaa maskanihi alladhiy kharaja minhu ‏{‏ma'a maa naala‏}‏ min aajrin aaw ghaniymaain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah guarantees him who strives in His Cause and whose motivation for going out is nothing but Jihad in His Cause and belief in His Word, that He will admit him into Paradise (if martyred) or bring him back to his dwelling place, whence he has come out, with what he gains of reward and booty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ غَزَا نَبِيٌّ مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ فَقَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ لاَ يَتْبَعْنِي رَجُلٌ مَلَكَ بُضْعَ امْرَأَةٍ وَهْوَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَبْنِيَ بِهَا وَلَمَّا يَبْنِ بِهَا، وَلاَ أَحَدٌ بَنَى بُيُوتًا وَلَمْ يَرْفَعْ سُقُوفَهَا، وَلاَ أَحَدٌ اشْتَرَى غَنَمًا أَوْ خَلِفَاتٍ وَهْوَ يَنْتَظِرُ وِلاَدَهَا‏.‏ فَغَزَا فَدَنَا مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ صَلاَةَ الْعَصْرِ أَوْ قَرِيبًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لِلشَّمْسِ إِنَّكِ مَأْمُورَةٌ وَأَنَا مَأْمُورٌ، اللَّهُمَّ احْبِسْهَا عَلَيْنَا‏.‏ فَحُبِسَتْ، حَتَّى فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ، فَجَمَعَ الْغَنَائِمَ، فَجَاءَتْ ـ يَعْنِي النَّارَ ـ لِتَأْكُلَهَا، فَلَمْ تَطْعَمْهَا، فَقَالَ إِنَّ فِيكُمْ غُلُولاً، فَلْيُبَايِعْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ قَبِيلَةٍ رَجُلٌ‏.‏ فَلَزِقَتْ يَدُ رَجُلٍ بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ فِيكُمُ الْغُلُولُ‏.‏ فَلْتُبَايِعْنِي قَبِيلَتُكَ، فَلَزِقَتْ يَدُ رَجُلَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةٍ بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ فِيكُمُ الْغُلُولُ، فَجَاءُوا بِرَأْسٍ مِثْلِ رَأْسِ بَقَرَةٍ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ فَوَضَعُوهَا، فَجَاءَتِ النَّارُ فَأَكَلَتْهَا، ثُمَّ أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَنَا الْغَنَائِمَ، رَأَى ضَعْفَنَا وَعَجْزَنَا فَأَحَلَّهَا لَنَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa abnu almubaaraki, 'an ma'marin, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ghazaa nabiyyun mina alaanbiyaa'i faqaala liqawmihi laa yatba'niy rajulun malaka bud'a amraaaain wahwa yuriydu aan yabniya bihaa walammaa yabni bihaa, walaa aahadun banaa buyuwtana walam yarfa' suquwfahaa, walaa aahadun ashtaraa ghanamana aaw khalifaatin wahwa yantaziru wilaadahaa‏.‏ faghazaa fadanaa mina alqaryaai salaaaa al'asri aaw qariybana min dhalika faqaala lilshhamsi iinnaki maamuwraaun waaanaa maamuwrun, alllahumma ahbishaa 'alaynaa‏.‏ fahubisat, hattaa fataha alllahu 'alayhi, fajama'a alghanaaiima, fajaa'at ya'niy alnnaara litaakulahaa, falam tat'amhaa, faqaala iinna fiykum ghuluwlaan, falyubaayi'niy min kulli qabiylaain rajulun‏.‏ falaziqat yadu rajulin biyadihi faqaala fiykumu alghuluwlu‏.‏ faltubaayi'niy qabiylatuka, falaziqat yadu rajulayni aaw thalaathaain biyadihi faqaala fiykumu alghuluwlu, fajaa'uwa biraasin mithli raasi baqaraain mina aldhhahabi fawada'uwhaa, fajaa'ati alnnaaru faaakalathaa, thumma aahalla alllahu lanaa alghanaaiima, raaaa da'fanaa wa'ajzanaa faaahallahaa lanaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A prophet amongst the prophets carried out a holy military expedition, so he said to his followers, 'Anyone who has married a woman and wants to consummate the marriage, and has not done so yet, should not accompany me; nor should a man who has built a house but has not completed its roof; nor a man who has sheep or shecamels and is waiting for the birth of their young ones.' So, the prophet carried out the expedition and when he reached that town at the time or nearly at the time of the `Asr prayer, he said to the sun, 'O sun! You are under Allah's Order and I am under Allah's Order O Allah! Stop it (i.e. the sun) from setting.' It was stopped till Allah made him victorious. Then he collected the booty and the fire came to burn it, but it did not burn it. He said (to his men), 'Some of you have stolen something from the booty. So one man from every tribe should give me a pledge of allegiance by shaking hands with me.' (They did so and) the hand of a man got stuck over the hand of their prophet. Then that prophet said (to the man), 'The theft has been committed by your people. So all the persons of your tribe should give me the pledge of allegiance by shaking hands with me.' The hands of two or three men got stuck over the hand of their prophet and he said, "You have committed the theft.' Then they brought a head of gold like the head of a cow and put it there, and the fire came and consumed the booty. The Prophet (ﷺ) added: Then Allah saw our weakness and disability, so he made booty legal for us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه لَوْلاَ آخِرُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ مَا فَتَحْتُ قَرْيَةً إِلاَّ قَسَمْتُهَا بَيْنَ أَهْلِهَا كَمَا قَسَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْبَرَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sadaqaau, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrahmani, 'an maalikin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala 'umaru rda allh 'nh lawlaa akhiru almuslimiyna maa fatahtu qaryaaan iilaaa qasamtuhaa bayna aahlihaa kamaa qasama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khaybara‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aslam:`Umar said, "Were it not for those Muslims who have not come to existence yet, I would have distributed (the land of) every town I conquer among the fighters as the Prophet (ﷺ) distributed the land of Khaibar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيُّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الرَّجُلُ يُقَاتِلُ لِلْمَغْنَمِ، وَالرَّجُلُ يُقَاتِلُ لِيُذْكَرَ، وَيُقَاتِلُ لِيُرَى مَكَانُهُ، مَنْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَاتَلَ لِتَكُونَ كَلِمَةُ اللَّهِ هِيَ الْعُلْيَا فَهْوَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amrinw, qaala sami'tu aabaa waaiilin, qaala haddathanaa aabuw muwsaa alaash'ariyyu rda allh 'nh qaala qaala aa'raabiyyun lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alrrajulu yuqaatilu lilmaghnami, waalrrajulu yuqaatilu liyudhkara, wayuqaatilu liyuraa makaanuhu, man fiy sabiyli alllahi faqaala ‏ "‏ man qaatala litakuwna kalimaau alllahi hiya al'ulyaa fahwa fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:A bedouin asked the Prophet, "A man may fight for the sake of booty, and another may fight so that he may be mentioned by the people, and a third may fight to show his position (i.e. bravery); which of these is regarded as fighting in Allah's Cause?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who fights so that Allah's Word (i.e. Islam) should be superior, fights for Allah's Cause
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُهْدِيَتْ لَهُ أَقْبِيَةٌ مِنْ دِيبَاجٍ مُزَرَّرَةٌ بِالذَّهَبِ، فَقَسَمَهَا فِي نَاسٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، وَعَزَلَ مِنْهَا وَاحِدًا لِمَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ، فَجَاءَ وَمَعَهُ ابْنُهُ الْمِسْوَرُ بْنُ مَخْرَمَةَ، فَقَامَ عَلَى الْبَابِ فَقَالَ ادْعُهُ لِي‏.‏ فَسَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَوْتَهُ فَأَخَذَ قَبَاءً فَتَلَقَّاهُ بِهِ وَاسْتَقْبَلَهُ بِأَزْرَارِهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا أَبَا الْمِسْوَرِ، خَبَأْتُ هَذَا لَكَ، يَا أَبَا الْمِسْوَرِ، خَبَأْتُ هَذَا لَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ فِي خُلُقِهِ شِدَّةٌ‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ‏.‏ قَالَ حَاتِمُ بْنُ وَرْدَانَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ قَدِمَتْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقْبِيَةٌ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ اللَّيْثُ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alwahhaabi, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy mulaykaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm auhdiyat lahu aaqbiyaaun min diybaajin muzarraraaun bialdhhahabi, faqasamahaa fiy naasin min aashaabihi, wa'azala minhaa waahidana limakhramaaa bni nawfalin, fajaa'a wama'ahu abnuhu almiswaru bnu makhramaaa, faqaama 'alaa albaabi faqaala ad'uhu liy‏.‏ fasami'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm sawtahu faaakhadha qabaa'an fatalaqqaahu bihi waastaqbalahu biaazraarihi faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa aabaa almiswari, khabaatu hadhaa laka, yaa aabaa almiswari, khabaatu hadhaa laka ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana fiy khuluqihi shiddaaun‏.‏ warawaahu abnu 'ulayyaaa 'an aayyuwba‏.‏ qaala haatimu bnu wardaana haddathanaa aayyuwbu 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa 'ani almiswari qadimat 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaqbiyaaun‏.‏ taaba'ahu alllaythu 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu Mulaika:Some silken cloaks with golden buttons were presented to the Prophet. He distributed them amongst his companions and kept one for Makhrama, bin Naufal. Later on Makhrama came along with his son Al-Miswar bin Makhrama, and stood up at the gate and said (to his son). "Call him (i.e. the Prophet) to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) heard his voice, took a silken cloak and brought it to him, placing those golden buttons in front of him saying, "O Abu-al-Miswar! I have kept this aside for you! O Abu-al Miswar! I have kept this aside for you!" Makhrama was a bad-tempered man
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ يَجْعَلُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم النَّخَلاَتِ حَتَّى افْتَتَحَ قُرَيْظَةَ وَالنَّضِيرَ، فَكَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy alaaswadi, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh yaquwlu kaana alrrajulu yaj'alu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alnnakhalaati hattaa aftataha qurayzaaa waalnnadiyra, fakaana ba'da dhalika yaruddu 'alayhim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:People used to give some of their datepalms to the Prophet (as a gift), till he conquered Bani Quraiza and Bani An-Nadir, whereupon he started returning their favors
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَبِي أُسَامَةَ أَحَدَّثَكُمْ هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ قَالَ لَمَّا وَقَفَ الزُّبَيْرُ يَوْمَ الْجَمَلِ دَعَانِي، فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ فَقَالَ يَا بُنَىِّ، إِنَّهُ لاَ يُقْتَلُ الْيَوْمَ إِلاَّ ظَالِمٌ أَوْ مَظْلُومٌ، وَإِنِّي لاَ أُرَانِي إِلاَّ سَأُقْتَلُ الْيَوْمَ مَظْلُومًا، وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَكْبَرِ هَمِّي لَدَيْنِي، أَفَتُرَى يُبْقِي دَيْنُنَا مِنْ مَالِنَا شَيْئًا فَقَالَ يَا بُنَىِّ بِعْ مَالَنَا فَاقْضِ دَيْنِي‏.‏ وَأَوْصَى بِالثُّلُثِ، وَثُلُثِهِ لِبَنِيهِ، يَعْنِي عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ يَقُولُ ثُلُثُ الثُّلُثِ، فَإِنْ فَضَلَ مِنْ مَالِنَا فَضْلٌ بَعْدَ قَضَاءِ الدَّيْنِ شَىْءٌ فَثُلُثُهُ لِوَلَدِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ هِشَامٌ وَكَانَ بَعْضُ وَلَدِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَدْ وَازَى بَعْضَ بَنِي الزُّبَيْرِ خُبَيْبٌ وَعَبَّادٌ، وَلَهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ تِسْعَةُ بَنِينَ وَتِسْعُ بَنَاتٍ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَجَعَلَ يُوصِينِي بِدَيْنِهِ وَيَقُولُ يَا بُنَىِّ، إِنْ عَجَزْتَ عَنْهُ فِي شَىْءٍ فَاسْتَعِنْ عَلَيْهِ مَوْلاَىَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا دَرَيْتُ مَا أَرَادَ حَتَّى قُلْتُ يَا أَبَتِ مَنْ مَوْلاَكَ قَالَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا وَقَعْتُ فِي كُرْبَةٍ مِنْ دَيْنِهِ إِلاَّ قُلْتُ يَا مَوْلَى الزُّبَيْرِ، اقْضِ عَنْهُ دَيْنَهُ‏.‏ فَيَقْضِيهِ، فَقُتِلَ الزُّبَيْرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَلَمْ يَدَعْ دِينَارًا وَلاَ دِرْهَمًا، إِلاَّ أَرَضِينَ مِنْهَا الْغَابَةُ، وَإِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ دَارًا بِالْمَدِينَةِ، وَدَارَيْنِ بِالْبَصْرَةِ، وَدَارًا بِالْكُوفَةِ، وَدَارًا بِمِصْرَ‏.‏ قَالَ وَإِنَّمَا كَانَ دَيْنُهُ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ كَانَ يَأْتِيهِ بِالْمَالِ فَيَسْتَوْدِعُهُ إِيَّاهُ فَيَقُولُ الزُّبَيْرُ لاَ وَلَكِنَّهُ سَلَفٌ، فَإِنِّي أَخْشَى عَلَيْهِ الضَّيْعَةَ، وَمَا وَلِيَ إِمَارَةً قَطُّ وَلاَ جِبَايَةَ خَرَاجٍ وَلاَ شَيْئًا، إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي غَزْوَةٍ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ مَعَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ فَحَسَبْتُ مَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الدَّيْنِ فَوَجَدْتُهُ أَلْفَىْ أَلْفٍ وَمِائَتَىْ أَلْفٍ قَالَ فَلَقِيَ حَكِيمُ بْنُ حِزَامٍ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ فَقَالَ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي، كَمْ عَلَى أَخِي مِنَ الدَّيْنِ فَكَتَمَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مِائَةُ أَلْفٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ حَكِيمٌ وَاللَّهِ مَا أُرَى أَمْوَالَكُمْ تَسَعُ لِهَذِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَفَرَأَيْتَكَ إِنْ كَانَتْ أَلْفَىْ أَلْفٍ وَمِائَتَىْ أَلْفٍ قَالَ مَا أُرَاكُمْ تُطِيقُونَ هَذَا، فَإِنْ عَجَزْتُمْ عَنْ شَىْءٍ مِنْهُ فَاسْتَعِينُوا بِي‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ الزُّبَيْرُ اشْتَرَى الْغَابَةَ بِسَبْعِينَ وَمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ، فَبَاعَهَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بِأَلْفِ أَلْفٍ وَسِتِّمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَقَالَ مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ عَلَى الزُّبَيْرِ حَقٌّ فَلْيُوَافِنَا بِالْغَابَةِ، فَأَتَاهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، وَكَانَ لَهُ عَلَى الزُّبَيْرِ أَرْبَعُمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ فَقَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِنْ شِئْتُمْ تَرَكْتُهَا لَكُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنْ شِئْتُمْ جَعَلْتُمُوهَا فِيمَا تُؤَخِّرُونَ إِنْ أَخَّرْتُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ فَاقْطَعُوا لِي قِطْعَةً‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَكَ مِنْ هَا هُنَا إِلَى هَا هُنَا‏.‏ قَالَ فَبَاعَ مِنْهَا فَقَضَى دَيْنَهُ فَأَوْفَاهُ، وَبَقِيَ مِنْهَا أَرْبَعَةُ أَسْهُمٍ وَنِصْفٌ، فَقَدِمَ عَلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ وَعِنْدَهُ عَمْرُو بْنُ عُثْمَانَ وَالْمُنْذِرُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ وَابْنُ زَمْعَةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ مُعَاوِيَةُ كَمْ قُوِّمَتِ الْغَابَةُ قَالَ كُلُّ سَهْمٍ مِائَةَ أَلْفٍ‏.‏ قَالَ كَمْ بَقِيَ قَالَ أَرْبَعَةُ أَسْهُمٍ وَنِصْفٌ‏.‏ قَالَ الْمُنْذِرُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ قَدْ أَخَذْتُ سَهْمًا بِمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ عُثْمَانَ قَدْ أَخَذْتُ سَهْمًا بِمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ زَمْعَةَ قَدْ أَخَذْتُ سَهْمًا بِمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ كَمْ بَقِيَ فَقَالَ سَهْمٌ وَنِصْفٌ‏.‏ قَالَ أَخَذْتُهُ بِخَمْسِينَ وَمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ‏.‏ قَالَ وَبَاعَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ نَصِيبَهُ مِنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بِسِتِّمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ مِنْ قَضَاءِ دَيْنِهِ قَالَ بَنُو الزُّبَيْرِ اقْسِمْ بَيْنَنَا مِيرَاثَنَا‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ، وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ حَتَّى أُنَادِيَ بِالْمَوْسِمِ أَرْبَعَ سِنِينَ أَلاَ مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ عَلَى الزُّبَيْرِ دَيْنٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا فَلْنَقْضِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَعَلَ كَلَّ سَنَةٍ يُنَادِي بِالْمَوْسِمِ، فَلَمَّا مَضَى أَرْبَعُ سِنِينَ قَسَمَ بَيْنَهُمْ قَالَ فَكَانَ لِلزُّبَيْرِ أَرْبَعُ نِسْوَةٍ، وَرَفَعَ الثُّلُثَ، فَأَصَابَ كُلَّ امْرَأَةٍ أَلْفُ أَلْفٍ وَمِائَتَا أَلْفٍ، فَجَمِيعُ مَالِهِ خَمْسُونَ أَلْفَ أَلْفٍ وَمِائَتَا أَلْفٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala qultu laabiy ausaamaaa aahaddathakum hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa 'an aabiyhi 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri qaala lammaa waqafa alzzubayru yawma aljamali da'aaniy, faqumtu iilaa janbihi faqaala yaa bunaaai, iinnahu laa yuqtalu alyawma iilaaa zaalimun aaw mazluwmun, waiinniy laa auraaniy iilaaa saauqtalu alyawma mazluwmana, waiinna min aakbari hammiy ladayniy, aafaturaa yubqiy daynunaa min maalinaa shayiana faqaala yaa bunaaai bi' maalanaa faaqdi dayniy‏.‏ waaawsaa bialthhuluthi, wathuluthihi libaniyhi, ya'niy 'abda alllahi bna alzzubayri yaquwlu thuluthu althhuluthi, faiin fadala min maalinaa fadlun ba'da qadaa'i alddayni shaa'un fathuluthuhu liwaladika‏.‏ qaala hishaamun wakaana ba'du waladi 'abdi alllahi qad waazaa ba'da baniy alzzubayri khubaybun wa'abbaadun, walahu yawmaiidhin tis'aau baniyna watis'u banaatin‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi faja'ala yuwsiyniy bidaynihi wayaquwlu yaa bunaaai, iin 'ajazta 'anhu fiy shaa'in faasta'in 'alayhi mawlaaaa‏.‏ qaala fawaalllahi maa daraytu maa aaraada hattaa qultu yaa aabati man mawlaaka qaala alllahu‏.‏ qaala fawaalllahi maa waqa'tu fiy kurbaain min daynihi iilaaa qultu yaa mawlaa alzzubayri, aqdi 'anhu daynahu‏.‏ fayaqdiyhi, faqutila alzzubayru rda allh 'nh walam yada' diynaarana walaa dirhamana, iilaaa aaradiyna minhaa alghaabaau, waiihdaa 'ashraaa daarana bialmadiynaai, wadaarayni bialbasraai, wadaarana bialkuwfaai, wadaarana bimisra‏.‏ qaala waiinnamaa kaana daynuhu alladhiy 'alayhi aanna alrrajula kaana yaatiyhi bialmaali fayastawdi'uhu iiyyaahu fayaquwlu alzzubayru laa walakinnahu salafun, faiinniy aakhshaa 'alayhi aldday'aaa, wamaa waliya iimaaraaan qattu walaa jibaayaaa kharaajin walaa shayiana, iilaaa aan yakuwna fiy ghazwaain ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaw ma'a aabiy bakrin wa'umara wa'uthmaana rda allh 'nhm qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu alzzubayri fahasabtu maa 'alayhi mina alddayni fawajadtuhu aalfaa aalfin wamiaiataa aalfin qaala falaqiya hakiymu bnu hizaamin 'abda alllahi bna alzzubayri faqaala yaa abna aakhiy, kam 'alaa aakhiy mina alddayni fakatamahu‏.‏ faqaala miaiaau aalfin‏.‏ faqaala hakiymun waalllahi maa auraa aamwaalakum tasa'u lihadhihi‏.‏ faqaala lahu 'abdu alllahi aafaraaaytaka iin kaanat aalfaa aalfin wamiaiataa aalfin qaala maa auraakum tutiyquwna hadhaa, faiin 'ajaztum 'an shaa'in minhu faasta'iynuwa biy‏.‏ qaala wakaana alzzubayru ashtaraa alghaabaaa bisab'iyna wamiaiaai aalfin, fabaa'ahaa 'abdu alllahi biaalfi aalfin wasittimiaiaai aalfin thumma qaama faqaala man kaana lahu 'alaa alzzubayri haqqun falyuwaafinaa bialghaabaai, faaataahu 'abdu alllahi bnu ja'farin, wakaana lahu 'alaa alzzubayri aarba'umiaiaai aalfin faqaala li'abdi alllahi iin shiitum taraktuhaa lakum‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi laa‏.‏ qaala faiin shiitum ja'altumuwhaa fiymaa tuuakhhiruwna iin aakhhartum‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi laa‏.‏ qaala qaala faaqta'uwa liy qit'aaan‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi laka min haa hunaa iilaa haa hunaa‏.‏ qaala fabaa'a minhaa faqadaa daynahu faaawfaahu, wabaqiya minhaa aarba'aau aashumin wanisfun, faqadima 'alaa mu'aawiyaaa wa'indahu 'amruw bnu 'uthmaana waalmundhiru bnu alzzubayri waabnu zam'aaa faqaala lahu mu'aawiyaau kam quwwimati alghaabaau qaala kullu sahmin miaiaaa aalfin‏.‏ qaala kam baqiya qaala aarba'aau aashumin wanisfun‏.‏ qaala almundhiru bnu alzzubayri qad aakhadhtu sahmana bimiaiaai aalfin‏.‏ qaala 'amruw bnu 'uthmaana qad aakhadhtu sahmana bimiaiaai aalfin‏.‏ waqaala abnu zam'aaa qad aakhadhtu sahmana bimiaiaai aalfin‏.‏ faqaala mu'aawiyaau kam baqiya faqaala sahmun wanisfun‏.‏ qaala aakhadhtuhu bikhamsiyna wamiaiaai aalfin‏.‏ qaala wabaa'a 'abdu alllahi bnu ja'farin nasiybahu min mu'aawiyaaa bisittimiaiaai aalfin, falammaa faragha abnu alzzubayri min qadaa'i daynihi qaala banuw alzzubayri aqsim baynanaa miyraathanaa‏.‏ qaala laa, waalllahi laa aaqsimu baynakum hattaa aunaadiya bialmawsimi aarba'a siniyna aalaa man kaana lahu 'alaa alzzubayri daynun falyaatinaa falnaqdihi‏.‏ qaala faja'ala kalla sanaain yunaadiy bialmawsimi, falammaa madaa aarba'u siniyna qasama baynahum qaala fakaana lilzzubayri aarba'u niswaain, warafa'a althhulutha, faaasaaba kulla amraaaain aalfu aalfin wamiaiataa aalfin, fajamiy'u maalihi khamsuwna aalfa aalfin wamiaiataa aalfin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair:When Az-Zubair got up during the battle of Al-Jamal, he called me and I stood up beside him, and he said to me, "O my son! Today one will be killed either as an oppressor or as an oppressed one. I see that I will be killed as an oppressed one. My biggest worry is my debts. Do you think, if we pay the debts, there will be something left for us from our money?" Az-Zubair added, "O my son! Sell our property and pay my debts." Az-Zubair then willed one-third of his property and willed one-third of that portion to his sons; namely, `Abdullah's sons. He said, "One-third of the one third. If any property is left after the payment of the debts, one-third (of the one-third of what is left) is to be given to your sons." (Hisham, a sub-narrator added, "Some of the sons of `Abdullah were equal in age to the sons of Az-Zubair e.g. Khubaib and `Abbas. `Abdullah had nine sons and nine daughters at that time." (The narrator `Abdullah added:) My father (Az-Zubair) went on drawing my attention to his debts saying, "If you should fail to pay part of the debts, appeal to my Master to help you." By Allah! I could not understand what he meant till I asked, "O father! Who is your Master?" He replied, "Allah (is my Master)." By Allah, whenever I had any difficulty regarding his debts, I would say, "Master of Az-Zubair! Pay his debts on his behalf ." and Allah would (help me to) pay it. Az-Zubair was martyred leaving no Dinar or Dirham but two pieces of land, one of which was (called) Al-Ghaba, and eleven houses in Medina, two in Basra, one in Kufa and one in Egypt. In fact, the source of the debt which he owed was, that if somebody brought some money to deposit with him. Az-Zubair would say, "No, (i won't keep it as a trust), but I take it as a debt, for I am afraid it might be lost." Az-Zubair was never appointed governor or collector of the tax of Kharaj or any other similar thing, but he collected his wealth (from the war booty he gained) during the holy battles he took part in, in the company of the Prophet, Abu Bakr, `Umar, and `Uthman. (`Abdullah bin Az-Zubair added:) When I counted his debt, it turned to be two million and two hundred thousand. (The sub-narrator added:) Hakim bin Hizam met `Abdullah bin Zubair and asked, "O my nephew! How much is the debt of my brother?" `Abdullah kept it as a secret and said, "One hundred thousand," Hakim said, "By Allah! I don't think your property will cover it." On that `Abdullah said to him, "What if it is two million and two hundred thousand?" Hakim said, "I don't think you can pay it; so if you are unable to pay all of it, I will help you." Az-Zubair had already bought Al-Ghaba for one hundred and seventy thousand. `Abdullah sold it for one million and six hundred thousand. Then he called the people saying, "Any person who has any money claim on Az-Zubair should come to us in Al-Ghaba." There came to him `Abdullah bin Ja`far whom Az-Zubair owed four hundred thousand. He said to `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair, "If you wish I will forgive you the debt." `Abdullah (bin Az-Zubair) said, "No." Then Ibn Ja`far said, "If you wish you can defer the payment if you should defer the payment of any debt." Ibn Az-Zubair said, "No." `Abdullah bin Ja`far said, "Give me a piece of the land." `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair said (to him), "Yours is the land extending from this place to this place." So, `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair sold some of the property (including the houses) and paid his debt perfectly, retaining four and a half shares from the land (i.e. Al-Ghaba). He then went to Mu'awiya while `Amr bin `Uthman, Al-Mundhir bin Az-Zubair and Ibn Zam`a were sitting with him. Mu'awiya asked, "At what price have you appraised Al-Ghaba?" He said, "One hundred thousand for each share," Muawiya asked, "How many shares have been left?" `Abdullah replied, "Four and a half shares." Al-Mundhir bin Az-Zubair said, "I would like to buy one share for one hundred thousand." `Amr bin `Uthman said, "I would like to buy one share for one hundred thousand." Ibn Zam`a said, "I would like to buy one share for one hundred thousand." Muawiya said, "How much is left now?" `Abdullah replied, "One share and a half." Muawiya said, "I would like to buy it for one hundred and fifty thousand." `Abdullah also sold his part to Muawiya for six hundred thousand. When Ibn Az-Zubair had paid all the debts. Az-Zubair's sons said to him, "Distribute our inheritance among us." He said, "No, by Allah, I will not distribute it among you till I announce in four successive Hajj seasons, 'Would those who have money claims on Az-Zubair come so that we may pay them their debt." So, he started to announce that in public in every Hajj season, and when four years had elapsed, he distributed the inheritance among the inheritors. Az-Zubair had four wives, and after the one-third of his property was excluded (according to the will), each of his wives received one million and two hundred thousand. So the total amount of his property was fifty million and two hundred thousand
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مَوْهَبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ إِنَّمَا تَغَيَّبَ عُثْمَانُ عَنْ بَدْرٍ، فَإِنَّهُ كَانَتْ تَحْتَهُ بِنْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَتْ مَرِيضَةً‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ لَكَ أَجْرَ رَجُلٍ مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا وَسَهْمَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu mawhabin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala iinnamaa taghayyaba 'uthmaanu 'an badrin, faiinnahu kaanat tahtahu bintu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaanat mariydaaan‏.‏ faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna laka aajra rajulin mimman shahida badrana wasahmahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Uthman did not join the Badr battle because he was married to one of the daughters of Allah's Apostle and she was ill. So, the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him. "You will get a reward and a share (from the war booty) similar to the reward and the share of one who has taken part in the Badr battle
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ وَزَعَمَ عُرْوَةُ أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ، وَمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَاهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ حِينَ جَاءَهُ وَفْدُ هَوَازِنَ مُسْلِمِينَ، فَسَأَلُوهُ أَنْ يَرُدَّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَسَبْيَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَحَبُّ الْحَدِيثِ إِلَىَّ أَصْدَقُهُ، فَاخْتَارُوا إِحْدَى الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ إِمَّا السَّبْىَ وَإِمَّا الْمَالَ، وَقَدْ كُنْتُ اسْتَأْنَيْتُ بِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَدْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم انْتَظَرَ آخِرَهُمْ بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ لَيْلَةً، حِينَ قَفَلَ مِنَ الطَّائِفِ، فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرُ رَادٍّ إِلَيْهِمْ إِلاَّ إِحْدَى الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ‏.‏ قَالُوا فَإِنَّا نَخْتَارُ سَبْيَنَا، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَأَثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ، فَإِنَّ إِخْوَانَكُمْ هَؤُلاَءِ قَدْ جَاءُونَا تَائِبِينَ، وَإِنِّي قَدْ رَأَيْتُ أَنْ أَرُدَّ إِلَيْهِمْ سَبْيَهُمْ، مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُطَيِّبَ فَلْيَفْعَلْ، وَمَنْ أَحَبَّ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَكُونَ عَلَى حَظِّهِ حَتَّى نُعْطِيَهُ إِيَّاهُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ مَا يُفِيءُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا فَلْيَفْعَلْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّاسُ قَدْ طَيَّبْنَا ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّا لاَ نَدْرِي مَنْ أَذِنَ مِنْكُمْ فِي ذَلِكَ مِمَّنْ لَمْ يَأْذَنْ، فَارْجِعُوا حَتَّى يَرْفَعَ إِلَيْنَا عُرَفَاؤُكُمْ أَمْرَكُمْ ‏"‏ فَرَجَعَ النَّاسُ، فَكَلَّمَهُمْ عُرَفَاؤُهُمْ، ثُمَّ رَجَعُوا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرُوهُ أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ طَيَّبُوا فَأَذِنُوا‏.‏ فَهَذَا الَّذِي بَلَغَنَا عَنْ سَبْىِ هَوَازِنَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ufayrin, qaala haddathaniy alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylun, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala waza'ama 'urwaau aanna marwaana bna alhakami, wamiswara bna makhramaaa, aakhbaraahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala hiyna jaa'ahu wafdu hawaazina muslimiyna, fasaaaluwhu aan yarudda iilayhim aamwaalahum wasabyahum faqaala lahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aahabbu alhadiythi iilaaaa aasdaquhu, faakhtaaruwa iihdaa alttaaiifatayni iimmaa alssabaa waiimmaa almaala, waqad kuntu astaanaytu bihim ‏"‏‏.‏ waqad kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm antazara akhirahum bid'a 'ashraaa laylaaan, hiyna qafala mina alttaaiifi, falammaa tabayyana lahum aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghayru raaddin iilayhim iilaaa iihdaa alttaaiifatayni‏.‏ qaaluwa faiinnaa nakhtaaru sabyanaa, faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy almuslimiyna faaathnaa 'alaa alllahi bimaa huwa aahluhu thumma qaala ‏"‏ aammaa ba'du, faiinna iikhwaanakum hauulaa'i qad jaa'uwnaa taaiibiyna, waiinniy qad raaaytu aan aarudda iilayhim sabyahum, man aahabba aan yutayyiba falyaf'al, waman aahabba minkum aan yakuwna 'alaa hazzihi hattaa nu'tiyahu iiyyaahu min aawwali maa yufiy'u alllahu 'alaynaa falyaf'al ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala alnnaasu qad tayyabnaa dhalika yaa rasuwla alllahi lahum‏.‏ faqaala lahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnaa laa nadriy man aadhina minkum fiy dhalika mimman lam yaadhan, faarji'uwa hattaa yarfa'a iilaynaa 'urafaauukum aamrakum ‏"‏ faraja'a alnnaasu, fakallamahum 'urafaauuhum, thumma raja'uwa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbaruwhu aannahum qad tayyabuwa faaadhinuwa‏.‏ fahadhaa alladhiy balaghanaa 'an sabai hawaazina‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Marwan bin Al-Hakam and Miswar bin Makhrama:When the Hawazin delegation came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after they had embraced Islam and requested him to return their properties and war prisoners to them, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "To me the best talk is the truest, so you may choose either of two things; the war prisoners or the wealth, for I have delayed their distribution." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had waited for them for over ten days when he returned from Ta'if. So, when those people came to know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was not going to return to them except one of the two things the said, "We choose our war Prisoners 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up amongst the Muslims, and after glorifying Allah as He deserved, he said, "Now then, these brothers of yours have come to us with repentance, and I see it logical that I should return their captives to them, so whoever of you likes to do that as a favor then he can do it, and whoever amongst you likes to stick to his share, let him give up his prisoners and we will compensate him from the very first Fai' (i.e. war booty received without fight) which Allah will give us." On that, all the people said. 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) We have agreed willingly to do so (return the captives)" Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them "I do not know who amongst you has agreed to this and who has not. You should return and let your leaders inform me of your agreement." The people returned and their leaders spoke to them, and then came to Allah's Apostle and said, "All the people have agreed willingly to do so and have given the permission to return the war prisoners (without Compensation)" (Az-Zuhri, the sub-narrator states) This is what has been related to us about the captives of Hawazin
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَاصِمٍ الْكُلَيْبِيُّ ـ وَأَنَا لِحَدِيثِ الْقَاسِمِ، أَحْفَظُ ـ عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ أَبِي مُوسَى، فَأُتِيَ ذَكَرَ دَجَاجَةً وَعِنْدَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي تَيْمِ اللَّهِ أَحْمَرُ كَأَنَّهُ مِنَ الْمَوَالِي، فَدَعَاهُ لِلطَّعَامِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُهُ يَأْكُلُ شَيْئًا، فَقَذِرْتُهُ، فَحَلَفْتُ لاَ آكُلُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ هَلُمَّ فَلأُحَدِّثْكُمْ عَنْ ذَاكَ، إِنِّي أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي نَفَرٍ مِنَ الأَشْعَرِيِّينَ نَسْتَحْمِلُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَحْمِلُكُمْ، وَمَا عِنْدِي مَا أَحْمِلُكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَهْبِ إِبِلٍ، فَسَأَلَ عَنَّا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ النَّفَرُ الأَشْعَرِيُّونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ لَنَا بِخَمْسِ ذَوْدٍ غُرِّ الذُّرَى، فَلَمَّا انْطَلَقْنَا قُلْنَا مَا صَنَعْنَا لاَ يُبَارَكُ لَنَا، فَرَجَعْنَا إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْنَا إِنَّا سَأَلْنَاكَ أَنْ تَحْمِلَنَا، فَحَلَفْتَ أَنْ لاَ تَحْمِلَنَا أَفَنَسِيتَ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَسْتُ أَنَا حَمَلْتُكُمْ، وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ حَمَلَكُمْ، وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لاَ أَحْلِفُ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَأَرَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا إِلاَّ أَتَيْتُ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ وَتَحَلَّلْتُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alwahhaabi, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, qaala wahaddathaniy alqaasimu bnu 'aasimin alkulaybiyyu waaanaa lihadiythi alqaasimi, aahfazu 'an zahdamin, qaala kunnaa 'inda aabiy muwsaa, faautiya dhakara dajaajaaan wa'indahu rajulun min baniy taymi alllahi aahmaru kaaannahu mina almawaaliy, fada'aahu liltta'aami faqaala iinniy raaaytuhu yaakulu shayiana, faqadhirtuhu, fahalaftu laa akulu‏.‏ faqaala halumma falauhaddithkum 'an dhaaka, iinniy aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy nafarin mina alaash'ariyyiyna nastahmiluhu faqaala ‏"‏ waalllahi laa aahmilukum, wamaa 'indiy maa aahmilukum ‏"‏‏.‏ waautiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahbi iibilin, fasaaala 'annaa faqaala ‏"‏ aayna alnnafaru alaash'ariyyuwna ‏"‏‏.‏ faaamara lanaa bikhamsi dhawdin ghurri aldhhuraa, falammaa antalaqnaa qulnaa maa sana'naa laa yubaaraku lanaa, faraja'naa iilayhi faqulnaa iinnaa saaalnaaka aan tahmilanaa, fahalafta aan laa tahmilanaa aafanasiyta qaala ‏"‏ lastu aanaa hamaltukum, walakinna alllaha hamalakum, waiinniy waalllahi iin shaa'a alllahu laa aahlifu 'alaa yamiynin faaaraa ghayrahaa khayrana minhaa iilaaa aataytu alladhiy huwa khayrun watahallaltuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zahdam:Once we were in the house of Abu Musa who presented a meal containing cooked chicken. A man from the tribe of Bani Taim Allah with red complexion as if he were from the Byzantine war prisoners, was present. Abu Musa invited him to share the meal but he (apologised) saying. "I saw chickens eating dirty things and so I have had a strong aversion to eating them, and have taken an oath that I will not eat chickens." Abu Musa said, "Come along, I will tell you about this matter (i.e. how to cancel one's oath). I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the company of a group of Al-Ashariyin, asked him to provide us with means of conveyance. He said, 'By Allah, I will not provide you with any means of conveyance and I have nothing to make you ride on.' Then some camels as booty were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he asked for us saying. 'Where are the group of Al-Ash`ariyun?' Then he ordered that we should be given five camels with white humps. When we set out we said, 'What have we done? We will never be blessed (with what we have been given).' So, we returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, 'We asked you to provide us with means of conveyance, but you took an oath that you would not provide us with any means of conveyance. Did you forget (your oath when you gave us the camels)? He replied. 'I have not provided you with means of conveyance, but Allah has provided you with it, and by Allah, Allah willing, if ever I take an oath to do something, and later on I find that it is more beneficial to do something different, I will do the thing which is better, and give expiation for my oath
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ سَرِيَّةً فِيهَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ، فَغَنِمُوا إِبِلاً كَثِيرًا، فَكَانَتْ سِهَامُهُمُ اثْنَىْ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا أَوْ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا، وَنُفِّلُوا بَعِيرًا بَعِيرًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha sariyyaaan fiyhaa 'abdu alllahi qibala najdin, faghanimuwa iibilaan kathiyrana, fakaanat sihaamuhumu athnaa 'ashara ba'iyrana aaw aahada 'ashara ba'iyrana, wanuffiluwa ba'iyrana ba'iyrana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi` from Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a Sariya towards Najd, and `Abdullah bin `Umar was in the Sariya. They gained a great number of camels as war booty. The share of each one of them was twelve or eleven camels, and they were given an extra camel each
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُنَفِّلُ بَعْضَ مَنْ يَبْعَثُ مِنَ السَّرَايَا لأَنْفُسِهِمْ خَاصَّةً سِوَى قِسْمِ عَامَّةِ الْجَيْشِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yunaffilu ba'da man yab'athu mina alssaraayaa laanfusihim khaassaaan siwaa qismi 'aammaai aljayshi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to give extra share to some of the members of the Sariya he used to send, in addition to the shares they shared with the army in general
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا بُرَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَلَغَنَا مَخْرَجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ بِالْيَمَنِ فَخَرَجْنَا مُهَاجِرِينَ إِلَيْهِ، أَنَا وَأَخَوَانِ لِي، أَنَا أَصْغَرُهُمْ، أَحَدُهُمَا أَبُو بُرْدَةَ وَالآخَرُ أَبُو رُهْمٍ، إِمَّا قَالَ فِي بِضْعٍ، وَإِمَّا قَالَ فِي ثَلاَثَةٍ وَخَمْسِينَ أَوِ اثْنَيْنِ وَخَمْسِينَ رَجُلاً مِنْ قَوْمِي فَرَكِبْنَا سَفِينَةً، فَأَلْقَتْنَا سَفِينَتُنَا إِلَى النَّجَاشِيِّ بِالْحَبَشَةِ، وَوَافَقْنَا جَعْفَرَ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَأَصْحَابَهُ عِنْدَهُ فَقَالَ جَعْفَرٌ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَنَا هَا هُنَا، وَأَمَرَنَا بِالإِقَامَةِ فَأَقِيمُوا مَعَنَا‏.‏ فَأَقَمْنَا مَعَهُ، حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا جَمِيعًا، فَوَافَقْنَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ افْتَتَحَ خَيْبَرَ، فَأَسْهَمَ لَنَا‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ فَأَعْطَانَا مِنْهَا‏.‏ وَمَا قَسَمَ لأَحَدٍ غَابَ عَنْ فَتْحِ خَيْبَرَ مِنْهَا شَيْئًا، إِلاَّ لِمَنْ شَهِدَ مَعَهُ، إِلاَّ أَصْحَابَ سَفِينَتِنَا مَعَ جَعْفَرٍ وَأَصْحَابِهِ، قَسَمَ لَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa buraydu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh qaala balaghanaa makhraju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu bialyamani fakharajnaa muhaajiriyna iilayhi, aanaa waaakhawaani liy, aanaa aasgharuhum, aahaduhumaa aabuw burdaaa waalakharu aabuw ruhmin, iimmaa qaala fiy bid'in, waiimmaa qaala fiy thalaathaain wakhamsiyna aawi athnayni wakhamsiyna rajulaan min qawmiy farakibnaa safiynaaan, faaalqatnaa safiynatunaa iilaa alnnajaashiyyi bialhabashaai, wawaafaqnaa ja'fara bna aabiy taalibin waaashaabahu 'indahu faqaala ja'farun iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'athanaa haa hunaa, waaamaranaa bialiiqaamaai faaaqiymuwa ma'anaa‏.‏ faaaqamnaa ma'ahu, hattaa qadimnaa jamiy'ana, fawaafaqnaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna aftataha khaybara, faaashama lanaa‏.‏ aaw qaala faaa'taanaa minhaa‏.‏ wamaa qasama laahadin ghaaba 'an fathi khaybara minhaa shayiana, iilaaa liman shahida ma'ahu, iilaaa aashaaba safiynatinaa ma'a ja'farin waaashaabihi, qasama lahum ma'ahum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:We got the news of the migration of the Prophet (ﷺ) while we were in Yemen, so we set out migrating to him. We were, I and my two brothers, I being the youngest, and one of my brothers was Abu Burda and the other was Abu Ruhm. We were over fifty (or fifty-three or fifty two) men from our people. We got on board a ship which took us to An-Najashi in Ethiopia, and there we found Ja`far bin Abu Talib and his companions with An-Najashi. Ja`far said (to us), "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has sent us here and ordered us to stay here, so you too, stay with us." We stayed with him till we all left (Ethiopia) and met the Prophet (ﷺ) at the time when he had conquered Khaibar. He gave us a share from its booty (or gave us from its booty). He gave only to those who had taken part in the Ghazwa with him. but he did not give any share to any person who had not participated in Khaibar's conquest except the people of our ship, besides Ja`far and his companions, whom he gave a share as he did them (i.e. the people of the ship)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، سَمِعَ جَابِرًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ قَدْ جَاءَنِي مَالُ الْبَحْرَيْنِ لَقَدْ أَعْطَيْتُكَ هَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَجِئْ حَتَّى قُبِضَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ مَالُ الْبَحْرَيْنِ أَمَرَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مُنَادِيًا فَنَادَى مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَيْنٌ أَوْ عِدَةٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِي كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏ فَحَثَا لِي ثَلاَثًا ـ وَجَعَلَ سُفْيَانُ يَحْثُو بِكَفَّيْهِ جَمِيعًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَنَا هَكَذَا قَالَ لَنَا ابْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ ـ وَقَالَ مَرَّةً فَأَتَيْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَسَأَلْتُ فَلَمْ يُعْطِنِي، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ فَلَمْ يُعْطِنِي، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ الثَّالِثَةَ فَقُلْتُ سَأَلْتُكَ فَلَمْ تُعْطِنِي، ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُكَ فَلَمْ تُعْطِنِي، ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُكَ فَلَمْ تُعْطِنِي، فَإِمَّا أَنْ تُعْطِيَنِي، وَإِمَّا أَنْ تَبْخَلَ عَنِّي‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتَ تَبْخَلُ عَلَىَّ مَا مَنَعْتُكَ مِنْ مَرَّةٍ إِلاَّ وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُعْطِيَكَ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ جَابِرٍ فَحَثَا لِي حَثْيَةً وَقَالَ عُدَّهَا‏.‏ فَوَجَدْتُهَا خَمْسَمِائَةٍ قَالَ فَخُذْ مِثْلَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْمُنْكَدِرِ وَأَىُّ دَاءٍ أَدْوَأُ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almunkadiri, sami'a jaabirana rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ law qad jaa'aniy maalu albahrayni laqad aa'taytuka hakadhaa wahakadhaa wahakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ falam yajii hattaa qubida alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm, falammaa jaa'a maalu albahrayni aamara aabuw bakrin munaadiyana fanaadaa man kaana lahu 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm daynun aaw 'idaaun falyaatinaa‏.‏ faaataytuhu faqultu iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala liy kadhaa wakadhaa‏.‏ fahathaa liy thalaathana waja'ala sufyaanu yahthuw bikaffayhi jamiy'ana, thumma qaala lanaa hakadhaa qaala lanaa abnu almunkadiri waqaala marraaan faaataytu aabaa bakrin fasaaaltu falam yu'tiniy, thumma aataytuhu falam yu'tiniy, thumma aataytuhu althhaalithaaa faqultu saaaltuka falam tu'tiniy, thumma saaaltuka falam tu'tiniy, thumma saaaltuka falam tu'tiniy, faiimmaa aan tu'tiyaniy, waiimmaa aan tabkhala 'anniy‏.‏ qaala qulta tabkhalu 'alaaaa maa mana'tuka min marraain iilaaa waaanaa auriydu aan au'tiyaka‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu wahaddathanaa 'amrunw 'an muhammadi bni 'aliyyin 'an jaabirin fahathaa liy hathyaaan waqaala 'uddahaa‏.‏ fawajadtuhaa khamsamiaiaain qaala fakhudh mithlahaa marratayni‏.‏ waqaala ya'niy abna almunkadiri waaaaau daa'in aadwaau mina albukhli
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to me), "If the property of Bahrain had come to us, I would have given you so much and so much." But the Bahrain property did not come till the Prophet (ﷺ) had died. When the Bahrain property came. Abu Bakr ordered somebody to announce, "Any person who has money claim on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) or whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had promised something, should come to us." So, I went to him and said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had promised to give me so much an so much." Abu Bakr scooped up money with both hands thrice for me." (The sub-narrator Sufyan illustrated this action by scooping up with both hands and said, "Ibn Munkadir, another sub-narrator, used to illustrate it in this way.") Narrated Jabir: Once I went to Abu Bakr and asked for the money but he did not give me, and I went to him again, but he did not give me, so I went to him for the third time and said, "I asked you, but you did not give me; then I asked you (for the second time) and you did not give me; then I asked you (for the third time) but you did not give me. You should either give me or allow yourself to be considered a miser regarding my case." Abu Bakr said, "You tell me that I am a miser with regard to you. But really, whenever I rejected your request, I had the inclination to give you." (In another narration Jabir added:) So, Abu Bakr scooped up money with both hands for me and asked me to count it. I found out that It was five hundred. Abu Bakr told me to take twice that amount
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْسِمُ غَنِيمَةً بِالْجِعْرَانَةِ إِذْ قَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ اعْدِلْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ ‏ "‏ شَقِيتَ إِنْ لَمْ أَعْدِلْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa qurraau, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu diynaarin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala baynamaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqsimu ghaniymaaan bialji'raanaai iidh qaala lahu rajulun a'dil‏.‏ faqaala lahu ‏ "‏ shaqiyta iin lam aa'dil ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was distributing the booty at Al-Ji'rana, somebody said to him "Be just (in your distribution)." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Verily I would be miserable if I did not act justly
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فِي أُسَارَى بَدْرٍ ‏ "‏ لَوْ كَانَ الْمُطْعِمُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَيًّا، ثُمَّ كَلَّمَنِي فِي هَؤُلاَءِ النَّتْنَى، لَتَرَكْتُهُمْ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an muhammadi bni jubayrin, 'an aabiyhi rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fiy ausaaraa badrin ‏ "‏ law kaana almut'imu bnu 'adiyyin hayyana, thumma kallamaniy fiy hauulaa'i alnnatnaa, lataraktuhum lahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:The Prophet (ﷺ) talked about war prisoners of Badr saying, "Had Al-Mut`im bin Adi been alive and interceded with me for these mean people, I would have freed them for his sake
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، قَالَ مَشَيْتُ أَنَا وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَفَّانَ، إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَعْطَيْتَ بَنِي الْمُطَّلِبِ وَتَرَكْتَنَا، وَنَحْنُ وَهُمْ مِنْكَ بِمَنْزِلَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا بَنُو الْمُطَّلِبِ وَبَنُو هَاشِمٍ شَىْءٌ وَاحِدٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ وَزَادَ قَالَ جُبَيْرٌ وَلَمْ يَقْسِمِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِبَنِي عَبْدِ شَمْسٍ وَلاَ لِبَنِي نَوْفَلٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَبْدُ شَمْسٍ وَهَاشِمٌ وَالْمُطَّلِبُ إِخْوَةٌ لأُمٍّ، وَأُمُّهُمْ عَاتِكَةُ بِنْتُ مُرَّةَ، وَكَانَ نَوْفَلٌ أَخَاهُمْ لأَبِيهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'ani abni almusayyabi, 'an jubayri bni mut'imin, qaala mashaytu aanaa wa'uthmaanu bnu 'affaana, iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi, aa'tayta baniy almuttalibi wataraktanaa, wanahnu wahum minka bimanzilaain waahidaain‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinnamaa banuw almuttalibi wabanuw haashimin shaa'un waahidun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala alllaythu haddathaniy yuwnusu wazaada qaala jubayrun walam yaqsimi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm libaniy 'abdi shamsin walaa libaniy nawfalin‏.‏ waqaala abnu iishaaqa 'abdu shamsin wahaashimun waalmuttalibu iikhwaaun laummin, waaummuhum 'aatikaau bintu murraaa, wakaana nawfalun aakhaahum laabiyhim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:I and `Uthman bin `Affan went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have given to Bani Al-Muttalib and left us although they and we are of the same kinship to you." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Bani Muttalib and Bani Hashim are one and the same." The Prophet (ﷺ) did not give a share to Bani `Abd Shams and Bani Naufal. (Ibn 'Is-haq said, "Abd Shams and Hashim and Al-Muttalib were maternal brothers and their mother was 'Atika bint Murra and Naufal was their paternal brother)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ الْمَاجِشُونِ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ بَيْنَا أَنَا وَاقِفٌ، فِي الصَّفِّ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ فَنَظَرْتُ عَنْ يَمِينِي، وَشِمَالِي، فَإِذَا أَنَا بِغُلاَمَيْنِ، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ حَدِيثَةٍ أَسْنَانُهُمَا، تَمَنَّيْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ بَيْنَ أَضْلَعَ مِنْهُمَا، فَغَمَزَنِي أَحَدُهُمَا فَقَالَ يَا عَمِّ، هَلْ تَعْرِفُ أَبَا جَهْلٍ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ، مَا حَاجَتُكَ إِلَيْهِ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي قَالَ أُخْبِرْتُ أَنَّهُ يَسُبُّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَئِنْ رَأَيْتُهُ لاَ يُفَارِقُ سَوَادِي سَوَادَهُ حَتَّى يَمُوتَ الأَعْجَلُ مِنَّا‏.‏ فَتَعَجَّبْتُ لِذَلِكَ، فَغَمَزَنِي الآخَرُ فَقَالَ لِي مِثْلَهَا، فَلَمْ أَنْشَبْ أَنْ نَظَرْتُ إِلَى أَبِي جَهْلٍ يَجُولُ فِي النَّاسِ، قُلْتُ أَلاَ إِنَّ هَذَا صَاحِبُكُمَا الَّذِي سَأَلْتُمَانِي‏.‏ فَابْتَدَرَاهُ بِسَيْفَيْهِمَا فَضَرَبَاهُ حَتَّى قَتَلاَهُ، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَاهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُّكُمَا قَتَلَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا أَنَا قَتَلْتُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ مَسَحْتُمَا سَيْفَيْكُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالاَ لاَ‏.‏ فَنَظَرَ فِي السَّيْفَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كِلاَكُمَا قَتَلَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ سَلَبُهُ لِمُعَاذِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْجَمُوحِ‏.‏ وَكَانَا مُعَاذَ ابْنَ عَفْرَاءَ وَمُعَاذَ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْجَمُوحِ‏.‏ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ سَمِعَ يُوسُفُ صَالِحًا وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ أَبَاهُ (عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ)
verses.translit: hadaathanaa musadaadun, hadaathanaa yuwsufu bnu almaajishuwni, 'an saalihi bni iibraahiyma bni 'abdi alraahmani bni 'awfin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jadiihi, qaala baynaa aanaa waaqifun, fiy alsaafii yawma badrin fanazartu 'an yamiyniy, washimaaliy, faiidhaa aanaa bighulaamayni, mina alaansaari hadiythaain aasnaanuhumaa, tamanaaytu aan aakuwna bayna aadla'a minhumaa, faghamazaniy aahaduhumaa faqaala yaa 'amii, hal ta'rifu aabaa jahlin qultu na'am, maa haajatuka iilayhi yaa abna aakhiy qaala aukhbirtu aanaahu yasubuu rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, waalaadhiy nafsiy biyadihi laiin raaaytuhu laa yufaariqu sawaadiy sawaadahu hataaa yamuwta alaa'jalu minaaa‏.‏ fata'ajaabtu lidhalika, faghamazaniy alakharu faqaala liy mithlahaa, falam aanshab aan nazartu iilaa aabiy jahlin yajuwlu fiy alnaaasi, qultu aalaa iinaa hadhaa saahibukumaa alaadhiy saaaltumaaniy‏.‏ faabtadaraahu bisayfayhimaa fadarabaahu hataaa qatalaahu, thumaa ansarafaa iilaa rasuwli allaahu sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbaraahu faqaala ‏"‏ aayuukumaa qatalahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala kuluu waahidin minhumaa aanaa qataltuhu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ hal masahtumaa sayfaykumaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalaa laa‏.‏ fanazara fiy alsaayfayni faqaala ‏"‏ kilaakumaa qatalahu ‏"‏‏.‏ salabuhu limu'aadhi bni 'amriw bni aljamuwhi‏.‏ wakaanaa mu'aadha abna 'afraa'a wamu'aadha bna 'amriw bni aljamuwhi‏.‏ qaala muhamaadun sami'a yuwsufu saalihana waiibraahiyma aabaahu ('abdi alraahmani bni 'awfin)
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf:While I was standing in the row on the day (of the battle) of Badr, I looked to my right and my left and saw two young Ansari boys, and I wished I had been stronger than they. One of them called my attention saying, "O Uncle! Do you know Abu Jahl?" I said, "Yes, What do you want from him, O my nephew?" He said, "I have been informed that he abuses Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). By Him in Whose Hands my life is, if I should see him, then my body will not leave his body till either of us meet his fate." I was astonished at that talk. Then the other boy called my attention saying the same as the other had said. After a while I saw Abu Jahl walking amongst the people. I said (to the boys), "Look! This is the man you asked me about." So, both of them attacked him with their swords and struck him to death and returned to Allah'S Apostle to inform him of that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "Which of you has killed him?" Each of them said, "I Have killed him." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "Have you cleaned your swords?" They said, "No. " He then looked at their swords and said, "No doubt, you both have killed him and the spoils of the deceased will be given to Mu`adh bin `Amr bin Al-Jamuh." The two boys were Mu`adh bin 'Afra and Mu`adh bin `Amr bin Al-Jamuh
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 57 — One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَفْلَحَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ حُنَيْنٍ، فَلَمَّا الْتَقَيْنَا كَانَتْ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ جَوْلَةٌ، فَرَأَيْتُ رَجُلاً مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ عَلاَ رَجُلاً مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَاسْتَدَرْتُ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُهُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ حَتَّى ضَرَبْتُهُ بِالسَّيْفِ عَلَى حَبْلِ عَاتِقِهِ، فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَىَّ فَضَمَّنِي ضَمَّةً وَجَدْتُ مِنْهَا رِيحَ الْمَوْتِ، ثُمَّ أَدْرَكَهُ الْمَوْتُ فَأَرْسَلَنِي، فَلَحِقْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَقُلْتُ مَا بَالُ النَّاسِ قَالَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ النَّاسَ رَجَعُوا، وَجَلَسَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ قَتَلَ قَتِيلاً لَهُ عَلَيْهِ بَيِّنَةٌ فَلَهُ سَلَبُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ فَقُلْتُ مَنْ يَشْهَدُ لِي ثُمَّ جَلَسْتُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ قَتَلَ قَتِيلاً لَهُ عَلَيْهِ بَيِّنَةٌ فَلَهُ سَلَبُهُ ‏"‏ فَقُمْتُ فَقُلْتُ مَنْ يَشْهَدُ لِي ثُمَّ جَلَسْتُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ الثَّالِثَةَ مِثْلَهُ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ صَدَقَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَسَلَبُهُ عِنْدِي فَأَرْضِهِ عَنِّي‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ ـ رضى الله عنه لاَهَا اللَّهِ إِذًا يَعْمِدُ إِلَى أَسَدٍ مِنْ أُسْدِ اللَّهِ يُقَاتِلُ عَنِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعْطِيكَ سَلَبَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ صَدَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَعْطَاهُ فَبِعْتُ الدِّرْعَ، فَابْتَعْتُ بِهِ مَخْرِفًا فِي بَنِي سَلِمَةَ، فَإِنَّهُ لأَوَّلُ مَالٍ تَأَثَّلْتُهُ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ‏.‏
