verses.translation: Narrated Jarir:as below. Narrated Humaid bin Hilal: Anas bin Malik said, "As if I see a cloud of dust swirling up in the lane of Bani Ghanim." Musa added, "That was caused by the procession of Gabriel
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ الْحَارِثَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَيْفَ يَأْتِيكَ الْوَحْىُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُّ ذَاكَ يَأْتِي الْمَلَكُ أَحْيَانًا فِي مِثْلِ صَلْصَلَةِ الْجَرَسِ، فَيَفْصِمُ عَنِّي وَقَدْ وَعَيْتُ مَا قَالَ، وَهْوَ أَشَدُّهُ عَلَىَّ، وَيَتَمَثَّلُ لِي الْمَلَكُ أَحْيَانًا رَجُلاً، فَيُكَلِّمُنِي فَأَعِي مَا يَقُولُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa farwaau, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna alhaaritha bna hishaamin, saaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kayfa yaatiyka alwahau qaala ‏ "‏ kullu dhaaka yaatiy almalaku aahyaanana fiy mithli salsalaai aljarasi, fayafsimu 'anniy waqad wa'aytu maa qaala, wahwa aashadduhu 'alaaaa, wayatamathhalu liy almalaku aahyaanana rajulaan, fayukallimuniy faaa'iy maa yaquwlu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Al Harith bin Hisham asked the Prophet, "How does the divine inspiration come to you?" He replied, "In all these ways: The Angel sometimes comes to me with a voice which resembles the sound of a ringing bell, and when this state abandons me, I remember what the Angel has said, and this type of Divine Inspiration is the hardest on me; and sometimes the Angel comes to me in the shape of a man and talks to me, and I understand and remember what he says
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَنْفَقَ زَوْجَيْنِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ دَعَتْهُ خَزَنَةُ الْجَنَّةِ أَىْ فُلُ هَلُمَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ذَاكَ الَّذِي لاَ تَوَى عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرْجُو أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shaybaanu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ man aanfaqa zawjayni fiy sabiyli alllahi da'athu khazanaau aljannaai aaa fulu halumma ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin dhaaka alladhiy laa tawaa 'alayhi‏.‏ qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aarjuw aan takuwna minhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Who ever spends a couple (of objects) in Allah's cause, will be called by the Gatekeepers of Paradise who will say, "O so-and-so, come on!" Abu Bakr said, "Such a person will never perish or be miserable' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I hope you will be among such person
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهَا ‏ "‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ، هَذَا جِبْرِيلُ يَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكِ السَّلاَمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ‏.‏ تَرَى مَا لاَ أَرَى‏.‏ تُرِيدُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa hishaamun, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lahaa ‏ "‏ yaa 'aaiishaau, hadhaa jibriylu yaqraau 'alayki alssalaama ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaalat wa'alayhi alssalaamu warahmaau alllahi wabarakaatuhu‏.‏ taraa maa laa aaraa‏.‏ turiydu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Salama:`Aisha said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to her "O `Aisha' This is Gabriel and he sends his (greetings) salutations to you." `Aisha said, "Salutations (Greetings) to him, and Allah's Mercy and Blessings be on him," and addressing the Prophet (ﷺ) she said, "You see what I don't see
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ ذَرٍّ، ح قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ ذَرٍّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِجِبْرِيلَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ تَزُورُنَا أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا تَزُورُنَا ‏"‏ قَالَ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلاَّ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu dharrin, h qaala haddathaniy yahyaa bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an 'umara bni dharrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lijibriyla ‏"‏ aalaa tazuwrunaa aakthara mimmaa tazuwrunaa ‏"‏ qaala fanazalat ‏{‏wamaa natanazzalu iilaaa biaamri rabbika lahu maa bayna aaydiynaa wamaa khalfanaa‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked Gabriel, "Why don't you visit us more often than you do?" Then the following Holy Verse was revealed (in this respect):-- "And we (angels) descend not but by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between those two and your Lord was never forgetful
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقْرَأَنِي جِبْرِيلُ عَلَى حَرْفٍ، فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أَسْتَزِيدُهُ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَى سَبْعَةِ أَحْرُفٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy sulaymaanu, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aaqraaaniy jibriylu 'alaa harfin, falam aazal aastaziyduhu hattaa antahaa iilaa sab'aai aahrufin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Gabriel read the Qur'an to me in one way (i.e. dialect) and I continued asking him to read it in different ways till he read it in seven different ways
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَجْوَدَ النَّاسِ، وَكَانَ أَجْوَدَ مَا يَكُونُ فِي رَمَضَانَ حِينَ يَلْقَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ، وَكَانَ جِبْرِيلُ يَلْقَاهُ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ، فَيُدَارِسُهُ الْقُرْآنَ، فَلَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ يَلْقَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ أَجْوَدُ بِالْخَيْرِ مِنَ الرِّيحِ الْمُرْسَلَةِ‏.‏ وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ‏.‏ وَرَوَى أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ وَفَاطِمَةُ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ كَانَ يُعَارِضُهُ الْقُرْآنَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aajwada alnnaasi, wakaana aajwada maa yakuwnu fiy ramadaana hiyna yalqaahu jibriylu, wakaana jibriylu yalqaahu fiy kulli laylaain min ramadaana, fayudaarisuhu alqurana, falarasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna yalqaahu jibriylu aajwadu bialkhayri mina alrriyhi almursalaai‏.‏ wa'an 'abdi alllahi haddathanaa ma'marun bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu‏.‏ warawaa aabuw hurayraaa wafaatimaau rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna jibriyla kaana yu'aariduhu alqurana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was the most generous of all the people, and he used to be more generous in the month of Ramadan when Gabriel used to meet him. Gabriel used to meet him every night in Ramadan to study the Holy Qur'an carefully together. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to become more generous than the fast wind when he met Gabriel
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، أَخَّرَ الْعَصْرَ شَيْئًا فَقَالَ لَهُ عُرْوَةُ أَمَا إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ قَدْ نَزَلَ فَصَلَّى أَمَامَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ اعْلَمْ مَا تَقُولُ يَا عُرْوَةُ‏.‏ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ بَشِيرَ بْنَ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ نَزَلَ جِبْرِيلُ فَأَمَّنِي، فَصَلَّيْتُ مَعَهُ، ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَهُ، ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَهُ، ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَهُ، ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ يَحْسُبُ بِأَصَابِعِهِ خَمْسَ صَلَوَاتٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna 'umara bna 'abdi al'aziyzi, aakhhara al'asra shayiana faqaala lahu 'urwaau aamaa iinna jibriyla qad nazala fasallaa aamaama rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru a'lam maa taquwlu yaa 'urwaau‏.‏ qaala sami'tu bashiyra bna aabiy mas'uwdin yaquwlu sami'tu aabaa mas'uwdin yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ nazala jibriylu faaammaniy, fasallaytu ma'ahu, thumma sallaytu ma'ahu, thumma sallaytu ma'ahu, thumma sallaytu ma'ahu, thumma sallaytu ma'ahu ‏"‏‏.‏ yahsubu biaasaabi'ihi khamsa salawaatin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Shihab:Once `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz delayed the `Asr prayer a little. `Urwa said to him, "Gabriel descended and led the prayer in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) " On that `Umar said, "O `Urwa! Be sure of what you say." "Urwa said, "I heard Bashir bin Abi Masud narrating from Ibn Masud who heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'Gabriel descended and led me in prayer; and then prayed with him again, and then prayed with him again, and then prayed with him again, and then prayed with him again, counting with his fingers five prayers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قَالَ لِي جِبْرِيلُ مَنْ مَاتَ مِنْ أُمَّتِكَ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ، أَوْ لَمْ يَدْخُلِ النَّارَ، قَالَ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قَالَ وَإِنْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an habiybi bni aabiy thaabitin, 'an zaydi bni wahbin, 'an aabiy dharrin rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ qaala liy jibriylu man maata min aummatika laa yushriku bialllahi shayiana dakhala aljannaaa, aaw lam yadkhuli alnnaara, qaala waiin zanaa waiin saraqa qaala waiin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Dhar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Gabriel said to me, 'Whoever amongst your followers dies without having worshipped others besides Allah, will enter Paradise (or will not enter the (Hell) Fire)." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked. "Even if he has committed illegal sexual intercourse or theft?" He replied, "Even then
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ يَتَعَاقَبُونَ، مَلاَئِكَةٌ بِاللَّيْلِ وَمَلاَئِكَةٌ بِالنَّهَارِ، وَيَجْتَمِعُونَ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ، ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ الَّذِينَ بَاتُوا فِيكُمْ، فَيَسْأَلُهُمْ وَهْوَ أَعْلَمُ، فَيَقُولُ كَيْفَ تَرَكْتُمْ ‏{‏عِبَادِي‏}‏ فَيَقُولُونَ تَرَكْنَاهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ، وَأَتَيْنَاهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ almalaaiikaau yata'aaqabuwna, malaaiikaaun bialllayli wamalaaiikaaun bialnnahaari, wayajtami'uwna fiy salaaai alfajri waal'asri, thumma ya'ruju iilayhi alladhiyna baatuwa fiykum, fayasaaluhum wahwa aa'lamu, fayaquwlu kayfa taraktum ‏{‏'ibaadiy‏}‏ fayaquwluwna taraknaahum yusalluwna, waaataynaahum yusalluwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Angels keep on descending from and ascending to the Heaven in turn, some at night and some by daytime, and all of them assemble together at the time of the Fajr and `Asr prayers. Then those who have stayed with you over-night, ascend unto Allah Who asks them, and He knows the answer better than they, "How have you left My slaves?" They reply, "We have left them praying as we found them praying." If anyone of you says "Amin" (during the Prayer at the end of the recitation of Surat-al-Fatiha), and the angels in Heaven say the same, and the two sayings coincide, all his past sins will be forgiven
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، أَنَّ نَافِعًا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ حَشَوْتُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وِسَادَةً فِيهَا تَمَاثِيلُ كَأَنَّهَا نُمْرُقَةٌ، فَجَاءَ فَقَامَ بَيْنَ الْبَابَيْنِ وَجَعَلَ يَتَغَيَّرُ وَجْهُهُ، فَقُلْتُ مَا لَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ هَذِهِ الْوِسَادَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ وِسَادَةٌ جَعَلْتُهَا لَكَ لِتَضْطَجِعَ عَلَيْهَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا عَلِمْتِ أَنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ لاَ تَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ صُورَةٌ، وَأَنَّ مَنْ صَنَعَ الصُّورَةَ يُعَذَّبُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَقُولُ أَحْيُوا مَا خَلَقْتُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, aakhbaranaa makhladun, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aumayyaaa, aanna naafi'ana, haddathahu aanna alqaasima bna muhammadin haddathahu 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat hashawtu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wisaadaaan fiyhaa tamaathiylu kaaannahaa numruqaaun, fajaa'a faqaama bayna albaabayni waja'ala yataghayyaru wajhuhu, faqultu maa lanaa yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ maa baalu hadhihi alwisaadaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat wisaadaaun ja'altuhaa laka litadtaji'a 'alayhaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aamaa 'alimti aanna almalaaiikaaa laa tadkhulu baytana fiyhi suwraaun, waaanna man sana'a alssuwraaa yu'adhhabu yawma alqiyaamaai yaquwlu aahyuwa maa khalaqtum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I stuffed for the Prophet (ﷺ) a pillow decorated with pictures (of animals) which looked like a Namruqa (i.e. a small cushion). He came and stood between the two doors and his face began to change. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What did we do wrong?" He said, "What is this pillow?" I said, "I have prepared this pillow for you, so that you may recline on it." He said, "Don't you know that angels do not enter a house wherein there are pictures; and whoever makes a picture will be punished on the Day of Resurrection and will be asked to give life to (what he has created)?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلاَ صُورَةُ تَمَاثِيلَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, aannahu sami'a abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu sami'tu aabaa talhaaa, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa tadkhulu almalaaiikaau baytana fiyhi kalbun walaa suwraau tamaathiyla ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Talha:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying; "Angels (of Mercy) do not enter a house wherein there is a dog or a picture of a living creature (a human being or an animal)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ بُكَيْرَ بْنَ الأَشَجِّ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ بُسْرَ بْنَ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ وَمَعَ، بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ الْخَوْلاَنِيُّ الَّذِي كَانَ فِي حَجْرِ مَيْمُونَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَهُمَا زَيْدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ أَنَّ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ صُورَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ بُسْرٌ فَمَرِضَ زَيْدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، فَعُدْنَاهُ فَإِذَا نَحْنُ فِي بَيْتِهِ بِسِتْرٍ فِيهِ تَصَاوِيرُ، فَقُلْتُ لِعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ أَلَمْ يُحَدِّثْنَا فِي التَّصَاوِيرِ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِلاَّ رَقْمٌ فِي ثَوْبٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَلاَ سَمِعْتَهُ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ بَلَى قَدْ ذَكَرَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa 'amrunw, aanna bukayra bna alaashajji, haddathahu aanna busra bna sa'iydin haddathahu aanna zayda bna khaalidin aljuhaniyya rda allh 'nh haddathahu wama'a, busri bni sa'iydin 'ubaydu alllahi alkhawlaaniyyu alladhiy kaana fiy hajri maymuwnaaa rda allh 'nha zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm haddathahumaa zaydu bnu khaalidin aanna aabaa talhaaa haddathahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa tadkhulu almalaaiikaau baytana fiyhi suwraaun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala busrun famarida zaydu bnu khaalidin, fa'udnaahu faiidhaa nahnu fiy baytihi bisitrin fiyhi tasaawiyru, faqultu li'ubaydi alllahi alkhawlaaniyyi aalam yuhaddithnaa fiy alttasaawiyri faqaala iinnahu qaala ‏"‏ iilaaa raqmun fiy thawbin ‏"‏‏.‏ aalaa sami'tahu qultu laa‏.‏ qaala balaa qad dhakarahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Busr bin Sa`id:That Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani narrated to him something in the presence of Sa`id bin 'Ubaidullah Al- Khaulani who was brought up in the house of Maimuna the wife of the Prophet. Zaid narrated to them that Abu Talha said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Angels (of Mercy) do not enter a house wherein there is a picture." Busr said, "Later on Zaid bin Khalid fell ill and we called on him. To our surprise we saw a curtain decorated with pictures in his house. I said to Ubaidullah Al-Khaulani, "Didn't he (i.e. Zaid) tell us about the (prohibition of) pictures?" He said, "But he excepted the embroidery on garments. Didn't you hear him?" I said, "No." He said, "Yes, he did
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ وَعَدَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جِبْرِيلُ فَقَالَ إِنَّا لاَ نَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ صُورَةٌ وَلاَ كَلْبٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, qaala haddathaniy abnu wahbin, qaala haddathaniy 'umaru, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala wa'ada alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm jibriylu faqaala iinnaa laa nadkhulu baytana fiyhi suwraaun walaa kalbun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salim's father:Once Gabriel promised the Prophet (that he would visit him, but Gabriel did not come) and later on he said, "We, angels, do not enter a house which contains a picture or a dog
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا قَالَ الإِمَامُ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ وَافَقَ قَوْلُهُ قَوْلَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an sumaaain, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa qaala aliimaamu sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu‏.‏ faquwluwa alllahumma rabbanaa laka alhamdu, faiinnahu man waafaqa qawluhu qawla almalaaiikaai, ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Imam, during the prayer, says, "Allah hears him who praises Him', say: 'O Allah! Our Lord! All the praises are for You/, for if the saying of anyone of you coincides with the saying of the angels, his past sins will be forgiven
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُلَيْحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ فِي صَلاَةٍ مَا دَامَتِ الصَّلاَةُ تَحْبِسُهُ، وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُ تَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ‏.‏ مَا لَمْ يَقُمْ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ أَوْ يُحْدِثْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fulayhin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an hilaali bni 'aliyyin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy 'amraaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna aahadakum fiy salaaain maa daamati alssalaaau tahbisuhu, waalmalaaiikaau taquwlu alllahumma aghfir lahu waarhamhu‏.‏ maa lam yaqum min salaatihi aaw yuhdith ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "As long as any-one of you is waiting for the prayer, he is considered to be praying actually, and the angels say, 'O Allah! Be merciful to him and forgive him', (and go on saying so) unless he leaves his place of praying or passes wind (i.e. breaks his ablution)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَعْلَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏{‏وَنَادَوْا يَا مَالِكُ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ فِي قِرَاءَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَنَادَوْا يَا مَالِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an safwaana bni ya'laa, 'an aabiyhi rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau 'alaa alminbari ‏{‏wanaadawa yaa maaliku‏}‏‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu fiy qiraa'aai 'abdi alllahi wanaadawa yaa maali‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Yali:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting the following Verse on the pulpit: "They will call: O Malik...' and Sufyan said that `Abdullah recited it: 'They will call: O Mali
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَلْ أَتَى عَلَيْكَ يَوْمٌ كَانَ أَشَدَّ مِنْ يَوْمِ أُحُدٍ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَقَدْ لَقِيتُ مِنْ قَوْمِكِ مَا لَقِيتُ، وَكَانَ أَشَدُّ مَا لَقِيتُ مِنْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْعَقَبَةِ، إِذْ عَرَضْتُ نَفْسِي عَلَى ابْنِ عَبْدِ يَالِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ كُلاَلٍ، فَلَمْ يُجِبْنِي إِلَى مَا أَرَدْتُ، فَانْطَلَقْتُ وَأَنَا مَهْمُومٌ عَلَى وَجْهِي، فَلَمْ أَسْتَفِقْ إِلاَّ وَأَنَا بِقَرْنِ الثَّعَالِبِ، فَرَفَعْتُ رَأْسِي، فَإِذَا أَنَا بِسَحَابَةٍ قَدْ أَظَلَّتْنِي، فَنَظَرْتُ فَإِذَا فِيهَا جِبْرِيلُ فَنَادَانِي فَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ سَمِعَ قَوْلَ قَوْمِكَ لَكَ وَمَا رَدُّوا عَلَيْكَ، وَقَدْ بَعَثَ إِلَيْكَ مَلَكَ الْجِبَالِ لِتَأْمُرَهُ بِمَا شِئْتَ فِيهِمْ، فَنَادَانِي مَلَكُ الْجِبَالِ، فَسَلَّمَ عَلَىَّ ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ، فَقَالَ ذَلِكَ فِيمَا شِئْتَ، إِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ أُطْبِقَ عَلَيْهِمِ الأَخْشَبَيْنِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَلْ أَرْجُو أَنْ يُخْرِجَ اللَّهُ مِنْ أَصْلاَبِهِمْ مَنْ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ وَحْدَهُ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy 'urwaau, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm haddathathu aannahaa qaalat lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hal aataa 'alayka yawmun kaana aashadda min yawmi auhudin qaala ‏ "‏ laqad laqiytu min qawmiki maa laqiytu, wakaana aashaddu maa laqiytu minhum yawma al'aqabaai, iidh 'aradtu nafsiy 'alaa abni 'abdi yaaliyla bni 'abdi kulaalin, falam yujibniy iilaa maa aaradtu, faantalaqtu waaanaa mahmuwmun 'alaa wajhiy, falam aastafiq iilaaa waaanaa biqarni althha'aalibi, farafa'tu raasiy, faiidhaa aanaa bisahaabaain qad aazallatniy, fanazartu faiidhaa fiyhaa jibriylu fanaadaaniy faqaala iinna alllaha qad sami'a qawla qawmika laka wamaa radduwa 'alayka, waqad ba'atha iilayka malaka aljibaali litaamurahu bimaa shiita fiyhim, fanaadaaniy malaku aljibaali, fasallama 'alaaaa thumma qaala yaa muhammadu, faqaala dhalika fiymaa shiita, iin shiita aan autbiqa 'alayhimi alaakhshabayni, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bal aarjuw aan yukhrija alllahu min aaslaabihim man ya'budu alllaha wahdahu laa yushriku bihi shayiana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:That she asked the Prophet (ﷺ) , 'Have you encountered a day harder than the day of the battle) of Uhud?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Your tribes have troubled me a lot, and the worse trouble was the trouble on the day of 'Aqaba when I presented myself to Ibn `Abd-Yalail bin `Abd-Kulal and he did not respond to my demand. So I departed, overwhelmed with excessive sorrow, and proceeded on, and could not relax till I found myself at Qarnath-Tha-alib where I lifted my head towards the sky to see a cloud shading me unexpectedly. I looked up and saw Gabriel in it. He called me saying, 'Allah has heard your people's saying to you, and what they have replied back to you, Allah has sent the Angel of the Mountains to you so that you may order him to do whatever you wish to these people.' The Angel of the Mountains called and greeted me, and then said, "O Muhammad! Order what you wish. If you like, I will let Al-Akh-Shabain (i.e. two mountains) fall on them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No but I hope that Allah will let them beget children who will worship Allah Alone, and will worship None besides Him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ زِرَّ بْنَ حُبَيْشٍ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ، تَعَالَى ‏{‏فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَى * فَأَوْحَى إِلَى عَبْدِهِ مَا أَوْحَى‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ أَنَّهُ رَأَى جِبْرِيلَ لَهُ سِتُّمِائَةِ جَنَاحٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa alshhaybaaniyyu, qaala saaaltu zirra bna hubayshin 'an qawli alllahi, ta'aalaa ‏{‏fakaana qaaba qawsayni aaw aadnaa * faaawhaa iilaa 'abdihi maa aawhaa‏}‏‏.‏ qaala haddathanaa abnu mas'uwdin aannahu raaaa jibriyla lahu sittumiaiaai janaahin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq-Ash-Shaibani:I asked Zir bin Hubaish regarding the Statement of Allah: "And was at a distance Of but two bowlengths Or (even) nearer; So did (Allah) convey The Inspiration to His slave (Gabriel) and then he (Gabriel) Conveyed (that to Muhammad). (53.9-10) On that, Zir said, "Ibn Mas`ud informed us that the Prophet (ﷺ) had seen Gabriel having 600 wings
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه – ‏{‏لَقَدْ رَأَى مِنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرَى‏}‏ قَالَ رَأَى رَفْرَفًا أَخْضَرَ سَدَّ أُفُقَ السَّمَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh – ‏{‏laqad raaaa min ayaati rabbihi alkubraa‏}‏ qaala raaaa rafrafana aakhdara sadda aufuqa alssamaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:Regarding the Verse: "Indeed he (Muhammad) did see. Of the Signs of his Lord, The Greatest!" (53.18) That the Prophet (ﷺ) had seen a green carpet spread all over the horizon of the sky
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا الْقَاسِمُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ مَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَأَى رَبَّهُ فَقَدْ أَعْظَمَ، وَلَكِنْ قَدْ رَأَى جِبْرِيلَ فِي صُورَتِهِ، وَخَلْقُهُ سَادٌّ مَا بَيْنَ الأُفُقِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyu, 'ani abni 'awnin, aanbaaanaa alqaasimu, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat man za'ama aanna muhammadana raaaa rabbahu faqad aa'zama, walakin qad raaaa jibriyla fiy suwratihi, wakhalquhu saaddun maa bayna alaufuqi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Whoever claimed that (the Prophet) Muhammad saw his Lord, is committing a great fault, for he only saw Gabriel in his genuine shape in which he was created covering the whole horizon
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ الأَشْوَعِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فَأَيْنَ قَوْلُهُ ‏{‏ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّى * فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَى‏}‏ قَالَتْ ذَاكَ جِبْرِيلُ كَانَ يَأْتِيهِ فِي صُورَةِ الرَّجُلِ، وَإِنَّهُ أَتَاهُ هَذِهِ الْمَرَّةَ فِي صُورَتِهِ الَّتِي هِيَ صُورَتُهُ، فَسَدَّ الأُفُقَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'ani abni alaashwa'i, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an masruwqin, qaala qultu li'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha faaayna qawluhu ‏{‏thumma danaa fatadallaa * fakaana qaaba qawsayni aaw aadnaa‏}‏ qaalat dhaaka jibriylu kaana yaatiyhi fiy suwraai alrrajuli, waiinnahu aataahu hadhihi almarraaa fiy suwratihi allatiy hiya suwratuhu, fasadda alaufuqa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Masruq:I asked Aisha "What about His Statement:-- "Then he (Gabriel) approached And came closer, And was at a distance Of but two bow-lengths Or (even) nearer?" (53.8-9) She replied, "It was Gabriel who used to come to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the figure of a man, but on that occasion, he came in his actual and real figure and (he was so huge) that he covered the whole horizon
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ رَأَيْتُ اللَّيْلَةَ رَجُلَيْنِ أَتَيَانِي قَالاَ الَّذِي يُوقِدُ النَّارَ مَالِكٌ خَازِنُ النَّارِ، وَأَنَا جِبْرِيلُ، وَهَذَا مِيكَائِيلُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, haddathanaa aabuw rajaa'in, 'an samuraaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ raaaytu alllaylaaa rajulayni aatayaaniy qaalaa alladhiy yuwqidu alnnaara maalikun khaazinu alnnaari, waaanaa jibriylu, wahadhaa miykaaiiylu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Samura:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Last night I saw (in a dream) two men coming to me. One of them said, "The person who kindles the fire is Malik, the gate-keeper of the (Hell) Fire, and I am Gabriel, and this is Michael
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا دَعَا الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَأَبَتْ، فَبَاتَ غَضْبَانَ عَلَيْهَا، لَعَنَتْهَا الْمَلاَئِكَةُ حَتَّى تُصْبِحَ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ شُعْبَةُ وَأَبُو حَمْزَةَ وَابْنُ دَاوُدَ وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa da'aa alrrajulu amraaatahu iilaa firaashihi faaabat, fabaata ghadbaana 'alayhaa, la'anathaa almalaaiikaau hattaa tusbiha ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu shu'baau waaabuw hamzaaa waabnu daawuda waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa 'ani alaa'mashi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a husband calls his wife to his bed (i.e. to have sexual relation) and she refuses and causes him to sleep in anger, the angels will curse her till morning
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ فَتَرَ عَنِّي الْوَحْىُ فَتْرَةً، فَبَيْنَا أَنَا أَمْشِي سَمِعْتُ صَوْتًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، فَرَفَعْتُ بَصَرِي قِبَلَ السَّمَاءِ فَإِذَا الْمَلَكُ الَّذِي جَاءَنِي بِحِرَاءٍ قَاعِدٌ عَلَى كُرْسِيٍّ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ، فَجُئِثْتُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى هَوَيْتُ إِلَى الأَرْضِ، فَجِئْتُ أَهْلِي فَقُلْتُ زَمِّلُونِي زَمِّلُونِي‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ‏}‏ إِلَى ‏{‏فَاهْجُرْ‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ وَالرِّجْزُ الأَوْثَانُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylun, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala sami'tu aabaa salamaaa, qaala aakhbaraniy jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ thumma fatara 'anniy alwahau fatraaan, fabaynaa aanaa aamshiy sami'tu sawtana mina alssamaa'i, farafa'tu basariy qibala alssamaa'i faiidhaa almalaku alladhiy jaa'aniy bihiraa'in qaa'idun 'alaa kursiyyin bayna alssamaa'i waalaardi, fajuiithtu minhu hattaa hawaytu iilaa alaardi, fajiitu aahliy faqultu zammiluwniy zammiluwniy‏.‏ faaanzala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa almuddathhiru‏}‏ iilaa ‏{‏faahjur‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw salamaaa waalrrijzu alaawthaanu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The Divine Inspiration was delayed for a short period but suddenly, as I was walking. I heard a voice in the sky, and when I looked up towards the sky, to my surprise, I saw the angel who had come to me in the Hira Cave, and he was sitting on a chair in between the sky and the earth. I was so frightened by him that I fell on the ground and came to my family and said (to them), 'Cover me! (with a blanket), cover me!' Then Allah sent the Revelation: "O, You wrapped up (In a blanket)! (Arise and warn! And your Lord magnify And keep pure your garments, And desert the idols)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ لِي خَلِيفَةُ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَمِّ، نَبِيِّكُمْ يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ رَأَيْتُ لَيْلَةَ أُسْرِيَ بِي مُوسَى رَجُلاً آدَمَ طُوَالاً جَعْدًا، كَأَنَّهُ مِنْ رِجَالِ شَنُوءَةَ، وَرَأَيْتُ عِيسَى رَجُلاً مَرْبُوعًا مَرْبُوعَ الْخَلْقِ إِلَى الْحُمْرَةِ وَالْبَيَاضِ، سَبْطَ الرَّأْسِ، وَرَأَيْتُ مَالِكًا خَازِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَالدَّجَّالَ فِي آيَاتٍ أَرَاهُنَّ اللَّهُ إِيَّاهُ، فَلاَ تَكُنْ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْ لِقَائِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ وَأَبُو بَكْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَحْرُسُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ الْمَدِينَةَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, ‏.‏ waqaala liy khaliyfaau haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy al'aaliyaai, haddathanaa abnu 'ammi, nabiyyikum ya'niy abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ raaaytu laylaaa ausriya biy muwsaa rajulaan adama tuwaalaan ja'dana, kaaannahu min rijaali shanuw'aaa, waraaaytu 'iysaa rajulaan marbuw'ana marbuw'a alkhalqi iilaa alhumraai waalbayaadi, sabta alrraasi, waraaaytu maalikana khaazina alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ waalddajjaala fiy ayaatin aaraahunna alllahu iiyyaahu, falaa takun fiy miryaain min liqaaiihi‏.‏ qaala aanasun waaabuw bakraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tahrusu almalaaiikaau almadiynaaa mina alddajjaali ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On the night of my Ascent to the Heaven, I saw Moses who was a tall brown curlyhaired man as if he was one of the men of Shan'awa tribe, and I saw Jesus, a man of medium height and moderate complexion inclined to the red and white colors and of lank hair. I also saw Malik, the gate-keeper of the (Hell) Fire and Ad-Dajjal amongst the signs which Allah showed me." (The Prophet then recited the Holy Verse): "So be not you in doubt of meeting him' when you met Moses during the night of Mi'raj over the heavens" (32.23) Narrated Anas and Abu Bakra: "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The angels will guard Medina from Ad-Dajjal (who will not be able to enter the city of Medina)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا مَاتَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ يُعْرَضُ عَلَيْهِ مَقْعَدُهُ بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ، فَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ فَمِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa alllaythu bnu sa'din, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa maata aahadukum faiinnahu yu'radu 'alayhi maq'aduhu bialghadaaai waal'ashiyyi, faiin kaana min aahli aljannaai famin aahli aljannaai, waiin kaana min aahli alnnaari famin aahli alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you dies, he will be shown his destination both in the morning and in the evening, and if he belongs to the people of Paradise, he will be shown his place in Paradise, and if he is from the people of Hell, he will be shown his place in Hell
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلْمُ بْنُ زَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اطَّلَعْتُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَرَأَيْتُ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِهَا الْفُقَرَاءَ، وَاطَّلَعْتُ فِي النَّارِ فَرَأَيْتُ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِهَا النِّسَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa salmu bnu zariyrin, haddathanaa aabuw rajaa'in, 'an 'imraana bni husaynin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ attala'tu fiy aljannaai faraaaytu aakthara aahlihaa alfuqaraa'a, waattala'tu fiy alnnaari faraaaytu aakthara aahlihaa alnnisaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I looked at Paradise and found poor people forming the majority of its inhabitants; and I looked at Hell and saw that the majority of its inhabitants were women
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَيْنَا نَحْنُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ قَالَ ‏ "‏ بَيْنَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ رَأَيْتُنِي فِي الْجَنَّةِ، فَإِذَا امْرَأَةٌ تَتَوَضَّأُ إِلَى جَانِبِ قَصْرٍ، فَقُلْتُ لِمَنْ هَذَا الْقَصْرُ فَقَالُوا لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، فَذَكَرْتُ غَيْرَتَهُ، فَوَلَّيْتُ مُدْبِرًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَبَكَى عُمَرُ وَقَالَ أَعَلَيْكَ أَغَارُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, haddathanaa alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylun, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala baynaa nahnu 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh qaala ‏ "‏ baynaa aanaa naaiimun raaaytuniy fiy aljannaai, faiidhaa amraaaaun tatawaddaau iilaa jaanibi qasrin, faqultu liman hadhaa alqasru faqaaluwa li'umara bni alkhattaabi, fadhakartu ghayratahu, fawallaytu mudbirana ‏"‏‏.‏ fabakaa 'umaru waqaala aa'alayka aaghaaru yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:While we were in the company of the Prophet, he said, "While I was asleep, I saw myself in Paradise and there I beheld a woman making ablution beside a palace, I asked, To whom does this palace belong? 'They said, To `Umar bin Al-Khattab.' Then I remembered `Umar's Ghaira (concerning women), and so I quickly went away from that palace." (When `Umar heard this from the Prophet), he wept and said, "Do you think it is likely that I feel Ghaira because of you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيَّ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ الأَشْعَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْخَيْمَةُ دُرَّةٌ مُجَوَّفَةٌ، طُولُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ ثَلاَثُونَ مِيلاً، فِي كُلِّ زَاوِيَةٍ مِنْهَا لِلْمُؤْمِنِ أَهْلٌ لاَ يَرَاهُمُ الآخَرُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ وَالْحَارِثُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ سِتُّونَ مِيلاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa hammaamun, qaala sami'tu aabaa 'imraana aljawniyya, yuhaddithu 'an aabiy bakri bni 'abdi alllahi bni qaysin alaash'ariyyi, 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alkhaymaau durraaun mujawwafaaun, tuwluhaa fiy alssamaa'i thalaathuwna miylaan, fiy kulli zaawiyaain minhaa lilmuumini aahlun laa yaraahumu alakharuwna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alssamadi waalhaarithu bnu 'ubaydin 'an aabiy 'imraana sittuwna miylaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Qais Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A tent (in Paradise) is like a hollow pearl which is thirty miles in height and on every corner of the tent the believer will have a family that cannot be seen by the others." (Narrated Abu `Imran in another narration, "The tent is sixty miles in height)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِي الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لاَ عَيْنَ رَأَتْ، وَلاَ أُذُنَ سَمِعَتْ، وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ، فَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏فَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ ‏}‏‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ qaala alllahu aa'dadtu li'ibaadiy alssaalihiyna maa laa 'ayna raaat, walaa audhuna sami'at, walaa khatara 'alaa qalbi basharin, faaqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏falaa ta'lamu nafsun maa aukhfiya lahum min qurraai aa'yunin ‏}‏‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, "I have prepared for My Pious slaves things which have never been seen by an eye, or heard by an ear, or imagined by a human being." If you wish, you can recite this Verse from the Holy Qur'an:--"No soul knows what is kept hidden for them, of joy as a reward for what they used to do
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَوَّلُ زُمْرَةٍ تَلِجُ الْجَنَّةَ صُورَتُهُمْ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ، لاَ يَبْصُقُونَ فِيهَا وَلاَ يَمْتَخِطُونَ وَلاَ يَتَغَوَّطُونَ، آنِيَتُهُمْ فِيهَا الذَّهَبُ، أَمْشَاطُهُمْ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ، وَمَجَامِرُهُمُ الأَلُوَّةُ، وَرَشْحُهُمُ الْمِسْكُ، وَلِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمْ زَوْجَتَانِ، يُرَى مُخُّ سُوقِهِمَا مِنْ وَرَاءِ اللَّحْمِ، مِنَ الْحُسْنِ، لاَ اخْتِلاَفَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَلاَ تَبَاغُضَ، قُلُوبُهُمْ قَلْبٌ وَاحِدٌ، يُسَبِّحُونَ اللَّهَ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aawwalu zumraain taliju aljannaaa suwratuhum 'alaa suwraai alqamari laylaaa albadri, laa yabsuquwna fiyhaa walaa yamtakhituwna walaa yataghawwatuwna, aniyatuhum fiyhaa aldhhahabu, aamshaatuhum mina aldhhahabi waalfiddaai, wamajaamiruhumu alaaluwwaau, warashhuhumu almisku, walikulli waahidin minhum zawjataani, yuraa mukhhu suwqihimaa min waraa'i alllahmi, mina alhusni, laa akhtilaafa baynahum walaa tabaaghuda, quluwbuhum qalbun waahidun, yusabbihuwna alllaha bukraaan wa'ashiyyana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The first group (of people) who will enter Paradise will be (glittering) like the moon when it is full. They will not spit or blow their noses or relieve nature. Their utensils will be of gold and their combs of gold and silver; in their centers the aloe wood will be used, and their sweat will smell like musk. Everyone of them will have two wives; the marrow of the bones of the wives' legs will be seen through the flesh out of excessive beauty. They ( i.e. the people of Paradise) will neither have differences nor hatred amongst themselves; their hearts will be as if one heart and they will be glorifying Allah in the morning and in the evening
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَوَّلُ زُمْرَةٍ تَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ، وَالَّذِينَ عَلَى إِثْرِهِمْ كَأَشَدِّ كَوْكَبٍ إِضَاءَةً، قُلُوبُهُمْ عَلَى قَلْبِ رَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ، لاَ اخْتِلاَفَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَلاَ تَبَاغُضَ، لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ زَوْجَتَانِ، كُلُّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا يُرَى مُخُّ سَاقِهَا مِنْ وَرَاءِ لَحْمِهَا مِنَ الْحُسْنِ، يُسَبِّحُونَ اللَّهَ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا، لاَ يَسْقَمُونَ وَلاَ يَمْتَخِطُونَ، وَلاَ يَبْصُقُونَ، آنِيَتُهُمُ الذَّهَبُ وَالْفِضَّةُ، وَأَمْشَاطُهُمُ الذَّهَبُ، وَقُودُ مَجَامِرِهِمُ الأُلُوَّةُ ـ قَالَ أَبُو الْيَمَانِ يَعْنِي الْعُودَ ـ وَرَشْحُهُمُ الْمِسْكُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ الإِبْكَارُ أَوَّلُ الْفَجْرِ، وَالْعَشِيُّ مَيْلُ الشَّمْسِ أَنْ تُرَاهُ تَغْرُبَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aawwalu zumraain tadkhulu aljannaaa 'alaa suwraai alqamari laylaaa albadri, waalladhiyna 'alaa iithrihim kaaashaddi kawkabin iidaa'aaan, quluwbuhum 'alaa qalbi rajulin waahidin, laa akhtilaafa baynahum walaa tabaaghuda, likulli amriiin minhum zawjataani, kullu waahidaain minhumaa yuraa mukhhu saaqihaa min waraa'i lahmihaa mina alhusni, yusabbihuwna alllaha bukraaan wa'ashiyyana, laa yasqamuwna walaa yamtakhituwna, walaa yabsuquwna, aniyatuhumu aldhhahabu waalfiddaau, waaamshaatuhumu aldhhahabu, waquwdu majaamirihimu alauluwwaau qaala aabuw alyamaani ya'niy al'uwda warashhuhumu almisku ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala mujaahidun aliibkaaru aawwalu alfajri, waal'ashiyyu maylu alshhamsi aan turaahu taghruba‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The first batch (of people) who will enter Paradise will be (glittering) like a full moon; and those who will enter next will be (glittering) like the brightest star. Their hearts will be as if the heart of a single man, for they will have no enmity amongst themselves, and everyone of them shall have two wives, each of whom will be so beautiful, pure and transparent that the marrow of the bones of their legs will be seen through the flesh. They will be glorifying Allah in the morning and evening, and will never fall ill, and they will neither blow their noses, nor spit. Their utensils will be of gold and silver, and their combs will be of gold, and the fuel used in their centers will be the aloeswood, and their sweat will smell like musk
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَيَدْخُلَنَّ مِنْ أُمَّتِي سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا ـ أَوْ سَبْعُمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ ـ لاَ يَدْخُلُ أَوَّلُهُمْ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ آخِرُهُمْ، وَجُوهُهُمْ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, haddathanaa fudaylu bnu sulaymaana, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ layadkhulanna min aummatiy sab'uwna aalfana aaw sab'umiaiaai aalfin laa yadkhulu aawwaluhum hattaa yadkhula akhiruhum, wajuwhuhum 'alaa suwraai alqamari laylaaa albadri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Verily! 70,000 or 700,000 of my followers will enter Paradise altogether; so that the first and the last amongst them will enter at the same time, and their faces will be glittering like the bright full moon
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْجُعْفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أُهْدِيَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جُبَّةُ سُنْدُسٍ، وَكَانَ يَنْهَى عَنِ الْحَرِيرِ، فَعَجِبَ النَّاسُ مِنْهَا، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ، لَمَنَادِيلُ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَحْسَنُ مِنْ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin alju'fiyyu, haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasun rda allh 'nh qaala auhdiya lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm jubbaau sundusin, wakaana yanhaa 'ani alhariyri, fa'ajiba alnnaasu minhaa, faqaala ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsu muhammadin biyadihi, lamanaadiylu sa'di bni mu'aadhin fiy aljannaai aahsanu min hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A silken cloak was presented to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he used to forbid the usage of silk (by men). When the people were fascinated by the cloak. he said, "By Allah in Whose Hands the life of Muhammad is, the handkerchiefs of Sa`d bin Mu`adh in Paradise are better than this
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِثَوْبٍ مِنْ حَرِيرٍ، فَجَعَلُوا يَعْجَبُونَ مِنْ حُسْنِهِ وَلِينِهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَمَنَادِيلُ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an sufyaana, qaala haddathaniy aabuw iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma qaala autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bithawbin min hariyrin, faja'aluwa ya'jabuwna min husnihi waliynihi, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ lamanaadiylu sa'di bni mu'aadhin fiy aljannaai aafdalu min hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was given a silken garment, and its beauty and delicacy astonished the people. On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No doubt, the handkerchiefs of Sa`d bin Mu`adh in Paradise are better than this
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَوْضِعُ سَوْطٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mawdi'u sawtin fiy aljannaai khayrun mina alddunyaa wamaa fiyhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d Al-Saidi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A place in Paradise equal to the size of a lash is better than the whole world and whatever is in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُؤْمِنِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَشَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ لاَ يَقْطَعُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'abdi almuumini, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna fiy aljannaai lashajaraaan yasiyru alrraakibu fiy zillihaa miaiaaa 'aamin laa yaqta'uhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is a tree in Paradise (which is so big and huge that) if a rider travels in its shade for one hundred years, he would not be able to cross it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِلاَلُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَشَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ سَنَةٍ، وَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏وَظِلٍّ مَمْدُودٍ‏}‏‏"‏ «وَلَقَابُ قَوْسِ أَحَدِكُمْ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ أَوْ تَغْرُبُ»
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu sinaanin, hadaathanaa fulayhu bnu sulaymaana, hadaathanaa hilaalu bnu 'aliyinn, 'an 'abdi alraahmani bni aabiy 'amraaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinaa fiy aljanaaai lashajaraaan yasiyru alraaakibu fiy ziliihaa miaiaaa sanaain, waaqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏wazilinn mamduwdin‏}‏‏"‏ «walaqaabu qawsi aahadikum fiy aljanaaai khayrun mimaaa tala'at 'alayhi alshaamsu aaw taghrubu»
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said "There is a tree in Paradise (which is so big and huge that) a rider could travel in its shade for a hundred years. And if you wish, you can recite:--'In shade long extended..' (56. 30) and a place in Paradise equal to an arrow bow of one of you, is better than (the whole earth) on which the sun rises and sets
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُلَيْحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَوَّلُ زُمْرَةٍ تَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ، وَالَّذِينَ عَلَى آثَارِهِمْ كَأَحْسَنِ كَوْكَبٍ دُرِّيٍّ فِي السَّمَاءِ إِضَاءَةً، قُلُوبُهُمْ عَلَى قَلْبِ رَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ، لاَ تَبَاغُضَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَلاَ تَحَاسُدَ، لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ زَوْجَتَانِ مِنَ الْحُورِ الْعِينِ، يُرَى مُخُّ سُوقِهِنَّ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْعَظْمِ وَاللَّحْمِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fulayhin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an hilaalin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy 'amraaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aawwalu zumraain tadkhulu aljannaaa 'alaa suwraai alqamari laylaaa albadri, waalladhiyna 'alaa athaarihim kaaahsani kawkabin durriyyin fiy alssamaa'i iidaa'aaan, quluwbuhum 'alaa qalbi rajulin waahidin, laa tabaaghuda baynahum walaa tahaasuda, likulli amriiin zawjataani mina alhuwri al'iyni, yuraa mukhhu suwqihinna min waraa'i al'azmi waalllahmi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The first batch (of people) who will enter Paradise will be (glittering) like the full moon, and the batch next to them will be (glittering) like the most brilliant star in the sky. Their hearts will be as if the heart of a single man, for they will have neither enmity nor jealousy amongst themselves; everyone will have two wives from the houris, (who will be so beautiful, pure and transparent that) the marrow of the bones of their legs will be seen through the bones and the flesh
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ أَخْبَرَنِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَمَّا مَاتَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ لَهُ مُرْضِعًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala 'adiyyu bnu thaabitin aakhbaraniy qaala sami'tu albaraa'a rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lammaa maata iibraahiymu qaala ‏ "‏ iinna lahu murdi'ana fiy aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara (bin Azib):The Prophet, after the death of his son Ibrahim, said, "There is a wet-nurse for him (i.e. Ibrahim) in Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ يَتَرَاءَيُونَ أَهْلَ الْغُرَفِ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ كَمَا يَتَرَاءَيُونَ الْكَوْكَبَ الدُّرِّيَّ الْغَابِرَ فِي الأُفُقِ مِنَ الْمَشْرِقِ أَوِ الْمَغْرِبِ، لِتَفَاضُلِ مَا بَيْنَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، تِلْكَ مَنَازِلُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ لاَ يَبْلُغُهَا غَيْرُهُمْ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، رِجَالٌ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَصَدَّقُوا الْمُرْسَلِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an safwaana bni sulaymin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna aahla aljannaai yataraa'ayuwna aahla alghurafi min fawqihim kamaa yataraa'ayuwna alkawkaba alddurriyya alghaabira fiy alaufuqi mina almashriqi aawi almaghribi, litafaaduli maa baynahum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi, tilka manaazilu alaanbiyaa'i laa yablughuhaa ghayruhum qaala ‏"‏ balaa waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi, rijaalun amanuwa bialllahi wasaddaquwa almursaliyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people of Paradise will look at the dwellers of the lofty mansions (i.e. a superior place in Paradise) in the same way as one looks at a brilliant star far away in the East or in the West on the horizon; all that is because of their superiority over one another (in rewards)." On that the people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Are these lofty mansions for the prophets which nobody else can reach? The Prophet (ﷺ) replied," No! "By Allah in whose Hands my life is, these are for the men who believed in Allah and also believed in the Apostles
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُطَرِّفٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ثَمَانِيَةُ أَبْوَابٍ، فِيهَا باب يُسَمَّى الرَّيَّانَ لاَ يَدْخُلُهُ إِلاَّ الصَّائِمُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu mutarrifin, qaala haddathaniy aabuw haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ fiy aljannaai thamaaniyaau aabwaabin, fiyhaa bab yusammaa alrrayyaana laa yadkhuluhu iilaaa alssaaiimuwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Paradise has eight gates, and one of them is called Ar-Raiyan through which none will enter but those who observe fasting
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُهَاجِرٍ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ وَهْبٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَبْرِدْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبْرِدْ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَتَّى فَاءَ الْفَىْءُ، يَعْنِي لِلتُّلُولِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبْرِدُوا بِالصَّلاَةِ، فَإِنَّ شِدَّةَ الْحَرِّ مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhaajirin aabiy alhasani, qaala sami'tu zayda bna wahbin, yaquwlu sami'tu aabaa dharrin rda allh 'nh yaquwlu kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy safarin faqaala ‏"‏ aabrid ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ aabrid ‏"‏‏.‏ hattaa faa'a alfaa'u, ya'niy lilttuluwli, thumma qaala ‏"‏ aabriduwa bialssalaaai, faiinna shiddaaa alharri min fayhi jahannama ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Dhar:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was on a journey, he said (regarding the performance of the Zuhr prayer), "Wait till it (i.e. the weather) gets cooler." He said the same again till the shade of the hillocks extended. Then he said, "Delay the (Zuhr) Prayer till it gets cooler, for the severity of heat is from the increase in heat of Hell (fire)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَبْرِدُوا بِالصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّ شِدَّةَ الْحَرِّ مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an dhakwaana, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aabriduwa bialssalaaai faiinna shiddaaa alharri min fayhi jahannama ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Delay the (Zuhr) Prayer till it gets cooler, for the severity of heat is from the increase in the heat of Hell (fire)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اشْتَكَتِ النَّارُ إِلَى رَبِّهَا، فَقَالَتْ رَبِّ أَكَلَ بَعْضِي بَعْضًا، فَأَذِنَ لَهَا بِنَفَسَيْنِ نَفَسٍ فِي الشِّتَاءِ وَنَفَسٍ فِي الصَّيْفِ، فَأَشَدُّ مَا تَجِدُونَ فِي الْحَرِّ، وَأَشَدُّ مَا تَجِدُونَ مِنَ الزَّمْهَرِيرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ashtakati alnnaaru iilaa rabbihaa, faqaalat rabbi aakala ba'diy ba'dana, faaadhina lahaa binafasayni nafasin fiy alshhitaa'i wanafasin fiy alssayfi, faaashaddu maa tajiduwna fiy alharri, waaashaddu maa tajiduwna mina alzzamhariyri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The (Hell) Fire complained to its Lord saying, 'O my Lord! My different parts eat up each other.' So, He allowed it to take two breaths, one in the winter and the other in summer, and this is the reason for the severe heat and the bitter cold you find (in weather)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ أَبِي جَمْرَةَ الضُّبَعِيِّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أُجَالِسُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ بِمَكَّةَ، فَأَخَذَتْنِي الْحُمَّى، فَقَالَ أَبْرِدْهَا عَنْكَ بِمَاءِ زَمْزَمَ، فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ فَأَبْرِدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِمَاءِ زَمْزَمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ شَكَّ هَمَّامٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an aabiy jamraaa aldduba'iyyi, qaala kuntu aujaalisu abna 'abbaasin bimakkaaa, faaakhadhatniy alhummaa, faqaala aabridhaa 'anka bimaa'i zamzama, faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ alhummaa min fayhi jahannama faaabriduwhaa bialmaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ bimaa'i zamzama ‏"‏‏.‏ shakka hammaamun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Jamra Ad-Dabi:I used to sit with Ibn `Abbas in Mecca. Once I had a fever and he said (to me), "Cool your fever with Zamzam water, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: 'It, (the Fever) is from the heat of the (Hell) Fire; so, cool it with water (or Zamzam water)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَوْرِ جَهَنَّمَ، فَأَبْرِدُوهَا عَنْكُمْ بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu 'abbaasin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abaayaaa bni rifaa'aaa, qaala aakhbaraniy raafi'u bnu khadiyjin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alhummaa min fawri jahannama, faaabriduwhaa 'ankum bialmaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Rafi` bin Khadij:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Fever is from the heat of the (Hell) Fire; so cool it with water
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ، فَأَبْرِدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alhummaa min fayhi jahannama, faaabriduwhaa bialmaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fever is from the heat of the (Hell) Fire, so cool it with water
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ فَأَبْرِدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, 'an yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alhummaa min fayhi jahannama faaabriduwhaa bialmaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fever is from the heat of the (Hell) Fire; so abate fever with water
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ نَارُكُمْ جُزْءٌ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ جُزْءًا مِنْ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنْ كَانَتْ لَكَافِيَةً‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فُضِّلَتْ عَلَيْهِنَّ بِتِسْعَةٍ وَسِتِّينَ جُزْءًا، كُلُّهُنَّ مِثْلُ حَرِّهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu aabiy auwaysin, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ naarukum juz'un min sab'iyna juz'ana min naari jahannama ‏"‏‏.‏ qiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi, iin kaanat lakaafiyaaan‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fuddilat 'alayhinna bitis'aain wasittiyna juz'ana, kulluhunna mithlu harrihaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Your (ordinary) fire is one of 70 parts of the (Hell) Fire." Someone asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) This (ordinary) fire would have been sufficient (to torture the unbelievers)," Allah's Apostle said, "The (Hell) Fire has 69 parts more than the ordinary (worldly) fire, each part is as hot as this (worldly) fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعَ عَطَاءً، يُخْبِرُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَعْلَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏{‏وَنَادَوْا يَا مَالِكُ ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, sami'a 'ataa'an, yukhbiru 'an safwaana bni ya'laa, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau 'alaa alminbari ‏{‏wanaadawa yaa maaliku ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Yali:That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) on the pulpit reciting:-- "They will cry: "O Malik!' (43.77) (Malik is the gate-keeper (angel) of the (Hell) Fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ،، قَالَ قِيلَ لأُسَامَةَ لَوْ أَتَيْتَ فُلاَنًا فَكَلَّمْتَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَرَوْنَ أَنِّي لاَ أُكَلِّمُهُ إِلاَّ أُسْمِعُكُمْ، إِنِّي أُكُلِّمُهُ فِي السِّرِّ دُونَ أَنْ أَفْتَحَ بَابًا لاَ أَكُونُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ فَتَحَهُ، وَلاَ أَقُولُ لِرَجُلٍ أَنْ كَانَ عَلَىَّ أَمِيرًا إِنَّهُ خَيْرُ النَّاسِ بَعْدَ شَىْءٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَا سَمِعْتَهُ يَقُولُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يُجَاءُ بِالرَّجُلِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ، فَتَنْدَلِقُ أَقْتَابُهُ فِي النَّارِ، فَيَدُورُ كَمَا يَدُورُ الْحِمَارُ بِرَحَاهُ، فَيَجْتَمِعُ أَهْلُ النَّارِ عَلَيْهِ، فَيَقُولُونَ أَىْ فُلاَنُ، مَا شَأْنُكَ أَلَيْسَ كُنْتَ تَأْمُرُنَا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَتَنْهَى عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ قَالَ كُنْتُ آمُرُكُمْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَلاَ آتِيهِ، وَأَنْهَاكُمْ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَآتِيهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ غُنْدَرٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, , qaala qiyla lausaamaaa law aatayta fulaanana fakallamtahu‏.‏ qaala iinnakum latarawna aanniy laa aukallimuhu iilaaa ausmi'ukum, iinniy aukullimuhu fiy alssirri duwna aan aaftaha baabana laa aakuwnu aawwala man fatahahu, walaa aaquwlu lirajulin aan kaana 'alaaaa aamiyrana iinnahu khayru alnnaasi ba'da shaa'in sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaaluwa wamaa sami'tahu yaquwlu qaala sami'tuhu yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yujaa'u bialrrajuli yawma alqiyaamaai fayulqaa fiy alnnaari, fatandaliqu aaqtaabuhu fiy alnnaari, fayaduwru kamaa yaduwru alhimaaru birahaahu, fayajtami'u aahlu alnnaari 'alayhi, fayaquwluwna aaa fulaanu, maa shaanuka aalaysa kunta taamurunaa bialma'ruwfi watanhaa 'ani almunkari qaala kuntu amurukum bialma'ruwfi walaa atiyhi, waaanhaakum 'ani almunkari waatiyhi ‏"‏‏.‏ rawaahu ghundarun 'an shu'baaa 'ani alaa'mashi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Wail:Somebody said to Usama, "Will you go to so-and-so (i.e. `Uthman) and talk to him (i.e. advise him regarding ruling the country)?" He said, "You see that I don't talk to him. Really I talk to (advise) him secretly without opening a gate (of affliction), for neither do I want to be the first to open it (i.e. rebellion), nor will I say to a man who is my ruler that he is the best of all the people after I have heard something from Allah's Apostle ." They said, What have you heard him saying? He said, "I have heard him saying, "A man will be brought on the Day of Resurrection and thrown in the (Hell) Fire, so that his intestines will come out, and he will go around like a donkey goes around a millstone. The people of (Hell) Fire will gather around him and say: O so-and-so! What is wrong with you? Didn't you use to order us to do good deeds and forbid us to do bad deeds? He will reply: Yes, I used to order you to do good deeds, but I did not do them myself, and I used to forbid you to do bad deeds, yet I used to do them myself
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 59 — Beginning of Creation
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ سُحِرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ كَتَبَ إِلَىَّ هِشَامٌ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ وَوَعَاهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ سُحِرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى كَانَ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ يَفْعَلُ الشَّىْءَ وَمَا يَفْعَلُهُ، حَتَّى كَانَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ دَعَا وَدَعَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَشَعَرْتِ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَفْتَانِي فِيمَا فِيهِ شِفَائِي أَتَانِي رَجُلاَنِ، فَقَعَدَ أَحَدُهُمَا عِنْدَ رَأْسِي وَالآخَرُ عِنْدَ رِجْلَىَّ، فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِلآخَرِ مَا وَجَعُ الرَّجُلِ قَالَ مَطْبُوبٌ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَنْ طَبَّهُ قَالَ لَبِيدُ بْنُ الأَعْصَمِ‏.‏ قَالَ فِي مَاذَا قَالَ فِي مُشُطٍ وَمُشَاقَةٍ وَجُفِّ طَلْعَةٍ ذَكَرٍ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَيْنَ هُوَ قَالَ فِي بِئْرِ ذَرْوَانَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَقَالَ لِعَائِشَةَ حِينَ رَجَعَ ‏"‏ نَخْلُهَا كَأَنَّهَا رُءُوسُ الشَّيَاطِينِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ اسْتَخْرَجْتَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ أَمَّا أَنَا فَقَدْ شَفَانِي اللَّهُ، وَخَشِيتُ أَنْ يُثِيرَ ذَلِكَ عَلَى النَّاسِ شَرًّا، ثُمَّ دُفِنَتِ الْبِئْرُ ‏"‏‏.‏
