verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi bni aabiy ya'quwba, qaala sami'tu 'abda alrrahmani bna aabiy bakraaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna alaaqra'a bna haabisin, qaala lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinnamaa baaya'aka surraaqu alhajiyji min aaslama waghifaara wamuzaynaaa waaahsibuhu wajuhaynaaa abnu aabiy ya'quwba shakka qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaraaayta iin kaana aaslamu waghifaaru wamuzaynaau waaahsibuhu wajuhaynaau khayrana min baniy tamiymin wabaniy 'aamirin waaasadin waghatafaana, khaabuwa wakhasiruwa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi, iinnahum lakhayrun minhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakra:Al-Aqra' bin Habis said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Nobody gave you the pledge of allegiance but the robbers of the pilgrims (i.e. those who used to rob the pilgrims) from the tribes of Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina." (Ibn Abi Ya'qub is in doubt whether Al-Aqra' added. 'And Juhaina.') The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't you think that the tribes of Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina (and also perhaps) Juhaina are better than the tribes of Bani Tamim, Bani Amir, Asad, and Ghatafan?" Somebody said, "They were unsuccessful and losers!" The Prophet said, "Yes, by Him in Whose Hands my life is, they (i.e. the former) are better than they (i.e. the latter)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَحْطَانَ يَسُوقُ النَّاسَ بِعَصَاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an thawri bni zaydin, 'an aabiy alghaythi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa yakhruja rajulun min qahtaana yasuwqu alnnaasa bi'asaahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The hour will not be established unless a man from the tribe of Qahtan appears, driving the people with his stick (ruling them with violence and oppression)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ غَزَوْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ ثَابَ مَعَهُ نَاسٌ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ حَتَّى كَثُرُوا، وَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ رَجُلٌ لَعَّابٌ فَكَسَعَ أَنْصَارِيًّا، فَغَضِبَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ غَضَبًا شَدِيدًا، حَتَّى تَدَاعَوْا، وَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ يَا لَلأَنْصَارِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْمُهَاجِرِيُّ يَا لَلْمُهَاجِرِينَ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ دَعْوَى أَهْلِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا شَأْنُهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأُخْبِرَ بِكَسْعَةِ الْمُهَاجِرِيِّ الأَنْصَارِيَّ قَالَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ دَعُوهَا فَإِنَّهَا خَبِيثَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ ابْنُ سَلُولَ أَقَدْ تَدَاعَوْا عَلَيْنَا، لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الأَذَلَّ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أَلاَ نَقْتُلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا الْخَبِيثَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَتَحَدَّثُ النَّاسُ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقْتُلُ أَصْحَابَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, aakhbaranaa makhladu bnu yaziyda, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu diynaarin, aannahu sami'a jaabirana rda allh 'nh yaquwlu ghazawnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqad thaaba ma'ahu naasun mina almuhaajiriyna hattaa kathuruwa, wakaana mina almuhaajiriyna rajulun la''aabun fakasa'a aansaariyyana, faghadiba alaansaariyyu ghadabana shadiydana, hattaa tadaa'awa, waqaala alaansaariyyu yaa lalaansaari‏.‏ waqaala almuhaajiriyyu yaa lalmuhaajiriyna‏.‏ fakharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ maa baalu da'waa aahli aljaahiliyyaai ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ maa shaanuhum ‏"‏‏.‏ faaukhbira bikas'aai almuhaajiriyyi alaansaariyya qaala faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ da'uwhaa faiinnahaa khabiythaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain abnu saluwla aaqad tadaa'awa 'alaynaa, laiin raja'naa iilaa almadiynaai layukhrijanna alaa'azzu minhaa alaadhalla‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru aalaa naqtulu yaa rasuwla alllahi hadhaa alkhabiytha li'abdi alllahi‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa yatahaddathu alnnaasu aannahu kaana yaqtulu aashaabahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) in a Ghazwa. A large number of emigrants joined him and among the emigrants there was a person who used to play jokes (or play with spears); so he (jokingly) stroked an Ansari man on the hip. The Ansari got so angry that both of them called their people. The Ansari said, "Help, O Ansar!" And the emigrant said "Help, O emigrants!" The Prophet (ﷺ) came out and said, "What is wrong with the people (as they are calling) this call of the period of Ignorance? "Then he said, "What is the matter with them?" So he was told about the stroke of the emigrant to the Ansari. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Stop this (i.e. appeal for help) for it is an evil call. "Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul (a hypocrite) said, "The emigrants have called and (gathered against us); so when we return to Medina, surely, the more honorable people will expel therefrom the meaner," Upon that `Umar said, "O Allah's Prophet! Shall we not kill this evil person (i.e. `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul) ?" The Prophet) said, "(No), lest the people should say that Muhammad used to kill his companions
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي ثَابِتُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَعَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ ضَرَبَ الْخُدُودَ، وَشَقَّ الْجُيُوبَ، وَدَعَا بِدَعْوَى الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy thaabitu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ wa'an sufyaana, 'an zubaydin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laysa minnaa man daraba alkhuduwda, washaqqa aljuyuwba, wada'aa bida'waa aljaahiliyyaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud):The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Who-ever slaps his face or tears the bosom of his dress, or calls the calls of the Period of Ignorance, is not from us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ عَمْرُو بْنُ لُحَىِّ بْنِ قَمَعَةَ بْنِ خِنْدِفَ أَبُو خُزَاعَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, aakhbaranaa iisraaiiylu, 'an aabiy hasiynin, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ 'amruw bnu luhaaai bni qama'aaa bni khindifa aabuw khuzaa'aaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "`Amr bin Luhai bin Qam'a bin Khindif was the father of Khuza`a
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالَ الْبَحِيرَةُ الَّتِي يُمْنَعُ دَرُّهَا لِلطَّوَاغِيتِ وَلاَ يَحْلُبُهَا أَحَدٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَالسَّائِبَةُ الَّتِي كَانُوا يُسَيِّبُونَهَا لآلِهَتِهِمْ فَلاَ يُحْمَلُ عَلَيْهَا شَىْءٌ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ رَأَيْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ عَامِرِ بْنِ لُحَىٍّ الْخُزَاعِيَّ يَجُرُّ قُصْبَهُ فِي النَّارِ، وَكَانَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ سَيَّبَ السَّوَائِبَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, qaala albahiyraau allatiy yumna'u darruhaa lilttawaaghiyti walaa yahlubuhaa aahadun mina alnnaasi, waalssaaiibaau allatiy kaanuwa yusayyibuwnahaa lalihatihim falaa yuhmalu 'alayhaa shaa'un‏.‏ qaala waqaala aabuw hurayraaa qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ raaaytu 'amraw bna 'aamiri bni luhaaain alkhuzaa'iyya yajurru qusbahu fiy alnnaari, wakaana aawwala man sayyaba alssawaaiiba ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:Al-Bahira was an animal whose milk was spared for the idols and other deities, and so nobody was allowed to milk it. As-Saiba was an animal which they (i.e. infidels) used to set free in the names of their gods so that it would not be used for carrying anything. Abu Huraira said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'I saw `Amr bin 'Amir bin Luhai Al-Khuza`i dragging his intestines in the (Hell) Fire, for he was the first man who started the custom of releasing animals (for the sake of false gods)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدٌ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ أَخْزَمَ ـ قَالَ أَبُو قُتَيْبَةَ سَلْمُ بْنُ قُتَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنِي مُثَنَّى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَصِيرُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو جَمْرَةَ، قَالَ لَنَا ابْنُ عَبَّاسِ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِإِسْلاَمِ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قُلْنَا بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو ذَرٍّ كُنْتُ رَجُلاً مِنْ غِفَارٍ، فَبَلَغَنَا أَنَّ رَجُلاً قَدْ خَرَجَ بِمَكَّةَ، يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ نَبِيٌّ، فَقُلْتُ لأَخِي انْطَلِقْ إِلَى هَذَا الرَّجُلِ كَلِّمْهُ وَأْتِنِي بِخَبَرِهِ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ فَلَقِيَهُ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَقُلْتُ مَا عِنْدَكَ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَجُلاً يَأْمُرُ بِالْخَيْرِ وَيَنْهَى عَنِ الشَّرِّ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ لَمْ تَشْفِنِي مِنَ الْخَبَرِ‏.‏ فَأَخَذْتُ جِرَابًا وَعَصًا، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلْتُ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَجَعَلْتُ لاَ أَعْرِفُهُ، وَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَ عَنْهُ، وَأَشْرَبُ مِنْ مَاءِ زَمْزَمَ وَأَكُونُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَرَّ بِي عَلِيٌّ فَقَالَ كَأَنَّ الرَّجُلَ غَرِيبٌ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلِقْ إِلَى الْمَنْزِلِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ لاَ يَسْأَلُنِي عَنْ شَىْءٍ، وَلاَ أُخْبِرُهُ، فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحْتُ غَدَوْتُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ لأَسْأَلَ عَنْهُ، وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ يُخْبِرُنِي عَنْهُ بِشَىْءٍ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَرَّ بِي عَلِيٌّ فَقَالَ أَمَا نَالَ لِلرَّجُلِ يَعْرِفُ مَنْزِلَهُ بَعْدُ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ انْطَلِقْ مَعِي‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ مَا أَمْرُكَ وَمَا أَقْدَمَكَ هَذِهِ الْبَلْدَةَ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنْ كَتَمْتَ عَلَىَّ أَخْبَرْتُكَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنِّي أَفْعَلُ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ بَلَغَنَا أَنَّهُ قَدْ خَرَجَ هَا هُنَا رَجُلٌ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ نَبِيٌّ، فَأَرْسَلْتُ أَخِي لِيُكَلِّمَهُ فَرَجَعَ وَلَمْ يَشْفِنِي مِنَ الْخَبَرِ، فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَلْقَاهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَمَا إِنَّكَ قَدْ رَشَدْتَ، هَذَا وَجْهِي إِلَيْهِ، فَاتَّبِعْنِي، ادْخُلْ حَيْثُ أَدْخُلُ، فَإِنِّي إِنْ رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا أَخَافُهُ عَلَيْكَ، قُمْتُ إِلَى الْحَائِطِ، كَأَنِّي أُصْلِحُ نَعْلِي، وَامْضِ أَنْتَ، فَمَضَى وَمَضَيْتُ مَعَهُ، حَتَّى دَخَلَ وَدَخَلْتُ مَعَهُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ لَهُ اعْرِضْ عَلَىَّ الإِسْلاَمَ‏.‏ فَعَرَضَهُ فَأَسْلَمْتُ مَكَانِي، فَقَالَ لِي ‏ "‏ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ اكْتُمْ هَذَا الأَمْرَ، وَارْجِعْ إِلَى بَلَدِكَ، فَإِذَا بَلَغَكَ ظُهُورُنَا فَأَقْبِلْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ لأَصْرُخَنَّ بِهَا بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِهِمْ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ، وَقُرَيْشٌ فِيهِ فَقَالَ يَا مَعْشَرَ قُرَيْشٍ، إِنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا قُومُوا إِلَى هَذَا الصَّابِئِ‏.‏ فَقَامُوا فَضُرِبْتُ لأَمُوتَ فَأَدْرَكَنِي الْعَبَّاسُ، فَأَكَبَّ عَلَىَّ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَقَالَ وَيْلَكُمْ تَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلاً مِنْ غِفَارَ، وَمَتْجَرُكُمْ وَمَمَرُّكُمْ عَلَى غِفَارَ‏.‏ فَأَقْلَعُوا عَنِّي، فَلَمَّا أَنْ أَصْبَحْتُ الْغَدَ رَجَعْتُ فَقُلْتُ مِثْلَ مَا قُلْتُ بِالأَمْسِ، فَقَالُوا قُومُوا إِلَى هَذَا الصَّابِئِ‏.‏ فَصُنِعَ ‏{‏بِي‏}‏ مِثْلَ مَا صُنِعَ بِالأَمْسِ وَأَدْرَكَنِي الْعَبَّاسُ فَأَكَبَّ عَلَىَّ، وَقَالَ مِثْلَ مَقَالَتِهِ بِالأَمْسِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَانَ هَذَا أَوَّلَ إِسْلاَمِ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zaydun huwa abnu aakhzama qaala aabuw qutaybaaa salmu bnu qutaybaaa haddathaniy muthannaa bnu sa'iydin alqasiyru, qaala haddathaniy aabuw jamraaa, qaala lanaa abnu 'abbaasi aalaa aukhbirukum biiislaami aabiy dharrin, qaala qulnaa balaa‏.‏ qaala qaala aabuw dharrin kuntu rajulaan min ghifaarin, fabalaghanaa aanna rajulaan qad kharaja bimakkaaa, yaz'umu aannahu nabiyyun, faqultu laakhiy antaliq iilaa hadhaa alrrajuli kallimhu waatiniy bikhabarihi‏.‏ faantalaqa falaqiyahu, thumma raja'a faqultu maa 'indaka faqaala waalllahi laqad raaaytu rajulaan yaamuru bialkhayri wayanhaa 'ani alshharri‏.‏ faqultu lahu lam tashfiniy mina alkhabari‏.‏ faaakhadhtu jiraabana wa'asana, thumma aaqbaltu iilaa makkaaa faja'altu laa aa'rifuhu, waaakrahu aan aasaala 'anhu, waaashrabu min maa'i zamzama waaakuwnu fiy almasjidi‏.‏ qaala famarra biy 'aliyyun faqaala kaaanna alrrajula ghariybun‏.‏ qaala qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala faantaliq iilaa almanzili‏.‏ qaala faantalaqtu ma'ahu laa yasaaluniy 'an shaa'in, walaa aukhbiruhu, falammaa aasbahtu ghadawtu iilaa almasjidi laasaala 'anhu, walaysa aahadun yukhbiruniy 'anhu bishaa'in‏.‏ qaala famarra biy 'aliyyun faqaala aamaa naala lilrrajuli ya'rifu manzilahu ba'du qaala qultu laa‏.‏ qaala antaliq ma'iy‏.‏ qaala faqaala maa aamruka wamaa aaqdamaka hadhihi albaldaaa qaala qultu lahu iin katamta 'alaaaa aakhbartuka‏.‏ qaala faiinniy aaf'alu‏.‏ qaala qultu lahu balaghanaa aannahu qad kharaja haa hunaa rajulun yaz'umu aannahu nabiyyun, faaarsaltu aakhiy liyukallimahu faraja'a walam yashfiniy mina alkhabari, faaaradtu aan aalqaahu‏.‏ faqaala lahu aamaa iinnaka qad rashadta, hadhaa wajhiy iilayhi, faattabi'niy, adkhul haythu aadkhulu, faiinniy iin raaaytu aahadana aakhaafuhu 'alayka, qumtu iilaa alhaaiiti, kaaanniy auslihu na'liy, waamdi aanta, famadaa wamadaytu ma'ahu, hattaa dakhala wadakhaltu ma'ahu 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu lahu a'rid 'alaaaa aliislaama‏.‏ fa'aradahu faaaslamtu makaaniy, faqaala liy ‏ "‏ yaa aabaa dharrin aktum hadhaa alaamra, waarji' iilaa baladika, faiidhaa balaghaka zuhuwrunaa faaaqbil ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu waalladhiy ba'athaka bialhaqqi laasrukhanna bihaa bayna aazhurihim‏.‏ fajaa'a iilaa almasjidi, waqurayshun fiyhi faqaala yaa ma'shara qurayshin, iinniy aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu, waaashhadu aanna muhammadana 'abduhu warasuwluhu‏.‏ faqaaluwa quwmuwa iilaa hadhaa alssaabiii‏.‏ faqaamuwa faduribtu laamuwta faaadrakaniy al'abbaasu, faaakabba 'alaaaa thumma aaqbala 'alayhim, faqaala waylakum taqtuluwna rajulaan min ghifaara, wamatjarukum wamamarrukum 'alaa ghifaara‏.‏ faaaqla'uwa 'anniy, falammaa aan aasbahtu alghada raja'tu faqultu mithla maa qultu bialaamsi, faqaaluwa quwmuwa iilaa hadhaa alssaabiii‏.‏ fasuni'a ‏{‏biy‏}‏ mithla maa suni'a bialaamsi waaadrakaniy al'abbaasu faaakabba 'alaaaa, waqaala mithla maqaalatihi bialaamsi‏.‏ qaala fakaana hadhaa aawwala iislaami aabiy dharrin rahimahu alllahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Jamra:Ibn `Abbas said to us, "Shall I tell you the story of Abu Dhar's conversion to Islam?" We said, "Yes." He said, "Abu Dhar said: I was a man from the tribe of Ghifar. We heard that a man had appeared in Mecca, claiming to be a Prophet. I said to my brother, 'Go to that man and talk to him and bring me his news.' He set out, met him and returned. I asked him, 'What is the news with you?' He said, 'By Allah, I saw a man enjoining what is good and forbidding what is evil.' I said to him, 'You have not satisfied me with this little information.' So, I took a waterskin and a stick and proceeded towards Mecca. Neither did I know him (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ), nor did I like to ask anyone about him. I Kept on drinking Zam zam water and staying in the Mosque. Then `Ali passed by me and said, 'It seems you are a stranger?' I said, 'Yes.' He proceeded to his house and I accompanied him. Neither did he ask me anything, nor did I tell him anything. Next morning I went to the Mosque to ask about the Prophet but no-one told me anything about him. `Ali passed by me again and asked, 'Hasn't the man recognized his dwelling place yet' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Come along with me.' He asked me, 'What is your business? What has brought you to this town?' I said to him, 'If you keep my secret, I will tell you.' He said, 'I will do.' I said to him, 'We have heard that a person has appeared here, claiming to be a Prophet. I sent my brother to speak to him and when he returned, he did not bring a satisfactory report; so I thought of meeting him personally.' `Ali said (to Abu Dhar), 'You have reached your goal; I am going to him just now, so follow me, and wherever I enter, enter after me. If I should see someone who may cause you trouble, I will stand near a wall pretending to mend my shoes (as a warning), and you should go away then.' `Ali proceeded and I accompanied him till he entered a place, and I entered with him to the Prophet (ﷺ) to whom I said, 'Present (the principles of) Islam to me.' When he did, I embraced Islam 'immediately. He said to me, 'O Abu Dhar! Keep your conversion as a secret and return to your town; and when you hear of our victory, return to us. ' I said, 'By Him Who has sent you with the Truth, I will announce my conversion to Islam publicly amongst them (i.e. the infidels),' Abu Dhar went to the Mosque, where some people from Quraish were present, and said, 'O folk of Quraish ! I testify that None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and I (also) testify that Muhammad is Allah's Slave and His Apostle.' (Hearing that) the Quraishi men said, 'Get at this Sabi (i.e. Muslim) !' They got up and beat me nearly to death. Al `Abbas saw me and threw himself over me to protect me. He then faced them and said, 'Woe to you! You want to kill a man from the tribe of Ghifar, although your trade and your communications are through the territory of Ghifar?' They therefore left me. The next morning I returned (to the Mosque) and said the same as I had said on the previous day. They again said, 'Get at this Sabi!' I was treated in the same way as on the previous day, and again Al-Abbas found me and threw himself over me to protect me and told them the same as he had said the day before.' So, that was the conversion of Abu Dhar (may Allah be Merciful to him) to Islam
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ أَسْلَمُ وَغِفَارُ وَشَىْءٌ مِنْ مُزَيْنَةَ وَجُهَيْنَةَ ـ أَوْ قَالَ شَىْءٌ مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ أَوْ مُزَيْنَةَ ـ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ ـ أَوْ قَالَ ـ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ أَسَدٍ وَتَمِيمٍ وَهَوَازِنَ وَغَطَفَانَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala aaslamu waghifaaru washaa'un min muzaynaaa wajuhaynaaa aaw qaala shaa'un min juhaynaaa aaw muzaynaaa khayrun 'inda alllahi aaw qaala yawma alqiyaamaai min aasadin watamiymin wahawaazina waghatafaana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Hurairah (ra):The Prophet (ﷺ) said, (The people of) Aslam, Ghifar and some people of Muzaina and Juhaina or said (some people of Juhaina or Muzaina) are better with Allah or said (on the Day of resurrection) than the tribe of Asad, Tamim, Hawazin and Ghatafan
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ إِذَا سَرَّكَ أَنْ تَعْلَمَ جَهْلَ الْعَرَبِ فَاقْرَأْ مَا فَوْقَ الثَّلاَثِينَ وَمِائَةٍ فِي سُورَةِ الأَنْعَامِ ‏{‏قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ قَتَلُوا أَوْلاَدَهُمْ سَفَهًا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏قَدْ ضَلُّوا وَمَا كَانُوا مُهْتَدِينَ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala iidhaa sarraka aan ta'lama jahla al'arabi faaqraa maa fawqa althhalaathiyna wamiaiaain fiy suwraai alaan'aami ‏{‏qad khasira alladhiyna qataluwa aawlaadahum safahana bighayri 'ilmin‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏qad dalluwa wamaa kaanuwa muhtadiyna‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:If you wish to know about the ignorance of the Arabs, refer to Surat-al-Anam after Verse No. 130:-- Indeed lost are those who have killed their children From folly without knowledge and have forbidden that which Allah has provided for them, inventing a lie against Allah. They have indeed gone astray and were not guided
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}‏ جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُنَادِي ‏"‏ يَا بَنِي فِهْرٍ، يَا بَنِي عَدِيٍّ لِبُطُونِ قُرَيْشٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu murraaa, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala lammaa nazalat ‏{‏waaandhir 'ashiyrataka alaaqrabiyna‏}‏ ja'ala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yunaadiy ‏"‏ yaa baniy fihrin, yaa baniy 'adiyyin libutuwni qurayshin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Verse:-- 'And warn your tribe of near kindred.' (26.214) was revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) started calling (the 'Arab tribes), "O Bani Fihr, O Bani `Adi" mentioning first the various branch tribes of Quraish
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: وَقَالَ لَنَا قَبِيصَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}‏ جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْعُوهُمْ قَبَائِلَ قَبَائِلَ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala lanaa qabiysaau aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an habiybi bni aabiy thaabitin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala lammaa nazalat ‏{‏waaandhir 'ashiyrataka alaaqrabiyna‏}‏ ja'ala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yad'uwhum qabaaiila qabaaiila‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: When the Verse:-- 'And warn your tribe of near kindred' (26.214). was revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) started calling every tribe by its name
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ، اشْتَرُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ، يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ اشْتَرُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ، يَا أُمَّ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ عَمَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، يَا فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ، اشْتَرِيَا أَنْفُسَكُمَا مِنَ اللَّهِ، لاَ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمَا مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، سَلاَنِي مِنْ مَالِي مَا شِئْتُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, aakhbaranaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yaa baniy 'abdi manaafin, ashtaruwa aanfusakum mina alllahi, yaa baniy 'abdi almuttalibi ashtaruwa aanfusakum mina alllahi, yaa aumma alzzubayri bni al'awwaami 'ammaaa rasuwli alllahi, yaa faatimaau binta muhammadin, ashtariyaa aanfusakumaa mina alllahi, laa aamliku lakumaa mina alllahi shayiana, salaaniy min maaliy maa shiitumaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Bani `Abd Manaf! Buy yourselves from Allah; O Bani `Abdul-Muttalib! Buy yourselves from Allah; O mother of Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam, the aunt of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and O Fatima bint Muhammad! Buy yourselves from Allah, for I cannot defend you before Allah. You (both) can ask me from my property as much as you like
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ دَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الأَنْصَارَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ فِيكُمْ أَحَدٌ مِنْ غَيْرِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ، إِلاَّ ابْنُ أُخْتٍ لَنَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ابْنُ أُخْتِ الْقَوْمِ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala da'aa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alaansaara faqaala ‏"‏ hal fiykum aahadun min ghayrikum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa laa, iilaaa abnu aukhtin lanaa‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ abnu aukhti alqawmi minhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for the Ansar (and when they came), he asked, 'Is there any stranger amongst you?" They said, "No except the son of our sister." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The son of the sister of some people belongs to them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا وَعِنْدَهَا جَارِيَتَانِ فِي أَيَّامِ مِنًى تُدَفِّفَانِ وَتَضْرِبَانِ، وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُتَغَشٍّ بِثَوْبِهِ، فَانْتَهَرَهُمَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، فَكَشَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دَعْهُمَا يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ، فَإِنَّهَا أَيَّامُ عِيدٍ، وَتِلْكَ الأَيَّامُ أَيَّامُ مِنًى ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتُرُنِي، وَأَنَا أَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْحَبَشَةِ، وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَزَجَرَهُمْ ‏{‏عُمَرُ‏}‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ دَعْهُمْ أَمْنًا بَنِي أَرْفَدَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ يَعْنِي مِنَ الأَمْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nh dakhala 'alayhaa wa'indahaa jaariyataani fiy aayyaami minana tudaffifaani watadribaani, waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm mutaghashhin bithawbihi, faantaharahumaa aabuw bakrin, fakashafa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an wajhihi, faqaala ‏"‏ da'humaa yaa aabaa bakrin, faiinnahaa aayyaamu 'iydin, watilka alaayyaamu aayyaamu minana ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaalat 'aaiishaau raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yasturuniy, waaanaa aanzuru iilaa alhabashaai, wahum yal'abuwna fiy almasjidi fazajarahum ‏{‏'umaru‏}‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ da'hum aamnana baniy aarfadaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ ya'niy mina alaamni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:That during the Mina days, Abu Bakr came to her, while there were two girls with her, beating drums, and the Prophet (ﷺ) was (lying) covering himself with his garment. Abu Bakr rebuked the two girls, but the Prophet (ﷺ) uncovered his face and said, "O Abu Bakr! Leave them, for these are the days of Id (festival)." Those days were the days of Mina-. `Aisha added, "I was being screened by the Prophet (ﷺ) while I was watching the Ethiopians playing in the Mosque. `Umar rebuked them, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave them, O Bani Arfida! Play. (for) you are safe
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتِ اسْتَأْذَنَ حَسَّانُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هِجَاءِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَيْفَ بِنَسَبِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ حَسَّانُ لأَسُلَّنَّكَ مِنْهُمْ كَمَا تُسَلُّ الشَّعَرَةُ مِنَ الْعَجِينِ‏.‏ وَعَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ ذَهَبْتُ أَسُبُّ حَسَّانَ عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ فَقَالَتْ لاَ تَسُبُّهُ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يُنَافِحُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalati astaadhana hassaanu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hijaa'i almushrikiyna, qaala ‏ "‏ kayfa binasabiy ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala hassaanu laasullannaka minhum kamaa tusallu alshha'araau mina al'ajiyni‏.‏ wa'an aabiyhi qaala dhahabtu aasubbu hassaana 'inda 'aaiishaaa faqaalat laa tasubbuhu faiinnahu kaana yunaafihu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Once Hassan bin Thabit asked the permission of the Prophet (ﷺ) to lampoon (i.e. compose satirical poetry defaming) the infidels. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What about the fact that I have common descent with them?" Hassan replied, "I shall take you out of them as a hair is taken out of dough." Narrated `Urwa: I started abusing Hassan in front of `Aisha, whereupon she said. "Don't abuse him, for he used to defend the Prophet (with his poetry)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَعْنٌ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لِي خَمْسَةُ أَسْمَاءٍ أَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، وَأَحْمَدُ، وَأَنَا الْمَاحِي الَّذِي يَمْحُو اللَّهُ بِي الْكُفْرَ، وَأَنَا الْحَاشِرُ الَّذِي يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ عَلَى قَدَمِي، وَأَنَا الْعَاقِبُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, qaala haddathaniy ma'nun, 'an maalikin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an muhammadi bni jubayri bni mut'imin, 'an aabiyhi rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ liy khamsaau aasmaa'in aanaa muhammadun, waaahmadu, waaanaa almaahiy alladhiy yamhuw alllahu biy alkufra, waaanaa alhaashiru alladhiy yuhsharu alnnaasu 'alaa qadamiy, waaanaa al'aaqibu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have five names: I am Muhammad and Ahmad; I am Al-Mahi through whom Allah will eliminate infidelity; I am Al-Hashir who will be the first to be resurrected, the people being resurrected thereafter; and I am also Al-`Aqib (i.e. There will be no prophet after me)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَلاَ تَعْجَبُونَ كَيْفَ يَصْرِفُ اللَّهُ عَنِّي شَتْمَ قُرَيْشٍ وَلَعْنَهُمْ يَشْتِمُونَ مُذَمَّمًا وَيَلْعَنُونَ مُذَمَّمًا وَأَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aalaa ta'jabuwna kayfa yasrifu alllahu 'anniy shatma qurayshin wala'nahum yashtimuwna mudhammamana wayal'anuwna mudhammamana waaanaa muhammadun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Doesn't it astonish you how Allah protects me from the Quraish's abusing and cursing? They abuse Mudhammam and curse Mudhammam while I am Muhammad (and not Mudhammam)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مِينَاءَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ كَرَجُلٍ بَنَى دَارًا فَأَكْمَلَهَا وَأَحْسَنَهَا، إِلاَّ مَوْضِعَ لَبِنَةٍ، فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يَدْخُلُونَهَا وَيَتَعَجَّبُونَ، وَيَقُولُونَ لَوْلاَ مَوْضِعُ اللَّبِنَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu sinaanin, haddathanaa saliymun, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu miynaa'a, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mathaliy wamathalu alaanbiyaa'i karajulin banaa daarana faaakmalahaa waaahsanahaa, iilaaa mawdi'a labinaain, faja'ala alnnaasu yadkhuluwnahaa wayata'ajjabuwna, wayaquwluwna lawlaa mawdi'u alllabinaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "My similitude in comparison with the other prophets is that of a man who has built a house completely and excellently except for a place of one brick. When the people enter the house, they admire its beauty and say: 'But for the place of this brick (how splendid the house will be)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مَثَلِي وَمَثَلَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ مِنْ قَبْلِي كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ بَنَى بَيْتًا فَأَحْسَنَهُ وَأَجْمَلَهُ، إِلاَّ مَوْضِعَ لَبِنَةٍ مِنْ زَاوِيَةٍ، فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يَطُوفُونَ بِهِ وَيَعْجَبُونَ لَهُ، وَيَقُولُونَ هَلاَّ وُضِعَتْ هَذِهِ اللَّبِنَةُ قَالَ فَأَنَا اللَّبِنَةُ، وَأَنَا خَاتِمُ النَّبِيِّينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna mathaliy wamathala alaanbiyaa'i min qabliy kamathali rajulin banaa baytana faaahsanahu waaajmalahu, iilaaa mawdi'a labinaain min zaawiyaain, faja'ala alnnaasu yatuwfuwna bihi waya'jabuwna lahu, wayaquwluwna halaaa wudi'at hadhihi alllabinaau qaala faaanaa alllabinaau, waaanaa khaatimu alnnabiyyiyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "My similitude in comparison with the other prophets before me, is that of a man who has built a house nicely and beautifully, except for a place of one brick in a corner. The people go about it and wonder at its beauty, but say: 'Would that this brick be put in its place!' So I am that brick, and I am the last of the Prophets
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تُوُفِّيَ وَهْوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَأَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm tuwuffiya wahwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna‏.‏ waqaala abnu shihaabin waaakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi mithlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) died when he was sixty three years old
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي السُّوقِ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ‏.‏ فَالْتَفَتَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ سَمُّوا بِاسْمِي، وَلاَ تَكْتَنُوا بِكُنْيَتِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an humaydin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alssuwqi faqaala rajulun yaa aabaa alqaasimi‏.‏ faaltafata alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ sammuwa biasmiy, walaa taktanuwa bikunyatiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was in the market, a man called (somebody), "O Abu-l-Qasim!' The Prophet (ﷺ) turned to him and said "Name yourselves after me but do not call yourselves by my Kuniya
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي، وَلاَ تَكْتَنُوا بِكُنْيَتِي ‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an mansuwrin, 'an saalimin, 'an jaabirin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ tasammawa biasmiy, walaa taktanuwa bikunyatiy ‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Name yourselves after me, but do not call yourselves by my Kuniya
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ سَمُّوا بِاسْمِي، وَلاَ تَكْتَنُوا بِكُنْيَتِي ‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aayyuwba, 'ani abni siyriyna, qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala aabuw alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ sammuwa biasmiy, walaa taktanuwa bikunyatiy ‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Abu-l-Qasim said, "Name yourselves after me, but do not call yourselves by my Kuniya
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنِ الْجُعَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، رَأَيْتُ السَّائِبَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ ابْنَ أَرْبَعٍ وَتِسْعِينَ جَلْدًا مُعْتَدِلاً فَقَالَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ مَا مُتِّعْتُ بِهِ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي إِلاَّ بِدُعَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، إِنَّ خَالَتِي ذَهَبَتْ بِي إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ ابْنَ أُخْتِي شَاكٍ فَادْعُ اللَّهَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَعَا لِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa alfadlu bnu muwsaa, 'ani alju'aydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, raaaytu alssaaiiba bna yaziyda abna aarba'in watis'iyna jaldana mu'tadilaan faqaala qad 'alimtu maa mutti'tu bihi sam'iy wabasariy iilaaa bidu'aa'i rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, iinna khaalatiy dhahabat biy iilayhi faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna abna aukhtiy shaakin faad'u alllaha‏.‏ qaala fada'aa liy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Ju'aid bin `Abdur Rahman:I saw As-Sa'ib bin Yazid when he was ninety-four years old, quite strong and of straight figure. He said, "I know that I enjoyed my hearing and seeing powers only because of the invocation of Allah's Apostle . My aunt took me to him and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My nephew is sick; will you invoke Allah for him?' So he invoked (Allah) for me
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، عَنِ الْجُعَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ السَّائِبَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ ذَهَبَتْ بِي خَالَتِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ ابْنَ أُخْتِي‏.‏ وَقَعَ فَمَسَحَ رَأْسِي وَدَعَا لِي بِالْبَرَكَةِ، وَتَوَضَّأَ فَشَرِبْتُ مِنْ وَضُوئِهِ، ثُمَّ قُمْتُ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى خَاتَمٍ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْحُجْلَةُ مِنْ حُجَلِ الْفَرَسِ الَّذِي بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ مِثْلَ زِرِّ الْحَجَلَةِ
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydi alllahi, haddathanaa haatimun, 'ani alju'aydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala sami'tu alssaaiiba bna yaziyda, qaala dhahabat biy khaalatiy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna abna aukhtiy‏.‏ waqa'a famasaha raasiy wada'aa liy bialbarakaai, watawaddaaa fasharibtu min waduwiihi, thumma qumtu khalfa zahrihi fanazartu iilaa khaatamin bayna katifayhi‏.‏ qaala abnu 'ubaydi alllahi alhujlaau min hujali alfarasi alladhiy bayna 'aynayhi‏.‏ qaala iibraahiymu bnu hamzaaa mithla zirri alhajalaai
verses.translation: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:My aunt took me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My nephew is sick."' The Prophet (ﷺ) passed his hands over my head and blessed me. Then he performed ablution and I drank the remaining water, and standing behind him, I saw the seal in between his shoulders
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ صَلَّى أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ الْعَصْرَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ يَمْشِي فَرَأَى الْحَسَنَ يَلْعَبُ مَعَ الصِّبْيَانِ، فَحَمَلَهُ عَلَى عَاتِقِهِ وَقَالَ بِأَبِي شَبِيهٌ بِالنَّبِيِّ لاَ شَبِيهٌ بِعَلِيٍّ‏.‏ وَعَلِيٌّ يَضْحَكُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'an 'umara bni sa'iydi bni aabiy husaynin, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, 'an 'uqbaaa bni alhaarithi, qaala sallaa aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh al'asra, thumma kharaja yamshiy faraaaa alhasana yal'abu ma'a alssibyaani, fahamalahu 'alaa 'aatiqihi waqaala biaabiy shabiyhun bialnnabiyyi laa shabiyhun bi'aliyyin‏.‏ wa'aliyyun yadhaku‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:(Once) Abu Bakr offered the `Asr prayer and then went out walking and saw Al-Hasan playing with the boys. He lifted him on to his shoulders and said, " Let my parents be sacrificed for your sake! (You) resemble the Prophet (ﷺ) and not `Ali," while `Ali was smiling
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ الْحَسَنُ يُشْبِهُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aabiy juhayfaaa rda allh 'nh qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaana alhasanu yushbihuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:I saw the Prophet, and Al-Hasan resembled him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جُحَيْفَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ ـ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ ـ يُشْبِهُهُ قُلْتُ لأَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ صِفْهُ لِي‏.‏ قَالَ كَانَ أَبْيَضَ قَدْ شَمِطَ‏.‏ وَأَمَرَ لَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ قَلُوصًا قَالَ فَقُبِضَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبْلَ أَنْ نَقْبِضَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu aabiy khaalidin, qaala sami'tu aabaa juhayfaaa rda allh 'nh qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaana alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin 'alayhimaa alssalaamu yushbihuhu qultu laabiy juhayfaaa sifhu liy‏.‏ qaala kaana aabyada qad shamita‏.‏ waaamara lanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bithalaatha 'ashraaa qaluwsana qaala faqubida alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qabla aan naqbidahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Isma`il bin Abi Khalid:I heard Abu Juhaifa saying, "I saw the Prophet, and Al-Hasan bin `Ali resembled him." I said to Abu- Juhaifa, "Describe him for me." He said, "He was white and his beard was black with some white hair. He promised to give us 13 young she-camels, but he expired before we could get them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ وَهْبٍ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ السُّوَائِيِّ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَأَيْتُ بَيَاضًا مِنْ تَحْتِ شَفَتِهِ السُّفْلَى الْعَنْفَقَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu rajaa'in, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an wahbin aabiy juhayfaaa alssuwaaiiyyi, qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waraaaytu bayaadana min tahti shafatihi alssuflaa al'anfaqaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Wahb Abu Juhaifa As-Suwai:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) and saw some white hair below his lower lip above the chin
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عِصَامُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرِيزُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ بُسْرٍ صَاحِبَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ شَيْخًا قَالَ كَانَ فِي عَنْفَقَتِهِ شَعَرَاتٌ بِيضٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'isaamu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hariyzu bnu 'uthmaana, aannahu saaala 'abda alllahi bna busrin saahiba alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala aaraaayta alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana shaykhana qaala kaana fiy 'anfaqatihi sha'araatun biydun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hariz bin `Uthman:That he asked `Abdullah bin Busr (i.e. the companion of the Prophet), "Did you see the Prophet (ﷺ) when he was old?" He said, "He had a few white hairs between the lower lip and the chin
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَصِفُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ كَانَ رَبْعَةً مِنَ الْقَوْمِ، لَيْسَ بِالطَّوِيلِ وَلاَ بِالْقَصِيرِ، أَزْهَرَ اللَّوْنِ لَيْسَ بِأَبْيَضَ أَمْهَقَ وَلاَ آدَمَ، لَيْسَ بِجَعْدٍ قَطَطٍ وَلاَ سَبْطٍ رَجِلٍ، أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ وَهْوَ ابْنُ أَرْبَعِينَ، فَلَبِثَ بِمَكَّةَ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ يُنْزَلُ عَلَيْهِ وَبِالْمَدِينَةِ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ، وَلَيْسَ فِي رَأْسِهِ وَلِحْيَتِهِ عِشْرُونَ شَعَرَةً بَيْضَاءَ‏.‏ قَالَ رَبِيعَةُ فَرَأَيْتُ شَعَرًا مِنْ شَعَرِهِ، فَإِذَا هُوَ أَحْمَرُ فَسَأَلْتُ فَقِيلَ احْمَرَّ مِنَ الطِّيبِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy abnu bukayrin, qaala haddathaniy alllaythu, 'an khaalidin, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy hilaalin, 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yasifu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala kaana rab'aaan mina alqawmi, laysa bialttawiyli walaa bialqasiyri, aazhara alllawni laysa biaabyada aamhaqa walaa adama, laysa bija'din qatatin walaa sabtin rajilin, aunzila 'alayhi wahwa abnu aarba'iyna, falabitha bimakkaaa 'ashra siniyna yunzalu 'alayhi wabialmadiynaai 'ashra siniyna, walaysa fiy raasihi walihyatihi 'ishruwna sha'araaan baydaa'a‏.‏ qaala rabiy'aau faraaaytu sha'arana min sha'arihi, faiidhaa huwa aahmaru fasaaaltu faqiyla ahmarra mina alttiybi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Rabi`a bin Abi `Abdur-Rahman:I heard Anas bin Malik describing the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "He was of medium height amongst the people, neither tall nor short; he had a rosy color, neither absolutely white nor deep brown; his hair was neither completely curly nor quite lank. Divine Inspiration was revealed to him when he was forty years old. He stayed ten years in Mecca receiving the Divine Inspiration, and stayed in Medina for ten more years. When he expired, he had scarcely twenty white hairs in his head and beard." Rabi`a said, "I saw some of his hairs and it was red. When I asked about that, I was told that it turned red because of scent
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْسَ بِالطَّوِيلِ الْبَائِنِ وَلاَ بِالْقَصِيرِ، وَلاَ بِالأَبْيَضِ الأَمْهَقِ، وَلَيْسَ بِالآدَمِ وَلَيْسَ بِالْجَعْدِ الْقَطَطِ وَلاَ بِالسَّبْطِ، بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَأْسِ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً، فَأَقَامَ بِمَكَّةَ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ، وَبِالْمَدِينَةِ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ، فَتَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ، وَلَيْسَ فِي رَأْسِهِ وَلِحْيَتِهِ عِشْرُونَ شَعْرَةً بَيْضَاءَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aannahu sami'ahu yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laysa bialttawiyli albaaiini walaa bialqasiyri, walaa bialaabyadi alaamhaqi, walaysa bialadami walaysa bialja'di alqatati walaa bialssabti, ba'athahu alllahu 'alaa raasi aarba'iyna sanaaan, faaaqaama bimakkaaa 'ashra siniyna, wabialmadiynaai 'ashra siniyna, fatawaffaahu alllahu, walaysa fiy raasihi walihyatihi 'ishruwna sha'raaan baydaa'a‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was neither very tall nor short, neither absolutely white nor deep brown. His hair was neither curly nor lank. Allah sent him (as an Apostle) when he was forty years old. Afterwards he resided in Mecca for ten years and in Medina for ten more years. When Allah took him unto Him, there were scarcely twenty white hairs in his head and beard
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ وَجْهًا وَأَحْسَنَهُ خَلْقًا، لَيْسَ بِالطَّوِيلِ الْبَائِنِ وَلاَ بِالْقَصِيرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu sa'iydin aabuw 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu yuwsufa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a, yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahsana alnnaasi wajhana waaahsanahu khalqana, laysa bialttawiyli albaaiini walaa bialqasiyri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was the handsomest of all the people, and had the best appearance. He was neither very tall nor short
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسًا هَلْ خَضَبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لاَ، إِنَّمَا كَانَ شَىْءٌ فِي صُدْغَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an qataadaaa, qaala saaaltu aanasana hal khadaba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala laa, iinnamaa kaana shaa'un fiy sudghayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to dye (his) hair?" He said, "No, for there were only a few white hairs on his temples
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرْبُوعًا، بَعِيدَ مَا بَيْنَ الْمَنْكِبَيْنِ، لَهُ شَعَرٌ يَبْلُغُ شَحْمَةَ أُذُنِهِ، رَأَيْتُهُ فِي حُلَّةٍ حَمْرَاءَ، لَمْ أَرَ شَيْئًا قَطُّ أَحْسَنَ مِنْهُ‏.‏ قَالَ يُوسُفُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ إِلَى مَنْكِبَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm marbuw'ana, ba'iyda maa bayna almankibayni, lahu sha'arun yablughu shahmaaa audhunihi, raaaytuhu fiy hullaain hamraa'a, lam aara shayiana qattu aahsana minhu‏.‏ qaala yuwsufu bnu aabiy iishaaqa 'an aabiyhi iilaa mankibayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) was of moderate height having broad shoulders (long) hair reaching his ear-lobes. Once I saw him in a red cloak and I had never seen a more handsome man than him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سُئِلَ الْبَرَاءُ أَكَانَ وَجْهُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ السَّيْفِ قَالَ لاَ بَلْ مِثْلَ الْقَمَرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa zuhayrun, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala suiila albaraa'u aakaana wajhu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithla alssayfi qaala laa bal mithla alqamari‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:Al-Bara' was asked, "Was the face of the Prophet (as bright) as a sword?" He said, "No, but (as bright) as a moon
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ أَبُو عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الأَعْوَرُ، بِالْمَصِّيصَةِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جُحَيْفَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْهَاجِرَةِ إِلَى الْبَطْحَاءِ فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَالْعَصْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَبَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ عَنَزَةٌ‏.‏ ‏{‏قَالَ شُعْبَةُ‏}‏ وَزَادَ فِيهِ عَوْنٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ قَالَ كَانَ يَمُرُّ مِنْ وَرَائِهَا الْمَرْأَةُ، وَقَامَ النَّاسُ فَجَعَلُوا يَأْخُذُونَ يَدَيْهِ، فَيَمْسَحُونَ بِهَا وُجُوهَهُمْ، قَالَ فَأَخَذْتُ بِيَدِهِ، فَوَضَعْتُهَا عَلَى وَجْهِي، فَإِذَا هِيَ أَبْرَدُ مِنَ الثَّلْجِ، وَأَطْيَبُ رَائِحَةً مِنَ الْمِسْكِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu mansuwrin aabuw 'aliyyin, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin alaa'waru, bialmassiysaai haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, qaala sami'tu aabaa juhayfaaa, qaala kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialhaajiraai iilaa albathaa'i fatawaddaaa thumma sallaa alzzuhra rak'atayni, waal'asra rak'atayni, wabayna yadayhi 'anazaaun‏.‏ ‏{‏qaala shu'baau‏}‏ wazaada fiyhi 'awnun 'an aabiyhi aabiy juhayfaaa qaala kaana yamurru min waraaiihaa almaraaau, waqaama alnnaasu faja'aluwa yaakhudhuwna yadayhi, fayamsahuwna bihaa wujuwhahum, qaala faaakhadhtu biyadihi, fawada'tuhaa 'alaa wajhiy, faiidhaa hiya aabradu mina althhalji, waaatyabu raaiihaaan mina almiski‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to Al-Batha' at noon, performed the ablution and offered' a two rak`at Zuhr prayer and a two-rak`at `Asr prayer while a spearheaded stick was planted before him and the passersby were passing in front of it. (After the prayer), the people got up and held the hands of the Prophet and passed them on their faces. I also took his hand and kept it on my face and noticed that it was colder than ice, and its smell was nicer than musk
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَجْوَدَ النَّاسِ، وَأَجْوَدُ مَا يَكُونُ فِي رَمَضَانَ، حِينَ يَلْقَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ، وَكَانَ جِبْرِيلُ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ يَلْقَاهُ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ، فَيُدَارِسُهُ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَجْوَدُ بِالْخَيْرِ مِنَ الرِّيحِ الْمُرْسَلَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aajwada alnnaasi, waaajwadu maa yakuwnu fiy ramadaana, hiyna yalqaahu jibriylu, wakaana jibriylu 'alayhi alssalaamu yalqaahu fiy kulli laylaain min ramadaana, fayudaarisuhu alqurana falarasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aajwadu bialkhayri mina alrriyhi almursalaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was the most generous of all the people, and he used to become more generous in Ramadan when Gabriel met him. Gabriel used to meet him every night during Ramadan to revise the Qur'an with him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then used to be more generous than the fast wind
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا مَسْرُورًا تَبْرُقُ أَسَارِيرُ وَجْهِهِ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعِي مَا قَالَ الْمُدْلِجِيُّ لِزَيْدٍ وَأُسَامَةَ ـ وَرَأَى أَقْدَامَهُمَا ـ إِنَّ بَعْضَ هَذِهِ الأَقْدَامِ مِنْ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala 'alayhaa masruwrana tabruqu aasaariyru wajhihi, faqaala ‏ "‏ aalam tasma'iy maa qaala almudlijiyyu lizaydin waausaamaaa waraaaa aaqdaamahumaa iinna ba'da hadhihi alaaqdaami min ba'din ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to her in a happy mood with his features glittering with joy, and said, "Have you not heard what the Qaif has said about Zaid and Us-ama? He saw their feet and remarked. These belong to each other." (i.e. They are father and son)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ كَعْبَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يُحَدِّثُ حِينَ تَخَلَّفَ عَنْ تَبُوكَ، قَالَ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ يَبْرُقُ وَجْهُهُ مِنَ السُّرُورِ، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سُرَّ اسْتَنَارَ وَجْهُهُ، حَتَّى كَأَنَّهُ قِطْعَةُ قَمَرٍ، وَكُنَّا نَعْرِفُ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdi alllahi bni ka'bin, aanna 'abda alllahi bna ka'bin, qaala sami'tu ka'ba bna maalikin, yuhaddithu hiyna takhallafa 'an tabuwka, qaala falammaa sallamtu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa yabruqu wajhuhu mina alssuruwri, wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa surra astanaara wajhuhu, hattaa kaaannahu qit'aau qamarin, wakunnaa na'rifu dhalika minhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:I heard Ka`b bin Malik talking after his failure to join (the Ghazwa of) Tabuk. He said, "When I greeted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whose face was glittering with happiness, for whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was happy, his face used to glitter, as if it was a piece of the moon, and we used to recognize it (i.e. his happiness) from his face
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بُعِثْتُ مِنْ خَيْرِ قُرُونِ بَنِي آدَمَ قَرْنًا فَقَرْنًا، حَتَّى كُنْتُ مِنَ الْقَرْنِ الَّذِي كُنْتُ فِيهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'amrinw, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ bu'ithtu min khayri quruwni baniy adama qarnana faqarnana, hattaa kuntu mina alqarni alladhiy kuntu fiyhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have been sent (as an Apostle) in the best of all the generations of Adam's offspring since their Creation
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَسْدِلُ شَعَرَهُ، وَكَانَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ يَفْرُقُونَ رُءُوسَهُمْ فَكَانَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ يَسْدِلُونَ رُءُوسَهُمْ، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحِبُّ مُوَافَقَةَ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ فِيمَا لَمْ يُؤْمَرْ فِيهِ بِشَىْءٍ، ثُمَّ فَرَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأْسَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yasdilu sha'arahu, wakaana almushrikuwna yafruquwna ru'uwsahum fakaana aahlu alkitaabi yasdiluwna ru'uwsahum, wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhibbu muwaafaqaaa aahli alkitaabi fiymaa lam yuumar fiyhi bishaa'in, thumma faraqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raasahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to let his hair hang down while the infidels used to part their hair. The people of the Scriptures were used to letting their hair hang down and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) liked to follow the people of the Scriptures in the matters about which he was not instructed otherwise. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) parted his hair
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمْ يَكُنِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاحِشًا وَلاَ مُتَفَحِّشًا وَكَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مِنْ خِيَارِكُمْ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, 'an aabiy hamzaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw rda allh 'nhma qaala lam yakuni alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faahishana walaa mutafahhishana wakaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna min khiyaarikum aahsanakum aakhlaaqana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) never used bad language neither a "Fahish nor a Mutafahish. He used to say "The best amongst you are those who have the best manners and character." (See Hadith No. 56 (B) Vol
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ مَا خُيِّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَمْرَيْنِ إِلاَّ أَخَذَ أَيْسَرَهُمَا، مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ إِثْمًا، فَإِنْ كَانَ إِثْمًا كَانَ أَبْعَدَ النَّاسِ مِنْهُ، وَمَا انْتَقَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِنَفْسِهِ، إِلاَّ أَنْ تُنْتَهَكَ حُرْمَةُ اللَّهِ فَيَنْتَقِمَ لِلَّهِ بِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aannahaa qaalat maa khuyyira rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna aamrayni iilaaa aakhadha aaysarahumaa, maa lam yakun iithmana, faiin kaana iithmana kaana aab'ada alnnaasi minhu, wamaa antaqama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm linafsihi, iilaaa aan tuntahaka hurmaau alllahi fayantaqima lillahi bihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was given the choice of one of two matters, he would choose the easier of the two, as long as it was not sinful to do so, but if it was sinful to do so, he would not approach it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never took revenge (over anybody) for his own sake but (he did) only when Allah's Legal Bindings were outraged in which case he would take revenge for Allah's Sake
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ مَا مَسِسْتُ حَرِيرًا وَلاَ دِيبَاجًا أَلْيَنَ مِنْ كَفِّ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَلاَ شَمِمْتُ رِيحًا قَطُّ أَوْ عَرْفًا قَطُّ أَطْيَبَ مِنْ رِيحِ أَوْ عَرْفِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala maa masistu hariyrana walaa diybaajana aalyana min kaffi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, walaa shamimtu riyhana qattu aaw 'arfana qattu aatyaba min riyhi aaw 'arfi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:I have never touched silk or Dibaj (i.e. thick silk) softer than the palm of the Prophet (ﷺ) nor have I smelt a perfume nicer than the sweat of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَشَدَّ حَيَاءً مِنَ الْعَذْرَاءِ فِي خِدْرِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy 'utbaaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aashadda hayaa'an mina al'adhraa'i fiy khidrihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) was shier than a veiled virgin girl
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، وَابْنُ، مَهْدِيٍّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، مِثْلَهُ وَإِذَا كَرِهَ شَيْئًا عُرِفَ فِي وَجْهِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa yahyaa, waabnu, mahdiyyin qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, mithlahu waiidhaa kariha shayiana 'urifa fiy wajhihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Shuba:A similar Hadith (i e. No. 762) with this addition: And if he (i.e. the Prophet) disliked something, the sign of aversion would appear on his face
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْجَعْدِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ مَا عَابَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَعَامًا قَطُّ، إِنِ اشْتَهَاهُ أَكَلَهُ، وَإِلاَّ تَرَكَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu alja'di, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala maa 'aaba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ta'aamana qattu, iini ashtahaahu aakalahu, waiilaaa tarakahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) never criticized any food (presented to him), but he would eat it if he liked it; otherwise, he would leave it (without expressing his dislike)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ مُضَرَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ الأَسْدِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَجَدَ فَرَّجَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى نَرَى إِبْطَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ ابْنُ بُكَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرٌ بَيَاضَ إِبْطَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa bakru bnu mudara, 'an ja'fari bni rabiy'aaa, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni maalikin abni buhaynaaa alaasdiyyi, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa sajada farraja bayna yadayhi hattaa naraa iibtayhi‏.‏ qaala waqaala abnu bukayrin haddathanaa bakrun bayaada iibtayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Malik bin Buhaina Al-Asdi:When the Prophet (ﷺ) prostrated, he used to keep his arms so widely apart that we used to see his armpits. (The sub-narrator, Ibn Bukair said, "The whiteness of his armpits)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ لاَ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ دُعَائِهِ، إِلاَّ فِي الاِسْتِسْقَاءِ، فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يُرَى بَيَاضُ إِبْطَيْهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى دَعَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ وَرَأَيْتُ بَيَاضَ إِبْطَيْهِ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa bnu hamaaadin, hadaathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, hadaathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, aanaa aanasana rda allh 'nh hadaathahum aanaa rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana laa yarfa'u yadayhi fiy shaa'in min du'aaiihi, iilaaa fiy alaistisqaa'i, faiinaahu kaana yarfa'u yadayhi hataaa yuraa bayaadu iibtayhi‏.‏ waqaala aabuw muwsaa da'aa alnaabiyuu salaaa allaahu 'alayhi wasalaama warafa'a yadayhi waraaaytu bayaada iibtayhi
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not use to raise his hands in his invocations except in the Istisqa (i.e. invoking Allah for the rain) in which he used to raise his hands so high that one could see the whiteness of his armpits. (Note: It may be that Anas did not see the Prophet (ﷺ) raising his hands but it has been narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to raise his hands for invocations other than Istisqa. See Hadith No. 612 Vol. 5. and Hadith No. 807 & 808 Vol
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَابِقٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَوْنَ بْنَ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، ذَكَرَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ دُفِعْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ بِالأَبْطَحِ فِي قُبَّةٍ كَانَ بِالْهَاجِرَةِ، خَرَجَ بِلاَلٌ فَنَادَى بِالصَّلاَةِ، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ فَأَخْرَجَ فَضْلَ وَضُوءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَوَقَعَ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ يَأْخُذُونَ مِنْهُ، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ فَأَخْرَجَ الْعَنَزَةَ، وَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ سَاقَيْهِ فَرَكَزَ الْعَنَزَةَ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَالْعَصْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، يَمُرُّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ الْحِمَارُ وَالْمَرْأَةُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu alssabbaahi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu saabiqin, haddathanaa maaliku bnu mighwalin, qaala sami'tu 'awna bna aabiy juhayfaaa, dhakara 'an aabiyhi, qaala dufi'tu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa bialaabtahi fiy qubbaain kaana bialhaajiraai, kharaja bilaalun fanaadaa bialssalaaai, thumma dakhala faaakhraja fadla waduw'i rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fawaqa'a alnnaasu 'alayhi yaakhudhuwna minhu, thumma dakhala faaakhraja al'anazaaa, wakharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaaanniy aanzuru iilaa wabiysi saaqayhi farakaza al'anazaaa, thumma sallaa alzzuhra rak'atayni waal'asra rak'atayni, yamurru bayna yadayhi alhimaaru waalmaraaau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:By chance I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) at noon while he was at Al-Abtah (resting) in a tent. Bilal came out (of the tent) and pronounced the Adhan for the prayer, and entering again, he brought out the water which was left after Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had performed the ablution. The people rushed to take some of the water. Bilal again went in and brought out a spear-headed stick, and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out. As if I were now looking at the whiteness of his leg. Bilal fixed the stick and the Prophet (ﷺ) offered a two-rak`at Zuhr prayer and a two-rak`at `Asr prayer, while women and donkeys were passing in front of the Prophet (beyond the stick)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَبَّاحٍ الْبَزَّارُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُحَدِّثُ حَدِيثًا لَوْ عَدَّهُ الْعَادُّ لأَحْصَاهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ أَلاَ يُعْجِبُكَ أَبُو فُلاَنٍ جَاءَ فَجَلَسَ إِلَى جَانِبِ حُجْرَتِي يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يُسْمِعُنِي ذَلِكَ وَكُنْتُ أُسَبِّحُ فَقَامَ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَقْضِيَ سُبْحَتِي، وَلَوْ أَدْرَكْتُهُ لَرَدَدْتُ عَلَيْهِ، إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَكُنْ يَسْرُدُ الْحَدِيثَ كَسَرْدِكُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alhasanu bnu sabbaahin albazzaaru, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yuhaddithu hadiythana law 'addahu al'aaddu laahsaahu‏.‏ waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aannahu qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat aalaa yu'jibuka aabuw fulaanin jaa'a fajalasa iilaa jaanibi hujratiy yuhaddithu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, yusmi'uniy dhalika wakuntu ausabbihu faqaama qabla aan aaqdiya subhatiy, walaw aadraktuhu laradadtu 'alayhi, iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yakun yasrudu alhadiytha kasardikum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to talk so clearly that if somebody wanted to count the number of his words, he could do so. Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair: `Aisha said (to me), "Don't you wonder at Abu so-and-so who came and sat by my dwelling and started relating the traditions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) intending to let me hear that, while I was performing an optional prayer. He left before I finished my optional prayer. Had I found him still there. I would have said to him, 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never talked so quickly and vaguely as you do
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ كَيْفَ كَانَتْ صَلاَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَمَضَانَ قَالَتْ مَا كَانَ يَزِيدُ فِي رَمَضَانَ وَلاَ غَيْرِهِ عَلَى إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، يُصَلِّي أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ فَلاَ تَسْأَلْ عَنْ حُسْنِهِنَّ وَطُولِهِنَّ، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي أَرْبَعًا فَلاَ تَسْأَلْ عَنْ حُسْنِهِنَّ وَطُولِهِنَّ، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي ثَلاَثًا فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تَنَامُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُوتِرَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ تَنَامُ عَيْنِي وَلاَ يَنَامُ قَلْبِي ‏"‏‏.‏
