verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahu saaala 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha kayfa kaanat salaaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ramadaana qaalat maa kaana yaziydu fiy ramadaana walaa ghayrihi 'alaa iihdaa 'ashraaa rak'aaan, yusalliy aarba'a raka'aatin falaa tasaal 'an husnihinna watuwlihinna, thumma yusalliy aarba'ana falaa tasaal 'an husnihinna watuwlihinna, thumma yusalliy thalaathana faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi tanaamu qabla aan tuwtira qaala ‏ "‏ tanaamu 'ayniy walaa yanaamu qalbiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Salama bin `Abdur-Rahman:That he asked `Aisha "How was the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the month of Ramadan?" She replied, "He used not to pray more than eleven rak`at whether in Ramadan or in any other month. He used to offer four rak`at, let alone their beauty and length, and then four rak`at, let alone their beauty and length. Afterwards he would offer three rak`at. I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you go to bed before offering the witr prayer?' He said, 'My eyes sleep, but my heart does not sleep
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ شَرِيكِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يُحَدِّثُنَا عَنْ لَيْلَةِ، أُسْرِيَ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ مَسْجِدِ الْكَعْبَةِ جَاءَ ثَلاَثَةُ نَفَرٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُوحَى إِلَيْهِ، وَهُوَ نَائِمٌ فِي مَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ، فَقَالَ أَوَّلُهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ هُوَ فَقَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ هُوَ خَيْرُهُمْ وَقَالَ آخِرُهُمْ خُذُوا خَيْرَهُمْ‏.‏ فَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ، فَلَمْ يَرَهُمْ حَتَّى جَاءُوا لَيْلَةً أُخْرَى، فِيمَا يَرَى قَلْبُهُ، وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَائِمَةٌ عَيْنَاهُ وَلاَ يَنَامُ قَلْبُهُ وَكَذَلِكَ الأَنْبِيَاءُ تَنَامُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ وَلاَ تَنَامُ قُلُوبُهُمْ، فَتَوَلاَّهُ جِبْرِيلُ ثُمَّ عَرَجَ بِهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy aakhiy, 'an sulaymaana, 'an shariyki bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy namirin, sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yuhaddithunaa 'an laylaai, ausriya bialnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm min masjidi alka'baai jaa'a thalaathaau nafarin qabla aan yuwhaa iilayhi, wahuwa naaiimun fiy masjidi alharaami, faqaala aawwaluhum aayyuhum huwa faqaala aawsatuhum huwa khayruhum waqaala akhiruhum khudhuwa khayrahum‏.‏ fakaanat tilka, falam yarahum hattaa jaa'uwa laylaaan aukhraa, fiymaa yaraa qalbuhu, waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm naaiimaaun 'aynaahu walaa yanaamu qalbuhu wakadhalika alaanbiyaa'u tanaamu aa'yunuhum walaa tanaamu quluwbuhum, fatawalaaahu jibriylu thumma 'araja bihi iilaa alssamaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sharik bin `Abdullah bin Abi Namir:I heard Anas bin Malik telling us about the night when the Prophet (ﷺ) was made to travel from the Ka`ba Mosque. Three persons (i.e. angels) came to the Prophet (ﷺ) before he was divinely inspired was an Apostle), while he was sleeping in Al-Masjid-ul-Haram. The first (of the three angels) said, "Which of them is he?" The second said, "He is the best of them." That was all that happened then, and he did not see them till they came at another night and he perceived their presence with his heart, for the eyes of the Prophet (ﷺ) were closed when he was asleep, but his heart was not asleep (not unconscious). This is characteristic of all the prophets: Their eyes sleep but their hearts do not sleep. Then Gabriel took charge of the Prophet (ﷺ) and ascended along with him to the Heaven
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلْمُ بْنُ زَرِيرٍ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا رَجَاءٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُصَيْنٍ، أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَسِيرٍ، فَأَدْلَجُوا لَيْلَتَهُمْ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ وَجْهُ الصُّبْحِ عَرَّسُوا فَغَلَبَتْهُمْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ حَتَّى ارْتَفَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ، فَكَانَ أَوَّلَ مَنِ اسْتَيْقَظَ مِنْ مَنَامِهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَكَانَ لاَ يُوقَظُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ مَنَامِهِ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَ، فَاسْتَيْقَظَ عُمَرُ فَقَعَدَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ فَجَعَلَ يُكَبِّرُ وَيَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ، حَتَّى اسْتَيْقَظَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَزَلَ وَصَلَّى بِنَا الْغَدَاةَ، فَاعْتَزَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ لَمْ يُصَلِّ مَعَنَا فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا فُلاَنُ مَا يَمْنَعُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ مَعَنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَصَابَتْنِي جَنَابَةٌ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَتَيَمَّمَ بِالصَّعِيدِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَجَعَلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَكُوبٍ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، وَقَدْ عَطِشْنَا عَطَشًا شَدِيدًا فَبَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ نَسِيرُ إِذَا نَحْنُ بِامْرَأَةٍ سَادِلَةٍ رِجْلَيْهَا بَيْنَ مَزَادَتَيْنِ، فَقُلْنَا لَهَا أَيْنَ الْمَاءُ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّهُ لاَ مَاءَ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا كَمْ بَيْنَ أَهْلِكِ وَبَيْنَ الْمَاءِ قَالَتْ يَوْمٌ وَلَيْلَةٌ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا انْطَلِقِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَلَمْ نُمَلِّكْهَا مِنْ أَمْرِهَا حَتَّى اسْتَقْبَلْنَا بِهَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَحَدَّثَتْهُ بِمِثْلِ الَّذِي حَدَّثَتْنَا غَيْرَ أَنَّهَا حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّهَا مُؤْتِمَةٌ، فَأَمَرَ بِمَزَادَتَيْهَا فَمَسَحَ فِي الْعَزْلاَوَيْنِ، فَشَرِبْنَا عِطَاشًا أَرْبَعِينَ رَجُلاً حَتَّى رَوِينَا، فَمَلأْنَا كُلَّ قِرْبَةٍ مَعَنَا وَإِدَاوَةٍ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ نَسْقِ بَعِيرًا وَهْىَ تَكَادُ تَنِضُّ مِنَ الْمِلْءِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَاتُوا مَا عِنْدَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجُمِعَ لَهَا مِنَ الْكِسَرِ وَالتَّمْرِ، حَتَّى أَتَتْ أَهْلَهَا قَالَتْ لَقِيتُ أَسْحَرَ النَّاسِ، أَوْ هُوَ نَبِيٌّ كَمَا زَعَمُوا، فَهَدَى اللَّهُ ذَاكَ الصِّرْمَ بِتِلْكَ الْمَرْأَةِ فَأَسْلَمَتْ وَأَسْلَمُوا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa salmu bnu zariyrin, sami'tu aabaa rajaa'in, qaala haddathanaa 'imraanu bnu husaynin, aannahum kaanuwa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy masiyrin, faaadlajuwa laylatahum hattaa iidhaa kaana wajhu alssubhi 'arrasuwa faghalabathum aa'yunuhum hattaa artafa'ati alshhamsu, fakaana aawwala mani astayqaza min manaamihi aabuw bakrin, wakaana laa yuwqazu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min manaamihi hattaa yastayqiza, faastayqaza 'umaru faqa'ada aabuw bakrin 'inda raasihi faja'ala yukabbiru wayarfa'u sawtahu, hattaa astayqaza alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fanazala wasallaa binaa alghadaaaa, faa'tazala rajulun mina alqawmi lam yusalli ma'anaa falammaa ansarafa qaala ‏"‏ yaa fulaanu maa yamna'uka aan tusalliya ma'anaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aasaabatniy janaabaaun‏.‏ faaamarahu aan yatayammama bialssa'iydi, thumma sallaa waja'alaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy rakuwbin bayna yadayhi, waqad 'atishnaa 'atashana shadiydana fabaynamaa nahnu nasiyru iidhaa nahnu biamraaaain saadilaain rijlayhaa bayna mazaadatayni, faqulnaa lahaa aayna almaa'u faqaalat iinnahu laa maa'a‏.‏ faqulnaa kam bayna aahliki wabayna almaa'i qaalat yawmun walaylaaun‏.‏ faqulnaa antaliqiy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaalat wamaa rasuwlu alllahi falam numallikhaa min aamrihaa hattaa astaqbalnaa bihaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm, fahaddathathu bimithli alladhiy haddathatnaa ghayra aannahaa haddathathu aannahaa muutimaaun, faaamara bimazaadatayhaa famasaha fiy al'azlaawayni, fasharibnaa 'itaashana aarba'iyna rajulaan hattaa rawiynaa, famalanaa kulla qirbaain ma'anaa waiidaawaain, ghayra aannahu lam nasqi ba'iyrana wahaa takaadu taniddu mina almil'i thumma qaala ‏"‏ haatuwa maa 'indakum ‏"‏‏.‏ fajumi'a lahaa mina alkisari waalttamri, hattaa aatat aahlahaa qaalat laqiytu aashara alnnaasi, aaw huwa nabiyyun kamaa za'amuwa, fahadaa alllahu dhaaka alssirma bitilka almaraaai faaaslamat waaaslamuwa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:That they were with the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey. They travelled the whole night, and when dawn approached, they took a rest and sleep overwhelmed them till the sun rose high in the sky. The first to get up was Abu Bakr. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used not to be awakened from his sleep, but he would wake up by himself. `Umar woke up and then Abu Bakr sat by the side of the Prophet's head and started saying: Allahu-Akbar raising his voice till the Prophet (ﷺ) woke up, (and after traveling for a while) he dismounted and led us in the morning prayer. A man amongst the people failed to join us in the prayer. When the Prophet (ﷺ) had finished the prayer, he asked (the man), "O so-and-so! What prevented you from offering the prayer with us?" He replied, "I am Junub." Allah's Apostle ordered him to perform Tayammam with clean earth. The man then offered the prayer. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered me and a few others to go ahead of him. We had become very thirsty. While we were on our way (looking for water), we came across a lady (riding an animal), hanging her legs between two water-skins. We asked her, "Where can we get water?" She replied, "Oh ! There is no water." We asked, "how far is your house from the water?" She replied, "A distance of a day and a night travel." We said, "Come on to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." She asked, "What is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" So we brought her to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) against her will, and she told him what she had told us before and added that she was the mother of orphans. So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that her two water-skins be brought and he rubbed the mouths of the water-skins. As we were thirsty, we drank till we quenched our thirst and we were forty men. We also filled all our waterskins and other utensils with water, but we did not water the camels. The waterskin was so full that it was almost about to burst. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Bring what (foodstuff) you have." So some dates and pieces of bread were collected for the lady, and when she went to her people, she said, "I have met either the greatest magician or a prophet as the people claim." So Allah guided the people of that village through that lady. She embraced Islam and they all embraced Islam
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِإِنَاءٍ وَهْوَ بِالزَّوْرَاءِ، فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ، فَجَعَلَ الْمَاءُ يَنْبُعُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ، فَتَوَضَّأَ الْقَوْمُ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ قُلْتُ لأَنَسٍ كَمْ كُنْتُمْ قَالَ ثَلاَثَمِائَةٍ، أَوْ زُهَاءَ ثَلاَثِمِائَةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala autiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biiinaa'in wahwa bialzzawraa'i, fawada'a yadahu fiy aliinaa'i, faja'ala almaa'u yanbu'u min bayni aasaabi'ihi, fatawaddaaa alqawmu‏.‏ qaala qataadaau qultu laanasin kam kuntum qaala thalaathamiaiaain, aaw zuhaa'a thalaathimiaiaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:A bowl of water was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was at Az-Zawra. He placed his hand in it and the water started flowing among his fingers. All the people performed ablution (with that water). Qatada asked Anas, "How many people were you?" Anas replied, "Three hundred or nearly three hundred
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَانَتْ صَلاَةُ الْعَصْرِ، فَالْتُمِسَ الْوَضُوءُ فَلَمْ يَجِدُوهُ فَأُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِوَضُوءٍ، فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ فِي ذَلِكَ الإِنَاءِ، فَأَمَرَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّئُوا مِنْهُ، فَرَأَيْتُ الْمَاءَ يَنْبُعُ مِنْ تَحْتِ أَصَابِعِهِ، فَتَوَضَّأَ النَّاسُ حَتَّى تَوَضَّئُوا مِنْ عِنْدِ آخِرِهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aannahu qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaanat salaaau al'asri, faaltumisa alwaduw'u falam yajiduwhu faautiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biwaduw'in, fawada'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadahu fiy dhalika aliinaa'i, faaamara alnnaasa aan yatawaddaiuwa minhu, faraaaytu almaa'a yanbu'u min tahti aasaabi'ihi, fatawaddaaa alnnaasu hattaa tawaddaiuwa min 'indi akhirihim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the 'time when the `Asr prayer was due. Then the people were searching for water for ablution but they could not find any. Then some water was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he placed his hand in the pot and ordered the people to perform the ablution with the water. I saw water flowing from underneath his fingers and the people started performing the ablution till all of them did it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَزْمٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ مَخَارِجِهِ وَمَعَهُ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، فَانْطَلَقُوا يَسِيرُونَ، فَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا مَاءً يَتَوَضَّئُونَ، فَانْطَلَقَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ، فَجَاءَ بِقَدَحٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ يَسِيرٍ فَأَخَذَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَوَضَّأَ، ثُمَّ مَدَّ أَصَابِعَهُ الأَرْبَعَ عَلَى الْقَدَحِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ قُومُوا فَتَوَضَّئُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَتَوَضَّأَ، الْقَوْمُ حَتَّى بَلَغُوا فِيمَا يُرِيدُونَ مِنَ الْوَضُوءِ، وَكَانُوا سَبْعِينَ أَوْ نَحْوَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mubaarakin, haddathanaa hazmun, qaala sami'tu alhasana, qaala haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ba'di makhaarijihi wama'ahu naasun min aashaabihi, faantalaquwa yasiyruwna, fahadarati alssalaaau falam yajiduwa maa'an yatawaddaiuwna, faantalaqa rajulun mina alqawmi, fajaa'a biqadahin min maa'in yasiyrin faaakhadhahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fatawaddaaa, thumma madda aasaabi'ahu alaarba'a 'alaa alqadahi thumma qaala ‏ "‏ quwmuwa fatawaddaiuwa ‏"‏‏.‏ fatawaddaaa, alqawmu hattaa balaghuwa fiymaa yuriyduwna mina alwaduw'i, wakaanuwa sab'iyna aaw nahwahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out on one of his journeys with some of his companions. They went on walking till the time of the prayer became due. They could not find water to perform the ablution. One of them went away and brought a little amount of water in a pot. The Prophet (ﷺ) took it and performed the ablution, and then stretched his four fingers on to the pot and said (to the people), "Get up to perform the ablution." They started performing the ablution till all of them did it, and they were seventy or so persons
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُنِيرٍ، سَمِعَ يَزِيدَ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَقَامَ مَنْ كَانَ قَرِيبَ الدَّارِ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ يَتَوَضَّأُ، وَبَقِيَ قَوْمٌ، فَأُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِخْضَبٍ مِنْ حِجَارَةٍ فِيهِ مَاءٌ، فَوَضَعَ كَفَّهُ فَصَغُرَ الْمِخْضَبُ أَنْ يَبْسُطَ فِيهِ كَفَّهُ، فَضَمَّ أَصَابِعَهُ فَوَضَعَهَا فِي الْمِخْضَبِ، فَتَوَضَّأَ الْقَوْمُ كُلُّهُمْ جَمِيعًا‏.‏ قُلْتُ كَمْ كَانُوا قَالَ ثَمَانُونَ رَجُلاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muniyrin, sami'a yaziyda, aakhbaranaa humaydun, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala hadarati alssalaaau faqaama man kaana qariyba alddaari mina almasjidi yatawaddaau, wabaqiya qawmun, faautiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bimikhdabin min hijaaraain fiyhi maa'un, fawada'a kaffahu fasaghura almikhdabu aan yabsuta fiyhi kaffahu, fadamma aasaabi'ahu fawada'ahaa fiy almikhdabi, fatawaddaaa alqawmu kulluhum jamiy'ana‏.‏ qultu kam kaanuwa qaala thamaanuwna rajulaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Humaid:Anas bin Malik said, "Once the time of the prayer became due and the people whose houses were close to the Mosque went to their houses to perform ablution, while the others remained (sitting there). A stone pot containing water was brought to the Prophet, who wanted to put his hand in it, but It was too small for him to spread his hand in it, and so he had to bring his fingers together before putting his hand in the pot. Then all the people performed the ablution (with that water)." I asked Anas, "How many persons were they." He replied, "There were eighty men
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ عَطِشَ النَّاسُ يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ، وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ رَكْوَةٌ فَتَوَضَّأَ فَجَهَشَ النَّاسُ نَحْوَهُ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا لَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لَيْسَ عِنْدَنَا مَاءٌ نَتَوَضَّأُ وَلاَ نَشْرَبُ إِلاَّ مَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ، فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ فِي الرَّكْوَةِ فَجَعَلَ الْمَاءُ يَثُورُ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ كَأَمْثَالِ الْعُيُونِ، فَشَرِبْنَا وَتَوَضَّأْنَا‏.‏ قُلْتُ كَمْ كُنْتُمْ قَالَ لَوْ كُنَّا مِائَةَ أَلْفٍ لَكَفَانَا، كُنَّا خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muslimin, haddathanaa husaynun, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala 'atisha alnnaasu yawma alhudaybiyaai, waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna yadayhi rakwaaun fatawaddaaa fajahasha alnnaasu nahwahu, faqaala ‏ "‏ maa lakum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa laysa 'indanaa maa'un natawaddaau walaa nashrabu iilaaa maa bayna yadayka, fawada'a yadahu fiy alrrakwaai faja'ala almaa'u yathuwru bayna aasaabi'ihi kaaamthaali al'uyuwni, fasharibnaa watawaddaanaa‏.‏ qultu kam kuntum qaala law kunnaa miaiaaa aalfin lakafaanaa, kunnaa khamsa 'ashraaa miaiaaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salim bin Abi Aj-Jad:Jabir bin `Abdullah said, "The people became very thirsty on the day of Al-Hudaibiya (Treaty). A small pot containing some water was in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) and when he had finished the ablution, the people rushed towards him. He asked, 'What is wrong with you?' They replied, 'We have no water either for performing ablution or for drinking except what is present in front of you.' So he placed his hand in that pot and the water started flowing among his fingers like springs. We all drank and performed ablution (from it)." I asked Jabir, "How many were you?" he replied, "Even if we had been one-hundred-thousand, it would have been sufficient for us, but we were fifteen-hundred
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً، وَالْحُدَيْبِيَةُ بِئْرٌ فَنَزَحْنَاهَا حَتَّى لَمْ نَتْرُكْ فِيهَا قَطْرَةً، فَجَلَسَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى شَفِيرِ الْبِئْرِ، فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَمَضْمَضَ وَمَجَّ فِي الْبِئْرِ، فَمَكَثْنَا غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَيْنَا حَتَّى رَوِينَا وَرَوَتْ ـ أَوْ صَدَرَتْ ـ رَكَائِبُنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i rda allh 'nh qaala kunnaa yawma alhudaybiyaai aarba'a 'ashraaa miaiaaan, waalhudaybiyaau biirun fanazahnaahaa hattaa lam natruk fiyhaa qatraaan, fajalasa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa shafiyri albiiri, fada'aa bimaa'in famadmada wamajja fiy albiiri, famakathnaa ghayra ba'iydin thumma astaqaynaa hattaa rawiynaa warawat aaw sadarat rakaaiibunaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:We were one-thousand-and-four-hundred persons on the day of Al-Hudaibiya (Treaty), and (at) Al- Hudaibiya (there) was a well. We drew out its water not leaving even a single drop. The Prophet (ﷺ) sat at the edge of the well and asked for some water with which he rinsed his mouth and then he threw it out into the well. We stayed for a short while and then drew water from the well and quenched our thirst, and even our riding animals drank water to their satisfaction
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ لأُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ لَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَعِيفًا، أَعْرِفُ فِيهِ الْجُوعَ فَهَلْ عِنْدَكِ مِنْ شَىْءٍ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَتْ أَقْرَاصًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ، ثُمَّ أَخْرَجَتْ خِمَارًا لَهَا فَلَفَّتِ الْخُبْزَ بِبَعْضِهِ، ثُمَّ دَسَّتْهُ تَحْتَ يَدِي وَلاَثَتْنِي بِبَعْضِهِ، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَتْنِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَذَهَبْتُ بِهِ، فَوَجَدْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَمَعَهُ النَّاسُ، فَقُمْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ آرْسَلَكَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ بِطَعَامٍ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِمَنْ مَعَهُ ‏"‏ قُومُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ وَانْطَلَقْتُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ حَتَّى جِئْتُ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ، قَدْ جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالنَّاسِ، وَلَيْسَ عِنْدَنَا مَا نُطْعِمُهُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَتِ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ حَتَّى لَقِيَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو طَلْحَةَ مَعَهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلُمِّي يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ مَا عِنْدَكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَتَتْ بِذَلِكَ الْخُبْزِ، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَفُتَّ، وَعَصَرَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ عُكَّةً فَأَدَمَتْهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ، فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا ثُمَّ خَرَجُوا، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ، فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا ثُمَّ خَرَجُوا، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ، فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا ثُمَّ خَرَجُوا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَكَلَ الْقَوْمُ كُلُّهُمْ وَشَبِعُوا، وَالْقَوْمُ سَبْعُونَ ـ أَوْ ثَمَانُونَ ـ رَجُلاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu qaala aabuw talhaaa laummi sulaymin laqad sami'tu sawta, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm da'iyfana, aa'rifu fiyhi aljuw'a fahal 'indaki min shaa'in qaalat na'am‏.‏ faaakhrajat aaqraasana min sha'iyrin, thumma aakhrajat khimaarana lahaa falaffati alkhubza biba'dihi, thumma dassathu tahta yadiy walaathatniy biba'dihi, thumma aarsalatniy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fadhahabtu bihi, fawajadtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy almasjidi wama'ahu alnnaasu, faqumtu 'alayhim faqaala liy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ arsalaka aabuw talhaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu na'am‏.‏ qaala bita'aamin‏.‏ faqultu na'am‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm liman ma'ahu ‏"‏ quwmuwa ‏"‏‏.‏ faantalaqa waantalaqtu bayna aaydiyhim hattaa jiitu aabaa talhaaa faaakhbartuhu‏.‏ faqaala aabuw talhaaa yaa aumma sulaymin, qad jaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialnnaasi, walaysa 'indanaa maa nut'imuhum‏.‏ faqaalati alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏ faantalaqa aabuw talhaaa hattaa laqiya rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, faaaqbala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw talhaaa ma'ahu, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ halummiy yaa aumma sulaymin maa 'indaki ‏"‏‏.‏ faaatat bidhalika alkhubzi, faaamara bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fafutta, wa'asarat aummu sulaymin 'ukkaaan faaadamathu, thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhi maa shaa'a alllahu aan yaquwla, thumma qaala ‏"‏ aidhan li'asharaain ‏"‏‏.‏ faaadhina lahum, faaakaluwa hattaa shabi'uwa thumma kharajuwa, thumma qaala ‏"‏ aidhan li'asharaain ‏"‏‏.‏ faaadhina lahum, faaakaluwa hattaa shabi'uwa thumma kharajuwa, thumma qaala ‏"‏ aidhan li'asharaain ‏"‏‏.‏ faaadhina lahum, faaakaluwa hattaa shabi'uwa thumma kharajuwa thumma qaala ‏"‏ aidhan li'asharaain ‏"‏‏.‏ faaakala alqawmu kulluhum washabi'uwa, waalqawmu sab'uwna aaw thamaanuwna rajulaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Talha said to Um Sulaim, "I have noticed feebleness in the voice of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which I think, is caused by hunger. Have you got any food?" She said, "Yes." She brought out some loaves of barley and took out a veil belonging to her, and wrapped the bread in part of it and put it under my arm and wrapped part of the veil round me and sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I went carrying it and found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the Mosque sitting with some people. When I stood there, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "Has Abu Talha sent you?" I said, "Yes". He asked, "With some food? I said, "Yes" Allah's Apostle then said to the men around him, "Get up!" He set out (accompanied by them) and I went ahead of them till I reached Abu Talha and told him (of the Prophet's visit). Abu Talha said, "O Um Sulaim! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is coming with the people and we have no food to feed them." She said, "Allah and His Apostle know better." So Abu Talha went out to receive Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Apostle came along with Abu Talha. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Um Sulaim! Bring whatever you have." She brought the bread which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered to be broken into pieces. Um Sulaim poured on them some butter from an oilskin. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited what Allah wished him to recite, and then said, "Let ten persons come (to share the meal)." Ten persons were admitted, ate their fill and went out. Then he again said, "Let another ten do the same." They were admitted, ate their fill and went out. Then he again said, '"'Let another ten persons (do the same.)" They were admitted, ate their fill and went out. Then he said, "Let another ten persons come." In short, all of them ate their fill, and they were seventy or eighty men
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الزُّبَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَعُدُّ الآيَاتِ بَرَكَةً وَأَنْتُمْ تَعُدُّونَهَا تَخْوِيفًا، كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ فَقَلَّ الْمَاءُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اطْلُبُوا فَضْلَةً مِنْ مَاءٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَاءُوا بِإِنَاءٍ فِيهِ مَاءٌ قَلِيلٌ، فَأَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَىَّ عَلَى الطَّهُورِ الْمُبَارَكِ، وَالْبَرَكَةُ مِنَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ الْمَاءَ يَنْبُعُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَلَقَدْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ تَسْبِيحَ الطَّعَامِ وَهْوَ يُؤْكَلُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw aahmada alzzubayriyyu, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala kunnaa na'uddu alayaati barakaaan waaantum ta'udduwnahaa takhwiyfana, kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy safarin faqalla almaa'u faqaala ‏"‏ atlubuwa fadlaaan min maa'in ‏"‏‏.‏ fajaa'uwa biiinaa'in fiyhi maa'un qaliylun, faaadkhala yadahu fiy aliinaa'i, thumma qaala ‏"‏ haaaa 'alaa alttahuwri almubaaraki, waalbarakaau mina alllahi ‏"‏ falaqad raaaytu almaa'a yanbu'u min bayni aasaabi'i rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, walaqad kunnaa nasma'u tasbiyha altta'aami wahwa yuukalu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:We used to consider miracles as Allah's Blessings, but you people consider them to be a warning. Once we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on a journey, and we ran short of water. He said, "Bring the water remaining with you." The people brought a utensil containing a little water. He placed his hand in it and said, "Come to the blessed water, and the Blessing is from Allah." I saw the water flowing from among the fingers of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , and no doubt, we heard the meal glorifying Allah, when it was being eaten (by him)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَامِرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرٌ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، تُوُفِّيَ وَعَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ، فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ أَبِي تَرَكَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنًا وَلَيْسَ عِنْدِي إِلاَّ مَا يُخْرِجُ نَخْلُهُ، وَلاَ يَبْلُغُ مَا يُخْرِجُ سِنِينَ مَا عَلَيْهِ، فَانْطَلِقْ مَعِي لِكَىْ لاَ يُفْحِشَ عَلَىَّ الْغُرَمَاءُ‏.‏ فَمَشَى حَوْلَ بَيْدَرٍ مِنْ بَيَادِرِ التَّمْرِ فَدَعَا ثَمَّ آخَرَ، ثُمَّ جَلَسَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ انْزِعُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَوْفَاهُمُ الَّذِي لَهُمْ، وَبَقِيَ مِثْلُ مَا أَعْطَاهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, qaala haddathaniy 'aamirun, qaala haddathaniy jaabirun rda allh 'nh aanna aabaahu, tuwuffiya wa'alayhi daynun, faaataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu iinna aabiy taraka 'alayhi daynana walaysa 'indiy iilaaa maa yukhriju nakhluhu, walaa yablughu maa yukhriju siniyna maa 'alayhi, faantaliq ma'iy likaa laa yufhisha 'alaaaa alghuramaa'u‏.‏ famashaa hawla baydarin min bayaadiri alttamri fada'aa thamma akhara, thumma jalasa 'alayhi faqaala ‏ "‏ anzi'uwhu ‏"‏‏.‏ faaawfaahumu alladhiy lahum, wabaqiya mithlu maa aa'taahum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:My father had died in debt. So I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "My father (died) leaving unpaid debts, and I have nothing except the yield of his date palms; and their yield for many years will not cover his debts. So please come with me, so that the creditors may not misbehave with me." The Prophet (ﷺ) went round one of the heaps of dates and invoked (Allah), and then did the same with another heap and sat on it and said, "Measure (for them)." He paid them their rights and what remained was as much as had been paid to them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ، الصُّفَّةِ كَانُوا أُنَاسًا فُقَرَاءَ، وَأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ مَرَّةً ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ طَعَامُ اثْنَيْنِ فَلْيَذْهَبْ بِثَالِثٍ، وَمَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ طَعَامُ أَرْبَعَةٍ فَلْيَذْهَبْ بِخَامِسٍ أَوْ سَادِسٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ، وَأَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ جَاءَ بِثَلاَثَةٍ وَانْطَلَقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَشَرَةٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَثَلاَثَةً، قَالَ فَهْوَ أَنَا وَأَبِي وَأُمِّي ـ وَلاَ أَدْرِي هَلْ قَالَ امْرَأَتِي وَخَادِمِي ـ بَيْنَ بَيْتِنَا وَبَيْنَ بَيْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَأَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ تَعَشَّى عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ لَبِثَ حَتَّى صَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَلَبِثَ حَتَّى تَعَشَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَاءَ بَعْدَ مَا مَضَى مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، قَالَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَتُهُ مَا حَبَسَكَ عَنْ أَضْيَافِكَ أَوْ ضَيْفِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَوَ عَشَّيْتِهِمْ قَالَتْ أَبَوْا حَتَّى تَجِيءَ، قَدْ عَرَضُوا عَلَيْهِمْ فَغَلَبُوهُمْ، فَذَهَبْتُ فَاخْتَبَأْتُ، فَقَالَ يَا غُنْثَرُ‏.‏ فَجَدَّعَ وَسَبَّ وَقَالَ كُلُوا وَقَالَ لاَ أَطْعَمُهُ أَبَدًا‏.‏ قَالَ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ مَا كُنَّا نَأْخُذُ مِنَ اللُّقْمَةِ إِلاَّ رَبَا مِنْ أَسْفَلِهَا أَكْثَرُ مِنْهَا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا، وَصَارَتْ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا كَانَتْ قَبْلُ، فَنَظَرَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَإِذَا شَىْءٌ أَوْ أَكْثَرُ قَالَ لاِمْرَأَتِهِ يَا أُخْتَ بَنِي فِرَاسٍ‏.‏ قَالَتْ لاَ وَقُرَّةِ عَيْنِي لَهْىَ الآنَ أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا قَبْلُ بِثَلاَثِ مَرَّاتٍ‏.‏ فَأَكَلَ مِنْهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا كَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ ـ يَعْنِي يَمِينَهُ ـ ثُمَّ أَكَلَ مِنْهَا لُقْمَةً، ثُمَّ حَمَلَهَا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَصْبَحَتْ عِنْدَهُ‏.‏ وَكَانَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمٍ عَهْدٌ، فَمَضَى الأَجَلُ، فَتَفَرَّقْنَا اثْنَا عَشَرَ رَجُلاً مَعَ كُلِّ رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ أُنَاسٌ‏.‏ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ كَمْ مَعَ كُلِّ رَجُلٍ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ بَعَثَ مَعَهُمْ، قَالَ أَكَلُوا مِنْهَا أَجْمَعُونَ‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ‏.‏ وَغَيْرُهُ يَقُولُ فَعَرَفْنَا مِنْ الْعِرَافَةِ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, hadaathanaa mu'tamirun, 'an aabiyhi, hadaathanaa aabuw 'uthmaana, aanaahu hadaathahu 'abdu alraahmani bnu aabiy bakrin rda allh 'nhma aanaa aashaaba, alsuufaaai kaanuwa aunaasana fuqaraa'a, waaanaa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala maraaaan ‏ "‏ man kaana 'indahu ta'aamu athnayni falyadhhab bithaalithin, waman kaana 'indahu ta'aamu aarba'aain falyadhhab bikhaamisin aaw saadisin ‏"‏‏.‏ aaw kamaa qaala, waaanaa aabaa bakrin jaa'a bithalaathaain waantalaqa alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'asharaain, waaabuw bakrin wathalaathaaan, qaala fahwa aanaa waaabiy waaumiiy walaa aadriy hal qaala amraaatiy wakhaadimiy bayna baytinaa wabayna bayti aabiy bakrin, waaanaa aabaa bakrin ta'ashaaa 'inda alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm thumaa labitha hataaa salaaa al'ishaa'a, thumaa raja'a falabitha hataaa ta'ashaaa rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajaa'a ba'da maa madaa mina allaayli maa shaa'a allaahu, qaalat lahu amraaatuhu maa habasaka 'an aadyaafika aaw dayfika‏.‏ qaala aawa 'ashaaytihim qaalat aabawa hataaa tajiy'a, qad 'araduwa 'alayhim faghalabuwhum, fadhahabtu faakhtabaatu, faqaala yaa ghuntharu‏.‏ fajadaa'a wasabaa waqaala kuluwa waqaala laa aat'amuhu aabadana‏.‏ qaala waaymu allaahi maa kunaaa naakhudhu mina alluuqmaai iilaaa rabaa min aasfalihaa aaktharu minhaa hataaa shabi'uwa, wasaarat aakthara mimaaa kaanat qablu, fanazara aabuw bakrin faiidhaa shaa'un aaw aaktharu qaala laimraaatihi yaa aukhta baniy firaasin‏.‏ qaalat laa waquraaai 'ayniy lahaa alana aaktharu mimaaa qablu bithalaathi maraaatin‏.‏ faaakala minhaa aabuw bakrin, waqaala iinaamaa kaana alshaaytaanu ya'niy yamiynahu thumaa aakala minhaa luqmaaan, thumaa hamalahaa iilaa alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm faaasbahat 'indahu‏.‏ wakaana baynanaa wabayna qawmin 'ahdun, famadaa alaajalu, fatafaraaqnaa athnaa 'ashara rajulaan ma'a kulii rajulin minhum aunaasun‏.‏ allaahu aa'lamu kam ma'a kulii rajulin, ghayra aanaahu ba'atha ma'ahum, qaala aakaluwa minhaa aajma'uwna‏.‏ aaw kamaa qaala‏.‏ waghayruhu yaquwlu fa'arafnaa min al'iraafaai
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr:The companions of Suffa were poor people. The Prophet (ﷺ) once said, "Whoever has food enough for two persons, should take a third one (from among them), and whoever has food enough for four persons, should take a fifth or a sixth (or said something similar)." Abu Bakr brought three persons while the Prophet (ﷺ) took ten. And Abu Bakr with his three family members (who were I, my father and my mother) (the sub-narrator is in doubt whether `Abdur-Rahman said, "My wife and my servant who was common for both my house and Abu Bakr's house.") Abu Bakr took his supper with the Prophet (ﷺ) and stayed there till he offered the `Isha' prayers. He returned and stayed till Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took his supper. After a part of the night had passed, he returned to his house. His wife said to him, "What has detained you from your guests?" He said, "Have you served supper to them?" She said, "They refused to take supper until you come. They (i.e. some members of the household) presented the meal to them but they refused (to eat)" I went to hide myself and he said, "O Ghunthar!" He invoked Allah to cause my ears to be cut and he rebuked me. He then said (to them): Please eat!" and added, I will never eat the meal." By Allah, whenever we took a handful of the meal, the meal grew from underneath more than that handful till everybody ate to his satisfaction; yet the remaining food was more than the original meal. Abu Bakr saw that the food was as much or more than the original amount. He called his wife, "O sister of Bani Firas!" She said, "O pleasure of my eyes. The food has been tripled in quantity." Abu Bakr then started eating thereof and said, "It (i.e. my oath not to eat) was because of Satan." He took a handful from it, and carried the rest to the Prophet. So that food was with the Prophet (ﷺ). There was a treaty between us and some people, and when the period of that treaty had elapsed, he divided us into twelve groups, each being headed by a man. Allah knows how many men were under the command of each leader. Anyhow, the Prophet (ﷺ) surely sent a leader with each group. Then all of them ate of that meal
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، وَعَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَصَابَ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ قَحْطٌ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَبَيْنَا هُوَ يَخْطُبُ يَوْمَ جُمُعَةٍ إِذْ قَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلَكَتِ الْكُرَاعُ، هَلَكَتِ الشَّاءُ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ يَسْقِينَا، فَمَدَّ يَدَيْهِ وَدَعَا‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ وَإِنَّ السَّمَاءَ لَمِثْلُ الزُّجَاجَةِ فَهَاجَتْ رِيحٌ أَنْشَأَتْ سَحَابًا ثُمَّ اجْتَمَعَ، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَتِ السَّمَاءُ عَزَالِيَهَا، فَخَرَجْنَا نَخُوضُ الْمَاءَ حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا مَنَازِلَنَا، فَلَمْ نَزَلْ نُمْطَرُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ الأُخْرَى، فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ ـ أَوْ غَيْرُهُ ـ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، تَهَدَّمَتِ الْبُيُوتُ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ يَحْبِسْهُ‏.‏ فَتَبَسَّمَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى السَّحَابِ تَصَدَّعَ حَوْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ كَأَنَّهُ إِكْلِيلٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, 'an aanasin, wa'an yuwnusa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala aasaaba aahla almadiynaai qahtun 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fabaynaa huwa yakhtubu yawma jumu'aain iidh qaama rajulun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi halakati alkuraa'u, halakati alshhaa'u, faad'u alllaha yasqiynaa, famadda yadayhi wada'aa‏.‏ qaala aanasun waiinna alssamaa'a lamithlu alzzujaajaai fahaajat riyhun aanshaaat sahaabana thumma ajtama'a, thumma aarsalati alssamaa'u 'azaaliyahaa, fakharajnaa nakhuwdu almaa'a hattaa aataynaa manaazilanaa, falam nazal numtaru iilaa aljumu'aai alaukhraa, faqaama iilayhi dhalika alrrajulu aaw ghayruhu faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, tahaddamati albuyuwtu, faad'u alllaha yahbishu‏.‏ fatabassama thumma qaala ‏ "‏ hawaalaynaa walaa 'alaynaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fanazartu iilaa alssahaabi tasadda'a hawla almadiynaai kaaannahu iikliylun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Once during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), the people of Medina suffered from drought. So while the Prophet was delivering a sermon on a Friday a man got up saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The horses and sheep have perished. Will you invoke Allah to bless us with rain?" The Prophet (ﷺ) lifted both his hands and invoked. The sky at that time was as clear as glass. Suddenly a wind blew, raising clouds that gathered together, and it started raining heavily. We came out (of the Mosque) wading through the flowing water till we reached our homes. It went on raining till the next Friday, when the same man or some other man stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The houses have collapsed; please invoke Allah to withhold the rain." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) smiled and said, "O Allah, (let it rain) around us and not on us." I then looked at the clouds to see them separating forming a sort of a crown round Medina
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ كَثِيرٍ أَبُو غَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَفْصٍ ـ وَاسْمُهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ أَخُو أَبِي عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَلاَءِ ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ نَافِعًا، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ فَلَمَّا اتَّخَذَ الْمِنْبَرَ تَحَوَّلَ إِلَيْهِ، فَحَنَّ الْجِذْعُ فَأَتَاهُ فَمَسَحَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، بِهَذَا‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي رَوَّادٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu kathiyrin aabuw ghassaana, haddathanaa aabuw hafsin waasmuhu 'umaru bnu al'alaa'i aakhuw aabiy 'amriw bni al'alaa'i qaala sami'tu naafi'ana, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu iilaa jidh'in falammaa attakhadha alminbara tahawwala iilayhi, fahanna aljidh'u faaataahu famasaha yadahu 'alayhi‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu alhamiydi aakhbaranaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, aakhbaranaa mu'aadhu bnu al'alaa'i, 'an naafi'in, bihadhaa‏.‏ warawaahu aabuw 'aasimin 'ani abni aabiy rawwaadin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to deliver his sermons while standing beside a trunk of a datepalm. When he had the pulpit made, he used it instead. The trunk started crying and the Prophet (ﷺ) went to it, rubbing his hand over it (to stop its crying)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ أَيْمَنَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُومُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى شَجَرَةٍ أَوْ نَخْلَةٍ، فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ ـ أَوْ رَجُلٌ ـ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلاَ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ مِنْبَرًا قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَعَلُوا لَهُ مِنْبَرًا، فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ دُفِعَ إِلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، فَصَاحَتِ النَّخْلَةُ صِيَاحَ الصَّبِيِّ، ثُمَّ نَزَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَضَمَّهُ إِلَيْهِ تَئِنُّ أَنِينَ الصَّبِيِّ، الَّذِي يُسَكَّنُ، قَالَ ‏"‏ كَانَتْ تَبْكِي عَلَى مَا كَانَتْ تَسْمَعُ مِنَ الذِّكْرِ عِنْدَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu aaymana, qaala sami'tu aabiy, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwmu yawma aljumu'aai iilaa shajaraain aaw nakhlaain, faqaalati amraaaaun mina alaansaari aaw rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi aalaa naj'alu laka minbarana qaala ‏"‏ iin shiitum ‏"‏‏.‏ faja'aluwa lahu minbarana, falammaa kaana yawmu aljumu'aai dufi'a iilaa alminbari, fasaahati alnnakhlaau siyaaha alssabiyyi, thumma nazala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fadammahu iilayhi taiinnu aaniyna alssabiyyi, alladhiy yusakkanu, qaala ‏"‏ kaanat tabkiy 'alaa maa kaanat tasma'u mina aldhhikri 'indahaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to stand by a tree or a date-palm on Friday. Then an Ansari woman or man said. "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we make a pulpit for you?" He replied, "If you wish." So they made a pulpit for him and when it was Friday, he proceeded towards the pulpit (for delivering the sermon). The datepalm cried like a child! The Prophet (ﷺ) descended (the pulpit) and embraced it while it continued moaning like a child being quietened. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It was crying for (missing) what it used to hear of religious knowledge given near to it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ كَانَ الْمَسْجِدُ مَسْقُوفًا عَلَى جُذُوعٍ مِنْ نَخْلٍ فَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا خَطَبَ يَقُومُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ مِنْهَا، فَلَمَّا صُنِعَ لَهُ الْمِنْبَرُ، وَكَانَ عَلَيْهِ فَسَمِعْنَا لِذَلِكَ الْجِذْعِ صَوْتًا كَصَوْتِ الْعِشَارِ، حَتَّى جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا فَسَكَنَتْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy aakhiy, 'an sulaymaana bni bilaalin, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy hafsu bnu 'ubaydi alllahi bni aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu kaana almasjidu masquwfana 'alaa judhuw'in min nakhlin fakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa khataba yaquwmu iilaa jidh'in minhaa, falammaa suni'a lahu alminbaru, wakaana 'alayhi fasami'naa lidhalika aljidh'i sawtana kasawti al'ishaari, hattaa jaa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fawada'a yadahu 'alayhaa fasakanat‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:That he heard Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, "The roof of the Mosque was built over trunks of datepalms working as pillars. When the Prophet (ﷺ) delivered a sermon, he used to stand by one of those trunks till the pulpit was made for him, and he used it instead. Then we heard the trunk sending a sound like of a pregnant she-camel till the Prophet (ﷺ) came to it, and put his hand over it, then it became quiet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ،‏.‏ حَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَيُّكُمْ يَحْفَظُ قَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْفِتْنَةِ فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ أَنَا أَحْفَظُ كَمَا قَالَ‏.‏ قَالَ هَاتِ إِنَّكَ لَجَرِيءٌ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ فِتْنَةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ وَجَارِهِ تُكَفِّرُهَا الصَّلاَةُ وَالصَّدَقَةُ وَالأَمْرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهْىُ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لَيْسَتْ هَذِهِ، وَلَكِنِ الَّتِي تَمُوجُ كَمَوْجِ الْبَحْرِ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لاَ بَأْسَ عَلَيْكَ مِنْهَا، إِنَّ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهَا بَابًا مُغْلَقًا‏.‏ قَالَ يُفْتَحُ الْبَابُ أَوْ يُكْسَرُ قَالَ لاَ بَلْ يُكْسَرُ‏.‏ قَالَ ذَاكَ أَحْرَى أَنْ لاَ يُغْلَقَ‏.‏ قُلْنَا عَلِمَ الْبَابَ قَالَ نَعَمْ، كَمَا أَنَّ دُونَ غَدٍ اللَّيْلَةَ، إِنِّي حَدَّثْتُهُ حَدِيثًا لَيْسَ بِالأَغَالِيطِ‏.‏ فَهِبْنَا أَنْ نَسْأَلَهُ، وَأَمَرْنَا مَسْرُوقًا، فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ مَنِ الْبَابُ قَالَ عُمَرُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, ‏.‏ haddathaniy bishru bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa muhammadun, 'an shu'baaa, 'an sulaymaana, sami'tu aabaa waaiilin, yuhaddithu 'an hudhayfaaa, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh qaala aayyukum yahfazu qawla rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alfitnaai faqaala hudhayfaau aanaa aahfazu kamaa qaala‏.‏ qaala haati iinnaka lajariy'un‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ fitnaau alrrajuli fiy aahlihi wamaalihi wajaarihi tukaffiruhaa alssalaaau waalssadaqaau waalaamru bialma'ruwfi waalnnahau 'ani almunkari ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala laysat hadhihi, walakini allatiy tamuwju kamawji albahri‏.‏ qaala yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna laa baasa 'alayka minhaa, iinna baynaka wabaynahaa baabana mughlaqana‏.‏ qaala yuftahu albaabu aaw yuksaru qaala laa bal yuksaru‏.‏ qaala dhaaka aahraa aan laa yughlaqa‏.‏ qulnaa 'alima albaaba qaala na'am, kamaa aanna duwna ghadin alllaylaaa, iinniy haddathtuhu hadiythana laysa bialaaghaaliyti‏.‏ fahibnaa aan nasaalahu, waaamarnaa masruwqana, fasaaalahu faqaala mani albaabu qaala 'umaru‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa:Once `Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "Who amongst you remembers the statement of Allah's Apostle regarding the afflictions?" Hudhaifa replied, "I remember what he said exactly." `Umar said, "Tell (us), you are really a daring man!" Hudhaifa said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'A man's afflictions (i.e. wrong deeds) concerning his relation to his family, his property and his neighbors are expiated by his prayers, giving in charity and enjoining what is good and forbidding what is evil.' " `Umar said, "I don't mean these afflictions but the afflictions that will be heaving up and down like waves of the sea." Hudhaifa replied, "O chief of the believers! You need not fear those (afflictions) as there is a closed door between you and them." `Umar asked, "Will that door be opened or broken?" Hudhaifa replied, "No, it will be broken." `Umar said, "Then it is very likely that the door will not be closed again." Later on the people asked Hudhaifa, "Did `Umar know what that door meant?" He said, "Yes, `Umar knew it as everyone knows that there will be night before the tomorrow morning. I narrated to `Umar an authentic narration, not lies." We dared not ask Hudhaifa; therefore we requested Masruq who asked him, "What does the door stand for?" He said, "`Umar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تُقَاتِلُوا قَوْمًا نِعَالُهُمُ الشَّعَرُ، وَحَتَّى تُقَاتِلُوا التُّرْكَ، صِغَارَ الأَعْيُنِ، حُمْرَ الْوُجُوهِ، ذُلْفَ الأُنُوفِ كَأَنَّ وُجُوهَهُمُ الْمَجَانُّ الْمُطْرَقَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ "«وَتَجِدُونَ مِنْ خَيْرِ النَّاسِ أَشَدَّهُمْ كَرَاهِيَةً لِهَذَا الأَمْرِ، حَتَّى يَقَعَ فِيهِ، وَالنَّاسُ مَعَادِنُ، خِيَارُهُمْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ خِيَارُهُمْ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ." "وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّ عَلَى أَحَدِكُمْ زَمَانٌ لأَنْ يَرَانِي أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ مِثْلُ أَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, hadaathanaa aabuw alziinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa taquwmu alsaaa'aau hataaa tuqaatiluwa qawmana ni'aaluhumu alshaa'aru, wahataaa tuqaatiluwa altuurka, sighaara alaa'yuni, humra alwujuwhi, dhulfa alaunuwfi kaaanaa wujuwhahumu almajaanuu almutraqaau ‏"‏‏.‏ "«watajiduwna min khayri alnaaasi aashadaahum karaahiyaaan lihadhaa alaamri, hataaa yaqa'a fiyhi, waalnaaasu ma'aadinu, khiyaaruhum fiy aljaahiliyaaai khiyaaruhum fiy aliislaami." "walayaatiyanaa 'alaa aahadikum zamaanun laan yaraaniy aahabuu iilayhi min aan yakuwna lahu mithlu aahlihi wamaalihi
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till you fight a nation wearing hairy shoes, and till you fight the Turks, who will have small eyes, red faces and flat noses; and their faces will be like flat shields. And you will find that the best people are those who hate responsibility of ruling most of all till they are chosen to be the rulers. And the people are of different natures: The best in the pre-Islamic period are the best in Islam. A time will come when any of you will love to see me rather than to have his family and property doubled
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تُقَاتِلُوا خُوزًا وَكَرْمَانَ مِنَ الأَعَاجِمِ، حُمْرَ الْوُجُوهِ، فُطْسَ الأُنُوفِ، صِغَارَ الأَعْيُنِ، وُجُوهُهُمُ الْمَجَانُّ الْمُطْرَقَةُ، نِعَالُهُمُ الشَّعَرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ غَيْرُهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, 'an hammaamin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa tuqaatiluwa khuwzana wakarmaana mina alaa'aajimi, humra alwujuwhi, futsa alaunuwfi, sighaara alaa'yuni, wujuwhuhumu almajaannu almutraqaau, ni'aaluhumu alshha'aru ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu ghayruhu 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till you fight with the Khudh and the Kirman from among the non-Arabs. They will be of red faces, flat noses and small eyes; their faces will look like flat shields, and their shoes will be of hair
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ قَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ أَخْبَرَنِي قَيْسٌ، قَالَ أَتَيْنَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَقَالَ صَحِبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَ سِنِينَ لَمْ أَكُنْ فِي سِنِيَّ أَحْرَصَ عَلَى أَنْ أَعِيَ الْحَدِيثَ مِنِّي فِيهِنَّ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ وَقَالَ هَكَذَا بِيَدِهِ ‏ "‏ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ السَّاعَةِ تُقَاتِلُونَ قَوْمًا نِعَالُهُمُ الشَّعَرُ، وَهُوَ هَذَا الْبَارِزُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً وَهُمْ أَهْلُ الْبَازَرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala qaala iismaa'iylu aakhbaraniy qaysun, qaala aataynaa aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh faqaala sahibtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thalaatha siniyna lam aakun fiy siniyya aahrasa 'alaa aan aa'iya alhadiytha minniy fiyhinna sami'tuhu yaquwlu waqaala hakadhaa biyadihi ‏ "‏ bayna yadaai alssaa'aai tuqaatiluwna qawmana ni'aaluhumu alshha'aru, wahuwa hadhaa albaarizu ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala sufyaanu marraaan wahum aahlu albaazari‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I enjoyed the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for three years, and during the other years of my life, never was I so anxious to understand the (Prophet's) traditions as I was during those three years. I heard him saying, beckoning with his hand in this way, "Before the Hour you will fight with people who will have hairy shoes and live in Al-Bariz." (Sufyan, the sub-narrator once said, "And they are the people of Al-Bazar)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ تَغْلِبَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ السَّاعَةِ تُقَاتِلُونَ قَوْمًا يَنْتَعِلُونَ الشَّعَرَ، وَتُقَاتِلُونَ قَوْمًا كَأَنَّ وُجُوهَهُمُ الْمَجَانُّ الْمُطْرَقَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, sami'tu alhasana, yaquwlu haddathanaa 'amruw bnu taghliba, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ bayna yadaai alssaa'aai tuqaatiluwna qawmana yanta'iluwna alshha'ara, watuqaatiluwna qawmana kaaanna wujuwhahumu almajaannu almutraqaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar bin Taghlib:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Near the Hour you will fight with people who will wear hairy shoes; and you will also fight people with flat faces like shields
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ تُقَاتِلُكُمُ الْيَهُودُ فَتُسَلَّطُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ الْحَجَرُ يَا مُسْلِمُ، هَذَا يَهُودِيٌّ وَرَائِي فَاقْتُلْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhakamu bnu naafi'in, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ tuqaatilukumu alyahuwdu fatusallatuwna 'alayhim thumma yaquwlu alhajaru yaa muslimu, hadhaa yahuwdiyyun waraaiiy faaqtulhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The Jews will fight with you, and you will be given victory over them so that a stone will say, 'O Muslim! There is a Jew behind me; kill him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَأْتِي عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ يَغْزُونَ، فَيُقَالُ فِيكُمْ مَنْ صَحِبَ الرَّسُولَ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَقُولُونَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَيُفْتَحُ عَلَيْهِمْ، ثُمَّ يَغْزُونَ فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ هَلْ فِيكُمْ مَنْ صَحِبَ مَنْ صَحِبَ الرَّسُولَ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَقُولُونَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَيُفْتَحُ لَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an jaabirin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yaatiy 'alaa alnnaasi zamaanun yaghzuwna, fayuqaalu fiykum man sahiba alrrasuwla sla allh 'lyh wslm fayaquwluwna na'am‏.‏ fayuftahu 'alayhim, thumma yaghzuwna fayuqaalu lahum hal fiykum man sahiba man sahiba alrrasuwla sla allh 'lyh wslm fayaquwluwna na'am‏.‏ fayuftahu lahum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A time will come when the people will wage holy war, and it will be asked, 'Is there any amongst you who has enjoyed the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?' They will say: 'Yes.' And then victory will be bestowed upon them. They will wage holy war again, and it will be asked: 'Is there any among you who has enjoyed the company of the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?' They will say: 'Yes.' And then victory will be bestowed on them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَعْدٌ الطَّائِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحِلُّ بْنُ خَلِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ بَيْنَا أَنَا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَشَكَا إِلَيْهِ الْفَاقَةَ، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ آخَرُ، فَشَكَا قَطْعَ السَّبِيلِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا عَدِيُّ هَلْ رَأَيْتَ الْحِيرَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَمْ أَرَهَا وَقَدْ أُنْبِئْتُ عَنْهَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنْ طَالَتْ بِكَ حَيَاةٌ لَتَرَيَنَّ الظَّعِينَةَ تَرْتَحِلُ مِنَ الْحِيرَةِ، حَتَّى تَطُوفَ بِالْكَعْبَةِ، لاَ تَخَافُ أَحَدًا إِلاَّ اللَّهَ ‏"‏ ـ قُلْتُ فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ نَفْسِي فَأَيْنَ دُعَّارُ طَيِّئٍ الَّذِينَ قَدْ سَعَّرُوا الْبِلاَدَ ‏"‏ وَلَئِنْ طَالَتْ بِكَ حَيَاةٌ لَتُفْتَحَنَّ كُنُوزُ كِسْرَى ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ كِسْرَى بْنِ هُرْمُزَ قَالَ ‏"‏ كِسْرَى بْنِ هُرْمُزَ، وَلَئِنْ طَالَتْ بِكَ حَيَاةٌ، لَتَرَيَنَّ الرَّجُلَ يُخْرِجُ مِلْءَ كَفِّهِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ أَوْ فِضَّةٍ، يَطْلُبُ مَنْ يَقْبَلُهُ مِنْهُ، فَلاَ يَجِدُ أَحَدًا يَقْبَلُهُ مِنْهُ، وَلَيَلْقَيَنَّ اللَّهَ أَحَدُكُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَاهُ، وَلَيْسَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُ تُرْجُمَانٌ يُتَرْجِمُ لَهُ‏.‏ فَيَقُولَنَّ أَلَمْ أَبْعَثْ إِلَيْكَ رَسُولاً فَيُبَلِّغَكَ فَيَقُولُ بَلَى‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَلَمْ أُعْطِكَ مَالاً وَأُفْضِلْ عَلَيْكَ فَيَقُولُ بَلَى‏.‏ فَيَنْظُرُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ فَلاَ يَرَى إِلاَّ جَهَنَّمَ، وَيَنْظُرُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ فَلاَ يَرَى إِلاَّ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَدِيٌّ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اتَّقُوا النَّارَ وَلَوْ بِشِقَّةِ تَمْرَةٍ، فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ شِقَّةَ تَمْرَةٍ فَبِكَلِمَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَدِيٌّ فَرَأَيْتُ الظَّعِينَةَ تَرْتَحِلُ مِنَ الْحِيرَةِ حَتَّى تَطُوفَ بِالْكَعْبَةِ، لاَ تَخَافُ إِلاَّ اللَّهَ، وَكُنْتُ فِيمَنِ افْتَتَحَ كُنُوزَ كِسْرَى بْنِ هُرْمُزَ، وَلَئِنْ طَالَتْ بِكُمْ حَيَاةٌ لَتَرَوُنَّ مَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يُخْرِجُ مِلْءَ كَفِّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu alhakami, aakhbaranaa alnnadru, aakhbaranaa iisraaiiylu, aakhbaranaa sa'dun alttaaiiyyu, aakhbaranaa muhillu bnu khaliyfaaa, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, qaala baynaa aanaa 'inda alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh aataahu rajulun fashakaa iilayhi alfaaqaaa, thumma aataahu akharu, fashakaa qat'a alssabiyli‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ yaa 'adiyyu hal raaayta alhiyraaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu lam aarahaa waqad aunbiitu 'anhaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiin taalat bika hayaaaun latarayanna alzza'iynaaa tartahilu mina alhiyraai, hattaa tatuwfa bialka'baai, laa takhaafu aahadana iilaaa alllaha ‏"‏ qultu fiymaa bayniy wabayna nafsiy faaayna du''aaru tayyiiin alladhiyna qad sa''aruwa albilaada ‏"‏ walaiin taalat bika hayaaaun latuftahanna kunuwzu kisraa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu kisraa bni hurmuza qaala ‏"‏ kisraa bni hurmuza, walaiin taalat bika hayaaaun, latarayanna alrrajula yukhriju mil'a kaffihi min dhahabin aaw fiddaain, yatlubu man yaqbaluhu minhu, falaa yajidu aahadana yaqbaluhu minhu, walayalqayanna alllaha aahadukum yawma yalqaahu, walaysa baynahu wabaynahu turjumaanun yutarjimu lahu‏.‏ fayaquwlanna aalam aab'ath iilayka rasuwlaan fayuballighaka fayaquwlu balaa‏.‏ fayaquwlu aalam au'tika maalaan waaufdil 'alayka fayaquwlu balaa‏.‏ fayanzuru 'an yamiynihi falaa yaraa iilaaa jahannama, wayanzuru 'an yasaarihi falaa yaraa iilaaa jahannama ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'adiyyun sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ attaquwa alnnaara walaw bishiqqaai tamraain, faman lam yajid shiqqaaa tamraain fabikalimaain tayyibaain ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'adiyyun faraaaytu alzza'iynaaa tartahilu mina alhiyraai hattaa tatuwfa bialka'baai, laa takhaafu iilaaa alllaha, wakuntu fiymani aftataha kunuwza kisraa bni hurmuza, walaiin taalat bikum hayaaaun latarawunna maa qaala alnnabiyyu aabuw alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yukhriju mil'a kaffihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:While I was in the city of the Prophet, a man came and complained to him (the Prophet, ) of destitution and poverty. Then another man came and complained of robbery (by highwaymen). The Prophet said, "Adi! Have you been to Al-Hira?" I said, "I haven't been to it, but I was informed about it." He said, "If you should live for a long time, you will certainly see that a lady in a Howdah traveling from Al-Hira will (safely reach Mecca and) perform the Tawaf of the Ka`ba, fearing none but Allah." I said to myself, "What will happen to the robbers of the tribe of Tai who have spread evil throughout the country?" The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "If you should live long, the treasures of Khosrau will be opened (and taken as spoils)." I asked, "You mean Khosrau, son of Hurmuz?" He said, "Khosrau, son of Hurmuz. And if you should live long, you will see that one will carry a handful of gold or silver and go out looking for a person to accept it from him, but will find none to accept it from him. And any of you, when meeting Allah, will meet Him without needing an interpreter between him and Allah to interpret for him, and Allah will say to him: 'Didn't I send a messenger to teach you?' He will say: 'Yes.' Allah will say: 'Didn't I give you wealth and do you favors?' He will say: 'Yes.' Then he will look to his right and see nothing but Hell, and look to his left and see nothing but Hell." `Adi further said: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Save yourself from the (Hell) Fire even with half a date (to be given in charity) and if you do not find a half date, then with a good pleasant word." `Adi added: (later on) I saw a lady in a Howdah traveling from Al-Hira till she performed the Tawaf of the Ka`ba, fearing none but Allah. And I was one of those who opened (conquered) the treasures of Khosrau, son of Hurmuz. If you should live long, you will see what the Prophet (ﷺ) Abu-l-Qasim had said: 'A person will come out with a handful of gold...etc
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَعْدَانُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُجَاهِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحِلُّ بْنُ خَلِيفَةَ، سَمِعْتُ عَدِيًّا، كُنْتُ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, aakhbaranaa sa'daanu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa aabuw mujaahidin, haddathanaa muhillu bnu khaliyfaaa, sami'tu 'adiyyana, kuntu 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Adi:as above (i.e. Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ شُرَحْبِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ يَوْمًا فَصَلَّى عَلَى أَهْلِ أُحُدٍ صَلاَتَهُ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ إِلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي فَرَطُكُمْ، وَأَنَا شَهِيدٌ عَلَيْكُمْ، إِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لأَنْظُرُ إِلَى حَوْضِي الآنَ، وَإِنِّي قَدْ أُعْطِيتُ خَزَائِنَ مَفَاتِيحِ الأَرْضِ، وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ مَا أَخَافُ بَعْدِي أَنْ تُشْرِكُوا، وَلَكِنْ أَخَافُ أَنْ تَنَافَسُوا فِيهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu shurahbiyla, haddathanaa laythun, 'an yaziyda, 'an aabiy alkhayri, 'an 'uqbaaa bni 'aamirin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja yawmana fasallaa 'alaa aahli auhudin salaatahu 'alaa almayyiti, thumma ansarafa iilaa alminbari, faqaala ‏ "‏ iinniy faratukum, waaanaa shahiydun 'alaykum, iinniy waalllahi laanzuru iilaa hawdiy alana, waiinniy qad au'tiytu khazaaiina mafaatiyhi alaardi, waiinniy waalllahi maa aakhaafu ba'diy aan tushrikuwa, walakin aakhaafu aan tanaafasuwa fiyhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Uqba bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) once came out and offered the funeral prayer for the martyrs of Uhud, and proceeded to the pulpit and said, "I shall be your predecessor and a witness on you, and I am really looking at my sacred Fount now, and no doubt, I have been given the keys of the treasures of the world. By Allah, I am not afraid that you will worship others along with Allah, but I am afraid that you will envy and fight one another for worldly fortunes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَشْرَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى أُطُمٍ مِنَ الآطَامِ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هَلْ تَرَوْنَ مَا أَرَى إِنِّي أَرَى الْفِتَنَ تَقَعُ خِلاَلَ بُيُوتِكُمْ مَوَاقِعَ الْقَطْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an ausaamaaa rda allh 'nh qaala aashrafa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa autumin mina alataami, faqaala ‏ "‏ hal tarawna maa aaraa iinniy aaraa alfitana taqa'u khilaala buyuwtikum mawaaqi'a alqatri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) stood on one of the high buildings (of Medina) and said, "Do you see what I see? I see affliction pouring among your houses like raindrops
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ حَدَّثَتْهَا عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا فَزِعًا يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَيْلٌ لِلْعَرَبِ مِنْ شَرٍّ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ، فُتِحَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلُ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَحَلَّقَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ وَبِالَّتِي تَلِيهَا، فَقَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَهْلِكُ وَفِينَا الصَّالِحُونَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ، إِذَا كَثُرَ الْخَبَثُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna zaynaba abnaaa aabiy salamaaa, haddathathu aanna aumma habiybaaa binta aabiy sufyaana haddathathaa 'an zaynaba binti jahshin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala 'alayhaa fazi'ana yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu, waylun lil'arabi min sharrin qadi aqtaraba, futiha alyawma min radmi yaajuwja wamaajuwja mithlu hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ wahallaqa biiisba'ihi wabiallatiy taliyhaa, faqaalat zaynabu faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aanahliku wafiynaa alssaalihuwna qaala ‏"‏ na'am, iidhaa kathura alkhabathu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zainab bint Jahsh:That the Prophet (ﷺ) came to her in a state of fear saying, "None has the right to be worshiped but Allah! Woe to the Arabs because of evil that has come near. Today a hole has been made in the wall of Gog and Magog as large as this." pointing with two of his fingers making a circle. Zainab said, "I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we be destroyed though amongst us there are pious people? ' He said, 'Yes, if evil increases
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: وَعَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَتْنِي هِنْدُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتِ اسْتَيْقَظَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، مَاذَا أُنْزِلَ مِنَ الْخَزَائِنِ وَمَاذَا أُنْزِلَ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wa'ani alzzuhriyyi, haddathatniy hindu bintu alhaarithi, aanna aumma salamaaa, qaalati astayqaza alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ subhaana alllahi, maadhaa aunzila mina alkhazaaiini wamaadhaa aunzila mina alfitani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Um Salama said:The Prophet (ﷺ) woke up and said, "Glorified be Allah: What great (how many) treasures have been sent down, and what great (how many ) afflictions have been sent down
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْمَاجِشُونِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ لِي إِنِّي أَرَاكَ تُحِبُّ الْغَنَمَ، وَتَتَّخِذُهَا، فَأَصْلِحْهَا وَأَصْلِحْ رُعَامَهَا، فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يَأْتِي عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ تَكُونُ الْغَنَمُ فِيهِ خَيْرَ مَالِ الْمُسْلِمِ، يَتْبَعُ بِهَا شَعَفَ الْجِبَالِ ـ أَوْ سَعَفَ الْجِبَالِ ـ فِي مَوَاقِعِ الْقَطْرِ، يَفِرُّ بِدِينِهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy salamaaa bni almaajishuwni, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy sa'sa'aaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh qaala qaala liy iinniy aaraaka tuhibbu alghanama, watattakhidhuhaa, faaaslihhaa waaaslih ru'aamahaa, faiinniy sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yaatiy 'alaa alnnaasi zamaanun takuwnu alghanamu fiyhi khayra maali almuslimi, yatba'u bihaa sha'afa aljibaali aaw sa'afa aljibaali fiy mawaaqi'i alqatri, yafirru bidiynihi mina alfitani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sasaa:Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri said to me, "I notice that you like sheep and you keep them; so take care of them and their food, for I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'A time will come upon the people when the best of a Muslim's property will be sheep, which he will take to the tops of mountains and to the places of rain-falls to run away with his religion in order to save it from afflictions
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ الأُوَيْسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَتَكُونُ فِتَنٌ، الْقَاعِدُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْقَائِمِ، وَالْقَائِمُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْمَاشِي، وَالْمَاشِي فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ السَّاعِي، وَمَنْ يُشْرِفْ لَهَا تَسْتَشْرِفْهُ، وَمَنْ وَجَدَ مَلْجَأً أَوْ مَعَاذًا فَلْيَعُذْ بِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُطِيعِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ نَوْفَلِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ،، مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ هَذَا، إِلاَّ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، يَزِيدُ ‏"‏ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ صَلاَةٌ مَنْ فَاتَتْهُ فَكَأَنَّمَا وُتِرَ أَهْلَهُ وَمَالَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi alauwaysiyyu, haddathanaa iibraahiymu, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'ani abni almusayyabi, waaabiy, salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ satakuwnu fitanun, alqaa'idu fiyhaa khayrun mina alqaaiimi, waalqaaiimu fiyhaa khayrun mina almaashiy, waalmaashiy fiyhaa khayrun mina alssaa'iy, waman yushrif lahaa tastashrifhu, waman wajada maljaaan aaw ma'aadhana falya'udh bihi ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni alhaarithi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni mutiy'i bni alaaswadi, 'an nawfali bni mu'aawiyaaa, , mithla hadiythi aabiy hurayraaa hadhaa, iilaaa aanna aabaa bakrin, yaziydu ‏"‏ mina alssalaaai salaaaun man faatathu fakaaannamaa wutira aahlahu wamaalahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There will be afflictions (and at the time) the sitting person will be better than the standing one, and the standing one will be better than the walking, and the walking will be better than the running. And whoever will look towards those afflictions, they will overtake him, and whoever will find a refuge or a shelter, should take refuge in it." The same narration is reported by Abu Bakr, with the addition, "(The Prophet (ﷺ) said), 'Among the prayers there is a prayer the missing of which will be to one like losing one's family and property
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ سَتَكُونُ أَثَرَةٌ وَأُمُورٌ تُنْكِرُونَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَمَا تَأْمُرُنَا قَالَ ‏"‏ تُؤَدُّونَ الْحَقَّ الَّذِي عَلَيْكُمْ، وَتَسْأَلُونَ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an zaydi bni wahbin, 'ani abni mas'uwdin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ satakuwnu aatharaaun waaumuwrun tunkiruwnahaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi famaa taamurunaa qaala ‏"‏ tuuadduwna alhaqqa alladhiy 'alaykum, watasaaluwna alllaha alladhiy lakum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Soon others will be preferred to you, and there will be things which you will not like." The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do you order us to do (in this case)? " He said, "(I order you) to give the rights that are on you and to ask your rights from Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يُهْلِكُ النَّاسَ هَذَا الْحَىُّ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا فَمَا تَأْمُرُنَا قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ أَنَّ النَّاسَ اعْتَزَلُوهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مَحْمُودٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا زُرْعَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahiymi, haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yuhliku alnnaasa hadhaa alhaaau min qurayshin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa famaa taamurunaa qaala ‏"‏ law aanna alnnaasa a'tazaluwhum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala mahmuwdun haddathanaa aabuw daawuda aakhbaranaa shu'baau 'an aabiy alttayyaahi sami'tu aabaa zur'aaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This branch from Quraish will ruin the people." The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What do you order us to do (then)?" He said, "I would suggest that the people keep away from them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمَكِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الأُمَوِيُّ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ مَرْوَانَ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ فَسَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ الصَّادِقَ الْمَصْدُوقَ، يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ هَلاَكُ أُمَّتِي عَلَى يَدَىْ غِلْمَةٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَرْوَانُ غِلْمَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ إِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ أُسَمِّيَهُمْ بَنِي فُلاَنٍ وَبَنِي فُلاَنٍ‏.‏
