verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu muhammadin almakkiyyu, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu yahyaa bni sa'iydin alaumawiyyu, 'an jaddihi, qaala kuntu ma'a marwaana waaabiy hurayraaa fasami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu sami'tu alssaadiqa almasduwqa, yaquwlu ‏ "‏ halaaku aummatiy 'alaa yadaa ghilmaain min qurayshin ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala marwaanu ghilmaaun‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa iin shiita aan ausammiyahum baniy fulaanin wabaniy fulaanin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id Al-Umawi:I was with Marwan and Abu Huraira and heard Abu Huraira saying, "I heard the trustworthy, truly inspired one (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) saying, 'The destruction of my followers will be brought about by the hands of some youngsters from Quraish." Marwan asked, "Youngsters?" Abu Huraira said, "If you wish, I would name them: They are the children of so-and-so and the children of so-and-so
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بُسْرُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَضْرَمِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيُّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنَ الْيَمَانِ، يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّاسُ يَسْأَلُونَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْخَيْرِ، وَكُنْتُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ الشَّرِّ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يُدْرِكَنِي‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا كُنَّا فِي جَاهِلِيَّةٍ وَشَرٍّ، فَجَاءَنَا اللَّهُ بِهَذَا الْخَيْرِ، فَهَلْ بَعْدَ هَذَا الْخَيْرِ مِنْ شَرٍّ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَهَلْ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ الشَّرِّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ، وَفِيهِ دَخَنٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَمَا دَخَنُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَوْمٌ يَهْدُونَ بِغَيْرِ هَدْيِي تَعْرِفُ مِنْهُمْ وَتُنْكِرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَهَلْ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ الْخَيْرِ مِنْ شَرٍّ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ دُعَاةٌ إِلَى أَبْوَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، مَنْ أَجَابَهُمْ إِلَيْهَا قَذَفُوهُ فِيهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صِفْهُمْ لَنَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هُمْ مِنْ جِلْدَتِنَا، وَيَتَكَلَّمُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِنَا ‏"‏ قُلْتُ فَمَا تَأْمُرُنِي إِنْ أَدْرَكَنِي ذَلِكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَلْزَمُ جَمَاعَةَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِمَامَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ جَمَاعَةٌ وَلاَ إِمَامٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاعْتَزِلْ تِلْكَ الْفِرَقَ كُلَّهَا، وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعَضَّ بِأَصْلِ شَجَرَةٍ حَتَّى يُدْرِكَكَ الْمَوْتُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa alwaliydu, qaala haddathaniy abnu jaabirin, qaala haddathaniy busru bnu 'ubaydi alllahi alhadramiyyu, qaala haddathaniy aabuw iidriysa alkhawlaaniyyu, aannahu sami'a hudhayfaaa bna alyamaani, yaquwlu kaana alnnaasu yasaaluwna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alkhayri, wakuntu aasaaluhu 'ani alshharri makhaafaaa aan yudrikaniy‏.‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa kunnaa fiy jaahiliyyaain washarrin, fajaa'anaa alllahu bihadhaa alkhayri, fahal ba'da hadhaa alkhayri min sharrin qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu wahal ba'da dhalika alshharri min khayrin qaala ‏"‏ na'am, wafiyhi dakhanun ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu wamaa dakhanuhu qaala ‏"‏ qawmun yahduwna bighayri hadyiy ta'rifu minhum watunkiru ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu fahal ba'da dhalika alkhayri min sharrin qaala ‏"‏ na'am du'aaaun iilaa aabwaabi jahannama, man aajaabahum iilayhaa qadhafuwhu fiyhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi sifhum lanaa faqaala ‏"‏ hum min jildatinaa, wayatakallamuwna biaalsinatinaa ‏"‏ qultu famaa taamuruniy iin aadrakaniy dhalika qaala ‏"‏ talzamu jamaa'aaa almuslimiyna waiimaamahum ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu faiin lam yakun lahum jamaa'aaun walaa iimaamun qaala ‏"‏ faa'tazil tilka alfiraqa kullahaa, walaw aan ta'adda biaasli shajaraain hattaa yudrikaka almawtu waaanta 'alaa dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa bin Al-Yaman:The people used to ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about good, but I used to ask him about evil for fear that it might overtake me. Once I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We were in ignorance and in evil and Allah has bestowed upon us the present good; will there be any evil after this good?" He said, "Yes." I asked, "Will there be good after that evil?" He said, "Yes, but it would be tained with Dakhan (i.e. Little evil)." I asked, "What will its Dakhan be?" He said, "There will be some people who will lead (people) according to principles other than my tradition. You will see their actions and disapprove of them." I said, "Will there be any evil after that good?" He said, "Yes, there will be some people who will invite others to the doors of Hell, and whoever accepts their invitation to it will be thrown in it (by them)." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Describe those people to us." He said, "They will belong to us and speak our language" I asked, "What do you order me to do if such a thing should take place in my life?" He said, "Adhere to the group of Muslims and their Chief." I asked, "If there is neither a group (of Muslims) nor a chief (what shall I do)?" He said, "Keep away from all those different sects, even if you had to bite (i.e. eat) the root of a tree, till you meet Allah while you are still in that state
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنِي قَيْسٌ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ تَعَلَّمَ أَصْحَابِي الْخَيْرَ وَتَعَلَّمْتُ الشَّرَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an iismaa'iyla, haddathaniy qaysun, 'an hudhayfaaa rda allh 'nh qaala ta'allama aashaabiy alkhayra wata'allamtu alshharra‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa:My companions learned (something about) good (through asking the Prophet) while I learned (something about) evil
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَقْتَتِلَ فِئَتَانِ دَعْوَاهُمَا وَاحِدَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhakamu bnu naafi'in, haddathanaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa, aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa yaqtatila fiiataani da'waahumaa waahidaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Day of (Judgment) will not be established till there is a war between two groups whose claims (or religion) will be the same
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَقْتَتِلَ فِئَتَانِ، فَيَكُونَ بَيْنَهُمَا مَقْتَلَةٌ عَظِيمَةٌ، دَعْوَاهُمَا وَاحِدَةٌ، وَلاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يُبْعَثَ دَجَّالُونَ كَذَّابُونَ قَرِيبًا مِنْ ثَلاَثِينَ، كُلُّهُمْ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaamin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa yaqtatila fiiataani, fayakuwna baynahumaa maqtalaaun 'aziymaaun, da'waahumaa waahidaaun, walaa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa yub'atha dajjaaluwna kadhhaabuwna qariybana min thalaathiyna, kulluhum yaz'umu aannahu rasuwlu alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hour will not be established till there is a war between two groups among whom there will be a great number of casualties, though the claims (or religion) of both of them will be one and the same. And the Hour will not be established till there appear about thirty liars, all of whom will be claiming to be the messengers of Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ يَقْسِمُ قَسْمًا أَتَاهُ ذُو الْخُوَيْصِرَةِ ـ وَهْوَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ ـ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اعْدِلْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَيْلَكَ، وَمَنْ يَعْدِلُ إِذَا لَمْ أَعْدِلْ قَدْ خِبْتَ وَخَسِرْتَ إِنْ لَمْ أَكُنْ أَعْدِلُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ائْذَنْ لِي فِيهِ، فَأَضْرِبَ عُنُقَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دَعْهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ أَصْحَابًا، يَحْقِرُ أَحَدُكُمْ صَلاَتَهُ مَعَ صَلاَتِهِمْ وَصِيَامَهُ مَعَ صِيَامِهِمْ، يَقْرَءُونَ الْقُرْآنَ لاَ يُجَاوِزُ تَرَاقِيَهُمْ، يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ الدِّينِ كَمَا يَمْرُقُ السَّهْمُ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ، يُنْظَرُ إِلَى نَصْلِهِ فَلاَ يُوجَدُ فِيهِ شَىْءٌ، ثُمَّ يُنْظَرُ إِلَى رِصَافِهِ فَمَا يُوجَدُ فِيهِ شَىْءٌ، ثُمَّ يُنْظَرُ إِلَى نَضِيِّهِ ـ وَهْوَ قِدْحُهُ ـ فَلاَ يُوجَدُ فِيهِ شَىْءٌ، ثُمَّ يُنْظَرُ إِلَى قُذَذِهِ فَلاَ يُوجَدُ فِيهِ شَىْءٌ، قَدْ سَبَقَ الْفَرْثَ وَالدَّمَ، آيَتُهُمْ رَجُلٌ أَسْوَدُ إِحْدَى عَضُدَيْهِ مِثْلُ ثَدْىِ الْمَرْأَةِ، أَوْ مِثْلُ الْبَضْعَةِ تَدَرْدَرُ وَيَخْرُجُونَ عَلَى حِينِ فُرْقَةٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَأَشْهَدُ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ قَاتَلَهُمْ وَأَنَا مَعَهُ، فَأَمَرَ بِذَلِكَ الرَّجُلِ، فَالْتُمِسَ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ حَتَّى نَظَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ عَلَى نَعْتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّذِي نَعَتَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya rda allh 'nh qaala baynamaa nahnu 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa yaqsimu qasmana aataahu dhuw alkhuwaysiraai wahwa rajulun min baniy tamiymin faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi a'dil‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ waylaka, waman ya'dilu iidhaa lam aa'dil qad khibta wakhasirta iin lam aakun aa'dilu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru yaa rasuwla alllahi aidhan liy fiyhi, faaadriba 'unuqahu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ da'hu faiinna lahu aashaabana, yahqiru aahadukum salaatahu ma'a salaatihim wasiyaamahu ma'a siyaamihim, yaqra'uwna alqurana laa yujaawizu taraaqiyahum, yamruquwna mina alddiyni kamaa yamruqu alssahmu mina alrramiyyaai, yunzaru iilaa naslihi falaa yuwjadu fiyhi shaa'un, thumma yunzaru iilaa risaafihi famaa yuwjadu fiyhi shaa'un, thumma yunzaru iilaa nadiyyihi wahwa qidhuhu falaa yuwjadu fiyhi shaa'un, thumma yunzaru iilaa qudhadhihi falaa yuwjadu fiyhi shaa'un, qad sabaqa alfartha waalddama, ayatuhum rajulun aaswadu iihdaa 'adudayhi mithlu thadai almaraaai, aaw mithlu albad'aai tadardaru wayakhrujuwna 'alaa hiyni furqaain mina alnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw sa'iydin faaashhadu aanniy sami'tu hadhaa alhadiytha min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, waaashhadu aanna 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin qaatalahum waaanaa ma'ahu, faaamara bidhalika alrrajuli, faaltumisa faautiya bihi hattaa nazartu iilayhi 'alaa na'ti alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alladhiy na'atahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:While we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was distributing (i.e. some property), there came Dhu-l- Khuwaisira, a man from the tribe of Bani Tamim and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do Justice." The Prophet said, "Woe to you! Who could do justice if I did not? I would be a desperate loser if I did not do justice." `Umar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allow me to chop his head off." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave him, for he has companions who pray and fast in such a way that you will consider your fasting negligible in comparison to theirs. They recite Qur'an but it does not go beyond their throats (i.e. they do not act on it) and they will desert Islam as an arrow goes through a victim's body, so that the hunter, on looking at the arrow's blade, would see nothing on it; he would look at its Risaf and see nothing: he would look at its Nadi and see nothing, and he would look at its Qudhadh ( 1 ) and see nothing (neither meat nor blood), for the arrow has been too fast even for the blood and excretions to smear. The sign by which they will be recognized is that among them there will be a black man, one of whose arms will resemble a woman's breast or a lump of meat moving loosely. Those people will appear when there will be differences amongst the people." I testify that I heard this narration from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I testify that `Ali bin Abi Talib fought with such people, and I was in his company. He ordered that the man (described by the Prophet (ﷺ) ) should be looked for. The man was brought and I looked at him and noticed that he looked exactly as the Prophet (ﷺ) had described him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ غَفَلَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ إِذَا حَدَّثْتُكُمْ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلأَنْ أَخِرَّ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ أَكْذِبَ عَلَيْهِ، وَإِذَا حَدَّثْتُكُمْ فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ، فَإِنَّ الْحَرْبَ خَدْعَةٌ، سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يَأْتِي فِي آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ قَوْمٌ حُدَثَاءُ الأَسْنَانِ، سُفَهَاءُ الأَحْلاَمِ، يَقُولُونَ مِنْ خَيْرِ قَوْلِ الْبَرِيَّةِ، يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ الإِسْلاَمِ كَمَا يَمْرُقُ السَّهْمُ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ، لاَ يُجَاوِزُ إِيمَانُهُمْ حَنَاجِرَهُمْ، فَأَيْنَمَا لَقِيتُمُوهُمْ فَاقْتُلُوهُمْ، فَإِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ لِمَنْ قَتَلَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an khaythamaaa, 'an suwaydi bni ghafalaaa, qaala qaala 'aliyyun rda allh 'nh iidhaa haddathtukum 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falaan aakhirra mina alssamaa'i aahabbu iilaaaa min aan aakdhiba 'alayhi, waiidhaa haddathtukum fiymaa bayniy wabaynakum, faiinna alharba khad'aaun, sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yaatiy fiy akhiri alzzamaani qawmun hudathaa'u alaasnaani, sufahaa'u alaahlaami, yaquwluwna min khayri qawli albariyyaai, yamruquwna mina aliislaami kamaa yamruqu alssahmu mina alrramiyyaai, laa yujaawizu iiymaanuhum hanaajirahum, faaaynamaa laqiytumuwhum faaqtuluwhum, faiinna qatlahum aajrun liman qatalahum yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:I relate the traditions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to you for I would rather fall from the sky than attribute something to him falsely. But when I tell you a thing which is between you and me, then no doubt, war is guile. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "In the last days of this world there will appear some young foolish people who will use (in their claim) the best speech of all people (i.e. the Qur'an) and they will abandon Islam as an arrow going through the game. Their belief will not go beyond their throats (i.e. they will have practically no belief), so wherever you meet them, kill them, for he who kills them shall get a reward on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ خَبَّابِ بْنِ الأَرَتِّ، قَالَ شَكَوْنَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ مُتَوَسِّدٌ بُرْدَةً لَهُ فِي ظِلِّ الْكَعْبَةِ، قُلْنَا لَهُ أَلاَ تَسْتَنْصِرُ لَنَا أَلاَ تَدْعُو اللَّهَ لَنَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ فِيمَنْ قَبْلَكُمْ يُحْفَرُ لَهُ فِي الأَرْضِ فَيُجْعَلُ فِيهِ، فَيُجَاءُ بِالْمِنْشَارِ، فَيُوضَعُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ فَيُشَقُّ بِاثْنَتَيْنِ، وَمَا يَصُدُّهُ ذَلِكَ عَنْ دِينِهِ، وَيُمْشَطُ بِأَمْشَاطِ الْحَدِيدِ، مَا دُونَ لَحْمِهِ مِنْ عَظْمٍ أَوْ عَصَبٍ، وَمَا يَصُدُّهُ ذَلِكَ عَنْ دِينِهِ، وَاللَّهِ لَيُتِمَّنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ حَتَّى يَسِيرَ الرَّاكِبُ مِنْ صَنْعَاءَ إِلَى حَضْرَمَوْتَ، لاَ يَخَافُ إِلاَّ اللَّهَ أَوِ الذِّئْبَ عَلَى غَنَمِهِ، وَلَكِنَّكُمْ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa qaysun, 'an khabbaabi bni alaaratti, qaala shakawnaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa mutawassidun burdaaan lahu fiy zilli alka'baai, qulnaa lahu aalaa tastansiru lanaa aalaa tad'uw alllaha lanaa qaala ‏ "‏ kaana alrrajulu fiyman qablakum yuhfaru lahu fiy alaardi fayuj'alu fiyhi, fayujaa'u bialminshaari, fayuwda'u 'alaa raasihi fayushaqqu biathnatayni, wamaa yasudduhu dhalika 'an diynihi, wayumshatu biaamshaati alhadiydi, maa duwna lahmihi min 'azmin aaw 'asabin, wamaa yasudduhu dhalika 'an diynihi, waalllahi layutimmanna hadhaa alaamra hattaa yasiyra alrraakibu min san'aa'a iilaa hadramawta, laa yakhaafu iilaaa alllaha aawi aldhhiiba 'alaa ghanamihi, walakinnakum tasta'jiluwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Khabbab bin Al-Arat:We complained to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (of the persecution inflicted on us by the infidels) while he was sitting in the shade of the Ka`ba, leaning over his Burd (i.e. covering sheet). We said to him, "Would you seek help for us? Would you pray to Allah for us?" He said, "Among the nations before you a (believing) man would be put in a ditch that was dug for him, and a saw would be put over his head and he would be cut into two pieces; yet that (torture) would not make him give up his religion. His body would be combed with iron combs that would remove his flesh from the bones and nerves, yet that would not make him abandon his religion. By Allah, this religion (i.e. Islam) will prevail till a traveler from Sana (in Yemen) to Hadrarmaut will fear none but Allah, or a wolf as regards his sheep, but you (people) are hasty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم افْتَقَدَ ثَابِتَ بْنَ قَيْسٍ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَنَا أَعْلَمُ لَكَ عِلْمَهُ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ فَوَجَدَهُ جَالِسًا فِي بَيْتِهِ مُنَكِّسًا رَأْسَهُ، فَقَالَ مَا شَأْنُكَ فَقَالَ شَرٌّ، كَانَ يَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَدْ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ، وَهْوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ‏.‏ فَأَتَى الرَّجُلُ فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ مُوسَى بْنُ أَنَسٍ فَرَجَعَ الْمَرَّةَ الآخِرَةَ بِبِشَارَةٍ عَظِيمَةٍ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اذْهَبْ إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْ لَهُ إِنَّكَ لَسْتَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَلَكِنْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa aazharu bnu sa'din, haddathanaa abnu 'awnin, qaala aanbaaaniy muwsaa bnu aanasin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aftaqada thaabita bna qaysin, faqaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi, aanaa aa'lamu laka 'ilmahu‏.‏ faaataahu fawajadahu jaalisana fiy baytihi munakkisana raasahu, faqaala maa shaanuka faqaala sharrun, kaana yarfa'u sawtahu fawqa sawti alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqad habita 'amaluhu, wahwa min aahli alnnaari‏.‏ faaataa alrrajulu faaakhbarahu aannahu qaala kadhaa wakadhaa‏.‏ faqaala muwsaa bnu aanasin faraja'a almarraaa alakhiraaa bibishaaraain 'aziymaain, faqaala ‏ "‏ adhhab iilayhi faqul lahu iinnaka lasta min aahli alnnaari, walakin min aahli aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) noticed the absence of Thabit bin Qais. A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I shall bring you his news." So he went to him and saw him sitting in his house drooping his head (sadly). He asked Thabit, "What's the matter?" Thabit replied, "An evil situation: A man used to raise his voice over the voice of the Prophet (ﷺ) and so all his good deeds have been annulled and he is from the people of Hell." The man went back and told the Prophet (ﷺ) that Thabit had said so-and-so. (The sub-narrator, Musa bin Anas said, "The man went to Thabit again with glad tidings)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Go and say to Thabit: 'You are not from the people of Fire, but from the people of Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَرَأَ رَجُلٌ الْكَهْفَ وَفِي الدَّارِ الدَّابَّةُ فَجَعَلَتْ تَنْفِرُ فَسَلَّمَ، فَإِذَا ضَبَابَةٌ ـ أَوْ سَحَابَةٌ ـ غَشِيَتْهُ، فَذَكَرَهُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اقْرَأْ فُلاَنُ، فَإِنَّهَا السَّكِينَةُ نَزَلَتْ لِلْقُرْآنِ، أَوْ تَنَزَّلَتْ لِلْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, sami'tu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma qaraaa rajulun alkahfa wafiy alddaari alddaabbaau faja'alat tanfiru fasallama, faiidhaa dabaabaaun aaw sahaabaaun ghashiyathu, fadhakarahu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ aqraa fulaanu, faiinnahaa alssakiynaau nazalat lilqurani, aaw tanazzalat lilqurani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:A man recited Surat-al-Kahf (in his prayer) and in the house there was a (riding) animal which got frightened and started jumping. The man finished his prayer with Taslim, but behold! A mist or a cloud hovered over him. He informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of that and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O so-and-so! Recite, for this (mist or cloud) was a sign of peace descending for the recitation of Qur'an
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الْحَرَّانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ، يَقُولُ جَاءَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ إِلَى أَبِي فِي مَنْزِلِهِ، فَاشْتَرَى مِنْهُ رَحْلاً فَقَالَ لِعَازِبٍ ابْعَثِ ابْنَكَ يَحْمِلْهُ مَعِي‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَمَلْتُهُ مَعَهُ، وَخَرَجَ أَبِي يَنْتَقِدُ ثَمَنَهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبِي يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ حَدِّثْنِي كَيْفَ صَنَعْتُمَا حِينَ سَرَيْتَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ أَسْرَيْنَا لَيْلَتَنَا، وَمِنَ الْغَدِ حَتَّى قَامَ قَائِمُ الظَّهِيرَةِ، وَخَلاَ الطَّرِيقُ لاَ يَمُرُّ فِيهِ أَحَدٌ، فَرُفِعَتْ لَنَا صَخْرَةٌ طَوِيلَةٌ، لَهَا ظِلٌّ لَمْ تَأْتِ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ فَنَزَلْنَا عِنْدَهُ، وَسَوَّيْتُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَانًا بِيَدِي يَنَامُ عَلَيْهِ، وَبَسَطْتُ فِيهِ فَرْوَةً، وَقُلْتُ نَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَأَنَا أَنْفُضُ لَكَ مَا حَوْلَكَ‏.‏ فَنَامَ وَخَرَجْتُ أَنْفُضُ مَا حَوْلَهُ، فَإِذَا أَنَا بِرَاعٍ مُقْبِلٍ بِغَنَمِهِ إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ يُرِيدُ مِنْهَا مِثْلَ الَّذِي أَرَدْنَا فَقُلْتُ لِمَنْ أَنْتَ يَا غُلاَمُ فَقَالَ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ أَوْ مَكَّةَ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَفِي غَنَمِكَ لَبَنٌ قَالَ نَعَمُ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَفَتَحْلُبُ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ شَاةً‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ انْفُضِ الضَّرْعَ مِنَ التُّرَابِ وَالشَّعَرِ وَالْقَذَى‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُ الْبَرَاءَ يَضْرِبُ إِحْدَى يَدَيْهِ عَلَى الأُخْرَى يَنْفُضُ، فَحَلَبَ فِي قَعْبٍ كُثْبَةً مِنْ لَبَنٍ، وَمَعِي إِدَاوَةٌ حَمَلْتُهَا لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْتَوِي مِنْهَا، يَشْرَبُ وَيَتَوَضَّأُ، فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أُوقِظَهُ، فَوَافَقْتُهُ حِينَ اسْتَيْقَظَ، فَصَبَبْتُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ عَلَى اللَّبَنِ حَتَّى بَرَدَ أَسْفَلُهُ، فَقُلْتُ اشْرَبْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ قَالَ ـ فَشَرِبَ، حَتَّى رَضِيتُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلرَّحِيلِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ بَلَى ـ قَالَ ـ فَارْتَحَلْنَا بَعْدَ مَا مَالَتِ الشَّمْشُ، وَاتَّبَعَنَا سُرَاقَةُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، فَقُلْتُ أُتِينَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَحْزَنْ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَدَعَا عَلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَارْتَطَمَتْ بِهِ فَرَسُهُ إِلَى بَطْنِهَا ـ أُرَى فِي جَلَدٍ مِنَ الأَرْضِ، شَكَّ زُهَيْرٌ ـ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أُرَاكُمَا قَدْ دَعَوْتُمَا عَلَىَّ فَادْعُوَا لِي، فَاللَّهُ لَكُمَا أَنْ أَرُدَّ عَنْكُمَا الطَّلَبَ‏.‏ فَدَعَا لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَجَا فَجَعَلَ لاَ يَلْقَى أَحَدًا إِلاَّ قَالَ كَفَيْتُكُمْ مَا هُنَا‏.‏ فَلاَ يَلْقَى أَحَدًا إِلاَّ رَدَّهُ‏.‏ قَالَ وَوَفَى لَنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yaziyda bni iibraahiyma aabuw alhasani alharraaniyyu, haddathanaa zuhayru bnu mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, sami'tu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin, yaquwlu jaa'a aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh iilaa aabiy fiy manzilihi, faashtaraa minhu rahlaan faqaala li'aazibin ab'athi abnaka yahmilhu ma'iy‏.‏ qaala fahamaltuhu ma'ahu, wakharaja aabiy yantaqidu thamanahu, faqaala lahu aabiy yaa aabaa bakrin haddithniy kayfa sana'tumaa hiyna sarayta ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala na'am aasraynaa laylatanaa, wamina alghadi hattaa qaama qaaiimu alzzahiyraai, wakhalaa alttariyqu laa yamurru fiyhi aahadun, farufi'at lanaa sakhraaun tawiylaaun, lahaa zillun lam taati 'alayhi alshhamsu fanazalnaa 'indahu, wasawwaytu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm makaanana biyadiy yanaamu 'alayhi, wabasattu fiyhi farwaaan, waqultu nam yaa rasuwla alllahi, waaanaa aanfudu laka maa hawlaka‏.‏ fanaama wakharajtu aanfudu maa hawlahu, faiidhaa aanaa biraa'in muqbilin bighanamihi iilaa alssakhraai yuriydu minhaa mithla alladhiy aaradnaa faqultu liman aanta yaa ghulaamu faqaala lirajulin min aahli almadiynaai aaw makkaaa‏.‏ qultu aafiy ghanamika labanun qaala na'amu‏.‏ qultu aafatahlubu qaala na'am‏.‏ faaakhadha shaaaan‏.‏ faqultu anfudi alddar'a mina altturaabi waalshha'ari waalqadhaa‏.‏ qaala faraaaytu albaraa'a yadribu iihdaa yadayhi 'alaa alaukhraa yanfudu, fahalaba fiy qa'bin kuthbaaan min labanin, wama'iy iidaawaaun hamaltuhaa lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yartawiy minhaa, yashrabu wayatawaddaau, faaataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fakarihtu aan auwqizahu, fawaafaqtuhu hiyna astayqaza, fasababtu mina almaa'i 'alaa alllabani hattaa barada aasfaluhu, faqultu ashrab yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala fashariba, hattaa radiytu thumma qaala ‏"‏ aalam yaani lilrrahiyli ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu balaa qaala faartahalnaa ba'da maa maalati alshhamshu, waattaba'anaa suraaqaau bnu maalikin, faqultu autiynaa yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ laa tahzan, iinna alllaha ma'anaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fada'aa 'alayhi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faartatamat bihi farasuhu iilaa batnihaa auraa fiy jaladin mina alaardi, shakka zuhayrun faqaala iinniy auraakumaa qad da'awtumaa 'alaaaa faad'uwaa liy, faalllahu lakumaa aan aarudda 'ankumaa alttalaba‏.‏ fada'aa lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fanajaa faja'ala laa yalqaa aahadana iilaaa qaala kafaytukum maa hunaa‏.‏ falaa yalqaa aahadana iilaaa raddahu‏.‏ qaala wawafaa lanaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:Abu Bakr came to my father who was at home and purchased a saddle from him. He said to `Azib, "Tell your son to carry it with me." So I carried it with him and my father followed us so as to take the price (of the saddle). My father said, "O Abu Bakr! Tell me what happened to you on your night journey with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (during Migration)." He said, "Yes, we travelled the whole night and also the next day till midday. when nobody could be seen on the way ( because of the severe heat) . Then there appeared a long rock having shade beneath it, and the sunshine had not come to it yet. So we dismounted there and I levelled a place and covered it with an animal hide or dry grass for the Prophet (ﷺ) to sleep on (for a while). I then said, 'Sleep, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and I will guard you.' So he slept and I went out to guard him. Suddenly I saw a shepherd coming with his sheep to that rock with the same intention we had when we came to it. I asked (him), 'To whom do you belong, O boy?' He replied, 'I belong to a man from Medina or Mecca.' I said, 'Do your sheep have milk?' He said, 'Yes.' I said, 'Will you milk for us?' He said, 'Yes.' He caught hold of a sheep and I asked him to clean its teat from dust, hairs and dirt. (The sub-narrator said that he saw Al-Bara' striking one of his hands with the other, demonstrating how the shepherd removed the dust.) The shepherd milked a little milk in a wooden container and I had a leather container which I carried for the Prophet (ﷺ) to drink and perform the ablution from. I went to the Prophet, hating to wake him up, but when I reached there, the Prophet (ﷺ) had already awakened; so I poured water over the middle part of the milk container, till the milk was cold. Then I said, 'Drink, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!' He drank till I was pleased. Then he asked, 'Has the time for our departure come?' I said, 'Yes.' So we departed after midday. Suraqa bin Malik followed us and I said, 'We have been discovered, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!' He said, Don't grieve for Allah is with us.' The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked evil on him (i.e. Suraqa) and so the legs of his horse sank into the earth up to its belly. (The subnarrator, Zuhair is not sure whether Abu Bakr said, "(It sank) into solid earth.") Suraqa said, 'I see that you have invoked evil on me. Please invoke good on me, and by Allah, I will cause those who are seeking after you to return.' The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked good on him and he was saved. Then, whenever he met somebody on the way, he would say, 'I have looked for him here in vain.' So he caused whomever he met to return. Thus Suraqa fulfilled his promise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُخْتَارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَى أَعْرَابِيٍّ ـ يَعُودُهُ ـ قَالَ وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا دَخَلَ عَلَى مَرِيضٍ يَعُودُهُ قَالَ لاَ بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ ‏"‏ لاَ بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتَ طَهُورٌ كَلاَّ بَلْ هِيَ حُمَّى تَفُورُ ـ أَوْ تَثُورُ ـ عَلَى شَيْخٍ كَبِيرٍ، تُزِيرُهُ الْقُبُورَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَنَعَمْ إِذًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu mukhtaarin, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala 'alaa aa'raabiyyin ya'uwduhu qaala wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa dakhala 'alaa mariydin ya'uwduhu qaala laa baasa tahuwrun iin shaa'a alllahu‏.‏ faqaala lahu ‏"‏ laa baasa tahuwrun iin shaa'a alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qulta tahuwrun kalaaa bal hiya hummaa tafuwru aaw tathuwru 'alaa shaykhin kabiyrin, tuziyruhu alqubuwra‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ fana'am iidhana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) paid a visit to a sick bedouin. The Prophet (ﷺ) when visiting a patient used to say, "No harm will befall you! May Allah cure you! May Allah cure you!" So the Prophet (ﷺ) said to the bedouin. "No harm will befall you. May Allah cure you!" The bedouin said, "You say, may Allah cure me? No, for it is a fever which boils in (the body of) an old man, and will lead him to the grave." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, then may it be as you say
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ رَجُلٌ نَصْرَانِيًّا فَأَسْلَمَ وَقَرَأَ الْبَقَرَةَ وَآلَ عِمْرَانَ، فَكَانَ يَكْتُبُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَعَادَ نَصْرَانِيًّا فَكَانَ يَقُولُ مَا يَدْرِي مُحَمَّدٌ إِلاَّ مَا كَتَبْتُ لَهُ، فَأَمَاتَهُ اللَّهُ فَدَفَنُوهُ، فَأَصْبَحَ وَقَدْ لَفَظَتْهُ الأَرْضُ فَقَالُوا هَذَا فِعْلُ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَصْحَابِهِ، لَمَّا هَرَبَ مِنْهُمْ نَبَشُوا عَنْ صَاحِبِنَا‏.‏ فَأَلْقُوهُ فَحَفَرُوا لَهُ فَأَعْمَقُوا، فَأَصْبَحَ وَقَدْ لَفَظَتْهُ الأَرْضُ، فَقَالُوا هَذَا فِعْلُ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَصْحَابِهِ نَبَشُوا عَنْ صَاحِبِنَا لَمَّا هَرَبَ مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ فَأَلْقَوْهُ فَحَفَرُوا لَهُ، وَأَعْمَقُوا لَهُ فِي الأَرْضِ مَا اسْتَطَاعُوا، فَأَصْبَحَ قَدْ لَفَظَتْهُ الأَرْضُ، فَعَلِمُوا أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنَ النَّاسِ فَأَلْقَوْهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala kaana rajulun nasraaniyyana faaaslama waqaraaa albaqaraaa waala 'imraana, fakaana yaktubu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fa'aada nasraaniyyana fakaana yaquwlu maa yadriy muhammadun iilaaa maa katabtu lahu, faaamaatahu alllahu fadafanuwhu, faaasbaha waqad lafazathu alaardu faqaaluwa hadhaa fi'lu muhammadin waaashaabihi, lammaa haraba minhum nabashuwa 'an saahibinaa‏.‏ faaalquwhu fahafaruwa lahu faaa'maquwa, faaasbaha waqad lafazathu alaardu, faqaaluwa hadhaa fi'lu muhammadin waaashaabihi nabashuwa 'an saahibinaa lammaa haraba minhum‏.‏ faaalqawhu fahafaruwa lahu, waaa'maquwa lahu fiy alaardi maa astataa'uwa, faaasbaha qad lafazathu alaardu, fa'alimuwa aannahu laysa mina alnnaasi faaalqawhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:There was a Christian who embraced Islam and read Surat-al-Baqara and Al-`Imran, and he used to write (the revelations) for the Prophet. Later on he returned to Christianity again and he used to say: "Muhammad knows nothing but what I have written for him." Then Allah caused him to die, and the people buried him, but in the morning they saw that the earth had thrown his body out. They said, "This is the act of Muhammad and his companions. They dug the grave of our companion and took his body out of it because he had run away from them." They again dug the grave deeply for him, but in the morning they again saw that the earth had thrown his body out. They said, "This is an act of Muhammad and his companions. They dug the grave of our companion and threw his body outside it, for he had run away from them." They dug the grave for him as deep as they could, but in the morning they again saw that the earth had thrown his body out. So they believed that what had befallen him was not done by human beings and had to leave him thrown (on the ground)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا هَلَكَ كِسْرَى فَلاَ كِسْرَى بَعْدَهُ، وَإِذَا هَلَكَ قَيْصَرُ فَلاَ قَيْصَرَ بَعْدَهُ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَتُنْفِقُنَّ كُنُوزَهُمَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala waaakhbaraniy abnu almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa halaka kisraa falaa kisraa ba'dahu, waiidhaa halaka qaysaru falaa qaysara ba'dahu, waalladhiy nafsu muhammadin biyadihi latunfiqunna kunuwzahumaa fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When Khosrau perishes, there will be no (more) Khosrau after him, and when Caesar perishes, there will be no more Caesar after him. By Him in Whose Hands Muhammad's life is, you will spend the treasures of both of them in Allah's Cause
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، رَفَعَهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا هَلَكَ كِسْرَى فَلاَ كِسْرَى بَعْدَهُ ـ وَذَكَرَ وَقَالَ ـ لَتُنْفَقَنَّ كُنُوزُهُمَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, rafa'ahu qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa halaka kisraa falaa kisraa ba'dahu wadhakara waqaala latunfaqanna kunuwzuhumaa fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin Samura:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When Khosrau perishes, there will be no more Khosrau after him, and when Caesar perishes, there will be no more Caesar after him." The Prophet (ﷺ) also said, "You will spend the treasures of both of them in Allah's Cause
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَدِمَ مُسَيْلِمَةُ الْكَذَّابُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ إِنْ جَعَلَ لِي مُحَمَّدٌ الأَمْرَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ تَبِعْتُهُ‏.‏ وَقَدِمَهَا فِي بَشَرٍ كَثِيرٍ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ، فَأَقْبَلَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَعَهُ ثَابِتُ بْنُ قَيْسِ بْنِ شَمَّاسٍ، وَفِي يَدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قِطْعَةُ جَرِيدٍ، حَتَّى وَقَفَ عَلَى مُسَيْلِمَةَ فِي أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ سَأَلْتَنِي هَذِهِ الْقِطْعَةَ مَا أَعْطَيْتُكَهَا، وَلَنْ تَعْدُوَ أَمْرَ اللَّهِ فِيكَ، وَلَئِنْ أَدْبَرْتَ لَيَعْقِرَنَّكَ اللَّهُ، وَإِنِّي لأَرَاكَ الَّذِي أُرِيتُ فِيكَ مَا رَأَيْتُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَمَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ رَأَيْتُ فِي يَدَىَّ سِوَارَيْنِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَأَهَمَّنِي شَأْنُهُمَا، فَأُوحِيَ إِلَىَّ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِ انْفُخْهُمَا، فَنَفَخْتُهُمَا فَطَارَا فَأَوَّلْتُهُمَا كَذَّابَيْنِ يَخْرُجَانِ بَعْدِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَانَ أَحَدُهُمَا الْعَنْسِيَّ وَالآخَرُ مُسَيْلِمَةَ الْكَذَّابَ صَاحِبَ الْيَمَامَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy husaynin, haddathanaa naafi'u bnu jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala qadima musaylimaau alkadhhaabu 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faja'ala yaquwlu iin ja'ala liy muhammadun alaamra min ba'dihi tabi'tuhu‏.‏ waqadimahaa fiy basharin kathiyrin min qawmihi, faaaqbala iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wama'ahu thaabitu bnu qaysi bni shammaasin, wafiy yadi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qit'aau jariydin, hattaa waqafa 'alaa musaylimaaa fiy aashaabihi faqaala ‏"‏ law saaaltaniy hadhihi alqit'aaa maa aa'taytukahaa, walan ta'duwa aamra alllahi fiyka, walaiin aadbarta laya'qirannaka alllahu, waiinniy laaraaka alladhiy auriytu fiyka maa raaaytu ‏"‏‏.‏ faaakhbaraniy aabuw hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ baynamaa aanaa naaiimun raaaytu fiy yadaaaa siwaarayni min dhahabin, faaahammaniy shaanuhumaa, faauwhiya iilaaaa fiy almanaami aani anfukhhumaa, fanafakhtuhumaa fataaraa faaawwaltuhumaa kadhhaabayni yakhrujaani ba'diy ‏"‏‏.‏ fakaana aahaduhumaa al'ansiyya waalakharu musaylimaaa alkadhhaaba saahiba alyamaamaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Musailama-al-Kadhdhab (i.e. the liar) came in the life-time of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with many of his people (to Medina) and said, "If Muhammad makes me his successor, I will follow him." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went up to him with Thabit bin Qais bin Shams; and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was carrying a piece of a datepalm leaf in his hand. He stood before Musailama (and his companions) and said, "If you asked me even this piece (of a leaf), I would not give it to you. You cannot avoid the fate you are destined to, by Allah. If you reject Islam, Allah will destroy you. I think that you are most probably the same person whom I have seen in the dream." Abu Huraira told me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); said, "While I was sleeping, I saw (in a dream) two gold bracelets round my arm, and that worried me too much. Then I was instructed divinely in my dream, to blow them off and so I blew them off, and they flew away. I interpreted the two bracelets as symbols of two liars who would appear after me. And so one of them was Al-Ansi and the other was Musailama Al-Kadhdhab from Al-Yamama
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ أُرَاهُ ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ رَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أُهَاجِرُ مِنْ مَكَّةَ إِلَى أَرْضٍ بِهَا نَخْلٌ، فَذَهَبَ وَهَلِي إِلَى أَنَّهَا الْيَمَامَةُ أَوْ هَجَرُ، فَإِذَا هِيَ الْمَدِينَةُ يَثْرِبُ، وَرَأَيْتُ فِي رُؤْيَاىَ هَذِهِ أَنِّي هَزَزْتُ سَيْفًا فَانْقَطَعَ صَدْرُهُ، فَإِذَا هُوَ مَا أُصِيبَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ، ثُمَّ هَزَزْتُهُ بِأُخْرَى فَعَادَ أَحْسَنَ مَا كَانَ، فَإِذَا هُوَ مَا جَاءَ اللَّهُ بِهِ مِنَ الْفَتْحِ وَاجْتِمَاعِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَرَأَيْتُ فِيهَا بَقَرًا وَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ فَإِذَا هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ، وَإِذَا الْخَيْرُ مَا جَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ، وَثَوَابِ الصِّدْقِ الَّذِي آتَانَا اللَّهُ بَعْدَ يَوْمِ بَدْرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu ausaamaaa, 'an buraydi bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy burdaaa, 'an jaddihi aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa auraahu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ raaaytu fiy almanaami aanniy auhaajiru min makkaaa iilaa aardin bihaa nakhlun, fadhahaba wahaliy iilaa aannahaa alyamaamaau aaw hajaru, faiidhaa hiya almadiynaau yathribu, waraaaytu fiy ruuyaaaa hadhihi aanniy hazaztu sayfana faanqata'a sadruhu, faiidhaa huwa maa ausiyba mina almuuminiyna yawma auhudin, thumma hazaztuhu biaukhraa fa'aada aahsana maa kaana, faiidhaa huwa maa jaa'a alllahu bihi mina alfathi waajtimaa'i almuuminiyna, waraaaytu fiyhaa baqarana waalllahu khayrun faiidhaa humu almuuminuwna yawma auhudin, waiidhaa alkhayru maa jaa'a alllahu mina alkhayri, wathawaabi alssidqi alladhiy ataanaa alllahu ba'da yawmi badrin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "In a dream I saw myself migrating from Mecca to a place having plenty of date trees. I thought that it was Al-Yamama or Hajar, but it came to be Medina i.e. Yathrib. In the same dream I saw myself moving a sword and its blade got broken. It came to symbolize the defeat which the Muslims suffered from, on the Day of Uhud. I moved the sword again, and it became normal as before, and that was the symbol of the victory Allah bestowed upon Muslims and their gathering together. I saw cows in my dream, and by Allah, that was a blessing, and they symbolized the believers on the Day of Uhud. And the blessing was the good Allah bestowed upon us and the reward of true belief which Allah gave us after the day of Badr
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ أَقْبَلَتْ فَاطِمَةُ تَمْشِي، كَأَنَّ مِشْيَتَهَا مَشْىُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَرْحَبًا بِابْنَتِي ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَجْلَسَهَا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ أَوْ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ، ثُمَّ أَسَرَّ إِلَيْهَا حَدِيثًا، فَبَكَتْ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا لِمَ تَبْكِينَ ثُمَّ أَسَرَّ إِلَيْهَا حَدِيثًا فَضَحِكَتْ فَقُلْتُ مَا رَأَيْتُ كَالْيَوْمِ فَرَحًا أَقْرَبَ مِنْ حُزْنٍ، فَسَأَلْتُهَا عَمَّا قَالَ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ مَا كُنْتُ لأُفْشِيَ سِرَّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى قُبِضَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلْتُهَا فَقَالَتْ أَسَرَّ إِلَىَّ ‏"‏ إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ كَانَ يُعَارِضُنِي الْقُرْآنَ كُلَّ سَنَةٍ مَرَّةً، وَإِنَّهُ عَارَضَنِي الْعَامَ مَرَّتَيْنِ، وَلاَ أُرَاهُ إِلاَّ حَضَرَ أَجَلِي، وَإِنَّكِ أَوَّلُ أَهْلِ بَيْتِي لَحَاقًا بِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَبَكَيْتُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ تَكُونِي سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ـ أَوْ نِسَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَضَحِكْتُ لِذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, 'an firaasin, 'an 'aamirin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat aaqbalat faatimaau tamshiy, kaaanna mishyatahaa mashau alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ marhabana biabnatiy ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma aajlasahaa 'an yamiynihi aaw 'an shimaalihi, thumma aasarra iilayhaa hadiythana, fabakat faqultu lahaa lima tabkiyna thumma aasarra iilayhaa hadiythana fadahikat faqultu maa raaaytu kaalyawmi farahana aaqraba min huznin, fasaaaltuhaa 'ammaa qaala‏.‏ faqaalat maa kuntu laufshiya sirra rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa qubida alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaaltuhaa faqaalat aasarra iilaaaa ‏"‏ iinna jibriyla kaana yu'aariduniy alqurana kulla sanaain marraaan, waiinnahu 'aaradaniy al'aama marratayni, walaa auraahu iilaaa hadara aajaliy, waiinnaki aawwalu aahli baytiy lahaaqana biy ‏"‏‏.‏ fabakaytu faqaala ‏"‏ aamaa tardayna aan takuwniy sayyidaaa nisaa'i aahli aljannaai aaw nisaa'i almuuminiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ fadahiktu lidhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Once Fatima came walking and her gait resembled the gait of the Prophet (ﷺ) . The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Welcome, O my daughter!" Then he made her sit on his right or on his left side, and then he told her a secret and she started weeping. I asked her, "Why are you weeping?" He again told her a secret and she started laughing. I said, "I never saw happiness so near to sadness as I saw today." I asked her what the Prophet (ﷺ) had told her. She said, "I would never disclose the secret of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." When the Prophet (ﷺ) died, I asked her about it. She replied. "The Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'Every year Gabriel used to revise the Qur'an with me once only, but this year he has done so twice. I think this portends my death, and you will be the first of my family to follow me.' So I started weeping. Then he said. 'Don't you like to be the chief of all the ladies of Paradise or the chief of the believing women? So I laughed for that
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ دَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاطِمَةَ ابْنَتَهُ فِي شَكْوَاهُ الَّذِي قُبِضَ فِيهِ، فَسَارَّهَا بِشَىْءٍ فَبَكَتْ، ثُمَّ دَعَاهَا، فَسَارَّهَا فَضَحِكَتْ، قَالَتْ فَسَأَلْتُهَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ سَارَّنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّهُ يُقْبَضُ فِي وَجَعِهِ الَّذِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهِ فَبَكَيْتُ، ثُمَّ سَارَّنِي فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنِّي أَوَّلُ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ أَتْبَعُهُ فَضَحِكْتُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat da'aa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faatimaaa abnatahu fiy shakwaahu alladhiy qubida fiyhi, fasaarrahaa bishaa'in fabakat, thumma da'aahaa, fasaarrahaa fadahikat, qaalat fasaaaltuhaa 'an dhalika‏.‏ faqaalat saarraniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbaraniy aannahu yuqbadu fiy waja'ihi alladhiy tuwuffiya fiyhi fabakaytu, thumma saarraniy faaakhbaraniy aanniy aawwalu aahli baytihi aatba'uhu fadahiktu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) in his fatal illness, called his daughter Fatima and told her a secret because of which she started weeping. Then he called her and told her another secret, and she started laughing. When I asked her about that, she replied, The Prophet (ﷺ) told me that he would die in his fatal illness, and so I wept, but then he secretly told me that from amongst his family, I would be the first to join him, and so I laughed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يُدْنِي ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ إِنَّ لَنَا أَبْنَاءً مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ تَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَ عُمَرُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ ‏{‏إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ‏}‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَجَلُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْلَمَهُ إِيَّاهُ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا أَعْلَمُ مِنْهَا إِلاَّ مَا تَعْلَمُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ar'araaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala kaana 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh yudniy abna 'abbaasin, faqaala lahu 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'awfin iinna lanaa aabnaa'an mithlahu‏.‏ faqaala iinnahu min haythu ta'lamu‏.‏ fasaaala 'umaru abna 'abbaasin 'an hadhihi alayaai ‏{‏iidhaa jaa'a nasru alllahi waalfathu‏}‏‏.‏ faqaala aajalu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aa'lamahu iiyyaahu‏.‏ qaala maa aa'lamu minhaa iilaaa maa ta'lamu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:About Ibn `Abbas: `Umar bin Al-Khattab used to treat Ibn `Abbas very favorably `Abdur Rahman bin `Auf said to him. "We also have sons that are equal to him (but you are partial to him.)" `Umar said, "It is because of his knowledge." Then `Umar asked Ibn `Abbas about the interpretation of the Verse:- 'When come the Help of Allah and the conquest (of Mecca) (110.1) Ibn `Abbas said. "It portended the death of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), which Allah had informed him of." `Umar said, "I do not know from this Verse but what you know
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ بْنِ الْغَسِيلِ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ بِمِلْحَفَةٍ قَدْ عَصَّبَ بِعِصَابَةٍ دَسْمَاءَ، حَتَّى جَلَسَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ يَكْثُرُونَ وَيَقِلُّ الأَنْصَارُ، حَتَّى يَكُونُوا فِي النَّاسِ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْمِلْحِ فِي الطَّعَامِ، فَمَنْ وَلِيَ مِنْكُمْ شَيْئًا يَضُرُّ فِيهِ قَوْمًا، وَيَنْفَعُ فِيهِ آخَرِينَ، فَلْيَقْبَلْ مِنْ مُحْسِنِهِمْ، وَيَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْ مُسِيئِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَانَ آخِرَ مَجْلِسٍ جَلَسَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu sulaymaana bni hanzalaaa bni alghasiyli, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy maradihi alladhiy maata fiyhi bimilhafaain qad 'assaba bi'isaabaain dasmaa'a, hattaa jalasa 'alaa alminbari fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi thumma qaala ‏ "‏ aammaa ba'du faiinna alnnaasa yakthuruwna wayaqillu alaansaaru, hattaa yakuwnuwa fiy alnnaasi bimanzilaai almilhi fiy altta'aami, faman waliya minkum shayiana yadurru fiyhi qawmana, wayanfa'u fiyhi akhariyna, falyaqbal min muhsinihim, wayatajaawaz 'an musiyiihim ‏"‏‏.‏ fakaana akhira majlisin jalasa bihi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his fatal illness came out, wrapped with a sheet, and his head was wrapped with an oiled bandage. He sat on the pulpit, and praising and glorifying Allah, he said, "Now then, people will increase but the Ansar will decrease in number, so much so that they, compared with the people, will be just like the salt in the meals. So, if any of you should take over the authority by which he can either benefit some people or harm some others, he should accept the goodness of their good people (i.e. Ansar) and excuse the faults of their wrong-doers." That was the last gathering which the Prophet (ﷺ) attended
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ الْجُعْفِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَخْرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ الْحَسَنَ فَصَعِدَ بِهِ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ ابْنِي هَذَا سَيِّدٌ، وَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُصْلِحَ بِهِ بَيْنَ فِئَتَيْنِ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa husaynun alju'fiyyu, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alhasani, 'an aabiy bakraaa rda allh 'nh aakhraja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata yawmin alhasana fasa'ida bihi 'alaa alminbari, faqaala ‏ "‏ abniy hadhaa sayyidun, wala'alla alllaha aan yusliha bihi bayna fiiatayni mina almuslimiyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakra:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) brought out Al-Hasan and took him up the pulpit along with him and said, "This son of mine is a Saiyid (i.e. chief) and I hope that Allah will help him bring about reconciliation between two Muslim groups
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَعَى جَعْفَرًا وَزَيْدًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجِيءَ خَبَرُهُمْ، وَعَيْنَاهُ تَذْرِفَانِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an humaydi bni hilaalin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm na'aa ja'farana wazaydana qabla aan yajiy'a khabaruhum, wa'aynaahu tadhrifaani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) had informed us of the death of Ja`far and Zaid before the news of their death reached us, and his eyes were shedding tears
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلْ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْمَاطٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَأَنَّى يَكُونُ لَنَا الأَنْمَاطُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا إِنَّهُ سَيَكُونُ لَكُمُ الأَنْمَاطُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنَا أَقُولُ لَهَا ـ يَعْنِي امْرَأَتَهُ ـ أَخِّرِي عَنِّي أَنْمَاطَكِ‏.‏ فَتَقُولُ أَلَمْ يَقُلِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا سَتَكُونُ لَكُمُ الأَنْمَاطُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَدَعُهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu 'abbaasin, haddathanaa abnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an jaabirin rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hal lakum min aanmaatin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu waaannaa yakuwnu lanaa alaanmaatu qaala ‏"‏ aamaa iinnahu sayakuwnu lakumu alaanmaatu ‏"‏‏.‏ faaanaa aaquwlu lahaa ya'niy amraaatahu aakhhiriy 'anniy aanmaataki‏.‏ fataquwlu aalam yaquli alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnahaa satakuwnu lakumu alaanmaatu ‏"‏‏.‏ faaada'uhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:(Once) the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you got carpets?" I replied, "Whence can we get carpets?" He said, "But you shall soon have carpets." I used to say to my wife, "Remove your carpets from my sight," but she would say, "Didn't the Prophet (ﷺ) tell you that you would soon have carpets?" So I would give up my request
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ انْطَلَقَ سَعْدُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ مُعْتَمِرًا ـ قَالَ ـ فَنَزَلَ عَلَى أُمَيَّةَ بْنِ خَلَفٍ أَبِي صَفْوَانَ، وَكَانَ أُمَيَّةُ إِذَا انْطَلَقَ إِلَى الشَّأْمِ فَمَرَّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ نَزَلَ عَلَى سَعْدٍ، فَقَالَ أُمَيَّةُ لِسَعْدٍ انْتَظِرْ حَتَّى إِذَا انْتَصَفَ النَّهَارُ، وَغَفَلَ النَّاسُ انْطَلَقْتُ فَطُفْتُ، فَبَيْنَا سَعْدٌ يَطُوفُ إِذَا أَبُو جَهْلٍ فَقَالَ مَنْ هَذَا الَّذِي يَطُوفُ بِالْكَعْبَةِ فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ أَنَا سَعْدٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ تَطُوفُ بِالْكَعْبَةِ آمِنًا، وَقَدْ آوَيْتُمْ مُحَمَّدًا وَأَصْحَابَهُ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَتَلاَحَيَا بَيْنَهُمَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُمَيَّةُ لِسَعْدٍ لاَ تَرْفَعْ صَوْتَكَ عَلَى أَبِي الْحَكَمِ، فَإِنَّهُ سَيِّدُ أَهْلِ الْوَادِي‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ سَعْدٌ وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ مَنَعْتَنِي أَنْ أَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ لأَقْطَعَنَّ مَتْجَرَكَ بِالشَّأْمِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَعَلَ أُمَيَّةُ يَقُولُ لِسَعْدٍ لاَ تَرْفَعْ صَوْتَكَ‏.‏ وَجَعَلَ يُمْسِكُهُ، فَغَضِبَ سَعْدٌ فَقَالَ دَعْنَا عَنْكَ، فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ قَاتِلُكَ‏.‏ قَالَ إِيَّاىَ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا يَكْذِبُ مُحَمَّدٌ إِذَا حَدَّثَ‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ إِلَى امْرَأَتِهِ، فَقَالَ أَمَا تَعْلَمِينَ مَا قَالَ لِي أَخِي الْيَثْرِبِيُّ قَالَتْ وَمَا قَالَ قَالَ زَعَمَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُحَمَّدًا يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ قَاتِلِي‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا يَكْذِبُ مُحَمَّدٌ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا خَرَجُوا إِلَى بَدْرٍ، وَجَاءَ الصَّرِيخُ قَالَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَتُهُ أَمَا ذَكَرْتَ مَا قَالَ لَكَ أَخُوكَ الْيَثْرِبِيُّ قَالَ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ لاَ يَخْرُجَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو جَهْلٍ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَشْرَافِ الْوَادِي، فَسِرْ يَوْمًا أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ، فَسَارَ مَعَهُمْ فَقَتَلَهُ اللَّهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an 'amriw bni maymuwnin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin rda allh 'nh qaala antalaqa sa'du bnu mu'aadhin mu'tamirana qaala fanazala 'alaa aumayyaaa bni khalafin aabiy safwaana, wakaana aumayyaau iidhaa antalaqa iilaa alshhaami famarra bialmadiynaai nazala 'alaa sa'din, faqaala aumayyaau lisa'din antazir hattaa iidhaa antasafa alnnahaaru, waghafala alnnaasu antalaqtu fatuftu, fabaynaa sa'dun yatuwfu iidhaa aabuw jahlin faqaala man hadhaa alladhiy yatuwfu bialka'baai faqaala sa'dun aanaa sa'dun‏.‏ faqaala aabuw jahlin tatuwfu bialka'baai aminana, waqad awaytum muhammadana waaashaabahu faqaala na'am‏.‏ fatalaahayaa baynahumaa‏.‏ faqaala aumayyaau lisa'din laa tarfa' sawtaka 'alaa aabiy alhakami, faiinnahu sayyidu aahli alwaadiy‏.‏ thumma qaala sa'dun waalllahi laiin mana'taniy aan aatuwfa bialbayti laaqta'anna matjaraka bialshhaami‏.‏ qaala faja'ala aumayyaau yaquwlu lisa'din laa tarfa' sawtaka‏.‏ waja'ala yumsikuhu, faghadiba sa'dun faqaala da'naa 'anka, faiinniy sami'tu muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm yaz'umu aannahu qaatiluka‏.‏ qaala iiyyaaaa qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala waalllahi maa yakdhibu muhammadun iidhaa haddatha‏.‏ faraja'a iilaa amraaatihi, faqaala aamaa ta'lamiyna maa qaala liy aakhiy alyathribiyyu qaalat wamaa qaala qaala za'ama aannahu sami'a muhammadana yaz'umu aannahu qaatiliy‏.‏ qaalat fawaalllahi maa yakdhibu muhammadun‏.‏ qaala falammaa kharajuwa iilaa badrin, wajaa'a alssariykhu qaalat lahu amraaatuhu aamaa dhakarta maa qaala laka aakhuwka alyathribiyyu qaala faaaraada aan laa yakhruja, faqaala lahu aabuw jahlin iinnaka min aashraafi alwaadiy, fasir yawmana aaw yawmayni, fasaara ma'ahum faqatalahu alllahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:Sa`d bin Mu`adh came to Mecca with the intention of performing `Umra, and stayed at the house of Umaiya bin Khalaf Abi Safwan, for Umaiya himself used to stay at Sa`d's house when he passed by Medina on his way to Sham. Umaiya said to Sa`d, "Will you wait till midday when the people are (at their homes), then you may go and perform the Tawaf round the Ka`ba?" So, while Sa`d was going around the Ka`ba, Abu Jahl came and asked, "Who is that who is performing Tawaf?" Sa`d replied, "I am Sa`d." Abu Jahl said, "Are you circumambulating the Ka`ba safely although you have given refuge to Muhammad and his companions?" Sa`d said, "Yes," and they started quarreling. Umaiya said to Sa`d, "Don't shout at Abi-l-Hakam (i.e. Abu Jahl), for he is chief of the valley (of Mecca)." Sa`d then said (to Abu Jahl). 'By Allah, if you prevent me from performing the Tawaf of the Ka`ba, I will spoil your trade with Sham." Umaiya kept on saying to Sa`d, "Don't raise your voice." and kept on taking hold of him. Sa`d became furious and said, (to Umaiya), "Be away from me, for I have heard Muhammad saying that he will kill you." Umaiya said, "Will he kill me?" Sa`d said, "Yes,." Umaiya said, "By Allah! When Muhammad says a thing, he never tells a lie." Umaiya went to his wife and said to her, "Do you know what my brother from Yathrib (i.e. Medina) has said to me?" She said, "What has he said?" He said, "He claims that he has heard Muhammad claiming that he will kill me." She said, By Allah! Muhammad never tells a lie." So when the infidels started to proceed for Badr (Battle) and declared war (against the Muslims), his wife said to him, "Don't you remember what your brother from Yathrib told you?" Umaiya decided not to go but Abu Jahl said to him, "You are from the nobles of the valley (of Mecca), so you should accompany us for a day or two." He went with them and thus Allah got him killed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ رَأَيْتُ النَّاسَ مُجْتَمِعِينَ فِي صَعِيدٍ، فَقَامَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَنَزَعَ ذَنُوبًا أَوْ ذَنُوبَيْنِ، وَفِي بَعْضِ نَزْعِهِ ضَعْفٌ، وَاللَّهُ يَغْفِرُ لَهُ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا عُمَرُ، فَاسْتَحَالَتْ بِيَدِهِ غَرْبًا، فَلَمْ أَرَ عَبْقَرِيًّا فِي النَّاسِ يَفْرِي فَرِيَّهُ، حَتَّى ضَرَبَ النَّاسُ بِعَطَنٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ هَمَّامٌ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَنَزَعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ذَنُوبَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu almughiyraai, 'an aabiyhi, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ raaaytu alnnaasa mujtami'iyna fiy sa'iydin, faqaama aabuw bakrin fanaza'a dhanuwbana aaw dhanuwbayni, wafiy ba'di naz'ihi da'fun, waalllahu yaghfiru lahu, thumma aakhadhahaa 'umaru, faastahaalat biyadihi gharbana, falam aara 'abqariyyana fiy alnnaasi yafriy fariyyahu, hattaa daraba alnnaasu bi'atanin ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala hammaamun 'an aabiy hurayraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ fanaza'a aabuw bakrin dhanuwbayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I saw (in a dream) the people assembled in a gathering, and then Abu Bakr got up and drew one or two buckets of water (from a well) but there was weakness in his drawing. May Allah forgive him. Then `Umar took the bucket and in his hands it turned into a very large bucket. I had never seen anyone amongst: the people who could draw the water as strongly as `Umar till all the people drank their fill and watered their camels that knelt down there
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبَّاسُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ النَّرْسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ أُنْبِئْتُ أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدَهُ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ، فَجَعَلَ يُحَدِّثُ ثُمَّ قَامَ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأُمِّ سَلَمَةَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَتْ هَذَا دِحْيَةُ‏.‏ قَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ ايْمُ اللَّهِ مَا حَسِبْتُهُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ حَتَّى سَمِعْتُ خُطْبَةَ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُخْبِرُ جِبْرِيلَ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لأَبِي عُثْمَانَ مِمَّنْ سَمِعْتَ هَذَا قَالَ مِنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abbaasu bnu alwaliydi alnnarsiyyu, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, qaala sami'tu aabiy, haddathanaa aabuw 'uthmaana, qaala aunbiitu aanna jibriyla 'alayhi alssalaamu aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'indahu aummu salamaaa, faja'ala yuhaddithu thumma qaama, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm laummi salamaaa ‏ "‏ man hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ aaw kamaa qaala‏.‏ qaala qaalat hadhaa dihyaau‏.‏ qaalat aummu salamaaa aymu alllahi maa hasibtuhu iilaaa iiyyaahu hattaa sami'tu khutbaaa nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yukhbiru jibriyla aaw kamaa qaala‏.‏ qaala faqultu laabiy 'uthmaana mimman sami'ta hadhaa qaala min ausaamaaa bni zaydin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu `Uthman:I got the news that Gabriel came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while Um Salama was present. Gabriel started talking (to the Prophet (ﷺ) and then left. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Um Salama, "(Do you know) who it was?" (or a similar question). She said, "It was Dihya (a handsome person amongst the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) )." Later on Um Salama said, "By Allah! I thought he was none but Dihya, till I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) talking about Gabriel in his sermon." (The Sub-narrator asked Abu `Uthman, "From where have you heard this narration?" He replied, "From Usama bin Zaid)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ، جَاءُوا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرُوا لَهُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مِنْهُمْ وَامْرَأَةً زَنَيَا فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا تَجِدُونَ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ فِي شَأْنِ الرَّجْمِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا نَفْضَحُهُمْ وَيُجْلَدُونَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ كَذَبْتُمْ، إِنَّ فِيهَا الرَّجْمَ‏.‏ فَأَتَوْا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ فَنَشَرُوهَا، فَوَضَعَ أَحَدُهُمْ يَدَهُ عَلَى آيَةِ الرَّجْمِ، فَقَرَأَ مَا قَبْلَهَا وَمَا بَعْدَهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا فِيهَا آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا صَدَقَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ، فِيهَا آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرُجِمَا‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَرَأَيْتُ الرَّجُلَ يَجْنَأُ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ يَقِيهَا الْحِجَارَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna alyahuwda, jaa'uwa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakaruwa lahu aanna rajulaan minhum waamraaaaan zanayaa faqaala lahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa tajiduwna fiy alttawraaai fiy shaani alrrajmi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa nafdahuhum wayujladuwna‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu salaamin kadhabtum, iinna fiyhaa alrrajma‏.‏ faaatawa bialttawraaai fanasharuwhaa, fawada'a aahaduhum yadahu 'alaa ayaai alrrajmi, faqaraaa maa qablahaa wamaa ba'dahaa‏.‏ faqaala lahu 'abdu alllahi bnu salaamin arfa' yadaka‏.‏ farafa'a yadahu faiidhaa fiyhaa ayaau alrrajmi‏.‏ faqaaluwa sadaqa yaa muhammadu, fiyhaa ayaau alrrajmi‏.‏ faaamara bihimaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm farujimaa‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi faraaaytu alrrajula yajnaau 'alaa almaraaai yaqiyhaa alhijaaraaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Jews came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him that a man and a woman from amongst them had committed illegal sexual intercourse. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them, "What do you find in the Torah (old Testament) about the legal punishment of Ar-Rajm (stoning)?" They replied, (But) we announce their crime and lash them." `Abdullah bin Salam said, "You are telling a lie; Torah contains the order of Rajm." They brought and opened the Torah and one of them placed his hand on the Verse of Rajm and read the verses preceding and following it. `Abdullah bin Salam said to him, "Lift your hand." When he lifted his hand, the Verse of Rajm was written there. They said, "Muhammad has told the truth; the Torah has the Verse of Rajm. The Prophet (ﷺ) then gave the order that both of them should be stoned to death. (`Abdullah bin `Umar said, "I saw the man leaning over the woman to shelter her from the stones)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شِقَّتَيْنِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اشْهَدُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sadaqaau bnu alfadli, aakhbaranaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, 'an mujaahidin, 'an aabiy ma'marin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin rda allh 'nh qaala anshaqqa alqamaru 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shiqqatayni faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ashhaduwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:During the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) the moon was split into two parts and on that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Bear witness (to this)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ لِي خَلِيفَةُ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ مَكَّةَ سَأَلُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُرِيَهُمْ آيَةً، فَأَرَاهُمُ انْشِقَاقَ الْقَمَرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa yuwnusu, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, ‏.‏ waqaala liy khaliyfaau haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aannahu haddathahum aanna aahla makkaaa saaaluwa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuriyahum ayaaan, faaaraahumu anshiqaaqa alqamari‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:That the Meccan people requested Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to show them a miracle, and so he showed them the splitting of the moon
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي خَلَفُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الْقُرَشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ مُضَرَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ الْقَمَرَ، انْشَقَّ فِي زَمَانِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy khalafu bnu khaalidin alqurashiyyu, haddathanaa bakru bnu mudara, 'an ja'fari bni rabiy'aaa, 'an 'iraaki bni maalikin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna alqamara, anshaqqa fiy zamaani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The moon was split into two parts during the lifetime of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَا مِنْ عِنْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُظْلِمَةٍ وَمَعَهُمَا مِثْلُ الْمِصْبَاحَيْنِ، يُضِيآنِ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمَا، فَلَمَّا افْتَرَقَا صَارَ مَعَ كُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا وَاحِدٌ حَتَّى أَتَى أَهْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhun, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasun rda allh 'nh aanna rajulayni, min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm kharajaa min 'indi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy laylaain muzlimaain wama'ahumaa mithlu almisbaahayni, yudiyani bayna aaydiyhimaa, falammaa aftaraqaa saara ma'a kulli waahidin minhumaa waahidun hattaa aataa aahlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Once two men from the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out of the house of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a very dark night. They were accompanied by two things that resembled two lamps lighting the way in front of them, and when they parted, each of them was accompanied by one of those two things (lamps) till they reached their homes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، سَمِعْتُ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَزَالُ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي ظَاهِرِينَ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُمْ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَهُمْ ظَاهِرُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy alaaswadi, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa qaysun, sami'tu almughiyraaa bna shu'baaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yazaalu naasun min aummatiy zaahiriyna hattaa yaatiyahum aamru alllahi wahum zaahiruwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Some of my followers will remain victorious (and on the right path) till the Last Day comes, and they will still be victorious
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَيْرُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَزَالُ مِنْ أُمَّتِي أُمَّةٌ قَائِمَةٌ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ، لاَ يَضُرُّهُمْ مَنْ خَذَلَهُمْ وَلاَ مَنْ خَالَفَهُمْ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُمْ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَهُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَيْرٌ فَقَالَ مَالِكُ بْنُ يُخَامِرَ قَالَ مُعَاذٌ وَهُمْ بِالشَّأْمِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ هَذَا مَالِكٌ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعَاذًا يَقُولُ وَهُمْ بِالشَّامِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa alwaliydu, qaala haddathaniy abnu jaabirin, qaala haddathaniy 'umayru bnu haaniiin, aannahu sami'a mu'aawiyaaa, yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yazaalu min aummatiy aummaaun qaaiimaaun biaamri alllahi, laa yadurruhum man khadhalahum walaa man khaalafahum hattaa yaatiyahum aamru alllahi wahum 'alaa dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'umayrun faqaala maaliku bnu yukhaamira qaala mu'aadhun wahum bialshhaami‏.‏ faqaala mu'aawiyaau hadhaa maalikun yaz'umu aannahu sami'a mu'aadhana yaquwlu wahum bialshhaami‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muawiya:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "A group of people amongst my followers will remain obedient to Allah's orders and they will not be harmed by anyone who will not help them or who will oppose them, till Allah's Order (the Last Day) comes upon them while they are still on the right path
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 61 — Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبِيبُ بْنُ غَرْقَدَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَىَّ، يُحَدِّثُونَ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْطَاهُ دِينَارًا يَشْتَرِي بِهِ شَاةً، فَاشْتَرَى لَهُ بِهِ شَاتَيْنِ، فَبَاعَ إِحْدَاهُمَا بِدِينَارٍ وَجَاءَهُ بِدِينَارٍ وَشَاةٍ، فَدَعَا لَهُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ فِي بَيْعِهِ، وَكَانَ لَوِ اشْتَرَى التُّرَابَ لَرَبِحَ فِيهِ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ كَانَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ جَاءَنَا بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ عَنْهُ، قَالَ سَمِعَهُ شَبِيبٌ مِنْ عُرْوَةَ، فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقَالَ شَبِيبٌ إِنِّي لَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ مِنْ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَىَّ يُخْبِرُونَهُ عَنْهُ‏.‏ وَلَكِنْ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الْخَيْرُ مَعْقُودٌ بِنَوَاصِي الْخَيْلِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ فِي دَارِهِ سَبْعِينَ فَرَسًا‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ يَشْتَرِي لَهُ شَاةً كَأَنَّهَا أُضْحِيَّةٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa shabiybu bnu gharqadaaa, qaala sami'tu alhaaaa, yuhaddithuwna 'an 'urwaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aa'taahu diynaarana yashtariy bihi shaaaan, faashtaraa lahu bihi shaatayni, fabaa'a iihdaahumaa bidiynaarin wajaa'ahu bidiynaarin washaaain, fada'aa lahu bialbarakaai fiy bay'ihi, wakaana lawi ashtaraa altturaaba larabiha fiyhi‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu kaana alhasanu bnu 'umaaraaa jaa'anaa bihadhaa alhadiythi 'anhu, qaala sami'ahu shabiybun min 'urwaaa, faaataytuhu faqaala shabiybun iinniy lam aasma'hu min 'urwaaa, qaala sami'tu alhaaaa yukhbiruwnahu 'anhu‏.‏ walakin sami'tuhu yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alkhayru ma'quwdun binawaasiy alkhayli iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala waqad raaaytu fiy daarihi sab'iyna farasana‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu yashtariy lahu shaaaan kaaannahaa audhiyyaaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa:That the Prophet (ﷺ) gave him one Dinar so as to buy a sheep for him. `Urwa bought two sheep for him with the money. Then he sold one of the sheep for one Dinar, and brought one Dinar and a sheep to the Prophet. On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah to bless him in his deals. So `Urwa used to gain (from any deal) even if he bought dust. (In another narration) `Urwa said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "There is always goodness in horses till the Day of Resurrection."
