verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، جَاءَ إِلَى سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ فَقَالَ هَذَا فُلاَنٌ ـ لأَمِيرِ الْمَدِينَةِ ـ يَدْعُو عَلِيًّا عِنْدَ الْمِنْبَرِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَا قَالَ يَقُولُ لَهُ أَبُو تُرَابٍ‏.‏ فَضَحِكَ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا سَمَّاهُ إِلاَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَمَا كَانَ لَهُ اسْمٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْهُ‏.‏ فَاسْتَطْعَمْتُ الْحَدِيثَ سَهْلاً، وَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا عَبَّاسٍ كَيْفَ قَالَ دَخَلَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَاضْطَجَعَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَيْنَ ابْنُ عَمِّكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِ فَوَجَدَ رِدَاءَهُ قَدْ سَقَطَ عَنْ ظَهْرِهِ، وَخَلَصَ التُّرَابُ إِلَى ظَهْرِهِ، فَجَعَلَ يَمْسَحُ التُّرَابَ عَنْ ظَهْرِهِ فَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ اجْلِسْ يَا أَبَا تُرَابٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rajulaan, jaa'a iilaa sahli bni sa'din faqaala hadhaa fulaanun laamiyri almadiynaai yad'uw 'aliyyana 'inda alminbari‏.‏ qaala fayaquwlu maadhaa qaala yaquwlu lahu aabuw turaabin‏.‏ fadahika qaala waalllahi maa sammaahu iilaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm, wamaa kaana lahu asmun aahabba iilayhi minhu‏.‏ faastat'amtu alhadiytha sahlaan, waqultu yaa aabaa 'abbaasin kayfa qaala dakhala 'aliyyun 'alaa faatimaaa thumma kharaja faadtaja'a fiy almasjidi, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aayna abnu 'ammiki ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat fiy almasjidi‏.‏ fakharaja iilayhi fawajada ridaa'ahu qad saqata 'an zahrihi, wakhalasa altturaabu iilaa zahrihi, faja'ala yamsahu altturaaba 'an zahrihi fayaquwlu ‏"‏ ajlis yaa aabaa turaabin ‏"‏‏.‏ marratayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Hazim:A man came to Sahl bin Sa`d and said, "This is so-and-so," meaning the Governor of Medina, "He is calling `Ali bad names near the pulpit." Sahl asked, "What is he saying?" He (i.e. the man) replied, "He calls him (i.e. `Ali) Abu Turab." Sahl laughed and said, "By Allah, none but the Prophet (ﷺ) called him by this name and no name was dearer to `Ali than this." So I asked Sahl to tell me more, saying, "O Abu `Abbas! How (was this name given to `Ali)?" Sahl said, "`Ali went to Fatima and then came out and slept in the Mosque. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked Fatima, "Where is your cousin?" She said, "In the Mosque." The Prophet (ﷺ) went to him and found that his (i.e. `Ali's) covering sheet had slipped off his back and dust had soiled his back. The Prophet (ﷺ) started wiping the dust off his back and said twice, "Get up! O Abu Turab (i.e. O. man with the dust)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ، فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ،، فَذَكَرَ عَنْ مَحَاسِنِ، عَمَلِهِ، قَالَ لَعَلَّ ذَاكَ يَسُوؤُكَ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَرْغَمَ اللَّهُ بِأَنْفِكَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، فَذَكَرَ مَحَاسِنَ عَمَلِهِ قَالَ هُوَ ذَاكَ، بَيْتُهُ أَوْسَطُ بُيُوتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَعَلَّ ذَاكَ يَسُوؤُكَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَجَلْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَرْغَمَ اللَّهُ بِأَنْفِكَ، انْطَلِقْ فَاجْهَدْ عَلَىَّ جَهْدَكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa husaynun, 'an zaaiidaaa, 'an aabiy hasiynin, 'an sa'di bni 'ubaydaaa, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa abni 'umara, fasaaalahu 'an 'uthmaana, , fadhakara 'an mahaasini, 'amalihi, qaala la'alla dhaaka yasuwuuka‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala faaarghama alllahu biaanfika‏.‏ thumma saaalahu 'an 'aliyyin, fadhakara mahaasina 'amalihi qaala huwa dhaaka, baytuhu aawsatu buyuwti alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ thumma qaala la'alla dhaaka yasuwuuka‏.‏ qaala aajal‏.‏ qaala faaarghama alllahu biaanfika, antaliq faajhad 'alaaaa jahdaka‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d bin 'Ubaida:A man came to Ibn `Umar and asked about `Uthman and Ibn `Umar mentioned his good deeds and said to the questioner. "Perhaps these facts annoy you?" The other said, "Yes." Ibn `Umar said, "May Allah stick your nose in the dust (i.e. degrade you)!' Then the man asked him about `Ali. Ibn `Umar mentioned his good deeds and said, "It is all true, and that is his house in the midst of the houses of the Prophet. Perhaps these facts have hurt you?" The questioner said, "Yes." Ibn `Umar said, "May Allah stick your nose in the dust (i.e. degrade you or make you do things which you hate) ! Go away and do whatever you can against me
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ، عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ شَكَتْ مَا تَلْقَى مِنْ أَثَرِ الرَّحَا، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَبْىٌ، فَانْطَلَقَتْ فَلَمْ تَجِدْهُ، فَوَجَدَتْ عَائِشَةَ، فَأَخْبَرَتْهَا، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَائِشَةُ بِمَجِيءِ فَاطِمَةَ، فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْنَا، وَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مَضَاجِعَنَا، فَذَهَبْتُ لأَقُومَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَلَى مَكَانِكُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَعَدَ بَيْنَنَا حَتَّى وَجَدْتُ بَرْدَ قَدَمَيْهِ عَلَى صَدْرِي وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُعَلِّمُكُمَا خَيْرًا مِمَّا سَأَلْتُمَانِي إِذَا أَخَذْتُمَا مَضَاجِعَكُمَا تُكَبِّرَا أَرْبَعًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَتُسَبِّحَا ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَتَحْمَدَا ثَلاَثَةً وَثَلاَثِينَ، فَهْوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمَا مِنْ خَادِمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, sami'tu abna aabiy laylaa, qaala haddathanaa 'aliyyun, aanna faatimaaa, 'alayhaa alssalaamu shakat maa talqaa min aathari alrrahaa, faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sabaun, faantalaqat falam tajidhu, fawajadat 'aaiishaaa, faaakhbarathaa, falammaa jaa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathu 'aaiishaau bimajiy'i faatimaaa, fajaa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaynaa, waqad aakhadhnaa madaaji'anaa, fadhahabtu laaquwma faqaala ‏"‏ 'alaa makaanikumaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqa'ada baynanaa hattaa wajadtu barda qadamayhi 'alaa sadriy waqaala ‏"‏ aalaa au'allimukumaa khayrana mimmaa saaaltumaaniy iidhaa aakhadhtumaa madaaji'akumaa tukabbiraa aarba'ana wathalaathiyna, watusabbihaa thalaathana wathalaathiyna, watahmadaa thalaathaaan wathalaathiyna, fahwa khayrun lakumaa min khaadimin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:Fatima complained of the suffering caused to her by the hand mill. Some Captives were brought to the Prophet, so she came to him but did not find him at home. `Aisha was present there to whom she told (of her desire for a servant). When the Prophet (ﷺ) came, Aisha informed him about Fatima's visit. `Ali added "So the Prophet (ﷺ) came to us, while we had gone to our bed. I wanted to get up but the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Remain at your place". Then he sat down between us till I found the coolness of his feet on my chest. Then he said, "Shall I teach you a thing which is better than what you have asked me? When you go to bed, say, 'Allahu-Akbar' thirty-four times, and 'Subhan Allah thirty-three times, and 'Al hamdu-li l-lah thirty-three times for that is better for you both than a servant
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِعَلِيٍّ ‏ "‏ أَمَا تَرْضَى أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'din, qaala sami'tu iibraahiyma bna sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm li'aliyyin ‏ "‏ aamaa tardaa aan takuwna minniy bimanzilaai haaruwna min muwsaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: And narrated Sad that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to 'Ali, "Will you not be pleased from this that you are to me like Aaron was to Moses?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْجَعْدِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ اقْضُوا كَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَقْضُونَ، فَإِنِّي أَكْرَهُ الاِخْتِلاَفَ حَتَّى يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ جَمَاعَةٌ، أَوْ أَمُوتَ كَمَا مَاتَ أَصْحَابِي‏.‏ فَكَانَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ يَرَى أَنَّ عَامَّةَ مَا يُرْوَى عَلَى عَلِيٍّ الْكَذِبُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu alja'di, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an aayyuwba, 'ani abni siyriyna, 'an 'abiydaaa, 'an 'aliyyin rda allh 'nh qaala aqduwa kamaa kuntum taqduwna, faiinniy aakrahu alaikhtilaafa hattaa yakuwna lilnnaasi jamaa'aaun, aaw aamuwta kamaa maata aashaabiy‏.‏ fakaana abnu siyriyna yaraa aanna 'aammaaa maa yurwaa 'alaa 'aliyyin alkadhibu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ubaida: Ali said (to the people of 'Iraq), "Judge as you used to judge, for I hate differences (and I do my best ) till the people unite as one group, or I die as my companions have died
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ دِينَارٍ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجُهَنِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّاسَ، كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ أَكْثَرَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ‏.‏ وَإِنِّي كُنْتُ أَلْزَمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشِبَعِ بَطْنِي، حَتَّى لاَ آكُلُ الْخَمِيرَ، وَلاَ أَلْبَسُ الْحَبِيرَ، وَلاَ يَخْدُمُنِي فُلاَنٌ وَلاَ فُلاَنَةُ، وَكُنْتُ أُلْصِقُ بَطْنِي بِالْحَصْبَاءِ مِنَ الْجُوعِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لأَسْتَقْرِئُ الرَّجُلَ الآيَةَ هِيَ مَعِي كَىْ يَنْقَلِبَ بِي فَيُطْعِمَنِي، وَكَانَ أَخْيَرَ النَّاسِ لِلْمِسْكِينِ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، كَانَ يَنْقَلِبُ بِنَا فَيُطْعِمُنَا مَا كَانَ فِي بَيْتِهِ، حَتَّى إِنْ كَانَ لَيُخْرِجُ إِلَيْنَا الْعُكَّةَ الَّتِي لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَىْءٌ، فَنَشُقُّهَا فَنَلْعَقُ مَا فِيهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu aabiy bakrin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu iibraahiyma bni diynaarin aabuw 'abdi alllahi aljuhaniyyu, 'ani abni aabiy dhiibin, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna alnnaasa, kaanuwa yaquwluwna aakthara aabuw hurayraaa‏.‏ waiinniy kuntu aalzamu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bishiba'i batniy, hattaa laa akulu alkhamiyra, walaa aalbasu alhabiyra, walaa yakhdumuniy fulaanun walaa fulaanaau, wakuntu aulsiqu batniy bialhasbaa'i mina aljuw'i, waiin kuntu laastaqriiu alrrajula alayaaa hiya ma'iy kaa yanqaliba biy fayut'imaniy, wakaana aakhyara alnnaasi lilmiskiyni ja'faru bnu aabiy taalibin, kaana yanqalibu binaa fayut'imunaa maa kaana fiy baytihi, hattaa iin kaana layukhriju iilaynaa al'ukkaaa allatiy laysa fiyhaa shaa'un, fanashuqquhaa fanal'aqu maa fiyhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The people used to say, "Abu Huraira narrates too many narrations." In fact I used to keep close to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and was satisfied with what filled my stomach. I ate no leavened bread and dressed no decorated striped clothes, and never did a man or a woman serve me, and I often used to press my belly against gravel because of hunger, and I used to ask a man to recite a Qur'anic Verse to me although I knew it, so that he would take me to his home and feed me. And the most generous of all the people to the poor was Ja`far bin Abi Talib. He used to take us to his home and offer us what was available therein. He would even offer us an empty folded leather container (of butter) which we would split and lick whatever was in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانَ إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَى ابْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ ذِي الْجَنَاحَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa iismaa'iylu bnu aabiy khaalidin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, aanna abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma kaana iidhaa sallama 'alaa abni ja'farin qaala alssalaamu 'alayka yaa abna dhiy aljanaahayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ash-Shu`bi:Whenever Ibn `Umar greeted Ibn Jafar, he used to say: "As-salamu-'Alaika (i.e. Peace be on you) O son of Dhu-l-Janahain (son of the two-winged person)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، كَانَ إِذَا قَحَطُوا اسْتَسْقَى بِالْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ بِنَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَسْقِينَا، وَإِنَّا نَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ بِعَمِّ نَبِيِّنَا فَاسْقِنَا‏.‏ قَالَ فَيُسْقَوْنَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyu, haddathaniy aabiy 'abdu alllahi bnu almuthannaa, 'an thumaamaaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aanasin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, kaana iidhaa qahatuwa astasqaa bial'abbaasi bni 'abdi almuttalibi, faqaala alllahumma iinnaa kunnaa natawassalu iilayka binabiyyinaa sla allh 'lyh wslm fatasqiynaa, waiinnaa natawassalu iilayka bi'ammi nabiyyinaa faasqinaa‏.‏ qaala fayusqawna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Whenever there was drought, `Umar bin Al-Khattab used to ask Allah for rain through Al-`Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib, saying, "O Allah! We used to request our Prophet to ask You for rain, and You would give us. Now we request the uncle of our Prophet to ask You for rain, so give us rain." And they would be given rain
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ تَسْأَلُهُ مِيرَاثَهَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، تَطْلُبُ صَدَقَةَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّتِي بِالْمَدِينَةِ وَفَدَكٍ وَمَا بَقِيَ مِنْ خُمُسِ خَيْبَرَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ نُورَثُ، مَا تَرَكْنَا فَهْوَ صَدَقَةٌ، إِنَّمَا يَأْكُلُ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ مِنْ هَذَا الْمَالِ ـ يَعْنِي مَالَ اللَّهِ ـ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ أَنْ يَزِيدُوا عَلَى الْمَأْكَلِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لاَ أُغَيِّرُ شَيْئًا مِنْ صَدَقَاتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّتِي كَانَتْ عَلَيْهَا فِي عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَلأَعْمَلَنَّ فِيهَا بِمَا عَمِلَ فِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَتَشَهَّدَ عَلِيٌّ، ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّا قَدْ عَرَفْنَا يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَضِيلَتَكَ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ قَرَابَتَهُمْ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَقَّهُمْ‏.‏ فَتَكَلَّمَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لَقَرَابَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ أَنْ أَصِلَ مِنْ قَرَابَتِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna faatimaaa 'alayhaa alssalaamu aarsalat iilaa aabiy bakrin tasaaluhu miyraathahaa mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiymaa aafaa'a alllahu 'alaa rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm, tatlubu sadaqaaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm allatiy bialmadiynaai wafadakin wamaa baqiya min khumusi khaybara‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa nuwrathu, maa taraknaa fahwa sadaqaaun, iinnamaa yaakulu alu muhammadin min hadhaa almaali ya'niy maala alllahi laysa lahum aan yaziyduwa 'alaa almaakali ‏"‏‏.‏ waiinniy waalllahi laa aughayyiru shayiana min sadaqaati alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm allatiy kaanat 'alayhaa fiy 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, walaa'malanna fiyhaa bimaa 'amila fiyhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ fatashahhada 'aliyyun, thumma qaala iinnaa qad 'arafnaa yaa aabaa bakrin fadiylataka‏.‏ wadhakara qaraabatahum min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaqqahum‏.‏ fatakallama aabuw bakrin faqaala waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi, laqaraabaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahabbu iilaaaa aan aasila min qaraabatiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Aisha: Fatima sent somebody to Abu Bakr asking him to give her her inheritance from the Prophet (ﷺ) from what Allah had given to His Apostle through Fai (i.e. booty gained without fighting). She asked for the Sadaqa (i.e. wealth assigned for charitable purposes) of the Prophet (ﷺ) at Medina, and Fadak, and what remained of the Khumus (i.e., one-fifth) of the Khaibar booty. Abu Bakr said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'We (Prophets), our property is not inherited, and whatever we leave is Sadaqa, but Muhammad's Family can eat from this property, i.e. Allah's property, but they have no right to take more than the food they need.' By Allah! I will not bring any change in dealing with the Sadaqa of the Prophet (and will keep them) as they used to be observed in his (i.e. the Prophet's) life-time, and I will dispose with it as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do," Then 'Ali said, "I testify that None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and that Muhammad is His Apostle," and added, "O Abu Bakr! We acknowledge your superiority." Then he (i.e. 'Ali) mentioned their own relationship to Allah's Apostle and their right. Abu Bakr then spoke saying, "By Allah in Whose Hands my life is. I love to do good to the relatives of Allah's Apostle rather than to my own relatives
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ وَاقِدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ قَالَ ارْقُبُوا مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alwahhaabi, haddathanaa khaalidun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an waaqidin, qaala sami'tu aabiy yuhaddithu, 'ani abni 'umara, 'an aabiy bakrin rda allh 'nhm qaala arqubuwa muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy aahli baytihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakr said: Look at Muhammad through his family (i.e. if you are no good to his family you are not good to him)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَاطِمَةُ بَضْعَةٌ مِنِّي، فَمَنْ أَغْضَبَهَا أَغْضَبَنِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, 'ani almiswari bni makhramaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ faatimaau bad'aaun minniy, faman aaghdabahaa aaghdabaniy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Fatima is a part of me, and he who makes her angry, makes me angry
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ دَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاطِمَةَ ابْنَتَهُ فِي شَكْوَاهُ الَّذِي قُبِضَ فِيهَا، فَسَارَّهَا بِشَىْءٍ فَبَكَتْ، ثُمَّ دَعَاهَا فَسَارَّهَا فَضَحِكَتْ، قَالَتْ فَسَأَلْتُهَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ سَارَّنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّهُ يُقْبَضُ فِي وَجَعِهِ الَّذِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهِ فَبَكَيْتُ، ثُمَّ سَارَّنِي فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنِّي أَوَّلُ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ أَتْبَعُهُ فَضَحِكْتُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat da'aa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faatimaaa abnatahu fiy shakwaahu alladhiy qubida fiyhaa, fasaarrahaa bishaa'in fabakat, thumma da'aahaa fasaarrahaa fadahikat, qaalat fasaaaltuhaa 'an dhalika‏.‏ faqaalat saarraniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbaraniy aannahu yuqbadu fiy waja'ihi alladhiy tuwuffiya fiyhi fabakaytu, thumma saarraniy faaakhbaraniy aanniy aawwalu aahli baytihi aatba'uhu fadahiktu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) called his daughter Fatima during his illness in which he died, and told her a secret whereupon she wept. Then he called her again and told her a secret whereupon she laughed. When I asked her about that, she replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) spoke to me in secret and informed me that he would die in the course of the illness during which he died, so I wept. He again spoke to me in secret and informed me that I would be the first of his family to follow him (after his death) and on that I laughed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَرْوَانُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ أَصَابَ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ رُعَافٌ شَدِيدٌ سَنَةَ الرُّعَافِ، حَتَّى حَبَسَهُ عَنِ الْحَجِّ وَأَوْصَى، فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ قَالَ اسْتَخْلِفْ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالُوهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَنْ فَسَكَتَ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ ـ أَحْسِبُهُ الْحَارِثَ ـ فَقَالَ اسْتَخْلِفْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ وَقَالُوا فَقَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَنْ هُوَ فَسَكَتَ قَالَ فَلَعَلَّهُمْ قَالُوا الزُّبَيْرَ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ أَمَا وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنَّهُ لَخَيْرُهُمْ مَا عَلِمْتُ، وَإِنْ كَانَ لأَحَبَّهُمْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala aakhbaraniy marwaanu bnu alhakami, qaala aasaaba 'uthmaana bna 'affaana ru'aafun shadiydun sanaaa alrru'aafi, hattaa habasahu 'ani alhajji waaawsaa, fadakhala 'alayhi rajulun min qurayshin qaala astakhlif‏.‏ qaala waqaaluwhu qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala waman fasakata, fadakhala 'alayhi rajulun akharu aahsibuhu alhaaritha faqaala astakhlif‏.‏ faqaala 'uthmaanu waqaaluwa faqaala na'am‏.‏ qaala waman huwa fasakata qaala fala'allahum qaaluwa alzzubayra qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala aamaa waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi iinnahu lakhayruhum maa 'alimtu, waiin kaana laahabbahum iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Marwan bin Al-Hakam:`Uthman bin `Affan was afflicted with severe nose-bleeding in the year when such illness was prevelant and that prevented him from performing Hajj, and (because of it) he made his will. A man from Quraish came to him and said, "Appoint your successor." `Uthman asked, "Did the people name him? (i.e. the successor) the man said, "Yes." `Uthman asked, "Who is that?" The man remained silent. Another man came to `Uthman and I think it was Al-Harith. He also said, "Appoint your successor." `Uthman asked, "Did the people name him?" The man replied "Yes." `Uthman said, "Who is that?" The man remained silent. `Uthman said, "Perhaps they have mentioned Az-Zubair?" The man said, "Yes." `Uthman said, "By Him in Whose Hands my life is, he is the best of them as I know, and the dearest of them to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، سَمِعْتُ مَرْوَانَ، كُنْتُ عِنْدَ عُثْمَانَ، أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ اسْتَخْلِفْ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقِيلَ ذَاكَ قَالَ نَعَمْ، الزُّبَيْرُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ خَيْرُكُمْ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, aakhbaraniy aabiy, sami'tu marwaana, kuntu 'inda 'uthmaana, aataahu rajulun faqaala astakhlif‏.‏ qaala waqiyla dhaaka qaala na'am, alzzubayru‏.‏ qaala aamaa waalllahi iinnakum lata'lamuwna aannahu khayrukum‏.‏ thalaathana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Marwan bin Al-Hakam:While I was with `Uthman, a man came to him and said, "Appoint your successor." `Uthman said, "Has such successor been named?" He replied, "Yes, Az-Zubair." `Uthman said, thrice, "By Allah! Indeed you know that he is the best of you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ـ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ حَوَارِيًّا، وَإِنَّ حَوَارِيَّ الزُّبَيْرُ بْنُ الْعَوَّامِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi huwa abnu aabiy salamaaa 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an jaabirin rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna likulli nabiyyin hawaariyyana, waiinna hawaariyya alzzubayru bnu al'awwaami ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every prophet used to have a Hawari (i.e. disciple), and my Hawari is Az-Zubair bin Al-`Awwam
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ‏{‏عَبْدُ اللَّهِ‏}‏ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ يَوْمَ الأَحْزَابِ جُعِلْتُ أَنَا وَعُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، فِي النِّسَاءِ، فَنَظَرْتُ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِالزُّبَيْرِ، عَلَى فَرَسِهِ، يَخْتَلِفُ إِلَى بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا، فَلَمَّا رَجَعْتُ قُلْتُ يَا أَبَتِ، رَأَيْتُكَ تَخْتَلِفُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَوَهَلْ رَأَيْتَنِي يَا بُنَىَّ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ يَأْتِ بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ فَيَأْتِينِي بِخَبَرِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْتُ، فَلَمَّا رَجَعْتُ جَمَعَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَوَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ فِدَاكَ أَبِي وَأُمِّي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu muhammadin, aakhbaranaa ‏{‏'abdu alllahi‏}‏ aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, qaala kuntu yawma alaahzaabi ju'iltu aanaa wa'umaru bnu aabiy salamaaa, fiy alnnisaa'i, fanazartu faiidhaa aanaa bialzzubayri, 'alaa farasihi, yakhtalifu iilaa baniy qurayzaaa marratayni aaw thalaathana, falammaa raja'tu qultu yaa aabati, raaaytuka takhtalifu‏.‏ qaala aawahal raaaytaniy yaa bunaaaa qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man yaati baniy qurayzaaa fayaatiyniy bikhabarihim ‏"‏‏.‏ faantalaqtu, falammaa raja'tu jama'a liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aabawayhi faqaala ‏"‏ fidaaka aabiy waaummiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair:During the battle of Al-Ahzab, I and `Umar bin Abi-Salama were kept behind with the women. Behold! I saw (my father) Az-Zubair riding his horse, going to and coming from Bani Quraiza twice or thrice. So when I came back I said, "O my father! I saw you going to and coming from Bani Quraiza?" He said, "Did you really see me, O my son?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Who will go to Bani Quraiza and bring me their news?' So I went, and when I came back, Allah's Apostle mentioned for me both his parents saying, "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالُوا لِلزُّبَيْرِ يَوْمَ الْيَرْمُوكِ أَلاَ تَشُدُّ فَنَشُدَّ مَعَكَ فَحَمَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَضَرَبُوهُ ضَرْبَتَيْنِ عَلَى عَاتِقِهِ، بَيْنَهُمَا ضَرْبَةٌ ضُرِبَهَا يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ فَكُنْتُ أُدْخِلُ أَصَابِعِي فِي تِلْكَ الضَّرَبَاتِ أَلْعَبُ وَأَنَا صَغِيرٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hafsin, haddathanaa abnu almubaaraki, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna aashaaba alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaluwa lilzzubayri yawma alyarmuwki aalaa tashuddu fanashudda ma'aka fahamala 'alayhim, fadarabuwhu darbatayni 'alaa 'aatiqihi, baynahumaa darbaaun duribahaa yawma badrin‏.‏ qaala 'urwaau fakuntu audkhilu aasaabi'iy fiy tilka alddarabaati aal'abu waaanaa saghiyrun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa:On the day of the battle of Al-Yarmuk, the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said to Az-Zubair, "Will you attack the enemy vigorously so that we may attack them along with you?" So Az-Zubair attacked them, and they inflicted two wounds over his shoulder, and in between these two wounds there was an old scar he had received on the day of the battle of Badr When I was a child, I used to insert my fingers into those scars in play
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ لَمْ يَبْقَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ تِلْكَ الأَيَّامِ الَّتِي قَاتَلَ فِيهِنَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرُ طَلْحَةَ وَسَعْدٍ‏.‏ عَنْ حَدِيثِهِمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, qaala lam yabqa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ba'di tilka alaayyaami allatiy qaatala fiyhinna rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghayru talhaaa wasa'din‏.‏ 'an hadiythihimaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu `Uthman:During one of the Ghazawat in which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was fighting, none remained with the Prophet (ﷺ) but Talha and Sa`d
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ،، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ يَدَ طَلْحَةَ الَّتِي وَقَى بِهَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ شَلَّتْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa khaalidun, haddathanaa abnu aabiy khaalidin, 'an qaysi bni aabiy haazimin, , qaala raaaytu yada talhaaa allatiy waqaa bihaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qad shallat‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qais bin Abi Hazim:I saw Talha's paralyzed hand with which he had protected the Prophet (from an arrow)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدًا، يَقُولُ جَمَعَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَوَيْهِ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, qaala sami'tu yahyaa, qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, qaala sami'tu sa'dana, yaquwlu jama'a liy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aabawayhi yawma auhudin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d:On the day of the battle of Uhud the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned for me both his parents (i.e. saying, "Let my parents be sacrificed for you)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي وَأَنَا ثُلُثُ الإِسْلاَمِ،‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa makkiyyu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa haashimu bnu haashimin, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala laqad raaaytuniy waaanaa thuluthu aliislaami, ‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d:No doubt, (for some time) I stood for one-third of the Muslims
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ هَاشِمِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، يَقُولُ مَا أَسْلَمَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ فِي الْيَوْمِ الَّذِي أَسْلَمْتُ فِيهِ، وَلَقَدْ مَكَثْتُ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ وَإِنِّي لَثُلُثُ الإِسْلاَمِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ أَبُو أُسَامَةَ حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, haddathanaa haashimu bnu haashimi bni 'utbaaa bni aabiy waqqaasin, qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, yaquwlu sami'tu sa'da bna aabiy waqqaasin, yaquwlu maa aaslama aahadun iilaaa fiy alyawmi alladhiy aaslamtu fiyhi, walaqad makathtu sab'aaa aayyaamin waiinniy lathuluthu aliislaami‏.‏ taaba'ahu aabuw ausaamaaa haddathanaa haashimun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:No man embraced Islam before the day on which I embraced Islam, and no doubt, I remained for seven days as one third of the then extant Muslims
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ إِنِّي لأَوَّلُ الْعَرَبِ رَمَى بِسَهْمٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، وَكُنَّا نَغْزُو مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَا لَنَا طَعَامٌ إِلاَّ وَرَقُ الشَّجَرِ، حَتَّى إِنَّ أَحَدَنَا لَيَضَعُ كَمَا يَضَعُ الْبَعِيرُ أَوِ الشَّاةُ، مَا لَهُ خِلْطٌ، ثُمَّ أَصْبَحَتْ بَنُو أَسَدٍ تُعَزِّرُنِي عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ، لَقَدْ خِبْتُ إِذًا وَضَلَّ عَمَلِي‏.‏ وَكَانُوا وَشَوْا بِهِ إِلَى عُمَرَ، قَالُوا لاَ يُحْسِنُ يُصَلِّي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'awnin, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an iismaa'iyla, 'an qaysin, qaala sami'tu sa'dana rda allh 'nh yaquwlu iinniy laawwalu al'arabi ramaa bisahmin fiy sabiyli alllahi, wakunnaa naghzuw ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wamaa lanaa ta'aamun iilaaa waraqu alshhajari, hattaa iinna aahadanaa layada'u kamaa yada'u alba'iyru aawi alshhaaau, maa lahu khiltun, thumma aasbahat banuw aasadin tu'azziruniy 'alaa aliislaami, laqad khibtu iidhana wadalla 'amaliy‏.‏ wakaanuwa washawa bihi iilaa 'umara, qaaluwa laa yuhsinu yusalliy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qais:I heard Sa`d saying, "I was the first amongst the 'Arabs who shot an arrow for Allah's Cause. We used to fight along with the Prophet, while we had nothing to eat except the leaves of trees so that one's excrete would look like the excrete balls of camel or a sheep, containing nothing to mix them together. Today Banu Asad tribe blame me for not having understood Islam. I would be a loser if my deeds were in vain." Those people complained about Sa`d to `Umar, claiming that he did not offer his prayers perfectly
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ، أَنَّ الْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، قَالَ إِنَّ عَلِيًّا خَطَبَ بِنْتَ أَبِي جَهْلٍ، فَسَمِعَتْ بِذَلِكَ، فَاطِمَةُ، فَأَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَزْعُمُ قَوْمُكَ أَنَّكَ لاَ تَغْضَبُ لِبَنَاتِكَ، هَذَا عَلِيٌّ نَاكِحٌ بِنْتَ أَبِي جَهْلٍ، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَمِعْتُهُ حِينَ تَشَهَّدَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ أَنْكَحْتُ أَبَا الْعَاصِ بْنَ الرَّبِيعِ، فَحَدَّثَنِي وَصَدَقَنِي، وَإِنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بَضْعَةٌ مِنِّي، وَإِنِّي أَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَسُوءَهَا، وَاللَّهِ لاَ تَجْتَمِعُ بِنْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِنْتُ عَدُوِّ اللَّهِ عِنْدَ رَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَتَرَكَ عَلِيٌّ الْخِطْبَةَ‏.‏ وَزَادَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَلْحَلَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ مِسْوَرٍ، سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَذَكَرَ صِهْرًا لَهُ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ شَمْسٍ فَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ فِي مُصَاهَرَتِهِ إِيَّاهُ فَأَحْسَنَ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَدَّثَنِي فَصَدَقَنِي، وَوَعَدَنِي فَوَفَى لِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu husaynin, aanna almiswara bna makhramaaa, qaala iinna 'aliyyana khataba binta aabiy jahlin, fasami'at bidhalika, faatimaau, faaatat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaz'umu qawmuka aannaka laa taghdabu libanaatika, hadhaa 'aliyyun naakihun binta aabiy jahlin, faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasami'tuhu hiyna tashahhada yaquwlu ‏"‏ aammaa ba'du aankahtu aabaa al'aasi bna alrrabiy'i, fahaddathaniy wasadaqaniy, waiinna faatimaaa bad'aaun minniy, waiinniy aakrahu aan yasuw'ahaa, waalllahi laa tajtami'u bintu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wabintu 'aduwwi alllahi 'inda rajulin waahidin ‏"‏‏.‏ fataraka 'aliyyun alkhitbaaa‏.‏ wazaada muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni halhalaaa 'ani abni shihaabin 'an 'aliyyin 'an miswarin, sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wadhakara sihrana lahu min baniy 'abdi shamsin faaathnaa 'alayhi fiy musaaharatihi iiyyaahu faaahsana qaala ‏"‏ haddathaniy fasadaqaniy, wawa'adaniy fawafaa liy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:`Ali demanded the hand of the daughter of Abu Jahl. Fatima heard of this and went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Your people think that you do not become angry for the sake of your daughters as `Ali is now going to marry the daughter of Abu Jahl. "On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up and after his recitation of Tashah-hud. I heard him saying, "Then after! I married one of my daughters to Abu Al-`As bin Al- Rabi` (the husband of Zainab, the daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) before Islam and he proved truthful in whatever he said to me. No doubt, Fatima is a part of me, I hate to see her being troubled. By Allah, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the daughter of Allah's Enemy cannot be the wives of one man." So `Ali gave up that engagement. 'Al-Miswar further said: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) talking and he mentioned a son-in-law of his belonging to the tribe of Bani `Abd-Shams. He highly praised him concerning that relationship and said (whenever) he spoke to me, he spoke the truth, and whenever he promised me, he fulfilled his promise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْثًا، وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمْ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، فَطَعَنَ بَعْضُ النَّاسِ فِي إِمَارَتِهِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنْ تَطْعُنُوا فِي إِمَارَتِهِ فَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ تَطْعُنُونَ فِي إِمَارَةِ أَبِيهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ، إِنْ كَانَ لَخَلِيقًا لِلإِمَارَةِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ لَمِنْ أَحَبِّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ، وَإِنَّ هَذَا لَمِنْ أَحَبِّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ بَعْدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu diynaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala ba'atha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'thana, waaammara 'alayhim ausaamaaa bna zaydin, fata'ana ba'du alnnaasi fiy iimaaratihi, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iin tat'unuwa fiy iimaaratihi faqad kuntum tat'unuwna fiy iimaaraai aabiyhi min qablu, waaymu alllahi, iin kaana lakhaliyqana liliimaaraai, waiin kaana lamin aahabbi alnnaasi iilaaaa, waiinna hadhaa lamin aahabbi alnnaasi iilaaaa ba'dahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent an army under the command of Usama bin Zaid. When some people criticized his leadership, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you are criticizing Usama's leadership, you used to criticize his father's leadership before. By Allah! He was worthy of leadership and was one of the dearest persons to me, and (now) this (i.e. Usama) is one of the dearest to me after him (i.e. Zaid)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ قَائِفٌ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَاهِدٌ، وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ مُضْطَجِعَانِ، فَقَالَ إِنَّ هَذِهِ الأَقْدَامَ بَعْضُهَا مِنْ بَعْضٍ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسُرَّ بِذَلِكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَعْجَبَهُ، فَأَخْبَرَ بِهِ عَائِشَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat dakhala 'alaaaa qaaiifun waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm shaahidun, waausaamaau bnu zaydin wazaydu bnu haarithaaa mudtaji'aani, faqaala iinna hadhihi alaaqdaama ba'duhaa min ba'din‏.‏ qaala fasurra bidhalika alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waaa'jabahu, faaakhbara bihi 'aaiishaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa:Aisha said, "A Qaif (i.e. one skilled in recognizing the lineage of a person through Physiognomy and through examining the body parts of an infant) came to me while the Prophet (ﷺ) was present, and Usama bin Zaid and Zaid bin Haritha were Lying asleep. The Qa'if said. These feet (of Usama and his father) are of persons belonging to the same lineage.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) was pleased with that saying which won his admiration, and he told `Aisha of it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها أَنَّ قُرَيْشًا، أَهَمَّهُمْ شَأْنُ الْمَخْزُومِيَّةِ، فَقَالُوا مَنْ يَجْتَرِئُ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حِبُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, rda allh 'nha aanna qurayshana, aahammahum shaanu almakhzuwmiyyaai, faqaaluwa man yajtariiu 'alayhi iilaaa ausaamaau bnu zaydin, hibbu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Aisha: The people of the Quraish tribe were worried about the Makhzumiya woman. They said. "Nobody dare speak to him (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) except Usama bin Zaid as he is the most beloved to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ ذَهَبْتُ أَسْأَلُ الزُّهْرِيَّ عَنْ حَدِيثِ الْمَخْزُومِيَّةِ، فَصَاحَ بِي، قُلْتُ لِسُفْيَانَ فَلَمْ تَحْتَمِلْهُ عَنْ أَحَدٍ قَالَ وَجَدْتُهُ فِي كِتَابٍ كَانَ كَتَبَهُ أَيُّوبُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ بَنِي مَخْزُومٍ سَرَقَتْ، فَقَالُ��ا مَنْ يُكَلِّمُ فِيهَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَجْتَرِئْ أَحَدٌ أَنْ يُكَلِّمَهُ، فَكَلَّمَهُ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ كَانَ إِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الشَّرِيفُ تَرَكُوهُ، وَإِذَا سَرَقَ الضَّعِيفُ قَطَعُوهُ، لَوْ كَانَتْ فَاطِمَةُ لَقَطَعْتُ يَدَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala dhahabtu aasaalu alzzuhriyya 'an hadiythi almakhzuwmiyyaai, fasaaha biy, qultu lisufyaana falam tahtamilhu 'an aahadin qaala wajadtuhu fiy kitaabin kaana katabahu aayyuwbu bnu muwsaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an 'urwaaa 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna amraaaaan min baniy makhzuwmin saraqat, faqaalu��a man yukallimu fiyhaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm falam yajtarii aahadun aan yukallimahu, fakallamahu ausaamaau bnu zaydin, faqaala ‏ "‏ iinna baniy iisraaiiyla kaana iidhaa saraqa fiyhimu alshhariyfu tarakuwhu, waiidhaa saraqa aldda'iyfu qata'uwhu, law kaanat faatimaau laqata'tu yadahaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Aisha said, "A woman from Bani Makhzumiya committed a theft and the people said, 'Who can intercede with the Prophet (ﷺ) for her?' So nobody dared speak to him (i.e. the Prophet) but Usama bin Zaid spoke to him. The Prophet said, 'If a reputable man amongst the children of Bani Israel committed a theft, they used to forgive him, but if a poor man committed a theft, they would cut his hand. But I would cut even the hand of Fatima (i.e. the daughter of the Prophet) if she committed a theft
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبَّادٍ، يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمَاجِشُونُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ نَظَرَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَوْمًا وَهْوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ إِلَى رَجُلٍ يَسْحَبُ ثِيَابَهُ فِي نَاحِيَةٍ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ انْظُرْ مَنْ هَذَا لَيْتَ هَذَا عِنْدِي‏.‏ قَالَ لَهُ إِنْسَانٌ أَمَا تَعْرِفُ هَذَا يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ هَذَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ فَطَأْطَأَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ رَأْسَهُ، وَنَقَرَ بِيَدَيْهِ فِي الأَرْضِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَوْ رَآهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَحَبَّهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alhasanu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa aabuw 'abbaadin, yahyaa bnu 'abbaadin haddathanaa almaajishuwnu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu diynaarin, qaala nazara abnu 'umara yawmana wahwa fiy almasjidi iilaa rajulin yashabu thiyaabahu fiy naahiyaain mina almasjidi faqaala anzur man hadhaa layta hadhaa 'indiy‏.‏ qaala lahu iinsaanun aamaa ta'rifu hadhaa yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani hadhaa muhammadu bnu ausaamaaa, qaala fataataaa abnu 'umara raasahu, wanaqara biyadayhi fiy alaardi, thumma qaala law raahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laahabbahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:One day Ibn `Umar, while in the Mosque, looked at a man who was dragging his clothes while walking in one of the corners of the Mosque He said, "See who is that. I wish he was near to me." Somebody then said (to Ibn `Umar), "Don't you know him, O Abu `Abdur-Rahman? He is Muhammad bin Usama." On that Ibn `Umar bowed his head and dug the earth with his hands and then, said, "If Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him, he would have loved him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ حَدَّثَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَأْخُذُهُ وَالْحَسَنَ فَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَحِبَّهُمَا فَإِنِّي أُحِبُّهُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, qaala sami'tu aabiy, haddathanaa aabuw 'uthmaana, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin rda allh 'nhma haddatha 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu kaana yaakhudhuhu waalhasana fayaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma aahibbahumaa faiinniy auhibbuhumaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama bin Zaid: That the Prophet (ﷺ) used to take him (i.e. Usama) and Al-Hasan (in his lap) and say: "O Allah! Love them, as I love them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: وَقَالَ نُعَيْمٌ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَوْلًى، لأُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ‏.‏ أَنَّ الْحَجَّاجَ بْنَ أَيْمَنَ ابْنِ أُمِّ أَيْمَنَ،، وَكَانَ، أَيْمَنُ ابْنُ أُمِّ أَيْمَنَ أَخَا أُسَامَةَ لأُمِّهِ، وَهْوَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ، فَرَآهُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لَمْ يُتِمَّ رُكُوعَهُ وَلاَ سُجُودَهُ فَقَالَ أَعِدْ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala nu'aymun 'ani abni almubaaraki, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy mawlana, lausaamaaa bni zaydin‏.‏ aanna alhajjaaja bna aaymana abni aummi aaymana, , wakaana, aaymanu abnu aummi aaymana aakhaa ausaamaaa laummihi, wahwa rajulun mina alaansaari, faraahu abnu 'umara lam yutimma rukuw'ahu walaa sujuwdahu faqaala aa'id‏.‏
verses.translation: The freed slave of Usama bin Zaid said, "Al-Hajjaj bin Aiman bin Um Aiman and Aiman Ibn Um Aiman was Usama's brother from the maternal side, and he was one of the Ansar. He was seen by Ibn 'Umar not performing his bowing and prostrations in a perfect manner. So Ibn 'Umar told him to repeat his prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَحَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ نَمِرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ، مَوْلَى أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَنَّهُ بَيْنَمَا هُوَ مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ إِذْ دَخَلَ الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَيْمَنَ فَلَمْ يُتِمَّ رُكُوعَهُ وَلاَ سُجُودَهُ، فَقَالَ أَعِدْ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا وَلَّى قَالَ لِي ابْنُ عُمَرَ مَنْ هَذَا قُلْتُ الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَيْمَنَ ابْنِ أُمِّ أَيْمَنَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لَوْ رَأَى هَذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَحَبَّهُ، فَذَكَرَ حُبَّهُ وَمَا وَلَدَتْهُ أُمُّ أَيْمَنَ‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِي عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ وَكَانَتْ حَاضِنَةَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi wahaddathaniy sulaymaanu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, haddathanaa alwaliydu, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu namirin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, haddathaniy harmalaau, mawlaa ausaamaaa bni zaydin aannahu baynamaa huwa ma'a 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara iidh dakhala alhajjaaju bnu aaymana falam yutimma rukuw'ahu walaa sujuwdahu, faqaala aa'id‏.‏ falammaa wallaa qaala liy abnu 'umara man hadhaa qultu alhajjaaju bnu aaymana abni aummi aaymana‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'umara law raaaa hadhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laahabbahu, fadhakara hubbahu wamaa waladathu aummu aaymana‏.‏ qaala wahaddathaniy ba'du aashaabiy 'an sulaymaana wakaanat haadinaaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Harmala, the freed slave of Usama bin Zaid said that while he was in the company of 'Abdullah bin 'Umar, Al-Hajjaj bin Aiman came in and (while praying) he did not perform his bowing and prostrations properly. So Ibn 'Umar told him to repeat his prayer. When he went away, Ibn 'Umar asked me, "Who is he?" I said, "Al-Hajjaj bin Um Aiman." Ibn 'Umar said, "If Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him, he would have loved him." Then Ibn 'Umar mentioned the love of the Prophet (ﷺ) for the children of Um Aiman. Sulaiman said that Um Aiman was one of the nurses of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ فِي حَيَاةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَأَى رُؤْيَا قَصَّهَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَتَمَنَّيْتُ أَنْ أَرَى رُؤْيَا أَقُصُّهَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَكُنْتُ غُلاَمًا أَعْزَبَ، وَكُنْتُ أَنَامُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ كَأَنَّ مَلَكَيْنِ أَخَذَانِي فَذَهَبَا بِي إِلَى النَّارِ، فَإِذَا هِيَ مَطْوِيَّةٌ كَطَىِّ الْبِئْرِ، فَإِذَا لَهَا قَرْنَانِ كَقَرْنَىِ الْبِئْرِ، وَإِذَا فِيهَا نَاسٌ قَدْ عَرَفْتُهُمْ، فَجَعَلْتُ أَقُولُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ‏.‏ فَلَقِيَهُمَا مَلَكٌ آخَرُ فَقَالَ لِي لَنْ تُرَاعَ‏. فَقَصَصْتُهَا عَلَى حَفْصَةَ‏.‏ فَقَصَّتْهَا حَفْصَةُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ نِعْمَ الرَّجُلُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، لَوْ كَانَ يُصَلِّي بِاللَّيْلِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سَالِمٌ فَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لاَ يَنَامُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu nasrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana alrrajulu fiy hayaaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa raaaa ruuyaa qassahaa 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fatamannaytu aan aaraa ruuyaa aaqussuhaa 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, wakuntu ghulaamana aa'zaba, wakuntu aanaamu fiy almasjidi 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faraaaytu fiy almanaami kaaanna malakayni aakhadhaaniy fadhahabaa biy iilaa alnnaari, faiidhaa hiya matwiyyaaun kataaai albiiri, faiidhaa lahaa qarnaani kaqarnaai albiiri, waiidhaa fiyhaa naasun qad 'araftuhum, faja'altu aaquwlu aa'uwdhu bialllahi mina alnnaari, aa'uwdhu bialllahi mina alnnaari‏.‏ falaqiyahumaa malakun akharu faqaala liy lan turaa'a‏. faqasastuhaa 'alaa hafsaaa‏.‏ faqassathaa hafsaau 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ ni'ma alrrajulu 'abdu alllahi, law kaana yusalliy bialllayli ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala saalimun fakaana 'abdu alllahi laa yanaamu mina alllayli iilaaa qaliylaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:If a man saw a dream during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) he would narrate it to the Prophet. Once I wished to see a dream and narrate it to the Prophet (ﷺ) I was young, unmarried, and used to sleep in the Mosque during the lifetime of the Prophet. I dreamt that two angels took me and went away with me towards the (Hell) Fire which looked like a well with the inside walls built up, and had two side-walls like those of a well. There I saw some people in it whom I knew. I started saying, "I seek Refuge with Allah from the (Hell) Fire, I seek Refuge with Allah from the (Hell) Fire." Then another angel met the other two and said to me, "Do not be afraid." I narrated my dream to Hafsa who, in her turn, narrated it to the Prophet. He said, "What an excellent man `Abdullah is if he only observes the night prayer." (Salim, a sub-narrator said, "Abdullah used not to sleep at night but very little hence forward)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أُخْتِهِ، حَفْصَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهَا ‏ "‏ إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ رَجُلٌ صَالِحٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, 'an aukhtihi, hafsaaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lahaa ‏ "‏ iinna 'abda alllahi rajulun saalihun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar from Hafsa his sister:That the Prophet (ﷺ) had said to her, "`Abdullah is a pious man
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ،، قَالَ قَدِمْتُ الشَّأْمَ فَصَلَّيْتُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ قُلْتُ اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ لِي جَلِيسًا صَالِحًا، فَأَتَيْتُ قَوْمًا فَجَلَسْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ، فَإِذَا شَيْخٌ قَدْ جَاءَ حَتَّى جَلَسَ إِلَى جَنْبِي، قُلْتُ مَنْ هَذَا قَالُوا أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُيَسِّرَ لِي جَلِيسًا صَالِحًا فَيَسَّرَكَ لِي، قَالَ مِمَّنْ أَنْتَ قُلْتُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَوَلَيْسَ عِنْدَكُمُ ابْنُ أُمِّ عَبْدٍ صَاحِبُ النَّعْلَيْنِ وَالْوِسَادِ وَالْمِطْهَرَةِ وَفِيكُمُ الَّذِي أَجَارَهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوَلَيْسَ فِيكُمْ صَاحِبُ سِرِّ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّذِي لاَ يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ كَيْفَ يَقْرَأُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ‏{‏وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى‏}‏، فَقَرَأْتُ عَلَيْهِ ‏{‏وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى * وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى * وَالذَّكَرِ وَالأُنْثَى‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَقْرَأَنِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ فِيهِ إِلَى فِيَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'ani almughiyraai, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, , qaala qadimtu alshhaama fasallaytu rak'atayni, thumma qultu alllahumma yassir liy jaliysana saalihana, faaataytu qawmana fajalastu iilayhim, faiidhaa shaykhun qad jaa'a hattaa jalasa iilaa janbiy, qultu man hadhaa qaaluwa aabuw alddardaa'i‏.‏ faqultu iinniy da'awtu alllaha aan yuyassira liy jaliysana saalihana fayassaraka liy, qaala mimman aanta qultu min aahli alkuwfaai‏.‏ qaala aawalaysa 'indakumu abnu aummi 'abdin saahibu alnna'layni waalwisaadi waalmitharaai wafiykumu alladhiy aajaarahu alllahu mina alshhaytaani 'alaa lisaani nabiyyihi sla allh 'lyh wslm aawalaysa fiykum saahibu sirri alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alladhiy laa ya'lamu aahadun ghayruhu thumma qaala kayfa yaqraau 'abdu alllahi ‏{‏waalllayli iidhaa yaghshaa‏}‏, faqaraatu 'alayhi ‏{‏waalllayli iidhaa yaghshaa * waalnnahaari iidhaa tajallaa * waaldhhakari waalaunthaa‏}‏‏.‏ qaala waalllahi laqad aaqraaaniyhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min fiyhi iilaa fiyya‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Alqama:I went to Sham and offered a two-rak`at prayer and then said, "O Allah! Bless me with a good pious companion." So I went to some people and sat with them. An old man came and sat by my side. I asked, "Who is he?" They replied, "(He is) Abu-Ad-Darda.' I said (to him), "I prayed to Allah to bless me with a pious companion and He sent you to me." He asked me, "From where are you?" I replied, "From the people of Al-Kufa." He said, "Isn't there amongst you Ibn Um `Abd, the one who used to carry the shoes, the cushion(or pillow) and the water for ablution? Is there amongst you the one whom Allah gave Refuge from Satan through the request of His Prophet. Is there amongst you the one who keeps the secrets of the Prophet (ﷺ) which nobody knows except him?" Abu Darda further asked, "How does `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud) recite the Sura starting with, 'By the Night as it conceals (the light)." (92.1) Then I recited before him: 'By the Night as it envelops: And by the Day as it appears in brightness; And by male and female.' (91.1-3) On this Abu Ad-Darda' said, "By Allah, the Prophet (ﷺ) made me recite the Sura in this way while I was listening to him (reciting it)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ ذَهَبَ عَلْقَمَةُ إِلَى الشَّأْمِ، فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ لِي جَلِيسًا صَالِحًا‏.‏ فَجَلَسَ إِلَى أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ فَقَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ مِمَّنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ فِيكُمْ ـ أَوْ مِنْكُمْ ـ صَاحِبُ السِّرِّ الَّذِي لاَ يَعْلَمُهُ غَيْرُهُ يَعْنِي حُذَيْفَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ فِيكُمُ ـ أَوْ مِنْكُمُ ـ الَّذِي أَجَارَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ، يَعْنِي عَمَّارًا‏.‏ قُلْتُ بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ فِيكُمْ ـ أَوْ مِنْكُمْ ـ صَاحِبُ السِّوَاكِ أَوِ السِّرَارِ قَالَ بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى * وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى‏}‏ قُلْتُ ‏{‏وَالذَّكَرِ وَالأُنْثَى‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ مَا زَالَ بِي هَؤُلاَءِ حَتَّى كَادُوا يَسْتَنْزِلُونِي عَنْ شَىْءٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mughiyraaa, 'an iibraahiyma, qaala dhahaba 'alqamaau iilaa alshhaami, falammaa dakhala almasjida qaala alllahumma yassir liy jaliysana saalihana‏.‏ fajalasa iilaa aabiy alddardaa'i faqaala aabuw alddardaa'i mimman aanta qaala min aahli alkuwfaai‏.‏ qaala aalaysa fiykum aaw minkum saahibu alssirri alladhiy laa ya'lamuhu ghayruhu ya'niy hudhayfaaa‏.‏ qaala qultu balaa‏.‏ qaala aalaysa fiykumu aaw minkumu alladhiy aajaarahu alllahu 'alaa lisaani nabiyyihi sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'niy mina alshhaytaani, ya'niy 'ammaarana‏.‏ qultu balaa‏.‏ qaala aalaysa fiykum aaw minkum saahibu alssiwaaki aawi alssiraari qaala balaa‏.‏ qaala kayfa kaana 'abdu alllahi yaqraau ‏{‏waalllayli iidhaa yaghshaa * waalnnahaari iidhaa tajallaa‏}‏ qultu ‏{‏waaldhhakari waalaunthaa‏}‏‏.‏ qaala maa zaala biy hauulaa'i hattaa kaaduwa yastanziluwniy 'an shaa'in sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibrahim:'Alqama went to Sham and when he entered the mosque, he said, "O Allah ! Bless me with a pious companion." So he sat with Abu Ad-Darda. Abu Ad-Darda' asked him, "Where are you from?" 'Alqama replied, "From the people of Kufa." Abu Ad-Darda said, "Isn't there amongst you the Keeper of the secret which nobody else knows i.e. Hudhaifa?" Al-qama said, "Yes." Then Abu Ad-Darda further said, "Isn't there amongst you the person whom Allah gave Refuge from Satan through the invocation of His Prophet namely `Ammar?" Alqama replied in the affirmative Abu Ad-Darda said, "Isn't there amongst you the person who carries the Siwak (or the Secret) (i.e. of the Prophet (ﷺ) namely `Abdullah bin Mas'ud)?" Alqama said, "Yes." Then Abu Ad-Darda asked, "How (Abdullah bin Masud) used to recite the Sura starting with: "By the night as it envelopes; By the day as it appears in brightness?" (92.1-2). Alqama said "And by male and female." Abu Ad-Darda then said, "These people (of Sham) tried hard to make me accept something other than what I had heard from the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَمِينًا، وَإِنَّ أَمِينَنَا أَيَّتُهَا الأُمَّةُ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, qaala haddathaniy aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna likulli aummaain aamiynana, waiinna aamiynanaa aayyatuhaa alaummaau aabuw 'ubaydaaa bnu aljarraahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, " Every nation has an extremely trustworthy man, and the trustworthy man of this (i.e. Muslim) nation is Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ صِلَةَ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَهْلِ نَجْرَانَ ‏ "‏ لأَبْعَثَنَّ ـ يَعْنِي عَلَيْكُمْ ـ يَعْنِي أَمِينًا ـ حَقَّ أَمِينٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَشْرَفَ أَصْحَابُهُ، فَبَعَثَ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ رضى الله عنه‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an silaaa, 'an hudhayfaaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm laahli najraana ‏ "‏ laab'athanna ya'niy 'alaykum ya'niy aamiynana haqqa aamiynin ‏"‏‏.‏ faaashrafa aashaabuhu, faba'atha aabaa 'ubaydaaa rda allh 'nh‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to the people of Najran, "I will send you the most trustworthy man." (Every one of) the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) was looking forward (to be that person). He then sent Abu 'Ubaida
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُوسَى، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، سَمِعَ أَبَا بَكْرَةَ، سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَالْحَسَنُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، يَنْظُرُ إِلَى النَّاسِ مَرَّةً وَإِلَيْهِ مَرَّةً، وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ ابْنِي هَذَا سَيِّدٌ، وَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُصْلِحَ بِهِ بَيْنَ فِئَتَيْنِ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sadaqaau, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, haddathanaa aabuw muwsaa, 'ani alhasani, sami'a aabaa bakraaa, sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alminbari waalhasanu iilaa janbihi, yanzuru iilaa alnnaasi marraaan waiilayhi marraaan, wayaquwlu ‏ "‏ abniy hadhaa sayyidun, wala'alla alllaha aan yusliha bihi bayna fiiatayni mina almuslimiyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakra:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) talking at the pulpit while Al-Hasan was sitting beside him, and he (i.e. the Prophet ) was once looking at the people and at another time Al-Hasan, and saying, "This son of mine is a Saiyid (i.e. chief) and perhaps Allah will bring about an agreement between two sects of the Muslims through him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَأْخُذُهُ وَالْحَسَنَ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحِبُّهُمَا فَأَحِبَّهُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa almu'tamiru, qaala sami'tu aabiy qaala, haddathanaa aabuw 'uthmaana, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu kaana yaakhudhuhu waalhasana wayaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy auhibbuhumaa faaahibbahumaa ‏"‏‏.‏ aaw kamaa qaala‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:That the Prophet (ﷺ) used to take him and Al-Hasan, and used to say, "O Allah! I love them, so please love them," or said something similar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أُتِيَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ بِرَأْسِ الْحُسَيْنِ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ فَجُعِلَ فِي طَسْتٍ، فَجَعَلَ يَنْكُتُ، وَقَالَ فِي حُسْنِهِ شَيْئًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ كَانَ أَشْبَهَهُمْ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَكَانَ مَخْضُوبًا بِالْوَسْمَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu alhusayni bni iibraahiyma, qaala haddathaniy husaynu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an muhammadin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh autiya 'ubaydu alllahi bnu ziyaadin biraasi alhusayni 'alayhi alssalaamu faju'ila fiy tastin, faja'ala yankutu, waqaala fiy husnihi shayiana‏.‏ faqaala aanasun kaana aashbahahum birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, wakaana makhduwbana bialwasmaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muhammad:Anas bin Malik said, "The head of Al-Husain was brought to 'Ubaidullah bin Ziyad and was put in a tray, and then Ibn Ziyad started playing with a stick at the nose and mouth of Al-Husain's head and saying something about his handsome features." Anas then said (to him), "Al-Husain resembled the Prophet more than the others did." Anas added, "His (i.e. Al-Husain's) hair was dyed with Wasma (i.e. a kind of plant used as a dye)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَدِيٌّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْحَسَنُ عَلَى عَاتِقِهِ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحِبُّهُ فَأَحِبَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu alminhaali, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy 'adiyyun, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a rda allh 'nh qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waalhasanu 'alaa 'aatiqihi yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy auhibbuhu faaahibbahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) carrying Al-Hasan on his shoulder an saying, "O Allah! I love him, so please love him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَحَمَلَ الْحَسَنَ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ بِأَبِي شَبِيهٌ بِالنَّبِيِّ، لَيْسَ شَبِيهٌ بِعَلِيٍّ‏.‏ وَعَلِيٌّ يَضْحَكُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'umaru bnu sa'iydi bni aabiy husaynin, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, 'an 'uqbaaa bni alhaarithi, qaala raaaytu aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nh wahamala alhasana wahwa yaquwlu biaabiy shabiyhun bialnnabiyyi, laysa shabiyhun bi'aliyyin‏.‏ wa'aliyyun yadhaku‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:I saw Abu Bakr carrying Al-Hasan and saying, "Let my father be sacrificed for you; you resemble the Prophet and not `Ali," while `Ali was laughing at this
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ مَعِينٍ، وَصَدَقَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ وَاقِدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ارْقُبُوا مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu ma'iynin, wasadaqaau, qaalaa aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an waaqidi bni muhammadin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala aabuw bakrin arqubuwa muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy aahli baytihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Abu Bakr used to say, "Look after Muhammad (ﷺ) in (looking after) his family
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسٌ، قَالَ لَمْ يَكُنْ أَحَدٌ أَشْبَهَ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu yuwsufa, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aanasin, ‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu alrrazzaaqi aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy aanasun, qaala lam yakun aahadun aashbaha bialnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alhasani bni 'aliyyin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:None resembled the Prophet (ﷺ) more than Al-Hasan bin `Ali did
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي يَعْقُوبَ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي نُعْمٍ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، وَسَأَلَهُ، عَنِ الْمُحْرِمِ،، قَالَ شُعْبَةُ أَحْسِبُهُ يَقْتُلُ الذُّبَابَ فَقَالَ أَهْلُ الْعِرَاقِ يَسْأَلُونَ عَنِ الذُّبَابِ وَقَدْ قَتَلُوا ابْنَ ابْنَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ هُمَا رَيْحَانَتَاىَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi bni aabiy ya'quwba, sami'tu abna aabiy nu'min, sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, wasaaalahu, 'ani almuhrimi, , qaala shu'baau aahsibuhu yaqtulu aldhhubaaba faqaala aahlu al'iraaqi yasaaluwna 'ani aldhhubaabi waqad qataluwa abna abnaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, waqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ humaa rayhaanataaaa mina alddunyaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Abi Nu'm:A person asked `Abdullah bin `Umar whether a Muslim could kill flies. I heard him saying (in reply). "The people of Iraq are asking about the killing of flies while they themselves murdered the son of the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . The Prophet (ﷺ) said, They (i.e. Hasan and Husain) are my two sweet basils in this world
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ عُمَرُ يَقُولُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ سَيِّدُنَا، وَأَعْتَقَ سَيِّدَنَا‏.‏ يَعْنِي بِلاَلاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy salamaaa, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, aakhbaranaa jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana 'umaru yaquwlu aabuw bakrin sayyidunaa, waaa'taqa sayyidanaa‏.‏ ya'niy bilaalaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:`Umar used to say, "Abu Bakr is our chief, and he manumitted our chief," meaning Bilal
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، أَنَّ بِلاَلاً، قَالَ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ إِنْ كُنْتَ إِنَّمَا اشْتَرَيْتَنِي لِنَفْسِكَ فَأَمْسِكْنِي، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ إِنَّمَا اشْتَرَيْتَنِي لِلَّهِ فَدَعْنِي وَعَمَلَ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, 'an muhammadi bni 'ubaydin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an qaysin, aanna bilaalaan, qaala laabiy bakrin iin kunta iinnamaa ashtaraytaniy linafsika faaamsikniy, waiin kunta iinnamaa ashtaraytaniy lillahi fada'niy wa'amala alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qais:Bilal said to Abu Bakr, "If you have bought me for yourself then keep me (for yourself), but if you have bought me for Allah's Sake, then leave me for Allah's Work
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،، قَالَ ضَمَّنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى صَدْرِهِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ عَلِّمْهُ الْحِكْمَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an khaalidin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, , qaala dammaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa sadrihi waqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma 'allimhu alhikmaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) embraced me (pressed me to his chest) and said, "O Allah, teach him wisdom (i.e. the understanding of the knowledge of Qur'an)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، وَقَالَ، ‏ "‏ عَلِّمْهُ الْكِتَابَ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ وَالْحِكْمَةُ الْإِصَابَةُ فِي غَيْرِ النُّبُوَّةِ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw ma'marin, hadaathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, waqaala, ‏ "‏ 'aliimhu alkitaaba ‏"‏‏.‏ hadaathanaa muwsaa, hadaathanaa wuhaybun, 'an khaalidin, mithlahu‏.‏ waalhikmaau aliisaabaau fiy ghayri alnuubuwaaai
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdul Warith: The same but said, "O Allah, teach him (Ibn Abbas) the Book (i.e. the understanding of the knowledge of Qur'an)." Narrated Khalid: As above
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَعَى زَيْدًا وَجَعْفَرًا وَابْنَ رَوَاحَةَ لِلنَّاسِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ خَبَرُهُمْ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَخَذَ الرَّايَةَ زَيْدٌ فَأُصِيبَ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ جَعْفَرٌ فَأُصِيبَ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ ابْنُ رَوَاحَةَ فَأُصِيبَ ـ وَعَيْنَاهُ تَذْرِفَانِ ـ حَتَّى أَخَذَ سَيْفٌ مِنْ سُيُوفِ اللَّهِ حَتَّى فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu waaqidin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an humaydi bni hilaalin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm na'aa zaydana waja'farana waabna rawaahaaa lilnnaasi qabla aan yaatiyahum khabaruhum, faqaala ‏ "‏ aakhadha alrraayaaa zaydun faausiyba, thumma aakhadha ja'farun faausiyba, thumma aakhadha abnu rawaahaaa faausiyba wa'aynaahu tadhrifaani hattaa aakhadha sayfun min suyuwfi alllahi hattaa fataha alllahu 'alayhim ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had informed the people about the death of Zaid, Ja`far and Ibn Rawaha before the news of their death reached them. He said with his eyes flowing with tears, "Zaid took the flag and was martyred; then Ja`far took the flag and was martyred, and then Ibn Rawaha took the flag and was martyred. Finally the flag was taken by one of Allah's Swords (i.e. Khalid bin Al-Walid) and Allah gave them (i.e. the Muslims) victory
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 62 — Companions of the Prophet
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ ذُكِرَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، فَقَالَ ذَاكَ رَجُلٌ لاَ أَزَالُ أُحِبُّهُ بَعْدَ مَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اسْتَقْرِئُوا الْقُرْآنَ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، فَبَدَأَ بِهِ، وَسَالِمٍ مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ، وَأُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، وَمُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي بَدَأَ بِأُبَىٍّ أَوْ بِمُعَاذٍ‏.‏
