verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ أَوَّلُ مَوْلُودٍ وُلِدَ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَتَوْا بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخَذَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَمْرَةً فَلاَكَهَا ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَهَا فِي فِيهِ، فَأَوَّلُ مَا دَخَلَ بَطْنَهُ رِيقُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, 'an aabiy ausaamaaa, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat aawwalu mawluwdin wulida fiy aliislaami 'abdu alllahi bnu alzzubayri, aatawa bihi alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhadha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm tamraaan falaakahaa thumma aadkhalahaa fiy fiyhi, faaawwalu maa dakhala batnahu riyqu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:The first child who was born in the Islamic Land (i.e. Medina) amongst the Emigrants, was `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair. They brought him to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) took a date, and after chewing it, put its juice in his mouth. So the first thing that went into the child's stomach, was the saliva of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَقْبَلَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَهْوَ مُرْدِفٌ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ شَيْخٌ يُعْرَفُ، وَنَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَابٌّ لاَ يُعْرَفُ، قَالَ فَيَلْقَى الرَّجُلُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَيَقُولُ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ، مَنْ هَذَا الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ فَيَقُولُ هَذَا الرَّجُلُ يَهْدِينِي السَّبِيلَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَيَحْسِبُ الْحَاسِبُ أَنَّهُ إِنَّمَا يَعْنِي الطَّرِيقَ، وَإِنَّمَا يَعْنِي سَبِيلَ الْخَيْرِ، فَالْتَفَتَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، فَإِذَا هُوَ بِفَارِسٍ قَدْ لَحِقَهُمْ، فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَذَا فَارِسٌ قَدْ لَحِقَ بِنَا‏.‏ فَالْتَفَتَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اصْرَعْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَصَرَعَهُ الْفَرَسُ، ثُمَّ قَامَتْ تُحَمْحِمُ فَقَالَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ مُرْنِي بِمَا شِئْتَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَقِفْ مَكَانَكَ، لاَ تَتْرُكَنَّ أَحَدًا يَلْحَقُ بِنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَانَ أَوَّلَ النَّهَارِ جَاهِدًا عَلَى نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَكَانَ آخِرَ النَّهَارِ مَسْلَحَةً لَهُ، فَنَزَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَانِبَ الْحَرَّةِ، ثُمَّ بَعَثَ إِلَى الأَنْصَارِ، فَجَاءُوا إِلَى نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَلَّمُوا عَلَيْهِمَا، وَقَالُوا ارْكَبَا آمِنَيْنِ مُطَاعَيْنِ‏.‏ فَرَكِبَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَحَفُّوا دُونَهُمَا بِالسِّلاَحِ، فَقِيلَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ جَاءَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ، جَاءَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَأَشْرَفُوا يَنْظُرُونَ وَيَقُولُونَ جَاءَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ، جَاءَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ يَسِيرُ حَتَّى نَزَلَ جَانِبَ دَارِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، فَإِنَّهُ لَيُحَدِّثُ أَهْلَهُ، إِذْ سَمِعَ بِهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ وَهْوَ فِي نَخْلٍ لأَهْلِهِ يَخْتَرِفُ لَهُمْ، فَعَجِلَ أَنْ يَضَعَ الَّذِي يَخْتَرِفُ لَهُمْ فِيهَا، فَجَاءَ وَهْىَ مَعَهُ، فَسَمِعَ مِنْ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ، فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَىُّ بُيُوتِ أَهْلِنَا أَقْرَبُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ أَنَا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، هَذِهِ دَارِي، وَهَذَا بَابِي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَانْطَلِقْ فَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مَقِيلاً ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قُومَا عَلَى بَرَكَةِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَأَنَّكَ جِئْتَ بِحَقٍّ، وَقَدْ عَلِمَتْ يَهُودُ أَنِّي سَيِّدُهُمْ وَابْنُ سَيِّدِهِمْ، وَأَعْلَمُهُمْ وَابْنُ أَعْلَمِهِمْ، فَادْعُهُمْ فَاسْأَلْهُمْ عَنِّي قَبْلَ أَنْ يَعْلَمُوا أَنِّي قَدْ أَسْلَمْتُ، فَإِنَّهُمْ إِنْ يَعْلَمُوا أَنِّي قَدْ أَسْلَمْتُ قَالُوا فِيَّ مَا لَيْسَ فِيَّ‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَقْبَلُوا فَدَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ الْيَهُودِ، وَيْلَكُمُ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ، فَوَاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ حَقًّا، وَأَنِّي جِئْتُكُمْ بِحَقٍّ فَأَسْلِمُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا مَا نَعْلَمُهُ‏.‏ قَالُوا لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَهَا ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَىُّ رَجُلٍ فِيكُمْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا ذَاكَ سَيِّدُنَا وَابْنُ سَيِّدِنَا، وَأَعْلَمُنَا وَابْنُ أَعْلَمِنَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَسْلَمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا حَاشَا لِلَّهِ، مَا كَانَ لِيُسْلِمَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَسْلَمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا حَاشَا لِلَّهِ، مَا كَانَ لِيُسْلِمَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا ابْنَ سَلاَمٍ، اخْرُجْ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ فَقَالَ يَا مَعْشَرَ الْيَهُودِ، اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ، فَوَاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَأَنَّهُ جَاءَ بِحَقٍّ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا كَذَبْتَ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadun, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu suhaybin, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala aaqbala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa almadiynaai wahwa murdifun aabaa bakrin, waaabuw bakrin shaykhun yu'rafu, wanabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shaabbun laa yu'rafu, qaala fayalqaa alrrajulu aabaa bakrin fayaquwlu yaa aabaa bakrin, man hadhaa alrrajulu alladhiy bayna yadayka fayaquwlu hadhaa alrrajulu yahdiyniy alssabiyla‏.‏ qaala fayahsibu alhaasibu aannahu iinnamaa ya'niy alttariyqa, waiinnamaa ya'niy sabiyla alkhayri, faaltafata aabuw bakrin, faiidhaa huwa bifaarisin qad lahiqahum, faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, hadhaa faarisun qad lahiqa binaa‏.‏ faaltafata nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma asra'hu ‏"‏‏.‏ fasara'ahu alfarasu, thumma qaamat tuhamhimu faqaala yaa nabiyya alllahi murniy bimaa shiita‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faqif makaanaka, laa tatrukanna aahadana yalhaqu binaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fakaana aawwala alnnahaari jaahidana 'alaa nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, wakaana akhira alnnahaari maslahaaan lahu, fanazala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaaniba alharraai, thumma ba'atha iilaa alaansaari, fajaa'uwa iilaa nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallamuwa 'alayhimaa, waqaaluwa arkabaa aminayni mutaa'ayni‏.‏ farakiba nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin, wahaffuwa duwnahumaa bialssilaahi, faqiyla fiy almadiynaai jaa'a nabiyyu alllahi, jaa'a nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faaashrafuwa yanzuruwna wayaquwluwna jaa'a nabiyyu alllahi, jaa'a nabiyyu alllahi‏.‏ faaaqbala yasiyru hattaa nazala jaaniba daari aabiy aayyuwba, faiinnahu layuhaddithu aahlahu, iidh sami'a bihi 'abdu alllahi bnu salaamin wahwa fiy nakhlin laahlihi yakhtarifu lahum, fa'ajila aan yada'a alladhiy yakhtarifu lahum fiyhaa, fajaa'a wahaa ma'ahu, fasami'a min nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma raja'a iilaa aahlihi, faqaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaaau buyuwti aahlinaa aaqrabu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw aayyuwba aanaa yaa nabiyya alllahi, hadhihi daariy, wahadhaa baabiy‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faantaliq fahayyii lanaa maqiylaan ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala quwmaa 'alaa barakaai alllahi‏.‏ falammaa jaa'a nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaa'a 'abdu alllahi bnu salaamin faqaala aashhadu aannaka rasuwlu alllahi, waaannaka jiita bihaqqin, waqad 'alimat yahuwdu aanniy sayyiduhum waabnu sayyidihim, waaa'lamuhum waabnu aa'lamihim, faad'uhum faasaalhum 'anniy qabla aan ya'lamuwa aanniy qad aaslamtu, faiinnahum iin ya'lamuwa aanniy qad aaslamtu qaaluwa fiyya maa laysa fiyya‏.‏ faaarsala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaaqbaluwa fadakhaluwa 'alayhi‏.‏ faqaala lahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa ma'shara alyahuwdi, waylakumu attaquwa alllaha, fawaalllahi alladhiy laa iilaha iilaaa huwa iinnakum lata'lamuwna aanniy rasuwlu alllahi haqqana, waaanniy jiitukum bihaqqin faaaslimuwa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa maa na'lamuhu‏.‏ qaaluwa lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalahaa thalaatha miraarin‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaaaau rajulin fiykum 'abdu alllahi bnu salaamin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa dhaaka sayyidunaa waabnu sayyidinaa, waaa'lamunaa waabnu aa'laminaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aafaraaaytum iin aaslama ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa haashaa lillahi, maa kaana liyuslima‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aafaraaaytum iin aaslama ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa haashaa lillahi, maa kaana liyuslima‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ yaa abna salaamin, akhruj 'alayhim ‏"‏‏.‏ fakharaja faqaala yaa ma'shara alyahuwdi, attaquwa alllaha, fawaalllahi alladhiy laa iilaha iilaaa huwa iinnakum lata'lamuwna aannahu rasuwlu alllahi, waaannahu jaa'a bihaqqin‏.‏ faqaaluwa kadhabta‏.‏ faaakhrajahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived at Medina with Abu Bakr, riding behind him on the same camel. Abu Bakr was an elderly man known to the people, while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was a youth that was unknown. Thus, if a man met Abu Bakr, he would say, "O Abu Bakr! Who is this man in front of you?" Abu Bakr would say, "This man shows me the Way," One would think that Abu Bakr meant the road, while in fact, Abu Bakr meant the way of virtue and good. Then Abu Bakr looked behind and saw a horse-rider pursuing them. He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is a horse-rider pursuing us." The Prophet (ﷺ) looked behind and said, "O Allah! Cause him to fall down." So the horse threw him down and got up neighing. After that the rider, Suraqa said, "O Allah's Prophet! Order me whatever you want." The Prophet said, "Stay where you are and do not allow anybody to reach us." So, in the first part of the day Suraqa was an enemy of Allah's Prophet and in the last part of it, he was a protector. Then Allah's Apostle alighted by the side of the Al-Harra and sent a message to the Ansar, and they came to Allah's Prophet and Abu Bakr, and having greeted them, they said, "Ride (your she-camels) safe and obeyed." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr rode and the Ansar, carrying their arms, surrounded them. The news that Allah's Prophet had come circulated in Medina. The people came out and were eagerly looking and saying "Allah's Prophet has come! Allah's Prophet has come! So the Prophet (ﷺ) went on till he alighted near the house of Abu Ayub. While the Prophet (ﷺ) was speaking with the family members of Abu Ayub, `Abdullah bin Salam heard the news of his arrival while he himself was picking the dates for his family from his family garden. He hurried to the Prophet (ﷺ) carrying the dates which he had collected for his family from the garden. He listened to Allah's Prophet and then went home. Then Allah's Prophet said, "Which is the nearest of the houses of our kith and kin?" Abu Ayub replied, "Mine, O Allah's Prophet! This is my house and this is my gate." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go and prepare a place for our midday rest." Abu Ayub said, "Get up (both of you) with Allah's Blessings." So when Allah's Prophet went into the house, `Abdullah bin Salam came and said "I testify that you (i.e. Muhammad) are Apostle of Allah and that you have come with the Truth. The Jews know well that I am their chief and the son of their chief and the most learned amongst them and the son of the most learned amongst them. So send for them (i.e. Jews) and ask them about me before they know that I have embraced Islam, for if they know that they will say about me things which are not correct." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for them, and they came and entered. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them, "O (the group of) Jews! Woe to you: be afraid of Allah. By Allah except Whom none has the right to be worshipped, you people know for certain, that I am Apostle of Allah and that I have come to you with the Truth, so embrace Islam." The Jews replied, "We do not know this." So they said this to the Prophet and he repeated it thrice. Then he said, "What sort of a man is `Abdullah bin Salam amongst you?" They said, "He is our chief and the son of our chief and the most learned man, and the son of the most learned amongst us." He said, "What would you think if he should embrace Islam?" They said, "Allah forbid! He can not embrace Islam." He said, " What would you think if he should embrace Islam?" They said, "Allah forbid! He can not embrace Islam." He said, "What would you think if he should embrace Islam?" They said, "Allah forbid! He can not embrace Islam." He said, "O Ibn Salam! Come out to them." He came out and said, "O (the group of) Jews! Be afraid of Allah except Whom none has the right to be worshipped. You know for certain that he is Apostle of Allah and that he has brought a True Religion!' They said, "You tell a lie." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned them out
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ يَعْنِي، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ كَانَ فَرَضَ لِلْمُهَاجِرِينَ الأَوَّلِينَ أَرْبَعَةَ آلاَفٍ فِي أَرْبَعَةٍ، وَفَرَضَ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ ثَلاَثَةَ آلاَفٍ وَخَمْسَمِائَةٍ فَقِيلَ لَهُ هُوَ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ، فَلِمَ نَقَصْتَهُ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةِ آلاَفٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا هَاجَرَ بِهِ أَبَوَاهُ‏.‏ يَقُولُ لَيْسَ هُوَ كَمَنْ هَاجَرَ بِنَفْسِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, 'an naafi'in ya'niy, 'ani abni 'umara, 'an 'umara bni alkhattaabi, rda allh 'nh qaala kaana farada lilmuhaajiriyna alaawwaliyna aarba'aaa alaafin fiy aarba'aain, wafarada laibni 'umara thalaathaaa alaafin wakhamsamiaiaain faqiyla lahu huwa mina almuhaajiriyna, falima naqastahu min aarba'aai alaafin faqaala iinnamaa haajara bihi aabawaahu‏.‏ yaquwlu laysa huwa kaman haajara binafsihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab fixed a grant of 4000 (Dirhams) for every Early Emigrant (i.e. Muhajir) and fixed a grant of 3500 (Dirhams) only for Ibn `Umar. Somebody said to `Umar, "Ibn `Umar is also one of the Early Emigrants; why do you give him less than four-thousand?" `Umar replied, "His parents took him with them when they migrated, so he was not like the one who had migrated by himself
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ خَبَّابٍ، قَالَ هَاجَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an khabbaabin, qaala haajarnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Khabbab:We migrated with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (See Hadith No. 253 below)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ شَقِيقَ بْنَ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَبَّابٌ، قَالَ هَاجَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبْتَغِي وَجْهَ اللَّهِ، وَوَجَبَ أَجْرُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ، فَمِنَّا مَنْ مَضَى لَمْ يَأْكُلْ مِنْ أَجْرِهِ شَيْئًا، مِنْهُمْ مُصْعَبُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، قُتِلَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ فَلَمْ نَجِدْ شَيْئًا نُكَفِّنُهُ فِيهِ، إِلاَّ نَمِرَةً كُنَّا إِذَا غَطَّيْنَا بِهَا رَأْسَهُ خَرَجَتْ رِجْلاَهُ، فَإِذَا غَطَّيْنَا رِجْلَيْهِ خَرَجَ رَأْسُهُ، فَأَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نُغْطِيَ رَأْسَهُ بِهَا، وَنَجْعَلَ عَلَى رِجْلَيْهِ مِنْ إِذْخِرٍ، وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَيْنَعَتْ لَهُ ثَمَرَتُهُ فَهْوَ يَهْدِبُهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, qaala sami'tu shaqiyqa bna salamaaa, qaala haddathanaa khabbaabun, qaala haajarnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nabtaghiy wajha alllahi, wawajaba aajrunaa 'alaa alllahi, faminnaa man madaa lam yaakul min aajrihi shayiana, minhum mus'abu bnu 'umayrin, qutila yawma auhudin falam najid shayiana nukaffinuhu fiyhi, iilaaa namiraaan kunnaa iidhaa ghattaynaa bihaa raasahu kharajat rijlaahu, faiidhaa ghattaynaa rijlayhi kharaja raasuhu, faaamaranaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan nughtiya raasahu bihaa, wanaj'ala 'alaa rijlayhi min iidhkhirin, waminnaa man aayna'at lahu thamaratuhu fahwa yahdibuhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Khabbab:We migrated with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) seeking Allah's Countenance, so our rewards became due and sure with Allah. Some of us passed away without eating anything of their rewards in this world. One of these was Mus`ab bin `Umair who was martyred on the day of the battle of Uhud. We did not find anything to shroud his body with except a striped cloak. When we covered his head with it, his feet remained uncovered, and when we covered his feet with it, his head remained uncovered. So Allah's Apostle ordered us to cover his head with it and put some Idhkhir (i.e. a kind of grass) over his feet. And there are some amongst us whose fruits have ripened and they are collecting them (i.e. they have received their rewards in this world)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيُّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَا قَالَ أَبِي لأَبِيكَ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّ أَبِي قَالَ لأَبِيكَ يَا أَبَا مُوسَى، هَلْ يَسُرُّكَ إِسْلاَمُنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِجْرَتُنَا مَعَهُ، وَجِهَادُنَا مَعَهُ، وَعَمَلُنَا كُلُّهُ مَعَهُ، بَرَدَ لَنَا، وَأَنَّ كُلَّ عَمَلٍ عَمِلْنَاهُ بَعْدَهُ نَجَوْنَا مِنْهُ كَفَافًا رَأْسًا بِرَأْسٍ فَقَالَ أَبِي لاَ وَاللَّهِ، قَدْ جَاهَدْنَا بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصَلَّيْنَا، وَصُمْنَا، وَعَمِلْنَا خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا، وَأَسْلَمَ عَلَى أَيْدِينَا بَشَرٌ كَثِيرٌ، وَإِنَّا لَنَرْجُو ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبِي لَكِنِّي أَنَا وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ عُمَرَ بِيَدِهِ لَوَدِدْتُ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ بَرَدَ لَنَا، وَأَنَّ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَمِلْنَاهُ بَعْدُ نَجَوْنَا مِنْهُ كَفَافًا رَأْسًا بِرَأْسٍ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ أَبَاكَ وَاللَّهِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَبِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bishrin, haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa 'awfun, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni qurraaa, qaala haddathaniy aabuw burdaaa bnu aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyu, qaala qaala liy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara hal tadriy maa qaala aabiy laabiyka qaala qultu laa‏.‏ qaala faiinna aabiy qaala laabiyka yaa aabaa muwsaa, hal yasurruka iislaamunaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahijratunaa ma'ahu, wajihaadunaa ma'ahu, wa'amalunaa kulluhu ma'ahu, barada lanaa, waaanna kulla 'amalin 'amilnaahu ba'dahu najawnaa minhu kafaafana raasana biraasin faqaala aabiy laa waalllahi, qad jaahadnaa ba'da rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasallaynaa, wasumnaa, wa'amilnaa khayrana kathiyrana, waaaslama 'alaa aaydiynaa basharun kathiyrun, waiinnaa lanarjuw dhalika‏.‏ faqaala aabiy lakinniy aanaa waalladhiy nafsu 'umara biyadihi lawadidtu aanna dhalika barada lanaa, waaanna kulla shaa'in 'amilnaahu ba'du najawnaa minhu kafaafana raasana biraasin‏.‏ faqultu iinna aabaaka waalllahi khayrun min aabiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda Bin Abi Musa Al-Ash`ari:`Abdullah bin `Umar said to me, "Do you know what my father said to your father once?" I said, "No." He said, "My father said to your father, 'O Abu Musa, will it please you that we will be rewarded for our conversion to Islam with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and our migration with him, and our Jihad with him and all our good deeds which we did, with him, and that all the deeds we did after his death will be disregarded whether good or bad?' Your father (i.e. Abu Musa) said, 'No, by Allah, we took part in Jihad after Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , prayed and did plenty of good deeds, and many people have embraced Islam at our hands, and no doubt, we expect rewards from Allah for these good deeds.' On that my father (i.e. `Umar) said, 'As for myself, By Him in Whose Hand `Umar's soul is, I wish that the deeds done by us at the time of the Prophet (ﷺ) remain rewardable while whatsoever we did after the death of the Prophet (ﷺ) be enough to save us from Punishment in that the good deeds compensate for the bad ones.' " On that I said (to Ibn `Umar), "By Allah, your father was better than my father
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ صَبَّاحٍ ـ أَوْ بَلَغَنِي عَنْهُ ـ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُ هَاجَرَ قَبْلَ أَبِيهِ يَغْضَبُ، قَالَ وَقَدِمْتُ أَنَا وَعُمَرُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَجَدْنَاهُ قَائِلاً فَرَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَنْزِلِ، فَأَرْسَلَنِي عُمَرُ وَقَالَ اذْهَبْ فَانْظُرْ هَلِ اسْتَيْقَظَ فَأَتَيْتُهُ، فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَبَايَعْتُهُ، ثُمَّ انْطَلَقْتُ إِلَى عُمَرَ، فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ أَنَّهُ قَدِ اسْتَيْقَظَ، فَانْطَلَقْنَا إِلَيْهِ نُهَرْوِلُ هَرْوَلَةً حَتَّى دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ فَبَايَعَهُ ثُمَّ بَايَعْتُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu sabbaahin aaw balaghaniy 'anhu haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an 'aasimin, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, qaala sami'tu abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma iidhaa qiyla lahu haajara qabla aabiyhi yaghdabu, qaala waqadimtu aanaa wa'umaru 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fawajadnaahu qaaiilaan faraja'naa iilaa almanzili, faaarsalaniy 'umaru waqaala adhhab faanzur hali astayqaza faaataytuhu, fadakhaltu 'alayhi fabaaya'tuhu, thumma antalaqtu iilaa 'umara, faaakhbartuhu aannahu qadi astayqaza, faantalaqnaa iilayhi nuharwilu harwalaaan hattaa dakhala 'alayhi fabaaya'ahu thumma baaya'tuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu `Uthman:I heard that Ibn `Umar used to become angry if someone mentioned that he had migrated before his father (`Umar), and he used to say, " `Umar and I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and found him having his midday rest, so we returned home. Then `Umar sent me again (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) and said, 'Go and see whether he is awake.' I went to him and entered his place and gave him the pledge of allegiance. Then I went back to `Umar and informed him that the Prophet (ﷺ) was awake. So we both went, running slowly, and when `Umar entered his place, he gave him the pledge of allegiance and thereafter I too gave him the pledge of allegiance
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُرَيْحُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، يُحَدِّثُ قَالَ ابْتَاعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مِنْ عَازِبٍ رَحْلاً فَحَمَلْتُهُ مَعَهُ قَالَ فَسَأَلَهُ عَازِبٌ عَنْ مَسِيرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أُخِذَ عَلَيْنَا بِالرَّصَدِ، فَخَرَجْنَا لَيْلاً، فَأَحْثَثْنَا لَيْلَتَنَا وَيَوْمَنَا حَتَّى قَامَ قَائِمُ الظَّهِيرَةِ، ثُمَّ رُفِعَتْ لَنَا صَخْرَةٌ، فَأَتَيْنَاهَا وَلَهَا شَىْءٌ مِنْ ظِلٍّ قَالَ فَفَرَشْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرْوَةً مَعِي، ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَانْطَلَقْتُ أَنْفُضُ مَا حَوْلَهُ، فَإِذَا أَنَا بِرَاعٍ قَدْ أَقْبَلَ فِي غُنَيْمَةٍ يُرِيدُ مِنَ الصَّخْرَةِ مِثْلَ الَّذِي أَرَدْنَا فَسَأَلْتُهُ لِمَنْ أَنْتَ يَا غُلاَمُ فَقَالَ أَنَا لِفُلاَنٍ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ هَلْ فِي غَنَمِكَ مِنْ لَبَنٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَهُ هَلْ أَنْتَ حَالِبٌ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ شَاةً مِنْ غَنَمِهِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ انْفُضِ الضَّرْعَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَلَبَ كُثْبَةً مِنْ لَبَنٍ، وَمَعِي إِدَاوَةٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ عَلَيْهَا خِرْقَةٌ قَدْ رَوَّأْتُهَا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَبَبْتُ عَلَى اللَّبَنِ حَتَّى بَرَدَ أَسْفَلُهُ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ اشْرَبْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَشَرِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى رَضِيتُ، ثُمَّ ارْتَحَلْنَا وَالطَّلَبُ فِي إِثْرِنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana, haddathanaa shurayhu bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu yuwsufa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a, yuhaddithu qaala abtaa'a aabuw bakrin min 'aazibin rahlaan fahamaltuhu ma'ahu qaala fasaaalahu 'aazibun 'an masiyri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala aukhidha 'alaynaa bialrrasadi, fakharajnaa laylaan, faaahthathnaa laylatanaa wayawmanaa hattaa qaama qaaiimu alzzahiyraai, thumma rufi'at lanaa sakhraaun, faaataynaahaa walahaa shaa'un min zillin qaala fafarashtu lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm farwaaan ma'iy, thumma adtaja'a 'alayhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faantalaqtu aanfudu maa hawlahu, faiidhaa aanaa biraa'in qad aaqbala fiy ghunaymaain yuriydu mina alssakhraai mithla alladhiy aaradnaa fasaaaltuhu liman aanta yaa ghulaamu faqaala aanaa lifulaanin‏.‏ faqultu lahu hal fiy ghanamika min labanin qaala na'am‏.‏ qultu lahu hal aanta haalibun qaala na'am‏.‏ faaakhadha shaaaan min ghanamihi faqultu lahu anfudi alddar'a‏.‏ qaala fahalaba kuthbaaan min labanin, wama'iy iidaawaaun min maa'in 'alayhaa khirqaaun qad rawwaatuhaa lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasababtu 'alaa alllabani hattaa barada aasfaluhu, thumma aataytu bihi alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu ashrab yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ fashariba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa radiytu, thumma artahalnaa waalttalabu fiy iithrinaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:Abu Bakr bought a (camel's) saddle from `Azib, and I carried it for him. `Azib (i.e. my father) asked Abu Bakr regarding the journey of the migration of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Abu Bakr said, "Close observers were appointed by our enemies to watch us. So we went out at night and travelled throughout the night and the following day till it was noon, then we perceived a rock and went towards it, and there was some shade under it. I spread a cloak I had with me for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and then the Prophet (ﷺ) layed on it. I went out to guard him and all of a sudden I saw a shepherd coming with his sheep looking for the same, the shade of the rock as we did, I asked him, 'O boy, to whom do you belong?' He replied, 'I belong to so-and-so.' I asked him, 'Is there some milk in your sheep?' He replied in the affirmative. I asked him, 'Will you milk?' He replied in the affirmative. Then he got hold of one of his sheep. I said to him, 'Remove the dust from its udder.' Then he milked a little milk. I had a water-skin with me which was tied with a piece of cloth. I had prepared the water-skin for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . So I poured some water over the milk (container) till its bottom became cold. Then I brought the milk to the Prophet and said, 'Drink, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank till I became pleased. Then we departed and the pursuers were following us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: قَالَ الْبَرَاءُ فَدَخَلْتُ مَعَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ، فَإِذَا عَائِشَةُ ابْنَتُهُ مُضْطَجِعَةٌ، قَدْ أَصَابَتْهَا حُمَّى، فَرَأَيْتُ أَبَاهَا فَقَبَّلَ خَدَّهَا، وَقَالَ كَيْفَ أَنْتِ يَا بُنَيَّةُ
verses.translit: qaala albaraa'u fadakhaltu ma'a aabiy bakrin 'alaa aahlihi, faiidhaa 'aaiishaau abnatuhu mudtaji'aaun, qad aasaabathaa hummaa, faraaaytu aabaahaa faqabbala khaddahaa, waqaala kayfa aanti yaa bunayyaau
verses.translation: Al-Bara added:I then went with Abu Bakr into his home (carrying that saddle) and there I saw his daughter `Aisha Lying in a bed because of heavy fever and I saw her father Abu Bakr kissing her cheek and saying, "How are you, little daughter?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حِمْيَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْلَةَ، أَنَّ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ وَسَّاجٍ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ، خَادِمِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَيْسَ فِي أَصْحَابِهِ أَشْمَطُ غَيْرَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، فَغَلَفَهَا بِالْحِنَّاءِ وَالْكَتَمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu himyara, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu aabiy 'ablaaa, aanna 'uqbaaa bna wassaajin, haddathahu 'an aanasin, khaadimi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm walaysa fiy aashaabihi aashmatu ghayra aabiy bakrin, faghalafahaa bialhinnaa'i waalkatami‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:(the servant of the Prophet) When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived (at Medina), there was not a single companion of the Prophet (ﷺ) who had grey and black hair except Abu Bakr, and he dyed his hair with Henna' and Katam (i.e. plants used for dying hair)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: وَقَالَ دُحَيْمٌ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ وَسَّاجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ، فَكَانَ أَسَنَّ أَصْحَابِهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، فَغَلَفَهَا بِالْحِنَّاءِ وَالْكَتَمِ حَتَّى قَنَأَ لَوْنُهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala duhaymun haddathanaa alwaliydu, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, haddathaniy aabuw 'ubaydin, 'an 'uqbaaa bni wassaajin, haddathaniy aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa, fakaana aasanna aashaabihi aabuw bakrin, faghalafahaa bialhinnaa'i waalkatami hattaa qanaaa lawnuhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Through another group of narrators, Anas bin Malik said: "When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Medina, the eldest amongst his companions was Abu Bakr. He dyed his hair with Hinna and Katam till it became of dark red color
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَصْبَغُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ كَلْبٍ يُقَالُ لَهَا أُمُّ بَكْرٍ، فَلَمَّا هَاجَرَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ طَلَّقَهَا، فَتَزَوَّجَهَا ابْنُ عَمِّهَا، هَذَا الشَّاعِرُ الَّذِي قَالَ هَذِهِ الْقَصِيدَةَ، رَثَى كُفَّارَ قُرَيْشٍ وَمَاذَا بِالْقَلِيبِ قَلِيبِ بَدْرٍ مِنَ الشِّيزَى تُزَيَّنُ بِالسَّنَامِ وَمَاذَا بِالْقَلِيبِ، قَلِيبِ بَدْرٍ مِنَ الْقَيْنَاتِ وَالشَّرْبِ الْكِرَامِ تُحَيِّي بِالسَّلاَمَةِ أُمُّ بَكْرٍ وَهَلْ لِي بَعْدَ قَوْمِي مِنْ سَلاَمِ يُحَدِّثُنَا الرَّسُولُ بِأَنْ سَنَحْيَا وَكَيْفَ حَيَاةُ أَصْدَاءٍ وَهَامِ
verses.translit: haddathanaa aasbaghu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nh tazawwaja amraaaaan min kalbin yuqaalu lahaa aummu bakrin, falammaa haajara aabuw bakrin tallaqahaa, fatazawwajahaa abnu 'ammihaa, hadhaa alshhaa'iru alladhiy qaala hadhihi alqasiydaaa, rathaa kuffaara qurayshin wamaadhaa bialqaliybi qaliybi badrin mina alshhiyzaa tuzayyanu bialssanaami wamaadhaa bialqaliybi, qaliybi badrin mina alqaynaati waalshharbi alkiraami tuhayyiy bialssalaamaai aummu bakrin wahal liy ba'da qawmiy min salaami yuhaddithunaa alrrasuwlu biaan sanahyaa wakayfa hayaaau aasdaa'in wahaami
verses.translation: Narrate Aisha:Abu Bakr married a woman from the tribe of Bani Kalb, called Um Bakr. When Abu Bakr migrated to Medina, he divorced her and she was married by her cousin, the poet who said the following poem lamenting the infidels of Quraish: "What is there kept in the well, The well of Badr, (The owners of) the trays of Roasted camel humps? What is there kept in the well, The well of Badr, (The owners of) lady singers And friends of the honorable companions; who used to drink (wine) together, Um Bakr greets us With the greeting of peace, But can I find peace After my people have gone? The Apostle tells us that We shall live again, But what sort of life will owls and skulls live?:
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْغَارِ فَرَفَعْتُ رَأْسِي، فَإِذَا أَنَا بِأَقْدَامِ الْقَوْمِ، فَقُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، لَوْ أَنَّ بَعْضَهُمْ طَأْطَأَ بَصَرَهُ رَآنَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اسْكُتْ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ، اثْنَانِ اللَّهُ ثَالِثُهُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, 'an aabiy bakrin rda allh 'nh qaala kuntu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alghaari farafa'tu raasiy, faiidhaa aanaa biaaqdaami alqawmi, faqultu yaa nabiyya alllahi, law aanna ba'dahum taataaa basarahu raanaa‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ askut yaa aabaa bakrin, athnaani alllahu thaalithuhumaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakr:I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) in the Cave. When I raised my head, I saw the feet of the people. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If some of them should look down, they will see us." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Bakr, be quiet! (For we are) two and Allah is the Third of us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ الْهِجْرَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَيْحَكَ إِنَّ الْهِجْرَةَ شَأْنُهَا شَدِيدٌ، فَهَلْ لَكَ مِنْ إِبِلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَتُعْطِي صَدَقَتَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلْ تَمْنَحُ مِنْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَتَحْلُبُهَا يَوْمَ وُرُودِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاعْمَلْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْبِحَارِ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَنْ يَتِرَكَ مِنْ عَمَلِكَ شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, ‏.‏ waqaala muhammadu bnu yuwsufa haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, qaala haddathaniy 'ataa'u bnu yaziyda alllaythiyyu, qaala haddathaniy aabuw sa'iydin rda allh 'nh qaala jaa'a aa'raabiyyun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahu 'ani alhijraai faqaala ‏"‏ wayhaka iinna alhijraaa shaanuhaa shadiydun, fahal laka min iibilin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fatu'tiy sadaqatahaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fahal tamnahu minhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fatahlubuhaa yawma wuruwdihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faa'mal min waraa'i albihaari, faiinna alllaha lan yatiraka min 'amalika shayiana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id:Once a bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him about the migration. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Mercy of Allah be on you! The migration is a quite difficult matter. Have you got some camels?" He replied in the affirmative. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you give their Zakat?" He replied in the affirmative. The Prophet said, "Do you let others benefit by their milk gratis?" He replied in the affirmative. Then the Prophet asked, "Do you milk them on their watering days and give their milk to the poor and needy?" He replied in the affirmative. The Prophet, said, "Go on doing like this from beyond the seas, and there is no doubt that Allah will not overlook any of your good deeds
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، سَمِعَ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَوَّلُ مَنْ قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا مُصْعَبُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ وَابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ، ثُمَّ قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا عَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ وَبِلاَلٌ رضى الله عنهم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aanbaaanaa aabuw iishaaqa, sami'a albaraa'a rda allh 'nh qaala aawwalu man qadima 'alaynaa mus'abu bnu 'umayrin waabnu aummi maktuwmin, thumma qadima 'alaynaa 'ammaaru bnu yaasirin wabilaalun rda allh 'nhm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:The first people who came to us (in Medina) were Mus`ab bin `Umair and Ibn Um Maktum. Then came to us `Ammar bin Yasir and Bilal
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَوَّلُ مَنْ قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا مُصْعَبُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ وَابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ، وَكَانَا يُقْرِئَانِ النَّاسَ، فَقَدِمَ بِلاَلٌ وَسَعْدٌ وَعَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ، ثُمَّ قَدِمَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فِي عِشْرِينَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَمَا رَأَيْتُ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَرِحُوا بِشَىْءٍ فَرَحَهُمْ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، حَتَّى جَعَلَ الإِمَاءُ يَقُلْنَ قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَا قَدِمَ حَتَّى قَرَأْتُ ‏{‏سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الأَعْلَى‏}‏ فِي سُوَرٍ مِنَ الْمُفَصَّلِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma qaala aawwalu man qadima 'alaynaa mus'abu bnu 'umayrin waabnu aummi maktuwmin, wakaanaa yuqriiaani alnnaasa, faqadima bilaalun wasa'dun wa'ammaaru bnu yaasirin, thumma qadima 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi fiy 'ishriyna min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm, famaa raaaytu aahla almadiynaai farihuwa bishaa'in farahahum birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, hattaa ja'ala aliimaa'u yaqulna qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm famaa qadima hattaa qaraatu ‏{‏sabbihi asma rabbika alaa'laa‏}‏ fiy suwarin mina almufassali‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:The first people who came to us (in Medina) were Mus`ab bin `Umair and Ibn Um Maktum who were teaching Qur'an to the people. Then there came Bilal, Sa`d and `Ammar bin Yasir. After that `Umar bin Al-Khattab came along with twenty other companions of the Prophet. Later on the Prophet (ﷺ) himself came (to Medina) and I had never seen the people of Medina so joyful as they were on the arrival of Allah's Apostle, for even the slave girls were saying, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has arrived!" And before his arrival I had read the Sura starting with:-- "Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High" (87.1) together with other Suras of Al-Mufassal
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ وُعِكَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَبِلاَلٌ ـ قَالَتْ ـ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِمَا فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَتِ كَيْفَ تَجِدُكَ وَيَا بِلاَلُ، كَيْفَ تَجِدُكَ قَالَتْ فَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِذَا أَخَذَتْهُ الْحُمَّى يَقُولُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مُصَبَّحٌ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَالْمَوْتُ أَدْنَى مِنْ شِرَاكِ نَعْلِهِ وَكَانَ بِلاَلٌ إِذَا أَقْلَعَ عَنْهُ الْحُمَّى يَرْفَعُ عَقِيرَتَهُ وَيَقُولُ أَلاَ لَيْتَ شِعْرِي هَلْ أَبِيتَنَّ لَيْلَةً بِوَادٍ وَحَوْلِي إِذْخِرٌ وَجَلِيلُ وَهَلْ أَرِدَنْ يَوْمًا مِيَاهَ مَجَنَّةٍ وَهَلْ يَبْدُوَنْ لِي شَامَةٌ وَطَفِيلُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَجِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ كَحُبِّنَا مَكَّةَ أَوْ أَشَدَّ، وَصَحِّحْهَا وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِهَا وَمُدِّهَا، وَانْقُلْ حُمَّاهَا فَاجْعَلْهَا بِالْجُحْفَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aannahaa qaalat lammaa qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa wu'ika aabuw bakrin wabilaalun qaalat fadakhaltu 'alayhimaa faqultu yaa aabati kayfa tajiduka wayaa bilaalu, kayfa tajiduka qaalat fakaana aabuw bakrin iidhaa aakhadhathu alhummaa yaquwlu kullu amriiin musabbahun fiy aahlihi waalmawtu aadnaa min shiraaki na'lihi wakaana bilaalun iidhaa aaqla'a 'anhu alhummaa yarfa'u 'aqiyratahu wayaquwlu aalaa layta shi'riy hal aabiytanna laylaaan biwaadin wahawliy iidhkhirun wajaliylu wahal aaridan yawmana miyaaha majannaain wahal yabduwan liy shaamaaun watafiylu qaalat 'aaiishaau fajiitu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbartuhu faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma habbib iilaynaa almadiynaaa kahubbinaa makkaaa aaw aashadda, wasahhihhaa wabaarik lanaa fiy saa'ihaa wamuddihaa, waanqul hummaahaa faaj'alhaa bialjuhfaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina, Abu Bakr and Bilal got fever, and I went to both of them and said, "O my father, how do you feel? O Bilal, how do you feel?" Whenever Abu Bakr's fever got worse, he would say, "Every man will meet his death once in one morning while he will be among his family, for death is really nearer to him than his leather shoe laces (to his feet)." And whenever fever deserted Bilal, he would say aloud, "Would that I know whether I shall spend a night in the valley (of Mecca) with Idhkhir and Jalil (i.e. kinds of grass) around me, and whether I shall drink one day the water of Majannah, and whether I shall see once again the hills of Shamah and Tafil?" Then I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him of that. He said, "O Allah, make us love Medina as much as or more than we used to love Mecca, O Allah, make it healthy and bless its Sa' and Mud (i.e. measures), and take away its fever to Al-Juhfa
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ، أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَدِيٍّ، أَخْبَرَهُ دَخَلْتُ، عَلَى عُثْمَانَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بِشْرُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَدِيِّ بْنِ خِيَارٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ فَتَشَهَّدَ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بَعَثَ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحَقِّ، وَكُنْتُ مِمَّنِ اسْتَجَابَ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ، وَآمَنَ بِمَا بُعِثَ بِهِ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ هَاجَرْتُ هِجْرَتَيْنِ، وَنِلْتُ صِهْرَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَبَايَعْتُهُ، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا عَصَيْتُهُ وَلاَ غَشَشْتُهُ حَتَّى تَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ إِسْحَاقُ الْكَلْبِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa hishaamun, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, haddathaniy 'urwaau, aanna 'ubayda alllahi bna 'adiyyin, aakhbarahu dakhaltu, 'alaa 'uthmaana‏.‏ waqaala bishru bnu shu'aybin haddathaniy aabiy, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, haddathaniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'ubayda alllahi bna 'adiyyi bni khiyaarin, aakhbarahu qaala dakhaltu 'alaa 'uthmaana fatashahhada thumma qaala aammaa ba'du faiinna alllaha ba'atha muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm bialhaqqi, wakuntu mimmani astajaaba lillahi walirasuwlihi, waamana bimaa bu'itha bihi muhammadun sla allh 'lyh wslm, thumma haajartu hijratayni, waniltu sihra rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, wabaaya'tuhu, fawaalllahi maa 'asaytuhu walaa ghashashtuhu hattaa tawaffaahu alllahu‏.‏ taaba'ahu iishaaqu alkalbiyyu haddathaniy alzzuhriyyu mithlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin Adi bin Khiyar:I went to `Uthman. After reciting Tashah-hud, he said,. "Then after no doubt, Allah sent Muhammad with the Truth, and I was amongst those who responded to the Call of Allah and His Prophet and believed in the message of Muhammad. Then I took part in the two migrations. I became the son-in-law of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and gave the pledge of allegiance to him By Allah, I never disobeyed him, nor did I deceive him till Allah took him unto Him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ،‏.‏ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ رَجَعَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ وَهْوَ بِمِنًى، فِي آخِرِ حَجَّةٍ حَجَّهَا عُمَرُ، فَوَجَدَنِي، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِنَّ الْمَوْسِمَ يَجْمَعُ رَعَاعَ النَّاسِ، وَإِنِّي أَرَى أَنْ تُمْهِلَ حَتَّى تَقْدَمَ الْمَدِينَةَ، فَإِنَّهَا دَارُ الْهِجْرَةِ وَالسُّنَّةِ، وَتَخْلُصَ لأَهْلِ الْفِقْهِ وَأَشْرَافِ النَّاسِ وَذَوِي رَأْيِهِمْ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ لأَقُومَنَّ فِي أَوَّلِ مَقَامٍ أَقُومُهُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, haddathaniy abnu wahbin, haddathanaa maalikun, ‏.‏ waaakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna abna 'abbaasin, aakhbarahu aanna 'abda alrrahmani bna 'awfin raja'a iilaa aahlihi wahwa biminana, fiy akhiri hajjaain hajjahaa 'umaru, fawajadaniy, faqaala 'abdu alrrahmani faqultu yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna iinna almawsima yajma'u ra'aa'a alnnaasi, waiinniy aaraa aan tumhila hattaa taqdama almadiynaaa, faiinnahaa daaru alhijraai waalssunnaai, watakhlusa laahli alfiqhi waaashraafi alnnaasi wadhawiy raayihim‏.‏ qaala 'umaru laaquwmanna fiy aawwali maqaamin aaquwmuhu bialmadiynaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:During the last Hajj led by `Umar, `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf returned to his family at Mina and met me there. `AbdurRahman said (to `Umar), "O chief of the believers! The season of Hajj is the season when there comes the scum of the people (besides the good amongst them), so I recommend that you should wait till you go back to Medina, for it is the place of Migration and Sunna (i.e. the Prophet's tradition), and there you will be able to refer the matter to the religious scholars and the nobles and the people of wise opinions." `Umar said, "I will speak of it in Medina on my very first sermon I will deliver there
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، أَنَّ أُمَّ الْعَلاَءِ ـ امْرَأَةً مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ بَايَعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ مَظْعُونٍ طَارَ لَهُمْ فِي السُّكْنَى حِينَ اقْتَرَعَتِ الأَنْصَارُ عَلَى سُكْنَى الْمُهَاجِرِينَ، قَالَتْ أُمُّ الْعَلاَءِ فَاشْتَكَى عُثْمَانُ عِنْدَنَا، فَمَرَّضْتُهُ حَتَّى تُوُفِّيَ، وَجَعَلْنَاهُ فِي أَثْوَابِهِ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ أَبَا السَّائِبِ، شَهَادَتِي عَلَيْكَ لَقَدْ أَكْرَمَكَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَمَا يُدْرِيكِ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَكْرَمَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ لاَ أَدْرِي بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَمَنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا هُوَ فَقَدْ جَاءَهُ وَاللَّهِ الْيَقِينُ، وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَرْجُو لَهُ الْخَيْرَ، وَمَا أَدْرِي وَاللَّهِ وَأَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ مَا يُفْعَلُ بِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ أُزَكِّي أَحَدًا بَعْدَهُ قَالَتْ فَأَحْزَنَنِي ذَلِكَ فَنِمْتُ فَأُرِيتُ لِعُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ عَيْنًا تَجْرِي، فَجِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ عَمَلُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, aakhbaranaa abnu shihaabin, 'an khaarijaaa bni zaydi bni thaabitin, aanna aumma al'alaa'i amraaaaan min nisaaiihim baaya'ati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathu aanna 'uthmaana bna maz'uwnin taara lahum fiy alssuknaa hiyna aqtara'ati alaansaaru 'alaa suknaa almuhaajiriyna, qaalat aummu al'alaa'i faashtakaa 'uthmaanu 'indanaa, famarradtuhu hattaa tuwuffiya, waja'alnaahu fiy aathwaabihi, fadakhala 'alaynaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu rahmaau alllahi 'alayka aabaa alssaaiibi, shahaadatiy 'alayka laqad aakramaka alllahu‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ wamaa yudriyki aanna alllaha aakramahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat qultu laa aadriy biaabiy aanta waaummiy yaa rasuwla alllahi faman qaala ‏"‏ aammaa huwa faqad jaa'ahu waalllahi alyaqiynu, waalllahi iinniy laarjuw lahu alkhayra, wamaa aadriy waalllahi waaanaa rasuwlu alllahi maa yuf'alu biy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat fawaalllahi laa auzakkiy aahadana ba'dahu qaalat faaahzananiy dhalika fanimtu faauriytu li'uthmaana bni maz'uwnin 'aynana tajriy, fajiitu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbartuhu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ dhalika 'amaluhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Um Al-`Ala:An Ansari woman who gave the pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) that the Ansar drew lots concerning the dwelling of the Emigrants. `Uthman bin Maz'un was decided to dwell with them (i.e. Um Al-`Ala's family), `Uthman fell ill and I nursed him till he died, and we covered him with his clothes. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) came to us and I (addressing the dead body) said, "O Abu As-Sa'ib, may Allah's Mercy be on you! I bear witness that Allah has honored you." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "How do you know that Allah has honored him?" I replied, "I do not know. May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! But who else is worthy of it (if not `Uthman)?" He said, "As to him, by Allah, death has overtaken him, and I hope the best for him. By Allah, though I am the Apostle of Allah, yet I do not know what Allah will do to me," By Allah, I will never assert the piety of anyone after him. That made me sad, and when I slept I saw in a dream a flowing stream for `Uthman bin Maz'un. I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him of it. He remarked, "That symbolizes his (good) deeds
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ يَوْمُ بُعَاثٍ يَوْمًا قَدَّمَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لِرَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ وَقَدِ افْتَرَقَ مَلَؤُهُمْ، وَقُتِلَتْ سَرَاتُهُمْ فِي دُخُولِهِمْ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana yawmu bu'aathin yawmana qaddamahu alllahu 'azza wajalla lirasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm, faqadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa waqadi aftaraqa malauuhum, waqutilat saraatuhum fiy dukhuwlihim fiy aliislaami‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The day of Bu'ath was a day (i.e. battle) which Allah caused to take place just before the mission of His Apostle so that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina, they (the tribes) had divided (into hostile groups) and their nobles had been killed; and all that facilitated their conversion to Islam
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَهَا يَوْمَ فِطْرٍ أَوْ أَضْحًى، وَعِنْدَهَا قَيْنَتَانِ ‏{‏تُغَنِّيَانِ‏}‏ بِمَا تَقَاذَفَتِ الأَنْصَارُ يَوْمَ بُعَاثَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مِزْمَارُ الشَّيْطَانِ مَرَّتَيْنِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ دَعْهُمَا يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ، إِنَّ لِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ عِيدًا، وَإِنَّ عِيدَنَا هَذَا الْيَوْمُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna aabaa bakrin, dakhala 'alayhaa waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'indahaa yawma fitrin aaw aadhana, wa'indahaa qaynataani ‏{‏tughanniyaani‏}‏ bimaa taqaadhafati alaansaaru yawma bu'aatha‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin mizmaaru alshhaytaani marratayni‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ da'humaa yaa aabaa bakrin, iinna likulli qawmin 'iydana, waiinna 'iydanaa hadhaa alyawmu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:That once Abu Bakr came to her on the day of `Id-ul-Fitr or `Id ul Adha while the Prophet (ﷺ) was with her and there were two girl singers with her, singing songs of the Ansar about the day of Buath. Abu Bakr said twice. "Musical instrument of Satan!" But the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave them Abu Bakr, for every nation has an `Id (i.e. festival) and this day is our `Id
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو التَّيَّاحِ، يَزِيدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ الضُّبَعِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ، نَزَلَ فِي عُلْوِ الْمَدِينَةِ فِي حَىٍّ يُقَالُ لَهُمْ بَنُو عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ ـ قَالَ ـ فَأَقَامَ فِيهِمْ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ لَيْلَةً، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ إِلَى مَلإِ بَنِي النَّجَّارِ ـ قَالَ ـ فَجَاءُوا مُتَقَلِّدِي سُيُوفِهِمْ، قَالَ وَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ رِدْفَهُ، وَمَلأُ بَنِي النَّجَّارِ حَوْلَهُ حَتَّى أَلْقَى بِفِنَاءِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ فَكَانَ يُصَلِّي حَيْثُ أَدْرَكَتْهُ الصَّلاَةُ، وَيُصَلِّي فِي مَرَابِضِ الْغَنَمِ، قَالَ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ أَمَرَ بِبِنَاءِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى مَلإِ بَنِي النَّجَّارِ، فَجَاءُوا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا بَنِي النَّجَّارِ، ثَامِنُونِي حَائِطَكُمْ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لاَ، وَاللَّهِ لاَ نَطْلُبُ ثَمَنَهُ إِلاَّ إِلَى اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَانَ فِيهِ مَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ كَانَتْ فِيهِ قُبُورُ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، وَكَانَتْ فِيهِ خِرَبٌ، وَكَانَ فِيهِ نَخْلٌ، فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقُبُورِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَنُبِشَتْ، وَبِالْخِرَبِ فَسُوِّيَتْ، وَبِالنَّخْلِ فَقُطِعَ، قَالَ فَصَفُّوا النَّخْلَ قِبْلَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ ـ قَالَ ـ وَجَعَلُوا عِضَادَتَيْهِ حِجَارَةً‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ جَعَلُوا يَنْقُلُونَ ذَاكَ الصَّخْرَ وَهُمْ يَرْتَجِزُونَ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَهُمْ يَقُولُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ لاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُ الآخِرَهْ فَانْصُرِ الأَنْصَارَ وَالْمُهَاجِرَهْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, ‏.‏ wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alssamadi, qaala sami'tu aabiy yuhaddithu, haddathanaa aabuw alttayyaahi, yaziydu bnu humaydin aldduba'iyyu qaala haddathaniy aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa, nazala fiy 'ulwi almadiynaai fiy haaain yuqaalu lahum banuw 'amriw bni 'awfin qaala faaaqaama fiyhim aarba'a 'ashraaa laylaaan, thumma aarsala iilaa malii baniy alnnajjaari qaala fajaa'uwa mutaqallidiy suyuwfihim, qaala wakaaanniy aanzuru iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa raahilatihi, waaabuw bakrin ridfahu, wamalau baniy alnnajjaari hawlahu hattaa aalqaa bifinaa'i aabiy aayyuwba, qaala fakaana yusalliy haythu aadrakathu alssalaaau, wayusalliy fiy maraabidi alghanami, qaala thumma iinnahu aamara bibinaa'i almasjidi, faaarsala iilaa malii baniy alnnajjaari, fajaa'uwa faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa baniy alnnajjaari, thaaminuwniy haaiitakum hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa laa, waalllahi laa natlubu thamanahu iilaaa iilaa alllahi‏.‏ qaala fakaana fiyhi maa aaquwlu lakum kaanat fiyhi qubuwru almushrikiyna, wakaanat fiyhi khirabun, wakaana fiyhi nakhlun, faaamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biqubuwri almushrikiyna fanubishat, wabialkhirabi fasuwwiyat, wabialnnakhli faquti'a, qaala fasaffuwa alnnakhla qiblaaa almasjidi qaala waja'aluwa 'idaadatayhi hijaaraaan‏.‏ qaala qaala ja'aluwa yanquluwna dhaaka alssakhra wahum yartajizuwna, warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ma'ahum yaquwluwna alllahumma iinnahu laa khayra iilaaa khayru alakhirah faansuri alaansaara waalmuhaajirah‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived at Medina, he alighted at the upper part of Medina among the people called Bani `Amr bin `Auf and he stayed with them for fourteen nights. Then he sent for the chiefs of Bani An-Najjar, and they came, carrying their swords. As if I am just now looking at Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on his she-camel with Abu Bakr riding behind him (on the same camel) and the chiefs of Bani An- Najjar around him till he dismounted in the courtyard of Abu Aiyub's home. The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the prayer wherever the prayer was due, and he would pray even in sheepfolds. Then he ordered that the mosque be built. He sent for the chiefs of Banu An-Najjar, and when they came, he said, "O Banu An-Najjar! Suggest to me the price of this garden of yours." They replied "No! By Allah, we do not demand its price except from Allah." In that garden there were the (following) things that I will tell you: Graves of pagans, unleveled land with holes and pits etc., and date-palm trees. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that the graves of the pagans be dug up and, the unleveled land be leveled and the date-palm trees be cut down. The trunks of the trees were arranged so as to form the wall facing the Qibla. The Stone pillars were built at the sides of its gate. The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) were carrying the stones and reciting some lyrics, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . . was with them and they were saying, "O Allah! There is no good except the good of the Hereafter, so bestow victory on the Ansar and the Emigrants
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، يَسْأَلُ السَّائِبَ ابْنَ أُخْتِ النَّمِرِ مَا سَمِعْتَ فِي، سُكْنَى مَكَّةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْعَلاَءَ بْنَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثٌ لِلْمُهَاجِرِ بَعْدَ الصَّدَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu hamzaaa, haddathanaa haatimun, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni humaydin alzzuhriyyi, qaala sami'tu 'umara bna 'abdi al'aziyzi, yasaalu alssaaiiba abna aukhti alnnamiri maa sami'ta fiy, suknaa makkaaa qaala sami'tu al'alaa'a bna alhadramiyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ thalaathun lilmuhaajiri ba'da alssadari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Humaid Az-Zuhri:I heard `Umar bin `Abdul-Aziz asking As-Sa'ib, the nephew of An-Namir, "What have you heard about residing in Mecca?" The other said, "I heard Al-Ala bin Al-Hadrami saying, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: An Emigrant is allowed to stay in Mecca for three days after departing from Mina (i.e. after performing all the ceremonies of Hajj)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ مَا عَدُّوا مِنْ مَبْعَثِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلاَ مِنْ وَفَاتِهِ، مَا عَدُّوا إِلاَّ مِنْ مَقْدَمِهِ الْمَدِينَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sahli bni sa'din, qaala maa 'adduwa min mab'athi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm walaa min wafaatihi, maa 'adduwa iilaaa min maqdamihi almadiynaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet's companions did not take as a starting date for the Muslim calendar, the day, the Prophet (ﷺ) had been sent as an Apostle or the day of his death, but the day of his arrival at Medina
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ فُرِضَتِ الصَّلاَةُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ هَاجَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَفُرِضَتْ أَرْبَعًا، وَتُرِكَتْ صَلاَةُ السَّفَرِ عَلَى الأُولَى‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat furidati alssalaaau rak'atayni, thumma haajara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fafuridat aarba'ana, waturikat salaaau alssafari 'alaa alauwlaa‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'abdu alrrazzaaqi 'an ma'marin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Originally, two rak`at were prescribed in every prayer. When the Prophet (ﷺ) migrated (to Medina) four rak`at were enjoined, while the journey prayer remained unchanged(i.e. two rak`at)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ عَادَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ مِنْ مَرَضٍ أَشْفَيْتُ مِنْهُ عَلَى الْمَوْتِ، فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، بَلَغَ بِي مِنَ الْوَجَعِ مَا تَرَى، وَأَنَا ذُو مَالٍ وَلاَ يَرِثُنِي إِلاَّ ابْنَةٌ لِي وَاحِدَةٌ، أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِثُلُثَىْ مَالِي قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِشَطْرِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الثُّلُثُ يَا سَعْدُ، وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ، إِنَّكَ أَنْ تَذَرَ ذُرِّيَّتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَذَرَهُمْ عَالَةً يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تَذَرَ ذُرِّيَّتَكَ، وَلَسْتَ بِنَافِقٍ نَفَقَةً تَبْتَغِي بِهَا وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ آجَرَكَ اللَّهُ بِهَا، حَتَّى اللُّقْمَةَ تَجْعَلُهَا فِي فِي امْرَأَتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أُخَلَّفُ بَعْدَ أَصْحَابِي قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تُخَلَّفَ فَتَعْمَلَ عَمَلاً تَبْتَغِي بِهِ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ ازْدَدْتَ بِهِ دَرَجَةً وَرِفْعَةً، وَلَعَلَّكَ تُخَلَّفُ حَتَّى يَنْتَفِعَ بِكَ أَقْوَامٌ، وَيُضَرَّ بِكَ آخَرُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أَمْضِ لأَصْحَابِي هِجْرَتَهُمْ، وَلاَ تَرُدَّهُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ، لَكِنِ الْبَائِسُ سَعْدُ ابْنُ خَوْلَةَ يَرْثِي لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تُوُفِّيَ بِمَكَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ وَمُوسَى عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تَذَرَ وَرَثَتَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'di bni maalikin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala 'aadaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama hajjaai alwadaa'i min maradin aashfaytu minhu 'alaa almawti, faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, balagha biy mina alwaja'i maa taraa, waaanaa dhuw maalin walaa yarithuniy iilaaa abnaaun liy waahidaaun, aafaaatasaddaqu bithuluthaa maaliy qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faaatasaddaqu bishatrihi qaala ‏"‏ althhuluthu yaa sa'du, waalthhuluthu kathiyrun, iinnaka aan tadhara dhurriyyataka aaghniyaa'a khayrun min aan tadharahum 'aalaaan yatakaffafuwna alnnaasa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aahmadu bnu yuwnusa 'an iibraahiyma ‏"‏ aan tadhara dhurriyyataka, walasta binaafiqin nafaqaaan tabtaghiy bihaa wajha alllahi iilaaa ajaraka alllahu bihaa, hattaa allluqmaaa taj'aluhaa fiy fiy amraaatika ‏"‏‏.‏ qulta yaa rasuwla alllahi, aukhallafu ba'da aashaabiy qaala ‏"‏ iinnaka lan tukhallafa fata'mala 'amalaan tabtaghiy bihi wajha alllahi iilaaa azdadta bihi darajaaan warif'aaan, wala'allaka tukhallafu hattaa yantafi'a bika aaqwaamun, wayudarra bika akharuwna, alllahumma aamdi laashaabiy hijratahum, walaa taruddahum 'alaa aa'qaabihim, lakini albaaiisu sa'du abnu khawlaaa yarthiy lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan tuwuffiya bimakkaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala aahmadu bnu yuwnusa wamuwsaa 'an iibraahiyma ‏"‏ aan tadhara warathataka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d bin Malik:In the year of Hajjat-ul-Wada` the Prophet (ﷺ) visited me when I fell ill and was about to die because of that illness. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am very ill as you see, and I am a rich man and have no heir except my only daughter. Shall I give 2/3 of my property in charity?" He said, "No." I said, "Shall I then give one half of it in charity?" He said, "O Sa`d! Give 1/3 (in charity) and even 1/3 is too much. No doubt, it is better to leave your children rich than to leave them poor, reduced to begging from others. And Allah will reward you for whatever you spend with the intention of gaining Allah's Pleasure even if it were a mouthful of food you put into your wives mouth." I said, "O Allah's Apostle! Am I to be left behind (in Mecca) after my companions have gone?" He said, "If you should be left behind, you will be upgraded and elevated for every deed you will do with a desire to achieve Allah's Pleasure. I hope that you will live long so that some people will benefit by you while others will be harmed. O Allah! Please fulfill the migration of my companions and do not make them turn back on their heels. But (we feel sorry for) the unlucky Sa`d bin Khaulah." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lamented his death in Mecca
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَدِمَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ، فَآخَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ سَعْدِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، فَعَرَضَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُنَاصِفَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمَالَهُ، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، دُلَّنِي عَلَى السُّوقِ‏.‏ فَرَبِحَ شَيْئًا مِنْ أَقِطٍ وَسَمْنٍ، فَرَآهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ أَيَّامٍ وَعَلَيْهِ وَضَرٌ مِنْ صُفْرَةٍ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَهْيَمْ يَا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، تَزَوَّجْتُ امْرَأَةً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَا سُقْتَ فِيهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَزْنَ نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوْلِمْ وَلَوْ بِشَاةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an humaydin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala qadima 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'awfin, faakhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm baynahu wabayna sa'di bni alrrabiy'i alaansaariyyi, fa'arada 'alayhi aan yunaasifahu aahlahu wamaalahu, faqaala 'abdu alrrahmani baaraka alllahu laka fiy aahlika wamaalika, dullaniy 'alaa alssuwqi‏.‏ farabiha shayiana min aaqitin wasamnin, faraahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da aayyaamin wa'alayhi wadarun min sufraain, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ mahyam yaa 'abda alrrahmani ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, tazawwajtu amraaaaan mina alaansaari‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ famaa suqta fiyhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala wazna nawaaain min dhahabin‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aawlim walaw bishaaain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:When `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf came to Medina and the Prophet (ﷺ) established the bond of brotherhood between him and Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi-al-Ansari, Sa`d suggested that `Abdur-Rahman should accept half of his property and family. `Abdur Rahman said, "May Allah bless you in your family and property; guide me to the market." So `Abdur-Rahman (while doing business in the market) made some profit of some condensed dry yoghurt and butter. After a few days the Prophet (ﷺ) saw him wearing clothes stained with yellow perfume. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What is this, O `Abdur-Rahman?" He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have married an Ansar' woman." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What have you given her as Mahr?" He (i.e. `Abdur-Rahman) said, "A piece of gold, about the weight of a date stone." Then the Prophet said, Give a banquet, even though of a sheep
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَلاَمٍ، بَلَغَهُ مَقْدَمُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ، فَأَتَاهُ يَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ، فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَائِلُكَ عَنْ ثَلاَثٍ لاَ يَعْلَمُهُنَّ إِلاَّ نَبِيٌّ مَا أَوَّلُ أَشْرَاطِ السَّاعَةِ وَمَا أَوَّلُ طَعَامٍ يَأْكُلُهُ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ وَمَا بَالُ الْوَلَدِ يَنْزِعُ إِلَى أَبِيهِ أَوْ إِلَى أُمِّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ جِبْرِيلُ آنِفًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ سَلاَمٍ ذَاكَ عَدُوُّ الْيَهُودِ مِنَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا أَوَّلُ أَشْرَاطِ السَّاعَةِ فَنَارٌ تَحْشُرُهُمْ مِنَ الْمَشْرِقِ إِلَى الْمَغْرِبِ، وَأَمَّا أَوَّلُ طَعَامٍ يَأْكُلُهُ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ، فَزِيَادَةُ كَبِدِ الْحُوتِ، وَأَمَّا الْوَلَدُ، فَإِذَا سَبَقَ مَاءُ الرَّجُلِ مَاءَ الْمَرْأَةِ نَزَعَ الْوَلَدَ، وَإِذَا سَبَقَ مَاءُ الْمَرْأَةِ مَاءَ الرَّجُلِ نَزَعَتِ الْوَلَدَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ الْيَهُودَ قَوْمٌ بُهُتٌ، فَاسْأَلْهُمْ عَنِّي قَبْلَ أَنْ يَعْلَمُوا بِإِسْلاَمِي، فَجَاءَتِ الْيَهُودُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَىُّ رَجُلٍ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ فِيكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا خَيْرُنَا وَابْنُ خَيْرِنَا وَأَفْضَلُنَا وَابْنُ أَفْضَلِنَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَسْلَمَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا أَعَاذَهُ اللَّهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَأَعَادَ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَقَالُوا مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالُوا شَرُّنَا وَابْنُ شَرِّنَا‏.‏ وَتَنَقَّصُوهُ‏.‏ قَالَ هَذَا كُنْتُ أَخَافُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haamidu bnu 'umara, 'an bishri bni almufaddali, haddathanaa humaydun, haddathanaa aanasun, aanna 'abda alllahi bna salaamin, balaghahu maqdamu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa, faaataahu yasaaluhu 'an aashyaa'a, faqaala iinniy saaiiluka 'an thalaathin laa ya'lamuhunna iilaaa nabiyyun maa aawwalu aashraati alssaa'aai wamaa aawwalu ta'aamin yaakuluhu aahlu aljannaai wamaa baalu alwaladi yanzi'u iilaa aabiyhi aaw iilaa aummihi qaala ‏"‏ aakhbaraniy bihi jibriylu anifana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala abnu salaamin dhaaka 'aduwwu alyahuwdi mina almalaaiikaai‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aammaa aawwalu aashraati alssaa'aai fanaarun tahshuruhum mina almashriqi iilaa almaghribi, waaammaa aawwalu ta'aamin yaakuluhu aahlu aljannaai, faziyaadaau kabidi alhuwti, waaammaa alwaladu, faiidhaa sabaqa maa'u alrrajuli maa'a almaraaai naza'a alwalada, waiidhaa sabaqa maa'u almaraaai maa'a alrrajuli naza'ati alwalada ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aashhadu aanna laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waaannaka rasuwlu alllahi‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, iinna alyahuwda qawmun buhutun, faasaalhum 'anniy qabla aan ya'lamuwa biiislaamiy, fajaa'ati alyahuwdu faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaaau rajulin 'abdu alllahi bnu salaamin fiykum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa khayrunaa waabnu khayrinaa waaafdalunaa waabnu aafdalinaa‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaraaaytum iin aaslama 'abdu alllahi bnu salaamin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa aa'aadhahu alllahu min dhalika‏.‏ faaa'aada 'alayhim, faqaaluwa mithla dhalika, fakharaja iilayhim 'abdu alllahi faqaala aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waaanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi‏.‏ qaaluwa sharrunaa waabnu sharrinaa‏.‏ watanaqqasuwhu‏.‏ qaala hadhaa kuntu aakhaafu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:When the news of the arrival of the Prophet (ﷺ) at Medina reached `Abdullah bin Salam, he went to him to ask him about certain things, He said, "I am going to ask you about three things which only a Prophet can answer: What is the first sign of The Hour? What is the first food which the people of Paradise will eat? Why does a child attract the similarity to his father or to his mother?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Gabriel has just now informed me of that." Ibn Salam said, "He (i.e. Gabriel) is the enemy of the Jews amongst the angels. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "As for the first sign of The Hour, it will be a fire that will collect the people from the East to the West. As for the first meal which the people of Paradise will eat, it will be the caudate (extra) lobe of the fish-liver. As for the child, if the man's discharge proceeds the woman's discharge, the child attracts the similarity to the man, and if the woman's discharge proceeds the man's, then the child attracts the similarity to the woman." On this, `Abdullah bin Salam said, "I testify that None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and that you are the Messenger of Allah." and added, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Jews invent such lies as make one astonished, so please ask them about me before they know about my conversion to Islam. " The Jews came, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What kind of man is `Abdullah bin Salam among you?" They replied, "The best of us and the son of the best of us and the most superior among us, and the son of the most superior among us. "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What would you think if `Abdullah bin Salam should embrace Islam?" They said, "May Allah protect him from that." The Prophet (ﷺ) repeated his question and they gave the same answer. Then `Abdullah came out to them and said, "I testify that None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah!" On this, the Jews said, "He is the most wicked among us and the son of the most wicked among us." So they degraded him. On this, he (i.e. `Abdullah bin Salam) said, "It is this that I was afraid of, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعَ أَبَا الْمِنْهَالِ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ مُطْعِمٍ، قَالَ بَاعَ شَرِيكٌ لِي دَرَاهِمَ فِي السُّوقِ نَسِيئَةً فَقُلْتُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ أَيَصْلُحُ هَذَا فَقَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ بِعْتُهَا فِي السُّوقِ فَمَا عَابَهُ أَحَدٌ، فَسَأَلْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ فَقَالَ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ نَتَبَايَعُ هَذَا الْبَيْعَ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا كَانَ يَدًا بِيَدٍ فَلَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسٌ، وَمَا كَانَ نَسِيئَةً فَلاَ يَصْلُحُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَالْقَ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ فَاسْأَلْهُ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ أَعْظَمَنَا تِجَارَةً، فَسَأَلْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ فَقَالَ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً فَقَالَ قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ وَنَحْنُ نَتَبَايَعُ، وَقَالَ نَسِيئَةً إِلَى الْمَوْسِمِ أَوِ الْحَجِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, sami'a aabaa alminhaali 'abda alrrahmani bna mut'imin, qaala baa'a shariykun liy daraahima fiy alssuwqi nasiyiaaan faqultu subhaana alllahi aayasluhu hadhaa faqaala subhaana alllahi, waalllahi laqad bi'tuhaa fiy alssuwqi famaa 'aabahu aahadun, fasaaaltu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin faqaala qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu natabaaya'u hadhaa albay'a, faqaala ‏ "‏ maa kaana yadana biyadin falaysa bihi baasun, wamaa kaana nasiyiaaan falaa yasluhu ‏"‏‏.‏ waalqa zayda bna aarqama faasaalhu faiinnahu kaana aa'zamanaa tijaaraaan, fasaaaltu zayda bna aarqama faqaala mithlahu‏.‏ waqaala sufyaanu marraaan faqaala qadima 'alaynaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa wanahnu natabaaya'u, waqaala nasiyiaaan iilaa almawsimi aawi alhajji‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Al-Minhal `AbdurRahman bin Mut`im:A partner of mine sold some Dirhams on credit in the market. I said, "Glorified be Allah! Is this legal?" He replied, "Glorified be Allah! By Allah, when I sold them in the market, nobody objected to it." Then I asked Al-Bara' bin `Azib (about it) he said, "We used to make such a transaction when the Prophet came to Medina. So he said, 'There is no harm in it if it is done from hand to hand, but it is not allowed on credit.' Go to Zaid bin Al- Arqam and ask him about it for he was the greatest trader of all of us." So I asked Zaid bin Al-Arqam., and he said the same (as Al-Bara) did
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْ آمَنَ بِي عَشَرَةٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ لآمَنَ بِي الْيَهُودُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa qurraau, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ law amana biy 'asharaaun mina alyahuwdi lamana biy alyahuwdu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Had only ten Jews (amongst their chiefs) believed me, all the Jews would definitely have believed me
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 63 — Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ ـ أَوْ مُحَمَّدُ ـ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْغُدَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ أُسَامَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عُمَيْسٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ وَإِذَا أُنَاسٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ يُعَظِّمُونَ عَاشُورَاءَ وَيَصُومُونَهُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نَحْنُ أَحَقُّ بِصَوْمِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِصَوْمِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu aaw muhammadu bnu 'ubaydi alllahi alghudaaniyyu haddathanaa hammaadu bnu ausaamaaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'umaysin, 'an qaysi bni muslimin, 'an taariqi bni shihaabin, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh qaala dakhala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa waiidhaa aunaasun mina alyahuwdi yu'azzimuwna 'aashuwraa'a wayasuwmuwnahu faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ nahnu aahaqqu bisawmihi ‏"‏‏.‏ faaamara bisawmihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Medina, he noticed that some people among the Jews used to respect Ashura' (i.e. 10th of Muharram) and fast on it. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "We have more right to observe fast on this day." and ordered that fasting should be observed on it
