الإِلَهِ وَإِنْ يَشَأْ يُبَارِكْ عَلَى أَوْصَالِ شِلْوٍ مُمَزَّعِ ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَيْهِ أَبُو سِرْوَعَةَ عُقْبَةُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، فَقَتَلَهُ وَكَانَ خُبَيْبٌ هُوَ سَنَّ لِكُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ قُتِلَ صَبْرًا الصَّلاَةَ، وَأَخْبَرَ أَصْحَابَهُ يَوْمَ أُصِيبُوا خَبَرَهُمْ، وَبَعَثَ نَاسٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ إِلَى عَاصِمِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ حِينَ حُدِّثُوا أَنَّهُ قُتِلَ أَنْ يُؤْتَوْا بِشَىْءٍ مِنْهُ يُعْرَفُ، وَكَانَ قَتَلَ رَجُلاً عَظِيمًا مِنْ عُظَمَائِهِمْ، فَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ لِعَاصِمٍ مِثْلَ الظُّلَّةِ مِنَ الدَّبْرِ، فَحَمَتْهُ مِنْ رُسُلِهِمْ، فَلَمْ يَقْدِرُوا أَنْ يَقْطَعُوا مِنْهُ شَيْئًا‏.‏ وَقَالَ كَعْبُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ذَكَرُوا مُرَارَةَ بْنَ الرَّبِيعِ الْعَمْرِيَّ وَهِلاَلَ بْنَ أُمَيَّةَ الْوَاقِفِيَّ، رَجُلَيْنِ صَالِحَيْنِ قَدْ شَهِدَا بَدْرًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa iibraahiymu, aakhbaranaa abnu shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'umaru bnu aasiydi bni jaariyaaa althhaqafiyyu, haliyfu baniy zuhraaa wakaana min aashaabi aabiy hurayraaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'asharaaan 'aynana, waaammara 'alayhim 'aasima bna thaabitin alaansaariyya, jadda 'aasimi bni 'umara bni alkhattaabi, hattaa iidhaa kaanuwa bialhadaai bayna 'usfaana wamakkaaa dhukiruwa lihaaain min hudhaylin yuqaalu lahum banuw lihyaana, fanafaruwa lahum biqariybin min miaiaai rajulin raamin, faaqtassuwa athaarahum hattaa wajaduwa maakalahumu alttamra fiy manzilin nazaluwhu faqaaluwa tamru yathriba‏.‏ faattaba'uwa athaarahum, falammaa hassa bihim 'aasimun waaashaabuhu lajaiuwa iilaa mawdi'in, faaahaata bihimu alqawmu, faqaaluwa lahum anziluwa faaa'tuwa biaaydiykum walakumu al'ahdu waalmiythaaqu aan laa naqtula minkum aahadana‏.‏ faqaala 'aasimu bnu thaabitin aayyuhaa alqawmu, aammaa aanaa falaa aanzilu fiy dhimmaai kaafirin‏.‏ thumma qaala alllahumma aakhbir 'annaa nabiyyaka sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faramawhum bialnnabli, faqataluwa 'aasimana, wanazala iilayhim thalaathaau nafarin 'alaa al'ahdi waalmiythaaqi, minhum khubaybun wazaydu bnu alddathinaai, warajulun akharu, falammaa astamkanuwa minhum aatlaquwa aawtaara qisiyyihim farabatuwhum bihaa‏.‏ qaala alrrajulu althhaalithu hadhaa aawwalu alghadri, waalllahi laa aashabukum, iinna liy bihauulaa'i auswaaan‏.‏ yuriydu alqatlaa, fajarraruwhu wa'aalajuwhu, faaabaa aan yashabahum, faantuliqa bikhubaybin wazaydi bni alddathinaai hattaa baa'uwhumaa ba'da waq'aai badrin, faabtaa'a banuw alhaarithi bni 'aamiri bni nawfalin khubaybana, wakaana khubaybun huwa qatala alhaaritha bna 'aamirin yawma badrin, falabitha khubaybun 'indahum aasiyrana hattaa aajma'uwa qatlahu, faasta'aara min ba'di banaati alhaarithi muwsaa yastahiddu bihaa faaa'aarathu, fadaraja bunaaaun lahaa wahaa ghaafilaaun hattaa aataahu, fawajadathu mujlisahu 'alaa fakhidhihi waalmuwsaa biyadihi qaalat fafazi'tu faz'aaan 'arafahaa khubaybun faqaala aatakhshayna aan aaqtulahu maa kuntu laaf'ala dhalika qaalat waalllahi maa raaaytu aasiyrana qattu khayrana min khubaybin, waalllahi laqad wajadtuhu yawmana yaakulu qitfana min 'inabin fiy yadihi, waiinnahu lamuwthaqun bialhadiydi, wamaa bimakkaaa min thamaraain wakaanat taquwlu iinnahu larizqun razaqahu alllahu khubaybana, falammaa kharajuwa bihi mina alharami liyaqtuluwhu fiy alhilli qaala lahum khubaybun da'uwniy ausalliy rak'atayni‏.‏ fatarakuwhu faraka'a rak'atayni, faqaala waalllahi lawlaa aan tahsibuwa aanna maa biy jaza'un lazidtu, thumma qaala alllahumma aahsihim 'adadana, waaqtulhum badadana, walaa tubqi minhum aahadana‏.‏ thumma aanshaaa yaquwlu falastu aubaaliy hiyna auqtalu muslimana 'alaa aaaai janbin kaana lillahi masra'iy wadhalika fiy dhaati aliilahi waiin yashaa yubaarik 'alaa aawsaali shilwin mumazza'i thumma qaama iilayhi aabuw sirwa'aaa 'uqbaau bnu alhaarithi, faqatalahu wakaana khubaybun huwa sanna likulli muslimin qutila sabrana alssalaaaa, waaakhbara aashaabahu yawma ausiybuwa khabarahum, waba'atha naasun min qurayshin iilaa 'aasimi bni thaabitin hiyna huddithuwa aannahu qutila aan yuutawa bishaa'in minhu yu'rafu, wakaana qatala rajulaan 'aziymana min 'uzamaaiihim, faba'atha alllahu li'aasimin mithla alzzullaai mina alddabri, fahamathu min rusulihim, falam yaqdiruwa aan yaqta'uwa minhu shayiana‏.‏ waqaala ka'bu bnu maalikin dhakaruwa muraaraaa bna alrrabiy'i al'amriyya wahilaala bna aumayyaaa alwaaqifiyya, rajulayni saalihayni qad shahidaa badrana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent out ten spies under the command of `Asim bin Thabit Al-Ansari, the grand-father of `Asim bin `Umar Al-Khattab. When they reached (a place called) Al-Hadah between 'Usfan and Mecca, their presence was made known to a sub-tribe of Hudhail called Banu Lihyan. So they sent about one hundred archers after them. The archers traced the footsteps (of the Muslims) till they found the traces of dates which they had eaten at one of their camping places. The archers said, "These dates are of Yathrib (i.e. Medina)," and went on tracing the Muslims' footsteps. When `Asim and his companions became aware of them, they took refuge in a (high) place. But the enemy encircled them and said, "Come down and surrender. We give you a solemn promise and covenant that we will not kill anyone of you." `Asim bin Thabit said, "O people! As for myself, I will never get down to be under the protection of an infidel. O Allah! Inform your Prophet about us." So the archers threw their arrows at them and martyred `Asim. Three of them came down and surrendered to them, accepting their promise and covenant and they were Khubaib, Zaid bin Ad-Dathina and another man. When the archers got hold of them, they untied the strings of the arrow bows and tied their captives with them. The third man said, "This is the first proof of treachery! By Allah, I will not go with you for I follow the example of these." He meant the martyred companions. The archers dragged him and struggled with him (till they martyred him). Then Khubaib and Zaid bin Ad-Dathina were taken away by them and later on they sold them as slaves in Mecca after the event of the Badr battle. The sons of Al-Harith bin `Amr bin Naufal bought Khubaib for he was a person who had killed (their father) Al-Harith bin `Amr on the day (of the battle) of Badr. Khubaib remained imprisoned by them till they decided unanimously to kill him. One day Khubaib borrowed from a daughter of Al-Harith, a razor for shaving his pubic hair, and she lent it to him. By chance, while she was inattentive, a little son of hers went to him (i.e. Khubaib) and she saw that Khubaib had seated him on his thigh while the razor was in his hand. She was so much terrified that Khubaib noticed her fear and said, "Are you afraid that I will kill him? Never would I do such a thing." Later on (while narrating the story) she said, "By Allah, I had never seen a better captive than Khubaib. By Allah, one day I saw him eating from a bunch of grapes in his hand while he was fettered with iron chains and (at that time) there was no fruit in Mecca." She used to say," It was food Allah had provided Khubaib with." When they took him to Al-Hil out of Mecca sanctuary to martyr him, Khubaib requested them. "Allow me to offer a two-rak`at prayer." They allowed him and he prayed two rak`at and then said, "By Allah! Had I not been afraid that you would think I was worried, I would have prayed more." Then he (invoked evil upon them) saying, "O Allah! Count them and kill them one by one, and do not leave anyone of them"' Then he recited: "As I am martyred as a Muslim, I do not care in what way I receive my death for Allah's Sake, for this is for the Cause of Allah. If He wishes, He will bless the cut limbs of my body." Then Abu Sirwa', 'Uqba bin Al-Harith went up to him and killed him. It was Khubaib who set the tradition of praying for any Muslim to be martyred in captivity (before he is executed). The Prophet (ﷺ) told his companions of what had happened (to those ten spies) on the same day they were martyred. Some Quraish people, being informed of `Asim bin Thabit's death, sent some messengers to bring a part of his body so that his death might be known for certain, for he had previously killed one of their leaders (in the battle of Badr). But Allah sent a swarm of wasps to protect the dead body of `Asim, and they shielded him from the messengers who could not cut anything from his body
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ذُكِرَ لَهُ أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ ـ وَكَانَ بَدْرِيًّا ـ مَرِضَ فِي يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ فَرَكِبَ إِلَيْهِ بَعْدَ أَنْ تَعَالَى النَّهَارُ وَاقْتَرَبَتِ الْجُمُعَةُ، وَتَرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa laythun, 'an yahyaa, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma dhukira lahu aanna sa'iyda bna zaydi bni 'amriw bni nufaylin wakaana badriyyana marida fiy yawmi jumu'aain farakiba iilayhi ba'da aan ta'aalaa alnnahaaru waaqtarabati aljumu'aau, wataraka aljumu'aaa
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi: Ibn 'Umar was once told that Said bin Zaid bin 'Amr bin Nufail, one of the Badr warriors, had fallen ill on a Friday. Ibn 'Umar rode to him late in the forenoon. The time of the Friday prayer approached and Ibn 'Umar did not take part in the Friday prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، كَتَبَ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَرْقَمِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، يَأْمُرُهُ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ، عَلَى سُبَيْعَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ الأَسْلَمِيَّةِ، فَيَسْأَلَهَا عَنْ حَدِيثِهَا وَعَنْ مَا قَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ اسْتَفْتَتْهُ، فَكَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَرْقَمِ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ يُخْبِرُهُ أَنَّ سُبَيْعَةَ بِنْتَ الْحَارِثِ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَحْتَ سَعْدِ ابْنِ خَوْلَةَ، وَهْوَ مِنْ بَنِي عَامِرِ بْنِ لُؤَىٍّ، وَكَانَ مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا، فَتُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ وَهْىَ حَامِلٌ، فَلَمْ تَنْشَبْ أَنْ وَضَعَتْ حَمْلَهَا بَعْدَ وَفَاتِهِ، فَلَمَّا تَعَلَّتْ مِنْ نِفَاسِهَا تَجَمَّلَتْ لِلْخُطَّابِ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ بْنُ بَعْكَكٍ ـ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ الدَّارِ ـ فَقَالَ لَهَا مَا لِي أَرَاكِ تَجَمَّلْتِ لِلْخُطَّابِ تُرَجِّينَ النِّكَاحَ فَإِنَّكِ وَاللَّهِ مَا أَنْتِ بِنَاكِحٍ حَتَّى تَمُرَّ عَلَيْكِ أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرٌ‏.‏ قَالَتْ سُبَيْعَةُ فَلَمَّا قَالَ لِي ذَلِكَ جَمَعْتُ عَلَىَّ ثِيَابِي حِينَ أَمْسَيْتُ، وَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَأَفْتَانِي بِأَنِّي قَدْ حَلَلْتُ حِينَ وَضَعْتُ حَمْلِي، وَأَمَرَنِي بِالتَّزَوُّجِ إِنْ بَدَا لِي‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ أَصْبَغُ عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، وَسَأَلْنَاهُ، فَقَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ، مَوْلَى بَنِي عَامِرِ بْنِ لُؤَىٍّ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ إِيَاسِ بْنِ الْبُكَيْرِ، وَكَانَ، أَبُوهُ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا أَخْبَرَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, aanna aabaahu, kataba iilaa 'umara bni 'abdi alllahi bni alaarqami alzzuhriyyi, yaamuruhu aan yadkhula, 'alaa subay'aaa binti alhaarithi alaaslamiyyaai, fayasaalahaa 'an hadiythihaa wa'an maa qaala lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna astaftathu, fakataba 'umaru bnu 'abdi alllahi bni alaarqami iilaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa yukhbiruhu aanna subay'aaa binta alhaarithi aakhbarathu aannahaa kaanat tahta sa'di abni khawlaaa, wahwa min baniy 'aamiri bni luuaaain, wakaana mimman shahida badrana, fatuwuffiya 'anhaa fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i wahaa haamilun, falam tanshab aan wada'at hamlahaa ba'da wafaatihi, falammaa ta'allat min nifaasihaa tajammalat lilkhuttaabi, fadakhala 'alayhaa aabuw alssanaabili bnu ba'kakin rajulun min baniy 'abdi alddaari faqaala lahaa maa liy aaraaki tajammalti lilkhuttaabi turajjiyna alnnikaaha faiinnaki waalllahi maa aanti binaakihin hattaa tamurra 'alayki aarba'aau aashhurin wa'ashrun‏.‏ qaalat subay'aau falammaa qaala liy dhalika jama'tu 'alaaaa thiyaabiy hiyna aamsaytu, waaataytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaaltuhu 'an dhalika, faaaftaaniy biaanniy qad halaltu hiyna wada'tu hamliy, waaamaraniy bialttazawwuji iin badaa liy‏.‏ taaba'ahu aasbaghu 'ani abni wahbin 'an yuwnusa‏.‏ waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, wasaaalnaahu, faqaala aakhbaraniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni thawbaana, mawlaa baniy 'aamiri bni luuaaain aanna muhammada bna iiyaasi bni albukayri, wakaana, aabuwhu shahida badrana aakhbarahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Subaia bint Al-Harith: That she was married to Sa`d bin Khaula who was from the tribe of Bani 'Amr bin Luai, and was one of those who fought the Badr battle. He died while she was pregnant during Hajjat-ul-Wada.' Soon after his death, she gave birth to a child. When she completed the term of delivery (i.e. became clean), she prepared herself for suitors. Abu As-Sanabil bin Ba'kak, a man from the tribe of Bani Abd-ud-Dar called on her and said to her, "What! I see you dressed up for the people to ask you in marriage. Do you want to marry By Allah, you are not allowed to marry unless four months and ten days have elapsed (after your husband's death)." Subai'a in her narration said, "When he (i.e. Abu As-Sanabil) said this to me, I put on my dress in the evening and went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and asked him about this problem. He gave the verdict that I was free to marry as I had already given birth to my child and ordered me to marry if I wished
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ رَافِعٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ وَكَانَ أَبُوهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَدْرٍ ـ قَالَ جَاءَ جِبْرِيلُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا تَعُدُّونَ أَهْلَ بَدْرٍ فِيكُمْ قَالَ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ـ أَوْ كَلِمَةً نَحْوَهَا ـ قَالَ وَكَذَلِكَ مَنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مِنَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an mu'aadhi bni rifaa'aaa bni raafi'in alzzuraqiyyi, 'an aabiyhi wakaana aabuwhu min aahli badrin qaala jaa'a jibriylu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ maa ta'udduwna aahla badrin fiykum qaala min aafdali almuslimiyna aaw kalimaaan nahwahaa qaala wakadhalika man shahida badrana mina almalaaiikaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Rifaa:(who was one of the Badr warriors) Gabriel came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "How do you look upon the warriors of Badr among yourselves?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "As the best of the Muslims." or said a similar statement. On that, Gabriel said, "And so are the Angels who participated in the Badr (battle)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ رَافِعٍ،، وَكَانَ، رِفَاعَةُ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَدْرٍ، وَكَانَ رَافِعٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعَقَبَةِ، فَكَانَ يَقُولُ لاِبْنِهِ مَا يَسُرُّنِي أَنِّي شَهِدْتُ بَدْرًا بِالْعَقَبَةِ قَالَ سَأَلَ جِبْرِيلُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an yahyaa, 'an mu'aadhi bni rifaa'aaa bni raafi'in, , wakaana, rifaa'aau min aahli badrin, wakaana raafi'un min aahli al'aqabaai, fakaana yaquwlu laibnihi maa yasurruniy aanniy shahidtu badrana bial'aqabaai qaala saaala jibriylu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mu`adh bin Rifa`a bin Rafi`:Rifa`a was one of the warriors of Badr while (his father) Rafi` was one of the people of Al-`Aqaba (i.e. those who gave the pledge of allegiance at Al-`Aqaba). Rafi` used to say to his son, "I would not have been happier if I had taken part in the Badr battle instead of taking part in the 'Aqaba pledge
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى، سَمِعَ مُعَاذَ بْنَ رِفَاعَةَ، أَنَّ مَلَكًا، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَعَنْ يَحْيَى، أَنَّ يَزِيدَ بْنَ الْهَادِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَهُ يَوْمَ حَدَّثَهُ مُعَاذٌ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ، فَقَالَ يَزِيدُ فَقَالَ مُعَاذٌ إِنَّ السَّائِلَ هُوَ جِبْرِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa yaziydu, aakhbaranaa yahyaa, sami'a mu'aadha bna rifaa'aaa, aanna malakana, saaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ wa'an yahyaa, aanna yaziyda bna alhaadi aakhbarahu aannahu kaana ma'ahu yawma haddathahu mu'aadhun hadhaa alhadiytha, faqaala yaziydu faqaala mu'aadhun iinna alssaaiila huwa jibriylu 'alayhi alssalaamu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mu`adh:The one who asked (the Prophet) was Gabriel (refer to Hadith)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ‏ "‏ هَذَا جِبْرِيلُ آخِذٌ بِرَأْسِ فَرَسِهِ ـ عَلَيْهِ أَدَاةُ الْحَرْبِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala yawma badrin ‏ "‏ hadhaa jibriylu akhidhun biraasi farasihi 'alayhi aadaaau alharbi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said on the day (of the battle) of Badr, "This is Gabriel holding the head of his horse and equipped with arms for the battle
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي خَلِيفَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ مَاتَ أَبُو زَيْدٍ وَلَمْ يَتْرُكْ عَقِبًا، وَكَانَ بَدْرِيًّا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy khaliyfaau, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyu, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala maata aabuw zaydin walam yatruk 'aqibana, wakaana badriyyana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Abu Zaid died and did not leave any offspring, and he was one of the Badr warriors
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ خَبَّابٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ، فَقَدَّمَ إِلَيْهِ أَهْلُهُ لَحْمًا مِنْ لُحُومِ الأَضْحَى فَقَالَ مَا أَنَا بِآكِلِهِ حَتَّى أَسْأَلَ، فَانْطَلَقَ إِلَى أَخِيهِ لأُمِّهِ وَكَانَ بَدْرِيًّا قَتَادَةَ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ فَسَأَلَهُ، فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ حَدَثَ بَعْدَكَ أَمْرٌ نَقْضٌ لِمَا كَانُوا يُنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ مِنْ أَكْلِ لُحُومِ الأَضْحَى بَعْدَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'ani abni khabbaabin, aanna aabaa sa'iydi bni maalikin alkhudriyya rda allh 'nh qadima min safarin, faqaddama iilayhi aahluhu lahmana min luhuwmi alaadhaa faqaala maa aanaa biakilihi hattaa aasaala, faantalaqa iilaa aakhiyhi laummihi wakaana badriyyana qataadaaa bni alnnu'maani fasaaalahu, faqaala iinnahu hadatha ba'daka aamrun naqdun limaa kaanuwa yunhawna 'anhu min aakli luhuwmi alaadhaa ba'da thalaathaai aayyaamin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Abu Sa`id bin Malik Al-Khudri returned from a journey and his family offered him some meat of sacrifices offered at `Id ul Adha. On that he said, "I will not eat it before asking (whether it is allowed)." He went to his maternal brother, Qatada bin Nu'man, who was one of the Badr warriors, and asked him about it. Qatada said, "After your departure, an order was issued by the Prophet (ﷺ) cancelling the prohibition of eating sacrifices after three days
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ لَقِيتُ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ وَهْوَ مُدَجَّجٌ لاَ يُرَى مِنْهُ إِلاَّ عَيْنَاهُ، وَهْوَ يُكْنَى أَبُو ذَاتِ الْكَرِشِ، فَقَالَ أَنَا أَبُو ذَاتِ الْكَرِشِ‏.‏ فَحَمَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَنَزَةِ، فَطَعَنْتُهُ فِي عَيْنِهِ فَمَاتَ‏.‏ قَالَ هِشَامٌ فَأُخْبِرْتُ أَنَّ الزُّبَيْرَ قَالَ لَقَدْ وَضَعْتُ رِجْلِي عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ تَمَطَّأْتُ، فَكَانَ الْجَهْدَ أَنْ نَزَعْتُهَا وَقَدِ انْثَنَى طَرَفَاهَا‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ فَسَأَلَهُ إِيَّاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَعْطَاهُ، فَلَمَّا قُبِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخَذَهَا، ثُمَّ طَلَبَهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَأَعْطَاهُ، فَلَمَّا قُبِضَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ سَأَلَهَا إِيَّاهُ عُمَرُ فَأَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهَا، فَلَمَّا قُبِضَ عُمَرُ أَخَذَهَا، ثُمَّ طَلَبَهَا عُثْمَانُ مِنْهُ فَأَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهَا، فَلَمَّا قُتِلَ عُثْمَانُ وَقَعَتْ عِنْدَ آلِ عَلِيٍّ، فَطَلَبَهَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، فَكَانَتْ عِنْدَهُ حَتَّى قُتِلَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala alzzubayru laqiytu yawma badrin 'ubaydaaa bna sa'iydi bni al'aasi wahwa mudajjajun laa yuraa minhu iilaaa 'aynaahu, wahwa yuknaa aabuw dhaati alkarishi, faqaala aanaa aabuw dhaati alkarishi‏.‏ fahamaltu 'alayhi bial'anazaai, fata'antuhu fiy 'aynihi famaata‏.‏ qaala hishaamun faaukhbirtu aanna alzzubayra qaala laqad wada'tu rijliy 'alayhi thumma tamattaatu, fakaana aljahda aan naza'tuhaa waqadi anthanaa tarafaahaa‏.‏ qaala 'urwaau fasaaalahu iiyyaahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaa'taahu, falammaa qubida rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhadhahaa, thumma talabahaa aabuw bakrin faaa'taahu, falammaa qubida aabuw bakrin saaalahaa iiyyaahu 'umaru faaa'taahu iiyyaahaa, falammaa qubida 'umaru aakhadhahaa, thumma talabahaa 'uthmaanu minhu faaa'taahu iiyyaahaa, falammaa qutila 'uthmaanu waqa'at 'inda ali 'aliyyin, fatalabahaa 'abdu alllahi bnu alzzubayri, fakaanat 'indahu hattaa qutila‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa:Az-Zubair said, "I met Ubaida bin Sa`id bin Al-As on the day (of the battle) of Badr and he was covered with armor; so much that only his eyes were visible. He was surnamed Abu Dhat-al-Karish. He said (proudly), 'I am Abu Dhat-al-Karish.' I attacked him with the spear and pierced his eye and he died. I put my foot over his body to pull (that spear) out, but even then I had to use a great force to take it out as its both ends were bent." `Urwa said, "Later on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked Az-Zubair for the spear and he gave it to him. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, Az-Zubair took it back. After that Abu Bakr demanded it and he gave it to him, and when Abu Bakr died, Az-Zubair took it back. `Umar then demanded it from him and he gave it to him. When `Umar died, Az-Zubair took it back, and then `Uthman demanded it from him and he gave it to him. When `Uthman was martyred, the spear remained with `Ali's offspring. Then `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair demanded it back, and it remained with him till he was martyred
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ، عَائِذُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ عُبَادَةَ بْنَ الصَّامِتِ، وَكَانَ، شَهِدَ بَدْرًا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بَايِعُونِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw iidriysa, 'aaiidhu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi aanna 'ubaadaaa bna alssaamiti, wakaana, shahida badrana aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ baayi'uwniy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:(who was one of the Badr warriors) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Give me the pledge of allegiance
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ أَبَا حُذَيْفَةَ وَكَانَ مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَبَنَّى سَالِمًا، وَأَنْكَحَهُ بِنْتَ أَخِيهِ هِنْدَ بِنْتَ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ ـ وَهْوَ مَوْلًى لاِمْرَأَةٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ ـ كَمَا تَبَنَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْدًا، وَكَانَ مَنْ تَبَنَّى رَجُلاً فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ دَعَاهُ النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ، وَوَرِثَ مِنْ مِيرَاثِهِ حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏ادْعُوهُمْ لآبَائِهِمْ‏}‏ فَجَاءَتْ سَهْلَةُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna aabaa hudhayfaaa wakaana mimman shahida badrana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tabannaa saalimana, waaankahahu binta aakhiyhi hinda binta alwaliydi bni 'utbaaa wahwa mawlana laimraaaain mina alaansaari kamaa tabannaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm zaydana, wakaana man tabannaa rajulaan fiy aljaahiliyyaai da'aahu alnnaasu iilayhi, wawaritha min miyraathihi hattaa aanzala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏ad'uwhum labaaiihim‏}‏ fajaa'at sahlaau alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm, fadhakara alhadiytha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Abu Hudhaifa, one of those who fought the battle of Badr, with Allah's Apostle adopted Salim as his son and married his niece Hind bint Al-Walid bin `Utba to him and Salim was a freed slave of an Ansari woman. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also adopted Zaid as his son. In the pre-Islamic period of ignorance the custom was that, if one adopted a son, the people would call him by the name of the adopted-father whom he would inherit as well, till Allah revealed: "Call them (adopted sons) By (the names of) their fathers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنِ الرُّبَيِّعِ بِنْتِ مُعَوِّذٍ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَدَاةَ بُنِيَ عَلَىَّ، فَجَلَسَ عَلَى فِرَاشِي كَمَجْلِسِكَ مِنِّي، وَجُوَيْرِيَاتٌ يَضْرِبْنَ بِالدُّفِّ، يَنْدُبْنَ مَنْ قُتِلَ مِنْ آبَائِهِنَّ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ حَتَّى قَالَتْ جَارِيَةٌ وَفِينَا نَبِيٌّ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي غَدٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُولِي هَكَذَا، وَقُولِي مَا كُنْتِ تَقُولِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu dhakwaana, 'ani alrrubayyi'i binti mu'awwidhin, qaalat dakhala 'alaaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ghadaaaa buniya 'alaaaa, fajalasa 'alaa firaashiy kamajlisika minniy, wajuwayriyaatun yadribna bialdduffi, yandubna man qutila min abaaiihinna yawma badrin hattaa qaalat jaariyaaun wafiynaa nabiyyun ya'lamu maa fiy ghadin‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa taquwliy hakadhaa, waquwliy maa kunti taquwliyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ar-Rubai bint Muauwidh:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to me the night my marriage was consummated and sat down on my bed as you (the sub-narrator) are sitting now, and small girls were beating the tambourine and singing in lamentation of my father who had been killed on the day of the battle of Badr. Then one of the girls said, "There is a Prophet amongst us who knows what will happen tomorrow." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to her)," Do not say this, but go on saying what you have spoken before
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ،‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ صَاحِبُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ قَدْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلاَ صُورَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُرِيدُ التَّمَاثِيلَ الَّتِي فِيهَا الأَرْوَاحُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, ‏.‏ haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy aakhiy, 'an sulaymaana, 'an muhammadi bni aabiy 'atiyqin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, aanna abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw talhaaa rda allh 'nh saahibu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaana qad shahida badrana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ laa tadkhulu almalaaiikaau baytana fiyhi kalbun walaa suwraaun ‏"‏‏.‏ yuriydu alttamaathiyla allatiy fiyhaa alaarwaahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Abu Talha, a companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one of those who fought at Badr together with Allah's Apostle told me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. "Angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture" He meant the images of creatures that have souls
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ،‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَنْبَسَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ، أَنَّ حُسَيْنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ ـ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا قَالَ كَانَتْ لِي شَارِفٌ مِنْ نَصِيبِي مِنَ الْمَغْنَمِ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْطَانِي مِمَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْخُمُسِ يَوْمَئِذٍ، فَلَمَّا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبْتَنِيَ بِفَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ بِنْتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاعَدْتُ رَجُلاً صَوَّاغًا فِي بَنِي قَيْنُقَاعَ أَنْ يَرْتَحِلَ مَعِي فَنَأْتِيَ بِإِذْخِرٍ، فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبِيعَهُ مِنَ الصَّوَّاغِينَ فَنَسْتَعِينَ بِهِ فِي وَلِيمَةِ عُرْسِي، فَبَيْنَا أَنَا أَجْمَعُ لِشَارِفَىَّ مِنَ الأَقْتَابِ وَالْغَرَائِرِ وَالْحِبَالِ، وَشَارِفَاىَ مُنَاخَانِ إِلَى جَنْبِ حُجْرَةِ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ، حَتَّى جَمَعْتُ مَا جَمَعْتُ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِشَارِفَىَّ قَدْ أُجِبَّتْ أَسْنِمَتُهَا، وَبُقِرَتْ خَوَاصِرُهُمَا، وَأُخِذَ مِنْ أَكْبَادِهِمَا، فَلَمْ أَمْلِكْ عَيْنَىَّ حِينَ رَأَيْتُ الْمَنْظَرَ، قُلْتُ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا قَالُوا فَعَلَهُ حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، وَهْوَ فِي هَذَا الْبَيْتِ، فِي شَرْبٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ، عِنْدَهُ قَيْنَةٌ وَأَصْحَابُهُ فَقَالَتْ فِي غِنَائِهَا أَلاَ يَا حَمْزَ لِلشُّرُفِ النِّوَاءِ، فَوَثَبَ حَمْزَةُ إِلَى السَّيْفِ، فَأَجَبَّ أَسْنِمَتَهُمَا، وَبَقَرَ خَوَاصِرَهُمَا، وَأَخَذَ مِنْ أَكْبَادِهِمَا قَالَ عَلِيٌّ فَانْطَلَقْتُ حَتَّى أَدْخُلَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدَهُ زَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ، وَعَرَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّذِي لَقِيتُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا لَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا رَأَيْتُ كَالْيَوْمِ، عَدَا حَمْزَةُ عَلَى نَاقَتَىَّ، فَأَجَبَّ أَسْنِمَتَهُمَا، وَبَقَرَ خَوَاصِرَهُمَا وَهَا هُوَ ذَا فِي بَيْتٍ مَعَهُ شَرْبٌ، فَدَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرِدَائِهِ، فَارْتَدَى ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ يَمْشِي، وَاتَّبَعْتُهُ أَنَا وَزَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ، حَتَّى جَاءَ الْبَيْتَ الَّذِي فِيهِ حَمْزَةُ، فَاسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَيْهِ فَأُذِنَ لَهُ، فَطَفِقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَلُومُ حَمْزَةَ فِيمَا فَعَلَ، فَإِذَا حَمْزَةُ ثَمِلٌ مُحْمَرَّةٌ عَيْنَاهُ، فَنَظَرَ حَمْزَةُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ، فَنَظَرَ إِلَى رُكْبَتِهِ، ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ، فَنَظَرَ إِلَى وَجْهِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ حَمْزَةُ وَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ إِلاَّ عَبِيدٌ لأَبِي فَعَرَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ ثَمِلٌ، فَنَكَصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ الْقَهْقَرَى، فَخَرَجَ وَخَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, ‏.‏ haddathanaa aahmadu bnu saalihin, haddathanaa 'anbasaau, haddathanaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaranaa 'aliyyu bnu husaynin, aanna husayna bna 'aliyyin 'alayhimu alssalaamu aakhbarahu aanna 'aliyyana qaala kaanat liy shaarifun min nasiybiy mina almaghnami yawma badrin, wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aa'taaniy mimmaa aafaa'a alllahu 'alayhi mina alkhumusi yawmaiidhin, falammaa aaradtu aan aabtaniya bifaatimaaa 'alayhaa alssalaamu binti alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waa'adtu rajulaan sawwaaghana fiy baniy qaynuqaa'a aan yartahila ma'iy fanaatiya biiidhkhirin, faaaradtu aan aabiy'ahu mina alssawwaaghiyna fanasta'iyna bihi fiy waliymaai 'ursiy, fabaynaa aanaa aajma'u lishaarifaaaa mina alaaqtaabi waalgharaaiiri waalhibaali, washaarifaaaa munaakhaani iilaa janbi hujraai rajulin mina alaansaari, hattaa jama'tu maa jama'tu faiidhaa aanaa bishaarifaaaa qad aujibbat aasnimatuhaa, wabuqirat khawaasiruhumaa, waaukhidha min aakbaadihimaa, falam aamlik 'aynaaaa hiyna raaaytu almanzara, qultu man fa'ala hadhaa qaaluwa fa'alahu hamzaau bnu 'abdi almuttalibi, wahwa fiy hadhaa albayti, fiy sharbin mina alaansaari, 'indahu qaynaaun waaashaabuhu faqaalat fiy ghinaaiihaa aalaa yaa hamza lilshhurufi alnniwaa'i, fawathaba hamzaau iilaa alssayfi, faaajabba aasnimatahumaa, wabaqara khawaasirahumaa, waaakhadha min aakbaadihimaa qaala 'aliyyun faantalaqtu hattaa aadkhula 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'indahu zaydu bnu haarithaaa, wa'arafa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alladhiy laqiytu faqaala ‏ "‏ maa laka ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, maa raaaytu kaalyawmi, 'adaa hamzaau 'alaa naaqataaaa, faaajabba aasnimatahumaa, wabaqara khawaasirahumaa wahaa huwa dhaa fiy baytin ma'ahu sharbun, fada'aa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biridaaiihi, faartadaa thumma antalaqa yamshiy, waattaba'tuhu aanaa wazaydu bnu haarithaaa, hattaa jaa'a albayta alladhiy fiyhi hamzaau, faastaadhana 'alayhi faaudhina lahu, fatafiqa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaluwmu hamzaaa fiymaa fa'ala, faiidhaa hamzaau thamilun muhmarraaun 'aynaahu, fanazara hamzaau iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma sa''ada alnnazara, fanazara iilaa rukbatihi, thumma sa''ada alnnazara, fanazara iilaa wajhihi, thumma qaala hamzaau wahal aantum iilaaa 'abiydun laabiy fa'arafa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu thamilun, fanakasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa 'aqibayhi alqahqaraa, fakharaja wakharajnaa ma'ahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:I had a she-camel which I got in my share from the booty of the battle of Badr, and the Prophet (ﷺ) had given me another she camel from the Khumus which Allah had bestowed on him that day. And when I intended to celebrate my marriage to Fatima, the daughter of the Prophet, I made an arrangement with a goldsmith from Bani Qainuqa 'that he should go with me to bring Idhkhir (i.e. a kind of grass used by gold-smiths) which I intended to sell to gold-smiths in order to spend its price on the marriage banquet. While I was collecting ropes and sacks of pack saddles for my two she-camels which were kneeling down beside an Ansari's dwelling and after collecting what I needed, I suddenly found that the humps of the two she-camels had been cut off and their flanks had been cut open and portions of their livers had been taken out. On seeing that, I could not help weeping. I asked, "Who has done that?" They (i.e. the people) said, "Hamza bin `Abdul Muttalib has done it. He is present in this house with some Ansari drinkers, a girl singer, and his friends. The singer said in her song, "O Hamza, get at the fat she-camels!" On hearing this, Hamza rushed to his sword and cut off the camels' humps and cut their flanks open and took out portions from their livers." Then I came to the Prophet, with whom Zaid bin Haritha was present. The Prophet (ﷺ) noticed my state and asked, "What is the matter?" I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I have never experienced such a day as today! Hamza attacked my two she-camels, cut off their humps and cut their flanks open, and he is still present in a house along with some drinkers." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for his cloak, put it on, and proceeded, followed by Zaid bin Haritha and myself, till he reached the house where Hamza was. He asked the permission to enter, and he was permitted. The Prophet (ﷺ) started blaming Hamza for what he had done. Hamza was drunk and his eyes were red. He looked at the Prophet (ﷺ) then raised his eyes to look at his knees and raised his eyes more to look at his face and then said, "You are not but my father's slaves." When the Prophet (ﷺ) understood that Hamza was drunk, he retreated, walking backwards went out and we left with him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ أَنْفَذَهُ لَنَا ابْنُ الأَصْبَهَانِيِّ سَمِعَهُ مِنِ ابْنِ مَعْقِلٍ، أَنَّ عَلِيًّا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ كَبَّرَ عَلَى سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, aakhbaranaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, qaala aanfadhahu lanaa abnu alaasbahaaniyyi sami'ahu mini abni ma'qilin, aanna 'aliyyana rda allh 'nh kabbara 'alaa sahli bni hunayfin faqaala iinnahu shahida badrana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Ma`qil:`Ali led the funeral prayer of Sahl bin Hunaif and said, "He was one of the warriors of Badr
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ حِينَ تَأَيَّمَتْ حَفْصَةُ بِنْتُ عُمَرَ مِنْ خُنَيْسِ بْنِ حُذَافَةَ السَّهْمِيِّ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا تُوُفِّيَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ عُمَرُ فَلَقِيتُ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ فَعَرَضْتُ عَلَيْهِ حَفْصَةَ فَقُلْتُ إِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْكَحْتُكَ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتَ عُمَرَ‏.‏ قَالَ سَأَنْظُرُ فِي أَمْرِي‏.‏ فَلَبِثْتُ لَيَالِيَ، فَقَالَ قَدْ بَدَا لِي أَنْ لاَ أَتَزَوَّجَ يَوْمِي هَذَا‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَقُلْتُ إِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْكَحْتُكَ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتَ عُمَرَ‏.‏ فَصَمَتَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، فَلَمْ يَرْجِعْ إِلَىَّ شَيْئًا، فَكُنْتُ عَلَيْهِ أَوْجَدَ مِنِّي عَلَى عُثْمَانَ، فَلَبِثْتُ لَيَالِيَ، ثُمَّ خَطَبَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَنْكَحْتُهَا إِيَّاهُ، فَلَقِيَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ لَعَلَّكَ وَجَدْتَ عَلَىَّ حِينَ عَرَضْتَ عَلَىَّ حَفْصَةَ فَلَمْ أَرْجِعْ إِلَيْكَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَمْنَعْنِي أَنْ أَرْجِعَ إِلَيْكَ فِيمَا عَرَضْتَ إِلاَّ أَنِّي قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ ذَكَرَهَا، فَلَمْ أَكُنْ لأُفْشِيَ سِرَّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَلَوْ تَرَكَهَا لَقَبِلْتُهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aannahu sami'a 'abda alllahi bna 'umara rda allh 'nhma yuhaddithu aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi hiyna taaayyamat hafsaau bintu 'umara min khunaysi bni hudhaafaaa alssahmiyyi wakaana min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad shahida badrana tuwuffiya bialmadiynaai qaala 'umaru falaqiytu 'uthmaana bna 'affaana fa'aradtu 'alayhi hafsaaa faqultu iin shiita aankahtuka hafsaaa binta 'umara‏.‏ qaala saaanzuru fiy aamriy‏.‏ falabithtu layaaliya, faqaala qad badaa liy aan laa aatazawwaja yawmiy hadhaa‏.‏ qaala 'umaru falaqiytu aabaa bakrin faqultu iin shiita aankahtuka hafsaaa binta 'umara‏.‏ fasamata aabuw bakrin, falam yarji' iilaaaa shayiana, fakuntu 'alayhi aawjada minniy 'alaa 'uthmaana, falabithtu layaaliya, thumma khatabahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaankahtuhaa iiyyaahu, falaqiyaniy aabuw bakrin faqaala la'allaka wajadta 'alaaaa hiyna 'aradta 'alaaaa hafsaaa falam aarji' iilayka qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala faiinnahu lam yamna'niy aan aarji'a iilayka fiymaa 'aradta iilaaa aanniy qad 'alimtu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad dhakarahaa, falam aakun laufshiya sirra rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, walaw tarakahaa laqabiltuhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "When (my daughter) Hafsa bint `Umar lost her husband Khunais bin Hudhaifa As-Sahrni who was one of the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and had fought in the battle of Badr and had died in Medina, I met `Uthman bin `Affan and suggested that he should marry Hafsa saying, "If you wish, I will marry Hafsa bint `Umar to you,' on that, he said, 'I will think it over.' I waited for a few days and then he said to me. 'I am of the opinion that I shall not marry at present.' Then I met Abu Bakr and said, 'if you wish, I will marry you, Hafsa bint `Umar.' He kept quiet and did not give me any reply and I became more angry with him than I was with `Uthman . Some days later, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) demanded her hand in marriage and I married her to him. Later on Abu Bakr met me and said, "Perhaps you were angry with me when you offered me Hafsa for marriage and I gave no reply to you?' I said, 'Yes.' Abu Bakr said, 'Nothing prevented me from accepting your offer except that I learnt that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had referred to the issue of Hafsa and I did not want to disclose the secret of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , but had he (i.e. the Prophet) given her up I would surely have accepted her
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، سَمِعَ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ الْبَدْرِيَّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَفَقَةُ الرَّجُلِ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni yaziyda, sami'a aabaa mas'uwdin albadriyya, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ nafaqaau alrrajuli 'alaa aahlihi sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Masud Al-Badri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man's spending on his family is a deed of charity
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يُحَدِّثُ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فِي إِمَارَتِهِ أَخَّرَ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ الْعَصْرَ وَهْوَ أَمِيرُ الْكُوفَةِ، فَدَخَلَ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ عُقْبَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَنْصَارِيُّ جَدُّ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَسَنٍ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا فَقَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ نَزَلَ جِبْرِيلُ فَصَلَّى فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَمْسَ صَلَوَاتٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ هَكَذَا أُمِرْتَ‏.‏ كَذَلِكَ كَانَ بَشِيرُ بْنُ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, sami'tu 'urwaaa bna alzzubayri, yuhaddithu 'umara bna 'abdi al'aziyzi fiy iimaaratihi aakhhara almughiyraau bnu shu'baaa al'asra wahwa aamiyru alkuwfaai, fadakhala aabuw mas'uwdin 'uqbaau bnu 'amrinw alaansaariyyu jaddu zaydi bni hasanin shahida badrana faqaala laqad 'alimta nazala jibriylu fasallaa fasallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khamsa salawaatin thumma qaala hakadhaa aumirta‏.‏ kadhalika kaana bashiyru bnu aabiy mas'uwdin yuhaddithu 'an aabiyhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Az-Zuhri:I heard `Urwa bin Az-Zubair talking to `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz during the latter's Governorship (at Medina), he said, "Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba delayed the `Asr prayer when he was the ruler of Al-Kufa. On that, Abu Mas`ud. `Uqba bin `Amr Al-Ansari, the grand-father of Zaid bin Hasan, who was one of the Badr warriors, came in and said, (to Al-Mughira), 'You know that Gabriel came down and offered the prayer and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed five prescribed prayers, and Gabriel said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "I have been ordered to do so (i.e. offer these five prayers at these fixed stated hours of the day)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْبَدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الآيَتَانِ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ مَنْ قَرَأَهُمَا فِي لَيْلَةٍ كَفَتَاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ وَهْوَ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ، فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَحَدَّثَنِيهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin albadriyyi rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alayataani min akhiri suwraai albaqaraai man qaraaahumaa fiy laylaain kafataahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alrrahmani falaqiytu aabaa mas'uwdin wahwa yatuwfu bialbayti, fasaaaltuhu fahaddathaniyhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Masud Al-Badri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is sufficient for one to recite the last two Verses of Surat-al-Baqara at night
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَحْمُودُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، أَنَّ عِتْبَانَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، وَكَانَ، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ أَنَّهُ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy mahmuwdu bnu alrrabiy'i, aanna 'itbaana bna maalikin, wakaana, min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mimman shahida badrana mina alaansaari aannahu aataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi:That `Itban bin Malik who was one of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and one of the warriors of Badr, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ صَالِحٍ ـ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْبَسَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُ الْحُصَيْنَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ ـ وَهْوَ أَحَدُ بَنِي سَالِمٍ وَهْوَ مِنْ سَرَاتِهِمْ ـ عَنْ حَدِيثِ، مَحْمُودِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ عَنْ عِتْبَانَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، فَصَدَّقَةُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu huwa abnu saalihin haddathanaa 'anbasaau, haddathanaa yuwnusu, qaala abnu shihaabin thumma saaaltu alhusayna bna muhammadin wahwa aahadu baniy saalimin wahwa min saraatihim 'an hadiythi, mahmuwdi bni alrrabiy'i 'an 'itbaana bni maalikin, fasaddaqaau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Shihab:I asked Al-Husain bin Muhammad who was one of the sons of Salim and one of the nobles amongst them, about the narration of Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi 'from `Itban bin Malik, and he confirmed it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، وَكَانَ، مِنْ أَكْبَرِ بَنِي عَدِيٍّ وَكَانَ أَبُوهُ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ عُمَرَ اسْتَعْمَلَ قُدَامَةَ بْنَ مَظْعُونٍ عَلَى الْبَحْرَيْنِ، وَكَانَ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا، وَهُوَ خَالُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ وَحَفْصَةَ رضى الله عنهم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'aamiri bni rabiy'aaa, wakaana, min aakbari baniy 'adiyyin wakaana aabuwhu shahida badrana ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna 'umara asta'mala qudaamaaa bna maz'uwnin 'alaa albahrayni, wakaana shahida badrana, wahuwa khaalu 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara wahafsaaa rda allh 'nhm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Rabi`a:who was one of the leaders of Bani `Adi and his father participated in the battle of Badr in the company of the Prophet. `Umar appointed Qudama bin Maz'un as ruler of Bahrain, Qudama was one of the warriors of the battle of Badr and was the maternal uncle of `Abdullah bin `Umar and Hafsa
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَ رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عَمَّيْهِ، وَكَانَا، شَهِدَا بَدْرًا أَخْبَرَاهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ كِرَاءِ الْمَزَارِعِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِسَالِمٍ فَتُكْرِيهَا أَنْتَ قَالَ نَعَمْ، إِنَّ رَافِعًا أَكْثَرَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadi bni aasmaa'a, haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an maalikin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aanna saalima bna 'abdi alllahi, aakhbarahu qaala aakhbara raafi'u bnu khadiyjin 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, aanna 'ammayhi, wakaanaa, shahidaa badrana aakhbaraahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an kiraa'i almazaari'i‏.‏ qultu lisaalimin fatukriyhaa aanta qaala na'am, iinna raafi'ana aakthara 'alaa nafsihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Az-Zuhri:Salim bin `Abdullah told me that Rafi` bin Khadij told `Abdullah bin `Umar that his two paternal uncles who had fought in the battle of Badr informed him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the renting of fields. I said to Salim, "Do you rent your land?" He said, "Yes, for Rafi` is mistaken
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ شَدَّادِ بْنِ الْهَادِ اللَّيْثِيَّ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رِفَاعَةَ بْنَ رَافِعٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، وَكَانَ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an husayni bni 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna shaddaadi bni alhaadi alllaythiyya, qaala raaaytu rifaa'aaa bna raafi'in alaansaariyya, wakaana shahida badrana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Shaddad bin Al-Had Al-Laithi:I saw Rifa`a bin Rafi` Al-Ansari who was a Badr warrior
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، وَيُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ الْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ عَوْفٍ وَهْوَ حَلِيفٌ لِبَنِي عَامِرِ بْنِ لُؤَىٍّ، وَكَانَ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ الْجَرَّاحِ إِلَى الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَأْتِي بِجِزْيَتِهَا، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هُوَ صَالَحَ أَهْلَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ، وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمِ الْعَلاَءَ بْنَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، فَقَدِمَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بِمَالٍ مِنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ فَسَمِعَتِ الأَنْصَارُ بِقُدُومِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، فَوَافَوْا صَلاَةَ الْفَجْرِ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ تَعَرَّضُوا لَهُ، فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ رَآهُمْ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَظُنُّكُمْ سَمِعْتُمْ أَنَّ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ قَدِمَ بِشَىْءٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا أَجَلْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَبْشِرُوا وَأَمِّلُوا مَا يَسُرُّكُمْ، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا الْفَقْرَ أَخْشَى عَلَيْكُمْ، وَلَكِنِّي أَخْشَى أَنْ تُبْسَطَ عَلَيْكُمُ الدُّنْيَا كَمَا بُسِطَتْ عَلَى مَنْ قَبْلَكُمْ، فَتَنَافَسُوهَا كَمَا تَنَافَسُوهَا، وَتُهْلِكَكُمْ كَمَا أَهْلَكَتْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, wayuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, aannahu aakhbarahu aanna almiswara bna makhramaaa aakhbarahu aanna 'amraw bna 'awfin wahwa haliyfun libaniy 'aamiri bni luuaaain, wakaana shahida badrana ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha aabaa 'ubaydaaa bna aljarraahi iilaa albahrayni yaatiy bijizyatihaa, wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm huwa saalaha aahla albahrayni, waaammara 'alayhimi al'alaa'a bna alhadramiyyi, faqadima aabuw 'ubaydaaa bimaalin mina albahrayni fasami'ati alaansaaru biquduwmi aabiy 'ubaydaaa, fawaafawa salaaaa alfajri ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, falammaa ansarafa ta'arraduwa lahu, fatabassama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna raahum thumma qaala ‏"‏ aazunnukum sami'tum aanna aabaa 'ubaydaaa qadima bishaa'in ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa aajal yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaabshiruwa waaammiluwa maa yasurrukum, fawaalllahi maa alfaqra aakhshaa 'alaykum, walakinniy aakhshaa aan tubsata 'alaykumu alddunyaa kamaa busitat 'alaa man qablakum, fatanaafasuwhaa kamaa tanaafasuwhaa, watuhlikakum kamaa aahlakathum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:That `Amr bin `Auf, who was an ally of Bani 'Amir bin Luai and one of those who fought at Badr in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) , said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah to Bahrain to bring the Jizya taxation from its people, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made a peace treaty with the people of Bahrain and appointed Al-`Ala' bin Al-Hadrami as their ruler. So, Abu 'Ubaida arrived with the money from Bahrain. When the Ansar heard of the arrival of Abu 'Ubaida (on the next day) they offered the morning prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and when the morning prayer had finished, they presented themselves before him. On seeing the Ansar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled and said, "I think you have heard that Abu 'Ubaida has brought something?" They replied, "Indeed, it is so, O Allah's Apostle!" He said, "Be happy, and hope for what will please you. By Allah, I am not afraid that you will be poor, but I fear that worldly wealth will be bestowed upon you as it was bestowed upon those who lived before you. So you will compete amongst yourselves for it, as they competed for it and it will destroy you as it did them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانَ يَقْتُلُ الْحَيَّاتِ كُلَّهَا‏.‏ حَتَّى حَدَّثَهُ أَبُو لُبَابَةَ الْبَدْرِيُّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ قَتْلِ جِنَّانِ الْبُيُوتِ، فَأَمْسَكَ عَنْهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma kaana yaqtulu alhayyaati kullahaa‏.‏ hattaa haddathahu aabuw lubaabaaa albadriyyu, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an qatli jinnaani albuyuwti, faaamsaka 'anhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar used to kill all kinds of snakes until Abu Lubaba Al-Badri told him that the Prophet (ﷺ) had forbidden the killing of harmless snakes living in houses and called Jinnan. So Ibn `Umar gave up killing them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُلَيْحٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رِجَالاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ اسْتَأْذَنُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا ائْذَنْ لَنَا فَلْنَتْرُكْ لاِبْنِ أُخْتِنَا عَبَّاسٍ فِدَاءَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَاللَّهِ لاَ تَذَرُونَ مِنْهُ دِرْهَمًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fulayhin, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, qaala abnu shihaabin haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna rijaalaan, mina alaansaari astaadhanuwa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa aidhan lanaa falnatruk laibni aukhtinaa 'abbaasin fidaa'ahu‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ waalllahi laa tadharuwna minhu dirhamana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Some men of the Ansar requested Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to allow them to see him, they said, "Allow us to forgive the ransom of our sister's son, `Abbas." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Allah, you will not leave a single Dirham of it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ الْمِقْدَادِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيُّ، ثُمَّ الْجُنْدَعِيُّ أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ، اللَّهِ بْنَ عَدِيِّ بْنِ الْخِيَارِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ الْمِقْدَادَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو الْكِنْدِيَّ، وَكَانَ حَلِيفًا لِبَنِي زُهْرَةَ، وَكَانَ مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ لَقِيتُ رَجُلاً مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ فَاقْتَتَلْنَا، فَضَرَبَ إِحْدَى يَدَىَّ بِالسَّيْفِ فَقَطَعَهَا، ثُمَّ لاَذَ مِنِّي بِشَجَرَةٍ فَقَالَ أَسْلَمْتُ لِلَّهِ‏.‏ آأَقْتُلُهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَعْدَ أَنْ قَالَهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَقْتُلْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّهُ قَطَعَ إِحْدَى يَدَىَّ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ذَلِكَ بَعْدَ مَا قَطَعَهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَقْتُلْهُ، فَإِنْ قَتَلْتَهُ فَإِنَّهُ بِمَنْزِلَتِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقْتُلَهُ، وَإِنَّكَ بِمَنْزِلَتِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُولَ كَلِمَتَهُ الَّتِي قَالَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'adiyyin, 'ani almiqdaadi bni alaaswadi, haddathaniy iishaaqu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa abnu aakhiy abni shihaabin, 'an 'ammihi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'u bnu yaziyda alllaythiyyu, thumma aljunda'iyyu aanna 'ubayda, alllahi bna 'adiyyi bni alkhiyaari aakhbarahu aanna almiqdaada bna 'amrinw alkindiyya, wakaana haliyfana libaniy zuhraaa, wakaana mimman shahida badrana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarahu aannahu qaala lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaraaayta iin laqiytu rajulaan mina alkuffaari faaqtatalnaa, fadaraba iihdaa yadaaaa bialssayfi faqata'ahaa, thumma laadha minniy bishajaraain faqaala aaslamtu lillahi‏.‏ aaaqtuluhu yaa rasuwla alllahi ba'da aan qaalahaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa taqtulhu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, iinnahu qata'a iihdaa yadaaaa, thumma qaala dhalika ba'da maa qata'ahaa‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa taqtulhu, faiin qataltahu faiinnahu bimanzilatika qabla aan taqtulahu, waiinnaka bimanzilatihi qabla aan yaquwla kalimatahu allatiy qaala ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin `Adi bin Al-Khiyar:That Al-Miqdad bin `Amr Al-Kindi, who was an ally of Bani Zuhra and one of those who fought the battle of Badr together with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told him that he said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "Suppose I met one of the infidels and we fought, and he struck one of my hands with his sword and cut it off and then took refuge in a tree and said, "I surrender to Allah (i.e. I have become a Muslim),' could I kill him, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), after he had said this?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You should not kill him." Al- Miqdad said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! But he had cut off one of my two hands, and then he had uttered those words?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "You should not kill him, for if you kill him, he would be in your position where you had been before killing him, and you would be in his position where he had been before uttering those words
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ‏ "‏ مَنْ يَنْظُرُ مَا صَنَعَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ، فَوَجَدَهُ قَدْ ضَرَبَهُ ابْنَا عَفْرَاءَ حَتَّى بَرَدَ، فَقَالَ آنْتَ أَبَا جَهْلٍ قَالَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ هَكَذَا قَالَهَا أَنَسٌ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنْتَ أَبَا جَهْلٍ قَالَ وَهَلْ فَوْقَ رَجُلٍ قَتَلْتُمُوهُ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ أَوْ قَالَ قَتَلَهُ قَوْمُهُ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ أَبُو مِجْلَزٍ قَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ فَلَوْ غَيْرُ أَكَّارٍ قَتَلَنِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, haddathanaa sulaymaanu alttaymiyyu, haddathanaa aanasun rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma badrin ‏ "‏ man yanzuru maa sana'a aabuw jahlin ‏"‏‏.‏ faantalaqa abnu mas'uwdin, fawajadahu qad darabahu abnaa 'afraa'a hattaa barada, faqaala anta aabaa jahlin qaala abnu 'ulayyaaa qaala sulaymaanu hakadhaa qaalahaa aanasun‏.‏ qaala aanta aabaa jahlin qaala wahal fawqa rajulin qataltumuwhu qaala sulaymaanu aaw qaala qatalahu qawmuhu‏.‏ qaala waqaala aabuw mijlazin qaala aabuw jahlin falaw ghayru aakkaarin qatalaniy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the day of Badr, "Who will go and see what has happened to Abu Jahl?" Ibn Mas`ud went and saw him struck by the two sons of 'Afra and was on the point of death . Ibn Mas`ud said, "Are you Abu Jahl?" Abu Jahl replied, "Can there be a man more superior to the one whom you have killed (or as Sulaiman said, or his own folk have killed.)?" Abu Jahl added, "Would that I had been killed by other than a mere farmer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ انْطَلِقْ بِنَا إِلَى إِخْوَانِنَا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ‏.‏ فَلَقِيَنَا مِنْهُمْ رَجُلاَنِ صَالِحَانِ شَهِدَا بَدْرًا‏.‏ فَحَدَّثْتُ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ فَقَالَ هُمَا عُوَيْمُ بْنُ سَاعِدَةَ، وَمَعْنُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, haddathaniy abnu 'abbaasin, 'an 'umara rda allh 'nhm lammaa tuwuffiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qultu laabiy bakrin antaliq binaa iilaa iikhwaaninaa mina alaansaari‏.‏ falaqiyanaa minhum rajulaani saalihaani shahidaa badrana‏.‏ fahaddathtu 'urwaaa bna alzzubayri faqaala humaa 'uwaymu bnu saa'idaaa, wama'nu bnu 'adiyyin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:`Umar said, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) died I said to Abu Bakr, 'Let us go to our Ansari brethren.' We met two pious men from them, who had fought in the battle of Badr." When I mentioned this to `Urwa bin Az-Zubair, he said, "Those two pious men were 'Uwaim bin Sa`ida and Ma`n bin Adi
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، سَمِعَ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، كَانَ عَطَاءُ الْبَدْرِيِّينَ خَمْسَةَ آلاَفٍ خَمْسَةَ آلاَفٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُمَرُ لأُفَضِّلَنَّهُمْ عَلَى مَنْ بَعْدَهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, sami'a muhammada bna fudaylin, 'an iismaa'iyla, 'an qaysin, kaana 'ataa'u albadriyyiyna khamsaaa alaafin khamsaaa alaafin‏.‏ waqaala 'umaru laufaddilannahum 'alaa man ba'dahum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qais:The Badr warriors were given five thousand (Dirhams) each, yearly. `Umar said, "I will surely give them more than what I will give to others
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِالطُّورِ، وَذَلِكَ أَوَّلَ مَا وَقَرَ الإِيمَانُ فِي قَلْبِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an muhammadi bni jubayrin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy almaghribi bialttuwri, wadhalika aawwala maa waqara aliiymaanu fiy qalbiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jubair bin Mut'im: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting Surat-at-Tur in Maghrib prayer, and that was at a time when belief was first planted in my heart. The Prophet (ﷺ) while speaking about the war prisoners of Badr, said, "Were Al-Mutim bin Adi alive and interceded with me for these filthy people, I would definitely forgive them for his sake
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: وَعَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فِي أُسَارَى بَدْرٍ ‏ "‏ لَوْ كَانَ الْمُطْعِمُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَيًّا ثُمَّ كَلَّمَنِي فِي هَؤُلاَءِ النَّتْنَى لَتَرَكْتُهُمْ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَقَعَتِ الْفِتْنَةُ الأُولَى ـ يَعْنِي مَقْتَلَ عُثْمَانَ ـ فَلَمْ تُبْقِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ بَدْرٍ أَحَدًا، ثُمَّ وَقَعَتِ الْفِتْنَةُ الثَّانِيَةُ ـ يَعْنِي الْحَرَّةَ ـ فَلَمْ تُبْقِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ أَحَدًا ثُمَّ وَقَعَتِ الثَّالِثَةُ فَلَمْ تَرْتَفِعْ وَلِلنَّاسِ طَبَاخٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: wa'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an muhammadi bni jubayri bni mut'imin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fiy ausaaraa badrin ‏ "‏ law kaana almut'imu bnu 'adiyyin hayyana thumma kallamaniy fiy hauulaa'i alnnatnaa lataraktuhum lahu ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala alllaythu 'an yahyaa, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, waqa'ati alfitnaau alauwlaa ya'niy maqtala 'uthmaana falam tubqi min aashaabi badrin aahadana, thumma waqa'ati alfitnaau althhaaniyaau ya'niy alharraaa falam tubqi min aashaabi alhudaybiyaai aahadana thumma waqa'ati althhaalithaau falam tartafi' walilnnaasi tabaakhun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Said bin Al-Musaiyab: When the first civil strife (in Islam) took place because of the murder of 'Uthman, it left none of the Badr warriors alive. When the second civil strife, that is the battle of Al-Harra, took place, it left none of the Hudaibiya treaty companions alive. Then the third civil strife took place and it did not subside till it had exhausted all the strength of the people
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ النُّمَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَسَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَعَلْقَمَةَ بْنَ وَقَّاصٍ، وَعُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ حَدِيثِ، عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُلٌّ ـ حَدَّثَنِي طَائِفَةً مِنَ الْحَدِيثِ ـ قَالَتْ فَأَقْبَلْتُ أَنَا وَأُمُّ مِسْطَحٍ فَعَثَرَتْ أُمُّ مِسْطَحٍ فِي مِرْطِهَا فَقَالَتْ تَعِسَ مِسْطَحٌ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ بِئْسَ مَا قُلْتِ، تَسُبِّينَ رَجُلاً شَهِدَ بَدْرًا فَذَكَرَ حَدِيثَ الإِفْكِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara alnnumayriyyu, haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu yaziyda, qaala sami'tu alzzuhriyya, qaala sami'tu 'urwaaa bna alzzubayri, wasa'iyda bna almusayyabi, wa'alqamaaa bna waqqaasin, wa'ubayda alllahi bna 'abdi alllahi, 'an hadiythi, 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm kullun haddathaniy taaiifaaan mina alhadiythi qaalat faaaqbaltu aanaa waaummu mistahin fa'atharat aummu mistahin fiy mirtihaa faqaalat ta'isa mistahun‏.‏ faqultu biisa maa qulti, tasubbiyna rajulaan shahida badrana fadhakara hadiytha aliifki‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Yunus bin Yazid:I heard Az-Zuhri saying, "I heard `Urwa bin Az-Zubair. Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab, 'Alqama bin Waqqas and 'Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah each narrating part of the narrative concerning `Aisha the wife of the Prophet. `Aisha said: When I and Um Mistah were returning, Um Mistah stumbled by treading on the end of her robe, and on that she said, 'May Mistah be ruined.' I said, 'You have said a bad thing, you curse a man who took part in the battle of Badr!." Az-Zuhri then narrated the narration of the Lie (forged against `Aisha)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُلَيْحِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ هَذِهِ مَغَازِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ يُلْقِيهِمْ ‏"‏ هَلْ وَجَدْتُمْ مَا وَعَدَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مُوسَى قَالَ نَافِعٌ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تُنَادِي نَاسًا أَمْوَاتًا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا أَنْتُمْ بِأَسْمَعَ لِمَا قُلْتُ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَجَمِيعُ مَنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ مِمَّنْ ضُرِبَ لَهُ بِسَهْمِهِ أَحَدٌ وَثَمَانُونَ رَجُلاً، وَكَانَ عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ يَقُولُ قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ قُسِمَتْ سُهْمَانُهُمْ فَكَانُوا مِائَةً، وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fulayhi bni sulaymaana, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala hadhihi maghaaziy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ fadhakara alhadiytha, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa yulqiyhim ‏"‏ hal wajadtum maa wa'adakum rabbukum haqqana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala muwsaa qaala naafi'un qaala 'abdu alllahi qaala naasun min aashaabihi yaa rasuwla alllahi tunaadiy naasana aamwaatana qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa aantum biaasma'a limaa qultu minhum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi fajamiy'u man shahida badrana min qurayshin mimman duriba lahu bisahmihi aahadun wathamaanuwna rajulaan, wakaana 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri yaquwlu qaala alzzubayru qusimat suhmaanuhum fakaanuwa miaiaaan, waalllahu aa'lamu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Shihab:These were the battles of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (which he fought), and while mentioning (the Badr battle) he said, "While the corpses of the pagans were being thrown into the well, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to them), 'Have you found what your Lord promised true?" `Abdullah said, "Some of the Prophet's companions said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You are addressing dead people.' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, 'You do not hear what I am saying, better than they.' The total number of Muslim fighters from Quraish who fought in the battle of Badr and were given their share of the booty, were 81 men." Az-Zubair said, "When their shares were distributed, their number was 101 men. But Allah knows it better
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ ضُرِبَتْ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ لِلْمُهَاجِرِينَ بِمِائَةِ سَهْمٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'an ma'marin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alzzubayri, qaala duribat yawma badrin lilmuhaajiriyna bimiaiaai sahmin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Az-Zubair:On the day of Badr, (Quraishi) Emigrants received 100 shares of the war booty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ حَارَبَتِ النَّضِيرُ وَقُرَيْظَةُ، فَأَجْلَى بَنِي النَّضِيرِ، وَأَقَرَّ قُرَيْظَةَ وَمَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ، حَتَّى حَارَبَتْ قُرَيْظَةُ فَقَتَلَ رِجَالَهُمْ وَقَسَمَ نِسَاءَهُمْ وَأَوْلاَدَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ إِلاَّ بَعْضَهُمْ لَحِقُوا بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَآمَنَهُمْ وَأَسْلَمُوا، وَأَجْلَى يَهُودَ الْمَدِينَةِ كُلَّهُمْ بَنِي قَيْنُقَاعَ وَهُمْ رَهْطُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلاَمٍ وَيَهُودَ بَنِي حَارِثَةَ، وَكُلَّ يَهُودِ الْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu nasrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala haarabati alnnadiyru waqurayzaau, faaajlaa baniy alnnadiyri, waaaqarra qurayzaaa wamanna 'alayhim, hattaa haarabat qurayzaau faqatala rijaalahum waqasama nisaa'ahum waaawlaadahum waaamwaalahum bayna almuslimiyna iilaaa ba'dahum lahiquwa bialnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faamanahum waaaslamuwa, waaajlaa yahuwda almadiynaai kullahum baniy qaynuqaa'a wahum rahtu 'abdi alllahi bni salaamin wayahuwda baniy haarithaaa, wakulla yahuwdi almadiynaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Bani An-Nadir and Bani Quraiza fought (against the Prophet (ﷺ) violating their peace treaty), so the Prophet exiled Bani An-Nadir and allowed Bani Quraiza to remain at their places (in Medina) taking nothing from them till they fought against the Prophet (ﷺ) again) . He then killed their men and distributed their women, children and property among the Muslims, but some of them came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he granted them safety, and they embraced Islam. He exiled all the Jews from Medina. They were the Jews of Bani Qainuqa', the tribe of `Abdullah bin Salam and the Jews of Bani Haritha and all the other Jews of Medina
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُدْرِكٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ سُورَةُ الْحَشْرِ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْ سُورَةُ النَّضِيرِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alhasanu bnu mudrikin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu hammaadin, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala qultu laibni 'abbaasin suwraau alhashri‏.‏ qaala qul suwraau alnnadiyri‏.‏ taaba'ahu hushaymun 'an aabiy bishrin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I mentioned to Ibn `Abbas Surat-Hashr. He said, "Call it Surat-an-Nadir
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه قَالَ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ يَجْعَلُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم النَّخَلاَتِ حَتَّى افْتَتَحَ قُرَيْظَةَ وَالنَّضِيرَ، فَكَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy alaaswadi, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, 'an aabiyhi, sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala kaana alrrajulu yaj'alu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alnnakhalaati hattaa aftataha qurayzaaa waalnnadiyra, fakaana ba'da dhalika yaruddu 'alayhim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Some people used to allot some date palm trees to the Prophet (ﷺ) as gift till he conquered Banu Quraiza and Bani An-Nadir, where upon he started returning their date palms to them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ حَرَّقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَخْلَ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ وَقَطَعَ وَهْىَ الْبُوَيْرَةُ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏مَا قَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ لِينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَائِمَةً عَلَى أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ‏}‏
