bakrin fiy alkhuruwji hiyna ashtadda 'alayhi alaadhaa, faqaala lahu ‏"‏ aaqim ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aatatma'u aan yuudhana laka, fakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ iinniy laarjuw dhalika ‏"‏ qaalat faantazarahu aabuw bakrin faaataahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata yawmin zuhrana fanaadaahu faqaala ‏"‏ aakhrij man 'indaka ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin iinnamaa humaa abnataaaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aasha'arta aannahu qad audhina liy fiy alkhuruwji ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi alssuhbaau‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alssuhbaau ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi 'indiy naaqataani qad kuntu aa'dadtuhumaa lilkhuruwji‏.‏ faaa'taa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm iihdaahumaa wahaa aljad'aa'u, farakibaa faantalaqaa hattaa aatayaa alghaara, wahwa bithawrin, fatawaarayaa fiyhi, fakaana 'aamiru bnu fuhayraaa ghulaamana li'abdi alllahi bni alttufayli bni sakhbaraaa aakhuw 'aaiishaaa laummihaa, wakaanat laabiy bakrin minhaaun, fakaana yaruwhu bihaa wayaghduw 'alayhim, wayusbihu fayaddaliju iilayhimaa thumma yasrahu, falaa yaftunu bihi aahadun mina alrri'aa'i, falammaa kharaja kharaja ma'ahumaa yu'qibaanihi hattaa qadimaa almadiynaaa, faqutila 'aamiru bnu fuhayraaa yawma biiri ma'uwnaaa‏.‏ wa'an aabiy ausaamaaa qaala qaala hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa faaakhbaraniy aabiy qaala lammaa qutila alladhiyna bibiiri ma'uwnaaa waausira 'amruw bnu aumayyaaa alddamriyyu qaala lahu 'aamiru bnu alttufayli man hadhaa faaashaara iilaa qatiylin, faqaala lahu 'amruw bnu aumayyaaa hadhaa 'aamiru bnu fuhayraaa‏.‏ faqaala laqad raaaytuhu ba'da maa qutila rufi'a iilaa alssamaa'i hattaa iinniy laanzuru iilaa alssamaa'i baynahu wabayna alaardi, thumma wudi'a‏.‏ faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm khabaruhum fana'aahum faqaala ‏"‏ iinna aashaabakum qad ausiybuwa, waiinnahum qad saaaluwa rabbahum, faqaaluwa rabbanaa aakhbir 'annaa iikhwaananaa bimaa radiynaa 'anka waradiyta 'annaa‏.‏ faaakhbarahum 'anhum ‏"‏‏.‏ waausiyba yawmaiidhin fiyhim 'urwaau bnu aasmaa'a bni alssalti, fasummiya 'urwaau bihi, wamundhiru bnu 'amrinw summiya bihi mundhirana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Abu Bakr asked the Prophet (ﷺ) to allow him to go out (of Mecca) when he was greatly annoyed (by the infidels). But the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, ''Wait." Abu Bakr said, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you hope that you will be allowed (to migrate)?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "I hope so." So Abu Bakr waited for him till one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came at noon time and addressed him saying "Let whoever is present with you, now leave you." Abu Bakr said, "None is present but my two daughters." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you noticed that I have been allowed to go out (to migrate)?" Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Apostle, I would like to accompany you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will accompany me." Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have got two she-camels which I had prepared and kept ready for (our) going out." So he gave one of the two (she-camels) to the Prophet (ﷺ) and it was Al-Jad`a . They both rode and proceeded till they reached the Cave at the mountain of Thaur where they hid themselves. Amir bin Fuhaira was the slave of `Abdullah bin at-Tufail bin Sakhbara `Aisha's brother from her mother's side. Abu Bakr had a milch she-camel. Amir used to go with it (i.e. the milch she-camel) in the afternoon and come back to them before noon by setting out towards them in the early morning when it was still dark and then he would take it to the pasture so that none of the shepherds would be aware of his job. When the Prophet (and Abu Bakr) went away (from the Cave), he (i.e. 'Amir) too went along with them and they both used to make him ride at the back of their camels in turns till they reached Medina. 'Amir bin Fuhaira was martyred on the day of Bir Ma'una. Narrated `Urwa: When those (Muslims) at Bir Ma'una were martyred and `Amr bin Umaiya Ad- Damri was taken prisoner, 'Amir bin at-Tufail, pointing at a killed person, asked `Amr, "Who is this?" `Amr bin Umaiya said to him, "He is 'Amir bin Fuhaira." 'Amir bin at-Tufail said, "I saw him lifted to the sky after he was killed till I saw the sky between him and the earth, and then he was brought down upon the earth. Then the news of the killed Muslims reached the Prophet (ﷺ) and he announced the news of their death saying, "Your companions (of Bir Ma'una) have been killed, and they have asked their Lord saying, 'O our Lord! Inform our brothers about us as we are pleased with You and You are pleased with us." So Allah informed them (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions) about them (i.e. martyrs of Bir Mauna). On that day, `Urwa bin Asma bin As-Salt who was one of them, was killed, and `Urwa (bin Az-Zubair) was named after `Urwa bin Asma and Mundhir (bin Az-Zubair) was named after Mundhir bin `Amr (who had also been martyred on that day)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَنَتَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ شَهْرًا يَدْعُو عَلَى رِعْلٍ وَذَكْوَانَ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ عُصَيَّةُ عَصَتِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu alttaymiyyu, 'an aabiy mijlazin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala qanata alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da alrrukuw'i shahrana yad'uw 'alaa ri'lin wadhakwaana wayaquwlu ‏ "‏ 'usayyaau 'asati alllaha warasuwlahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said Al-Qunut after Bowing (i.e. Ar-Ruku') for one month, invoking evil upon (the tribes of) Ril and Dhakwan. He used to say, "Usaiya disobeyed Allah and His Apostle
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ دَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الَّذِينَ قَتَلُوا ـ يَعْنِي ـ أَصْحَابَهُ بِبِئْرِ مَعُونَةَ ثَلاَثِينَ صَبَاحًا حِينَ يَدْعُو عَلَى رِعْلٍ وَلِحْيَانَ وَعُصَيَّةَ عَصَتِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى لِنَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا أَصْحَابِ بِئْرِ مَعُونَةَ قُرْآنًا قَرَأْنَاهُ حَتَّى نُسِخَ بَعْدُ بَلِّغُوا قَوْمَنَا فَقَدْ لَقِينَا رَبَّنَا فَرَضِيَ عَنَّا وَرَضِينَا عَنْهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala da'aa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alladhiyna qataluwa ya'niy aashaabahu bibiiri ma'uwnaaa thalaathiyna sabaahana hiyna yad'uw 'alaa ri'lin walihyaana wa'usayyaaa 'asati alllaha warasuwlahu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaala aanasun faaanzala alllahu ta'aalaa linabiyyihi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alladhiyna qutiluwa aashaabi biiri ma'uwnaaa quranana qaraanaahu hattaa nusikha ba'du ballighuwa qawmanaa faqad laqiynaa rabbanaa faradiya 'annaa waradiynaa 'anhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked evil upon those (people) who killed his companions at Bir Mauna for 30 days (in the morning prayer). He invoked evil upon (tribes of) Ril, Lihyan and Usaiya who disobeyed Allah and His Apostle. Allah revealed a Qur'anic Verse to His Prophet regarding those who had been killed, i.e. the Muslims killed at Bir Ma'una, and we recited the Verse till later it was cancelled. (The Verse was:) 'Inform our people that we have met our Lord, and He is pleased with us, and we are pleased with Him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ الْقُنُوتِ، فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ كَانَ قَبْلَ الرُّكُوعِ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ قَالَ قَبْلَهُ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّ فُلاَنًا أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْكَ أَنَّكَ قُلْتَ بَعْدَهُ، قَالَ كَذَبَ إِنَّمَا قَنَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ شَهْرًا، أَنَّهُ كَانَ بَعَثَ نَاسًا يُقَالُ لَهُمُ الْقُرَّاءُ، وَهُمْ سَبْعُونَ رَجُلاً إِلَى نَاسٍ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، وَبَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَهْدٌ قِبَلَهُمْ، فَظَهَرَ هَؤُلاَءِ الَّذِينَ كَانَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَهْدٌ، فَقَنَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ شَهْرًا يَدْعُو عَلَيْهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa 'aasimun alaahwalu, qaala saaaltu aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh 'ani alqunuwti, fiy alssalaaai faqaala na'am‏.‏ faqultu kaana qabla alrrukuw'i aaw ba'dahu qaala qablahu‏.‏ qultu faiinna fulaanana aakhbaraniy 'anka aannaka qulta ba'dahu, qaala kadhaba iinnamaa qanata rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da alrrukuw'i shahrana, aannahu kaana ba'atha naasana yuqaalu lahumu alqurraa'u, wahum sab'uwna rajulaan iilaa naasin mina almushrikiyna, wabaynahum wabayna rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ahdun qibalahum, fazahara hauulaa'i alladhiyna kaana baynahum wabayna rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ahdun, faqanata rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da alrrukuw'i shahrana yad'uw 'alayhim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Asim Al-Ahwal:I asked Anas bin Malik regarding Al-Qunut during the prayer. Anas replied, "Yes (Al-Qunut was said by the Prophet (ﷺ) in the prayer)." I said, "Is it before Bowing or after Bowing?" Anas replied, "(It was said) before (Bowing)." I said, "So-and-so informed me that you told him that it was said after Bowing." Anas replied, "He was mistaken, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said Al-Qunut after Bowing for one month. The Prophet (ﷺ) had sent some people called Al-Qurra who were seventy in number, to some pagan people who had concluded a peace treaty with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . But those who had concluded the treaty with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) violated the treaty (and martyred all the seventy men). So Allah's Apostle said Al-Qunut after Bowing (in the prayer) for one month, invoking evil upon them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَرَضَهُ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ وَهْوَ ابْنُ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ فَلَمْ يُجِزْهُ، وَعَرَضَهُ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ وَهْوَ ابْنُ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ فَأَجَازَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aradahu yawma auhudin wahwa abnu aarba'a 'ashraaa falam yujizhu, wa'aradahu yawma alkhandaqi wahwa abnu khamsa 'ashraaa faaajaazahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:That the Prophet (ﷺ) inspected him on the day of Uhud while he was fourteen years old, and the Prophet (ﷺ) did not allow him to take part in the battle. He was inspected again by the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of Al- Khandaq (i.e. battle of the Trench) while he was fifteen years old, and the Prophet (ﷺ) allowed him to take Part in the battle
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْخَنْدَقِ، وَهُمْ يَحْفِرُونَ، وَنَحْنُ نَنْقُلُ التُّرَابَ عَلَى أَكْتَادِنَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ عَيْشَ إِلاَّ عَيْشُ الآخِرَهْ، فَاغْفِرْ لِلْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَالأَنْصَارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy qutaybaau, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din rda allh 'nh qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alkhandaqi, wahum yahfiruwna, wanahnu nanqulu altturaaba 'alaa aaktaadinaa, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahumma laa 'aysha iilaaa 'ayshu alakhirah, faaghfir lilmuhaajiriyna waalaansaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the Trench, and some were digging the trench while we were carrying the earth on our shoulders. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'O Allah! There is no life except the life of the Hereafter, so please forgive the Emigrants and the Ansar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْخَنْدَقِ، فَإِذَا الْمُهَاجِرُونَ وَالأَنْصَارُ يَحْفِرُونَ فِي غَدَاةٍ بَارِدَةٍ، فَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ عَبِيدٌ يَعْمَلُونَ ذَلِكَ لَهُمْ، فَلَمَّا رَأَى مَا بِهِمْ مِنَ النَّصَبِ وَالْجُوعِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ الْعَيْشَ عَيْشُ الآخِرَهْ فَاغْفِرْ لِلأَنْصَارِ وَالْمُهَاجِرَهْ ‏"‏ فَقَالُوا مُجِيبِينَ لَهُ نَحْنُ الَّذِينَ بَايَعُوا مُحَمَّدَا عَلَى الْجِهَادِ مَا بَقِينَا أَبَدَا
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, 'an humaydin, sami'tu aanasana rda allh 'nh yaquwlu kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa alkhandaqi, faiidhaa almuhaajiruwna waalaansaaru yahfiruwna fiy ghadaaain baaridaain, falam yakun lahum 'abiydun ya'maluwna dhalika lahum, falammaa raaaa maa bihim mina alnnasabi waaljuw'i qaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinna al'aysha 'ayshu alakhirah faaghfir lilaansaari waalmuhaajirah ‏"‏ faqaaluwa mujiybiyna lahu nahnu alladhiyna baaya'uwa muhammadaa 'alaa aljihaadi maa baqiynaa aabadaa
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out towards the Khandaq (i.e. Trench) and saw the Emigrants and the Ansar digging the trench in the cold morning. They had no slaves to do that (work) for them. When the Prophet saw their hardship and hunger, he said, 'O Allah! The real life is the life of the Hereafter, so please forgive Ansar and the Emigrants." They said in reply to him, "We are those who have given the Pledge of allegiance to Muhammad for to observe Jihad as long as we live
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ جَعَلَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ وَالأَنْصَارُ يَحْفِرُونَ الْخَنْدَقَ حَوْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ، وَيَنْقُلُونَ التُّرَابَ عَلَى مُتُونِهِمْ وَهُمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ الَّذِينَ بَايَعُوا مُحَمَّدَا عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ مَا بَقِينَا أَبَدَا قَالَ يَقُولُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ يُجِيبُهُمُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ لاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُ الآخِرَهْ، فَبَارِكْ فِي الأَنْصَارِ وَالْمُهَاجِرَهْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يُؤْتَوْنَ بِمِلْءِ كَفَّى مِنَ الشَّعِيرِ فَيُصْنَعُ لَهُمْ بِإِهَالَةٍ سَنِخَةٍ تُوضَعُ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ الْقَوْمِ، وَالْقَوْمُ جِيَاعٌ، وَهْىَ بَشِعَةٌ فِي الْحَلْقِ وَلَهَا رِيحٌ مُنْتِنٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala ja'ala almuhaajiruwna waalaansaaru yahfiruwna alkhandaqa hawla almadiynaai, wayanquluwna altturaaba 'alaa mutuwnihim wahum yaquwluwna nahnu alladhiyna baaya'uwa muhammadaa 'alaa aliislaami maa baqiynaa aabadaa qaala yaquwlu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa yujiybuhumu ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinnahu laa khayra iilaaa khayru alakhirah, fabaarik fiy alaansaari waalmuhaajirah ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yuutawna bimil'i kaffaa mina alshha'iyri fayusna'u lahum biiihaalaain sanikhaain tuwda'u bayna yadaai alqawmi, waalqawmu jiyaa'un, wahaa bashi'aaun fiy alhalqi walahaa riyhun muntinun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Al-Muhajirun (i.e. the Emigrants) and the Ansar were digging the trench around Medina and were carrying the earth on their backs while saying, "We are those who have given the pledge of allegiance to Muhammad for Islam as long as we live." The Prophet (ﷺ) said in reply to their saying, "O Allah! There is no goodness except the goodness of the Hereafter; so please grant Your Blessing to the Ansar and the Emigrants." The people used to bring a handful of barley, and a meal used to be prepared thereof by cooking it with a cooking material (i.e. oil, fat and butter having a change in color and smell) and it used to be presented to the people (i.e. workers) who were hungry, and it used to stick to their throats and had a nasty smell
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلاَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ أَيْمَنَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ جَابِرًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَقَالَ إِنَّا يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ نَحْفِرُ فَعَرَضَتْ كُدْيَةٌ شَدِيدَةٌ، فَجَاءُوا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا هَذِهِ كُدْيَةٌ عَرَضَتْ فِي الْخَنْدَقِ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَنَا نَازِلٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ وَبَطْنُهُ مَعْصُوبٌ بِحَجَرٍ، وَلَبِثْنَا ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ لاَ نَذُوقُ ذَوَاقًا، فَأَخَذَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمِعْوَلَ فَضَرَبَ، فَعَادَ كَثِيبًا أَهْيَلَ أَوْ أَهْيَمَ، فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ائْذَنْ لِي إِلَى الْبَيْتِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لاِمْرَأَتِي رَأَيْتُ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا، مَا كَانَ فِي ذَلِكَ صَبْرٌ، فَعِنْدَكِ شَىْءٌ قَالَتْ عِنْدِي شَعِيرٌ وَعَنَاقٌ‏.‏ فَذَبَحْتُ الْعَنَاقَ وَطَحَنَتِ الشَّعِيرَ، حَتَّى جَعَلْنَا اللَّحْمَ فِي الْبُرْمَةِ، ثُمَّ جِئْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْعَجِينُ قَدِ انْكَسَرَ، وَالْبُرْمَةُ بَيْنَ الأَثَافِيِّ قَدْ كَادَتْ أَنْ تَنْضَجَ فَقُلْتُ طُعَيِّمٌ لِي، فَقُمْ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَرَجُلٌ أَوْ رَجُلاَنِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ كَمْ هُوَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَذَكَرْتُ لَهُ، قَالَ ‏"‏ كَثِيرٌ طَيِّبٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُلْ لَهَا لاَ تَنْزِعُ الْبُرْمَةَ وَلاَ الْخُبْزَ مِنَ التَّنُّورِ حَتَّى آتِيَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قُومُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ وَالأَنْصَارُ، فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ قَالَ وَيْحَكِ جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَالأَنْصَارِ وَمَنْ مَعَهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَتْ هَلْ سَأَلَكَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ادْخُلُوا وَلاَ تَضَاغَطُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَعَلَ يَكْسِرُ الْخُبْزَ وَيَجْعَلُ عَلَيْهِ اللَّحْمَ، وَيُخَمِّرُ الْبُرْمَةَ وَالتَّنُّورَ إِذَا أَخَذَ مِنْهُ، وَيُقَرِّبُ إِلَى أَصْحَابِهِ ثُمَّ يَنْزِعُ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَكْسِرُ الْخُبْزَ وَيَغْرِفُ حَتَّى شَبِعُوا وَبَقِيَ بَقِيَّةٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ كُلِي هَذَا وَأَهْدِي، فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ أَصَابَتْهُمْ مَجَاعَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalaaadu bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu aaymana, 'an aabiyhi, qaala aataytu jaabirana rda allh 'nh faqaala iinnaa yawma alkhandaqi nahfiru fa'aradat kudyaaun shadiydaaun, fajaa'uwa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa hadhihi kudyaaun 'aradat fiy alkhandaqi, faqaala ‏"‏ aanaa naazilun ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaama wabatnuhu ma'suwbun bihajarin, walabithnaa thalaathaaa aayyaamin laa nadhuwqu dhawaaqana, faaakhadha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almi'wala fadaraba, fa'aada kathiybana aahyala aaw aahyama, faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aidhan liy iilaa albayti‏.‏ faqultu laimraaatiy raaaytu bialnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm shayiana, maa kaana fiy dhalika sabrun, fa'indaki shaa'un qaalat 'indiy sha'iyrun wa'anaaqun‏.‏ fadhabahtu al'anaaqa watahanati alshha'iyra, hattaa ja'alnaa alllahma fiy alburmaai, thumma jiitu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waal'ajiynu qadi ankasara, waalburmaau bayna alaathaafiyyi qad kaadat aan tandaja faqultu tu'ayyimun liy, faqum aanta yaa rasuwla alllahi warajulun aaw rajulaani‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ kam huwa ‏"‏‏.‏ fadhakartu lahu, qaala ‏"‏ kathiyrun tayyibun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ qul lahaa laa tanzi'u alburmaaa walaa alkhubza mina alttannuwri hattaa atiya ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ quwmuwa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaama almuhaajiruwna waalaansaaru, falammaa dakhala 'alaa amraaatihi qaala wayhaki jaa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bialmuhaajiriyna waalaansaari waman ma'ahum‏.‏ qaalat hal saaalaka qultu na'am‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ adkhuluwa walaa tadaaghatuwa ‏"‏‏.‏ faja'ala yaksiru alkhubza wayaj'alu 'alayhi alllahma, wayukhammiru alburmaaa waalttannuwra iidhaa aakhadha minhu, wayuqarribu iilaa aashaabihi thumma yanzi'u, falam yazal yaksiru alkhubza wayaghrifu hattaa shabi'uwa wabaqiya baqiyyaaun qaala ‏"‏ kuliy hadhaa waaahdiy, faiinna alnnaasa aasaabathum majaa'aaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:We were digging (the trench) on the day of (Al-Khandaq ( i.e. Trench )) and we came across a big solid rock. We went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Here is a rock appearing across the trench." He said, "I am coming down." Then he got up, and a stone was tied to his belly for we had not eaten anything for three days. So the Prophet (ﷺ) took the spade and struck the big solid rock and it became like sand. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allow me to go home." (When the Prophet (ﷺ) allowed me) I said to my wife, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) in a state that I cannot treat lightly. Have you got something (for him to eat?" She replied, "I have barley and a she goat." So I slaughtered the she-kid and she ground the barley; then we put the meat in the earthenware cooking pot. Then I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) when the dough had become soft and fermented and (the meat in) the pot over the stone trivet had nearly been well-cooked, and said, "I have got a little food prepared, so get up O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), you and one or two men along with you (for the food)." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "How much is that food?" I told him about it. He said, "It is abundant and good. Tell your wife not to remove the earthenware pot from the fire and not to take out any bread from the oven till I reach there." Then he said (to all his companions), "Get up." So the Muhajirin (i.e. Emigrants) and the Ansar got up. When I came to my wife, I said, "Allah's Mercy be upon you! The Prophet came along with the Muhajirin and the Ansar and those who were present with them." She said, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) ask you (how much food you had)?" I replied, "Yes." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Enter and do not throng." The Prophet (ﷺ) started cutting the bread (into pieces) and put the cooked meat over it. He covered the earthenware pot and the oven whenever he took something out of them. He would give the food to his companions and take the meat out of the pot. He went on cutting the bread and scooping the meat (for his companions) till they all ate their fill, and even then, some food remained. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to my wife), "Eat and present to others as the people are struck with hunger
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَنْظَلَةُ بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مِينَاءَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا حُفِرَ الْخَنْدَقُ رَأَيْتُ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَمَصًا شَدِيدًا، فَانْكَفَأْتُ إِلَى امْرَأَتِي فَقُلْتُ هَلْ عِنْدَكِ شَىْءٌ فَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَمَصًا شَدِيدًا‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَتْ إِلَىَّ جِرَابًا فِيهِ صَاعٌ مِنْ شَعِيرٍ، وَلَنَا بُهَيْمَةٌ دَاجِنٌ فَذَبَحْتُهَا، وَطَحَنَتِ الشَّعِيرَ فَفَرَغَتْ إِلَى فَرَاغِي، وَقَطَّعْتُهَا فِي بُرْمَتِهَا، ثُمَّ وَلَّيْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ لاَ تَفْضَحْنِي بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِمَنْ مَعَهُ‏.‏ فَجِئْتُهُ فَسَارَرْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ذَبَحْنَا بُهَيْمَةً لَنَا وَطَحَنَّا صَاعًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ كَانَ عِنْدَنَا، فَتَعَالَ أَنْتَ وَنَفَرٌ مَعَكَ‏.‏ فَصَاحَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَهْلَ الْخَنْدَقِ، إِنَّ جَابِرًا قَدْ صَنَعَ سُورًا فَحَىَّ هَلاً بِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُنْزِلُنَّ بُرْمَتَكُمْ، وَلاَ تَخْبِزُنَّ عَجِينَكُمْ حَتَّى أَجِيءَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجِئْتُ وَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْدُمُ النَّاسَ حَتَّى جِئْتُ امْرَأَتِي، فَقَالَتْ بِكَ وَبِكَ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ قَدْ فَعَلْتُ الَّذِي قُلْتِ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَتْ لَهُ عَجِينًا، فَبَصَقَ فِيهِ وَبَارَكَ، ثُمَّ عَمَدَ إِلَى بُرْمَتِنَا فَبَصَقَ وَبَارَكَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ادْعُ خَابِزَةً فَلْتَخْبِزْ مَعِي وَاقْدَحِي مِنْ بُرْمَتِكُمْ وَلاَ تُنْزِلُوهَا‏"‏، وَهُمْ أَلْفٌ، فَأُقْسِمُ بِاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَكَلُوا حَتَّى تَرَكُوهُ وَانْحَرَفُوا، وَإِنَّ بُرْمَتَنَا لَتَغِطُّ كَمَا هِيَ، وَإِنَّ عَجِينَنَا لَيُخْبَزُ كَمَا هُوَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, aakhbaranaa hanzalaau bnu aabiy sufyaana, aakhbaranaa sa'iydu bnu miynaa'a, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala lammaa hufira alkhandaqu raaaytu bialnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm khamasana shadiydana, faankafaatu iilaa amraaatiy faqultu hal 'indaki shaa'un faiinniy raaaytu birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khamasana shadiydana‏.‏ faaakhrajat iilaaaa jiraabana fiyhi saa'un min sha'iyrin, walanaa buhaymaaun daajinun fadhabahtuhaa, watahanati alshha'iyra fafaraghat iilaa faraaghiy, waqatta'tuhaa fiy burmatihaa, thumma wallaytu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat laa tafdahniy birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wabiman ma'ahu‏.‏ fajiituhu fasaarartuhu faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi dhabahnaa buhaymaaan lanaa watahannaa saa'ana min sha'iyrin kaana 'indanaa, fata'aala aanta wanafarun ma'aka‏.‏ fasaaha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ yaa aahla alkhandaqi, iinna jaabirana qad sana'a suwrana fahaaaa halaan bikum ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tunzilunna burmatakum, walaa takhbizunna 'ajiynakum hattaa aajiy'a ‏"‏‏.‏ fajiitu wajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqdumu alnnaasa hattaa jiitu amraaatiy, faqaalat bika wabika‏.‏ faqultu qad fa'altu alladhiy qulti‏.‏ faaakhrajat lahu 'ajiynana, fabasaqa fiyhi wabaaraka, thumma 'amada iilaa burmatinaa fabasaqa wabaaraka thumma qaala ‏"‏ ad'u khaabizaaan faltakhbiz ma'iy waaqdahiy min burmatikum walaa tunziluwhaa‏"‏, wahum aalfun, faauqsimu bialllahi laqad aakaluwa hattaa tarakuwhu waanharafuwa, waiinna burmatanaa lataghittu kamaa hiya, waiinna 'ajiynanaa layukhbazu kamaa huwa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:When the Trench was dug, I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) in the state of severe hunger. So I returned to my wife and said, "Have you got anything (to eat), for I have seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a state of severe hunger." She brought out for me, a bag containing one Sa of barley, and we had a domestic she animal (i.e. a kid) which I slaughtered then, and my wife ground the barley and she finished at the time I finished my job (i.e. slaughtering the kid). Then I cut the meat into pieces and put it in an earthenware (cooking) pot, and returned to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . My wife said, "Do not disgrace me in front of Allah's Apostle and those who are with him." So I went to him and said to him secretly, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have slaughtered a she-animal (i.e. kid) of ours, and we have ground a Sa of barley which was with us. So please come, you and another person along with you." The Prophet (ﷺ) raised his voice and said, "O people of Trench ! Jabir has prepared a meal so let us go." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Don't put down your earthenware meat pot (from the fireplace) or bake your dough till I come." So I came (to my house) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) too, came, proceeding before the people. When I came to my wife, she said, "May Allah do so-and-so to you." I said, "I have told the Prophet (ﷺ) of what you said." Then she brought out to him (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) the dough, and he spat in it and invoked for Allah's Blessings in it. Then he proceeded towards our earthenware meat-pot and spat in it and invoked for Allah's Blessings in it. Then he said (to my wife). Call a lady-baker to bake along with you and keep on taking out scoops from your earthenware meat-pot, and do not put it down from its fireplace." They were onethousand (who took their meals), and by Allah they all ate, and when they left the food and went away, our earthenware pot was still bubbling (full of meat) as if it had not decreased, and our dough was still being baked as if nothing had been taken from it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها ‏{‏إِذْ جَاءُوكُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ الأَبْصَارُ‏}‏ قَالَتْ كَانَ ذَاكَ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, rda allh 'nha ‏{‏iidh jaa'uwkum min fawqikum wamin aasfala minkum waiidh zaaghati alaabsaaru‏}‏ qaalat kaana dhaaka yawma alkhandaqi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:As regards the following Qur'anic Verse:-- "When they came on you from above and from below you (from east and west of the valley) and when the eyes grew wild and the hearts reached up to the throats....." (33.10) That happened on the day of Al-Khandaq (i.e. Trench)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْقُلُ التُّرَابَ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ حَتَّى أَغْمَرَ بَطْنَهُ أَوِ اغْبَرَّ بَطْنُهُ يَقُولُ وَاللَّهِ لَوْلاَ اللَّهُ مَا اهْتَدَيْنَا وَلاَ تَصَدَّقْنَا وَلاَ صَلَّيْنَا فَأَنْزِلَنْ سَكِينَةً عَلَيْنَا وَثَبِّتِ الأَقْدَامَ إِنْ لاَقَيْنَا إِنَّ الأُلَى قَدْ بَغَوْا عَلَيْنَا إِذَا أَرَادُوا فِتْنَةً أَبَيْنَا وَرَفَعَ بِهَا صَوْتَهُ أَبَيْنَا أَبَيْنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i rda allh 'nh qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yanqulu altturaaba yawma alkhandaqi hattaa aaghmara batnahu aawi aghbarra batnuhu yaquwlu waalllahi lawlaa alllahu maa ahtadaynaa walaa tasaddaqnaa walaa sallaynaa faaanzilan sakiynaaan 'alaynaa wathabbiti alaaqdaama iin laaqaynaa iinna alaulaa qad baghawa 'alaynaa iidhaa aaraaduwa fitnaaan aabaynaa warafa'a bihaa sawtahu aabaynaa aabaynaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) was carrying earth on the day of Al-Khandaq till his `Abdomen was fully covered with dust, and he was saying, "By Allah, without Allah we would not have been guided, neither would we have given in charity, nor would we have prayed. So (O Allah), please send Sakina (i.e. calmness) upon us, and make our feet firm if we meet the enemy as the enemy have rebelled against us, and if they intend affliction, (i.e. want to frighten us and fight against us then we would not flee but withstand them)." The Prophet (ﷺ) used to raise his voice saying, "Abaina! Abaina! (i.e. would not, we would not)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رَضِيَ الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ نُصِرْتُ بِالصَّبَا وَأُهْلِكَتْ عَادٌ بِالدَّبُورِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an shu'baaa, qaala haddathaniy alhakamu, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin radiya allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ nusirtu bialssabaa waauhlikat 'aadun bialddabuwri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been made victorious by As-Saba (i.e. an easterly wind) and the Ad nation was destroyed by Ad-Dabur (i.e. a westerly wind)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُرَيْحُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، يُحَدِّثُ قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ الأَحْزَابِ، وَخَنْدَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَيْتُهُ يَنْقُلُ مِنْ تُرَابِ الْخَنْدَقِ حَتَّى وَارَى عَنِّي الْغُبَارُ جِلْدَةَ بَطْنِهِ، وَكَانَ كَثِيرَ الشَّعَرِ، فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَرْتَجِزُ بِكَلِمَاتِ ابْنِ رَوَاحَةَ، وَهْوَ يَنْقُلُ مِنَ التُّرَابِ يَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ لَوْلاَ أَنْتَ مَا اهْتَدَيْنَا وَلاَ تَصَدَّقْنَا وَلاَ صَلَّيْنَا فَأَنْزِلَنْ سَكِينَةً عَلَيْنَا وَثَبِّتِ الأَقْدَامَ إِنْ لاَقَيْنَا إِنَّ الأُلَى قَدْ بَغَوْا عَلَيْنَا وَإِنْ أَرَادُوا فِتْنَةً أَبَيْنَا قَالَ ثُمَّ يَمُدُّ صَوْتَهُ بِآخِرِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana, haddathanaa shurayhu bnu maslamaaa, qaala haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a, yuhaddithu qaala lammaa kaana yawmu alaahzaabi, wakhandaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaytuhu yanqulu min turaabi alkhandaqi hattaa waaraa 'anniy alghubaaru jildaaa batnihi, wakaana kathiyra alshha'ari, fasami'tuhu yartajizu bikalimaati abni rawaahaaa, wahwa yanqulu mina altturaabi yaquwlu alllahumma lawlaa aanta maa ahtadaynaa walaa tasaddaqnaa walaa sallaynaa faaanzilan sakiynaaan 'alaynaa wathabbiti alaaqdaama iin laaqaynaa iinna alaulaa qad baghawa 'alaynaa waiin aaraaduwa fitnaaan aabaynaa qaala thumma yamuddu sawtahu biakhirihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:When it was the day of Al-Ahzab (i.e. the clans) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dug the trench, I saw him carrying earth out of the trench till dust made the skin of his `Abdomen out of my sight and he was a hairy man. I heard him reciting the poetic verses composed by Ibn Rawaha while he was carrying the earth, "O Allah! Without You we would not have been guided, nor would we have given in charity, nor would we have prayed. So, (O Allah), please send Sakina (i.e. calmness) upon us and make our feet firm if we meet the enemy, as they have rebelled against us. And if they intend affliction (i.e. want to frighten us, and fight against us) then we would not (flee but withstand them)." The Prophet (ﷺ) would then prolong his voice at the last words
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ ـ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَوَّلُ يَوْمٍ شَهِدْتُهُ يَوْمُ الْخَنْدَقِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdaau bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani huwa abnu 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin 'an aabiyhi, aanna abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala aawwalu yawmin shahidtuhu yawmu alkhandaqi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The first day (i.e. Ghazwa) I participated in, was the day of Al-Khandaq (i.e. Trench)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى حَفْصَةَ وَنَسْوَاتُهَا تَنْطُفُ، قُلْتُ قَدْ كَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِ النَّاسِ مَا تَرَيْنَ، فَلَمْ يُجْعَلْ لِي مِنَ الأَمْرِ شَىْءٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَتِ الْحَقْ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ، وَأَخْشَى أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي احْتِبَاسِكَ عَنْهُمْ فُرْقَةٌ‏.‏ فَلَمْ تَدَعْهُ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ، فَلَمَّا تَفَرَّقَ النَّاسُ خَطَبَ مُعَاوِيَةُ قَالَ مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ فِي هَذَا الأَمْرِ فَلْيُطْلِعْ لَنَا قَرْنَهُ، فَلَنَحْنُ أَحَقُّ بِهِ مِنْهُ وَمِنْ أَبِيهِ‏.‏ قَالَ حَبِيبُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ فَهَلاَّ أَجَبْتَهُ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَحَلَلْتُ حُبْوَتِي وَهَمَمْتُ أَنْ أَقُولَ أَحَقُّ بِهَذَا الأَمْرِ مِنْكَ مَنْ قَاتَلَكَ وَأَبَاكَ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ‏.‏ فَخَشِيتُ أَنْ أَقُولَ كَلِمَةً تُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ الْجَمْعِ، وَتَسْفِكُ الدَّمَ، وَيُحْمَلُ عَنِّي غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ، فَذَكَرْتُ مَا أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ فِي الْجِنَانِ‏.‏ قَالَ حَبِيبٌ حُفِظْتَ وَعُصِمْتَ‏.‏ قَالَ مَحْمُودٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ وَنَوْسَاتُهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala waaakhbaraniy abnu taawusin, 'an 'ikrimaaa bni khaalidin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala dakhaltu 'alaa hafsaaa wanaswaatuhaa tantufu, qultu qad kaana min aamri alnnaasi maa tarayna, falam yuj'al liy mina alaamri shaa'un‏.‏ faqaalati alhaq faiinnahum yantaziruwnaka, waaakhshaa aan yakuwna fiy ahtibaasika 'anhum furqaaun‏.‏ falam tada'hu hattaa dhahaba, falammaa tafarraqa alnnaasu khataba mu'aawiyaau qaala man kaana yuriydu aan yatakallama fiy hadhaa alaamri falyutli' lanaa qarnahu, falanahnu aahaqqu bihi minhu wamin aabiyhi‏.‏ qaala habiybu bnu maslamaaa fahalaaa aajabtahu qaala 'abdu alllahi fahalaltu hubwatiy wahamamtu aan aaquwla aahaqqu bihadhaa alaamri minka man qaatalaka waaabaaka 'alaa aliislaami‏.‏ fakhashiytu aan aaquwla kalimaaan tufarriqu bayna aljam'i, watasfiku alddama, wayuhmalu 'anniy ghayru dhalika, fadhakartu maa aa'adda alllahu fiy aljinaani‏.‏ qaala habiybun hufizta wa'usimta‏.‏ qaala mahmuwdun 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi wanawsaatuhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ikrima bin Khalid:Ibn `Umar said, "I went to Hafsa while water was dribbling from her twined braids. I said, 'The condition of the people is as you see, and no authority has been given to me.' Hafsa said, (to me), 'Go to them, and as they (i.e. the people) are waiting for you, and I am afraid your absence from them will produce division amongst them.' " So Hafsa did not leave Ibn `Umar till we went to them. When the people differed. Muawiya addressed the people saying, "'If anybody wants to say anything in this matter of the Caliphate, he should show up and not conceal himself, for we are more rightful to be a Caliph than he and his father." On that, Habib bin Masalama said (to Ibn `Umar), "Why don't you reply to him (i.e. Muawiya)?" `Abdullah bin `Umar said, "I untied my garment that was going round my back and legs while I was sitting and was about to say, 'He who fought against you and against your father for the sake of Islam, is more rightful to be a Caliph,' but I was afraid that my statement might produce differences amongst the people and cause bloodshed, and my statement might be interpreted not as I intended. (So I kept quiet) remembering what Allah has prepared in the Gardens of Paradise (for those who are patient and prefer the Hereafter to this worldly life)." Habib said, "You did what kept you safe and secure (i.e. you were wise in doing so)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ صُرَدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الأَحْزَابِ ‏ "‏ نَغْزُوهُمْ وَلاَ يَغْزُونَنَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an sulaymaana bni suradin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alaahzaabi ‏ "‏ naghzuwhum walaa yaghzuwnanaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sulaiman bin Surad:On the day of Al-Ahzab (i.e. clans) the Prophet (ﷺ) said, (After this battle) we will go to attack them(i.e. the infidels) and they will not come to attack us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ صُرَدٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ حِينَ أَجْلَى الأَحْزَابُ عَنْهُ ‏ "‏ الآنَ نَغْزُوهُمْ وَلاَ يَغْزُونَنَا، نَحْنُ نَسِيرُ إِلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, sami'tu aabaa iishaaqa, yaquwlu sami'tu sulaymaana bna suradin, yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu hiyna aajlaa alaahzaabu 'anhu ‏ "‏ alana naghzuwhum walaa yaghzuwnanaa, nahnu nasiyru iilayhim ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sulaiman bin Surad:When the clans were driven away, I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "From now onwards we will go to attack them (i.e. the infidels) and they will not come to attack us, but we will go to them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ ‏ "‏ مَلأَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ بُيُوتَهُمْ وَقُبُورَهُمْ نَارًا كَمَا شَغَلُونَا عَنْ صَلاَةِ الْوُسْطَى حَتَّى غَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an muhammadin, 'an 'abiydaaa, 'an 'aliyyin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala yawma alkhandaqi ‏ "‏ malaa alllahu 'alayhim buyuwtahum waqubuwrahum naarana kamaa shaghaluwnaa 'an salaaai alwustaa hattaa ghaabati alshhamsu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:On the day of Al-Khandaq (i.e. Trench), the Prophet (ﷺ) said '(Let) Allah fill their (i.e. the infidels') houses and graves with fire just as they have prevented us from offering the Middle Prayer (i.e. `Asr prayer) till the sun had set
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ بَعْدَ مَا غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ جَعَلَ يَسُبُّ كُفَّارَ قُرَيْشٍ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا كِدْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ حَتَّى كَادَتِ الشَّمْسُ أَنْ تَغْرُبَ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَاللَّهِ مَا صَلَّيْتُهَا ‏"‏ فَنَزَلْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بُطْحَانَ، فَتَوَضَّأَ لِلصَّلاَةِ وَتَوَضَّأْنَا لَهَا، فَصَلَّى الْعَصْرَ بَعْدَ مَا غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى بَعْدَهَا الْمَغْرِبَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa almakkiyyu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh jaa'a yawma alkhandaqi ba'da maa gharabati alshhamsu ja'ala yasubbu kuffaara qurayshin qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi maa kidtu aan ausalliya hattaa kaadati alshhamsu aan taghruba‏.‏ qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waalllahi maa sallaytuhaa ‏"‏ fanazalnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm buthaana, fatawaddaaa lilssalaaai watawaddaanaa lahaa, fasallaa al'asra ba'da maa gharabati alshhamsu, thumma sallaa ba'dahaa almaghriba‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:`Umar bin Al-Khattab came on the day of Al-Khandaq after the sun had set and he was abusing the infidels of Quraish saying, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I was unable to offer the (`Asr) prayer till the sun was about to set." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Allah, I have not offered this (i.e. `Asr) prayer." So we came down along with the Prophet (ﷺ) to Buthan where he performed ablution for the prayer and then we performed the ablution for it. Then he offered the `Asr prayer after the sun had set, and after it he offered the Maghrib prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الأَحْزَابِ ‏"‏ مَنْ يَأْتِينَا بِخَبَرِ الْقَوْمِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ أَنَا‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ يَأْتِينَا بِخَبَرِ الْقَوْمِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ أَنَا‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ يَأْتِينَا بِخَبَرِ الْقَوْمِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ أَنَا‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ حَوَارِيًّا، وَإِنَّ حَوَارِيَّ الزُّبَيْرُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'ani abni almunkadiri, qaala sami'tu jaabirana, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alaahzaabi ‏"‏ man yaatiynaa bikhabari alqawmi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala alzzubayru aanaa‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ man yaatiynaa bikhabari alqawmi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala alzzubayru aanaa‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ man yaatiynaa bikhabari alqawmi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala alzzubayru aanaa‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinna likulli nabiyyin hawaariyyana, waiinna hawaariyya alzzubayru ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:On the day of Al-Ahzab (i.e. clans), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Who will bring us the news of the people (i.e. the clans of Quraish infidels)?" Az-Zubair said, "I." The Prophet (ﷺ) again said, "Who will bring us the news of the people?" Az-Zubair said, "I." The Prophet (ﷺ) again said, "Who will bring us the news of the people?" Az-Zubair said, "I." The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Every prophet has his Hawari (i.e. disciple - special helper); my disciple is Az-Zubair
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَعَزَّ جُنْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَغَلَبَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ، فَلاَ شَىْءَ بَعْدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu, aa'azza jundahu, wanasara 'abdahu waghalaba alaahzaaba wahdahu, falaa shaa'a ba'dahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say, "None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Alone (Who) honored His Warriors and made His Slave victorious, and He (Alone) defeated the (infidel) clans; so there is nothing after Him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَزَارِيُّ، وَعَبْدَةُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ دَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الأَحْزَابِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, aakhbaranaa alfazaariyyu, wa'abdaau, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna aabiy aawfaa rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu da'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alaahzaabi faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma munzila alkitaabi, sariy'a alhisaabi, ahzimi alaahzaaba, alllahumma ahzimhum wazalzilhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked evil upon the clans saying, "Allah, the Revealer of the Holy Book (i.e. the Qur'an), the Quick Taker of the accounts! Please defeat the clans. O Allah! Defeat them and shake them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، وَنَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا قَفَلَ مِنَ الْغَزْوِ، أَوِ الْحَجِّ، أَوِ الْعُمْرَةِ، يَبْدَأُ فَيُكَبِّرُ ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهْوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونُ سَاجِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an saalimin, wanaafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa qafala mina alghazwi, aawi alhajji, aawi al'umraai, yabdaau fayukabbiru thalaatha miraarin thumma yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu, lahu almulku walahu alhamdu, wahwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun, ayibuwna taaiibuwna 'aabiduwnu saajiduwna, lirabbinaa haamiduwna, sadaqa alllahu wa'dahu, wanasara 'abdahu, wahazama alaahzaaba wahdahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned from a Ghazwa, Hajj or `Umra, he used to start (saying), "Allahu- Akbar," thrice and then he would say, "None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone Who has no partners. To Him belongs the Kingdom, all praises are for Him, and He is able to do all things (i.e. Omnipotent). We are returning with repentance (to Allah) worshipping, prostrating, and praising our Lord. Allah has fulfilled His Promise, made His Slave victorious, and He (Alone) defeated the clans (of infidels)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ لَمَّا رَجَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْخَنْدَقِ وَوَضَعَ السِّلاَحَ وَاغْتَسَلَ، أَتَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ فَقَالَ قَدْ وَضَعْتَ السِّلاَحَ وَاللَّهِ مَا وَضَعْنَاهُ، فَاخْرُجْ إِلَيْهِمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَإِلَى أَيْنَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ هَا هُنَا، وَأَشَارَ إِلَى بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ، فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat lammaa raja'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alkhandaqi wawada'a alssilaaha waaghtasala, aataahu jibriylu 'alayhi alssalaamu faqaala qad wada'ta alssilaaha waalllahi maa wada'naahu, faakhruj iilayhim‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ faiilaa aayna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala haa hunaa, waaashaara iilaa baniy qurayzaaa, fakharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilayhim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from Al-Khandaq (i.e. Trench) and laid down his arms and took a bath, Gabriel came and said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), You have laid down your arms? By Allah, we angels have not laid them down yet. So set out for them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Where to go?" Gabriel said, "Towards this side," pointing towards Banu Quraiza. So the Prophet (ﷺ) went out towards them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْغُبَارِ سَاطِعًا فِي زُقَاقِ بَنِي غَنْمٍ مَوْكِبِ جِبْرِيلَ حِينَ سَارَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, 'an humaydi bni hilaalin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala kaaanniy aanzuru iilaa alghubaari saati'ana fiy zuqaaqi baniy ghanmin mawkibi jibriyla hiyna saara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa baniy qurayzaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:As if I am just now looking at the dust rising in the street of Banu Ghanm (in Medina) because of the marching of Gabriel's regiment when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out to Banu Quraiza (to attack them)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ بْنُ أَسْمَاءَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الأَحْزَابِ ‏ "‏ لاَ يُصَلِّيَنَّ أَحَدٌ الْعَصْرَ إِلاَّ فِي بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَدْرَكَ بَعْضُهُمُ الْعَصْرَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لاَ نُصَلِّي حَتَّى نَأْتِيَهَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَلْ نُصَلِّي، لَمْ يُرِدْ مِنَّا ذَلِكَ، فَذُكِرَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يُعَنِّفْ وَاحِدًا مِنْهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadi bni aasmaa'a, haddathanaa juwayriyaau bnu aasmaa'a, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alaahzaabi ‏ "‏ laa yusalliyanna aahadun al'asra iilaaa fiy baniy qurayzaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faaadraka ba'duhumu al'asra fiy alttariyqi, faqaala ba'duhum laa nusalliy hattaa naatiyahaa‏.‏ waqaala ba'duhum bal nusalliy, lam yurid minnaa dhalika, fadhukira dhalika lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm falam yu'annif waahidana minhum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:On the day of Al-Ahzab (i.e. Clans) the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you Muslims) should offer the `Asr prayer but at Banu Quraiza's place." The `Asr prayer became due for some of them on the way. Some of those said, "We will not offer it till we reach it, the place of Banu Quraiza," while some others said, "No, we will pray at this spot, for the Prophet (ﷺ) did not mean that for us." Later on It was mentioned to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he did not berate any of the two groups
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، وَحَدَّثَنِي خَلِيفَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ يَجْعَلُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم النَّخَلاَتِ حَتَّى افْتَتَحَ قُرَيْظَةَ وَالنَّضِيرَ، وَإِنَّ أَهْلِي أَمَرُونِي أَنْ آتِيَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَسْأَلَهُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا أَعْطَوْهُ أَوْ بَعْضَهُ‏.‏ وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ أَعْطَاهُ أُمَّ أَيْمَنَ، فَجَاءَتْ أُمُّ أَيْمَنَ فَجَعَلَتِ الثَّوْبَ فِي عُنُقِي تَقُولُ كَلاَّ وَالَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ لاَ يُعْطِيكَهُمْ وَقَدْ أَعْطَانِيهَا، أَوْ كَمَا قَالَتْ، وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَكِ كَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَتَقُولُ كَلاَّ وَاللَّهِ‏.‏ حَتَّى أَعْطَاهَا، حَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ عَشَرَةَ أَمْثَالِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy alaaswadi, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, wahaddathaniy khaliyfaau, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, qaala sami'tu aabiy, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala kaana alrrajulu yaj'alu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alnnakhalaati hattaa aftataha qurayzaaa waalnnadiyra, waiinna aahliy aamaruwniy aan atiya alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaasaalahu alladhiyna kaanuwa aa'tawhu aaw ba'dahu‏.‏ wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qad aa'taahu aumma aaymana, fajaa'at aummu aaymana faja'alati althhawba fiy 'unuqiy taquwlu kalaaa waalladhiy laa iilaha iilaaa huwa laa yu'tiykahum waqad aa'taaniyhaa, aaw kamaa qaalat, waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ laki kadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ wataquwlu kalaaa waalllahi‏.‏ hattaa aa'taahaa, hasibtu aannahu qaala ‏"‏ 'asharaaa aamthaalihi ‏"‏‏.‏ aaw kamaa qaala‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Some (of the Ansar) used to present date palm trees to the Prophet (ﷺ) till Banu Quraiza and Banu An- Nadir were conquered (then he returned to the people their date palms). My people ordered me to ask the Prophet (ﷺ) to return some or all the date palms they had given to him, but the Prophet (ﷺ) had given those trees to Um Aiman. On that, Um Aiman came and put the garment around my neck and said, "No, by Him except Whom none has the right to be worshipped, he will not return those trees to you as he (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) has given them to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to her), "Return those trees and I will give you so much (instead of them)." But she kept on refusing, saying, "No, by Allah," till he gave her ten times the number of her date palms
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ نَزَلَ أَهْلُ قُرَيْظَةَ عَلَى حُكْمِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ، فَأَرْسَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى سَعْدٍ، فَأَتَى عَلَى حِمَارٍ، فَلَمَّا دَنَا مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ لِلأَنْصَارِ ‏"‏ قُومُوا إِلَى سَيِّدِكُمْ ـ أَوْ ـ خَيْرِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَؤُلاَءِ نَزَلُوا عَلَى حُكْمِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ تَقْتُلُ مُقَاتِلَتَهُمْ وَتَسْبِي ذَرَارِيَّهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَضَيْتَ بِحُكْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ ‏"‏ بِحُكْمِ الْمَلِكِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'din, qaala sami'tu aabaa aumaamaaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya rda allh 'nh yaquwlu nazala aahlu qurayzaaa 'alaa hukmi sa'di bni mu'aadhin, faaarsala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa sa'din, faaataa 'alaa himaarin, falammaa danaa mina almasjidi qaala lilaansaari ‏"‏ quwmuwa iilaa sayyidikum aaw khayrikum ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ hauulaa'i nazaluwa 'alaa hukmika ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala taqtulu muqaatilatahum watasbiy dharaariyyahum‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ qadayta bihukmi alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ warubbamaa qaala ‏"‏ bihukmi almaliki ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The people of (Banu) Quraiza agreed to accept the verdict of Sa`d bin Mu`adh. So the Prophet (ﷺ) sent for Sa`d, and the latter came (riding) a donkey and when he approached the Mosque, the Prophet (ﷺ) said to the Ansar, "Get up for your chief or for the best among you." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to Sa`d)." These (i.e. Banu Quraiza) have agreed to accept your verdict." Sa`d said, "Kill their (men) warriors and take their offspring as captives, "On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You have judged according to Allah's Judgment," or said, "according to the King's judgment
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ أُصِيبَ سَعْدٌ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ، رَمَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ حِبَّانُ ابْنُ الْعَرِقَةِ، رَمَاهُ فِي الأَكْحَلِ، فَضَرَبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْمَةً فِي الْمَسْجِدِ لِيَعُودَهُ مِنْ قَرِيبٍ، فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْخَنْدَقِ وَضَعَ السِّلاَحَ وَاغْتَسَلَ، فَأَتَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ وَهْوَ يَنْفُضُ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الْغُبَارِ فَقَالَ قَدْ وَضَعْتَ السِّلاَحَ وَاللَّهِ مَا وَضَعْتُهُ، اخْرُجْ إِلَيْهِمْ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ فَأَيْنَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَشَارَ إِلَى بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ، فَأَتَاهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَزَلُوا عَلَى حُكْمِهِ، فَرَدَّ الْحُكْمَ إِلَى سَعْدٍ، قَالَ فَإِنِّي أَحْكُمُ فِيهِمْ أَنْ تُقْتَلَ الْمُقَاتِلَةُ، وَأَنْ تُسْبَى النِّسَاءُ وَالذُّرِّيَّةُ، وَأَنْ تُقْسَمَ أَمْوَالُهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ هِشَامٌ فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ سَعْدًا قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَىَّ أَنْ أُجَاهِدَهُمْ فِيكَ مِنْ قَوْمٍ كَذَّبُوا رَسُولَكَ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَخْرَجُوهُ، اللَّهُمَّ فَإِنِّي أَظُنُّ أَنَّكَ قَدْ وَضَعْتَ الْحَرْبَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ بَقِيَ مِنْ حَرْبِ قُرَيْشٍ شَىْءٌ، فَأَبْقِنِي لَهُ حَتَّى أُجَاهِدَهُمْ فِيكَ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ وَضَعْتَ الْحَرْبَ فَافْجُرْهَا، وَاجْعَلْ مَوْتَتِي فِيهَا‏.‏ فَانْفَجَرَتْ مِنْ لَبَّتِهِ، فَلَمْ يَرُعْهُمْ وَفِي الْمَسْجِدِ خَيْمَةٌ مِنْ بَنِي غِفَارٍ إِلاَّ الدَّمُ يَسِيلُ إِلَيْهِمْ فَقَالُوا يَا أَهْلَ الْخَيْمَةِ مَا هَذَا الَّذِي يَأْتِينَا مِنْ قِبَلِكُمْ فَإِذَا سَعْدٌ يَغْذُو جُرْحُهُ دَمًا، فَمَاتَ مِنْهَا رضى الله عنه‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat ausiyba sa'dun yawma alkhandaqi, ramaahu rajulun min qurayshin yuqaalu lahu hibbaanu abnu al'ariqaai, ramaahu fiy alaakhali, fadaraba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khaymaaan fiy almasjidi liya'uwdahu min qariybin, falammaa raja'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alkhandaqi wada'a alssilaaha waaghtasala, faaataahu jibriylu 'alayhi alssalaamu wahwa yanfudu raasahu mina alghubaari faqaala qad wada'ta alssilaaha waalllahi maa wada'tuhu, akhruj iilayhim‏.‏ qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ faaayna ‏"‏‏.‏ faaashaara iilaa baniy qurayzaaa, faaataahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fanazaluwa 'alaa hukmihi, faradda alhukma iilaa sa'din, qaala faiinniy aahkumu fiyhim aan tuqtala almuqaatilaau, waaan tusbaa alnnisaa'u waaldhhurriyyaau, waaan tuqsama aamwaaluhum‏.‏ qaala hishaamun faaakhbaraniy aabiy 'an 'aaiishaaa aanna sa'dana qaala alllahumma iinnaka ta'lamu aannahu laysa aahadun aahabba iilaaaa aan aujaahidahum fiyka min qawmin kadhhabuwa rasuwlaka sla allh 'lyh wslm waaakhrajuwhu, alllahumma faiinniy aazunnu aannaka qad wada'ta alharba baynanaa wabaynahum, faiin kaana baqiya min harbi qurayshin shaa'un, faaabqiniy lahu hattaa aujaahidahum fiyka, waiin kunta wada'ta alharba faafjurhaa, waaj'al mawtatiy fiyhaa‏.‏ faanfajarat min labbatihi, falam yaru'hum wafiy almasjidi khaymaaun min baniy ghifaarin iilaaa alddamu yasiylu iilayhim faqaaluwa yaa aahla alkhaymaai maa hadhaa alladhiy yaatiynaa min qibalikum faiidhaa sa'dun yaghdhuw jurhuhu damana, famaata minhaa rda allh 'nh‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Sa`d was wounded on the day of Khandaq (i.e. Trench) when a man from Quraish, called Hibban bin Al-`Araqa hit him (with an arrow). The man was Hibban bin Qais from (the tribe of) Bani Mais bin 'Amir bin Lu'ai who shot an arrow at Sa`d's medial arm vein (or main artery of the arm). The Prophet (ﷺ) pitched a tent (for Sa`d) in the Mosque so that he might be near to the Prophet (ﷺ) to visit. When the Prophet returned from the (battle) of Al-Khandaq (i.e. Trench) and laid down his arms and took a bath Gabriel came to him while he (i.e. Gabriel) was shaking the dust off his head, and said, "You have laid down the arms?" By Allah, I have not laid them down. Go out to them (to attack them)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Where?" Gabriel pointed towards Bani Quraiza. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to them (i.e. Banu Quraiza) (i.e. besieged them). They then surrendered to the Prophet's judgment but he directed them to Sa`d to give his verdict concerning them. Sa`d said, "I give my judgment that their warriors should be killed, their women and children should be taken as captives, and their properties distributed." Narrated Hisham: My father informed me that `Aisha said, "Sa`d said, "O Allah! You know that there is nothing more beloved to me than to fight in Your Cause against those who disbelieved Your Apostle and turned him out (of Mecca). O Allah! I think you have put to an end the fight between us and them (i.e. Quraish infidels). And if there still remains any fight with the Quraish (infidels), then keep me alive till I fight against them for Your Sake. But if you have brought the war to an end, then let this wound burst and cause my death thereby.' So blood gushed from the wound. There was a tent in the Mosque belonging to Banu Ghifar who were surprised by the blood flowing towards them . They said, 'O people of the tent! What is this thing which is coming to us from your side?' Behold! Blood was flowing profusely out of Sa`d's wound. Sa`d then died because of that
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَدِيٌّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِحَسَّانَ ‏ "‏ اهْجُهُمْ ـ أَوْ هَاجِهِمْ ـ وَجِبْرِيلُ مَعَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhajjaaju bnu minhaalin, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy 'adiyyun, aannahu sami'a albaraa'a rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm lihassaana ‏ "‏ ahjuhum aaw haajihim wajibriylu ma'aka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Hassan, "Abuse them (with your poems), and Gabriel is with you (i.e, supports you)." (Through another group of sub narrators) Al-Bara bin Azib said, "On the day of Quraiza's (besiege), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Hassan bin Thabit, 'Abuse them (with your poems), and Gabriel is with you (i.e. supports you)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: وَزَادَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ قُرَيْظَةَ لِحَسَّانَ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ ‏ "‏ اهْجُ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، فَإِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ مَعَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wazaada iibraahiymu bnu tahmaana 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an 'adiyyi bni thaabitin, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma qurayzaaa lihassaana bni thaabitin ‏ "‏ ahju almushrikiyna, faiinna jibriyla ma'aka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' bin `Azib said (through another chain of sub-narrators):"On the day of Quraiza's (siege), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Hassan bin Thabit, 'Abuse them (with your poems), and Jibril is with you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عِمْرَانُ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى بِأَصْحَابِهِ فِي الْخَوْفِ فِي غَزْوَةِ السَّابِعَةِ غَزْوَةِ ذَاتِ الرِّقَاعِ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْخَوْفَ بِذِي قَرَدٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu rajaa'in aakhbaranaa 'imraanu alqattaanu, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa biaashaabihi fiy alkhawfi fiy ghazwaai alssaabi'aai ghazwaai dhaati alrriqaa'i‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin sallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alkhawfa bidhiy qaradin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin Abdullah (ra):The Prophet (ﷺ) led his Companions in the Fear Prayer in the seventh Ghazwa i.e. the Ghazwa of Dhat-ur-Riqa. Ibn Abbas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the Fear Prayer at a place called Dhi-Qarad
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: وَقَالَ بَكْرُ بْنُ سَوَادَةَ حَدَّثَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، أَنَّ جَابِرًا، حَدَّثَهُمْ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهِمْ يَوْمَ مُحَارِبٍ وَثَعْلَبَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala bakru bnu sawaadaaa haddathaniy ziyaadu bnu naafi'in, 'an aabiy muwsaa, aanna jaabirana, haddathahum sallaa alnnabiyyu, sla allh 'lyh wslm bihim yawma muhaaribin watha'labaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir said that the Prophet (ﷺ) led the people in the Fear Prayer on the day of Muharib and Tha'laba (i.e. the day of the battle of Dhat-ur-Riqa)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: وَقَالَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ سَمِعْتُ وَهْبَ بْنَ كَيْسَانَ، سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا، خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى ذَاتِ الرِّقَاعِ مِنْ نَخْلٍ فَلَقِيَ جَمْعًا مِنْ غَطَفَانَ، فَلَمْ يَكُنْ قِتَالٌ، وَأَخَافَ النَّاسُ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا فَصَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكْعَتَىِ الْخَوْفِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ يَزِيدُ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ غَزَوْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْقَرَدِ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala abnu iishaaqa sami'tu wahba bna kaysaana, sami'tu jaabirana, kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa dhaati alrriqaa'i min nakhlin falaqiya jam'ana min ghatafaana, falam yakun qitaalun, waaakhaafa alnnaasu ba'duhum ba'dana fasallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm rak'ataai alkhawfi‏.‏ waqaala yaziydu 'an salamaaa ghazawtu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alqaradi‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir added:"The Prophet (ﷺ) set out for the battle of Dhat-ur-Riqa' at a place called Nakhl and he met a group of people from Ghatafan, but there was no clash (between them); the people were afraid of each other and the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the two raka'at of the Fear prayer." Narrated Salama: "I fought in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of al-Qarad
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزَاةٍ وَنَحْنُ سِتَّةُ نَفَرٍ بَيْنَنَا بَعِيرٌ نَعْتَقِبُهُ، فَنَقِبَتْ أَقْدَامُنَا وَنَقِبَتْ قَدَمَاىَ وَسَقَطَتْ أَظْفَارِي، وَكُنَّا نَلُفُّ عَلَى أَرْجُلِنَا الْخِرَقَ، فَسُمِّيَتْ غَزْوَةَ ذَاتِ الرِّقَاعِ، لِمَا كُنَّا نَعْصِبُ مِنَ الْخِرَقِ عَلَى أَرْجُلِنَا، وَحَدَّثَ أَبُو مُوسَى بِهَذَا، ثُمَّ كَرِهَ ذَاكَ، قَالَ مَا كُنْتُ أَصْنَعُ بِأَنْ أَذْكُرَهُ‏.‏ كَأَنَّهُ كَرِهَ أَنْ يَكُونَ شَىْءٌ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ أَفْشَاهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydi bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh qaala kharajnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazaaain wanahnu sittaau nafarin baynanaa ba'iyrun na'taqibuhu, fanaqibat aaqdaamunaa wanaqibat qadamaaaa wasaqatat aazfaariy, wakunnaa naluffu 'alaa aarjulinaa alkhiraqa, fasummiyat ghazwaaa dhaati alrriqaa'i, limaa kunnaa na'sibu mina alkhiraqi 'alaa aarjulinaa, wahaddatha aabuw muwsaa bihadhaa, thumma kariha dhaaka, qaala maa kuntu aasna'u biaan aadhkurahu‏.‏ kaaannahu kariha aan yakuwna shaa'un min 'amalihi aafshaahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda:Abu Musa said, "We went out in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) for a Ghazwa and we were six persons having one camel which we rode in rotation. So, (due to excessive walking) our feet became thin and my feet became thin and my nail dropped, and we used to wrap our feet with the pieces of cloth, and for this reason, the Ghazwa was named Dhat-ur-Riqa as we wrapped our feet with rags." When Abu- Musa narrated this (Hadith), he felt regretful to do so and said, as if he disliked to have disclosed a good deed of his
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُومَانَ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ خَوَّاتٍ، عَمَّنْ شَهِدَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ ذَاتِ الرِّقَاعِ صَلَّى صَلاَةَ الْخَوْفِ أَنَّ طَائِفَةً صَفَّتْ مَعَهُ، وَطَائِفَةٌ وُجَاهَ الْعَدُوِّ، فَصَلَّى بِالَّتِي مَعَهُ رَكْعَةً، ثُمَّ ثَبَتَ قَائِمًا، وَأَتَمُّوا لأَنْفُسِهِمْ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفُوا، فَصَفُّوا وُجَاهَ الْعَدُوِّ، وَجَاءَتِ الطَّائِفَةُ الأُخْرَى فَصَلَّى بِهِمِ الرَّكْعَةَ الَّتِي بَقِيَتْ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ، ثُمَّ ثَبَتَ جَالِسًا، وَأَتَمُّوا لأَنْفُسِهِمْ، ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ بِهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maalikin, 'an yaziyda bni ruwmaana, 'an saalihi bni khawwaatin, 'amman shahida rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma dhaati alrriqaa'i sallaa salaaaa alkhawfi aanna taaiifaaan saffat ma'ahu, wataaiifaaun wujaaha al'aduwwi, fasallaa biallatiy ma'ahu rak'aaan, thumma thabata qaaiimana, waaatammuwa laanfusihim thumma ansarafuwa, fasaffuwa wujaaha al'aduwwi, wajaa'ati alttaaiifaau alaukhraa fasallaa bihimi alrrak'aaa allatiy baqiyat min salaatihi, thumma thabata jaalisana, waaatammuwa laanfusihim, thumma sallama bihim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salih bin Khawwat:Concerning those who witnessed the Fear Prayer that was performed in the battle of Dhat-ur-Riqa' in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); One batch lined up behind him while another batch (lined up) facing the enemy. The Prophet (ﷺ) led the batch that was with him in one rak`a, and he stayed in the standing posture while that batch completed their (two rak`at) prayer by themselves and went away, lining in the face of the enemy, while the other batch came and he (i.e. the Prophet) offered his remaining rak`a with them, and then, kept on sitting till they completed their prayer by themselves, and he then finished his prayer with Taslim along with them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: وَقَالَ مُعَاذٌ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَخْلٍ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ صَلاَةَ الْخَوْفِ‏.‏ قَالَ مَالِكٌ وَذَلِكَ أَحْسَنُ مَا سَمِعْتُ فِي صَلاَةِ الْخَوْفِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ اللَّيْثُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ أَنَّ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَهُ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةِ بَنِي أَنْمَارٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala mu'aadhun haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binakhlin‏.‏ fadhakara salaaaa alkhawfi‏.‏ qaala maalikun wadhalika aahsanu maa sami'tu fiy salaaai alkhawfi‏.‏ taaba'ahu alllaythu 'an hishaamin 'an zaydi bni aaslama aanna alqaasima bna muhammadin haddathahu sallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazwaai baniy aanmaarin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Az-Zubair:Jabir said, "We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) at Nakhl," and then he mentioned the Fear prayer. Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad: The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the Fear prayer in the Ghazwa of Banu Anmar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ خَوَّاتٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ، قَالَ يَقُومُ الإِمَامُ مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، وَطَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ مَعَهُ وَطَائِفَةٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْعَدُوِّ، وُجُوهُهُمْ إِلَى الْعَدُوِّ، فَيُصَلِّي بِالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ رَكْعَةً، ثُمَّ يَقُومُونَ، فَيَرْكَعُونَ لأَنْفُسِهِمْ رَكْعَةً وَيَسْجُدُونَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ فِي مَكَانِهِمْ، ثُمَّ يَذْهَبُ هَؤُلاَءِ إِلَى مَقَامِ أُولَئِكَ فَيَرْكَعُ بِهِمْ رَكْعَةً، فَلَهُ ثِنْتَانِ، ثُمَّ يَرْكَعُونَ وَيَسْجُدُونَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ خَوَّاتٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، سَمِعَ الْقَاسِمَ، أَخْبَرَنِي صَالِحُ بْنُ خَوَّاتٍ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ، حَدَّثَهُ قَوْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa musadaadun, hadaathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin alqataaanu, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin alaansaariyii, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhamaadin, 'an saalihi bni khawaaatin, 'an sahli bni aabiy hathmaaa, qaala yaquwmu aliimaamu mustaqbila alqiblaai, wataaiifaaun minhum ma'ahu wataaiifaaun min qibali al'aduwii, wujuwhuhum iilaa al'aduwii, fayusaliiy bialaadhiyna ma'ahu rak'aaan, thumaa yaquwmuwna, fayarka'uwna laanfusihim rak'aaan wayasjuduwna sajdatayni fiy makaanihim, thumaa yadhhabu hauulaa'i iilaa maqaami auwlaiika fayarka'u bihim rak'aaan, falahu thintaani, thumaa yarka'uwna wayasjuduwna sajdatayni‏.‏ hadaathanaa musadaadun, hadaathanaa yahyaa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an 'abdi alraahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an saalihi bni khawaaatin, 'an sahli bni aabiy hathmaaa, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ hadaathaniy muhamaadu bnu 'ubaydi allaahi, qaala hadaathaniy abnu aabiy haazimin, 'an yahyaa, sami'a alqaasima, aakhbaraniy saalihu bnu khawaaatin, 'an sahlin, hadaathahu qawlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Abi Hathma:(describing the Fear prayer): The Imam stands up facing the Qibla and one batch of them (i.e. the army) (out of the two) prays along with him and the other batch faces the enemy. The Imam offers one rak`a with the first batch, then they themselves stand up alone and offer one bowing and two prostrations while they are still in their place, and then go away to relieve the second batch, and the second batch comes (and takes the place of the first batch in the prayer behind the Imam) and he offers the second rak`a with them. So he completes his two-rak`at and then the second batch bows and prostrates two prostrations (i.e. complete their second rak`a and thus all complete their prayer). (This hadith has also been narrated through two other chains by Sahl b. Abi Hathma)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
