verses.translit: hadaathanaa alsaaltu bnu muhamaadin, hadaathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, qultu lisa'iydi bni almusayaabi balaghaniy aanaa jaabira bna 'abdi allaahi, kaana yaquwlu kaanuwa aarba'a 'ashraaa miaiaaan‏.‏ faqaala liy sa'iydun hadaathaniy jaabirun kaanuwa khamsa 'ashraaa miaiaaan alaadhiyna baaya'uwa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alhudaybiyaai‏.‏ taaba'ahu aabuw daawuda hadaathanaa quraaau 'an qataadaaa
verses.translation: Narrated Qatada:I said to Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab, "I have been informed that Jabir bin `Abdullah said that the number (of Al-Hudaibiya Muslim warriors) was 1400." Sa`id said to me, "Jabir narrated to me that they were 1500 who gave the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of Al-Hudaibiya
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ ‏ "‏ أَنْتُمْ خَيْرُ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكُنَّا أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعَمِائَةٍ، وَلَوْ كُنْتُ أُبْصِرُ الْيَوْمَ لأَرَيْتُكُمْ مَكَانَ الشَّجَرَةِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ الأَعْمَشُ سَمِعَ سَالِمًا سَمِعَ جَابِرًا أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعَمِائَةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala 'amrunw sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alhudaybiyaai ‏ "‏ aantum khayru aahli alaardi ‏"‏‏.‏ wakunnaa aalfana waaarba'amiaiaain, walaw kuntu aubsiru alyawma laaraytukum makaana alshhajaraai‏.‏ taaba'ahu alaa'mashu sami'a saalimana sami'a jaabirana aalfana waaarba'amiaiaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of Al-Hudaibiya, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us' "You are the best people on the earth!" We were 1400 then. If I could see now, I would have shown you the place of the Tree (beneath which we gave the Pledge of Allegiance)." Salim said, "Our number was
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: وَقَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي أَوْفَى ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانَ أَصْحَابُ الشَّجَرَةِ أَلْفًا وَثَلاَثَمِائَةٍ، وَكَانَتْ أَسْلَمُ ثُمْنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy aawfaa rda allh 'nhma kaana aashaabu alshhajaraai aalfana wathalaathamiaiaain, wakaanat aaslamu thumna almuhaajiriyna‏.‏ taaba'ahu muhammadu bnu bashhaarin haddathanaa aabuw daawuda haddathanaa shu'baau‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa said, "The people (who gave the Pledge of allegiance) under the Tree numbered 1300 and the number of Bani Aslam was 1/8 of the Emigrants
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مِرْدَاسًا الأَسْلَمِيَّ، يَقُولُ ـ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الشَّجَرَةِ ـ يُقْبَضُ الصَّالِحُونَ الأَوَّلُ فَالأَوَّلُ، وَتَبْقَى حُفَالَةٌ كَحُفَالَةِ التَّمْرِ وَالشَّعِيرِ، لاَ يَعْبَأُ اللَّهُ بِهِمْ شَيْئًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, 'an iismaa'iyla, 'an qaysin, aannahu sami'a mirdaasana alaaslamiyya, yaquwlu wakaana min aashaabi alshhajaraai yuqbadu alssaalihuwna alaawwalu faalaawwalu, watabqaa hufaalaaun kahufaalaai alttamri waalshha'iyri, laa ya'baau alllahu bihim shayiana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mirdas Al-Aslami:Who was among those (who had given the Pledge of allegiance) under the Tree: Pious people will die in succession, and there will remain the dregs of society who will be like the useless residues of dates and barley and Allah will pay no attention to them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ، وَالْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، قَالاَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فِي بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ قَلَّدَ الْهَدْىَ وَأَشْعَرَ وَأَحْرَمَ مِنْهَا‏.‏ لاَ أُحْصِي كَمْ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ سُفْيَانَ حَتَّى سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ لاَ أَحْفَظُ مِنَ الزُّهْرِيِّ الإِشْعَارَ وَالتَّقْلِيدَ، فَلاَ أَدْرِي ـ يَعْنِي ـ مَوْضِعَ الإِشْعَارِ وَالتَّقْلِيدِ، أَوِ الْحَدِيثَ كُلَّهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an marwaana, waalmiswari bni makhramaaa, qaalaa kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama alhudaybiyaai fiy bid'a 'ashraaa miaiaaan min aashaabihi, falammaa kaana bidhiy alhulayfaai qallada alhadaa waaash'ara waaahrama minhaa‏.‏ laa auhsiy kam sami'tuhu min sufyaana hattaa sami'tuhu yaquwlu laa aahfazu mina alzzuhriyyi aliish'aara waalttaqliyda, falaa aadriy ya'niy mawdi'a aliish'aari waalttaqliydi, aawi alhadiytha kullahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Marwan and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out in the company of 1300 to 1500 of his companions in the year of Al-Hudaibiya, and when they reached Dhul-Hulaifa, he garlanded and marked his Hadi and assumed the state of Ihram
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، وَرْقَاءَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَآهُ وَقَمْلُهُ يَسْقُطُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَحْلِقَ وَهْوَ بِالْحُدَيْبِيَةِ، لَمْ يُبَيِّنْ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ يَحِلُّونَ بِهَا، وَهُمْ عَلَى طَمَعٍ أَنْ يَدْخُلُوا مَكَّةَ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ الْفِدْيَةَ، فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُطْعِمَ فَرَقًا بَيْنَ سِتَّةِ مَسَاكِينَ، أَوْ يُهْدِيَ شَاةً، أَوْ يَصُومَ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu khalafin, qaala haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu yuwsufa, 'an aabiy bishrin, warqaa'a, 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, 'an mujaahidin, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu aabiy laylaa, 'an ka'bi bni 'ujraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raahu waqamluhu yasqutu 'alaa wajhihi faqaala ‏ "‏ aayuudhiyka hawaammuka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ faaamarahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yahliqa wahwa bialhudaybiyaai, lam yubayyin lahum aannahum yahilluwna bihaa, wahum 'alaa tama'in aan yadkhuluwa makkaaa, faaanzala alllahu alfidyaaa, faaamarahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yut'ima faraqana bayna sittaai masaakiyna, aaw yuhdiya shaaaan, aaw yasuwma thalaathaaa aayyaamin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ka`b bin Ujra:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him with the lice falling (from his head) on his face. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Are your lice troubling you? Ka`b said, "Yes." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) thus ordered him to shave his head while he was at Al-Hudaibiya. Up to then there was no indication that all of them would finish their state of Ihram and they hoped that they would enter Mecca. Then the order of Al-Fidya was revealed, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered Ka`b to feed six poor persons with one Faraq of food or slaughter a sheep or fast for three days
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ إِلَى السُّوقِ، فَلَحِقَتْ عُمَرَ امْرَأَةٌ شَابَّةٌ فَقَالَتْ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ هَلَكَ زَوْجِي وَتَرَكَ صِبْيَةً صِغَارًا، وَاللَّهِ مَا يُنْضِجُونَ كُرَاعًا، وَلاَ لَهُمْ زَرْعٌ وَلاَ ضَرْعٌ، وَخَشِيتُ أَنْ تَأْكُلَهُمُ الضَّبُعُ، وَأَنَا بِنْتُ خُفَافِ بْنِ إِيمَاءَ الْغِفَارِيِّ، وَقَدْ شَهِدَ أَبِي الْحُدَيْبِيَةَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَوَقَفَ مَعَهَا عُمَرُ، وَلَمْ يَمْضِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ مَرْحَبًا بِنَسَبٍ قَرِيبٍ‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ إِلَى بَعِيرٍ ظَهِيرٍ كَانَ مَرْبُوطًا فِي الدَّارِ، فَحَمَلَ عَلَيْهِ غِرَارَتَيْنِ مَلأَهُمَا طَعَامًا، وَحَمَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا نَفَقَةً وَثِيَابًا، ثُمَّ نَاوَلَهَا بِخِطَامِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ اقْتَادِيهِ فَلَنْ يَفْنَى حَتَّى يَأْتِيَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِخَيْرٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَكْثَرْتَ لَهَا‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ ثَكِلَتْكَ أُمُّكَ، وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَرَى أَبَا هَذِهِ وَأَخَاهَا قَدْ حَاصَرَا حِصْنًا زَمَانًا، فَافْتَتَحَاهُ، ثُمَّ أَصْبَحْنَا نَسْتَفِيءُ سُهْمَانَهُمَا فِيهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kharajtu ma'a 'umara bni alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh iilaa alssuwqi, falahiqat 'umara amraaaaun shaabbaaun faqaalat yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna halaka zawjiy wataraka sibyaaan sighaarana, waalllahi maa yundijuwna kuraa'ana, walaa lahum zar'un walaa dar'un, wakhashiytu aan taakulahumu alddabu'u, waaanaa bintu khufaafi bni iiymaa'a alghifaariyyi, waqad shahida aabiy alhudaybiyaaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fawaqafa ma'ahaa 'umaru, walam yamdi, thumma qaala marhabana binasabin qariybin‏.‏ thumma ansarafa iilaa ba'iyrin zahiyrin kaana marbuwtana fiy alddaari, fahamala 'alayhi ghiraaratayni malaahumaa ta'aamana, wahamala baynahumaa nafaqaaan wathiyaabana, thumma naawalahaa bikhitaamihi thumma qaala aqtaadiyhi falan yafnaa hattaa yaatiyakumu alllahu bikhayrin‏.‏ faqaala rajulun yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna aaktharta lahaa‏.‏ qaala 'umaru thakilatka aummuka, waalllahi iinniy laaraa aabaa hadhihi waaakhaahaa qad haasaraa hisnana zamaanana, faaftatahaahu, thumma aasbahnaa nastafiy'u suhmaanahumaa fiyhi‏.‏
verses.translation: (Narrated Aslam:Once I went with `Umar bin Al-Khattab to the market. A young woman followed `Umar and said, "O chief of the believers! My husband has died, leaving little children. By Allah, they have not even a sheep's trotter to cook; they have no farms or animals. I am afraid that they may die because of hunger, and I am the daughter of Khufaf bin Ima Al-Ghafari, and my father witnessed the Pledge of allegiance) of Al-Hudaibiya with the Prophet.' `Umar stopped and did not proceed, and said, "I welcome my near relative." Then he went towards a strong camel which was tied in the house, and carried on to it, two sacks he had loaded with food grains and put between them money and clothes and gave her its rope to hold and said, "Lead it, and this provision will not finish till Allah gives you a good supply." A man said, "O chief of the believers! You have given her too much." "`Umar said disapprovingly. "May your mother be bereaved of you! By Allah, I have seen her father and brother besieging a fort for a long time and conquering it, and then we were discussing what their shares they would have from that war booty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ أَبُو عَمْرٍو الْفَزَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ الشَّجَرَةَ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهَا بَعْدُ فَلَمْ أَعْرِفْهَا‏.‏ قَالَ مَحْمُودٌ ثُمَّ أُنْسِيتُهَا بَعْدُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa shabaabaau bnu sawwaarin aabuw 'amrinw alfazaariyyu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala laqad raaaytu alshhajaraaa, thumma aataytuhaa ba'du falam aa'rifhaa‏.‏ qaala mahmuwdun thumma aunsiytuhaa ba'du‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:That his father said, "I saw the Tree (of the Ar-Ridwan Pledge of allegiance) and when I returned to it later, I was not able to recognize it. (The sub--narrator Mahmud said, Al-Musaiyab said, 'Then I forgot it (i.e., the Tree)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ حَاجًّا فَمَرَرْتُ بِقَوْمٍ يُصَلُّونَ قُلْتُ مَا هَذَا الْمَسْجِدُ قَالُوا هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةُ، حَيْثُ بَايَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْعَةَ الرُّضْوَانِ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي أَنَّهُ كَانَ فِيمَنْ بَايَعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ، قَالَ فَلَمَّا خَرَجْنَا مِنَ الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ نَسِينَاهَا، فَلَمْ نَقْدِرْ عَلَيْهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَعْلَمُوهَا وَعَلِمْتُمُوهَا أَنْتُمْ، فَأَنْتُمْ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mahmuwdun, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an taariqi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala antalaqtu haajjana famarartu biqawmin yusalluwna qultu maa hadhaa almasjidu qaaluwa hadhihi alshhajaraau, haythu baaya'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bay'aaa alrrudwaani‏.‏ faaataytu sa'iyda bna almusayyabi faaakhbartuhu faqaala sa'iydun haddathaniy aabiy aannahu kaana fiyman baaya'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tahta alshhajaraai, qaala falammaa kharajnaa mina al'aami almuqbili nasiynaahaa, falam naqdir 'alayhaa‏.‏ faqaala sa'iydun iinna aashaaba muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm lam ya'lamuwhaa wa'alimtumuwhaa aantum, faaantum aa'lamu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Tariq bin `Abdur-Rahman:When I set out for Hajj, I passed by some people offering a prayer, I asked, "What is this mosque?" They said, "This is the Tree where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took the Ar-Ridwan Pledge of allegiance. Then I went to Sa`id bin Musaiyab and informed him about it. Sa`id said, "My father said that he was amongst those who had given the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) beneath the Tree. He (i.e. my father) said, "When we set out the following year, we forgot the Tree and were unable to recognize it. "Then Sa`id said (perhaps ironically) "The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) could not recognize it; nevertheless, you do recognize it; therefore you have a better knowledge
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا طَارِقٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِمَّنْ بَايَعَ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ، فَرَجَعْنَا إِلَيْهَا الْعَامَ الْمُقْبِلَ فَعَمِيَتْ عَلَيْنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, haddathanaa taariqun, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu kaana mimman baaya'a tahta alshhajaraai, faraja'naa iilayhaa al'aama almuqbila fa'amiyat 'alaynaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:That his father was amongst those who had given the Pledge of allegiance (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) beneath the Tree, and the next year when they went towards the Tree, they were not able to recognize it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ طَارِقٍ، قَالَ ذُكِرَتْ عِنْدَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ الشَّجَرَةُ فَضَحِكَ فَقَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي وَكَانَ، شَهِدَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an taariqin, qaala dhukirat 'inda sa'iydi bni almusayyabi alshhajaraau fadahika faqaala aakhbaraniy aabiy wakaana, shahidahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Tariq:(The tree where the Ridwan Pledge of allegiance was taken by the Prophet) was mentioned before Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab. On that he smiled and said, "My father informed me (about it) and he had witnessed it (i.e. the Pledge)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى ـ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الشَّجَرَةِ ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ قَوْمٌ بِصَدَقَةٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ أَبِي بِصَدَقَتِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى آلِ أَبِي أَوْفَى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu bnu aabiy iiyaasin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna aabiy aawfaa wakaana min aashaabi alshhajaraai qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aataahu qawmun bisadaqaain qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma salli 'alayhim ‏"‏‏.‏ faaataahu aabiy bisadaqatihi faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma salli 'alaa ali aabiy aawfaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:(Who was one of those who had given the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) beneath the Tree) When the people brought Sadaqa (i.e. Zakat) to the Prophet (ﷺ) he used to say, "O Allah! Bless them with your Mercy." Once my father came with his Sadaqa to him whereupon he (i.e. the Prophet) said. "O Allah! Bless the family of Abu `Aufa
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْحَرَّةِ وَالنَّاسُ يُبَايِعُونَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ فَقَالَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ عَلَى مَا يُبَايِعُ ابْنُ حَنْظَلَةَ النَّاسَ قِيلَ لَهُ عَلَى الْمَوْتِ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ أُبَايِعُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ أَحَدًا بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَكَانَ شَهِدَ مَعَهُ الْحُدَيْبِيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aakhiyhi, 'an sulaymaana, 'an 'amriw bni yahyaa, 'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, qaala lammaa kaana yawmu alharraai waalnnaasu yubaayi'uwna li'abdi alllahi bni hanzalaaa faqaala abnu zaydin 'alaa maa yubaayi'u abnu hanzalaaa alnnaasa qiyla lahu 'alaa almawti‏.‏ qaala laa aubaayi'u 'alaa dhalika aahadana ba'da rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ wakaana shahida ma'ahu alhudaybiyaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abbas bin Tamim:When it was the day (of the battle) of Al-Harra the people were giving Pledge of allegiance to `Abdullah bin Hanzala. Ibn Zaid said, "For what are the people giving Pledge of allegiance to `Abdullah bin Hanzala?" It was said to him, "For death." Ibn Zaid said, "I will never give the Pledge of allegiance for that to anybody else after Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." Ibn Zaid was one of those who had witnessed the day of Al-Hudaibiya with the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَعْلَى الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا إِيَاسُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ـ أَبِي وَكَانَ، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الشَّجَرَةِ ـ قَالَ كُنَّا نُصَلِّي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْجُمُعَةَ ثُمَّ نَنْصَرِفُ، وَلَيْسَ لِلْحِيطَانِ ظِلٌّ نَسْتَظِلُّ فِيهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu ya'laa almuhaaribiyyu, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa iiyaasu bnu salamaaa bni alaakwa'i, qaala haddathaniy aabiy wakaana, min aashaabi alshhajaraai qaala kunnaa nusalliy ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aljumu'aaa thumma nansarifu, walaysa lilhiytaani zillun nastazillu fiyhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Iyas bin Salama bin Al-Akwa`:My father who was amongst those who had given the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) beneath the Tree, said to me, "We used to offer the Jumua prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then depart at a time when the walls had no shade for us to take shelter in
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِسَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ عَلَى أَىِّ شَىْءٍ بَايَعْتُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ عَلَى الْمَوْتِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa haatimun, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy 'ubaydin, qaala qultu lisalamaaa bni alaakwa'i 'alaa aaaai shaa'in baaya'tum rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alhudaybiyaai‏.‏ qaala 'alaa almawti‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Yazid bin Abi Ubaid:I said to Salama bin Al-Akwa`, "For what did you give the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of Al-Hudaibiya?" He replied, "For death (in the Cause of Islam)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِشْكَابٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَقِيتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ فَقُلْتُ طُوبَى لَكَ صَحِبْتَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبَايَعْتَهُ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي إِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثْنَا بَعْدَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu iishkaabin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, 'ani al'alaa'i bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala laqiytu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma faqultu tuwbaa laka sahibta alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wabaaya'tahu tahta alshhajaraai‏.‏ faqaala yaa abna aakhiy iinnaka laa tadriy maa aahdathnaa ba'dahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Musaiyab:I met Al-Bara bin `Azib and said (to him). "May you live prosperously! You enjoyed the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and gave him the Pledge of allegiance (of Al-Hudaibiya) under the Tree." On that, Al- Bara' said, "O my nephew! You do not know what we have done after him (i.e. his death)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ صَالِحٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ سَلاَّمٍ ـ عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، أَنَّ ثَابِتَ بْنَ الضَّحَّاكِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، بَايَعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu saalihin, qaala haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau huwa abnu salaaamin 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, aanna thaabita bna alddahhaaki, aakhbarahu aannahu, baaya'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm tahta alshhajaraai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Qilaba:that Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak had informed him that he was one of those who had given the Pledge of allegiance (of Al-Hudaibiya) beneath the Tree
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ‏{‏إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا‏}‏ قَالَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَصْحَابُهُ هَنِيئًا مَرِيئًا فَمَا لَنَا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏لِيُدْخِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ‏}‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ فَقَدِمْتُ الْكُوفَةَ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا كُلِّهِ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ فَذَكَرْتُ لَهُ فَقَالَ أَمَّا ‏{‏إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ‏}‏ فَعَنْ أَنَسٍ، وَأَمَّا هَنِيئًا مَرِيئًا فَعَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh ‏{‏iinnaa fatahnaa laka fathana mubiynana‏}‏ qaala alhudaybiyaau‏.‏ qaala aashaabuhu haniyiana mariyiana famaa lanaa faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏liyudkhila almuuminiyna waalmuuminaati jannaatin‏}‏ qaala shu'baau faqadimtu alkuwfaaa fahaddathtu bihadhaa kullihi 'an qataadaaa thumma raja'tu fadhakartu lahu faqaala aammaa ‏{‏iinnaa fatahnaa laka‏}‏ fa'an aanasin, waaammaa haniyiana mariyiana fa'an 'ikrimaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:regarding Allah's Statement: "Verily! We have granted you (O, Muhammad) Manifest victory." (48.1) It refers to the Al-Hudaibiya Pledge. And the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the Prophet), "Congratulations and happiness for you; but what reward shall we get?" So Allah revealed:-- "That He may admit the believing men and women to gardens beneath which rivers flow
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مَجْزَأَةَ بْنِ زَاهِرٍ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ وَكَانَ مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ الشَّجَرَةَ ـ قَالَ إِنِّي لأُوقِدُ تَحْتَ الْقِدْرِ بِلُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ إِذْ نَادَى مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an majzaaaaa bni zaahirin alaaslamiyyi, 'an aabiyhi wakaana mimman shahida alshhajaraaa qaala iinniy lauwqidu tahta alqidri biluhuwmi alhumuri iidh naadaa munaadiy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanhaakum 'an luhuwmi alhumuri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zahir Al-Aslami:(who was one of those who had witnessed (the Pledge of allegiance beneath) the Tree) While I was making fire beneath the cooking pots containing donkey's meat, the announcer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) announced, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbids you to eat donkey's meat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: وَعَنْ مَجْزَأَةَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْهُمْ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الشَّجَرَةِ اسْمُهُ أُهْبَانُ بْنُ أَوْسٍ وَكَانَ اشْتَكَى رُكْبَتَهُ، وَكَانَ إِذَا سَجَدَ جَعَلَ تَحْتَ رُكْبَتِهِ وِسَادَةً‏.‏
verses.translit: wa'an majzaaaaa, 'an rajulin, minhum min aashaabi alshhajaraai asmuhu auhbaanu bnu aawsin wakaana ashtakaa rukbatahu, wakaana iidhaa sajada ja'ala tahta rukbatihi wisaadaaan‏.‏
verses.translation: The same narration was told by Majzaa from a man called Uhban bin Aus who was one of those who had witnessed (the Pledge of allegiance beneath) the Tree., and who had some trouble in his knee so that while doing prostrations, he used to put a pillow underneath his knee
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ ـ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الشَّجَرَةِ ـ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابُهُ أُتُوا بِسَوِيقٍ فَلاَكُوهُ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مُعَاذٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an bushayri bni yasaarin, 'an suwaydi bni alnnu'maani wakaana min aashaabi alshhajaraai kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaashaabuhu autuwa bisawiyqin falaakuwhu‏.‏ taaba'ahu mu'aadhun 'an shu'baaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Suwaid bin An-Nu`man:who was one of those who witnessed (the Pledge of allegiance beneath) the Tree: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions were given Sawiq and they chewed it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَاذَانُ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي جَمْرَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِذَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الشَّجَرَةِ هَلْ يُنْقَضُ الْوِتْرُ قَالَ إِذَا أَوْتَرْتَ مِنْ أَوَّلِهِ، فَلاَ تُوتِرْ مِنْ آخِرِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu haatimi bni baziy'in, haddathanaa shaadhaanu, 'an shu'baaa, 'an aabiy jamraaa, qaala saaaltu 'aaiidha bna 'amrinw rda allh 'nh wakaana min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm min aashaabi alshhajaraai hal yunqadu alwitru qaala iidhaa aawtarta min aawwalihi, falaa tuwtir min akhirihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Jamra:I asked Aidh bin `Amr, who was one of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) one of those (who gave the allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) under the Tree): "Can the witr prayer be repeated (in one night)?" He said, "If you have offered it in the first part of the night, you should not repeat it in the last part of the night." (See Fath-ul-Bari page 458 Vol 8th)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَسِيرُ فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ، وَعُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَسِيرُ مَعَهُ لَيْلاً، فَسَأَلَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ شَىْءٍ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ، ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ وَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ثَكِلَتْكَ أُمُّكَ يَا عُمَرُ، نَزَرْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، كُلُّ ذَلِكَ لاَ يُجِيبُكَ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ فَحَرَّكْتُ بَعِيرِي ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمْتُ أَمَامَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَخَشِيتُ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ فِيَّ قُرْآنٌ، فَمَا نَشِبْتُ أَنْ سَمِعْتُ صَارِخًا يَصْرُخُ بِي ـ قَالَ ـ فَقُلْتُ لَقَدْ خَشِيتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ نَزَلَ فِيَّ قُرْآنٌ‏.‏ وَجِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَىَّ اللَّيْلَةَ سُورَةٌ لَهِيَ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا‏}‏‏.‏‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yasiyru fiy ba'di aasfaarihi, wa'umaru bnu alkhattaabi yasiyru ma'ahu laylaan, fasaaalahu 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi 'an shaa'in falam yujibhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma saaalahu falam yujibhu, thumma saaalahu falam yujibhu waqaala 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi thakilatka aummuka yaa 'umaru, nazarta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thalaatha marraatin, kullu dhalika laa yujiybuka‏.‏ qaala 'umaru faharraktu ba'iyriy thumma taqaddamtu aamaama almuslimiyna, wakhashiytu aan yanzila fiyya quranun, famaa nashibtu aan sami'tu saarikhana yasrukhu biy qaala faqultu laqad khashiytu aan yakuwna nazala fiyya quranun‏.‏ wajiitu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallamtu 'alayhi faqaala ‏"‏ laqad aunzilat 'alaaaa alllaylaaa suwraaun lahiya aahabbu iilaaaa mimmaa tala'at 'alayhi alshhamsu, thumma qaraaa ‏{‏iinnaa fatahnaa laka fathana mubiynana‏}‏‏.‏‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Aslam:My father said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was proceeding at night on one of his journeys and `Umar bin Al- Khattab was going along with him. `Umar bin Al-Khattab asked him (about something) but Allah's Apostle did not answer him. `Umar asked him again, but he did not answer him. He asked him again (for the third time) but he did not answer him. On that `Umar bin Al-Khattab addressed himself saying, "May your mother be bereaved of you, O `Umar, for you have asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) thrice, yet he has not answered you." `Umar said, "Then I made my camel run fast and took it in front of the other Muslims, and I was afraid that something might be revealed in my connection. I had hardly waited for a moment when I heard somebody calling me. I said, 'I was afraid that something might have been revealed about me.' Then I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and greeted him. He (i.e. the Prophet) said, 'Tonight there has been revealed to me, a Sura which is dearer to me than (all the world) on which the sun rises,' and then he recited: 'Verily! We have granted you (O Muhammad) A manifest victory
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، حِينَ حَدَّثَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ،، حَفِظْتُ بَعْضَهُ، وَثَبَّتَنِي مَعْمَرٌ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، وَمَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، يَزِيدُ أَحَدُهُمَا عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ قَالاَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فِي بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، فَلَمَّا أَتَى ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ قَلَّدَ الْهَدْىَ، وَأَشْعَرَهُ، وَأَحْرَمَ مِنْهَا بِعُمْرَةٍ، وَبَعَثَ عَيْنًا لَهُ مِنْ خُزَاعَةَ، وَسَارَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى كَانَ بِغَدِيرِ الأَشْطَاطِ، أَتَاهُ عَيْنُهُ قَالَ إِنَّ قُرَيْشًا جَمَعُوا لَكَ جُمُوعًا، وَقَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكَ الأَحَابِيشَ، وَهُمْ مُقَاتِلُوكَ وَصَادُّوكَ عَنِ الْبَيْتِ وَمَانِعُوكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشِيرُوا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عَلَىَّ، أَتَرَوْنَ أَنْ أَمِيلَ إِلَى عِيَالِهِمْ وَذَرَارِيِّ هَؤُلاَءِ الَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَصُدُّونَا عَنِ الْبَيْتِ، فَإِنْ يَأْتُونَا كَانَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَدْ قَطَعَ عَيْنًا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، وَإِلاَّ تَرَكْنَاهُمْ مَحْرُوبِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، خَرَجْتَ عَامِدًا لِهَذَا الْبَيْتِ، لاَ تُرِيدُ قَتْلَ أَحَدٍ وَلاَ حَرْبَ أَحَدٍ، فَتَوَجَّهْ لَهُ، فَمَنْ صَدَّنَا عَنْهُ قَاتَلْنَاهُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ امْضُوا عَلَى اسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala sami'tu alzzuhriyya, hiyna haddatha hadhaa alhadiytha, , hafiztu ba'dahu, wathabbataniy ma'marun 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'ani almiswari bni makhramaaa, wamarwaana bni alhakami, yaziydu aahaduhumaa 'alaa saahibihi qaalaa kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama alhudaybiyaai fiy bid'a 'ashraaa miaiaaan min aashaabihi, falammaa aataa dhaa alhulayfaai qallada alhadaa, waaash'arahu, waaahrama minhaa bi'umraain, waba'atha 'aynana lahu min khuzaa'aaa, wasaara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa kaana bighadiyri alaashtaati, aataahu 'aynuhu qaala iinna qurayshana jama'uwa laka jumuw'ana, waqad jama'uwa laka alaahaabiysha, wahum muqaatiluwka wasaadduwka 'ani albayti wamaani'uwka‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aashiyruwa aayyuhaa alnnaasu 'alaaaa, aatarawna aan aamiyla iilaa 'iyaalihim wadharaariyyi hauulaa'i alladhiyna yuriyduwna aan yasudduwnaa 'ani albayti, faiin yaatuwnaa kaana alllahu 'azza wajalla qad qata'a 'aynana mina almushrikiyna, waiilaaa taraknaahum mahruwbiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw bakrin yaa rasuwla alllahi, kharajta 'aamidana lihadhaa albayti, laa turiydu qatla aahadin walaa harba aahadin, fatawajjah lahu, faman saddanaa 'anhu qaatalnaahu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ amduwa 'alaa asmi alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama and Marwan bin Al-Hakam:(one of them said more than his friend): The Prophet (ﷺ) set out in the company of more than onethousand of his companions in the year of Al-Hudaibiya, and when he reached Dhul-Hulaifa, he garlanded his Hadi (i.e. sacrificing animal), assumed the state of Ihram for `Umra from that place and sent a spy of his from Khuzi'a (tribe). The Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded on till he reached (a village called) Ghadir-al-Ashtat. There his spy came and said, "The Quraish (infidels) have collected a great number of people against you, and they have collected against you the Ethiopians, and they will fight with you, and will stop you from entering the Ka`ba and prevent you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people! Give me your opinion. Do you recommend that I should destroy the families and offspring of those who want to stop us from the Ka`ba? If they should come to us (for peace) then Allah will destroy a spy from the pagans, or otherwise we will leave them in a miserable state." On that Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Apostle! You have come with the intention of visiting this House (i.e. Ka`ba) and you do not want to kill or fight anybody. So proceed to it, and whoever should stop us from it, we will fight him." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Proceed on, in the Name of Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مَرْوَانَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ، وَالْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، يُخْبِرَانِ خَبَرًا مِنْ خَبَرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي عُمْرَةِ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فَكَانَ فِيمَا أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ عَنْهُمَا أَنَّهُ لَمَّا كَاتَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُهَيْلَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو، يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ عَلَى قَضِيَّةِ الْمُدَّةِ، وَكَانَ فِيمَا اشْتَرَطَ سُهَيْلُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو أَنَّهُ قَالَ لاَ يَأْتِيكَ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ وَإِنْ كَانَ عَلَى دِينِكَ إِلاَّ رَدَدْتَهُ إِلَيْنَا، وَخَلَّيْتَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ‏.‏ وَأَبَى سُهَيْلٌ أَنْ يُقَاضِيَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ عَلَى ذَلِكَ، فَكَرِهَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ذَلِكَ وَامَّعَضُوا، فَتَكَلَّمُوا فِيهِ، فَلَمَّا أَبَى سُهَيْلٌ أَنْ يُقَاضِيَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ عَلَى ذَلِكَ، كَاتَبَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَرَدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَا جَنْدَلِ بْنَ سُهَيْلٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ إِلَى أَبِيهِ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، وَلَمْ يَأْتِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحَدٌ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ إِلاَّ رَدَّهُ فِي تِلْكَ الْمُدَّةِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسْلِمًا، وَجَاءَتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ مُهَاجِرَاتٍ، فَكَانَتْ أُمُّ كُلْثُومٍ بِنْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ مُعَيْطٍ مِمَّنْ خَرَجَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْىَ عَاتِقٌ، فَجَاءَ أَهْلُهَا يَسْأَلُونَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَرْجِعَهَا إِلَيْهِمْ، حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِي الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مَا أَنْزَلَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa ya'quwbu, haddathaniy abnu aakhiy abni shihaabin, 'an 'ammihi, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a marwaana bna alhakami, waalmiswara bna makhramaaa, yukhbiraani khabarana min khabari rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy 'umraai alhudaybiyaai fakaana fiymaa aakhbaraniy 'urwaau 'anhumaa aannahu lammaa kaataba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm suhayla bna 'amrinw, yawma alhudaybiyaai 'alaa qadiyyaai almuddaai, wakaana fiymaa ashtarata suhaylu bnu 'amrinw aannahu qaala laa yaatiyka minnaa aahadun waiin kaana 'alaa diynika iilaaa radadtahu iilaynaa, wakhallayta baynanaa wabaynahu‏.‏ waaabaa suhaylun aan yuqaadiya rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa 'alaa dhalika, fakariha almuuminuwna dhalika waamma'aduwa, fatakallamuwa fiyhi, falammaa aabaa suhaylun aan yuqaadiya rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa 'alaa dhalika, kaatabahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, faradda rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aabaa jandali bna suhaylin yawmaiidhin iilaa aabiyhi suhayli bni 'amrinw, walam yaati rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahadun mina alrrijaali iilaaa raddahu fiy tilka almuddaai, waiin kaana muslimana, wajaa'ati almuuminaatu muhaajiraatin, fakaanat aummu kulthuwmin bintu 'uqbaaa bni mu'aytin mimman kharaja iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaa 'aatiqun, fajaa'a aahluhaa yasaaluwna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yarji'ahaa iilayhim, hattaa aanzala alllahu ta'aalaa fiy almuuminaati maa aanzala‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:That he heard Marwan bin Al-Hakam and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama relating one of the events that happened to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the `Umra of Al-Hudaibiya. They said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) concluded the truce with Suhail bin `Amr on the day of Al-Hudaibiya, one of the conditions which Suhail bin `Amr stipulated, was his saying (to the Prophet), "If anyone from us (i.e. infidels) ever comes to you, though he has embraced your religion, you should return him to us, and should not interfere between us and him." Suhail refused to conclude the truce with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except on this condition. The believers disliked this condition and got disgusted with it and argued about it. But when Suhail refused to conclude the truce with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except on that condition, Allah's Apostle concluded it. Accordingly, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then returned Abu Jandal bin Suhail to his father, Suhail bin `Amr, and returned every man coming to him from them during that period even if he was a Muslim. The believing women Emigrants came (to Medina) and Um Kulthum, the daughter of `Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait was one of those who came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and she was an adult at that time. Her relatives came, asking Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to return her to them, and in this connection, Allah revealed the Verses dealing with the believing (women)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَمْتَحِنُ مَنْ هَاجَرَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِهَذِهِ الآيَةِ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ‏}‏‏.‏ وَعَنْ عَمِّهِ قَالَ بَلَغَنَا حِينَ أَمَرَ اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَرُدَّ إِلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا أَنْفَقُوا عَلَى مَنْ هَاجَرَ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ، وَبَلَغَنَا أَنَّ أَبَا بَصِيرٍ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَهُ بِطُولِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala abnu shihaabin waaakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yamtahinu man haajara mina almuuminaati bihadhihi alayaai ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alnnabiyyu iidhaa jaa'aka almuuminaatu‏}‏‏.‏ wa'an 'ammihi qaala balaghanaa hiyna aamara alllahu rasuwlahu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yarudda iilaa almushrikiyna maa aanfaquwa 'alaa man haajara min aazwaajihim, wabalaghanaa aanna aabaa basiyrin‏.‏ fadhakarahu bituwlihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Aisha said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to test all the believing women who migrated to him, with the following Verse:-- "O Prophet! When the believing Women come to you, to give the pledge of allegiance to you." (60.12) `Urwa's uncle said, "We were informed when Allah ordered His Apostle to return to the pagans what they had given to their wives who lately migrated (to Medina) and we were informed that Abu Basir..." relating the whole narration
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ خَرَجَ مُعْتَمِرًا فِي الْفِتْنَةِ فَقَالَ إِنْ صُدِدْتُ عَنِ الْبَيْتِ، صَنَعْنَا كَمَا صَنَعْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَأَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ عَامَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, 'an maalikin, 'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara rda allh 'nhma kharaja mu'tamirana fiy alfitnaai faqaala iin sudidtu 'ani albayti, sana'naa kamaa sana'naa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faaahalla bi'umraain min aajli aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana aahalla bi'umraain 'aama alhudaybiyaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah bin `Umar set out for Umra during the period of afflictions, and he said, "If I should be stopped from visiting the Ka`ba, I will do what we did when we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He assumed Ihram for `Umra in the year of Al-Hudaibiya
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ أَهَلَّ وَقَالَ إِنْ حِيلَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ لَفَعَلْتُ كَمَا فَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ حَالَتْ كُفَّارُ قُرَيْشٍ بَيْنَهُ‏.‏ وَتَلاَ ‏{‏لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aannahu aahalla waqaala iin hiyla bayniy wabaynahu lafa'altu kamaa fa'ala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna haalat kuffaaru qurayshin baynahu‏.‏ watalaa ‏{‏laqad kaana lakum fiy rasuwli alllahi auswaaun hasanaaun‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar assumed Ihram and said, "If something should intervene between me and the Ka`ba, then I will do what the Prophet (ﷺ) did when the Quraish infidels intervened between him and (the Ka`ba). Then Ibn `Umar recited: "You have indeed in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) A good example to follow
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَسَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَاهُ أَنَّهُمَا، كَلَّمَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ بَعْضَ بَنِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَهُ لَوْ أَقَمْتَ الْعَامَ، فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ لاَ تَصِلَ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ‏.‏ قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَحَالَ كُفَّارُ قُرَيْشٍ دُونَ الْبَيْتِ، فَنَحَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَدَايَاهُ، وَحَلَقَ وَقَصَّرَ أَصْحَابُهُ، وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي أَوْجَبْتُ عُمْرَةً ‏"‏‏.‏ فَإِنْ خُلِّيَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ طُفْتُ، وَإِنْ حِيلَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ صَنَعْتُ كَمَا صَنَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَارَ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ قَالَ مَا أُرَى شَأْنَهُمَا إِلاَّ وَاحِدًا، أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتُ حَجَّةً مَعَ عُمْرَتِي‏.‏ فَطَافَ طَوَافًا وَاحِدًا وَسَعْيًا وَاحِدًا، حَتَّى حَلَّ مِنْهُمَا جَمِيعًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadi bni aasmaa'a, haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an naafi'in, aanna 'ubayda alllahi bna 'abdi alllahi, wasaalima bna 'abdi alllahi, aakhbaraahu aannahumaa, kallamaa 'abda alllahi bna 'umara‏.‏ wahaddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an naafi'in, aanna ba'da baniy 'abdi alllahi, qaala lahu law aaqamta al'aama, faiinniy aakhaafu aan laa tasila iilaa albayti‏.‏ qaala kharajnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fahaala kuffaaru qurayshin duwna albayti, fanahara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm hadaayaahu, wahalaqa waqassara aashaabuhu, waqaala ‏ "‏ aushhidukum aanniy aawjabtu 'umraaan ‏"‏‏.‏ faiin khulliya bayniy wabayna albayti tuftu, waiin hiyla bayniy wabayna albayti sana'tu kamaa sana'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaara saa'aaan thumma qaala maa auraa shaanahumaa iilaaa waahidana, aushhidukum aanniy qad aawjabtu hajjaaan ma'a 'umratiy‏.‏ fataafa tawaafana waahidana wasa'yana waahidana, hattaa halla minhumaa jamiy'ana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:One of `Abdullah's sons said to `Abdullah (bin `Umar) "I wish you would stay this year (and not perform Hajj) as I am afraid that you will not be able to reach the Ka`ba." On that he (i.e. `Abdullah bin `Umar) said, "We went out with the Prophet (for `Umra), and when the Quraish infidels intervened between us and the Ka`ba, the Prophet (ﷺ) slaughtered his Hadi and shaved (his head), and his companions cut short their hair." Then `Abdullah bin `Umar said, "I make you witness that I have intended to perform `Umra and if I am allowed to reach the Ka`ba, I will perform the Tawaf, and if something (i.e. obstacles) intervene between me and the Ka`ba, then I will do what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did." Then after going for a while, he said, "I consider the ceremonies (of both `Umra and Hajj as one and the same, so I would like you to witness that I have intended to perform Hajj along with my `Umra." So he performed only one Tawaf and one Sai (between Safa and Marwa) and finished the Ihram of both Umra and Hajj
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي شُجَاعُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، سَمِعَ النَّضْرَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَخْرٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ إِنَّ النَّاسَ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، أَسْلَمَ قَبْلَ عُمَرَ، وَلَيْسَ كَذَلِكَ، وَلَكِنْ عُمَرُ يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ أَرْسَلَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ إِلَى فَرَسٍ لَهُ عِنْدَ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ يَأْتِي بِهِ لِيُقَاتِلَ عَلَيْهِ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُبَايِعُ عِنْدَ الشَّجَرَةِ، وَعُمَرُ لاَ يَدْرِي بِذَلِكَ، فَبَايَعَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَى الْفَرَسِ، فَجَاءَ بِهِ إِلَى عُمَرَ، وَعُمَرُ يَسْتَلْئِمُ لِلْقِتَالِ، فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُبَايِعُ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ ـ قَالَ ـ فَانْطَلَقَ فَذَهَبَ مَعَهُ حَتَّى بَايَعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَهِيَ الَّتِي يَتَحَدَّثُ النَّاسُ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ أَسْلَمَ قَبْلَ عُمَرَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy shujaa'u bnu alwaliydi, sami'a alnnadra bna muhammadin, haddathanaa sakhrun, 'an naafi'in, qaala iinna alnnaasa yatahaddathuwna aanna abna 'umara, aaslama qabla 'umara, walaysa kadhalika, walakin 'umaru yawma alhudaybiyaai aarsala 'abda alllahi iilaa farasin lahu 'inda rajulin mina alaansaari yaatiy bihi liyuqaatila 'alayhi, warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yubaayi'u 'inda alshhajaraai, wa'umaru laa yadriy bidhalika, fabaaya'ahu 'abdu alllahi, thumma dhahaba iilaa alfarasi, fajaa'a bihi iilaa 'umara, wa'umaru yastaliimu lilqitaali, faaakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yubaayi'u tahta alshhajaraai qaala faantalaqa fadhahaba ma'ahu hattaa baaya'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fahiya allatiy yatahaddathu alnnaasu aanna abna 'umara aaslama qabla 'umara‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:The people used to say that Ibn `Umar had embraced Islam before `Umar. This is not true. What happened is that `Umar sent `Abdullah to bring his horse from an Ansari man so as to fight on it. At that time the people were giving the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) near the Tree, and `Umar was not aware of that. So `Abdullah (bin `Umar) gave the Pledge of Allegiance (to the Prophet) and went to take the horse and brought it to `Umar. While `Umar was putting on the armor to get ready for fighting, `Abdullah informed him that the people were giving the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Apostle beneath the Tree. So `Umar set out and `Abdullah accompanied him till he gave the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and it was this event that made people say that Ibn `Umar had embraced Islam before `Umar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: وَقَالَ هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْعُمَرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّاسَ، كَانُوا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ، تَفَرَّقُوا فِي ظِلاَلِ الشَّجَرِ، فَإِذَا النَّاسُ مُحْدِقُونَ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، انْظُرْ مَا شَأْنُ النَّاسِ قَدْ أَحْدَقُوا بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَجَدَهُمْ يُبَايِعُونَ، فَبَايَعَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى عُمَرَ فَخَرَجَ فَبَايَعَ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala hishaamu bnu 'ammaarin haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu muhammadin al'umariyyu, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnaasa, kaanuwa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alhudaybiyaai, tafarraquwa fiy zilaali alshhajari, faiidhaa alnnaasu muhdiquwna bialnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa 'abda alllahi, anzur maa shaanu alnnaasi qad aahdaquwa birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fawajadahum yubaayi'uwna, fabaaya'a thumma raja'a iilaa 'umara fakharaja fabaaya'a‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah bin `Umar added:"The people were along with the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of Al-Hudaibiya spreading in the shade of the trees. Suddenly the people surrounded the Prophet (ﷺ) and started looking at him." `Umar said, "O `Abdullah! Go and see why the people are encircling Allah's Apostle and looking at him." `Abdullah bin `Umar then saw the people giving the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet. So he also gave the Pledge of allegiance and returned to `Umar who went out in his turn and gave the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ اعْتَمَرَ فَطَافَ فَطُفْنَا مَعَهُ، وَصَلَّى وَصَلَّيْنَا مَعَهُ، وَسَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، فَكُنَّا نَسْتُرُهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ، لاَ يُصِيبُهُ أَحَدٌ بِشَىْءٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa ya'laa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna aabiy aawfaa rda allh 'nhma qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna a'tamara fataafa fatufnaa ma'ahu, wasallaa wasallaynaa ma'ahu, wasa'aa bayna alssafaa waalmarwaai, fakunnaa nasturuhu min aahli makkaaa, laa yusiybuhu aahadun bishaa'in‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) when he performed the `Umra. He performed the Tawaf and we did the same; he offered the prayer and we also offered the prayer with him. Then he performed the Sai between Safa and Marwa and we were guarding him against the people of Mecca so that nobody should harm him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَابِقٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حَصِينٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو وَائِلٍ لَمَّا قَدِمَ سَهْلُ بْنُ حُنَيْفٍ مِنْ صِفِّينَ أَتَيْنَاهُ نَسْتَخْبِرُهُ فَقَالَ اتَّهِمُوا الرَّأْىَ، فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي يَوْمَ أَبِي جَنْدَلٍ وَلَوْ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَرُدَّ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمْرَهُ لَرَدَدْتُ، وَاللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، وَمَا وَضَعْنَا أَسْيَافَنَا عَلَى عَوَاتِقِنَا لأَمْرٍ يُفْظِعُنَا إِلاَّ أَسْهَلْنَ بِنَا إِلَى أَمْرٍ نَعْرِفُهُ قَبْلَ هَذَا الأَمْرِ، مَا نَسُدُّ مِنْهَا خُصْمًا إِلاَّ انْفَجَرَ عَلَيْنَا خُصْمٌ مَا نَدْرِي كَيْفَ نَأْتِي لَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu saabiqin, haddathanaa maaliku bnu mighwalin, qaala sami'tu aabaa hasiynin, qaala qaala aabuw waaiilin lammaa qadima sahlu bnu hunayfin min siffiyna aataynaahu nastakhbiruhu faqaala attahimuwa alrraaaa, falaqad raaaytuniy yawma aabiy jandalin walaw aastatiy'u aan aarudda 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aamrahu laradadtu, waalllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu, wamaa wada'naa aasyaafanaa 'alaa 'awaatiqinaa laamrin yufzi'unaa iilaaa aashalna binaa iilaa aamrin na'rifuhu qabla hadhaa alaamri, maa nasuddu minhaa khusmana iilaaa anfajara 'alaynaa khusmun maa nadriy kayfa naatiy lahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Wail:When Sahl bin Hunaif returned from (the battle of) Siffin, we went to ask him (as to why he had come back). He replied, "(You should not consider me a coward) but blame your opinions. I saw myself on the day of Abu Jandal (inclined to fight), and if I had the power of refusing the order of Allah's Apostle then, I would have refused it (and fought the infidels bravely). Allah and His Apostle know (what is convenient) better. Whenever we put our swords on our shoulders for any matter that terrified us, our swords led us to an easy agreeable solution before the present situation (of disagreement and dispute between the Muslims). When we mend the breach in one side, it opened in another, and we do not know what to do about it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَتَى عَلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَمَنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ، وَالْقَمْلُ يَتَنَاثَرُ عَلَى وَجْهِي فَقَالَ ‏{‏أَيُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّ رَأْسِكَ‏}‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَاحْلِقْ، وَصُمْ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، أَوْ أَطْعِمْ سِتَّةَ مَسَاكِينَ، أَوِ انْسُكْ نَسِيكَةً ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَيُّوبُ لاَ أَدْرِي بِأَىِّ هَذَا بَدَأَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, 'an ka'bi bni 'ujraaa rda allh 'nh qaala aataa 'alaaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm zamana alhudaybiyaai, waalqamlu yatanaatharu 'alaa wajhiy faqaala ‏{‏aayuudhiyka hawaammu raasika‏}‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ faahliq, wasum thalaathaaa aayyaamin, aaw aat'im sittaaa masaakiyna, aawi ansuk nasiykaaan ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aayyuwbu laa aadriy biaaaai hadhaa badaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ka`b bin Ujra:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to me at the time of Al-Hudaibiya Pledge while lice were falling on my face. He said, "Are the lice of your head troubling you?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Shave your head and fast for three days, or feed six poor persons, or slaughter a sheep as sacrifice." (The sub-narrator, Aiyub said, "I do not know with which of these three options he started)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحُدَيْبِيَةِ وَنَحْنُ مُحْرِمُونَ، وَقَدْ حَصَرَنَا الْمُشْرِكُونَ ـ قَالَ ـ وَكَانَتْ لِي وَفْرَةٌ فَجَعَلَتِ الْهَوَامُّ تَسَّاقَطُ عَلَى وَجْهِي، فَمَرَّ بِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّ رَأْسِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ مَرِيضًا أَوْ بِهِ أَذًى مِنْ رَأْسِهِ فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu hishaamin aabuw 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hushaymun, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an mujaahidin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'an ka'bi bni 'ujraaa, qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialhudaybiyaai wanahnu muhrimuwna, waqad hasaranaa almushrikuwna qaala wakaanat liy wafraaun faja'alati alhawaammu tassaaqatu 'alaa wajhiy, famarra biy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aayuudhiyka hawaammu raasika ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala waaunzilat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏faman kaana minkum mariydana aaw bihi aadhana min raasihi fafidyaaun min siyaamin aaw sadaqaain aaw nusukin‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ka`b bin Ujra:We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Al-Hudaibiya in the state of Ihram and the pagans did not allow us to proceed (to the Ka`ba). I had thick hair and lice started falling on my face. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by me and said, "Are the lice of your head troubling you?" I replied, Yes." (The sub-narrator added, "Then the following Divine Verse was revealed:-- "And if anyone of you is ill or has an ailment in his scalp, (necessitating shaving) must pay a ransom (Fidya) of either fasting or feeding the poor, Or offering a sacrifice
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ نَاسًا مِنْ عُكْلٍ وَعُرَيْنَةَ قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَكَلَّمُوا بِالإِسْلاَمِ فَقَالُوا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنَّا كُنَّا أَهْلَ ضَرْعٍ، وَلَمْ نَكُنْ أَهْلَ رِيفٍ‏.‏ وَاسْتَوْخَمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ، فَأَمَرَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَوْدٍ وَرَاعٍ، وَأَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَخْرُجُوا فِيهِ، فَيَشْرَبُوا مِنْ أَلْبَانِهَا وَأَبْوَالِهَا، فَانْطَلَقُوا حَتَّى إِذَا كَانُوا نَاحِيَةَ الْحَرَّةِ كَفَرُوا بَعْدَ إِسْلاَمِهِمْ، وَقَتَلُوا رَاعِيَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَاسْتَاقُوا الذَّوْدَ، فَبَلَغَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَعَثَ الطَّلَبَ فِي آثَارِهِمْ فَأَمَرَ بِهِمْ فَسَمَرُوا أَعْيُنَهُمْ، وَقَطَعُوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ، وَتُرِكُوا فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْحَرَّةِ حَتَّى مَاتُوا عَلَى حَالِهِمْ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ كَانَ يَحُثُّ عَلَى الصَّدَقَةِ، وَيَنْهَى عَنِ الْمُثْلَةِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَأَبَانُ وَحَمَّادٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ مِنْ عُرَيْنَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ وَأَيُّوبُ عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَدِمَ نَفَرٌ مِنْ عُكْلٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, aanna aanasana rda allh 'nh haddathahum aanna naasana min 'uklin wa'uraynaaa qadimuwa almadiynaaa 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm watakallamuwa bialiislaami faqaaluwa yaa nabiyya alllahi iinnaa kunnaa aahla dar'in, walam nakun aahla riyfin‏.‏ waastawkhamuwa almadiynaaa, faaamarahum rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bidhawdin waraa'in, waaamarahum aan yakhrujuwa fiyhi, fayashrabuwa min aalbaanihaa waaabwaalihaa, faantalaquwa hattaa iidhaa kaanuwa naahiyaaa alharraai kafaruwa ba'da iislaamihim, waqataluwa raa'iya alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, waastaaquwa aldhhawda, fabalagha alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faba'atha alttalaba fiy athaarihim faaamara bihim fasamaruwa aa'yunahum, waqata'uwa aaydiyahum, waturikuwa fiy naahiyaai alharraai hattaa maatuwa 'alaa haalihim‏.‏ qaala qataadaau balaghanaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da dhalika kaana yahuthhu 'alaa alssadaqaai, wayanhaa 'ani almuthlaai‏.‏ waqaala shu'baau waaabaanu wahammaadun 'an qataadaaa min 'uraynaaa‏.‏ waqaala yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin waaayyuwbu 'an aabiy qilaabaaa 'an aanasin qadima nafarun min 'uklin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Some people of the tribe of `Ukl and `Uraina arrived at Medina to meet the Prophet (ﷺ) and embraced Islam and said, "O Allah's Prophet! We are the owners of milch livestock (i.e. bedouins) and not farmers (i.e. countrymen)." They found the climate of Medina unsuitable for them. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that they should be provided with some milch camels and a shepherd and ordered them to go out of Medina and to drink the camels' milk and urine (as medicine) So they set out and when they reached Al-Harra, they reverted to Heathenism after embracing Islam, and killed the shepherd of the Prophet and drove away the camels. When this news reached the Prophet, he sent some people in pursuit of them. (So they were caught and brought back to the Prophet (ﷺ) ). The Prophet (ﷺ) gave his orders in their concern. So their eyes were branded with pieces of iron and their hands and legs were cut off and they were left away in Harra till they died in that state of theirs. (See Hadith 234 Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَبُو عُمَرَ الْحَوْضِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، وَالْحَجَّاجُ الصَّوَّافُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ وَكَانَ مَعَهُ بِالشَّأْمِ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، اسْتَشَارَ النَّاسَ يَوْمًا قَالَ مَا تَقُولُونَ فِي هَذِهِ الْقَسَامَةِ فَقَالُوا حَقٌّ، قَضَى بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَضَتْ بِهَا الْخُلَفَاءُ، قَبْلَكَ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَبُو قِلاَبَةَ خَلْفَ سَرِيرِهِ فَقَالَ عَنْبَسَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ فَأَيْنَ حَدِيثُ أَنَسٍ فِي الْعُرَنِيِّينَ قَالَ أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ إِيَّاىَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ مِنْ عُرَيْنَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ مِنْ عُكْلٍ‏.‏ ذَكَرَ الْقِصَّةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahiymi, haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara aabuw 'umara alhawdiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, waalhajjaaju alssawwaafu, qaala haddathaniy aabuw rajaa'in, mawlaa aabiy qilaabaaa wakaana ma'ahu bialshhaami aanna 'umara bna 'abdi al'aziyzi, astashaara alnnaasa yawmana qaala maa taquwluwna fiy hadhihi alqasaamaai faqaaluwa haqqun, qadaa bihaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqadat bihaa alkhulafaa'u, qablaka‏.‏ qaala waaabuw qilaabaaa khalfa sariyrihi faqaala 'anbasaau bnu sa'iydin faaayna hadiythu aanasin fiy al'uraniyyiyna qaala aabuw qilaabaaa iiyyaaaa haddathahu aanasu bnu maalikin‏.‏ qaala 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu suhaybin 'an aanasin min 'uraynaaa‏.‏ waqaala aabuw qilaabaaa 'an aanasin min 'uklin‏.‏ dhakara alqissaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Raja:The freed slave of Abu Qilaba, who was with Abu Qilaba in Sham: `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz consulted the people saying, "What do you think of Qasama." They said, "'It is a right (judgment) which Allah's Apostle and the Caliphs before you acted on." Abu Qilaba was behind `Umar's bed. 'Anbasa bin Sa`id said, But what about the narration concerning the people of `Uraina?" Abu Qilaba said, "Anas bin Malik narrated it to me," and then narrated the whole story
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَلَمَةَ بْنَ الأَكْوَعِ، يَقُولُ خَرَجْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُؤَذَّنَ، بِالأُولَى، وَكَانَتْ لِقَاحُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَرْعَى بِذِي قَرَدٍ ـ قَالَ ـ فَلَقِيَنِي غُلاَمٌ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ فَقَالَ أُخِذَتْ لِقَاحُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ مَنْ أَخَذَهَا قَالَ غَطَفَانُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَصَرَخْتُ ثَلاَثَ صَرَخَاتٍ ـ يَا صَبَاحَاهْ ـ قَالَ فَأَسْمَعْتُ مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَىِ الْمَدِينَةِ، ثُمَّ انْدَفَعْتُ عَلَى وَجْهِي حَتَّى أَدْرَكْتُهُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذُوا يَسْتَقُونَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ، فَجَعَلْتُ أَرْمِيهِمْ بِنَبْلِي، وَكُنْتُ رَامِيًا، وَأَقُولُ أَنَا ابْنُ الأَكْوَعْ، الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الرُّضَّعْ‏.‏ وَأَرْتَجِزُ حَتَّى اسْتَنْقَذْتُ اللِّقَاحَ مِنْهُمْ، وَاسْتَلَبْتُ مِنْهُمْ ثَلاَثِينَ بُرْدَةً، قَالَ وَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسُ فَقُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ قَدْ حَمَيْتُ الْقَوْمَ الْمَاءَ وَهُمْ عِطَاشٌ، فَابْعَثْ إِلَيْهِمُ السَّاعَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا ابْنَ الأَكْوَعِ، مَلَكْتَ فَأَسْجِحْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ رَجَعْنَا وَيُرْدِفُنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى نَاقَتِهِ حَتَّى دَخَلْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa haatimun, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy 'ubaydin, qaala sami'tu salamaaa bna alaakwa'i, yaquwlu kharajtu qabla aan yuuadhhana, bialauwlaa, wakaanat liqaahu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tar'aa bidhiy qaradin qaala falaqiyaniy ghulaamun li'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin faqaala aukhidhat liqaahu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qultu man aakhadhahaa qaala ghatafaanu‏.‏ qaala fasarakhtu thalaatha sarakhaatin yaa sabaahaah qaala faaasma'tu maa bayna laabataai almadiynaai, thumma andafa'tu 'alaa wajhiy hattaa aadraktuhum waqad aakhadhuwa yastaquwna mina almaa'i, faja'altu aarmiyhim binabliy, wakuntu raamiyana, waaaquwlu aanaa abnu alaakwa', alyawmu yawmu alrrudda'‏.‏ waaartajizu hattaa astanqadhtu allliqaaha minhum, waastalabtu minhum thalaathiyna burdaaan, qaala wajaa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnaasu faqultu yaa nabiyya alllahi qad hamaytu alqawma almaa'a wahum 'itaashun, faab'ath iilayhimu alssaa'aaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa abna alaakwa'i, malakta faaasjih ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala thumma raja'naa wayurdifuniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa naaqatihi hattaa dakhalnaa almadiynaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:Once I went (from Medina) towards (Al-Ghaba) before the first Adhan of the Fajr Prayer. The shecamels of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to graze at a place called Dhi-Qarad. A slave of `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf met me (on the way) and said, "The she-camels of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had been taken away by force." I asked, "Who had taken them?" He replied "(The people of) Ghatafan." I made three loud cries (to the people of Medina) saying, "O Sabahah!" I made the people between the two mountains of Medina hear me. Then I rushed onward and caught up with the robbers while they were watering the camels. I started throwing arrows at them as I was a good archer and I was saying, "I am the son of Al-Akwa`, and today will perish the wicked people." I kept on saying like that till I restored the shecamels (of the Prophet), I also snatched thirty Burda (i.e. garments) from them. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) and the other people came there, and I said, "O Allah's Prophet! I have stopped the people (of Ghatafan) from taking water and they are thirsty now. So send (some people) after them now." On that the Prophet said, "O the son of Al-Akwa`! You have over-powered them, so forgive them." Then we all came back and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) seated me behind him on his she-camel till we entered Medina
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، أَنَّ سُوَيْدَ بْنَ النُّعْمَانِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، خَرَجَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ خَيْبَرَ، حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِالصَّهْبَاءِ ـ وَهْىَ مِنْ أَدْنَى خَيْبَرَ ـ صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِالأَزْوَادِ فَلَمْ يُؤْتَ إِلاَّ بِالسَّوِيقِ، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَثُرِّيَ، فَأَكَلَ وَأَكَلْنَا، ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى الْمَغْرِبِ، فَمَضْمَضَ وَمَضْمَضْنَا، ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an bushayri bni yasaarin, aanna suwayda bna alnnu'maani, aakhbarahu aannahu, kharaja ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama khaybara, hattaa iidhaa kunnaa bialssahbaa'i wahaa min aadnaa khaybara sallaa al'asra, thumma da'aa bialaazwaadi falam yuuta iilaaa bialssawiyqi, faaamara bihi fathurriya, faaakala waaakalnaa, thumma qaama iilaa almaghribi, famadmada wamadmadnaa, thumma sallaa walam yatawaddaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Suwaid bin An-Nu`man:I went out in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) in the year of Khaibar, and when we reached As Sahba' which is the lower part of Khaibar, the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the `Asr prayer and then asked the people to collect the journey food. Nothing was brought but Sawiq which the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered to be moistened with water, and then he ate it and we also ate it. Then he got up to offer the Maghrib prayer. He washed his mouth, and we too washed our mouths, and then he offered the prayer without repeating his abulution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى خَيْبَرَ فَسِرْنَا لَيْلاً، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ لِعَامِرٍ يَا عَامِرُ أَلاَ تُسْمِعُنَا مِنْ هُنَيْهَاتِكَ‏.‏ وَكَانَ عَامِرٌ رَجُلاً شَاعِرًا فَنَزَلَ يَحْدُو بِالْقَوْمِ يَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ لَوْلاَ أَنْتَ مَا اهْتَدَيْنَا وَلاَ تَصَدَّقْنَا وَلاَ صَلَّيْنَا فَاغْفِرْ فِدَاءً لَكَ مَا أَبْقَيْنَا وَثَبِّتِ الأَقْدَامَ إِنْ لاَقَيْنَا وَأَلْقِيَنْ سَكِينَةً عَلَيْنَا إِنَّا إِذَا صِيحَ بِنَا أَبَيْنَا وَبِالصِّيَاحِ عَوَّلُوا عَلَيْنَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ هَذَا السَّائِقُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا عَامِرُ بْنُ الأَكْوَعِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَرْحَمُهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ وَجَبَتْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، لَوْلاَ أَمْتَعْتَنَا بِهِ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْنَا خَيْبَرَ، فَحَاصَرْنَاهُمْ حَتَّى أَصَابَتْنَا مَخْمَصَةٌ شَدِيدَةٌ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى فَتَحَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ، فَلَمَّا أَمْسَى النَّاسُ مَسَاءَ الْيَوْمِ الَّذِي فُتِحَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ أَوْقَدُوا نِيرَانًا كَثِيرَةً، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا هَذِهِ النِّيرَانُ عَلَى أَىِّ شَىْءٍ تُوقِدُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا عَلَى لَحْمٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ عَلَى أَىِّ لَحْمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لَحْمِ حُمُرِ الإِنْسِيَّةِ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَهْرِيقُوهَا وَاكْسِرُوهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَوْ نُهَرِيقُهَا وَنَغْسِلُهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوْ ذَاكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا تَصَافَّ الْقَوْمُ كَانَ سَيْفُ عَامِرٍ قَصِيرًا فَتَنَاوَلَ بِهِ سَاقَ يَهُودِيٍّ لِيَضْرِبَهُ، وَيَرْجِعُ ذُبَابُ سَيْفِهِ، فَأَصَابَ عَيْنَ رُكْبَةِ عَامِرٍ، فَمَاتَ مِنْهُ قَالَ فَلَمَّا قَفَلُوا، قَالَ سَلَمَةُ رَآنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ آخِذٌ بِيَدِي، قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَهُ فِدَاكَ أَبِي وَأُمِّي، زَعَمُوا أَنَّ عَامِرًا حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَذَبَ مَنْ قَالَهُ، إِنَّ لَهُ لأَجْرَيْنِ ـ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَ إِصْبَعَيْهِ ـ إِنَّهُ لَجَاهِدٌ مُجَاهِدٌ قَلَّ عَرَبِيٌّ مَشَى بِهَا مِثْلَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَشَأَ بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu allaahi bnu maslamaaa, hadaathanaa haatimu bnu iismaa'iyla, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy 'ubaydin, 'an salamaaa bni alaakwa'i rda allh 'nh qaala kharajnaa ma'a alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa khaybara fasirnaa laylaan, faqaala rajulun mina alqawmi li'aamirin yaa 'aamiru aalaa tusmi'unaa min hunayhaatika‏.‏ wakaana 'aamirun rajulaan shaa'irana fanazala yahduw bialqawmi yaquwlu: allaahumaa lawlaa aanta maa ahtadaynaa walaa tasadaaqnaa walaa salaaynaa faaghfir fidaa'an laka maa aabqaynaa wathabiiti alaaqdaama iin laaqaynaa waaalqiyan sakiynaaan 'alaynaa iinaaa iidhaa siyha binaa aabaynaa wabialsiiyaahi 'awaaluwa 'alaynaa faqaala rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man hadhaa alsaaaiiqu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa 'aamiru bnu alaakwa'i‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ yarhamuhu allaahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala rajulun mina alqawmi wajabat yaa nabiyaa allaahi, lawlaa aamta'tanaa bihi‏.‏ faaataynaa khaybara, fahaasarnaahum hataaa aasaabatnaa makhmasaaun shadiydaaun, thumaa iinaa allaaha ta'aalaa fatahahaa 'alayhim, falamaaa aamsaa alnaaasu masaa'a alyawmi alaadhiy futihat 'alayhim aawqaduwa niyraanana kathiyraaan, faqaala alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa hadhihi alniiyraanu 'alaa aaaii shaa'in tuwqiduwna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa 'alaa lahmin‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ 'alaa aaaii lahmin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa lahmi humuri aliinsiyaaai‏.‏ qaala alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aahriyquwhaa waaksiruwhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala rajulun yaa rasuwla allaahi, aaw nuhariyquhaa wanaghsiluhaa qaala ‏"‏ aaw dhaaka ‏"‏‏.‏ falamaaa tasaafaa alqawmu kaana sayfu 'aamirin qasiyrana fatanaawala bihi saaqa yahuwdiyinn liyadribahu, wayarji'u dhubaabu sayfihi, faaasaaba 'ayna rukbaai 'aamirin, famaata minhu qaala falamaaa qafaluwa, qaala salamaau raaniy rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa akhidhun biyadiy, qaala ‏"‏ maa laka ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu lahu fidaaka aabiy waaumiiy, za'amuwa aanaa 'aamirana habita 'amaluhu‏.‏ qaala alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ kadhaba man qaalahu, iinaa lahu laajrayni wajama'a bayna iisba'ayhi iinaahu lajaahidun mujaahidun qalaa 'arabiyunn mashaa bihaa mithlahu ‏"‏‏.‏ hadaathanaa qutaybaau hadaathanaa haatimun qaala ‏"‏ nashaaa bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa`:We went out to Khaibar in the company of the Prophet. While we were proceeding at night, a man from the group said to 'Amir, "O 'Amir! Won't you let us hear your poetry?" 'Amir was a poet, so he got down and started reciting for the people poetry that kept pace with the camels' footsteps, saying:-- "O Allah! Without You we Would not have been guided On the right path Neither would be have given In charity, nor would We have prayed. So please forgive us, what we have committed (i.e. our defects); let all of us Be sacrificed for Your Cause And send Sakina (i.e. calmness) Upon us to make our feet firm When we meet our enemy, and If they will call us towards An unjust thing, We will refuse. The infidels have made a hue and Cry to ask others' help Against us." The Prophet (ﷺ) on that, asked, "Who is that (camel) driver (reciting poetry)?" The people said, "He is 'Amir bin Al-Akwa`." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on him." A man amongst the people said, "O Allah's Prophet! has (martyrdom) been granted to him. Would that you let us enjoy his company longer." Then we reached and besieged Khaibar till we were afflicted with severe hunger. Then Allah helped the Muslims conquer it (i.e. Khaibar). In the evening of the day of the conquest of the city, the Muslims made huge fires. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What are these fires? For cooking what, are you making the fire?" The people replied, "(For cooking) meat." He asked, "What kind of meat?" They (i.e. people) said, "The meat of donkeys." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Throw away the meat and break the pots!" Some man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we throw away the meat and wash the pots instead?" He said, "(Yes, you can do) that too." So when the army files were arranged in rows (for the clash), 'Amir's sword was short and he aimed at the leg of a Jew to strike it, but the sharp blade of the sword returned to him and injured his own knee, and that caused him to die.
