When they returned from the battle, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw me (in a sad mood). He took my hand and said, "What is bothering you?" I replied, "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you! The people say that the deeds of 'Amir are lost." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever says so, is mistaken, for 'Amir has got a double reward." The Prophet raised two fingers and added, "He (i.e. Amir) was a persevering struggler in the Cause of Allah and there are few 'Arabs who achieved the like of (good deeds) 'Amir had done
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَى خَيْبَرَ لَيْلاً، وَكَانَ إِذَا أَتَى قَوْمًا بِلَيْلٍ لَمْ يُغِرْ بِهِمْ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ، فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ خَرَجَتِ الْيَهُودُ بِمَسَاحِيهِمْ وَمَكَاتِلِهِمْ، فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ قَالُوا مُحَمَّدٌ وَاللَّهِ، مُحَمَّدٌ وَالْخَمِيسُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خَرِبَتْ خَيْبَرُ، إِنَّا إِذَا نَزَلْنَا بِسَاحَةِ قَوْمٍ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an humaydin alttawiyli, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aataa khaybara laylaan, wakaana iidhaa aataa qawmana bilaylin lam yughir bihim hattaa yusbiha, falammaa aasbaha kharajati alyahuwdu bimasaahiyhim wamakaatilihim, falammaa raaawhu qaaluwa muhammadun waalllahi, muhammadun waalkhamiysu, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kharibat khaybaru, iinnaa iidhaa nazalnaa bisaahaai qawmin fasaa'a sabaahu almundhariyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reached Khaibar at night and it was his habit that, whenever he reached the enemy at night, he will not attack them till it was morning. When it was morning, the Jews came out with their spades and baskets, and when they saw him(i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ), they said, "Muhammad! By Allah! Muhammad and his army!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Khaibar is destroyed, for whenever we approach a (hostile) nation (to fight), then evil will be the morning for those who have been warned
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: أَخْبَرَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ صَبَّحْنَا خَيْبَرَ بُكْرَةً، فَخَرَجَ أَهْلُهَا بِالْمَسَاحِي، فَلَمَّا بَصُرُوا بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالُوا مُحَمَّدٌ وَاللَّهِ، مُحَمَّدٌ وَالْخَمِيسُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ خَرِبَتْ خَيْبَرُ، إِنَّا إِذَا نَزَلْنَا بِسَاحَةِ قَوْمٍ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَصَبْنَا مِنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ فَنَادَى مُنَادِي النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يَنْهَيَانِكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ، فَإِنَّهَا رِجْسٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: aakhbaranaa sadaqaau bnu alfadli, aakhbaranaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala sabbahnaa khaybara bukraaan, fakharaja aahluhaa bialmasaahiy, falammaa basuruwa bialnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaluwa muhammadun waalllahi, muhammadun waalkhamiysu‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahu aakbaru kharibat khaybaru, iinnaa iidhaa nazalnaa bisaahaai qawmin fasaa'a sabaahu almundhariyna ‏"‏‏.‏ faaasabnaa min luhuwmi alhumuri fanaadaa munaadiy alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinna alllaha warasuwlahu yanhayaanikum 'an luhuwmi alhumuri, faiinnahaa rijsun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We reached Khaibar early in the morning and the inhabitants of Khaibar came out carrying their spades, and when they saw the Prophet (ﷺ) they said, "Muhammad! By Allah! Muhammad and his army!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allahu-Akbar! Khaibar is destroyed, for whenever we approach a (hostile) nation (to fight) then evil will be the morning for those who have been warned." We then got the meat of donkeys (and intended to eat it), but an announcement was made by the announcer of the Prophet, "Allah and His Apostle forbid you to eat the meat of donkeys as it is an impure thing
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَهُ جَاءٍ فَقَالَ أُكِلَتِ الْحُمُرُ‏.‏ فَسَكَتَ، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ الثَّانِيَةَ فَقَالَ أُكِلَتِ الْحُمُرُ‏.‏ فَسَكَتَ، ثُمَّ الثَّالِثَةَ فَقَالَ أُفْنِيَتِ الْحُمُرُ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ مُنَادِيًا فَنَادَى فِي النَّاسِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يَنْهَيَانِكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ‏.‏ فَأُكْفِئَتِ الْقُدُورُ، وَإِنَّهَا لَتَفُورُ بِاللَّحْمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alwahhaabi, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an muhammadin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaa'ahu jaa'in faqaala aukilati alhumuru‏.‏ fasakata, thumma aataahu althhaaniyaaa faqaala aukilati alhumuru‏.‏ fasakata, thumma althhaalithaaa faqaala aufniyati alhumuru‏.‏ faaamara munaadiyana fanaadaa fiy alnnaasi iinna alllaha warasuwlahu yanhayaanikum 'an luhuwmi alhumuri alaahliyyaai‏.‏ faaukfiiati alquduwru, waiinnahaa latafuwru bialllahmi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Someone came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "The donkeys have been eaten (by the Muslims)." The Prophet kept quiet. Then the man came again and said, "The donkeys have been eaten." The Prophet (ﷺ) kept quiet. The man came to him the third time and said, "The donkeys have been consumed." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered an announcer to announce to the people, "Allah and His Apostle forbid you to eat the meat of donkeys." Then the cooking pots were upset while the meat was still boiling in them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصُّبْحَ قَرِيبًا مِنْ خَيْبَرَ بِغَلَسٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ خَرِبَتْ خَيْبَرُ، إِنَّا إِذَا نَزَلْنَا بِسَاحَةِ قَوْمٍ، فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَخَرَجُوا يَسْعَوْنَ فِي السِّكَكِ، فَقَتَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمُقَاتِلَةَ، وَسَبَى الذُّرِّيَّةَ، وَكَانَ فِي السَّبْىِ صَفِيَّةُ، فَصَارَتْ إِلَى دِحْيَةَ الْكَلْبِيِّ، ثُمَّ صَارَتْ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَجَعَلَ عِتْقَهَا صَدَاقَهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ لِثَابِتٍ يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ آنْتَ قُلْتَ لأَنَسٍ مَا أَصْدَقَهَا فَحَرَّكَ ثَابِتٌ رَأْسَهُ تَصْدِيقًا لَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala sallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alssubha qariybana min khaybara bighalasin thumma qaala ‏ "‏ alllahu aakbaru kharibat khaybaru, iinnaa iidhaa nazalnaa bisaahaai qawmin, fasaa'a sabaahu almundhariyna ‏"‏‏.‏ fakharajuwa yas'awna fiy alssikaki, faqatala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almuqaatilaaa, wasabaa aldhhurriyyaaa, wakaana fiy alssabai safiyyaau, fasaarat iilaa dihyaaa alkalbiyyi, thumma saarat iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, faja'ala 'itqahaa sadaaqahaa‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu suhaybin lithaabitin yaa aabaa muhammadin anta qulta laanasin maa aasdaqahaa faharraka thaabitun raasahu tasdiyqana lahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the Fajr Prayer near Khaibar when it was still dark and then said, "Allahu-Akbar! Khaibar is destroyed, for whenever we approach a (hostile) nation (to fight), then evil will be the morning for those who have been warned." Then the inhabitants of Khaibar came out running on the roads. The Prophet (ﷺ) had their warriors killed, their offspring and women taken as captives. Safiya was amongst the captives, She first came in the share of Dihya Al-Kalbi but later on she belonged to the Prophet . The Prophet (ﷺ) made her manumission as her 'Mahr
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ سَبَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَفِيَّةَ، فَأَعْتَقَهَا وَتَزَوَّجَهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ثَابِتٌ لأَنَسٍ مَا أَصْدَقَهَا قَالَ أَصْدَقَهَا نَفْسَهَا فَأَعْتَقَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni suhaybin, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh yaquwlu sabaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm safiyyaaa, faaa'taqahaa watazawwajahaa‏.‏ faqaala thaabitun laanasin maa aasdaqahaa qaala aasdaqahaa nafsahaa faaa'taqahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdul `Aziz bin Suhaib:Anas bin Malik said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) took Safiya as a captive. He manumitted her and married her." Thabit asked Anas, "What did he give her as Mahr (i.e. marriage gift)?" Anas replied. "Her Mahr was herself, for he manumitted her
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْتَقَى هُوَ وَالْمُشْرِكُونَ فَاقْتَتَلُوا، فَلَمَّا مَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى عَسْكَرِهِ، وَمَالَ الآخَرُونَ إِلَى عَسْكَرِهِمْ، وَفِي أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ لاَ يَدَعُ لَهُمْ شَاذَّةً وَلاَ فَاذَّةً إِلاَّ اتَّبَعَهَا، يَضْرِبُهَا بِسَيْفِهِ، فَقِيلَ مَا أَجْزَأَ مِنَّا الْيَوْمَ أَحَدٌ كَمَا أَجْزَأَ فُلاَنٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمَا إِنَّهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ أَنَا صَاحِبُهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَرَجَ مَعَهُ كُلَّمَا وَقَفَ وَقَفَ مَعَهُ، وَإِذَا أَسْرَعَ أَسْرَعَ مَعَهُ ـ قَالَ ـ فَجُرِحَ الرَّجُلُ جُرْحًا شَدِيدًا، فَاسْتَعْجَلَ الْمَوْتَ، فَوَضَعَ سَيْفَهُ بِالأَرْضِ وَذُبَابَهُ بَيْنَ ثَدْيَيْهِ، ثُمَّ تَحَامَلَ عَلَى سَيْفِهِ، فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ، فَخَرَجَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي ذَكَرْتَ آنِفًا أَنَّهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، فَأَعْظَمَ النَّاسُ ذَلِكَ، فَقُلْتُ أَنَا لَكُمْ بِهِ‏.‏ فَخَرَجْتُ فِي طَلَبِهِ، ثُمَّ جُرِحَ جُرْحًا شَدِيدًا، فَاسْتَعْجَلَ الْمَوْتَ، فَوَضَعَ نَصْلَ سَيْفِهِ فِي الأَرْضِ وَذُبَابَهُ بَيْنَ ثَدْيَيْهِ، ثُمَّ تَحَامَلَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، فِيمَا يَبْدُو لِلنَّاسِ، وَهْوَ مِنَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، فِيمَا يَبْدُو لِلنَّاسِ، وَهْوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm altaqaa huwa waalmushrikuwna faaqtataluwa, falammaa maala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa 'askarihi, wamaala alakharuwna iilaa 'askarihim, wafiy aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun laa yada'u lahum shaadhhaaan walaa faadhhaaan iilaaa attaba'ahaa, yadribuhaa bisayfihi, faqiyla maa aajzaaa minnaa alyawma aahadun kamaa aajzaaa fulaanun‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aamaa iinnahu min aahli alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala rajulun mina alqawmi aanaa saahibuhu‏.‏ qaala fakharaja ma'ahu kullamaa waqafa waqafa ma'ahu, waiidhaa aasra'a aasra'a ma'ahu qaala fajuriha alrrajulu jurhana shadiydana, faasta'jala almawta, fawada'a sayfahu bialaardi wadhubaabahu bayna thadyayhi, thumma tahaamala 'alaa sayfihi, faqatala nafsahu, fakharaja alrrajulu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aashhadu aannaka rasuwlu alllahi qaala ‏"‏ wamaa dhaaka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala alrrajulu alladhiy dhakarta anifana aannahu min aahli alnnaari, faaa'zama alnnaasu dhalika, faqultu aanaa lakum bihi‏.‏ fakharajtu fiy talabihi, thumma juriha jurhana shadiydana, faasta'jala almawta, fawada'a nasla sayfihi fiy alaardi wadhubaabahu bayna thadyayhi, thumma tahaamala 'alayhi, faqatala nafsahu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'inda dhalika ‏"‏ iinna alrrajula laya'malu 'amala aahli aljannaai, fiymaa yabduw lilnnaasi, wahwa mina aahli alnnaari, waiinna alrrajula laya'malu 'amala aahli alnnaari, fiymaa yabduw lilnnaasi, wahwa min aahli aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As Saidi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (and his army) encountered the pagans and the two armies.,, fought and then Allah's Apostle returned to his army camps and the others (i.e. the enemy) returned to their army camps. Amongst the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) there was a man who could not help pursuing any single isolated pagan to strike him with his sword. Somebody said, "None has benefited the Muslims today more than so-and-so." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He is from the people of the Hell-Fire certainly." A man amongst the people (i.e. Muslims) said, "I will accompany him (to know the fact)." So he went along with him, and whenever he stopped he stopped with him, and whenever he hastened, he hastened with him. The (brave) man then got wounded severely, and seeking to die at once, he planted his sword into the ground and put its point against his chest in between his breasts, and then threw himself on it and committed suicide. On that the person (who was accompanying the deceased all the time) came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "I testify that you are the Messenger of Allah." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Why is that (what makes you say so)?" He said "It is concerning the man whom you have already mentioned as one of the dwellers of the Hell-Fire. The people were surprised by your statement, and I said to them, "I will try to find out the truth about him for you." So I went out after him and he was then inflicted with a severe wound and because of that, he hurried to bring death upon himself by planting the handle of his sword into the ground and directing its tip towards his chest between his breasts, and then he threw himself over it and committed suicide." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "A man may do what seem to the people as the deeds of the dwellers of Paradise but he is from the dwellers of the Hell-Fire and another may do what seem to the people as the deeds of the dwellers of the Hell- Fire, but he is from the dwellers of Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ شَهِدْنَا خَيْبَرَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِرَجُلٍ مِمَّنْ مَعَهُ يَدَّعِي الإِسْلاَمَ ‏"‏ هَذَا مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا حَضَرَ الْقِتَالُ قَاتَلَ الرَّجُلُ أَشَدَّ الْقِتَالِ، حَتَّى كَثُرَتْ بِهِ الْجِرَاحَةُ، فَكَادَ بَعْضُ النَّاسِ يَرْتَابُ، فَوَجَدَ الرَّجُلُ أَلَمَ الْجِرَاحَةِ، فَأَهْوَى بِيَدِهِ إِلَى كِنَانَتِهِ، فَاسْتَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا أَسْهُمًا، فَنَحَرَ بِهَا نَفْسَهُ، فَاشْتَدَّ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، صَدَّقَ اللَّهُ حَدِيثَكَ، انْتَحَرَ فُلاَنٌ فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قُمْ يَا فُلاَنُ فَأَذِّنْ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلاَّ مُؤْمِنٌ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُؤَيِّدُ الدِّينَ بِالرَّجُلِ الْفَاجِرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مَعْمَرٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala shahidnaa khaybara, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lirajulin mimman ma'ahu yadda'iy aliislaama ‏"‏ hadhaa min aahli alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa hadara alqitaalu qaatala alrrajulu aashadda alqitaali, hattaa kathurat bihi aljiraahaau, fakaada ba'du alnnaasi yartaabu, fawajada alrrajulu aalama aljiraahaai, faaahwaa biyadihi iilaa kinaanatihi, faastakhraja minhaa aashumana, fanahara bihaa nafsahu, faashtadda rijaalun mina almuslimiyna, faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi, saddaqa alllahu hadiythaka, antahara fulaanun faqatala nafsahu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ qum yaa fulaanu faaadhhin aannahu laa yadkhulu aljannaaa iilaaa muuminun, iinna alllaha yuuayyidu alddiyna bialrrajuli alfaajiri ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu ma'marun 'ani alzzuhriyyi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:We witnessed (the battle of) Khaibar. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said about one of those who were with him and who claimed to be a Muslim. "This (man) is from the dwellers of the Hell-Fire." When the battle started, that fellow fought so violently and bravely that he received plenty of wounds. Some of the people were about to doubt (the Prophet's statement), but the man, feeling the pain of his wounds, put his hand into his quiver and took out of it, some arrows with which he slaughtered himself (i.e. committed suicide). Then some men amongst the Muslims came hurriedly and said, "O Allah's Apostle! Allah has made your statement true so-and-so has committed suicide. "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O so-and-so! Get up and make an announcement that none but a believer will enter Paradise and that Allah may support the religion with an unchaste (evil) wicked man
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: وَقَالَ شَبِيبٌ عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ شَهِدْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حُنَيْنًا‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ صَالِحٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الزُّبَيْدِيُّ أَخْبَرَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ كَعْبٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ كَعْبٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ شَهِدَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْبَرَ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَسَعِيدٌ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala shabiybun 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy abnu almusayyabi, wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'abdi alllahi bni ka'bin, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala shahidnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hunaynana‏.‏ waqaala abnu almubaaraki 'an yuwnusa 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an sa'iydin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ taaba'ahu saalihun 'ani alzzuhriyyi‏.‏ waqaala alzzubaydiyyu aakhbaraniy alzzuhriyyu aanna 'abda alrrahmani bna ka'bin aakhbarahu aanna 'ubayda alllahi bna ka'bin qaala aakhbaraniy man shahida ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm khaybara‏.‏ qaala alzzuhriyyu waaakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi wasa'iydun 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: narration about the chain of narrators
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا غَزَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْبَرَ ـ أَوْ قَالَ لَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ أَشْرَفَ النَّاسُ عَلَى وَادٍ، فَرَفَعُوا أَصْوَاتَهُمْ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ارْبَعُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ، إِنَّكُمْ لاَ تَدْعُونَ أَصَمَّ وَلاَ غَائِبًا، إِنَّكُمْ تَدْعُونَ سَمِيعًا قَرِيبًا وَهْوَ مَعَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَنَا خَلْفَ دَابَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَمِعَنِي وَأَنَا أَقُولُ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ، فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَلِمَةٍ مِنْ كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فِدَاكَ أَبِي وَأُمِّي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, 'an 'aasimin, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa ghazaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khaybara aaw qaala lammaa tawajjaha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aashrafa alnnaasu 'alaa waadin, farafa'uwa aaswaatahum bialttakbiyri alllahu aakbaru alllahu aakbaru, laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ arba'uwa 'alaa aanfusikum, iinnakum laa tad'uwna aasamma walaa ghaaiibana, iinnakum tad'uwna samiy'ana qariybana wahwa ma'akum ‏"‏‏.‏ waaanaa khalfa daabbaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasami'aniy waaanaa aaquwlu laa hawla walaa quwwaaa iilaaa bialllahi, faqaala liy ‏"‏ yaa 'abda alllahi bna qaysin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aalaa aadulluka 'alaa kalimaain min kanzin min kunuwzi aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu balaa yaa rasuwla alllahi fidaaka aabiy waaummiy‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa hawla walaa quwwaaa iilaaa bialllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fought the battle of Khaibar, or when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went towards it, (whenever) the people, (passed over a high place overlooking a valley, they raised their voices saying, "Allahu-Akbar! Allahu-Akbar! None has the right to be worshipped except Allah." On that Allah's Apostle said (to them), "Lower your voices, for you are not calling a deaf or an absent one, but you are calling a Hearer Who is near and is with you." I was behind the riding animal of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he heard me saying. "There Is neither might, nor power but with Allah," On that he said to me, "O `Abdullah bin Qais!" I said, "Labbaik. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "Shall I tell you a sentence which is one of the treasures of Paradise" I said, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let my father and mother be sacrificed for your sake." He said, "It is: There is neither might nor power but with Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ أَثَرَ ضَرْبَةٍ فِي سَاقِ سَلَمَةَ، فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا مُسْلِمٍ، مَا هَذِهِ الضَّرْبَةُ قَالَ هَذِهِ ضَرْبَةٌ أَصَابَتْنِي يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ، فَقَالَ النَّاسُ أُصِيبَ سَلَمَةُ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَفَثَ فِيهِ ثَلاَثَ نَفَثَاتٍ، فَمَا اشْتَكَيْتُهَا حَتَّى السَّاعَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa almakkiyyu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu aabiy 'ubaydin, qaala raaaytu aathara darbaain fiy saaqi salamaaa, faqultu yaa aabaa muslimin, maa hadhihi alddarbaau qaala hadhihi darbaaun aasaabatniy yawma khaybara, faqaala alnnaasu ausiyba salamaau‏.‏ faaataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fanafatha fiyhi thalaatha nafathaatin, famaa ashtakaytuhaa hattaa alssaa'aai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Yazid bin Abi Ubaid:I saw the trace of a wound in Salama's leg. I said to him, "O Abu Muslim! What is this wound?" He said, "This was inflicted on me on the day of Khaibar and the people said, 'Salama has been wounded.' Then I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he puffed his saliva in it (i.e. the wound) thrice., and since then I have not had any pain in it till this hour
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ، قَالَ الْتَقَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْمُشْرِكُونَ فِي بَعْضِ مَغَازِيهِ فَاقْتَتَلُوا، فَمَالَ كُلُّ قَوْمٍ إِلَى عَسْكَرِهِمْ، وَفِي الْمُسْلِمِينَ رَجُلٌ لاَ يَدَعُ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ شَاذَّةً وَلاَ فَاذَّةً إِلاَّ اتَّبَعَهَا فَضَرَبَهَا بِسَيْفِهِ، فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أَجْزَأَ أَحَدُهُمْ مَا أَجْزَأَ فُلاَنٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا أَيُّنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ إِنْ كَانَ هَذَا مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ لأَتَّبِعَنَّهُ، فَإِذَا أَسْرَعَ وَأَبْطَأَ كُنْتُ مَعَهُ‏.‏ حَتَّى جُرِحَ فَاسْتَعْجَلَ الْمَوْتَ، فَوَضَعَ نِصَابَ سَيْفِهِ بِالأَرْضِ، وَذُبَابَهُ بَيْنَ ثَدْيَيْهِ، ثُمَّ تَحَامَلَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ، فَجَاءَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَخْبَرَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَعْمَلُ بِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، فِيمَا يَبْدُو لِلنَّاسِ، وَإِنَّهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَيَعْمَلُ بِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، فِيمَا يَبْدُو لِلنَّاسِ وَهْوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sahlin, qaala altaqaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waalmushrikuwna fiy ba'di maghaaziyhi faaqtataluwa, famaala kullu qawmin iilaa 'askarihim, wafiy almuslimiyna rajulun laa yada'u mina almushrikiyna shaadhhaaan walaa faadhhaaan iilaaa attaba'ahaa fadarabahaa bisayfihi, faqiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi maa aajzaaa aahaduhum maa aajzaaa fulaanun‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinnahu min aahli alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa aayyunaa min aahli aljannaai iin kaana hadhaa min aahli alnnaari faqaala rajulun mina alqawmi laattabi'annahu, faiidhaa aasra'a waaabtaaa kuntu ma'ahu‏.‏ hattaa juriha faasta'jala almawta, fawada'a nisaaba sayfihi bialaardi, wadhubaabahu bayna thadyayhi, thumma tahaamala 'alayhi, faqatala nafsahu, fajaa'a alrrajulu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aashhadu aannaka rasuwlu alllahi faqaala ‏"‏ wamaa dhaaka ‏"‏‏.‏ faaakhbarahu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinna alrrajula laya'malu bi'amali aahli aljannaai, fiymaa yabduw lilnnaasi, waiinnahu min aahli alnnaari, waya'malu bi'amali aahli alnnaari, fiymaa yabduw lilnnaasi wahwa min aahli aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl:During one of his Ghazawat, the Prophet (ﷺ) encountered the pagans, and the two armies fought, and then each of them returned to their army camps. Amongst the (army of the) Muslims there was a man who would follow every pagan separated from the army and strike him with his sword. It was said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! None has fought so satisfactorily as so-and-so (namely, that brave Muslim). "The Prophet said, "He is from the dwellers of the Hell-Fire." The people said, "Who amongst us will be of the dwellers of Paradise if this (man) is from the dwellers of the Hell-Fire?" Then a man from amongst the people said, "I will follow him and accompany him in his fast and slow movements." The (brave) man got wounded, and wanting to die at once, he put the handle of his sword on the ground and its tip in between his breasts, and then threw himself over it, committing suicide. Then the man (who had watched the deceased) returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I testify that you are Apostle of Allah." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What is this?" The man told him the whole story. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man may do what may seem to the people as the deeds of the dwellers of Paradise, but he is of the dwellers of the Hell-Fire and a man may do what may seem to the people as the deeds of the dwellers of the Hell-Fire, but he is from the dwellers of Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْخُزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ، قَالَ نَظَرَ أَنَسٌ إِلَى النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، فَرَأَى طَيَالِسَةً فَقَالَ كَأَنَّهُمُ السَّاعَةَ يَهُودُ خَيْبَرَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu sa'iydin alkhuzaa'iyyu, haddathanaa ziyaadu bnu alrrabiy'i, 'an aabiy 'imraana, qaala nazara aanasun iilaa alnnaasi yawma aljumu'aai, faraaaa tayaalisaaan faqaala kaaannahumu alssaa'aaa yahuwdu khaybara‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu `Imran:Anas looked at the people wearing Tailsans (i.e. a special kind of head covering worn by Jews in old days). On that Anas said, "At this moment they (i.e. those people) look like the Jews of Khaibar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ تَخَلَّفَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي خَيْبَرَ، وَكَانَ رَمِدًا فَقَالَ أَنَا أَتَخَلَّفُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَحِقَ، فَلَمَّا بِتْنَا اللَّيْلَةَ الَّتِي فُتِحَتْ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لأُعْطِيَنَّ الرَّايَةَ غَدًا ـ أَوْ لَيَأْخُذَنَّ الرَّايَةَ غَدًا ـ رَجُلٌ يُحِبُّهُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، يُفْتَحُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَنَحْنُ نَرْجُوهَا فَقِيلَ هَذَا عَلِيٌّ، فَأَعْطَاهُ فَفُتِحَ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa haatimun, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy 'ubaydin, 'an salamaaa, rda allh 'nh qaala kaana 'aliyyun rda allh 'nh takhallafa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy khaybara, wakaana ramidana faqaala aanaa aatakhallafu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm falahiqa, falammaa bitnaa alllaylaaa allatiy futihat qaala ‏ "‏ lau'tiyanna alrraayaaa ghadana aaw layaakhudhanna alrraayaaa ghadana rajulun yuhibbuhu alllahu warasuwluhu, yuftahu 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏ fanahnu narjuwhaa faqiyla hadhaa 'aliyyun, faaa'taahu fafutiha 'alayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salama:`Ali remained behind the Prophet (ﷺ) during the Ghazwa of Khaibar as he was suffering from eye trouble. He then said, "(How can) I remain behind the Prophet (ﷺ) ," and followed him. So when he slept on the night of the conquest of Khaibar, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will give the flag tomorrow, or tomorrow the flag will be taken by a man who is loved by Allah and His Apostle , and (Khaibar) will be conquered through him, (with Allah's help)" While every one of us was hopeful to have the flag, it was said, "Here is `Ali" and the Prophet (ﷺ) gave him the flag and Khaibar was conquered through him (with Allah's Help)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَهْلُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ ‏"‏ لأُعْطِيَنَّ هَذِهِ الرَّايَةَ غَدًا رَجُلاً، يَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ، يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ، وَيُحِبُّهُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَبَاتَ النَّاسُ يَدُوكُونَ لَيْلَتَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يُعْطَاهَا فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ النَّاسُ غَدَوْا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، كُلُّهُمْ يَرْجُو أَنْ يُعْطَاهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقِيلَ هُوَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَشْتَكِي عَيْنَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَرْسِلُوا إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ فَبَصَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي عَيْنَيْهِ، وَدَعَا لَهُ، فَبَرَأَ حَتَّى كَأَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِهِ وَجَعٌ، فَأَعْطَاهُ الرَّايَةَ، فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُقَاتِلُهُمْ حَتَّى يَكُونُوا مِثْلَنَا، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ انْفُذْ عَلَى رِسْلِكَ حَتَّى تَنْزِلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ، ثُمَّ ادْعُهُمْ إِلَى الإِسْلاَمِ، وَأَخْبِرْهُمْ بِمَا يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ حَقِّ اللَّهِ فِيهِ، فَوَاللَّهِ لأَنْ يَهْدِيَ اللَّهُ بِكَ رَجُلاً وَاحِدًا خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنْ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَكَ حُمْرُ النَّعَمِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy haazimin, qaala aakhbaraniy sahlu bnu sa'din rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala yawma khaybara ‏"‏ lau'tiyanna hadhihi alrraayaaa ghadana rajulaan, yaftahu alllahu 'alaa yadayhi, yuhibbu alllaha warasuwlahu, wayuhibbuhu alllahu warasuwluhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fabaata alnnaasu yaduwkuwna laylatahum aayyuhum yu'taahaa falammaa aasbaha alnnaasu ghadawa 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, kulluhum yarjuw aan yu'taahaa faqaala ‏"‏ aayna 'aliyyu bnu aabiy taalibin ‏"‏‏.‏ faqiyla huwa yaa rasuwla alllahi yashtakiy 'aynayhi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaarsiluwa iilayhi ‏"‏‏.‏ faautiya bihi fabasaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy 'aynayhi, wada'aa lahu, fabaraaa hattaa kaaan lam yakun bihi waja'un, faaa'taahu alrraayaaa, faqaala 'aliyyun yaa rasuwla alllahi auqaatiluhum hattaa yakuwnuwa mithlanaa, faqaala ‏"‏ anfudh 'alaa rislika hattaa tanzila bisaahatihim, thumma ad'uhum iilaa aliislaami, waaakhbirhum bimaa yajibu 'alayhim min haqqi alllahi fiyhi, fawaalllahi laan yahdiya alllahu bika rajulaan waahidana khayrun laka min aan yakuwna laka humru alnna'ami ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:On the day of Khaibar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Tomorrow I will give this flag to a man through whose hands Allah will give us victory. He loves Allah and His Apostle, and he is loved by Allah and His Apostle." The people remained that night, wondering as to who would be given it. In the morning the people went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and everyone of them was hopeful to receive it (i.e. the flag). The Prophet said, "Where is `Ali bin Abi Talib?" It was said, "He is suffering from eye trouble O Allah's Apostle." He said, "Send for him." `Ali was brought and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spat in his eye and invoked good upon him. So `Ali was cured as if he never had any trouble. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) gave him the flag. `Ali said "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I will fight with them till they become like us." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Proceed and do not hurry. When you enter their territory, call them to embrace Islam and inform them of Allah's Rights which they should observe, for by Allah, even if a single man is led on the right path (of Islam) by Allah through you, then that will be better for you than the nice red camels
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْغَفَّارِ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، مَوْلَى الْمُطَّلِبِ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَدِمْنَا خَيْبَرَ، فَلَمَّا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْحِصْنَ ذُكِرَ لَهُ جَمَالُ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ حُيَىِّ بْنِ أَخْطَبَ، وَقَدْ قُتِلَ زَوْجُهَا وَكَانَتْ عَرُوسًا، فَاصْطَفَاهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِنَفْسِهِ، فَخَرَجَ بِهَا، حَتَّى بَلَغْنَا سَدَّ الصَّهْبَاءِ حَلَّتْ، فَبَنَى بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ صَنَعَ حَيْسًا فِي نِطَعٍ صَغِيرٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي ‏ "‏ آذِنْ مَنْ حَوْلَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ وَلِيمَتَهُ عَلَى صَفِيَّةَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ، فَرَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَوِّي لَهَا وَرَاءَهُ بِعَبَاءَةٍ، ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ عِنْدَ بَعِيرِهِ، فَيَضَعُ رُكْبَتَهُ، وَتَضَعُ صَفِيَّةُ رِجْلَهَا عَلَى رُكْبَتِهِ حَتَّى تَرْكَبَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alghaffaari bnu daawuda, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, h wahaddathaniy aahmadu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy ya'quwbu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alzzuhriyyu, 'an 'amrinw, mawlaa almuttalibi 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala qadimnaa khaybara, falammaa fataha alllahu 'alayhi alhisna dhukira lahu jamaalu safiyyaaa binti huyaaai bni aakhtaba, waqad qutila zawjuhaa wakaanat 'aruwsana, faastafaahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm linafsihi, fakharaja bihaa, hattaa balaghnaa sadda alssahbaa'i hallat, fabanaa bihaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, thumma sana'a haysana fiy nita'in saghiyrin, thumma qaala liy ‏ "‏ adhin man hawlaka ‏"‏‏.‏ fakaanat tilka waliymatahu 'alaa safiyyaaa, thumma kharajnaa iilaa almadiynaai, faraaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhawwiy lahaa waraa'ahu bi'abaa'aain, thumma yajlisu 'inda ba'iyrihi, fayada'u rukbatahu, watada'u safiyyaau rijlahaa 'alaa rukbatihi hattaa tarkaba‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We arrived at Khaibar, and when Allah helped His Apostle to open the fort, the beauty of Safiya bint Huyai bin Akhtaq whose husband had been killed while she was a bride, was mentioned to Allah's Apostle. The Prophet (ﷺ) selected her for himself, and set out with her, and when we reached a place called Sidd-as-Sahba,' Safiya became clean from her menses. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married her. Hais (i.e. an 'Arabian dish) was prepared on a small leather mat. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Invite the people around you." So that was the marriage banquet of the Prophet (ﷺ) and Safiya. Then we proceeded towards Medina, and I saw the Prophet, making for her a kind of cushion with his cloak behind him (on his camel). He then sat beside his camel and put his knee for Safiya to put her foot on, in order to ride (on the camel)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقَامَ عَلَى صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ حُيَىٍّ، بِطَرِيقِ خَيْبَرَ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، حَتَّى أَعْرَسَ بِهَا، وَكَانَتْ فِيمَنْ ضُرِبَ عَلَيْهَا الْحِجَابُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy aakhiy, 'an sulaymaana, 'an yahyaa, 'an humaydin alttawiyli, sami'a aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aaqaama 'alaa safiyyaaa binti huyaaain, bitariyqi khaybara thalaathaaa aayyaamin, hattaa aa'rasa bihaa, wakaanat fiyman duriba 'alayhaa alhijaabu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) stayed with Safiya bint Huyai for three days on the way of Khaibar where he consummated his marriage with her. Safiya was amongst those who were ordered to use a veil
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدٌ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ أَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ خَيْبَرَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ثَلاَثَ لَيَالٍ يُبْنَى عَلَيْهِ بِصَفِيَّةَ، فَدَعَوْتُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ إِلَى وَلِيمَتِهِ، وَمَا كَانَ فِيهَا مِنْ خُبْزٍ وَلاَ لَحْمٍ، وَمَا كَانَ فِيهَا إِلاَّ أَنْ أَمَرَ بِلاَلاً بِالأَنْطَاعِ فَبُسِطَتْ، فَأَلْقَى عَلَيْهَا التَّمْرَ وَالأَقِطَ وَالسَّمْنَ، فَقَالَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ إِحْدَى أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُهُ قَالُوا إِنْ حَجَبَهَا فَهْىَ إِحْدَى أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَحْجُبْهَا فَهْىَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُهُ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا ارْتَحَلَ وَطَّأَ لَهَا خَلْفَهُ، وَمَدَّ الْحِجَابَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'fari bni aabiy kathiyrin, qaala aakhbaraniy humaydun, aannahu sami'a aanasana rda allh 'nh yaquwlu aaqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna khaybara waalmadiynaai thalaatha layaalin yubnaa 'alayhi bisafiyyaaa, fada'awtu almuslimiyna iilaa waliymatihi, wamaa kaana fiyhaa min khubzin walaa lahmin, wamaa kaana fiyhaa iilaaa aan aamara bilaalaan bialaantaa'i fabusitat, faaalqaa 'alayhaa alttamra waalaaqita waalssamna, faqaala almuslimuwna iihdaa aummahaati almuuminiyna, aaw maa malakat yamiynuhu qaaluwa iin hajabahaa fahaa iihdaa aummahaati almuuminiyna, waiin lam yahjubhaa fahaa mimmaa malakat yamiynuhu‏.‏ falammaa artahala wattaaa lahaa khalfahu, wamadda alhijaaba‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) stayed for three nights between Khaibar and Medina and was married to Safiya. I invited the Muslim to his marriage banquet and there waa neither meat nor bread in that banquet but the Prophet ordered Bilal to spread the leather mats on which dates, dried yogurt and butter were put. The Muslims said amongst themselves, "Will she (i.e. Safiya) be one of the mothers of the believers, (i.e. one of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) or just (a lady captive) of what his right-hand possesses" Some of them said, "If the Prophet (ﷺ) makes her observe the veil, then she will be one of the mothers of the believers (i.e. one of the Prophet's wives), and if he does not make her observe the veil, then she will be his lady slave." So when he departed, he made a place for her behind him (on his camel and made her observe the veil)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا مُحَاصِرِي خَيْبَرَ فَرَمَى إِنْسَانٌ بِجِرَابٍ فِيهِ شَحْمٌ، فَنَزَوْتُ لآخُذَهُ، فَالْتَفَتُّ فَإِذَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم�� فَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau‏.‏ wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa wahbun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an humaydi bni hilaalin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mughaffalin rda allh 'nh qaala kunnaa muhaasiriy khaybara faramaa iinsaanun bijiraabin fiyhi shahmun, fanazawtu lakhudhahu, faaltafattu faiidhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm�� faastahyaytu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:While we were besieging Khaibar, a person threw a leather container containing some fat and I ran to take it. Suddenly I looked behind, and behold! The Prophet (ﷺ) was there. So I felt shy (to take it then)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، وَسَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ عَنْ أَكْلِ الثَّوْمِ، وَعَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ‏.‏ نَهَى عَنْ أَكْلِ الثَّوْمِ هُوَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ وَحْدَهُ‏.‏ وَلُحُومُ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ عَنْ سَالِمٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, 'an aabiy ausaamaaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, wasaalimin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa yawma khaybara 'an aakli althhawmi, wa'an luhuwmi alhumuri alaahliyyaai‏.‏ nahaa 'an aakli althhawmi huwa 'an naafi'in wahdahu‏.‏ waluhuwmu alhumuri alaahliyyaai 'an saalimin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:On the day of Khaiber, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of garlic and the meat of donkeys
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَسَنِ، ابْنَىْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ مُتْعَةِ النِّسَاءِ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ، وَعَنْ أَكْلِ الْحُمُرِ الإِنْسِيَّةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, haddathanaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, waalhasani, abnaa muhammadi bni 'aliyyin 'an aabiyhimaa, 'an 'aliyyi bni aabiy taalibin rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an mut'aai alnnisaa'i yawma khaybara, wa'an aakli alhumuri aliinsiyyaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali bin Abi Talib:On the day of Khaibar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the Mut'a (i.e. temporary marriage) and the eating of donkey-meat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa yawma khaybara 'an luhuwmi alhumuri alaahliyyaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:On the day of Khaibar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of donkey meat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، وَسَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu nasrin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, wasaalimin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aakli luhuwmi alhumuri alaahliyyaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of donkey-meat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ، وَرَخَّصَ فِي الْخَيْلِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an 'amrinw, 'an muhammadi bni 'aliyyin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma khaybara 'an luhuwmi alhumuri, warakhhasa fiy alkhayli‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of Khaibar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of donkey meat and allowed the eating of horse meat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادٌ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَصَابَتْنَا مَجَاعَةٌ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ، فَإِنَّ الْقُدُورَ لَتَغْلِي ـ قَالَ وَبَعْضُهَا نَضِجَتْ ـ فَجَاءَ مُنَادِي النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ تَأْكُلُوا مِنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ شَيْئًا وَأَهْرِيقُوهَا‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي أَوْفَى فَتَحَدَّثْنَا أَنَّهُ إِنَّمَا نَهَى عَنْهَا لأَنَّهَا لَمْ تُخَمَّسْ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ نَهَى عَنْهَا الْبَتَّةَ، لأَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَأْكُلُ الْعَذِرَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa 'abbaadun, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, qaala sami'tu abna aabiy aawfaa rda allh 'nhma aasaabatnaa majaa'aaun yawma khaybara, faiinna alquduwra lataghliy qaala waba'duhaa nadijat fajaa'a munaadiy alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm laa taakuluwa min luhuwmi alhumuri shayiana waaahriyquwhaa‏.‏ qaala abnu aabiy aawfaa fatahaddathnaa aannahu iinnamaa nahaa 'anhaa laannahaa lam tukhammas‏.‏ waqaala ba'duhum nahaa 'anhaa albattaaa, laannahaa kaanat taakulu al'adhiraaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Abi `Aufa:We where afflicted with severe hunger on the day of Khaibar. While the cooking pots were boiling and some of the food was well-cooked, the announcer of the Prophet (ﷺ) came to say, "Do not eat anything of the donkey-meat and upset the cooking pots." We then thought that the Prophet (ﷺ) had prohibited such food because the Khumus had not been taken out of it. Some others said, "He prohibited the meat of donkeys from the point of view of principle, because donkeys used to eat dirty things
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى، رضى الله عنهم أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَصَابُوا حُمُرًا فَطَبَخُوهَا، فَنَادَى مُنَادِي النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكْفِئُوا الْقُدُورَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy 'adiyyu bnu thaabitin, 'ani albaraa'i, wa'abdi alllahi bni aabiy aawfaa, rda allh 'nhm aannahum kaanuwa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaasaabuwa humurana fatabakhuwhaa, fanaadaa munaadiy alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakfiiuwa alquduwra‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara and `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:That when they were in the company of the Prophet, they got some donkeys which they (slaughtered and) cooked. Then the announcer of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Turn the cooking pots upside down (i.e. throw out the meat)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، وَابْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى، يُحَدِّثَانِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ وَقَدْ نَصَبُوا الْقُدُورَ أَكْفِئُوا الْقُدُورَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'adiyyu bnu thaabitin, sami'tu albaraa'a, waabna aabiy aawfaa, yuhaddithaani 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala yawma khaybara waqad nasabuwa alquduwra aakfiiuwa alquduwra‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara' and Ibn Abi `Aufa:On the day of Khaibar when the cooking pots were put on the fire, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Turn the cooking pots upside down
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ غَزَوْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyi bni thaabitin, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala ghazawnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahwahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:We took part in a Ghazwa with the Prophet (same as Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَمَرَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةِ خَيْبَرَ أَنْ نُلْقِيَ الْحُمُرَ الأَهْلِيَّةَ نِيئَةً وَنَضِيجَةً، ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْمُرْنَا بِأَكْلِهِ بَعْدُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, aakhbaranaa 'aasimun, 'an 'aamirin, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma qaala aamaranaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazwaai khaybara aan nulqiya alhumura alaahliyyaaa niyiaaan wanadiyjaaan, thumma lam yaamurnaa biaaklihi ba'du‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara Bin Azib:During the Ghazwa of Khaibar, the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to throw away the meat of the donkeys whether it was still raw or cooked. He did not allow us to eat it later on
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي الْحُسَيْنِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي أَنَهَى عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُ كَانَ حَمُولَةَ النَّاسِ، فَكَرِهَ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ حَمُولَتُهُمْ، أَوْ حَرَّمَهُ فِي يَوْمِ خَيْبَرَ، لَحْمَ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu aabiy alhusayni, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an 'aasimin, 'an 'aamirin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala laa aadriy aanahaa 'anhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min aajli aannahu kaana hamuwlaaa alnnaasi, fakariha aan tadhhaba hamuwlatuhum, aaw harramahu fiy yawmi khaybara, lahma alhumuri alaahliyyaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I do not know whether the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the eating of donkey-meat (temporarily) because they were the beasts of burden for the people, and he disliked that their means of transportation should be lost, or he forbade it on the day of Khaibar permanently
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَابِقٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَسَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ لِلْفَرَسِ سَهْمَيْنِ، وَلِلرَّاجِلِ سَهْمًا‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَّرَهُ نَافِعٌ فَقَالَ إِذَا كَانَ مَعَ الرَّجُلِ فَرَسٌ فَلَهُ ثَلاَثَةُ أَسْهُمٍ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ فَرَسٌ فَلَهُ سَهْمٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu saabiqin, haddathanaa zaaiidaau, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qasama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma khaybara lilfarasi sahmayni, walilrraajili sahmana‏.‏ qaala fassarahu naafi'un faqaala iidhaa kaana ma'a alrrajuli farasun falahu thalaathaau aashumin, faiin lam yakun lahu farasun falahu sahmun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:On the day of Khaibar, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) divided (the war booty of Khaibar) with the ratio of two shares for the horse and one-share for the foot soldier. (The sub-narrator, Nafi` explained this, saying, "If a man had a horse, he was given three shares and if he had no horse, then he was given one share)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ جُبَيْرَ بْنَ مُطْعِمٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ مَشَيْتُ أَنَا وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَفَّانَ، إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْنَا أَعْطَيْتَ بَنِي الْمُطَّلِبِ مِنْ خُمْسِ خَيْبَرَ، وَتَرَكْتَنَا، وَنَحْنُ بِمَنْزِلَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا بَنُو هَاشِمٍ وَبَنُو الْمُطَّلِبِ شَىْءٌ وَاحِدٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ جُبَيْرٌ وَلَمْ يَقْسِمِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِبَنِي عَبْدِ شَمْسٍ وَبَنِي نَوْفَلٍ شَيْئًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, aanna jubayra bna mut'imin, aakhbarahu qaala mashaytu aanaa wa'uthmaanu bnu 'affaana, iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqulnaa aa'tayta baniy almuttalibi min khumsi khaybara, wataraktanaa, wanahnu bimanzilaain waahidaain minka‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa banuw haashimin wabanuw almuttalibi shaa'un waahidun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala jubayrun walam yaqsimi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm libaniy 'abdi shamsin wabaniy nawfalin shayiana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:`Uthman bin `Affan and I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "You had given Banu Al-Muttalib from the Khumus of Khaibar's booty and left us in spite of the fact that we and Banu Al-Muttalib are similarly related to you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Banu Hashim and Banu Al-Muttalib only are one and the same." So the Prophet (ﷺ) did not give anything to Banu `Abd Shams and Banu Nawfal
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا بُرَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَلَغَنَا مَخْرَجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ بِالْيَمَنِ، فَخَرَجْنَا مُهَاجِرِينَ إِلَيْهِ أَنَا، وَأَخَوَانِ لِي أَنَا أَصْغَرُهُمْ، أَحَدُهُمَا أَبُو بُرْدَةَ، وَالآخَرُ أَبُو رُهْمٍ ـ إِمَّا قَالَ بِضْعٌ وَإِمَّا قَالَ ـ فِي ثَلاَثَةٍ وَخَمْسِينَ أَوِ اثْنَيْنِ وَخَمْسِينَ رَجُلاً مِنْ قَوْمِي، فَرَكِبْنَا سَفِينَةً، فَأَلْقَتْنَا سَفِينَتُنَا إِلَى النَّجَاشِيِّ بِالْحَبَشَةِ، فَوَافَقْنَا جَعْفَرَ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَأَقَمْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا جَمِيعًا، فَوَافَقْنَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ افْتَتَحَ خَيْبَرَ، وَكَانَ أُنَاسٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ يَقُولُونَ لَنَا ـ يَعْنِي لأَهْلِ السَّفِينَةِ ـ سَبَقْنَاكُمْ بِالْهِجْرَةِ، وَدَخَلَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ عُمَيْسٍ، وَهْىَ مِمَّنْ قَدِمَ مَعَنَا، عَلَى حَفْصَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَائِرَةً، وَقَدْ كَانَتْ هَاجَرَتْ إِلَى النَّجَاشِيِّ فِيمَنْ هَاجَرَ، فَدَخَلَ عُمَرُ عَلَى حَفْصَةَ وَأَسْمَاءُ عِنْدَهَا، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ حِينَ رَأَى أَسْمَاءَ مَنْ هَذِهِ قَالَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ عُمَيْسٍ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ الْحَبَشِيَّةُ هَذِهِ الْبَحْرِيَّةُ هَذِهِ قَالَتْ أَسْمَاءُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ سَبَقْنَاكُمْ بِالْهِجْرَةِ، فَنَحْنُ أَحَقُّ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْكُمْ‏.‏ فَغَضِبَتْ وَقَالَتْ كَلاَّ وَاللَّهِ، كُنْتُمْ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُطْعِمُ جَائِعَكُمْ، وَيَعِظُ جَاهِلَكُمْ، وَكُنَّا فِي دَارِ أَوْ فِي أَرْضِ الْبُعَدَاءِ الْبُغَضَاءِ بِالْحَبَشَةِ، وَذَلِكَ فِي اللَّهِ وَفِي رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَايْمُ اللَّهِ، لاَ أَطْعَمُ طَعَامًا، وَلاَ أَشْرَبُ شَرَابًا حَتَّى أَذْكُرَ مَا قُلْتَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ كُنَّا نُؤْذَى وَنُخَافُ، وَسَأَذْكُرُ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَسْأَلُهُ، وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَكْذِبُ وَلاَ أَزِيغُ وَلاَ أَزِيدُ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathaniy muhamaadu bnu al'alaa'i, hadaathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, hadaathanaa buraydu bnu 'abdi allaahi, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh qaala balaghanaa makhraju alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu bialyamani, fakharajnaa muhaajiriyna iilayhi aanaa, waaakhawaani liy aanaa aasgharuhum, aahaduhumaa aabuw burdaaa, waalakharu aabuw ruhmin iimaaa qaala bid'un waiimaaa qaala fiy thalaathaain wakhamsiyna aawi athnayni wakhamsiyna rajulaan min qawmiy, farakibnaa safiynaaan, faaalqatnaa safiynatunaa iilaa alnaajaashiyii bialhabashaai, fawaafaqnaa ja'fara bna aabiy taalibin faaaqamnaa ma'ahu hataaa qadimnaa jamiy'ana, fawaafaqnaa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna aftataha khaybara, wakaana aunaasun mina alnaaasi yaquwluwna lanaa ya'niy laahli alsaafiynaai sabaqnaakum bialhijraai, wadakhalat aasmaa'u bintu 'umaysin, wahaa mimaan qadima ma'anaa, 'alaa hafsaaa zawji alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm zaaiiraaan, waqad kaanat haajarat iilaa alnaajaashiyii fiyman haajara, fadakhala 'umaru 'alaa hafsaaa waaasmaa'u 'indahaa, faqaala 'umaru hiyna raaaa aasmaa'a man hadhihi qaalat aasmaa'u bintu 'umaysin‏.‏ qaala 'umaru alhabashiyaaau hadhihi albahriyaaau hadhihi qaalat aasmaa'u na'am‏.‏ qaala sabaqnaakum bialhijraai, fanahnu aahaquu birasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm minkum‏.‏ faghadibat waqaalat kalaaa waallaahi, kuntum ma'a rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yut'imu jaaii'akum, waya'izu jaahilakum, wakunaaa fiy daari aaw fiy aardi albu'adaa'i albughadaa'i bialhabashaai, wadhalika fiy allaahi wafiy rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaymu allaahi, laa aat'amu ta'aamana, walaa aashrabu sharaabana hataaa aadhkura maa qulta lirasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu kunaaa nuudhaa wanukhaafu, wasaaadhkuru dhalika lilnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm waaasaaluhu, waallaahi laa aakdhibu walaa aaziyghu walaa aaziydu 'alayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:The news of the migration of the Prophet (from Mecca to Medina) reached us while we were in Yemen. So we set out as emigrants towards him. We were (three) I and my two brothers. I was the youngest of them, and one of the two was Abu Burda, and the other, Abu Ruhm, and our total number was either 53 or 52 men from my people. We got on board a boat and our boat took us to Negus in Ethiopia. There we met Ja`far bin Abi Talib and stayed with him. Then we all came (to Medina) and met the Prophet (ﷺ) at the time of the conquest of Khaibar. Some of the people used to say to us, namely the people of the ship, "We have migrated before you." Asma' bint 'Umais who was one of those who had come with us, came as a visitor to Hafsa, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ). She had migrated along with those other Muslims who migrated to Negus. `Umar came to Hafsa while Asma' bint 'Umais was with her. `Umar, on seeing Asma,' said, "Who is this?" She said, "Asma' bint 'Umais," `Umar said, "Is she the Ethiopian? Is she the sea-faring lady?" Asma' replied, "Yes." `Umar said, "We have migrated before you (people of the boat), so we have got more right than you over Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) " On that Asma' became angry and said, "No, by Allah, while you were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was feeding the hungry ones amongst you, and advised the ignorant ones amongst you, we were in the far-off hated land of Ethiopia, and all that was for the sake of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . By Allah, I will neither eat any food nor drink anything till I inform Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of all that you have said. There we were harmed and frightened. I will mention this to the Prophet (ﷺ) and will not tell a lie or curtail your saying or add something to it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنَّ عُمَرَ قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَا قُلْتِ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ لَهُ كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ بِأَحَقَّ بِي مِنْكُمْ، وَلَهُ وَلأَصْحَابِهِ هِجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ، وَلَكُمْ أَنْتُمْ أَهْلَ السَّفِينَةِ هِجْرَتَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ أَبَا مُوسَى وَأَصْحَابَ السَّفِينَةِ يَأْتُونِي أَرْسَالاً، يَسْأَلُونِي عَنْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ، مَا مِنَ الدُّنْيَا شَىْءٌ هُمْ بِهِ أَفْرَحُ وَلاَ أَعْظَمُ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ مِمَّا قَالَ لَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم. قَالَ أَبُو بُرْدَةَ قَالَتْ أَسْمَاءُ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ أَبَا مُوسَى وَإِنَّهُ لَيَسْتَعِيدُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ مِنِّي‏.‏
verses.translit: falamaaa jaa'a alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat yaa nabiyaa allaahi iinaa 'umara qaala kadhaa wakadhaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ famaa qulti lahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat qultu lahu kadhaa wakadhaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laysa biaahaqaa biy minkum, walahu walaashaabihi hijraaun waahidaaun, walakum aantum aahla alsaafiynaai hijrataani ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat falaqad raaaytu aabaa muwsaa waaashaaba alsaafiynaai yaatuwniy aarsaalaan, yasaaluwniy 'an hadhaa alhadiythi, maa mina alduunyaa shaa'un hum bihi aafrahu walaa aa'zamu fiy aanfusihim mimaaa qaala lahumu alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm. qaala aabuw burdaaa qaalat aasmaa'u falaqad raaaytu aabaa muwsaa waiinaahu layasta'iydu hadhaa alhadiytha miniiy‏.‏
verses.translation: So when the Prophet (ﷺ) came, she said, "O Allah's Prophet `Umar has said so-and-so." He said (to Asma'), "What did you say to him?" Asma' said, "I told him so-and-so." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He (i.e. `Umar) has not got more right than you people over me, as he and his companions have (the reward of) only one migration, and you, the people of the boat, have (the reward of) two migrations." Asma' later on said, "I saw Abu Musa and the other people of the boat coming to me in successive groups, asking me about this narration, and to them nothing in the world was more cheerful and greater than what the Prophet (ﷺ) had said about them." Narrated Abu Burda:Asma' said, "I saw Abu Musa requesting me to repeat this narration again and again
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: قَالَ أَبُو بُرْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لأَعْرِفُ أَصْوَاتَ رُفْقَةِ الأَشْعَرِيِّينَ بِالْقُرْآنِ، حِينَ يَدْخُلُونَ بِاللَّيْلِ، وَأَعْرِفُ مَنَازِلَهُمْ مِنْ أَصْوَاتِهِمْ بِالْقُرْآنِ بِاللَّيْلِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لَمْ أَرَ مَنَازِلَهُمْ حِينَ نَزَلُوا بِالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْهُمْ حَكِيمٌ، إِذَا لَقِيَ الْخَيْلَ ـ أَوْ قَالَ الْعَدُوَّ ـ قَالَ لَهُمْ إِنَّ أَصْحَابِي يَأْمُرُونَكُمْ أَنْ تَنْظُرُوهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala aabuw burdaaa 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinniy laa'rifu aaswaata rufqaai alaash'ariyyiyna bialqurani, hiyna yadkhuluwna bialllayli, waaa'rifu manaazilahum min aaswaatihim bialqurani bialllayli, waiin kuntu lam aara manaazilahum hiyna nazaluwa bialnnahaari, waminhum hakiymun, iidhaa laqiya alkhayla aaw qaala al'aduwwa qaala lahum iinna aashaabiy yaamuruwnakum aan tanzuruwhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda:Abu Musa said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I recognize the voice of the group of Al- Ashariyun, when they recite the Qur'an, when they enter their homes at night, and I recognize their houses by (listening) to their voices when they are reciting the Qur'an at night although I have not seen their houses when they came to them during the day time. Amongst them is Hakim who, on meeting the cavalry or the enemy, used to say to them (i.e. the enemy). My companions order you to wait for them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، سَمِعَ حَفْصَ بْنَ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بُرَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قَدِمْنَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ أَنِ افْتَتَحَ خَيْبَرَ، فَقَسَمَ لَنَا، وَلَمْ يَقْسِمْ لأَحَدٍ لَمْ يَشْهَدِ الْفَتْحَ غَيْرَنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, sami'a hafsa bna ghiyaathin, haddathanaa buraydu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala qadimnaa 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da aani aftataha khaybara, faqasama lanaa, walam yaqsim laahadin lam yashhadi alfatha ghayranaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:We came upon the Prophet (ﷺ) after he had conquered Khaibar. He then gave us a share (from the booty), but apart from us he did not give to anybody else who did not attend the Conquest
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ثَوْرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمٌ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ مُطِيعٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ افْتَتَحْنَا خَيْبَرَ، وَلَمْ نَغْنَمْ ذَهَبًا وَلاَ فِضَّةً، إِنَّمَا غَنِمْنَا الْبَقَرَ وَالإِبِلَ وَالْمَتَاعَ وَالْحَوَائِطَ، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى وَادِي الْقُرَى، وَمَعَهُ عَبْدٌ لَهُ يُقَالُ لَهُ مِدْعَمٌ، أَهْدَاهُ لَهُ أَحَدُ بَنِي الضِّبَابِ، فَبَيْنَمَا هُوَ يَحُطُّ رَحْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ جَاءَهُ سَهْمٌ عَائِرٌ حَتَّى أَصَابَ ذَلِكَ الْعَبْدَ، فَقَالَ النَّاسُ هَنِيئًا لَهُ الشَّهَادَةُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بَلَى وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، إِنَّ الشَّمْلَةَ الَّتِي أَصَابَهَا يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ مِنَ الْمَغَانِمِ لَمْ تُصِبْهَا الْمَقَاسِمُ لَتَشْتَعِلُ عَلَيْهِ نَارًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ حِينَ سَمِعَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشِرَاكٍ أَوْ بِشِرَاكَيْنِ، فَقَالَ هَذَا شَىْءٌ كُنْتُ أَصَبْتُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ شِرَاكٌ أَوْ شِرَاكَانِ مِنْ نَارٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, qaala haddathaniy thawrun, qaala haddathaniy saalimun, mawlaa abni mutiy'in aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh yaquwlu aftatahnaa khaybara, walam naghnam dhahabana walaa fiddaaan, iinnamaa ghanimnaa albaqara waaliibila waalmataa'a waalhawaaiita, thumma ansarafnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa waadiy alquraa, wama'ahu 'abdun lahu yuqaalu lahu mid'amun, aahdaahu lahu aahadu baniy alddibaabi, fabaynamaa huwa yahuttu rahla rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh jaa'ahu sahmun 'aaiirun hattaa aasaaba dhalika al'abda, faqaala alnnaasu haniyiana lahu alshhahaadaau‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ balaa waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi, iinna alshhamlaaa allatiy aasaabahaa yawma khaybara mina almaghaanimi lam tusibhaa almaqaasimu latashta'ilu 'alayhi naarana ‏"‏‏.‏ fajaa'a rajulun hiyna sami'a dhalika mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bishiraakin aaw bishiraakayni, faqaala hadhaa shaa'un kuntu aasabtuhu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ shiraakun aaw shiraakaani min naarin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:When we conquered Khaibar, we gained neither gold nor silver as booty, but we gained cows, camels, goods and gardens. Then we departed with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to the valley of Al-Qura, and at that time Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a slave called Mid`am who had been presented to him by one of Banu Ad-Dibbab. While the slave was dismounting the saddle of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) an arrow the thrower of which was unknown, came and hit him. The people said, "Congratulations to him for the martyrdom." Allah's Apostle said, "No, by Him in Whose Hand my soul is, the sheet (of cloth) which he had taken (illegally) on the day of Khaibar from the booty before the distribution of the booty, has become a flame of Fire burning him." On hearing that, a man brought one or two leather straps of shoes to the Prophet and said, "These are things I took (illegally)." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "This is a strap, or these are two straps of Fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ أَمَا وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لَوْلاَ أَنْ أَتْرُكَ آخِرَ النَّاسِ بَبَّانًا لَيْسَ لَهُمْ شَىْءٌ، مَا فُتِحَتْ عَلَىَّ قَرْيَةٌ إِلاَّ قَسَمْتُهَا كَمَا قَسَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْبَرَ، وَلَكِنِّي أَتْرُكُهَا خِزَانَةً لَهُمْ يَقْتَسِمُونَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala aakhbaraniy zaydun, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu sami'a 'umara bna alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh yaquwlu aamaa waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi, lawlaa aan aatruka akhira alnnaasi babbaanana laysa lahum shaa'un, maa futihat 'alaaaa qaryaaun iilaaa qasamtuhaa kamaa qasama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khaybara, walakinniy aatrukuhaa khizaanaaan lahum yaqtasimuwnahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, were I not afraid that the other Muslims might be left in poverty, I would divide (the land of) whatever village I may conquer (among the fighters), as the Prophet (ﷺ) divided the land of Khaibar. But I prefer to leave it as a (source of) a common treasury for them to distribute its revenue amongst themselves
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَوْلاَ آخِرُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ مَا فُتِحَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ قَرْيَةٌ إِلاَّ قَسَمْتُهَا، كَمَا قَسَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْبَرَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu mahdiyyin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'umara rda allh 'nh qaala lawlaa akhiru almuslimiyna maa futihat 'alayhim qaryaaun iilaaa qasamtuhaa, kamaa qasama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khaybara‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar:But for the other Muslims (i.e. coming generations) I would divide (the land of) whatever villages the Muslims might conquer (among the fighters), as the Prophet (ﷺ) divided (the land of) Khaibar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، وَسَأَلَهُ، إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْبَسَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ، قَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُ بَنِي سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ لاَ تُعْطِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ هَذَا قَاتِلُ ابْنِ قَوْقَلٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَاعَجَبَاهْ لِوَبْرٍ تَدَلَّى مِنْ قَدُومِ الضَّأْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala sami'tu alzzuhriyya, wasaaalahu, iismaa'iylu bnu aumayyaaa qaala aakhbaraniy 'anbasaau bnu sa'iydin, aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahu, qaala lahu ba'du baniy sa'iydi bni al'aasi laa tu'tihi‏.‏ faqaala aabuw hurayraaa hadhaa qaatilu abni qawqalin‏.‏ faqaala waa'ajabaah liwabrin tadallaa min qaduwmi alddaani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Anbasa bin Sa`id:Abu Huraira came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him (for a share from the Khaibar booty). On that, one of the sons of Sa`id bin Al-`As said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do not give him." Abu Huraira then said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) "This is the murderer of Ibn Qauqal." Sa`id's son said, "How strange! A guinea pig coming from Qadum Ad-Dan
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: وَيُذْكَرُ عَنِ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْبَسَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يُخْبِرُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْعَاصِي قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَانَ عَلَى سَرِيَّةٍ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ، قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَقَدِمَ أَبَانُ وَأَصْحَابُهُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِخَيْبَرَ، بَعْدَ مَا افْتَتَحَهَا، وَإِنَّ حُزْمَ خَيْلِهِمْ لَلِيفٌ، قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لاَ تَقْسِمْ لَهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبَانُ وَأَنْتَ بِهَذَا يَا وَبْرُ تَحَدَّرَ مِنْ رَأْسِ ضَأْنٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا أَبَانُ اجْلِسْ ‏"‏ فَلَمْ يَقْسِمْ لَهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: wayudhkaru 'ani alzzubaydiyyi, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'anbasaau bnu sa'iydin, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yukhbiru sa'iyda bna al'aasiy qaala ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aabaana 'alaa sariyyaain mina almadiynaai qibala najdin, qaala aabuw hurayraaa faqadima aabaanu waaashaabuhu 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bikhaybara, ba'da maa aftatahahaa, waiinna huzma khaylihim laliyfun, qaala aabuw hurayraaa qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, laa taqsim lahum‏.‏ qaala aabaanu waaanta bihadhaa yaa wabru tahaddara min raasi daanin‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa aabaanu ajlis ‏"‏ falam yaqsim lahum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent Aban from Medina to Najd as the commander of a Sariya. Aban and his companions came to the Prophet (ﷺ) at Khaibar after the Prophet (ﷺ) had conquered it, and the reins of their horses were made of the fire of date palm trees. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do not give them a share of the booty." On that, Aban said (to me), "Strange! You suggest such a thing though you are what you are, O guinea pig coming down from the top of Ad-Da'n (a lotus tree)!" On that the Prophet said, "O Aban, sit down!" and did not give them any share
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي جَدِّي، أَنَّ أَبَانَ بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، أَقْبَلَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا قَاتِلُ ابْنِ قَوْقَلٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبَانُ لأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَاعَجَبًا لَكَ وَبْرٌ تَدَأْدَأَ مِنْ قَدُومِ ضَأْنٍ‏.‏ يَنْعَى عَلَىَّ امْرَأً أَكْرَمَهُ اللَّهُ بِيَدِي، وَمَنَعَهُ أَنْ يُهِينَنِي بِيَدِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu yahyaa bni sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy jaddiy, aanna aabaana bna sa'iydin, aaqbala iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallama 'alayhi, faqaala aabuw hurayraaa yaa rasuwla alllahi hadhaa qaatilu abni qawqalin‏.‏ waqaala aabaanu laabiy hurayraaa waa'ajabana laka wabrun tadaadaaa min qaduwmi daanin‏.‏ yan'aa 'alaaaa amraaan aakramahu alllahu biyadiy, wamana'ahu aan yuhiynaniy biyadihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id:Aban bin Sa`id came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and greeted him. Abu Huraira said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This (Aban) is the murderer of Ibn Qauqal." (On hearing that), Aban said to Abu Huraira, "How strange your saying is! You, a guinea pig, descending from Qadum Dan, blaming me for (killing) a person whom Allah favored (with martyrdom) with my hand, and whom He forbade to degrade me with his hand
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
