I was sitting near to him, and he was eating chicken as his lunch, and there was a man sitting amongst the people. Abu Musa invited the man to the lunch, but the latter said, "I saw chickens (eating something (dirty) so I consider them unclean." Abu Musa said, "Come on! I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) eating it (i.e. chicken)." The man said "I have taken an oath that I will not eat (chicken)" Abu Musa said, "Come on! I will tell you about your oath. We, a group of Al-Ash`ariyin people went to the Prophet and asked him to give us something to ride, but the Prophet (ﷺ) refused. Then we asked him for the second time to give us something to ride, but the Prophet (ﷺ) took an oath that he would not give us anything to ride. After a while, some camels of booty were brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he ordered that five camels be given to us. When we took those camels we said, "We have made the Prophet (ﷺ) forget his oath, and we will not be successful after that." So I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Apostle ! You took an oath that you would not give us anything to ride, but you have given us." He said, "Yes, for if I take an oath and later I see a better solution than that, I act on the later (and gave the expiation of that oath)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَخْرَةَ، جَامِعُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ مُحْرِزٍ الْمَازِنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُصَيْنٍ، قَالَ جَاءَتْ بَنُو تَمِيمٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَبْشِرُوا يَا بَنِي تَمِيمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا أَمَّا إِذْ بَشَّرْتَنَا فَأَعْطِنَا‏.‏ فَتَغَيَّرَ وَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَجَاءَ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اقْبَلُوا الْبُشْرَى إِذْ لَمْ يَقْبَلْهَا بَنُو تَمِيمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا قَدْ قَبِلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa aabuw sakhraaa, jaami'u bnu shaddaadin haddathanaa safwaanu bnu muhrizin almaaziniyyu, haddathanaa 'imraanu bnu husaynin, qaala jaa'at banuw tamiymin iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aabshiruwa yaa baniy tamiymin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa aammaa iidh bashhartanaa faaa'tinaa‏.‏ fataghayyara wajhu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fajaa'a naasun min aahli alyamani, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aqbaluwa albushraa iidh lam yaqbalhaa banuw tamiymin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa qad qabilnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:The people of Banu Tamim came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he said, "Be glad (i.e. have good tidings). O Banu Tamim!" They said, "As you have given us good tidings then give us (some material things)." On that the features of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed (i.e. he took it ill). Then some people from Yemen came, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to them) "Accept good tidings as Banu Tamim have not accepted them." They said, "We accept them, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْجُعْفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الإِيمَانُ هَا هُنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى الْيَمَنِ ‏"‏ وَالْجَفَاءُ وَغِلَظُ الْقُلُوبِ فِي الْفَدَّادِينَ، عِنْدَ أُصُولِ أَذْنَابِ الإِبِلِ مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنَا الشَّيْطَانِ رَبِيعَةَ وَمُضَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin alju'fiyyu, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'an qaysi bni aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ aliiymaanu haa hunaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waaashaara biyadihi iilaa alyamani ‏"‏ waaljafaa'u waghilazu alquluwbi fiy alfaddaadiyna, 'inda ausuwli aadhnaabi aliibili min haythu yatlu'u qarnaa alshhaytaani rabiy'aaa wamudara ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Masud:The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned with his hand towards Yemen and said, "Belief is there." The harshness and mercilessness are the qualities of those farmers etc, who are busy with their camels and pay no attention to the religion (is towards the east) from where the side of the head of Satan will appear; those are the tribes of Rabi`a and Mudar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَتَاكُمْ أَهْلُ الْيَمَنِ، هُمْ أَرَقُّ أَفْئِدَةً وَأَلْيَنُ قُلُوبًا، الإِيمَانُ يَمَانٍ وَالْحِكْمَةُ يَمَانِيَةٌ، وَالْفَخْرُ وَالْخُيَلاَءُ فِي أَصْحَابِ الإِبِلِ، وَالسَّكِينَةُ وَالْوَقَارُ فِي أَهْلِ الْغَنَمِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ غُنْدَرٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، سَمِعْتُ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an sulaymaana, 'an dhakwaana, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aataakum aahlu alyamani, hum aaraqqu aafiidaaan waaalyanu quluwbana, aliiymaanu yamaanin waalhikmaau yamaaniyaaun, waalfakhru waalkhuyalaa'u fiy aashaabi aliibili, waalssakiynaau waalwaqaaru fiy aahli alghanami ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala ghundarun 'an shu'baaa, 'an sulaymaana, sami'tu dhakwaana, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people of Yemen have come to you and they are more gentle and soft-hearted. Belief is Yemenite and Wisdom is Yemenite, while pride and haughtiness are the qualities of the owners of camels (i.e. bedouins). Calmness and solemnity are the characters of the owners of sheep
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الإِيمَانُ يَمَانٍ، وَالْفِتْنَةُ هَا هُنَا، هَا هُنَا يَطْلُعُ قَرْنُ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy aakhiy, 'an sulaymaana, 'an thawri bni zaydin, 'an aabiy alghaythi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aliiymaanu yamaanin, waalfitnaau haa hunaa, haa hunaa yatlu'u qarnu alshhaytaani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Belief is Yemenite while afflictions appear from there (the east) from where the side of the head of Satan will appear
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَتَاكُمْ أَهْلُ الْيَمَنِ، أَضْعَفُ قُلُوبًا وَأَرَقُّ أَفْئِدَةً، الْفِقْهُ يَمَانٍ، وَالْحِكْمَةُ يَمَانِيَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aataakum aahlu alyamani, aad'afu quluwbana waaaraqqu aafiidaaan, alfiqhu yamaanin, waalhikmaau yamaaniyaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people of Yemen have come to you, and they are more soft hearted and gentle hearted people. The capacity for understanding religion is Yemenite and Wisdom is Yemenite
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا جُلُوسًا مَعَ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، فَجَاءَ خَبَّابٌ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَيَسْتَطِيعُ هَؤُلاَءِ الشَّبَابُ أَنْ يَقْرَءُوا كَمَا تَقْرَأُ قَالَ أَمَا إِنَّكَ لَوْ شِئْتَ أَمَرْتُ بَعْضَهُمْ يَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ قَالَ أَجَلْ‏.‏ قَالَ اقْرَأْ يَا عَلْقَمَةُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ زَيْدُ بْنُ حُدَيْرٍ أَخُو زِيَادِ بْنِ حُدَيْرٍ أَتَأْمُرُ عَلْقَمَةَ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ وَلَيْسَ بِأَقْرَئِنَا قَالَ أَمَا إِنَّكَ إِنْ شِئْتَ أَخْبَرْتُكَ بِمَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي قَوْمِكَ وَقَوْمِهِ‏.‏ فَقَرَأْتُ خَمْسِينَ آيَةً مِنْ سُورَةِ مَرْيَمَ، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ تَرَى قَالَ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ مَا أَقْرَأُ شَيْئًا إِلاَّ وَهُوَ يَقْرَؤُهُ، ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ إِلَى خَبَّابٍ وَعَلَيْهِ خَاتَمٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَقَالَ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِهَذَا الْخَاتَمِ أَنْ يُلْقَى قَالَ أَمَا إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَرَاهُ عَلَىَّ بَعْدَ الْيَوْمِ، فَأَلْقَاهُ‏.‏ رَوَاهُ غُنْدَرٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, 'an aabiy hamzaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, qaala kunnaa juluwsana ma'a abni mas'uwdin, fajaa'a khabbaabun faqaala yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani, aayastatiy'u hauulaa'i alshhabaabu aan yaqra'uwa kamaa taqraau qaala aamaa iinnaka law shiita aamartu ba'dahum yaqraau 'alayka qaala aajal‏.‏ qaala aqraa yaa 'alqamaau‏.‏ faqaala zaydu bnu hudayrin aakhuw ziyaadi bni hudayrin aataamuru 'alqamaaa aan yaqraaa walaysa biaaqraiinaa qaala aamaa iinnaka iin shiita aakhbartuka bimaa qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy qawmika waqawmihi‏.‏ faqaraatu khamsiyna ayaaan min suwraai maryama, faqaala 'abdu alllahi kayfa taraa qaala qad aahsana‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi maa aaqraau shayiana iilaaa wahuwa yaqrauuhu, thumma altafata iilaa khabbaabin wa'alayhi khaatamun min dhahabin faqaala aalam yaani lihadhaa alkhaatami aan yulqaa qaala aamaa iinnaka lan taraahu 'alaaaa ba'da alyawmi, faaalqaahu‏.‏ rawaahu ghundarun 'an shu'baaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Alqama:We were sitting with Ibn Masud when Khabbab came and said, "O Abu `Abdur-Rahman! Can these young fellows recite Qur'an as you do?" Ibn Mas`ud said, "If you wish I can order one of them to recite (Qur'an) for you ." Khabbab replied, "Yes. "Ibn Mas`ud said, "Recite, O 'Alqama!" On that, Zaid bin Hudair, the brother of Ziyad bin Hudair said, (to Ibn Mas`ud), "Why have you ordered 'Alqama to recite though he does not recite better than we?" Ibn Mas`ud said, "If you like, I would tell you what the Prophet (ﷺ) said about your nation and his (i.e. 'Alqama's) nation." So I recited fifty Verses from Sura-Maryam. `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud) said to Khabbab, "What do you think (about 'Alqama's recitation)?" Khabbab said, "He has recited well." `Abdullah said, "Whatever I recite, 'Alqama recites." Then `Abdullah turned towards Khabbab and saw that he was wearing a gold ring, whereupon he said, "Hasn't the time for its throwing away come yet?" Khabbab said, "You will not see me wearing it after today," and he threw it away
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ جَاءَ الطُّفَيْلُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّ دَوْسًا قَدْ هَلَكَتْ، عَصَتْ وَأَبَتْ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِ دَوْسًا وَأْتِ بِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani abni dhakwaana, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala jaa'a alttufaylu bnu 'amrinw iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala iinna dawsana qad halakat, 'asat waaabat, faad'u alllaha 'alayhim‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma ahdi dawsana waati bihim ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Tufail bin `Amr came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "The Daus (nation) have perished as they disobeyed and refused to accept Islam. So invoke Allah against them." But the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Give guidance to the Daus (tribe) and bring them (to Islam)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ فِي الطَّرِيقِ: يَا لَيْلَةً مِنْ طُولِهَا وَعَنَائِهَا عَلَى أَنَّهَا مِنْ دَارَةِ الْكُفْرِ نَجَّتِ وَأَبَقَ غُلاَمٌ لِي فِي الطَّرِيقِ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَايَعْتُهُ، فَبَيْنَا أَنَا عِنْدَهُ إِذْ طَلَعَ الْغُلاَمُ، فَقَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ هَذَا غُلاَمُكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ هُوَ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى‏.‏ فَأَعْتَقْتُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathaniy muhamaadu bnu al'alaa'i, hadaathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, hadaathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an qaysin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala lamaaa qadimtu 'alaa alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qultu fiy altaariyqi: yaa laylaaan min tuwlihaa wa'anaaiihaa 'alaa aanaahaa min daaraai alkufri najaati waaabaqa ghulaamun liy fiy altaariyqi, falamaaa qadimtu 'alaa alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm fabaaya'tuhu, fabaynaa aanaa 'indahu iidh tala'a alghulaamu, faqaala liy alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa aabaa hurayraaa hadhaa ghulaamuka ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu huwa liwajhi allaahi ta'aalaa‏.‏ faaa'taqtuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:When I came to the Prophet (ﷺ), I said on my way, "O what a long tedious tiresome night; nevertheless, it has rescued me from the place of Heathenism." A slave of mine ran away on the way. When I reached the Prophet (ﷺ) I gave him the oath of allegiance (for Islam), and while I was sitting with him, suddenly the slave appeared. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me. "O Abu Huraira! Here is your slave," I said, "He (i.e. the slave) is (free) for Allah's Sake," and manumitted him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ أَتَيْنَا عُمَرَ فِي وَفْدٍ، فَجَعَلَ يَدْعُو رَجُلاً رَجُلاً وَيُسَمِّيهِمْ فَقُلْتُ أَمَا تَعْرِفُنِي يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَالَ بَلَى، أَسْلَمْتَ إِذْ كَفَرُوا، وَأَقْبَلْتَ إِذْ أَدْبَرُوا، وَوَفَيْتَ إِذْ غَدَرُوا، وَعَرَفْتَ إِذْ أَنْكَرُوا‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَدِيٌّ فَلاَ أُبَالِي إِذًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki, 'an 'amriw bni huraythin, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, qaala aataynaa 'umara fiy wafdin, faja'ala yad'uw rajulaan rajulaan wayusammiyhim faqultu aamaa ta'rifuniy yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna qaala balaa, aaslamta iidh kafaruwa, waaaqbalta iidh aadbaruwa, wawafayta iidh ghadaruwa, wa'arafta iidh aankaruwa‏.‏ faqaala 'adiyyun falaa aubaaliy iidhana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:We came to `Umar in a delegation (during his rule). He started calling the men one by one, calling each by his name. (As he did not call me early) I said to him. "Don't you know me, O chief of the Believers?" He said, "Yes, you embraced Islam when they (i.e. your people) disbelieved; you have come (to the Truth) when they ran away; you fulfilled your promises when they broke theirs; and you recognized it (i.e. the Truth of Islam) when they denied it." On that, `Adi said, "I therefore don't care
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، فَأَهْلَلْنَا بِعُمْرَةٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ هَدْىٌ فَلْيُهْلِلْ بِالْحَجِّ مَعَ الْعُمْرَةِ، ثُمَّ لاَ يَحِلَّ حَتَّى يَحِلَّ مِنْهُمَا جَمِيعًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَدِمْتُ مَعَهُ مَكَّةَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ، وَلَمْ أَطُفْ بِالْبَيْتِ وَلاَ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، فَشَكَوْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ انْقُضِي رَأْسَكِ، وَامْتَشِطِي وَأَهِلِّي بِالْحَجِّ وَدَعِي الْعُمْرَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَفَعَلْتُ فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا الْحَجَّ أَرْسَلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ إِلَى التَّنْعِيمِ فَاعْتَمَرْتُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ مَكَانَ عُمْرَتِكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَطَافَ الَّذِينَ أَهَلُّوا بِالْعُمْرَةِ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، ثُمَّ حَلُّوا، ثُمَّ طَافُوا طَوَافًا آخَرَ بَعْدَ أَنْ رَجَعُوا مِنْ مِنًى، وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ جَمَعُوا الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ فَإِنَّمَا طَافُوا طَوَافًا وَاحِدًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i, faaahlalnaa bi'umraain, thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man kaana ma'ahu hadaun falyuhlil bialhajji ma'a al'umraai, thumma laa yahilla hattaa yahilla minhumaa jamiy'ana ‏"‏‏.‏ faqadimtu ma'ahu makkaaa waaanaa haaiidun, walam aatuf bialbayti walaa bayna alssafaa waalmarwaai, fashakawtu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ anqudiy raasaki, waamtashitiy waaahilliy bialhajji wada'iy al'umraaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fafa'altu falammaa qadaynaa alhajja aarsalaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ma'a 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy bakrin alssiddiyqi iilaa alttan'iymi faa'tamartu faqaala ‏"‏ hadhihi makaana 'umratiki ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat fataafa alladhiyna aahalluwa bial'umraai bialbayti wabayna alssafaa waalmarwaai, thumma halluwa, thumma taafuwa tawaafana akhara ba'da aan raja'uwa min minana, waaammaa alladhiyna jama'uwa alhajja waal'umraaa faiinnamaa taafuwa tawaafana waahidana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:We went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during Hajjat-ul-Wada` and we assumed the Ihram for `Umra. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us, "Whoever has got the Hadi should assume the Ihram for Hajj and `Umra and should not finish his Ihram till he has performed both (`Umra and Hajj)." I arrived at Mecca along with him (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) while I was menstruating, so I did not perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba or between Safa and Marwa. I informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that and he said, "Undo your braids and comb your hair, and then assume the Ihram for Hajj and leave the `Umra." I did so, and when we performed and finished the Hajj, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me to at-Tan`im along with (my brother) `Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, to perform the `Umra. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This `Umra is in lieu of your missed `Umra." Those who had assumed the Ihram for `Umra, performed the Tawaf around the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa, and then finished their Ihram, and on their return from Mina, they performed another Tawaf (around the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa), but those who combined their Hajj and `Umra, performed only one Tawaf (between Safa and Marwa) (for both)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، إِذَا طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ فَقَدْ حَلَّ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ مِنْ أَيْنَ قَالَ هَذَا ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ مِنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَا إِلَى الْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ‏}‏ وَمِنْ أَمْرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَصْحَابَهُ أَنْ يَحِلُّوا فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ إِنَّمَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ بَعْدَ الْمُعَرَّفِ‏.‏ قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَرَاهُ قَبْلُ وَبَعْدُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, qaala haddathaniy 'ataa'un, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, iidhaa taafa bialbayti faqad halla‏.‏ faqultu min aayna qaala hadhaa abnu 'abbaasin qaala min qawli alllahi ta'aalaa ‏{‏thumma mahilluhaa iilaa albayti al'atiyqi‏}‏ wamin aamri alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aashaabahu aan yahilluwa fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i‏.‏ qultu iinnamaa kaana dhalika ba'da almu'arrafi‏.‏ qaala kaana abnu 'abbaasin yaraahu qablu waba'du‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Juraij:`Ata' said, "Ibn `Abbas said, 'If he (i.e. the one intending to perform `Umra) has performed the Tawaf around the Ka`ba, his Ihram is considered to have finished.' I said, 'What proof does Ibn `Abbas has as to this saying?" `Ata' said, "(The proof is taken) from the Statement of Allah:-- "And afterwards they are brought For sacrifice unto Ancient House (Ka`ba at Mecca)" (22.33) and from the order of the Prophet to his companions to finish their Ihram during Hajjat-ul-Wada`." I said (to `Ata'), "That (i.e. finishing the Ihram) was after coming from `Arafat." `Ata' said, "Ibn `Abbas used to allow it before going to `Arafat (after finishing the `Umra) and after coming from it (i.e. after performing the Hajj)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي بَيَانٌ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ طَارِقًا، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَدِمْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْبَطْحَاءِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَحَجَجْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ كَيْفَ أَهْلَلْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ بِإِهْلاَلٍ كَإِهْلاَلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ طُفْ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ ثُمَّ حِلَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَطُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، وَأَتَيْتُ امْرَأَةً مِنْ قَيْسٍ فَفَلَتْ رَأْسِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy bayaanun, haddathanaa alnnadru, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an qaysin, qaala sami'tu taariqana, 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi rda allh 'nh qaala qadimtu 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialbathaa'i faqaala ‏"‏ aahajajta ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ kayfa aahlalta ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka biiihlaalin kaiihlaali rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ tuf bialbayti wabialssafaa waalmarwaai thumma hilla ‏"‏‏.‏ fatuftu bialbayti wabialssafaa waalmarwaai, waaataytu amraaaaan min qaysin fafalat raasiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) at a place called Al-Batha'. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Did you assume the Ihram for Hajj?" I said, "Yes," He said, "How did you express your intention (for performing Hajj)? " I said, "Labbaik (i.e. I am ready) to assume the Ihram with the same intention as that of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." The Prophet said, "Perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa, and then finish your Ihram." So I performed the Tawaf around the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa and then I came to a woman from the tribe of Qais who removed the lice from my head
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ حَفْصَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ أَزْوَاجَهُ أَنْ يَحْلِلْنَ عَامَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، فَقَالَتْ حَفْصَةُ فَمَا يَمْنَعُكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَبَّدْتُ رَأْسِي وَقَلَّدْتُ هَدْيِي، فَلَسْتُ أَحِلُّ حَتَّى أَنْحَرَ هَدْيِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, aakhbaranaa aanasu bnu 'iyaadin, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara, aakhbarahu aanna hafsaaa rda allh 'nha zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aamara aazwaajahu aan yahlilna 'aama hajjaai alwadaa'i, faqaalat hafsaau famaa yamna'uka faqaala ‏ "‏ labbadtu raasiy waqalladtu hadyiy, falastu aahillu hattaa aanhara hadyiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hafsa:(the wife of the Prophet) The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered all his wives to finish their Ihram during the year of Hajjat-ul-Wada`. On that, I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) "What stops you from finishing your Ihram?" He said, "I have matted my hair and garlanded my Hadi. So I will not finish my Ihram unless I have slaughtered my Hadi
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، وَقَالَ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مِنْ خَثْعَمَ اسْتَفْتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ وَالْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ رَدِيفُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ فَرِيضَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ أَدْرَكَتْ أَبِي شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَسْتَوِيَ عَلَى الرَّاحِلَةِ، فَهَلْ يَقْضِي أَنْ أَحُجَّ عَنْهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala haddathaniy shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, waqaala, muhammadu bnu yuwsufa haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu shihaabin, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna amraaaaan, min khath'ama astaftat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i waalfadlu bnu 'abbaasin radiyfu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna fariydaaa alllahi 'alaa 'ibaadihi aadrakat aabiy shaykhana kabiyrana laa yastatiy'u aan yastawiya 'alaa alrraahilaai, fahal yaqdiy aan aahujja 'anhu qaala ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A woman from the tribe of Khath'am asked for the verdict of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (regarding something) during Hajjat-ul-Wada` while Al-Fadl bin `Abbas was the companion-rider behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She asked, "Allah's ordained obligation (i.e. compulsory Hajj) enjoined on His slaves has become due on my old father who cannot sit firmly on the riding animal. Will it be sufficient if I perform the Hajj on his behalf?" He said, "Yes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُرَيْجُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَقْبَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْفَتْحِ وَهْوَ مُرْدِفٌ أُسَامَةَ عَلَى الْقَصْوَاءِ‏.‏ وَمَعَهُ بِلاَلٌ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ حَتَّى أَنَاخَ عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لِعُثْمَانَ ‏ "‏ ائْتِنَا بِالْمِفْتَاحِ ‏"‏، فَجَاءَهُ بِالْمِفْتَاحِ فَفَتَحَ لَهُ الْبَابَ، فَدَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأُسَامَةُ وَبِلاَلٌ وَعُثْمَانُ، ثُمَّ أَغْلَقُوا عَلَيْهِمِ الْبَابَ، فَمَكَثَ نَهَارًا طَوِيلاً ثُمَّ خَرَجَ، وَابْتَدَرَ النَّاسُ الدُّخُولَ، فَسَبَقْتُهُمْ فَوَجَدْتُ بِلاَلاً قَائِمًا مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْبَابِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَيْنَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ صَلَّى بَيْنَ ذَيْنِكَ الْعَمُودَيْنِ الْمُقَدَّمَيْنِ‏.‏ وَكَانَ الْبَيْتُ عَلَى سِتَّةِ أَعْمِدَةٍ سَطْرَيْنِ، صَلَّى بَيْنَ الْعَمُودَيْنِ مِنَ السَّطْرِ الْمُقَدَّمِ، وَجَعَلَ باب الْبَيْتِ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ، وَاسْتَقْبَلَ بِوَجْهِهِ الَّذِي يَسْتَقْبِلُكَ حِينَ تَلِجُ الْبَيْتَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجِدَارِ، قَالَ وَنَسِيتُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَهُ كَمْ صَلَّى وَعِنْدَ الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي صَلَّى فِيهِ مَرْمَرَةٌ حَمْرَاءُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadun, haddathanaa surayju bnu alnnu'maani, haddathanaa fulayhun, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala aaqbala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama alfathi wahwa murdifun ausaamaaa 'alaa alqaswaa'i‏.‏ wama'ahu bilaalun wa'uthmaanu bnu talhaaa hattaa aanaakha 'inda albayti, thumma qaala li'uthmaana ‏ "‏ aitinaa bialmiftaahi ‏"‏, fajaa'ahu bialmiftaahi fafataha lahu albaaba, fadakhala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waausaamaau wabilaalun wa'uthmaanu, thumma aaghlaquwa 'alayhimi albaaba, famakatha nahaarana tawiylaan thumma kharaja, waabtadara alnnaasu alddukhuwla, fasabaqtuhum fawajadtu bilaalaan qaaiimana min waraa'i albaabi faqultu lahu aayna sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala sallaa bayna dhaynika al'amuwdayni almuqaddamayni‏.‏ wakaana albaytu 'alaa sittaai aa'midaain satrayni, sallaa bayna al'amuwdayni mina alssatri almuqaddami, waja'ala bab albayti khalfa zahrihi, waastaqbala biwajhihi alladhiy yastaqbiluka hiyna taliju albayta baynahu wabayna aljidaari, qaala wanasiytu aan aasaalahu kam sallaa wa'inda almakaani alladhiy sallaa fiyhi marmaraaun hamraa'u‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated (Abdullah) bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) arrived (at Mecca) in the year of the Conquest (of Mecca) while Usama was riding behind him on (his she-camel)'. Al-Qaswa.' Bilal and `Uthman bin Talha were accompanying him. When he made his she-camel kneel down near the Ka`ba, he said to `Uthman, "Get us the key (of the Ka`ba). He brought the key to him and opened the gate (of the Ka`ba), for him. The Prophet, Usama, Bilal and `Uthman (bin Talha) entered the Ka`ba and then closed the gate behind them (from inside). The Prophet (ﷺ) stayed there for a long period and then came out. The people rushed to get in, but I went in before them and found Bilal standing behind the gate, and I said to him, "Where did the Prophet (ﷺ) pray?" He said, "He prayed between those two front pillars." The Ka`ba was built on six pillars, arranged in two rows, and he prayed between the two pillars of the front row leaving the gate of the Ka`ba at his back and facing (in prayer) the wall which faces one when one enters the Ka`ba. Between him and that wall (was the distance of about three cubits). But I forgot to ask Bilal about the number of rak`at the Prophet (ﷺ) had prayed. There was a red piece of marble at the place where he (i.e. the Prophet) had offered the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُمَا أَنَّ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتَ حُيَىٍّ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَاضَتْ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَحَابِسَتُنَا هِيَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّهَا قَدْ أَفَاضَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَطَافَتْ بِالْبَيْتِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَلْتَنْفِرْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, haddathaniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, waaabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathumaa aanna safiyyaaa binta huyaaain zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm haadat fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aahaabisatunaa hiya ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu iinnahaa qad aafaadat yaa rasuwla alllahi wataafat bialbayti‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ faltanfir ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Safiya bint Huyai, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) menstruated during Hajjat-ul- Wada` The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Is she going to detain us?" I said to him, "She has already come to Mecca and performed the Tawaf (ul-ifada) around the Ka`ba, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, " Let her then proceed on (to Medina)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كُنَّا نَتَحَدَّثُ بِحَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِنَا، وَلاَ نَدْرِي مَا حَجَّةُ الْوَدَاعِ، فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ الْمَسِيحَ الدَّجَّالَ فَأَطْنَبَ فِي ذِكْرِهِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَعَثَ اللَّهُ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلاَّ أَنْذَرَ أُمَّتَهُ، أَنْذَرَهُ نُوحٌ وَالنَّبِيُّونَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ، وَإِنَّهُ يَخْرُجُ فِيكُمْ، فَمَا خَفِيَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ شَأْنِهِ فَلَيْسَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْكُمْ أَنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَيْسَ عَلَى مَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْكُمْ ثَلاَثًا، إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَيْسَ بِأَعْوَرَ، وَإِنَّهُ أَعْوَرُ عَيْنِ الْيُمْنَى، كَأَنَّ عَيْنَهُ عِنَبَةٌ طَافِيَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ ‏"‏ أَلاَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ دِمَاءَكُمْ وَأَمْوَالَكُمْ، كَحُرْمَةِ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا، فِي بَلَدِكُمْ هَذَا، فِي شَهْرِكُمْ هَذَا، أَلاَ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اشْهَدْ، ثَلاَثًا، وَيْلَكُمْ، أَوْ وَيْحَكُمُ، انْظُرُوا لاَ تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي كُفَّارًا، يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu wahbin, qaala haddathaniy 'umaru bnu muhammadin, aanna aabaahu, haddathahu 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala kunnaa natahaddathu bihajjaai alwadaa'i waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna aazhurinaa, walaa nadriy maa hajjaau alwadaa'i, fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi thumma dhakara almasiyha alddajjaala faaatnaba fiy dhikrihi waqaala ‏"‏ maa ba'atha alllahu min nabiyyin iilaaa aandhara aummatahu, aandharahu nuwhun waalnnabiyyuwna min ba'dihi, waiinnahu yakhruju fiykum, famaa khafiya 'alaykum min shaanihi falaysa yakhfaa 'alaykum aanna rabbakum laysa 'alaa maa yakhfaa 'alaykum thalaathana, iinna rabbakum laysa biaa'wara, waiinnahu aa'waru 'ayni alyumnaa, kaaanna 'aynahu 'inabaaun taafiyaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ ‏"‏ aalaa iinna alllaha harrama 'alaykum dimaa'akum waaamwaalakum, kahurmaai yawmikum hadhaa, fiy baladikum hadhaa, fiy shahrikum hadhaa, aalaa hal ballaghtu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma ashhad, thalaathana, waylakum, aaw wayhakumu, anzuruwa laa tarji'uwa ba'diy kuffaarana, yadribu ba'dukum riqaaba ba'din ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:We were talking about Hajjat-ul-Wada`, while the Prophet (ﷺ) was amongst us. We did not know what Hajjat-ul-Wada` signified. The Prophet (ﷺ) praised Allah and then mentioned Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal and described him extensively, saying, "Allah did not send any prophet but that prophet warned his nation of Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal. Noah and the prophets following him warned (their people) of him. He will appear amongst you (O Muhammad's followers), and if it happens that some of his qualities may be hidden from you, but your Lord's State is clear to you and not hidden from you. The Prophet (ﷺ) said it thrice. Verily, your Lord is not blind in one eye, while he (i.e. Ad-Dajjal) is blind in the right eye which looks like a grape bulging out (of its cluster). No doubt,! Allah has made your blood and your properties sacred to one another like the sanctity of this day of yours, in this town of yours, in this month of yours." The Prophet (ﷺ) added: No doubt! Haven't I conveyed Allah's Message to you? " They replied, "Yes," The Prophet (ﷺ) said thrice, "O Allah! Be witness for it." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Woe to you!" (or said), "May Allah be merciful to you! Do not become infidels after me (i.e. my death) by cutting the necks (throats) of one another
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَرْقَمَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَزَا تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ غَزْوَةً، وَأَنَّهُ حَجَّ بَعْدَ مَا هَاجَرَ حَجَّةً وَاحِدَةً لَمْ يَحُجَّ بَعْدَهَا حَجَّةَ الْوَدَاعِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ وَبِمَكَّةَ أُخْرَى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, qaala haddathaniy zaydu bnu aarqama, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ghazaa tis'a 'ashraaa ghazwaaan, waaannahu hajja ba'da maa haajara hajjaaan waahidaaan lam yahujja ba'dahaa hajjaaa alwadaa'i‏.‏ qaala aabuw iishaaqa wabimakkaaa aukhraa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:The Prophet (ﷺ) fought nineteen Ghazwas and performed only one Hajj after he migrated (to Medina), and did not perform another Hajj after it, and that was Hajj-ul-Wada`,' Abu 'Is-haq said, "He performed when he was in Mecca
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُدْرِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ لِجَرِيرٍ ‏"‏ اسْتَنْصِتِ النَّاسَ ‏"‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي كُفَّارًا، يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'aliyyi bni mudrikin, 'an aabiy zur'aaa bni 'amriw bni jariyrin, 'an jariyrin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i lijariyrin ‏"‏ astansiti alnnaasa ‏"‏ faqaala ‏"‏ laa tarji'uwa ba'diy kuffaarana, yadribu ba'dukum riqaaba ba'din ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jarir:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me during Hajjatul-Wada`. "Ask the people to listen." He then said, "Do not become infidels after me by cutting the necks (throats) of one another
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الزَّمَانُ قَدِ اسْتَدَارَ كَهَيْئَةِ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ، السَّنَةُ اثْنَا عَشَرَ شَهْرًا مِنْهَا أَرْبَعَةٌ حُرُمٌ ثَلاَثَةٌ مُتَوَالِيَاتٌ ذُو الْقَعْدَةِ وَذُو الْحِجَّةِ وَالْمُحَرَّمُ، وَرَجَبُ مُضَرَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ جُمَادَى وَشَعْبَانَ، أَىُّ شَهْرٍ هَذَا ‏"‏ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَسَكَتَ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ بِغَيْرِ اسْمِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ ذُو الْحِجَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَىُّ بَلَدٍ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، فَسَكَتَ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ بِغَيْرِ اسْمِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ الْبَلْدَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَىُّ يَوْمٍ هَذَا ‏"‏ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، فَسَكَتَ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ بِغَيْرِ اسْمِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ دِمَاءَكُمْ وَأَمْوَالَكُمْ ـ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ وَأَعْرَاضَكُمْ ـ عَلَيْكُمْ حَرَامٌ كَحُرْمَةِ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا، فِي بَلَدِكُمْ هَذَا، فِي شَهْرِكُمْ هَذَا وَسَتَلْقَوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ، فَسَيَسْأَلُكُمْ عَنْ أَعْمَالِكُمْ، أَلاَ فَلاَ تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي ضُلاَّلاً، يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ، أَلاَ لِيُبَلِّغِ الشَّاهِدُ الْغَائِبَ، فَلَعَلَّ بَعْضَ مَنْ يُبَلَّغُهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَوْعَى لَهُ مِنْ بَعْضِ مَنْ سَمِعَهُ ـ فَكَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ إِذَا ذَكَرَهُ يَقُولُ صَدَقَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ ـ أَلاَ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an muhammadin, 'ani abni aabiy bakraaa, 'an aabiy bakraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ alzzamaanu qadi astadaara kahayiaai yawma khalaqa alssamawaati waalaarda, alssanaau athnaa 'ashara shahrana minhaa aarba'aaun hurumun thalaathaaun mutawaaliyaatun dhuw alqa'daai wadhuw alhijjaai waalmuharramu, warajabu mudara alladhiy bayna jumaadaa washa'baana, aaaau shahrin hadhaa ‏"‏ qulnaa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏ fasakata hattaa zanannaa aannahu sayusammiyhi bighayri asmihi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aalaysa dhuw alhijjaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qulnaa balaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaaaau baladin hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qulnaa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu, fasakata hattaa zanannaa aannahu sayusammiyhi bighayri asmihi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aalaysa albaldaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qulnaa balaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaaaau yawmin hadhaa ‏"‏ qulnaa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu, fasakata hattaa zanannaa aannahu sayusammiyhi bighayri asmihi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aalaysa yawma alnnahri ‏"‏‏.‏ qulnaa balaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinna dimaa'akum waaamwaalakum qaala muhammadun waaahsibuhu qaala waaa'raadakum 'alaykum haraamun kahurmaai yawmikum hadhaa, fiy baladikum hadhaa, fiy shahrikum hadhaa wasatalqawna rabbakum, fasayasaalukum 'an aa'maalikum, aalaa falaa tarji'uwa ba'diy dulaaalaan, yadribu ba'dukum riqaaba ba'din, aalaa liyuballighi alshhaahidu alghaaiiba, fala'alla ba'da man yuballaghuhu aan yakuwna aaw'aa lahu min ba'di man sami'ahu fakaana muhammadun iidhaa dhakarahu yaquwlu sadaqa muhammadun sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma qaala aalaa hal ballaghtu‏.‏ marratayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Time has taken its original shape which it had when Allah created the Heavens and the Earth. The year is of twelve months, four of which are sacred, and out of these (four) three are in succession, i.e. Dhul-Qa'da, Dhul-Hijja and Al-Muharram, and the fourth is Rajab which is named after the Mudar tribe, between (the month of) Jumaida (ath-thania) and Sha'ban." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Which is this month?" We said, "Allah and His Apostle know better." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) kept quiet so long that we thought that he might name it with another name. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Isn't it the month of Dhul-Hijja?" We replied, "Yes." Then he said, "Which town is this?" "We replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." On that he kept quiet so long that we thought that he might name it with another name. Then he said, "Isn't it the town of Mecca?" We replied, "Yes, " Then he said, "Which day is today?" We replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He kept quiet so long that we thought that he might name it with another name. Then he said, "Isn't it the day of An- Nahr (i.e. sacrifice)?" We replied, "Yes." He said, "So your blood, your properties, (The sub-narrator Muhammad said, 'I think the Prophet (ﷺ) also said: And your honor..) are sacred to one another like the sanctity of this day of yours, in this city of yours, in this month of yours; and surely, you will meet your Lord, and He will ask you about your deeds. Beware! Do not become infidels after me, cutting the throats of one another. It is incumbent on those who are present to convey this message (of mine) to those who are absent. May be that some of those to whom it will be conveyed will understand it better than those who have actually heard it." (The sub-narrator, Muhammad, on remembering that narration, used to say, "Muhammad spoke the truth!") He (i.e. Prophet) then added twice, "No doubt! Haven't I conveyed (Allah's Message) to you?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ أُنَاسًا، مِنَ الْيَهُودِ قَالُوا لَوْ نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ فِينَا لاَتَّخَذْنَا ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ عِيدًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أَيَّةُ آيَةٍ فَقَالُوا ‏{‏الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِي‏}‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ أَىَّ مَكَانٍ أُنْزِلَتْ، أُنْزِلَتْ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاقِفٌ بِعَرَفَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu althhawriyyu, 'an qaysi bni muslimin, 'an taariqi bni shihaabin, aanna aunaasana, mina alyahuwdi qaaluwa law nazalat hadhihi alayaau fiynaa laattakhadhnaa dhalika alyawma 'iydana‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru aayyaau ayaain faqaaluwa ‏{‏alyawma aakmaltu lakum diynakum waaatmamtu 'alaykum ni'matiy‏}‏‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru iinniy laa'lamu aaaaa makaanin aunzilat, aunzilat warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaqifun bi'arafaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Tariq bin Shihab:Some Jews said, "Had this Verse been revealed to us, we would have taken that day as `Id (festival)." `Umar said, "What Verse?" They said:-- "This day I have Perfected your religion for you, Completed My Favor upon you And have chosen for you Islam as your religion" (5.3) `Umar said, "I know the place where it was revealed; It was revealed while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was staying at `Arafat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ، وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِحَجَّةٍ، وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِحَجٍّ وَعُمْرَةٍ، وَأَهَلَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحَجِّ، فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ أَوْ جَمَعَ الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ فَلَمْ يَحِلُّوا حَتَّى يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ وَقَالَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an aabiy alaaswadi, muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni nawfalin 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, faminnaa man aahalla bi'umraain, waminnaa man aahalla bihajjaain, waminnaa man aahalla bihajjin wa'umraain, waaahalla rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialhajji, faaammaa man aahalla bialhajji aaw jama'a alhajja waal'umraaa falam yahilluwa hattaa yawma alnnahri‏.‏ haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa aakhbaranaa maalikun waqaala ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i‏.‏ haddathanaa iismaa'iylu haddathanaa maalikun mithlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:We set out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and some of us assumed the Ihram for `Umra, some assumed it for Hajj, and some assumed it for both Hajj and `Umra. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assumed the Ihram for Hajj. So those who had assumed the Ihram for Hajj or for both Hajj and `Umra, did not finish their Ihram till the day of An-Nahr (i.e. slaughter of sacrifices). Malik also narrated as above, saying, "(We set out) with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in Hajjat-ul-Wada`...)" This hadith also reaches us through another chain
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ سَعْدٍ ـ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ عَادَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ مِنْ وَجَعٍ، أَشْفَيْتُ مِنْهُ عَلَى الْمَوْتِ، فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَلَغَ بِي مِنَ الْوَجَعِ مَا تَرَى، وَأَنَا ذُو مَالٍ وَلاَ يَرِثُنِي إِلاَّ ابْنَةٌ لِي وَاحِدَةٌ أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِثُلُثَىْ مَالِي قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِشَطْرِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَالثُّلُثِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ، إِنَّكَ أَنْ تَذَرَ وَرَثَتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَذَرَهُمْ عَالَةً يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ، وَلَسْتَ تُنْفِقُ نَفَقَةً تَبْتَغِي بِهَا وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ أُجِرْتَ بِهَا، حَتَّى اللُّقْمَةَ تَجْعَلُهَا فِي فِي امْرَأَتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ آأُخَلَّفُ بَعْدَ أَصْحَابِي قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تُخَلَّفَ فَتَعْمَلَ عَمَلاً تَبْتَغِي بِهِ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ ازْدَدْتَ بِهِ دَرَجَةً وَرِفْعَةً، وَلَعَلَّكَ تُخَلَّفُ حَتَّى يَنْتَفِعَ بِكَ أَقْوَامٌ وَيُضَرَّ بِكَ آخَرُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أَمْضِ لأَصْحَابِي هِجْرَتَهُمْ، وَلاَ تَرُدَّهُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ‏.‏ لَكِنِ الْبَائِسُ سَعْدُ ابْنُ خَوْلَةَ رَثَى لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تُوُفِّيَ بِمَكَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu huwa abnu sa'din haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala 'aadaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i min waja'in, aashfaytu minhu 'alaa almawti, faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi balagha biy mina alwaja'i maa taraa, waaanaa dhuw maalin walaa yarithuniy iilaaa abnaaun liy waahidaaun aafaaatasaddaqu bithuluthaa maaliy qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu aafaaatasaddaqu bishatrihi qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu faalthhuluthi qaala ‏"‏ waalthhuluthu kathiyrun, iinnaka aan tadhara warathataka aaghniyaa'a khayrun min aan tadharahum 'aalaaan yatakaffafuwna alnnaasa, walasta tunfiqu nafaqaaan tabtaghiy bihaa wajha alllahi iilaaa aujirta bihaa, hattaa allluqmaaa taj'aluhaa fiy fiy amraaatika ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aaukhallafu ba'da aashaabiy qaala ‏"‏ iinnaka lan tukhallafa fata'mala 'amalaan tabtaghiy bihi wajha alllahi iilaaa azdadta bihi darajaaan warif'aaan, wala'allaka tukhallafu hattaa yantafi'a bika aaqwaamun wayudarra bika akharuwna, alllahumma aamdi laashaabiy hijratahum, walaa taruddahum 'alaa aa'qaabihim‏.‏ lakini albaaiisu sa'du abnu khawlaaa rathaa lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan tuwuffiya bimakkaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) visited me during Hajjat ul-Wada` while I was suffering from a disease which brought me to the verge of death. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My ailment has reached such a (bad) state as you see, and I have much wealth, but I have no-one to inherit from me except my only daughter. Shall I give 2/3 of my property as alms (in charity)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No," I said, "Shall I give half of my property as alms?" He said, "No." I said, "(Shall I give) 1/3 of it? " He replied, " 1/3, and even 1/3 is too much. It is better for you to leave your inheritors wealthy rather than to leave them poor, begging people (for their sustenance); and whatever you spend for Allah's Sake, you will get reward for it even for the morsel of food which you put in your wives mouth." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Should I remain (in Mecca) behind my companions (who are going with you to Medina)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you remain behind, any good deed which you will do for Allah's Sake, will upgrade and elevate you. May be you will live longer so that some people may benefit by you and some other (i.e. infidels) may get harmed by you." The Prophet (ﷺ) then added, "O Allah! Complete the Migration of my companions and do not turn them on their heels. But the poor Sa`d bin Khaula (not the above mentioned Sa`d) (died in Mecca) ." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pitied Sa`d for he died in Mecca
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو ضَمْرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَلَقَ رَأْسَهُ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa aabuw damraaa, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma aakhbarahum aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm halaqa raasahu fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) got his head shaved during Hajjat-ul-Wada
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَلَقَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ وَأُنَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ وَقَصَّرَ بَعْضُهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, aakhbarahu abnu 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm halaqa fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i waaunaasun min aashaabihi waqassara ba'duhum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:During Hajjat-ul-Wada`, the Prophet (ﷺ) and some of his companions got their heads shaved while some of his companions got their head-hair cut short
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، أَقْبَلَ يَسِيرُ عَلَى حِمَارٍ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمٌ بِمِنًى فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ، فَسَارَ الْحِمَارُ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ بَعْضِ الصَّفِّ، ثُمَّ نَزَلَ عَنْهُ، فَصَفَّ مَعَ النَّاسِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, haddathanaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, ‏.‏ waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aakhbarahu aannahu, aaqbala yasiyru 'alaa himaarin, warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimun biminana fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i yusalliy bialnnaasi, fasaara alhimaaru bayna yadaa ba'di alssaffi, thumma nazala 'anhu, fasaffa ma'a alnnaasi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:That he came riding a donkey when Allah's Apostle was standing at Mina during Hajjat-ul-Wada`, leading the people in prayer. The donkey passed in front of a part of the row (of the people offering the prayer). Then he dismounted from it and took his position in the row with the people
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، سُئِلَ أُسَامَةُ وَأَنَا شَاهِدٌ، عَنْ سَيْرِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّتِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْعَنَقَ، فَإِذَا وَجَدَ فَجْوَةً نَصَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an hishaamin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy qaala, suiila ausaamaau waaanaa shaahidun, 'an sayri alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjatihi‏.‏ faqaala al'anaqa, faiidhaa wajada fajwaaan nassa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hisham's father:In my presence, Usama was asked about the speed of the Prophet (ﷺ) during his Hajj. He replied, "It was Al-`Anaq (i.e. moderate easy speed) and if he encountered an open space, he used to increase his speed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْخَطْمِيِّ، أَنَّ أَبَا أَيُّوبَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، صَلَّى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ جَمِيعًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'adiyyi bni thaabitin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni yaziyda alkhatmiyyi, aanna aabaa aayyuwba, aakhbarahu aannahu, sallaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i almaghriba waal'ishaa'a jamiy'ana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Khatmi:That Abu Aiyub informed him that he offered the Maghrib and `Isha' prayers together with the Prophet during Hajjat-ul-Wada
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَرْسَلَنِي أَصْحَابِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَسْأَلُهُ الْحُمْلاَنَ لَهُمْ، إِذْ هُمْ مَعَهُ فِي جَيْشِ الْعُسْرَةِ وَهْىَ غَزْوَةُ تَبُوكَ فَقُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ أَصْحَابِي أَرْسَلُونِي إِلَيْكَ لِتَحْمِلَهُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَى شَىْءٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَوَافَقْتُهُ، وَهْوَ غَضْبَانُ وَلاَ أَشْعُرُ، وَرَجَعْتُ حَزِينًا مِنْ مَنْعِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَمِنْ مَخَافَةِ أَنْ يَكُونَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَدَ فِي نَفْسِهِ عَلَىَّ، فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى أَصْحَابِي فَأَخْبَرْتُهُمُ الَّذِي قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمْ أَلْبَثْ إِلاَّ سُوَيْعَةً إِذْ سَمِعْتُ بِلاَلاً يُنَادِي أَىْ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ‏.‏ فَأَجَبْتُهُ، فَقَالَ أَجِبْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْعُوكَ، فَلَمَّا أَتَيْتُهُ، قَالَ ‏"‏ خُذْ هَذَيْنِ الْقَرِينَيْنِ ـ وَهَذَيْنِ الْقَرِينَيْنِ لِسِتَّةِ أَبْعِرَةٍ ابْتَاعَهُنَّ حِينَئِذٍ مِنْ سَعْدٍ ـ فَانْطَلِقْ بِهِنَّ إِلَى أَصْحَابِكَ فَقُلْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ ـ أَوْ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ يَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ فَارْكَبُوهُنَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ بِهِنَّ، فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ وَلَكِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَدَعُكُمْ حَتَّى يَنْطَلِقَ مَعِي بَعْضُكُمْ إِلَى مَنْ سَمِعَ مَقَالَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ تَظُنُّوا أَنِّي حَدَّثْتُكُمْ شَيْئًا لَمْ يَقُلْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا لِي إِنَّكَ عِنْدَنَا لَمُصَدَّقٌ، وَلَنَفْعَلَنَّ مَا أَحْبَبْتَ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ أَبُو مُوسَى بِنَفَرٍ مِنْهُمْ حَتَّى أَتَوُا الَّذِينَ سَمِعُوا قَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَنْعَهُ إِيَّاهُمْ، ثُمَّ إِعْطَاءَهُمْ بَعْدُ، فَحَدَّثُوهُمْ بِمِثْلِ مَا حَدَّثَهُمْ بِهِ أَبُو مُوسَى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydi bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh qaala aarsalaniy aashaabiy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aasaaluhu alhumlaana lahum, iidh hum ma'ahu fiy jayshi al'usraai wahaa ghazwaau tabuwka faqultu yaa nabiyya alllahi, iinna aashaabiy aarsaluwniy iilayka litahmilahum‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ waalllahi laa aahmilukum 'alaa shaa'in ‏"‏‏.‏ wawaafaqtuhu, wahwa ghadbaanu walaa aash'uru, waraja'tu haziynana min man'i alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, wamin makhaafaai aan yakuwna alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wajada fiy nafsihi 'alaaaa, faraja'tu iilaa aashaabiy faaakhbartuhumu alladhiy qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm, falam aalbath iilaaa suway'aaan iidh sami'tu bilaalaan yunaadiy aaa 'abda alllahi bna qaysin‏.‏ faaajabtuhu, faqaala aajib rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yad'uwka, falammaa aataytuhu, qaala ‏"‏ khudh hadhayni alqariynayni wahadhayni alqariynayni lisittaai aab'iraain abtaa'ahunna hiynaiidhin min sa'din faantaliq bihinna iilaa aashaabika faqul iinna alllaha aaw qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yahmilukum 'alaa hauulaa'i faarkabuwhunna ‏"‏‏.‏ faantalaqtu iilayhim bihinna, faqultu iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yahmilukum 'alaa hauulaa'i walakinniy waalllahi laa aada'ukum hattaa yantaliqa ma'iy ba'dukum iilaa man sami'a maqaalaaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laa tazunnuwa aanniy haddathtukum shayiana lam yaqulhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa liy iinnaka 'indanaa lamusaddaqun, walanaf'alanna maa aahbabta‏.‏ faantalaqa aabuw muwsaa binafarin minhum hattaa aatawua alladhiyna sami'uwa qawla rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm man'ahu iiyyaahum, thumma ii'taa'ahum ba'du, fahaddathuwhum bimithli maa haddathahum bihi aabuw muwsaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:My Companions sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to ask him for some animals to ride on as they were accompanying him in the army of Al-Usra, and that was the Ghazwa (Battle) of Tabuk, I said, "O Allah's Prophet! My companions have sent me to you to provide them with means of transportation." He said, "By Allah! I will not make you ride anything." It happened that when I reached him, he was in an angry mood, and I didn't notice it. So I returned in a sad mood because of the refusal of the Prophet (ﷺ) and for the fear that the Prophet (ﷺ) might have become 'angry with me. So I returned to my companions and informed them of what the Prophet (ﷺ) had said. Only a short while had passed when I heard Bilal calling, "O `Abdullah bin Qais!" I replied to his call. Bilal said, "Respond to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who is calling you." When I went to him (i.e. the Prophet), he said, "Take these two camels tied together and also these two camels tied together,"' referring to six camels he had brought them from Sa`d at that time. The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Take them to your companions and say, 'Allah (or Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ) allows you to ride on these,' so ride on them." So I took those camels to them and said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) allows you to ride on these (camels) but by Allah, I will not leave you till some of you proceed with me to somebody who heard the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Do not think that I narrate to you a thing which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has not said." They said to me, "We consider you truthful, and we will do what you like." The sub-narrator added: So Abu Musa proceeded along with some of them till they came to those who have heard the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wherein he denied them (some animals to ride on) and (his statement) whereby he gave them the same. So these people told them the same information as Abu Musa had told them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ إِلَى تَبُوكَ، وَاسْتَخْلَفَ عَلِيًّا فَقَالَ أَتُخَلِّفُنِي فِي الصِّبْيَانِ وَالنِّسَاءِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلاَ تَرْضَى أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ نَبِيٌّ بَعْدِي ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ سَمِعْتُ مُصْعَبًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an shu'baaa, 'ani alhakami, 'an mus'abi bni sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja iilaa tabuwka, waastakhlafa 'aliyyana faqaala aatukhallifuniy fiy alssibyaani waalnnisaa'i qaala ‏ "‏ aalaa tardaa aan takuwna minniy bimanzilaai haaruwna min muwsaa iilaaa aannahu laysa nabiyyun ba'diy ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala aabuw daawuda haddathanaa shu'baau 'ani alhakami sami'tu mus'abana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out for Tabuk. appointing `Ali as his deputy (in Medina). `Ali said, "Do you want to leave me with the children and women?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Will you not be pleased that you will be to me like Aaron to Moses? But there will be no prophet after me
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 64 — Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءً، يُخْبِرُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَعْلَى بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ غَزَوْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعُسْرَةَ قَالَ كَانَ يَعْلَى يَقُولُ تِلْكَ الْغَزْوَةُ أَوْثَقُ أَعْمَالِي عِنْدِي‏.‏ قَالَ عَطَاءٌ فَقَالَ صَفْوَانُ قَالَ يَعْلَى فَكَانَ لِي أَجِيرٌ فَقَاتَلَ إِنْسَانًا فَعَضَّ أَحَدُهُمَا يَدَ الآخَرِ، قَالَ عَطَاءٌ فَلَقَدْ أَخْبَرَنِي صَفْوَانُ أَيُّهُمَا عَضَّ الآخَرَ فَنَسِيتُهُ، قَالَ فَانْتَزَعَ الْمَعْضُوضُ يَدَهُ مِنْ فِي الْعَاضِّ، فَانْتَزَعَ إِحْدَى ثَنِيَّتَيْهِ، فَأَتَيَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَهْدَرَ ثَنِيَّتَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ عَطَاءٌ وَحَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَفَيَدَعُ يَدَهُ فِي فِيكَ تَقْضَمُهَا، كَأَنَّهَا فِي فِي فَحْلٍ يَقْضَمُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala sami'tu 'ataa'an, yukhbiru qaala aakhbaraniy safwaanu bnu ya'laa bni aumayyaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala ghazawtu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'usraaa qaala kaana ya'laa yaquwlu tilka alghazwaau aawthaqu aa'maaliy 'indiy‏.‏ qaala 'ataa'un faqaala safwaanu qaala ya'laa fakaana liy aajiyrun faqaatala iinsaanana fa'adda aahaduhumaa yada alakhari, qaala 'ataa'un falaqad aakhbaraniy safwaanu aayyuhumaa 'adda alakhara fanasiytuhu, qaala faantaza'a alma'duwdu yadahu min fiy al'aaddi, faantaza'a iihdaa thaniyyatayhi, faaatayaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaahdara thaniyyatahu‏.‏ qaala 'ataa'un wahasibtu aannahu qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aafayada'u yadahu fiy fiyka taqdamuhaa, kaaannahaa fiy fiy fahlin yaqdamuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Safwan bin Ya`la bin Umaiya:that his father said, "I participated in Al-Usra (i.e. Tabuk) along with the Prophet." Ya`la added, "(My participation in) that Ghazwa was the best of my deeds to me." Ya`la said, "I had a laborer who quarrelled with somebody, and one of the two bit the hand of the other (`Ata', the sub-narrator, said, "Safwan told me who bit whom but I forgot it"), and the one who was bitten, pulled his hand out of the mouth of the biter, so one of the incisors of the biter was broken. So we came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he considered the biter's claim as invalid (i.e. the biter did not get a recompense for his broken incisor). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Should he leave his hand in your mouth so that you might snap it as if it were in the mouth of a male camel to snap it?
