verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'ani alhaarithi bni shubaylin, 'an aabiy 'amrinw alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an zaydi bni aarqama, qaala kunnaa natakallamu fiy alssalaaai yukallimu aahadunaa aakhaahu fiy haajatihi hattaa nazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏haafizuwa 'alaa alssalawaati waalssalaaai alwustaa waquwmuwa lillahi qaanitiyna‏}‏ faaumirnaa bialssukuwti‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:We used to speak while in prayer. One of us used to speak to his brother (while in prayer) about his need, till the Verse was revealed:-- "Guard strictly the (five obligatory) prayers, especially the middle (the Best) (`Asr) Prayer and stand before Allah with obedience (and not to speak to others during the prayers)." Then we were ordered not to speak in the prayers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانَ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنْ صَلاَةِ الْخَوْفِ قَالَ يَتَقَدَّمُ الإِمَامُ وَطَائِفَةٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ فَيُصَلِّي بِهِمِ الإِمَامُ رَكْعَةً، وَتَكُونُ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ الْعَدُوِّ لَمْ يُصَلُّوا، فَإِذَا صَلَّوُا الَّذِينَ مَعَهُ رَكْعَةً اسْتَأْخَرُوا مَكَانَ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُصَلُّوا وَلاَ يُسَلِّمُونَ، وَيَتَقَدَّمُ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُصَلُّوا فَيُصَلُّونَ مَعَهُ رَكْعَةً، ثُمَّ يَنْصَرِفُ الإِمَامُ وَقَدْ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فَيَقُومُ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنَ الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ فَيُصَلُّونَ لأَنْفُسِهِمْ رَكْعَةً بَعْدَ أَنْ يَنْصَرِفَ الإِمَامُ، فَيَكُونُ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنَ الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ قَدْ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فَإِنْ كَانَ خَوْفٌ هُوَ أَشَدَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ صَلَّوْا رِجَالاً، قِيَامًا عَلَى أَقْدَامِهِمْ، أَوْ رُكْبَانًا مُسْتَقْبِلِي الْقِبْلَةِ أَوْ غَيْرَ مُسْتَقْبِلِيهَا‏.‏ قَالَ مَالِكٌ قَالَ نَافِعٌ لاَ أُرَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara rda allh 'nhma kaana iidhaa suiila 'an salaaai alkhawfi qaala yataqaddamu aliimaamu wataaiifaaun mina alnnaasi fayusalliy bihimi aliimaamu rak'aaan, watakuwnu taaiifaaun minhum baynahum wabayna al'aduwwi lam yusalluwa, faiidhaa sallawua alladhiyna ma'ahu rak'aaan astaakharuwa makaana alladhiyna lam yusalluwa walaa yusallimuwna, wayataqaddamu alladhiyna lam yusalluwa fayusalluwna ma'ahu rak'aaan, thumma yansarifu aliimaamu waqad sallaa rak'atayni, fayaquwmu kullu waahidin mina alttaaiifatayni fayusalluwna laanfusihim rak'aaan ba'da aan yansarifa aliimaamu, fayakuwnu kullu waahidin mina alttaaiifatayni qad sallaa rak'atayni, faiin kaana khawfun huwa aashadda min dhalika sallawa rijaalaan, qiyaamana 'alaa aaqdaamihim, aaw rukbaanana mustaqbiliy alqiblaai aaw ghayra mustaqbiliyhaa‏.‏ qaala maalikun qaala naafi'un laa auraa 'abda alllahi bna 'umara dhakara dhalika iilaaa 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Whenever `Abdullah bin `Umar was asked about Salat-al-Khauf (i.e. prayer of fear) he said, "The Imam comes forward with a group of people and leads them in a one rak`a prayer while another group from them who has not prayed yet, stay between the praying group and the enemy. When those who are with the Imam have finished their one rak`a, they retreat and take the positions of those who have not prayed but they will not finish their prayers with Taslim. Those who have not prayed, come forward to offer a rak`a with the Imam (while the first group covers them from the enemy). Then the Imam, having offered two rak`at, finishes his prayer. Then each member of the two groups offer the second rak`a alone after the Imam has finished his prayer. Thus each one of the two groups will have offered two rak`at. But if the fear is too great, they can pray standing on their feet or riding on their mounts, facing the Qibla or not." Nafi` added: I do not think that `Abdullah bin `Umar narrated this except from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (See Hadith No. 451, Vol 5 to know exactly "The Fear Prayer)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ الأَسْوَدِ، وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبُ بْنُ الشَّهِيدِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ قُلْتُ لِعُثْمَانَ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ الَّتِي فِي الْبَقَرَةِ ‏{‏وَالَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَاجًا‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏غَيْرَ إِخْرَاجٍ‏}‏ قَدْ نَسَخَتْهَا الأُخْرَى، فَلِمَ تَكْتُبُهَا قَالَ تَدَعُهَا‏.‏ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي لاَ أُغَيِّرُ شَيْئًا مِنْهُ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ حُمَيْدٌ أَوْ نَحْوَ هَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy alaaswadi, haddathanaa humaydu bnu alaaswadi, wayaziydu bnu zuray'in, qaalaa haddathanaa habiybu bnu alshhahiydi, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, qaala qaala abnu alzzubayri qultu li'uthmaana hadhihi alayaau allatiy fiy albaqaraai ‏{‏waalladhiyna yutawaffawna minkum wayadharuwna aazwaajana‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏ghayra iikhraajin‏}‏ qad nasakhathaa alaukhraa, falima taktubuhaa qaala tada'uhaa‏.‏ yaa abna aakhiy laa aughayyiru shayiana minhu min makaanihi‏.‏ qaala humaydun aaw nahwa hadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Az-Zubair:I said to `Uthman, "This Verse which is in Surat-al-Baqara: "Those of you who die and leave widows behind...without turning them out." has been abrogated by another Verse. Why then do you write it (in the Qur'an)?" `Uthman said. "Leave it (where it is), O the son of my brother, for I will not shift anything of it (i.e. the Qur'an) from its original position
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، وَسَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نَحْنُ أَحَقُّ بِالشَّكِّ مِنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ ‏{‏رَبِّ أَرِنِي كَيْفَ تُحْيِي الْمَوْتَى قَالَ أَوَلَمْ تُؤْمِنْ قَالَ بَلَى وَلَكِنْ لِيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِي‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu saalihin, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, wasa'iydin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ nahnu aahaqqu bialshhakki min iibraahiyma iidh qaala ‏{‏rabbi aariniy kayfa tuhyiy almawtaa qaala aawalam tuumin qaala balaa walakin liyatmaiinna qalbiy‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We have more right to be in doubt than Abraham when he said, 'My Lord! Show me how You give life to the dead.' He said, 'Do you not believe?' He said, 'Yes (I believe) but to be stronger in Faith
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،‏.‏ قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ أَخَاهُ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَوْمًا لأَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَ تَرَوْنَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏أَيَوَدُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ تَكُونَ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ‏}‏ قَالُوا اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَغَضِبَ عُمَرُ فَقَالَ قُولُوا نَعْلَمُ أَوْ لاَ نَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فِي نَفْسِي مِنْهَا شَىْءٌ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي قُلْ وَلاَ تَحْقِرْ نَفْسَكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ضُرِبَتْ مَثَلاً لِعَمَلٍ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ أَىُّ عَمَلٍ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ لِعَمَلٍ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ لِرَجُلٍ غَنِيٍّ يَعْمَلُ بِطَاعَةِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، ثُمَّ بَعَثَ اللَّهُ لَهُ الشَّيْطَانَ فَعَمِلَ بِالْمَعَاصِي حَتَّى أَغْرَقَ أَعْمَالَهُ‏.‏ ‏{‏فَصُرْهُنَّ‏}‏ قَطِّعْهُنَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'ani abni jurayjin, sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna aabiy mulaykaaa, yuhaddithu 'ani abni 'abbaasin, ‏.‏ qaala wasami'tu aakhaahu aabaa bakri bna aabiy mulaykaaa, yuhaddithu 'an 'ubaydi bni 'umayrin, qaala qaala 'umaru rda allh 'nh yawmana laashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyma tarawna hadhihi alayaaa nazalat ‏{‏aayawaddu aahadukum aan takuwna lahu jannaaun‏}‏ qaaluwa alllahu aa'lamu‏.‏ faghadiba 'umaru faqaala quwluwa na'lamu aaw laa na'lamu‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'abbaasin fiy nafsiy minhaa shaa'un yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna‏.‏ qaala 'umaru yaa abna aakhiy qul walaa tahqir nafsaka‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin duribat mathalaan li'amalin‏.‏ qaala 'umaru aaaau 'amalin qaala abnu 'abbaasin li'amalin‏.‏ qaala 'umaru lirajulin ghaniyyin ya'malu bitaa'aai alllahi 'azza wajalla, thumma ba'atha alllahu lahu alshhaytaana fa'amila bialma'aasiy hattaa aaghraqa aa'maalahu‏.‏ ‏{‏fasurhunna‏}‏ qatti'hunna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ubaid bin Umair:Once `Umar (bin Al-Khattab) said to the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) "What do you think about this Verse:--"Does any of you wish that he should have a garden?" They replied, "Allah knows best." `Umar became angry and said, "Either say that you know or say that you do not know!" On that Ibn `Abbas said, "O chief of the believers! I have something in my mind to say about it." `Umar said, "O son of my brother! Say, and do not under estimate yourself." Ibn `Abbas said, "This Verse has been set up as an example for deeds." `Umar said, "What kind of deeds?" Ibn `Abbas said, "For deeds." `Umar said, "This is an example for a rich man who does good out of obedience of Allah and then Allah sends him Satan whereupon he commits sins till all his good deeds are lost
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي شَرِيكُ بْنُ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، أَنَّ عَطَاءَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، وَعَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، قَالاَ سَمِعْنَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَيْسَ الْمِسْكِينُ الَّذِي تَرُدُّهُ التَّمْرَةُ وَالتَّمْرَتَانِ وَلاَ اللُّقْمَةُ وَلاَ اللُّقْمَتَانِ‏.‏ إِنَّمَا الْمِسْكِينُ الَّذِي يَتَعَفَّفُ وَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ يَعْنِي قَوْلَهُ ‏{‏لاَ يَسْأَلُونَ النَّاسَ إِلْحَافًا‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy maryama, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala haddathaniy shariyku bnu aabiy namirin, aanna 'ataa'a bna yasaarin, wa'abda alrrahmani bna aabiy 'amraaa alaansaariyya, qaalaa sami'naa aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh yaquwlu qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laysa almiskiynu alladhiy tarudduhu alttamraau waalttamrataani walaa allluqmaau walaa allluqmataani‏.‏ iinnamaa almiskiynu alladhiy yata'affafu waaqra'uwa iin shiitum ya'niy qawlahu ‏{‏laa yasaaluwna alnnaasa iilhaafana‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The poor person is not the one for whom a date or two or a morsel or two (of food is sufficient but the poor person is he who does not (beg or) ask the people (for something) or show his poverty at all. Recite if you wish, (Allah's Statement): "They do not beg of people at all
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ لَمَّا نَزَلَتِ الآيَاتُ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي الرِّبَا قَرَأَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى النَّاسِ، ثُمَّ حَرَّمَ التِّجَارَةَ فِي الْخَمْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathanaa muslimun, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat lammaa nazalati alayaatu min akhiri suwraai albaqaraai fiy alrribaa qaraaahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alnnaasi, thumma harrama alttijaaraaa fiy alkhamri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When the Verses of Surat-al-Baqara regarding usury (i.e. Riba) were revealed, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited them before the people and then he prohibited the trade of alcoholic liquors
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الضُّحَى، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لَمَّا أُنْزِلَتِ الآيَاتُ الأَوَاخِرُ مِنْ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَلاَهُنَّ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَحَرَّمَ التِّجَارَةَ فِي الْخَمْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa bishru bnu khaalidin, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an sulaymaana, sami'tu aabaa aldduhaa, yuhaddithu 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat lammaa aunzilati alayaatu alaawaakhiru min suwraai albaqaraai kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatalaahunna fiy almasjidi, faharrama alttijaaraaa fiy alkhamri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When the last Verses of Surat-al-Baqara were revealed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out and recited them in the Mosque and prohibited the trade of alcoholic liquors
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا أُنْزِلَتِ الآيَاتُ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ قَرَأَهُنَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، وَحَرَّمَ التِّجَارَةَ فِي الْخَمْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat lammaa aunzilati alayaatu min akhiri suwraai albaqaraai qaraaahunna alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy almasjidi, waharrama alttijaaraaa fiy alkhamri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When the last Verses of Surat-al-Baqara were revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) read them in the Mosque and prohibited the trade of alcoholic liquors
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: وَقَالَ لَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، وَالأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا أُنْزِلَتِ الآيَاتُ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَرَأَهُنَّ عَلَيْنَا، ثُمَّ حَرَّمَ التِّجَارَةَ فِي الْخَمْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala lanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa 'an sufyaana, 'an mansuwrin, waalaa'mashi, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat lammaa aunzilati alayaatu min akhiri suwraai albaqaraai qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaraaahunna 'alaynaa, thumma harrama alttijaaraaa fiy alkhamri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When the last Verses of Surat-al-Baqara were revealed, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and recited them before us and then prohibited the trade of alcoholic liquors
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ آخِرُ آيَةٍ نَزَلَتْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم آيَةُ الرِّبَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau bnu 'uqbaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'aasimin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala akhiru ayaain nazalat 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ayaau alrribaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The last Verse (in the Qur'an) revealed to the Prophet (ﷺ) was the Verse dealing with usury (i.e. Riba)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا النُّفَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْكِينٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ الأَصْفَرِ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ أَنَّهَا قَدْ نُسِخَتْ ‏{‏وَإِنْ تُبْدُوا مَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, haddathanaa alnnufayliyyu, haddathanaa miskiynun, 'an shu'baaa, 'an khaalidin alhadhhaa'i, 'an marwaana alaasfari, 'an rajulin, min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa abnu 'umara aannahaa qad nusikhat ‏{‏waiin tubduwa maa fiy aanfusikum aaw tukhfuwhu‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:This Verse:--"Whether you show what is in your minds or conceal it.." (2.284) was abrogated
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ الأَصْفَرِ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ أَحْسِبُهُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ ‏{‏إِنْ تُبْدُوا مَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ‏}‏ قَالَ نَسَخَتْهَا الآيَةُ الَّتِي بَعْدَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa rawhun, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an khaalidin alhadhhaa'i, 'an marwaana alaasfari, 'an rajulin, min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala aahsibuhu abna 'umara ‏{‏iin tubduwa maa fiy aanfusikum aaw tukhfuwhu‏}‏ qaala nasakhathaa alayaau allatiy ba'dahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Marwan Al-Asfar:A man from the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who I think, was Ibn `Umar said, "The Verse:-- "Whether you show what is in your minds or conceal it...." was abrogated by the Verse following it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التُّسْتَرِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ تَلاَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏{‏هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ مِنْهُ آيَاتٌ مُحْكَمَاتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَابِهَاتٌ فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَابَهَ مِنْهُ ابْتِغَاءَ الْفِتْنَةِ وَابْتِغَاءَ تَأْوِيلِهِ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏أُولُو الأَلْبَابِ‏}‏ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَابَهَ مِنْهُ، فَأُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ سَمَّى اللَّهُ، فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu iibraahiyma alttustariyyu, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat talaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hadhihi alayaaa ‏{‏huwa alladhiy aanzala 'alayka alkitaaba minhu ayaatun muhkamaatun hunna aummu alkitaabi waaukharu mutashaabihaatun faaammaa alladhiyna fiy quluwbihim zayghun fayattabi'uwna maa tashaabaha minhu abtighaa'a alfitnaai waabtighaa'a taawiylihi‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏auwluw alaalbaabi‏}‏ qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ faiidhaa raaayta alladhiyna yattabi'uwna maa tashaabaha minhu, faauwlaiika alladhiyna sammaa alllahu, faahdharuwhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited the Verse:-- "It is He who has sent down to you the Book. In it are Verses that are entirely clear, they are the foundation of the Book, others not entirely clear. So as for those in whose hearts there is a deviation (from the Truth ). follow thereof that is not entirely clear seeking affliction and searching for its hidden meanings; but no one knows its hidden meanings but Allah. And those who are firmly grounded in knowledge say: "We believe in it (i.e. in the Qur'an) the whole of it (i.e. its clear and unclear Verses) are from our Lord. And none receive admonition except men of understanding." (3.7) Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If you see those who follow thereof that is not entirely clear, then they are those whom Allah has named [as having deviation (from the Truth)] 'So beware of them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ يُولَدُ إِلاَّ وَالشَّيْطَانُ يَمَسُّهُ حِينَ يُولَدُ، فَيَسْتَهِلُّ صَارِخًا مِنْ مَسِّ الشَّيْطَانِ إِيَّاهُ، إِلاَّ مَرْيَمَ وَابْنَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ وَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏وَإِنِّي أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ maa min mawluwdin yuwladu iilaaa waalshhaytaanu yamassuhu hiyna yuwladu, fayastahillu saarikhana min massi alshhaytaani iiyyaahu, iilaaa maryama waabnahaa ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma yaquwlu aabuw hurayraaa waaqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏waiinniy au'iydhuhaa bika wadhurriyyatahaa mina alshhaytaani alrrajiymi ‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:Abu Huraira said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'No child is born but that, Satan touches it when it is born whereupon it starts crying loudly because of being touched by Satan, except Mary and her son." Abu Huraira then said, "Recite, if you wish: "And I seek Refuge with You (Allah) for her and her offspring from Satan, the outcast
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ يَمِينَ صَبْرٍ لِيَقْتَطِعَ بِهَا مَالَ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ، لَقِيَ اللَّهَ وَهْوَ عَلَيْهِ غَضْبَانُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَصْدِيقَ ذَلِكَ ‏{‏إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلاً أُولَئِكَ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُمْ فِي الآخِرَةِ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَخَلَ الأَشْعَثُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ وَقَالَ مَا يُحَدِّثُكُمْ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قُلْنَا كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏ قَالَ فِيَّ أُنْزِلَتْ كَانَتْ لِي بِئْرٌ فِي أَرْضِ ابْنِ عَمٍّ لِي قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بَيِّنَتُكَ أَوْ يَمِينُهُ ‏"‏ فَقُلْتُ إِذًا يَحْلِفَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينِ صَبْرٍ يَقْتَطِعُ بِهَا مَالَ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ وَهْوَ فِيهَا فَاجِرٌ، لَقِيَ اللَّهَ وَهْوَ عَلَيْهِ غَضْبَانٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man halafa yamiyna sabrin liyaqtati'a bihaa maala amriiin muslimin, laqiya alllaha wahwa 'alayhi ghadbaanu ‏"‏‏.‏ faaanzala alllahu tasdiyqa dhalika ‏{‏iinna alladhiyna yashtaruwna bi'ahdi alllahi waaaymaanihim thamanana qaliylaan auwlaiika laa khalaaqa lahum fiy alakhiraai‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai‏.‏ qaala fadakhala alaash'athu bnu qaysin waqaala maa yuhaddithukum aabuw 'abdi alrrahmani qulnaa kadhaa wakadhaa‏.‏ qaala fiyya aunzilat kaanat liy biirun fiy aardi abni 'ammin liy qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ bayyinatuka aaw yamiynuhu ‏"‏ faqultu iidhana yahlifa yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man halafa 'alaa yamiyni sabrin yaqtati'u bihaa maala amriiin muslimin wahwa fiyhaa faajirun, laqiya alllaha wahwa 'alayhi ghadbaanun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Wail:`Abdullah bin Masud said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever takes an oath when asked to do so, in which he may deprive a Muslim of his property unlawfully, will meet Allah Who will be angry with him.' So Allah revealed in confirmation of this statement:--"Verily! Those who Purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and oaths, they shall have no portion in the Hereafter..." (3.77) Then entered Al-Ash'ath bin Qais and said, "What is Abu `Abdur-Rahman narrating to you?" We replied, 'So-and-so." Al-Ash'ath said, "This Verse was revealed in my connection. I had a well in the land of my cousin (and he denied my, possessing it). On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, 'Either you bring forward a proof or he (i.e. your cousin) takes an oath (to confirm his claim)' I said, 'I am sure he would take a (false) oath, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).' He said, 'If somebody takes an oath when asked to do so through which he may deprive a Muslim of his property (unlawfully) and he is a liar in his oath, he will meet Allah Who will be angry with him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ ـ سَمِعَ هُشَيْمًا، أَخْبَرَنَا الْعَوَّامُ بْنُ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَقَامَ سِلْعَةً فِي السُّوقِ فَحَلَفَ فِيهَا لَقَدْ أَعْطَى بِهَا مَا لَمْ يُعْطَهُ‏.‏ لِيُوقِعَ فِيهَا رَجُلاً مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلاً‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun huwa abnu aabiy haashimin sami'a hushaymana, aakhbaranaa al'awwaamu bnu hawshabin, 'an iibraahiyma bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy aawfaa rda allh 'nhma aanna rajulaan, aaqaama sil'aaan fiy alssuwqi fahalafa fiyhaa laqad aa'taa bihaa maa lam yu'tahu‏.‏ liyuwqi'a fiyhaa rajulaan mina almuslimiyna, fanazalat ‏{‏iinna alladhiyna yashtaruwna bi'ahdi alllahi waaaymaanihim thamanana qaliylaan‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu `Aufa:A man displayed some merchandise in the market and took an oath that he had been offered a certain price for it while in fact he had not, in order to cheat a man from the Muslims. So then was revealed:-- "Verily! Those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَتَيْنِ، كَانَتَا تَخْرِزَانِ فِي بَيْتٍ ـ أَوْ فِي الْحُجْرَةِ ـ فَخَرَجَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا وَقَدْ أُنْفِذَ بِإِشْفًى فِي كَفِّهَا، فَادَّعَتْ عَلَى الأُخْرَى، فَرُفِعَ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ يُعْطَى النَّاسُ بِدَعْوَاهُمْ لَذَهَبَ دِمَاءُ قَوْمٍ وَأَمْوَالُهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ذَكِّرُوهَا بِاللَّهِ وَاقْرَءُوا عَلَيْهَا ‏{‏إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ‏}‏‏.‏ فَذَكَّرُوهَا فَاعْتَرَفَتْ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْيَمِينُ عَلَى الْمُدَّعَى عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyi bni nasrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu daawuda, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, aanna amraaatayni, kaanataa takhrizaani fiy baytin aaw fiy alhujraai fakharajat iihdaahumaa waqad aunfidha biiishfana fiy kaffihaa, faadda'at 'alaa alaukhraa, farufi'a iilaa abni 'abbaasin, faqaala abnu 'abbaasin qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ law yu'taa alnnaasu bida'waahum ladhahaba dimaa'u qawmin waaamwaaluhum ‏"‏‏.‏ dhakkiruwhaa bialllahi waaqra'uwa 'alayhaa ‏{‏iinna alladhiyna yashtaruwna bi'ahdi alllahi‏}‏‏.‏ fadhakkaruwhaa faa'tarafat, faqaala abnu 'abbaasin qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alyamiynu 'alaa almudda'aa 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Abu Mulaika:Two women were stitching shoes in a house or a room. Then one of them came out with an awl driven into her hand, and she sued the other for it. The case was brought before Ibn `Abbas, Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If people were to be given what they claim (without proving their claim) the life and property of the nation would be lost.' Will you remind her (i.e. the defendant), of Allah and recite before her:--"Verily! Those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths..."(3.77) So they reminded her and she confessed. Ibn `Abbas then said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The oath is to be taken by the defendant (in the absence of any proof against him)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سُفْيَانَ، مِنْ فِيهِ إِلَى فِيَّ قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ فِي الْمُدَّةِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ ـ فَبَيْنَا أَنَا بِالشَّأْمِ إِذْ جِيءَ بِكِتَابٍ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى هِرَقْلَ قَالَ وَكَانَ دِحْيَةُ الْكَلْبِيُّ جَاءَ بِهِ فَدَفَعَهُ إِلَى عَظِيمِ بُصْرَى، فَدَفَعَهُ عَظِيمُ بُصْرَى إِلَى ـ هِرَقْلَ ـ قَالَ فَقَالَ هِرَقْلُ هَلْ هَا هُنَا أَحَدٌ مِنْ قَوْمِ هَذَا الرَّجُلِ الَّذِي يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ نَبِيٌّ فَقَالُوا نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَدُعِيتُ فِي نَفَرٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ فَدَخَلْنَا عَلَى هِرَقْلَ، فَأُجْلِسْنَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ أَيُّكُمْ أَقْرَبُ نَسَبًا مِنْ هَذَا الرَّجُلِ الَّذِي يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ نَبِيٌّ فَقَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا‏.‏ فَأَجْلَسُونِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، وَأَجْلَسُوا أَصْحَابِي خَلْفِي، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِتُرْجُمَانِهِ فَقَالَ قُلْ لَهُمْ إِنِّي سَائِلٌ هَذَا عَنْ هَذَا الرَّجُلِ الَّذِي يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ نَبِيٌّ، فَإِنْ كَذَبَنِي فَكَذِّبُوهُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ، لَوْلاَ أَنْ يُؤْثِرُوا عَلَىَّ الْكَذِبَ لَكَذَبْتُ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِتُرْجُمَانِهِ سَلْهُ كَيْفَ حَسَبُهُ فِيكُمْ قَالَ قُلْتُ هُوَ فِينَا ذُو حَسَبٍ‏.‏ قَالَ فَهَلْ كَانَ مِنْ آبَائِهِ مَلِكٌ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَهَلْ كُنْتُمْ تَتَّهِمُونَهُ بِالْكَذِبِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُولَ مَا قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَيَتَّبِعُهُ أَشْرَافُ النَّاسِ أَمْ ضُعَفَاؤُهُمْ قَالَ قُلْتُ بَلْ ضُعَفَاؤُهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ يَزِيدُونَ أَوْ يَنْقُصُونَ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ بَلْ يَزِيدُونَ‏.‏ قَالَ هَلْ يَرْتَدُّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ دِينِهِ، بَعْدَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ فِيهِ، سَخْطَةً لَهُ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَهَلْ قَاتَلْتُمُوهُ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ قِتَالُكُمْ إِيَّاهُ قَالَ قُلْتُ تَكُونُ الْحَرْبُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ سِجَالاً، يُصِيبُ مِنَّا وَنُصِيبُ مِنْهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَهَلْ يَغْدِرُ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ وَنَحْنُ مِنْهُ فِي هَذِهِ الْمُدَّةِ لاَ نَدْرِي مَا هُوَ صَانِعٌ فِيهَا‏.‏ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا أَمْكَنَنِي مِنْ كَلِمَةٍ أُدْخِلُ فِيهَا شَيْئًا غَيْرَ هَذِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَهَلْ قَالَ هَذَا الْقَوْلَ أَحَدٌ قَبْلَهُ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِتُرْجُمَانِهِ قُلْ لَهُ إِنِّي سَأَلْتُكَ عَنْ حَسَبِهِ فِيكُمْ، فَزَعَمْتَ أَنَّهُ فِيكُمْ ذُو حَسَبٍ، وَكَذَلِكَ الرُّسُلُ تُبْعَثُ فِي أَحْسَابِ قَوْمِهَا، وَسَأَلْتُكَ هَلْ كَانَ فِي آبَائِهِ مَلِكٌ فَزَعَمْتَ أَنْ لاَ فَقُلْتُ لَوْ كَانَ مِنْ آبَائِهِ مَلِكٌ قُلْتُ رَجُلٌ يَطْلُبُ مُلْكَ آبَائِهِ، وَسَأَلْتُكَ عَنْ أَتْبَاعِهِ أَضُعَفَاؤُهُمْ أَمْ أَشْرَافُهُمْ فَقُلْتَ بَلْ ضُعَفَاؤُهُمْ، وَهُمْ أَتْبَاعُ الرُّسُلِ، وَسَأَلْتُكَ هَلْ كُنْتُمْ تَتَّهِمُونَهُ بِالْكَذِبِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُولَ مَا قَالَ فَزَعَمْتَ أَنْ لاَ، فَعَرَفْتُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِيَدَعَ الْكَذِبَ عَلَى النَّاسِ ثُمَّ يَذْهَبَ فَيَكْذِبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَسَأَلْتُكَ هَلْ يَرْتَدُّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ دِينِهِ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ فِيهِ سَخْطَةً لَهُ فَزَعَمْتَ أَنْ لاَ، وَكَذَلِكَ الإِيمَانُ إِذَا خَالَطَ بَشَاشَةَ الْقُلُوبِ، وَسَأَلْتُكَ هَلْ يَزِيدُونَ أَمْ يَنْقُصُونَ فَزَعَمْتَ أَنَّهُمْ يَزِيدُونَ، وَكَذَلِكَ الإِيمَانُ حَتَّى يَتِمَّ، وَسَأَلْتُكَ هَلْ قَاتَلْتُمُوهُ فَزَعَمْتَ أَنَّكُمْ قَاتَلْتُمُوهُ فَتَكُونُ الْحَرْبُ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُ سِجَالاً، يَنَالُ مِنْكُمْ وَتَنَالُونَ مِنْهُ، وَكَذَلِكَ الرُّسُلُ تُبْتَلَى، ثُمَّ تَكُونُ لَهُمُ الْعَاقِبَةُ، وَسَأَلْتُكَ هَلْ يَغْدِرُ فَزَعَمْتَ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَغْدِرُ، وَكَذَلِكَ الرُّسُلُ لاَ تَغْدِرُ، وَسَأَلْتُكَ هَلْ قَالَ أَحَدٌ هَذَا الْقَوْلَ قَبْلَهُ فَزَعَمْتَ أَنْ لاَ، فَقُلْتُ لَوْ كَانَ قَالَ هَذَا الْقَوْلَ أَحَدٌ قَبْلَهُ قُلْتُ رَجُلٌ ائْتَمَّ بِقَوْلٍ قِيلَ قَبْلَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ بِمَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَأْمُرُنَا بِالصَّلاَةِ وَالزَّكَاةِ وَالصِّلَةِ وَالْعَفَافِ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنْ يَكُ مَا تَقُولُ فِيهِ حَقًّا فَإِنَّهُ نَبِيٌّ، وَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ خَارِجٌ، وَلَمْ أَكُ أَظُنُّهُ مِنْكُمْ، وَلَوْ أَنِّي أَعْلَمُ أَنِّي أَخْلُصُ إِلَيْهِ لأَحْبَبْتُ لِقَاءَهُ، وَلَوْ كُنْتُ عِنْدَهُ لَغَسَلْتُ عَنْ قَدَمَيْهِ، وَلَيَبْلُغَنَّ مُلْكُهُ مَا تَحْتَ قَدَمَىَّ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِكِتَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَرَأَهُ، فَإِذَا فِيهِ ‏"‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، إِلَى هِرَقْلَ عَظِيمِ الرُّومِ، سَلاَمٌ عَلَى مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الْهُدَى، أَمَّا بَعْدُ، فَإِنِّي أَدْعُوكَ بِدِعَايَةِ الإِسْلاَمِ، أَسْلِمْ تَسْلَمْ، وَأَسْلِمْ يُؤْتِكَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ مَرَّتَيْنِ، فَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ فَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ إِثْمَ الأَرِيسِيِّينَ، وَ‏{‏يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ تَعَالَوْا إِلَى كَلِمَةٍ سَوَاءٍ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَنْ لاَ نَعْبُدَ إِلاَّ اللَّهَ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏اشْهَدُوا بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ‏}‏‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْ قِرَاءَةِ الْكِتَابِ ارْتَفَعَتِ الأَصْوَاتُ عِنْدَهُ، وَكَثُرَ اللَّغَطُ، وَأُمِرَ بِنَا فَأُخْرِجْنَا قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لأَصْحَابِي حِينَ خَرَجْنَا لَقَدْ أَمِرَ أَمْرُ ابْنِ أَبِي كَبْشَةَ، أَنَّهُ لَيَخَافُهُ مَلِكُ بَنِي الأَصْفَرِ فَمَا زِلْتُ مُوقِنًا بِأَمْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ سَيَظْهَرُ حَتَّى أَدْخَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَىَّ الإِسْلاَمَ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ فَدَعَا هِرَقْلُ عُظَمَاءَ الرُّومِ فَجَمَعَهُمْ فِي دَارٍ لَهُ فَقَالَ يَا مَعْشَرَ الرُّومِ، هَلْ لَكُمْ فِي الْفَلاَحِ وَالرَّشَدِ آخِرَ الأَبَدِ، وَأَنْ يَثْبُتَ لَكُمْ مُلْكُكُمْ قَالَ فَحَاصُوا حَيْصَةَ حُمُرِ الْوَحْشِ إِلَى الأَبْوَابِ، فَوَجَدُوهَا قَدْ غُلِقَتْ، فَقَالَ عَلَىَّ بِهِمْ‏.‏ فَدَعَا بِهِمْ فَقَالَ إِنِّي إِنَّمَا اخْتَبَرْتُ شِدَّتَكُمْ عَلَى دِينِكُمْ، فَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ مِنْكُمُ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتُ‏.‏ فَسَجَدُوا لَهُ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an ma'marin, ‏.‏ wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, qaala haddathaniy abnu 'abbaasin, qaala haddathaniy aabuw sufyaana, min fiyhi iilaa fiyya qaala antalaqtu fiy almuddaai allatiy kaanat bayniy wabayna rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fabaynaa aanaa bialshhaami iidh jiy'a bikitaabin mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa hiraqla qaala wakaana dihyaau alkalbiyyu jaa'a bihi fadafa'ahu iilaa 'aziymi busraa, fadafa'ahu 'aziymu busraa iilaa hiraqla qaala faqaala hiraqlu hal haa hunaa aahadun min qawmi hadhaa alrrajuli alladhiy yaz'umu aannahu nabiyyun faqaaluwa na'am‏.‏ qaala fadu'iytu fiy nafarin min qurayshin fadakhalnaa 'alaa hiraqla, faaujlisnaa bayna yadayhi faqaala aayyukum aaqrabu nasabana min hadhaa alrrajuli alladhiy yaz'umu aannahu nabiyyun faqaala aabuw sufyaana faqultu aanaa‏.‏ faaajlasuwniy bayna yadayhi, waaajlasuwa aashaabiy khalfiy, thumma da'aa biturjumaanihi faqaala qul lahum iinniy saaiilun hadhaa 'an hadhaa alrrajuli alladhiy yaz'umu aannahu nabiyyun, faiin kadhabaniy fakadhhibuwhu‏.‏ qaala aabuw sufyaana waaymu alllahi, lawlaa aan yuuthiruwa 'alaaaa alkadhiba lakadhabtu‏.‏ thumma qaala liturjumaanihi salhu kayfa hasabuhu fiykum qaala qultu huwa fiynaa dhuw hasabin‏.‏ qaala fahal kaana min abaaiihi malikun qaala qultu laa‏.‏ qaala fahal kuntum tattahimuwnahu bialkadhibi qabla aan yaquwla maa qaala qultu laa‏.‏ qaala aayattabi'uhu aashraafu alnnaasi aam du'afaauuhum qaala qultu bal du'afaauuhum‏.‏ qaala yaziyduwna aaw yanqusuwna qaala qultu laa bal yaziyduwna‏.‏ qaala hal yartaddu aahadun minhum 'an diynihi, ba'da aan yadkhula fiyhi, sakhtaaan lahu qaala qultu laa‏.‏ qaala fahal qaataltumuwhu qaala qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala fakayfa kaana qitaalukum iiyyaahu qaala qultu takuwnu alharbu baynanaa wabaynahu sijaalaan, yusiybu minnaa wanusiybu minhu‏.‏ qaala fahal yaghdiru qaala qultu laa wanahnu minhu fiy hadhihi almuddaai laa nadriy maa huwa saani'un fiyhaa‏.‏ qaala waalllahi maa aamkananiy min kalimaain audkhilu fiyhaa shayiana ghayra hadhihi‏.‏ qaala fahal qaala hadhaa alqawla aahadun qablahu qultu laa‏.‏ thumma qaala liturjumaanihi qul lahu iinniy saaaltuka 'an hasabihi fiykum, faza'amta aannahu fiykum dhuw hasabin, wakadhalika alrrusulu tub'athu fiy aahsaabi qawmihaa, wasaaaltuka hal kaana fiy abaaiihi malikun faza'amta aan laa faqultu law kaana min abaaiihi malikun qultu rajulun yatlubu mulka abaaiihi, wasaaaltuka 'an aatbaa'ihi aadu'afaauuhum aam aashraafuhum faqulta bal du'afaauuhum, wahum aatbaa'u alrrusuli, wasaaaltuka hal kuntum tattahimuwnahu bialkadhibi qabla aan yaquwla maa qaala faza'amta aan laa, fa'araftu aannahu lam yakun liyada'a alkadhiba 'alaa alnnaasi thumma yadhhaba fayakdhiba 'alaa alllahi, wasaaaltuka hal yartaddu aahadun minhum 'an diynihi ba'da aan yadkhula fiyhi sakhtaaan lahu faza'amta aan laa, wakadhalika aliiymaanu iidhaa khaalata bashaashaaa alquluwbi, wasaaaltuka hal yaziyduwna aam yanqusuwna faza'amta aannahum yaziyduwna, wakadhalika aliiymaanu hattaa yatimma, wasaaaltuka hal qaataltumuwhu faza'amta aannakum qaataltumuwhu fatakuwnu alharbu baynakum wabaynahu sijaalaan, yanaalu minkum watanaaluwna minhu, wakadhalika alrrusulu tubtalaa, thumma takuwnu lahumu al'aaqibaau, wasaaaltuka hal yaghdiru faza'amta aannahu laa yaghdiru, wakadhalika alrrusulu laa taghdiru, wasaaaltuka hal qaala aahadun hadhaa alqawla qablahu faza'amta aan laa, faqultu law kaana qaala hadhaa alqawla aahadun qablahu qultu rajulun aitamma biqawlin qiyla qablahu‏.‏ qaala thumma qaala bima yaamurukum qaala qultu yaamurunaa bialssalaaai waalzzakaaai waalssilaai waal'afaafi‏.‏ qaala iin yaku maa taquwlu fiyhi haqqana faiinnahu nabiyyun, waqad kuntu aa'lamu aannahu khaarijun, walam aaku aazunnuhu minkum, walaw aanniy aa'lamu aanniy aakhlusu iilayhi laahbabtu liqaa'ahu, walaw kuntu 'indahu laghasaltu 'an qadamayhi, walayablughanna mulkuhu maa tahta qadamaaaa‏.‏ qaala thumma da'aa bikitaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaraaahu, faiidhaa fiyhi ‏"‏ bismi alllahi alrrahmani alrrahiymi min muhammadin rasuwli alllahi, iilaa hiraqla 'aziymi alrruwmi, salaamun 'alaa mani attaba'a alhudaa, aammaa ba'du, faiinniy aad'uwka bidi'aayaai aliislaami, aaslim taslam, waaaslim yuutika alllahu aajraka marratayni, faiin tawallayta faiinna 'alayka iithma alaariysiyyiyna, wa‏{‏yaa aahla alkitaabi ta'aalawa iilaa kalimaain sawaa'in baynanaa wabaynakum aan laa na'buda iilaaa alllaha‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏ashhaduwa biaannaa muslimuwna‏}‏‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa faragha min qiraa'aai alkitaabi artafa'ati alaaswaatu 'indahu, wakathura alllaghatu, waaumira binaa faaukhrijnaa qaala faqultu laashaabiy hiyna kharajnaa laqad aamira aamru abni aabiy kabshaaa, aannahu layakhaafuhu maliku baniy alaasfari famaa ziltu muwqinana biaamri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu sayazharu hattaa aadkhala alllahu 'alaaaa aliislaama‏.‏ qaala alzzuhriyyu fada'aa hiraqlu 'uzamaa'a alrruwmi fajama'ahum fiy daarin lahu faqaala yaa ma'shara alrruwmi, hal lakum fiy alfalaahi waalrrashadi akhira alaabadi, waaan yathbuta lakum mulkukum qaala fahaasuwa haysaaa humuri alwahshi iilaa alaabwaabi, fawajaduwhaa qad ghuliqat, faqaala 'alaaaa bihim‏.‏ fada'aa bihim faqaala iinniy iinnamaa akhtabartu shiddatakum 'alaa diynikum, faqad raaaytu minkumu alladhiy aahbabtu‏.‏ fasajaduwa lahu waraduwa 'anhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Abu Sufyan narrated to me personally, saying, "I set out during the Truce that had been concluded between me and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). While I was in Sham, a letter sent by the Prophet (ﷺ) was brought to Heraclius. Dihya Al-Kalbi had brought and given it to the governor of Busra, and the latter forwarded it to Heraclius. Heraclius said, 'Is there anyone from the people of this man who claims to be a prophet?' The people replied, 'Yes.' So I along with some of Quraishi men were called and we entered upon Heraclius, and we were seated in front of him. Then he said, 'Who amongst you is the nearest relative to the man who claims to be a prophet?' So they made me sit in front of him and made my companions sit behind me. Then he called upon his translator and said (to him), 'Tell them (i.e. Abu Sufyan's companions) that I am going to ask him (i.e. Abu Sufyan) regarding that man who claims to be a prophet. So, if he tells me a lie, they should contradict him (instantly).' By Allah, had I not been afraid that my companions would consider me a liar, I would have told lies. Heraclius then said to his translator, 'Ask him: What is his (i.e. the Prophet's) family status amongst you? I said, 'He belongs to a noble family amongst us." Heraclius said, 'Was any of his ancestors a king?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Did you ever accuse him of telling lies before his saying what he has said?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Do the nobles follow him or the poor people?' I said, 'It is the poor who followed him.' He said, 'Is the number of his followers increasing or decreasing?' I said, 'They are increasing.' He said, 'Does anyone renounce his religion (i.e. Islam) after embracing it, being displeased with it?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Did you fight with him?' I replied, 'Yes.' He said, 'How was your fighting with him?' I said, 'The fighting between us was undecided and victory was shared by him and us by turns. He inflicts casualties upon us and we inflict casualties upon him.' He said, 'Did he ever betray?' I said, 'No, but now we are away from him in this truce and we do not know what he will do in it" Abu Sufyan added, "By Allah, I was not able to insert in my speech a word (against him) except that. Heraclius said, 'Did anybody else (amongst you) ever claim the same (i.e. Islam) before him?' I said, 'No.' Then Heraclius told his translator to tell me (i.e. Abu Sufyan), 'I asked you about his family status amongst you, and you told me that he comes from a noble family amongst you. Verily, all Apostles come from the noblest family among their people. Then I asked you whether any of his ancestors was a king, and you denied that. Thereupon I thought that had one of his fore-fathers been a king, I would have said that he (i.e. Muhammad) was seeking to rule the kingdom of his fore-fathers. Then I asked you regarding his followers, whether they were the noble or the poor among the people, and you said that they were only the poor (who follow him). In fact, such are the followers of the Apostles. Then I asked you whether you have ever accused him of telling lies before saying what he said, and your reply was in the negative. Therefore, I took for granted that a man who did not tell a lie about others, could ever tell a lie about Allah. Then I asked you whether anyone of his followers had renounced his religion (i.e. Islam) after embracing it, being displeased with it, and you denied that. And such is Faith when it mixes with the cheerfulness of the hearts. Then I asked you whether his followers were increasing or decreasing. You claimed that they were increasing. That is the way of true faith till it is complete. Then I asked you whether you had ever fought with him, and you claimed that you had fought with him and the battle between you and him was undecided and the victory was shared by you and him in turns; he inflicted casualties upon you and you inflicted casualties upon them. Such is the case with the Apostles; they are put to test and the final victory is for them. Then I asked you whether he had ever betrayed; you claimed that he had never betrayed. Indeed, Apostles never betray. Then I asked you whether anyone had said this statement before him; and you denied that. Thereupon I thought if somebody had said that statement before him, then I would have said that he was but a man copying some sayings said before him." Abu Sufyan said, "Heraclius then asked me, 'What does he order you to do?' I said, 'He orders us (to offer) prayers and (to pay) Zakat and to keep good relationship with the Kith and kin and to be chaste.' Then Heraclius said, 'If whatever you have said, is true, he is really a prophet, and I knew that he ( i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) was going to appear, but I never thought that he would be from amongst you. If I were certain that I can reach him, I would like to meet him and if I were with him, I would wash his feet; and his kingdom will expand (surely to what is under my feet).' Then Heraclius asked for the letter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and read it wherein was written: "In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful. This letter is from Muhammad, Apostle of Allah, to Heraclius, the sovereign of Byzantine........ Peace be upon him who follows the Right Path. Now then, I call you to embrace Islam. Embrace Islam and you will be saved (from Allah's Punishment); embrace Islam, and Allah will give you a double reward, but if you reject this, you will be responsible for the sins of the tillers (i.e. the people of your kingdom) and (Allah's Statement):--"O the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians)! Come to a word common to you and us that we worship None but Allah....bear witness that we are Muslims.' (3.64) When he finished reading the letter, voices grew louder near him and there was a great hue and cry, and we were ordered to go out." Abu Sufyan added, "While coming out, I said to my companions, 'The situation of Ibn Abu Kabsha (i.e. Muhammad) has become strong; even the king of Banu Al-Asfar is afraid of him.' So I continued to believe that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would be victorious, till Allah made me embrace Islam." Az-Zuhri said, "Heraclius then invited all the chiefs of the Byzantines and had them assembled in his house and said, 'O group of Byzantines! Do you wish to have a permanent success and guidance and that your kingdom should remain with you?' (Immediately after hearing that), they rushed towards the gate like onagers, but they found them closed. Heraclius then said, 'Bring them back to me.' So he called them and said, 'I just wanted to test the strength of your adherence to your religion. Now I have observed of you that which I like.' Then the people fell in prostration before him and became pleased with him." (See Hadith No. 6,Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ كَانَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَكْثَرَ أَنْصَارِيٍّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ نَخْلاً، وَكَانَ أَحَبَّ أَمْوَالِهِ إِلَيْهِ بَيْرُحَاءٍ، وَكَانَتْ مُسْتَقْبِلَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْخُلُهَا وَيَشْرَبُ مِنْ مَاءٍ فِيهَا طَيِّبٍ، فَلَمَّا أُنْزِلَتْ ‏{‏لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّى تُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ‏}‏ قَامَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ ‏{‏لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّى تُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ‏}‏ وَإِنَّ أَحَبَّ أَمْوَالِي إِلَىَّ بَيْرُحَاءٍ وَإِنَّهَا صَدَقَةٌ لِلَّهِ، أَرْجُو بِرَّهَا وَذُخْرَهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ، فَضَعْهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ حَيْثُ أَرَاكَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بَخْ، ذَلِكَ مَالٌ رَايِحٌ، ذَلِكَ مَالٌ رَايِحٌ، وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ مَا قُلْتَ، وَإِنِّي أَرَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَهَا فِي الأَقْرَبِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَفْعَلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَسَمَهَا أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فِي أَقَارِبِهِ وَبَنِي عَمِّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ وَرَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ مَالٌ رَابِحٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ ‏"‏ مَالٌ رَايِحٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh yaquwlu kaana aabuw talhaaa aakthara aansaariyyin bialmadiynaai nakhlaan, wakaana aahabba aamwaalihi iilayhi bayruhaa'in, wakaanat mustaqbilaaa almasjidi, wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadkhuluhaa wayashrabu min maa'in fiyhaa tayyibin, falammaa aunzilat ‏{‏lan tanaaluwa albirra hattaa tunfiquwa mimmaa tuhibbuwna‏}‏ qaama aabuw talhaaa faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, iinna alllaha yaquwlu ‏{‏lan tanaaluwa albirra hattaa tunfiquwa mimmaa tuhibbuwna‏}‏ waiinna aahabba aamwaaliy iilaaaa bayruhaa'in waiinnahaa sadaqaaun lillahi, aarjuw birrahaa wadhukhrahaa 'inda alllahi, fada'haa yaa rasuwla alllahi haythu aaraaka alllahu‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ bakh, dhalika maalun raayihun, dhalika maalun raayihun, waqad sami'tu maa qulta, waiinniy aaraa aan taj'alahaa fiy alaaqrabiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw talhaaa aaf'alu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ faqasamahaa aabuw talhaaa fiy aaqaaribihi wabaniy 'ammihi‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa warawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa ‏"‏ dhalika maalun raabihun ‏"‏‏.‏ haddathaniy yahyaa bnu yahyaa qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin ‏"‏ maalun raayihun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Out of all the Ansar, living in Medina, Abu Talha had the largest number of (date palm trees) gardens, and the most beloved of his property to him was Bairuha garden which was standing opposite the Mosque (of the Prophet). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to enter it and drink of its good water. When the Verse was revealed:--"By no means shall you attain righteousness unless you spend (in charity) of that which you love." (3.92) Abu Talha got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Allah says:--"By no means shall you attain righteousness unless you spend (in charity) of that which you love." (3.92) and the most beloved of my property to me is the Bairuha garden, so I give it (as a charitable gift) in Allah's Cause and hope to receive good out of it, and to have it stored for me with Allah. So, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Dispose it of (i.e. utilize it) in the way Allah orders you (to dispose it of)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Bravo! That is a fruitful property! That is a fruitful property! I have heard what you have said and I think that you should distribute that (garden) amongst your relatives." Then Abu Talha distributed that garden amongst his relatives and his cousins. Narrated Yahya bin Yahya: I learnt from Malik, "..a fruitful property
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ فَجَعَلَهَا لِحَسَّانَ وَأُبِيٍّ، وَأَنَا أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ، وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ لِي مِنْهَا شَيْئًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyu, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an thumaamaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala faja'alahaa lihassaana waaubiyyin, waaanaa aaqrabu iilayhi, walam yaj'al liy minhaa shayiana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Abu Talha distributed the garden between Hassan and Ubai, but he did not give me anything thereof although I was a nearer relative to him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو ضَمْرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ، جَاءُوا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ وَامْرَأَةٍ قَدْ زَنَيَا، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ كَيْفَ تَفْعَلُونَ بِمَنْ زَنَى مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا نُحَمِّمُهُمَا وَنَضْرِبُهُمَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَجِدُونَ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ الرَّجْمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لاَ نَجِدُ فِيهَا شَيْئًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ كَذَبْتُمْ ‏{‏فَأْتُوا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ فَاتْلُوهَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ‏}‏ فَوَضَعَ مِدْرَاسُهَا الَّذِي يُدَرِّسُهَا مِنْهُمْ كَفَّهُ عَلَى آيَةِ الرَّجْمِ، فَطَفِقَ يَقْرَأُ مَا دُونَ يَدِهِ وَمَا وَرَاءَهَا، وَلاَ يَقْرَأُ آيَةَ الرَّجْمِ، فَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ عَنْ آيَةِ الرَّجْمِ فَقَالَ مَا هَذِهِ فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا ذَلِكَ قَالُوا هِيَ آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِمَا فَرُجِمَا قَرِيبًا مِنْ حَيْثُ مَوْضِعُ الْجَنَائِزِ عِنْدَ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَرَأَيْتُ صَاحِبَهَا يَجْنَأُ عَلَيْهَا يَقِيهَا الْحِجَارَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa aabuw damraaa, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna alyahuwda, jaa'uwa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm birajulin minhum waamraaaain qad zanayaa, faqaala lahum ‏"‏ kayfa taf'aluwna biman zanaa minkum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa nuhammimuhumaa wanadribuhumaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ laa tajiduwna fiy alttawraaai alrrajma ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa laa najidu fiyhaa shayiana‏.‏ faqaala lahum 'abdu alllahi bnu salaamin kadhabtum ‏{‏faatuwa bialttawraaai faatluwhaa iin kuntum saadiqiyna‏}‏ fawada'a midraasuhaa alladhiy yudarrisuhaa minhum kaffahu 'alaa ayaai alrrajmi, fatafiqa yaqraau maa duwna yadihi wamaa waraa'ahaa, walaa yaqraau ayaaa alrrajmi, fanaza'a yadahu 'an ayaai alrrajmi faqaala maa hadhihi falammaa raaawa dhalika qaaluwa hiya ayaau alrrajmi‏.‏ faaamara bihimaa farujimaa qariybana min haythu mawdi'u aljanaaiizi 'inda almasjidi, faraaaytu saahibahaa yajnaau 'alayhaa yaqiyhaa alhijaaraaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Jews brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) a man and a woman from among them who had committed illegal sexual intercourse. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to them, "How do you usually punish the one amongst you who has committed illegal sexual intercourse?" They replied, "We blacken their faces with coal and beat them," He said, "Don't you find the order of Ar-Rajm (i.e. stoning to death) in the Torah?" They replied, "We do not find anything in it." `Abdullah bin Salam (after hearing this conversation) said to them. "You have told a lie! Bring here the Torah and recite it if you are truthful." (So the Jews brought the Torah). And the religious teacher who was teaching it to them, put his hand over the Verse of Ar- Rajm and started reading what was written above and below the place hidden with his hand, but he did not read the Verse of Ar-Rajm. `Abdullah bin Salam removed his (i.e. the teacher's) hand from the Verse of Ar-Rajm and said, "What is this?" So when the Jews saw that Verse, they said, "This is the Verse of Ar-Rajm." So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered the two adulterers to be stoned to death, and they were stoned to death near the place where biers used to be placed near the Mosque. I saw her companion (i.e. the adulterer) bowing over her so as to protect her from the stones
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَة َ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ ‏{‏كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ‏}‏ قَالَ خَيْرَ النَّاسِ لِلنَّاسِ، تَأْتُونَ بِهِمْ فِي السَّلاَسِلِ فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ حَتَّى يَدْخُلُوا فِي الإِسْلاَمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, 'an sufyaana, 'an maysaraaa, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraa a rda allh 'nh ‏{‏kuntum khayra aummaain aukhrijat lilnnaasi‏}‏ qaala khayra alnnaasi lilnnaasi, taatuwna bihim fiy alssalaasili fiy aa'naaqihim hattaa yadkhuluwa fiy aliislaami‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Verse:--"You (true Muslims) are the best of peoples ever raised up for mankind." means, the best of peoples for the people, as you bring them with chains on their necks till they embrace Islam
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّه ِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ فِينَا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏إِذْ هَمَّتْ طَائِفَتَانِ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ تَفْشَلاَ وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّهُمَا‏}‏ قَالَ نَحْنُ الطَّائِفَتَانِ بَنُو حَارِثَةَ وَبَنُو سَلِمَةَ، وَمَا نُحِبُّ ـ وَقَالَ سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً وَمَا يَسُرُّنِي ـ أَنَّهَا لَمْ تُنْزَلْ لِقَوْلِ اللَّهِ ‏{‏وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّهُمَا‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala qaala 'amrunw sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllah i rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu fiynaa nazalat ‏{‏iidh hammat taaiifataani minkum aan tafshalaa waalllahu waliyyuhumaa‏}‏ qaala nahnu alttaaiifataani banuw haarithaaa wabanuw salimaaa, wamaa nuhibbu waqaala sufyaanu marraaan wamaa yasurruniy aannahaa lam tunzal liqawli alllahi ‏{‏waalllahu waliyyuhumaa‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Verse:--"When two parties from among you were about to lose heart, but Allah was their Protector," (3.122) was revealed concerning us, and we were the two parties, i.e. Banu Haritha and Banu Salama, and we do not wish (that it had not been revealed) or I would not have been pleased (if it had not been revealed), for Allah says:--"...Allah was their Protector
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الآخِرَةِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ فُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا ‏"‏‏.‏ بَعْدَ مَا يَقُولُ ‏"‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الأَمْرِ شَىْءٌ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏فَإِنَّهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ‏}‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hibbaanu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy saalimun, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i fiy alrrak'aai alakhiraai mina alfajri yaquwlu ‏"‏ alllahumma al'an fulaanana wafulaanana wafulaanana ‏"‏‏.‏ ba'da maa yaquwlu ‏"‏ sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu rabbanaa walaka alhamdu ‏"‏‏.‏ faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏laysa laka mina alaamri shaa'un‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏faiinnahum zaalimuwna‏}‏‏.‏ rawaahu iishaaqu bnu raashidin 'ani alzzuhriyyi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salim's father:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on raising his head from the bowing in the last rak`a in the Fajr prayer, saying, "O Allah, curse such-and-such person and such-and-such person, and such-and-such person," after saying, "Allah hears him who sends his praises to Him, O our Lord, all praise is for You." So Allah revealed:--"Not for you (O Muhammad) (but for Allah) is the decision, verily they are indeed wrongdoers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ أَوْ يَدْعُوَ لأَحَدٍ قَنَتَ بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ، فَرُبَّمَا قَالَ إِذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْجِ الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ، وَسَلَمَةَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، وَعَيَّاشَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ، اللَّهُمَّ اشْدُدْ وَطْأَتَكَ عَلَى مُضَرَ وَاجْعَلْهَا سِنِينَ كَسِنِي يُوسُفَ ‏"‏‏.‏ يَجْهَرُ بِذَلِكَ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي بَعْضِ صَلاَتِهِ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ فُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا ‏"‏‏.‏ لأَحْيَاءٍ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ، حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الأَمْرِ شَىْءٌ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, waaabiy, salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa aaraada aan yad'uwa 'alaa aahadin aaw yad'uwa laahadin qanata ba'da alrrukuw'i, farubbamaa qaala iidhaa qaala ‏"‏ sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu, alllahumma rabbanaa laka alhamdu, alllahumma aanji alwaliyda bna alwaliydi, wasalamaaa bna hishaamin, wa'ayyaasha bna aabiy rabiy'aaa, alllahumma ashdud wataataka 'alaa mudara waaj'alhaa siniyna kasiniy yuwsufa ‏"‏‏.‏ yajharu bidhalika wakaana yaquwlu fiy ba'di salaatihi fiy salaaai alfajri ‏"‏ alllahumma al'an fulaanana wafulaanana ‏"‏‏.‏ laahyaa'in mina al'arabi, hattaa aanzala alllahu ‏{‏laysa laka mina alaamri shaa'un‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) intended to invoke evil upon somebody or invoke good upon somebody, he used to invoke (Allah) after bowing (in the prayer). Sometimes after saying, "Allah hears him who sends his praises to Him, all praise is for You, O our Lord," he would say, "O Allah. Save Al-Walid bin Al-Walid and Salama bin Hisham, and `Aiyash bin Abu Rabi`a. O Allah! Inflict Your Severe Torture on Mudar (tribe) and strike them with (famine) years like the years of Joseph." The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say in a loud voice, and he also used to say in some of his Fajr prayers, "O Allah! Curse so-and-so and so-and-so." naming some of the Arab tribes till Allah revealed:--"Not for you (O Muhammad) (but for Allah) is the decision
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الرَّجَّالَةِ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، وَأَقْبَلُوا مُنْهَزِمِينَ، فَذَاكَ إِذْ يَدْعُوهُمُ الرَّسُولُ فِي أُخْرَاهُمْ، وَلَمْ يَبْقَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرُ اثْنَىْ عَشَرَ رَجُلاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma qaala ja'ala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alrrajjaalaai yawma auhudin 'abda alllahi bna jubayrin, waaaqbaluwa munhazimiyna, fadhaaka iidh yad'uwhumu alrrasuwlu fiy aukhraahum, walam yabqa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghayru athnaa 'ashara rajulaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) appointed `Abdullah bin Jubair as the commander of the infantry during the battle of Uhud. They returned defeated, and that is what is meant by:-- "And the Apostle was calling them back in the rear. None remained with the Prophet (ﷺ) then, but twelve men
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَبُو يَعْقُوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، أَنَّ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ، قَالَ غَشِيَنَا النُّعَاسُ وَنَحْنُ فِي مَصَافِّنَا يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ ـ قَالَ ـ فَجَعَلَ سَيْفِي يَسْقُطُ مِنْ يَدِي وَآخُذُهُ، وَيَسْقُطُ وَآخُذُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma bni 'abdi alrrahmani aabuw ya'quwba, haddathanaa husaynu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasun, aanna aabaa talhaaa, qaala ghashiyanaa alnnu'aasu wanahnu fiy masaaffinaa yawma auhudin qaala faja'ala sayfiy yasqutu min yadiy waakhudhuhu, wayasqutu waakhudhuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Talha:Slumber overtook us during the battle of Uhud while we were in the front files. My sword would fall from my hand and I would pick it up, and again it would fall down and I would pick it up again
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ ـ أُرَاهُ قَالَ ـ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، ‏{‏حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ‏}‏ قَالَهَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ حِينَ أُلْقِيَ فِي النَّارِ، وَقَالَهَا مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ قَالُوا ‏{‏إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكُمْ فَاخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَانًا وَقَالُوا حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa auraahu qaala haddathanaa aabuw bakrin, 'an aabiy hasiynin, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, ‏{‏hasbunaa alllahu wani'ma alwakiylu‏}‏ qaalahaa iibraahiymu 'alayhi alssalaamu hiyna aulqiya fiy alnnaari, waqaalahaa muhammadun sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna qaaluwa ‏{‏iinna alnnaasa qad jama'uwa lakum faakhshawhum fazaadahum iiymaanana waqaaluwa hasbunaa alllahu wani'ma alwakiylu‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:'Allah is Sufficient for us and He Is the Best Disposer of affairs," was said by Abraham when he was thrown into the fire; and it was said by Muhammad when they (i.e. hypocrites) said, "A great army is gathering against you, therefore, fear them," but it only increased their faith and they said: "Allah is Sufficient for us, and He is the Best Disposer (of affairs, for us)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ آخِرَ قَوْلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حِينَ أُلْقِيَ فِي النَّارِ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an aabiy hasiynin, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala kaana akhira qawli iibraahiyma hiyna aulqiya fiy alnnaari hasbiya alllahu wani'ma alwakiylu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The last statement of Abraham when he was thrown into the fire was:--"Allah is Sufficient for us and He is the Best Disposer (of affairs for us)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُنِيرٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ ـ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً فَلَمْ يُؤَدِّ زَكَاتَهُ، مُثِّلَ لَهُ مَالُهُ شُجَاعًا أَقْرَعَ، لَهُ زَبِيبَتَانِ يُطَوَّقُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، يَأْخُذُ بِلِهْزِمَتَيْهِ ـ يَعْنِي بِشِدْقَيْهِ ـ يَقُولُ أَنَا مَالُكَ أَنَا كَنْزُكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ تَلاَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏{‏وَلاَ يَحْسِبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ بِمَا آتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muniyrin, sami'a aabaa alnnadri, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani huwa abnu 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man ataahu alllahu maalaan falam yuuaddi zakaatahu, muthhila lahu maaluhu shujaa'ana aaqra'a, lahu zabiybataani yutawwaquhu yawma alqiyaamaai, yaakhudhu bilihzimatayhi ya'niy bishidqayhi yaquwlu aanaa maaluka aanaa kanzuka ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma talaa hadhihi alayaaa ‏{‏walaa yahsibanna alladhiyna yabkhaluwna bimaa ataahumu alllahu min fadlihi‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Anyone whom Allah has given wealth but he does not pay its Zakat, then, on the Day of Resurrection, his wealth will be presented to him in the shape of a bald-headed poisonous male snake with two poisonous glands in its mouth and it will encircle itself round his neck and bite him over his cheeks and say, "I am your wealth; I am your treasure." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited this Divine Verse:-- "And let not those who covetously withhold of that which Allah has bestowed upon them of His Bounty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكِبَ عَلَى حِمَارٍ عَلَى قَطِيفَةٍ فَدَكِيَّةٍ، وَأَرْدَفَ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ وَرَاءَهُ، يَعُودُ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ فِي بَنِي الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ قَبْلَ وَقْعَةِ بَدْرٍ ـ قَالَ ـ حَتَّى مَرَّ بِمَجْلِسٍ فِيهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ، ابْنُ سَلُولَ، وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسْلِمَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ فَإِذَا فِي الْمَجْلِسِ أَخْلاَطٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ عَبَدَةِ الأَوْثَانِ وَالْيَهُودِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَفِي الْمَجْلِسِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَوَاحَةَ، فَلَمَّا غَشِيَتِ الْمَجْلِسَ عَجَاجَةُ الدَّابَّةِ خَمَّرَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ أَنْفَهُ بِرِدَائِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لاَ تُغَبِّرُوا عَلَيْنَا‏.‏ فَسَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ وَقَفَ فَنَزَلَ فَدَعَاهُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ، وَقَرَأَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنَ، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ ابْنُ سَلُولَ أَيُّهَا الْمَرْءُ، إِنَّهُ لاَ أَحْسَنَ مِمَّا تَقُولُ، إِنْ كَانَ حَقًّا، فَلاَ تُؤْذِينَا بِهِ فِي مَجْلِسِنَا، ارْجِعْ إِلَى رَحْلِكَ، فَمَنْ جَاءَكَ فَاقْصُصْ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَوَاحَةَ بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَاغْشَنَا بِهِ فِي مَجَالِسِنَا، فَإِنَّا نُحِبُّ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَاسْتَبَّ الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَالْمُشْرِكُونَ وَالْيَهُودُ حَتَّى كَادُوا يَتَثَاوَرُونَ، فَلَمْ يَزَلِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُخَفِّضُهُمْ حَتَّى سَكَنُوا، ثُمَّ رَكِبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَابَّتَهُ فَسَارَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ عَلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا سَعْدُ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ مَا قَالَ أَبُو حُبَابٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُرِيدُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أُبَىٍّ ‏"‏ قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، اعْفُ عَنْهُ وَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُ، فَوَالَّذِي أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ، لَقَدْ جَاءَ اللَّهُ بِالْحَقِّ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكَ، لَقَدِ اصْطَلَحَ أَهْلُ هَذِهِ الْبُحَيْرَةِ عَلَى أَنْ يُتَوِّجُوهُ فَيُعَصِّبُونَهُ بِالْعِصَابَةِ، فَلَمَّا أَبَى اللَّهُ ذَلِكَ بِالْحَقِّ الَّذِي أَعْطَاكَ اللَّهُ شَرِقَ بِذَلِكَ، فَذَلِكَ فَعَلَ بِهِ ما رَأَيْتَ‏.‏ فَعَفَا عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابُهُ يَعْفُونَ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَأَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ كَمَا أَمَرَهُمُ اللَّهُ، وَيَصْبِرُونَ عَلَى الأَذَى قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏وَلَتَسْمَعُنَّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا أَذًى كَثِيرًا ‏}‏ الآيَةَ، وَقَالَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏وَدَّ كَثِيرٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَوْ يَرُدُّونَكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ إِيمَانِكُمْ كُفَّارًا حَسَدًا مِنْ عِنْدِ أَنْفُسِهِمْ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَأَوَّلُ الْعَفْوَ مَا أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ بِهِ، حَتَّى أَذِنَ اللَّهُ فِيهِمْ، فَلَمَّا غَزَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَدْرًا، فَقَتَلَ اللَّهُ بِهِ صَنَادِيدَ كُفَّارِ قُرَيْشٍ قَالَ ابْنُ أُبَىٍّ ابْنُ سَلُولَ، وَمَنْ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، وَعَبَدَةِ الأَوْثَانِ هَذَا أَمْرٌ قَدْ تَوَجَّهَ‏.‏ فَبَايَعُوا الرَّسُولَ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ فَأَسْلَمُوا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna ausaamaaa bna zaydin rda allh 'nhma aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakiba 'alaa himaarin 'alaa qatiyfaain fadakiyyaain, waaardafa ausaamaaa bna zaydin waraa'ahu, ya'uwdu sa'da bna 'ubaadaaa fiy baniy alhaarithi bni alkhazraji qabla waq'aai badrin qaala hattaa marra bimajlisin fiyhi 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain, abnu saluwla, wadhalika qabla aan yuslima 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain faiidhaa fiy almajlisi aakhlaatun mina almuslimiyna waalmushrikiyna 'abadaai alaawthaani waalyahuwdi waalmuslimiyna, wafiy almajlisi 'abdu alllahi bnu rawaahaaa, falammaa ghashiyati almajlisa 'ajaajaau alddaabbaai khammara 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain aanfahu biridaaiihi, thumma qaala laa tughabbiruwa 'alaynaa‏.‏ fasallama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alayhim thumma waqafa fanazala fada'aahum iilaa alllahi, waqaraaa 'alayhimu alqurana, faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain abnu saluwla aayyuhaa almar'u, iinnahu laa aahsana mimmaa taquwlu, iin kaana haqqana, falaa tuudhiynaa bihi fiy majlisinaa, arji' iilaa rahlika, faman jaa'aka faaqsus 'alayhi‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu rawaahaaa balaa yaa rasuwla alllahi, faaghshanaa bihi fiy majaalisinaa, faiinnaa nuhibbu dhalika‏.‏ faastabba almuslimuwna waalmushrikuwna waalyahuwdu hattaa kaaduwa yatathaawaruwna, falam yazali alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yukhaffiduhum hattaa sakanuwa, thumma rakiba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm daabbatahu fasaara hattaa dakhala 'alaa sa'di bni 'ubaadaaa, faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa sa'du aalam tasma' maa qaala aabuw hubaabin ‏"‏‏.‏ yuriydu 'abda alllahi bna aubaaain ‏"‏ qaala kadhaa wakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala sa'du bnu 'ubaadaaa yaa rasuwla alllahi, a'fu 'anhu waasfah 'anhu, fawaalladhiy aanzala 'alayka alkitaaba, laqad jaa'a alllahu bialhaqqi alladhiy aanzala 'alayka, laqadi astalaha aahlu hadhihi albuhayraai 'alaa aan yutawwijuwhu fayu'assibuwnahu bial'isaabaai, falammaa aabaa alllahu dhalika bialhaqqi alladhiy aa'taaka alllahu shariqa bidhalika, fadhalika fa'ala bihi ma raaayta‏.‏ fa'afaa 'anhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waaashaabuhu ya'fuwna 'ani almushrikiyna waaahli alkitaabi kamaa aamarahumu alllahu, wayasbiruwna 'alaa alaadhaa qaala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏walatasma'unna mina alladhiyna auwtuwa alkitaaba min qablikum wamina alladhiyna aashrakuwa aadhana kathiyrana ‏}‏ alayaaa, waqaala alllahu ‏{‏wadda kathiyrun min aahli alkitaabi law yarudduwnakum min ba'di iiymaanikum kuffaarana hasadana min 'indi aanfusihim‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai, wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yataaawwalu al'afwa maa aamarahu alllahu bihi, hattaa aadhina alllahu fiyhim, falammaa ghazaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm badrana, faqatala alllahu bihi sanaadiyda kuffaari qurayshin qaala abnu aubaaain abnu saluwla, waman ma'ahu mina almushrikiyna, wa'abadaai alaawthaani hadhaa aamrun qad tawajjaha‏.‏ fabaaya'uwa alrrasuwla sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa aliislaami faaaslamuwa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a donkey, equipped with a thick cloth-covering made in Fadak and I was riding behind him. He was going to pay visit to Sa`d bin Ubada in Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj; and this incident happened before the battle of Badr. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a gathering in which `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul was present, and that was before `Abdullah bin Ubai embraced Islam. Behold in that gathering there were people of different religions: there were Muslims, pagans, idol-worshippers and Jews, and in that gathering `Abdullah bin Rawaha was also present. When a cloud of dust raised by the donkey reached that gathering, `Abdullah bin Ubai covered his nose with his garment and then said, "Do not cover us with dust." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) greeted them and stopped and dismounted and invited them to Allah (i.e. to embrace Islam) and recited to them the Holy Qur'an. On that, `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul said, "O man ! There is nothing better than that what you say. If it is the truth, then do not trouble us with it in our gatherings. Return to your mount (or residence) and if somebody comes to you, relate (your tales) to him." On that `Abdullah bin Rawaha said, "Yes, O Allah's Apostle! Bring it (i.e. what you want to say) to us in our gathering, for we love that." So the Muslims, the pagans and the Jews started abusing one another till they were on the point of fighting with one another. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on quietening them till they became quiet, whereupon the Prophet rode his animal (mount) and proceeded till he entered upon Sa`d bin Ubada. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Sa`d, "Did you not hear what 'Abu Hubab said?" He meant `Abdullah bin Ubai. "He said so-and-so." On that Sa`d bin Ubada said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Excuse and forgive him, for by Him Who revealed the Book to you, Allah brought the Truth which was sent to you at the time when the people of this town (i.e. Medina) had decided unanimously to crown him and tie a turban on his head (electing him as chief). But when Allah opposed that (decision) through the Truth which Allah gave to you, he (i.e. `Abdullah bin Ubai) was grieved with jealousy, and that caused him to do what you have seen." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) excused him, for the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions used to forgive the pagans and the people of Scripture as Allah had ordered them, and they used to put up with their mischief with patience. Allah said: "And you shall certainly hear much that will grieve you from those who received the Scripture before you and from the pagans........'(3.186) And Allah also said:--"Many of the people of the Scripture wish if they could turn you away as disbelievers after you have believed, from selfish envy.."
