(2.109) So the Prophet (ﷺ) used to stick to the principle of forgiveness for them as long as Allah ordered him to do so till Allah permitted fighting them. So when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fought the battle of Badr and Allah killed the nobles of Quraish infidels through him, Ibn Ubai bin Salul and the pagans and idolaters who were with him, said, "This matter (i.e. Islam) has appeared (i.e. became victorious)." So they gave the pledge of allegiance (for embracing Islam) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and became Muslims
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رِجَالاً مِنَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْغَزْوِ تَخَلَّفُوا عَنْهُ، وَفَرِحُوا بِمَقْعَدِهِمْ خِلاَفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِذَا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اعْتَذَرُوا إِلَيْهِ وَحَلَفُوا، وَأَحَبُّوا أَنْ يُحْمَدُوا بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا، فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏لاَ يَحْسِبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْرَحُونَ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala haddathaniy zaydu bnu aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh aanna rijaalaan mina almunaafiqiyna 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa alghazwi takhallafuwa 'anhu, wafarihuwa bimaq'adihim khilaafa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faiidhaa qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm a'tadharuwa iilayhi wahalafuwa, waaahabbuwa aan yuhmaduwa bimaa lam yaf'aluwa, fanazalat ‏{‏laa yahsibanna alladhiyna yafrahuwna‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), some men among the hypocrites used to remain behind him (i.e. did not accompany him) when he went out for a Ghazwa and they would be pleased to stay at home behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned (from the battle) they would put forward (false) excuses and take oaths, wishing to be praised for what they had not done. So there was revealed:-- "Think not that those who rejoice in what they have done, and love to be praised for what they have not done
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنَ وَقَّاصٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ قَالَ لِبَوَّابِهِ اذْهَبْ يَا رَافِعُ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْ لَئِنْ كَانَ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ فَرِحَ بِمَا أُوتِيَ، وَأَحَبَّ أَنْ يُحْمَدَ بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلْ، مُعَذَّبًا، لَنُعَذَّبَنَّ أَجْمَعُونَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَمَا لَكُمْ وَلِهَذِهِ إِنَّمَا دَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَهُودَ فَسَأَلَهُمْ عَنْ شَىْءٍ، فَكَتَمُوهُ إِيَّاهُ، وَأَخْبَرُوهُ بِغَيْرِهِ، فَأَرَوْهُ أَنْ قَدِ اسْتَحْمَدُوا إِلَيْهِ بِمَا أَخْبَرُوهُ عَنْهُ فِيمَا سَأَلَهُمْ، وَفَرِحُوا بِمَا أُوتُوا مِنْ كِتْمَانِهِمْ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏{‏وَإِذْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ‏}‏ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَا أَتَوْا وَيُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يُحْمَدُوا بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا‏}‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, aanaa abna jurayjin, aakhbarahum 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, aanaa 'alqamaaa bna waqaaasin, aakhbarahu aanaa marwaana qaala libawaaabihi adhhab yaa raafi'u iilaa abni 'abaaasin faqul laiin kaana kuluu amriiin fariha bimaa auwtiya, waaahabaa aan yuhmada bimaa lam yaf'al, mu'adhaabana, lanu'adhaabanaa aajma'uwna‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'abaaasin wamaa lakum walihadhihi iinaamaa da'aa alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm yahuwda fasaaalahum 'an shaa'in, fakatamuwhu iiyaaahu, waaakhbaruwhu bighayrihi, faaarawhu aan qadi astahmaduwa iilayhi bimaa aakhbaruwhu 'anhu fiymaa saaalahum, wafarihuwa bimaa auwtuwa min kitmaanihim, thumaa qaraaa abnu 'abaaasin ‏{‏waiidh aakhadha allaahu miythaaqa alaadhiyna auwtuwa alkitaaba‏}‏ kadhalika hataaa qawlihi ‏{‏yafrahuwna bimaa aatawa wayuhibuuwna aan yuhmaduwa bimaa lam yaf'aluwa‏}‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'abdu alraazaaaqi 'ani abni jurayjin‏.‏ hadaathanaa abnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa alhajaaaju, 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy abnu aabiy mulaykaaa, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alraahmani bni 'awfin, aanaahu aakhbarahu aanaa marwaana bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Alqama bin Waqqas:Marwan said to his gatekeeper, "Go to Ibn `Abbas, O Rafi`, and say, 'If everybody who rejoices in what he has done, and likes to be praised for what he has not done, will be punished, then all of us will be punished." Ibn `Abbas said, "What connection have you with this case? It was only that the Prophet (ﷺ) called the Jews and asked them about something, and they hid the truth and told him something else, and showed him that they deserved praise for the favor of telling him the answer to his question, and they became happy with what they had concealed. Then Ibn `Abbas recited:-- "(And remember) when Allah took a Covenant from those who were given the Scripture..and those who rejoice in what they have done and love to be praised for what they have not done.' " (3.187-188) Humaid bin `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf narrated that Marwan had told him (the above narration)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بِتُّ عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ، فَتَحَدَّثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ أَهْلِهِ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ رَقَدَ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرُ قَعَدَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَقَالَ ‏{‏إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ ��للَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لآيَاتٍ لأُولِي الأَلْبَابِ‏}‏، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَتَوَضَّأَ وَاسْتَنَّ، فَصَلَّى إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ بِلاَلٌ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala aakhbaraniy shariyku bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy namirin, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala bittu 'inda khaalatiy maymuwnaaa, fatahaddatha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ma'a aahlihi saa'aaan thumma raqada, falammaa kaana thuluthu alllayli alakhiru qa'ada fanazara iilaa alssamaa'i faqaala ‏{‏iinna fiy khalqi alssamawaati waalaardi waakhtilaafi ��lllayli waalnnahaari layaatin lauwliy alaalbaabi‏}‏, thumma qaama fatawaddaaa waastanna, fasallaa iihdaa 'ashraaa rak'aaan, thumma aadhhana bilaalun fasallaa rak'atayni, thumma kharaja fasallaa alssubha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I stayed overnight in the house of my aunt Maimuna. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) talked with his wife for a while and then went to bed. When it was the last third of the night, he got up and looked towards the sky and said: "Verily! In the creation of the Heavens and the Earth and in the alteration of night and day, there are indeed signs for men of understanding." (3.190) Then he stood up, performed ablution, brushed his teeth with a Siwak, and then prayed eleven rak`at. Then Bilal pronounced the Adhan (i.e. call for the Fajr prayer). The Prophet (ﷺ) then offered two rak`at (Sunna) prayer and went out (to the Mosque) and offered the (compulsory congregational) Fajr prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بِتُّ عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ فَقُلْتُ لأَنْظُرَنَّ إِلَى صَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَطُرِحَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وِسَادَةٌ، فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طُولِهَا، فَجَعَلَ يَمْسَحُ النَّوْمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ الآيَاتِ الْعَشْرَ الأَوَاخِرَ مِنْ آلِ عِمْرَانَ حَتَّى خَتَمَ، ثُمَّ أَتَى شَنًّا مُعَلَّقًا، فَأَخَذَهُ فَتَوَضَّأَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي، فَقُمْتُ فَصَنَعْتُ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعَ ثُمَّ جِئْتُ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِي، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي، فَجَعَلَ يَفْتِلُهَا، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَوْتَرَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, 'an makhramaaa bni sulaymaana, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala bittu 'inda khaalatiy maymuwnaaa faqultu laanzuranna iilaa salaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faturihat lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wisaadaaun, fanaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy tuwlihaa, faja'ala yamsahu alnnawma 'an wajhihi, thumma qaraaa alayaati al'ashra alaawaakhira min ali 'imraana hattaa khatama, thumma aataa shannana mu'allaqana, faaakhadhahu fatawaddaaa, thumma qaama yusalliy, faqumtu fasana'tu mithla maa sana'a thumma jiitu faqumtu iilaa janbihi, fawada'a yadahu 'alaa raasiy, thumma aakhadha biaudhuniy, faja'ala yaftiluhaa, thumma sallaa rak'atayni, thumma sallaa rak'atayni, thumma sallaa rak'atayni, thumma sallaa rak'atayni, thumma sallaa rak'atayni, thumma sallaa rak'atayni, thumma aawtara‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(One night) I stayed overnight in the house of my aunt Maimuna, and said to myself, "I will watch the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) " My aunt placed a cushion for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he slept on it in its length-wise direction and (woke-up) rubbing the traces of sleep off his face and then he recited the last ten Verses of Surat-al-`Imran till he finished it. Then he went to a hanging water skin and took it, performed the ablution and then stood up to offer the prayer. I got up and did the same as he had done, and stood beside him. He put his hand on my head and held me by the ear and twisted it. He offered two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, and finally the witr (i.e. one rak`a) prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، بَاتَ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْىَ خَالَتُهُ قَالَ فَاضْطَجَعْتُ فِي عَرْضِ الْوِسَادَةِ، وَاضْطَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَهْلُهُ فِي طُولِهَا، فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى انْتَصَفَ اللَّيْلُ، أَوْ قَبْلَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ، أَوْ بَعْدَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ، ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَعَلَ يَمْسَحُ النَّوْمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ بِيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ الْعَشْرَ الآيَاتِ الْخَوَاتِمَ مِنْ سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى شَنٍّ مُعَلَّقَةٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْهَا، فَأَحْسَنَ وُضُوءَهُ، ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي، فَصَنَعْتُ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعَ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبْتُ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى رَأْسِي، وَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي بِيَدِهِ الْيُمْنَى يَفْتِلُهَا، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَوْتَرَ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى جَاءَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ، فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa ma'nu bnu 'iysaa, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an makhramaaa bni sulaymaana, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin, aakhbarahu aannahu, baata 'inda maymuwnaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaa khaalatuhu qaala faadtaja'tu fiy 'ardi alwisaadaai, waadtaja'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaahluhu fiy tuwlihaa, fanaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa antasafa alllaylu, aaw qablahu biqaliylin, aaw ba'dahu biqaliylin, thumma astayqaza rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faja'ala yamsahu alnnawma 'an wajhihi biyadayhi, thumma qaraaa al'ashra alayaati alkhawaatima min suwraai ali 'imraana, thumma qaama iilaa shannin mu'allaqaain fatawaddaaa minhaa, faaahsana wuduw'ahu, thumma qaama yusalliy, fasana'tu mithla maa sana'a, thumma dhahabtu faqumtu iilaa janbihi, fawada'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadahu alyumnaa 'alaa raasiy, waaakhadha biaudhuniy biyadihi alyumnaa yaftiluhaa, fasallaa rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma aawtara, thumma adtaja'a hattaa jaa'ahu almuuadhhinu, faqaama fasallaa rak'atayni khafiyfatayni, thumma kharaja fasallaa alssubha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:That once he stayed overnight (in the house) of his aunt Maimuna. the wife of the Prophet. He added: I lay on the cushion transversely and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lay along with his wife in the lengthwise direction of the pillow. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept till the middle of the night, either a bit before or a bit after it, and then woke up rubbing the traces of sleep off his face with his hands and then he recited the last ten Verses of Surat-al-`Imran, got up and went to a hanging water skin. He then performed the ablution from it, and it was perfect ablution, and then stood up to offer the prayer. I too did the same as he had done, and then went to stand beside him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put his right hand on my head and held and twisted my right ear. He then offered two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at. then two rak`at, and finally one rak`a, the witr. Then he lay down again till the Muadhdhin (i.e. the call-maker) came to him, whereupon he got up and offered a light two-rak`at prayer, and went out (to the Mosque) and offered the (compulsory congregational) Fajr prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، بَاتَ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْىَ خَالَتُهُ قَالَ فَاضْطَجَعْتُ فِي عَرْضِ الْوِسَادَةِ، وَاضْطَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَهْلُهُ فِي طُولِهَا، فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى إِذَا انْتَصَفَ اللَّيْلُ، أَوْ قَبْلَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ، أَوْ بَعْدَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ، اسْتَيْقَظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَلَسَ يَمْسَحُ النَّوْمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ بِيَدِهِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ الْعَشْرَ الآيَاتِ الْخَوَاتِمَ مِنْ سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى شَنٍّ مُعَلَّقَةٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْهَا، فَأَحْسَنَ وُضُوءَهُ، ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُمْتُ فَصَنَعْتُ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعَ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبْتُ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى رَأْسِي، وَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي الْيُمْنَى يَفْتِلُهَا، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَوْتَرَ ثُمَّ، اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى جَاءَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ، فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maalikin, 'an makhramaaa bni sulaymaana, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin aanna abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aakhbarahu aannahu, baata 'inda maymuwnaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaa khaalatuhu qaala faadtaja'tu fiy 'ardi alwisaadaai, waadtaja'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaahluhu fiy tuwlihaa, fanaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa iidhaa antasafa alllaylu, aaw qablahu biqaliylin, aaw ba'dahu biqaliylin, astayqaza rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajalasa yamsahu alnnawma 'an wajhihi biyadihi, thumma qaraaa al'ashra alayaati alkhawaatima min suwraai ali 'imraana, thumma qaama iilaa shannin mu'allaqaain fatawaddaaa minhaa, faaahsana wuduw'ahu, thumma qaama yusalliy‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin faqumtu fasana'tu mithla maa sana'a, thumma dhahabtu faqumtu iilaa janbihi, fawada'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadahu alyumnaa 'alaa raasiy, waaakhadha biaudhuniy alyumnaa yaftiluhaa, fasallaa rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma aawtara thumma, adtaja'a hattaa jaa'ahu almuuadhhinu, faqaama fasallaa rak'atayni khafiyfatayni, thumma kharaja fasallaa alssubha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:That once he stayed overnight in the house of his aunt, the wife of the Prophet. He added: I lay on the cushion transversely while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lay along with his wife in the lengthwise direction of the cushion. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept till the middle of the night, either a bit before or a bit after it, and then woke up rubbing the traces of sleep off his face with his hands, and then recited the last ten Verses of Surat ali-`Imran. Then he got up and went to a hanging water skin, performed ablution from it ---- and performed it perfectly. Then he stood up to perform the prayer. I also did the same as he had done and then went to stand beside him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put his right hand on my head and held and twisted my right ear. He then offered two rak`at, then two rak`at then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, and finally, one rak`a witr. Then he lay down again till the Muadhdhin (i.e. the call-maker) came to him, whereupon he got up and offered a light two rak`at prayer and went out (to the Mosque) and offered the (compulsory congregational) Fajr prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، كَانَتْ لَهُ يَتِيمَةٌ فَنَكَحَهَا، وَكَانَ لَهَا عَذْقٌ، وَكَانَ يُمْسِكُهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهَا مِنْ نَفْسِهِ شَىْءٌ فَنَزَلَتْ فِيهِ ‏{‏وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى‏}‏ أَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ كَانَتْ شَرِيكَتَهُ فِي ذَلِكَ الْعَذْقِ وَفِي مَالِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna rajulaan, kaanat lahu yatiymaaun fanakahahaa, wakaana lahaa 'adhqun, wakaana yumsikuhaa 'alayhi, walam yakun lahaa min nafsihi shaa'un fanazalat fiyhi ‏{‏waiin khiftum aan laa tuqsituwa fiy alyataamaa‏}‏ aahsibuhu qaala kaanat shariykatahu fiy dhalika al'adhqi wafiy maalihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:There was an orphan (girl) under the care of a man. He married her and she owned a date palm (garden). He married her just because of that and not because he loved her. So the Divine Verse came regarding his case: "If you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphan girls..." (4.3) The sub-narrator added: I think he (i.e. another sub-narrator) said, "That orphan girl was his partner in that datepalm (garden) and in his property
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ، تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى‏}‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ يَا ابْنَ أُخْتِي، هَذِهِ الْيَتِيمَةُ تَكُونُ فِي حَجْرِ وَلِيِّهَا، تَشْرَكُهُ فِي مَالِهِ وَيُعْجِبُهُ مَالُهَا وَجَمَالُهَا، فَيُرِيدُ وَلِيُّهَا أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَهَا، بِغَيْرِ أَنْ يُقْسِطَ فِي صَدَاقِهَا، فَيُعْطِيَهَا مِثْلَ مَا يُعْطِيهَا غَيْرُهُ، فَنُهُوا عَنْ أَنْ يَنْكِحُوهُنَّ، إِلاَّ أَنْ يُقْسِطُوا لَهُنَّ، وَيَبْلُغُوا لَهُنَّ أَعْلَى سُنَّتِهِنَّ فِي الصَّدَاقِ، فَأُمِرُوا أَنْ يَنْكِحُوا مَا طَابَ لَهُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ سِوَاهُنَّ‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَإِنَّ النَّاسَ اسْتَفْتَوْا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏وَيَسْتَفْتُونَكَ فِي النِّسَاءِ‏}‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَقَوْلُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فِي آيَةٍ أُخْرَى ‏{‏وَتَرْغَبُونَ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ‏}‏ رَغْبَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ عَنْ يَتِيمَتِهِ حِينَ تَكُونُ قَلِيلَةَ الْمَالِ وَالْجَمَالِ قَالَتْ فَنُهُوا أَنْ يَنْكِحُوا عَنْ مَنْ رَغِبُوا فِي مَالِهِ وَجَمَالِهِ فِي يَتَامَى النِّسَاءِ، إِلاَّ بِالْقِسْطِ، مِنْ أَجْلِ رَغْبَتِهِمْ عَنْهُنَّ إِذَا كُنَّ قَلِيلاَتِ الْمَالِ وَالْجَمَالِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aannahu saaala 'aaiishaaa 'an qawli alllahi, ta'aalaa ‏{‏waiin khiftum aan laa tuqsituwa fiy alyataamaa‏}‏‏.‏ faqaalat yaa abna aukhtiy, hadhihi alyatiymaau takuwnu fiy hajri waliyyihaa, tashrakuhu fiy maalihi wayu'jibuhu maaluhaa wajamaaluhaa, fayuriydu waliyyuhaa aan yatazawwajahaa, bighayri aan yuqsita fiy sadaaqihaa, fayu'tiyahaa mithla maa yu'tiyhaa ghayruhu, fanuhuwa 'an aan yankihuwhunna, iilaaa aan yuqsituwa lahunna, wayablughuwa lahunna aa'laa sunnatihinna fiy alssadaaqi, faaumiruwa aan yankihuwa maa taaba lahum mina alnnisaa'i siwaahunna‏.‏ qaala 'urwaau qaalat 'aaiishaau waiinna alnnaasa astaftawa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da hadhihi alayaai faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏wayastaftuwnaka fiy alnnisaa'i‏}‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau waqawlu alllahi ta'aalaa fiy ayaain aukhraa ‏{‏watarghabuwna aan tankihuwhunna‏}‏ raghbaau aahadikum 'an yatiymatihi hiyna takuwnu qaliylaaa almaali waaljamaali qaalat fanuhuwa aan yankihuwa 'an man raghibuwa fiy maalihi wajamaalihi fiy yataamaa alnnisaa'i, iilaaa bialqisti, min aajli raghbatihim 'anhunna iidhaa kunna qaliylaati almaali waaljamaali‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:That he asked `Aisha regarding the Statement of Allah: "If you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphan girls..." (4.3) She said, "O son of my sister! An Orphan girl used to be under the care of a guardian with whom she shared property. Her guardian, being attracted by her wealth and beauty, would intend to marry her without giving her a just Mahr, i.e. the same Mahr as any other person might give her (in case he married her). So such guardians were forbidden to do that unless they did justice to their female wards and gave them the highest Mahr their peers might get. They were ordered (by Allah, to marry women of their choice other than those orphan girls." `Aisha added," The people asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) his instructions after the revelation of this Divine Verse whereupon Allah revealed: "They ask your instruction regarding women " (4.127) `Aisha further said, "And the Statement of Allah: "And yet whom you desire to marry." (4.127) as anyone of you refrains from marrying an orphan girl (under his guardianship) when she is lacking in property and beauty." `Aisha added, "So they were forbidden to marry those orphan girls for whose wealth and beauty they had a desire unless with justice, and that was because they would refrain from marrying them if they were lacking in property and beauty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَمَنْ كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ وَمَنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ‏}‏ أَنَّهَا نَزَلَتْ فِي مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ إِذَا كَانَ فَقِيرًا، أَنَّهُ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ مَكَانَ قِيَامِهِ عَلَيْهِ، بِمَعْرُوفٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha fiy qawlihi ta'aalaa ‏{‏waman kaana ghaniyyana falyasta'fif waman kaana faqiyrana falyaakul bialma'ruwfi‏}‏ aannahaa nazalat fiy maali alyatiymi iidhaa kaana faqiyrana, aannahu yaakulu minhu makaana qiyaamihi 'alayhi, bima'ruwfin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:regarding the Statement of Allah: "And whoever amongst the guardian is rich, he should take no wages, but if he is poor, let him have for himself what is just and reasonable (according to his work). This Verse was revealed regarding the orphan's property. If the guardian is poor, he can take from the property of the orphan, what is just and reasonable according to his work and the time he spends on managing it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ الأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏{‏وَإِذَا حَضَرَ الْقِسْمَةَ أُولُو الْقُرْبَى وَالْيَتَامَى وَالْمَسَاكِينُ‏}‏ قَالَ هِيَ مُحْكَمَةٌ وَلَيْسَتْ بِمَنْسُوخَةٍ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ سَعِيدٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi alaashja'iyyu, 'an sufyaana, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma ‏{‏waiidhaa hadara alqismaaa auwluw alqurbaa waalyataamaa waalmasaakiynu‏}‏ qaala hiya muhkamaaun walaysat bimansuwkhaain‏.‏ taaba'ahu sa'iydun 'ani abni 'abbaasin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ikrima:Ibn `Abbas said ( regarding the verse), "And when the relatives and the orphans and the poor are present at the time of division, "this verse and its order is valid and not abrogated
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ مُنْكَدِرٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ عَادَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي بَنِي سَلِمَةَ مَاشِيَيْنِ فَوَجَدَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ أَعْقِلُ، فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْهُ، ثُمَّ رَشَّ عَلَىَّ، فَأَفَقْتُ فَقُلْتُ مَا تَأْمُرُنِي أَنْ أَصْنَعَ فِي مَالِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏يُوصِيكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي أَوْلاَدِكُمْ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, aanna abna jurayjin, aakhbarahum qaala aakhbaraniy abnu munkadirin, 'an jaabirin rda allh 'nh qaala 'aadaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin fiy baniy salimaaa maashiyayni fawajadaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm laa aa'qilu, fada'aa bimaa'in fatawaddaaa minhu, thumma rashha 'alaaaa, faaafaqtu faqultu maa taamuruniy aan aasna'a fiy maaliy yaa rasuwla alllahi fanazalat ‏{‏yuwsiykumu alllahu fiy aawlaadikum‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr came on foot to pay me a visit (during my illness) at Banu Salama's (dwellings). The Prophet (ﷺ) found me unconscious, so he asked for water and performed the ablution from it and sprinkled some water over me. I came to my senses and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do you order me to do as regards my wealth?" So there was revealed:-- "Allah commands you as regards your children's (inheritance):
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ وَرْقَاءَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ الْمَالُ لِلْوَلَدِ، وَكَانَتِ الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ، فَنَسَخَ اللَّهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ مَا أَحَبَّ، فَجَعَلَ لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلَ حَظِّ الأُنْثَيَيْنِ، وَجَعَلَ لِلأَبَوَيْنِ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا السُّدُسَ وَالثُّلُثَ، وَجَعَلَ لِلْمَرْأَةِ الثُّمُنَ وَالرُّبُعَ، وَلِلزَّوْجِ الشَّطْرَ وَالرُّبُعَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, 'an warqaa'a, 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana almaalu lilwaladi, wakaanati alwasiyyaau lilwaalidayni, fanasakha alllahu min dhalika maa aahabba, faja'ala lildhhakari mithla hazzi alaunthayayni, waja'ala lilaabawayni likulli waahidin minhumaa alssudusa waalthhulutha, waja'ala lilmaraaai althhumuna waalrrubu'a, walilzzawji alshhatra waalrrubu'a‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(In the Pre-Islamic Period ) the children used to inherit all the property but the parents used to inherit only through a will. So Allah cancelled that which He liked to cancel and put decreed that the share of a son was to be twice the share of a daughter, and for the parents one-sixth for each one of them, or one third, and for the wife one-eighth or one-fourth, and for the husband one-half, or one-fourth
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَسْبَاطُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،‏.‏ قَالَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ وَذَكَرَهُ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ السُّوَائِيُّ وَلاَ أَظُنُّهُ ذَكَرَهُ إِلاَّ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَرِثُوا النِّسَاءَ كَرْهًا وَلاَ تَعْضُلُوهُنَّ لِتَذْهَبُوا بِبَعْضِ مَا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ‏}‏ قَالَ كَانُوا إِذَا مَاتَ الرَّجُلُ كَانَ أَوْلِيَاؤُهُ أَحَقَّ بِامْرَأَتِهِ، إِنْ شَاءَ بَعْضُهُمْ تَزَوَّجَهَا، وَإِنْ شَاءُوا زَوَّجُوهَا، وَإِنْ شَاءُوا لَمْ يُزَوِّجُوهَا، فَهُمْ أَحَقُّ بِهَا مِنْ أَهْلِهَا، فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ فِي ذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, haddathanaa aasbaatu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa alshhaybaaniyyu, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, ‏.‏ qaala alshhaybaaniyyu wadhakarahu aabuw alhasani alssuwaaiiyyu walaa aazunnuhu dhakarahu iilaaa 'ani abni 'abbaasin, ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alladhiyna amanuwa laa yahillu lakum aan tarithuwa alnnisaa'a karhana walaa ta'duluwhunna litadhhabuwa biba'di maa ataytumuwhunna‏}‏ qaala kaanuwa iidhaa maata alrrajulu kaana aawliyaauuhu aahaqqa biamraaatihi, iin shaa'a ba'duhum tazawwajahaa, waiin shaa'uwa zawwajuwhaa, waiin shaa'uwa lam yuzawwijuwhaa, fahum aahaqqu bihaa min aahlihaa, fanazalat hadhihi alayaau fiy dhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:regarding the Divine Verse: "O you who believe! You are forbidden to inherit women against their will, and you should not treat them with harshness that you may take back part of the (Mahr) dower you have given them." (4.19) (Before this revelation) if a man died, his relatives used to have the right to inherit his wife, and one of them could marry her if he wished, or they would give her in marriage if they wished, or, if they wished, they would not give her in marriage at all, and they would be more entitled to dispose her, than her own relatives. So the above Verse was revealed in this connection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الصَّلْتُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاس ٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏{‏وَلِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مَوَالِيَ‏}‏ قَالَ وَرَثَةً‏.‏ ‏{‏وَالَّذِينَ عَاقَدَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ‏}‏ كَانَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ لَمَّا قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ يَرِثُ الْمُهَاجِرُ الأَنْصَارِيَّ دُونَ ذَوِي رَحِمِهِ لِلأُخُوَّةِ الَّتِي آخَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَهُمْ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏وَلِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مَوَالِيَ‏}‏ نُسِخَتْ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏{‏وَالَّذِينَ عَاقَدَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ ‏}‏ مِنَ النَّصْرِ، وَالرِّفَادَةِ وَالنَّصِيحَةِ، وَقَدْ ذَهَبَ الْمِيرَاثُ وَيُوصِي لَهُ‏.‏ سَمِعَ أَبُو أُسَامَةَ إِدْرِيسَ، وَسَمِعَ إِدْرِيسُ طَلْحَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alssaltu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an iidriysa, 'an talhaaa bni musarrifin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaas in rda allh 'nhma ‏{‏walikullin ja'alnaa mawaaliya‏}‏ qaala warathaaan‏.‏ ‏{‏waalladhiyna 'aaqadat aaymaanukum‏}‏ kaana almuhaajiruwna lammaa qadimuwa almadiynaaa yarithu almuhaajiru alaansaariyya duwna dhawiy rahimihi lilaukhuwwaai allatiy akhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm baynahum falammaa nazalat ‏{‏walikullin ja'alnaa mawaaliya‏}‏ nusikhat, thumma qaala ‏{‏waalladhiyna 'aaqadat aaymaanukum ‏}‏ mina alnnasri, waalrrifaadaai waalnnasiyhaai, waqad dhahaba almiyraathu wayuwsiy lahu‏.‏ sami'a aabuw ausaamaaa iidriysa, wasami'a iidriysu talhaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding the Verse: "To everyone, We have appointed heirs." (4.33) 'Mawali' means heirs. And regarding:-- "And those to whom your right hands have pledged." When the Emigrants came to Medina, an Emigrant used to be the heir of an Ansari with the exclusion of the latter's relatives, and that was because of the bond of brotherhood which the Prophet (ﷺ) had established between them (i.e. the Emigrants and the Ansar). So when the Verses:-- "To everyone We have appointed heirs." was revealed, (the inheritance through bond of brotherhood) was cancelled. Ibn `Abbas then said: "And those to whom your right hands have pledged." is concerned with the covenant of helping and advising each other. So allies are no longer to be the heir of each other, but they can bequeath each other some of their property by means of a will
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَرَ، حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ أُنَاسًا فِي زَمَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَلْ نَرَى رَبَّنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ نَعَمْ، هَلْ تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ الشَّمْسِ بِالظَّهِيرَةِ، ضَوْءٌ لَيْسَ فِيهَا سَحَابٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَهَلْ تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ، ضَوْءٌ لَيْسَ فِيهَا سَحَابٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، إِلاَّ كَمَا تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ أَحَدِهِمَا، إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ تَتْبَعُ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ مَا كَانَتْ تَعْبُدُ‏.‏ فَلاَ يَبْقَى مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ غَيْرَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الأَصْنَامِ وَالأَنْصَابِ إِلاَّ يَتَسَاقَطُونَ فِي النَّارِ، حَتَّى إِذَا لَمْ يَبْقَ إِلاَّ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ، بَرٌّ أَوْ فَاجِرٌ وَغُبَّرَاتُ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ، فَيُدْعَى الْيَهُودُ فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ مَنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ قَالُوا كُنَّا نَعْبُدُ عُزَيْرَ ابْنَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ كَذَبْتُمْ، مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِنْ صَاحِبَةٍ وَلاَ وَلَدٍ، فَمَاذَا تَبْغُونَ فَقَالُوا عَطِشْنَا رَبَّنَا فَاسْقِنَا‏.‏ فَيُشَارُ أَلاَ تَرِدُونَ، فَيُحْشَرُونَ إِلَى النَّارِ كَأَنَّهَا سَرَابٌ، يَحْطِمُ بَعْضُهَا بَعْضًا فَيَتَسَاقَطُونَ فِي النَّارِ، ثُمَّ يُدْعَى النَّصَارَى، فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ مَنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ قَالُوا كُنَّا نَعْبُدُ الْمَسِيحَ ابْنَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ كَذَبْتُمْ، مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِنْ صَاحِبَةٍ وَلاَ وَلَدٍ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ مَاذَا تَبْغُونَ فَكَذَلِكَ مِثْلَ الأَوَّلِ، حَتَّى إِذَا لَمْ يَبْقَ إِلاَّ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ مِنْ بَرٍّ أَوْ فَاجِرٍ، أَتَاهُمْ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ فِي أَدْنَى صُورَةٍ مِنَ الَّتِي رَأَوْهُ فِيهَا، فَيُقَالُ مَاذَا تَنْتَظِرُونَ تَتْبَعُ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ مَا كَانَتْ تَعْبُدُ‏.‏ قَالُوا فَارَقْنَا النَّاسَ فِي الدُّنْيَا عَلَى أَفْقَرِ مَا كُنَّا إِلَيْهِمْ، وَلَمْ نُصَاحِبْهُمْ، وَنَحْنُ نَنْتَظِرُ رَبَّنَا الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْبُدُ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا رَبُّكُمْ، فَيَقُولُونَ لاَ نُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi al'aziyzi, haddathanaa aabuw 'umara, hafsu bnu maysaraaa 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh aanna aunaasana fiy zamani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi, hal naraa rabbanaa yawma alqiyaamaai qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ na'am, hal tudaarruwna fiy ruuyaai alshhamsi bialzzahiyraai, daw'un laysa fiyhaa sahaabun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa laa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ wahal tudaarruwna fiy ruuyaai alqamari laylaaa albadri, daw'un laysa fiyhaa sahaabun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa laa‏.‏ qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa tudaarruwna fiy ruuyaai alllahi 'azza wajalla yawma alqiyaamaai, iilaaa kamaa tudaarruwna fiy ruuyaai aahadihimaa, iidhaa kaana yawmu alqiyaamaai aadhhana muuadhhinun tatba'u kullu aummaain maa kaanat ta'budu‏.‏ falaa yabqaa man kaana ya'budu ghayra alllahi mina alaasnaami waalaansaabi iilaaa yatasaaqatuwna fiy alnnaari, hattaa iidhaa lam yabqa iilaaa man kaana ya'budu alllaha, barrun aaw faajirun waghubbaraatu aahli alkitaabi, fayud'aa alyahuwdu fayuqaalu lahum man kuntum ta'buduwna qaaluwa kunnaa na'budu 'uzayra abna alllahi‏.‏ fayuqaalu lahum kadhabtum, maa attakhadha alllahu min saahibaain walaa waladin, famaadhaa tabghuwna faqaaluwa 'atishnaa rabbanaa faasqinaa‏.‏ fayushaaru aalaa tariduwna, fayuhsharuwna iilaa alnnaari kaaannahaa saraabun, yahtimu ba'duhaa ba'dana fayatasaaqatuwna fiy alnnaari, thumma yud'aa alnnasaaraa, fayuqaalu lahum man kuntum ta'buduwna qaaluwa kunnaa na'budu almasiyha abna alllahi‏.‏ fayuqaalu lahum kadhabtum, maa attakhadha alllahu min saahibaain walaa waladin‏.‏ fayuqaalu lahum maadhaa tabghuwna fakadhalika mithla alaawwali, hattaa iidhaa lam yabqa iilaaa man kaana ya'budu alllaha min barrin aaw faajirin, aataahum rabbu al'aalamiyna fiy aadnaa suwraain mina allatiy raaawhu fiyhaa, fayuqaalu maadhaa tantaziruwna tatba'u kullu aummaain maa kaanat ta'budu‏.‏ qaaluwa faaraqnaa alnnaasa fiy alddunyaa 'alaa aafqari maa kunnaa iilayhim, walam nusaahibhum, wanahnu nantaziru rabbanaa alladhiy kunnaa na'budu‏.‏ fayaquwlu aanaa rabbukum, fayaquwluwna laa nushriku bialllahi shayiana‏.‏ marratayni aaw thalaathana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:During the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) some people said, : O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes; do you have any difficulty in seeing the sun at midday when it is bright and there is no cloud in the sky?" They replied, "No." He said, "Do you have any difficulty in seeing the moon on a full moon night when it is bright and there is no cloud in the sky?" They replied, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(Similarly) you will have no difficulty in seeing Allah on the Day of Resurrection as you have no difficulty in seeing either of them. On the Day of Resurrection, a call-maker will announce, "Let every nation follow that which they used to worship." Then none of those who used to worship anything other than Allah like idols and other deities but will fall in Hell (Fire), till there will remain none but those who used to worship Allah, both those who were obedient (i.e. good) and those who were disobedient (i.e. bad) and the remaining party of the people of the Scripture. Then the Jews will be called upon and it will be said to them, 'Who did you use to worship?' They will say, 'We used to worship Ezra, the son of Allah.' It will be said to them, 'You are liars, for Allah has never taken anyone as a wife or a son. What do you want now?' They will say, 'O our Lord! We are thirsty, so give us something to drink.' They will be directed and addressed thus, 'Will you drink,' whereupon they will be gathered unto Hell (Fire) which will look like a mirage whose different sides will be destroying each other. Then they will fall into the Fire. Afterwards the Christians will be called upon and it will be said to them, 'Who did you use to worship?' They will say, 'We used to worship Jesus, the son of Allah.' It will be said to them, 'You are liars, for Allah has never taken anyone as a wife or a son,' Then it will be said to them, 'What do you want?' They will say what the former people have said. Then, when there remain (in the gathering) none but those who used to worship Allah (Alone, the real Lord of the Worlds) whether they were obedient or disobedient. Then (Allah) the Lord of the worlds will come to them in a shape nearest to the picture they had in their minds about Him. It will be said, 'What are you waiting for?' Every nation has followed what they used to worship.' They will reply, 'We left the people in the world when we were in great need of them and we did not take them as friends. Now we are waiting for our Lord Whom we used to worship.' Allah will say, 'I am your Lord.' They will say twice or thrice, 'We do not worship any besides Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ يَحْيَى بَعْضُ الْحَدِيثِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ عَلَىَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ آقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَيْكَ أُنْزِلَ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَسْمَعَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَرَأْتُ عَلَيْهِ سُورَةَ النِّسَاءِ حَتَّى بَلَغْتُ ‏{‏فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ شَهِيدًا‏}‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْسِكْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَإِذَا عَيْنَاهُ تَذْرِفَانِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sadaqaau, aakhbaranaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, 'an sulaymaana, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'abiydaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala yahyaa ba'du alhadiythi 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, qaala qaala liy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aqraa 'alaaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu aqraau 'alayka wa'alayka aunzila qaala ‏"‏ faiinniy auhibbu aan aasma'ahu min ghayriy ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaraatu 'alayhi suwraaa alnnisaa'i hattaa balaghtu ‏{‏fakayfa iidhaa jiinaa min kulli aummaain bishahiydin wajiinaa bika 'alaa hauulaa'i shahiydana‏}‏ qaala ‏"‏ aamsik ‏"‏‏.‏ faiidhaa 'aynaahu tadhrifaani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Recite (of the Qur'an) for me," I said, "Shall I recite it to you although it had been revealed to you?" He said, "I like to hear (the Qur'an) from others." So I recited Surat-an- Nisa' till I reached: "How (will it be) then when We bring from each nation a witness, and We bring you (O Muhammad) as a witness against these people?" (4.41) Then he said, "Stop!" And behold, his eyes were overflowing with tears
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ هَلَكَتْ قِلاَدَةٌ لأَسْمَاءَ فَبَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَلَبِهَا، رِجَالاً فَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ وَلَيْسُوا عَلَى وُضُوءٍ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا مَاءً، فَصَلَّوْا وَهُمْ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ يَعْنِي آيَةَ التَّيَمُّمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, aakhbaranaa 'abdaau, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat halakat qilaadaaun laasmaa'a faba'atha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy talabihaa, rijaalaan fahadarati alssalaaau walaysuwa 'alaa wuduw'in‏.‏ walam yajiduwa maa'an, fasallawa wahum 'alaa ghayri wuduw'in, faaanzala alllahu‏.‏ ya'niy ayaaa alttayammumi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The necklace of Asma' was lost, so the Prophet (ﷺ) sent some men to look for it. The time for the prayer became due and they had not performed ablution and could not find water, so they offered the prayer without ablution. Then Allah revealed (the Verse of Tayammum)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏{‏أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَأُولِي الأَمْرِ مِنْكُمْ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُذَافَةَ بْنِ قَيْسِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ، إِذْ بَعَثَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَرِيَّةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sadaqaau bnu alfadli, aakhbaranaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'an ya'laa bni muslimin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma ‏{‏aatiy'uwa alllaha waaatiy'uwa alrrasuwla waauwliy alaamri minkum‏}‏‏.‏ qaala nazalat fiy 'abdi alllahi bni hudhaafaaa bni qaysi bni 'adiyyin, iidh ba'athahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy sariyyaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Verse: "Obey Allah and Obey the Apostle and those of you (Muslims) who are in authority." (4.59) was revealed in connection with `Abdullah bin Hudhafa bin Qais bin `Adi' when the Prophet (ﷺ) appointed him as the commander of a Sariyya (army detachment)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ خَاصَمَ الزُّبَيْرُ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فِي شَرِيجٍ مِنَ الْحَرَّةِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اسْقِ يَا زُبَيْرُ ثُمَّ أَرْسِلِ الْمَاءَ إِلَى جَارِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنْ كَانَ ابْنَ عَمَّتِكَ فَتَلَوَّنَ وَجْهُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اسْقِ يَا زُبَيْرُ ثُمَّ احْبِسِ الْمَاءَ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ إِلَى الْجَدْرِ، ثُمَّ أَرْسِلِ الْمَاءَ إِلَى جَارِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَاسْتَوْعَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلزُّبَيْرِ حَقَّهُ فِي صَرِيحِ الْحُكْمِ حِينَ أَحْفَظَهُ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، كَانَ أَشَارَ عَلَيْهِمَا بِأَمْرٍ لَهُمَا فِيهِ سَعَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ فَمَا أَحْسِبُ هَذِهِ الآيَاتِ إِلاَّ نَزَلَتْ فِي ذَلِكَ ‏{‏فَلاَ وَرَبِّكَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ حَتَّى يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, qaala khaasama alzzubayru rajulaan mina alaansaari fiy shariyjin mina alharraai, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ asqi yaa zubayru thumma aarsili almaa'a iilaa jaarika ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala alaansaariyyu yaa rasuwla alllahi aan kaana abna 'ammatika fatalawwana wajhuhu thumma qaala ‏"‏ asqi yaa zubayru thumma ahbisi almaa'a hattaa yarji'a iilaa aljadri, thumma aarsili almaa'a iilaa jaarika ‏"‏‏.‏ waastaw'aa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm lilzzubayri haqqahu fiy sariyhi alhukmi hiyna aahfazahu alaansaariyyu, kaana aashaara 'alayhimaa biaamrin lahumaa fiyhi sa'aaun‏.‏ qaala alzzubayru famaa aahsibu hadhihi alayaati iilaaa nazalat fiy dhalika ‏{‏falaa warabbika laa yuuminuwna hattaa yuhakkimuwka fiymaa shajara baynahum‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa:Az-Zubair quarrelled with a man from the Ansar because of a natural mountainous stream at Al-Harra. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Zubair! Irrigate (your lands) and then let the water flow to your neighbor." The Ansar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (This is because) he (Zubair) is your cousin?" At that, the Prophet's face became red (with anger) and he said "O Zubair! Irrigate (your land) and then withhold the water till it fills the land up to the walls and then let it flow to your neighbor." So the Prophet (ﷺ) enabled Az-Zubair to take his full right after the Ansari provoked his anger. The Prophet (ﷺ) had previously given an order that was in favor of both of them Az-Zubair said, "I don't think but the Verse was revealed in this connection: "But no, by your Lord, they can have no faith, until they make you judge in all disputes between them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ يَمْرَضُ إِلاَّ خُيِّرَ بَيْنَ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ فِي شَكْوَاهُ الَّذِي قُبِضَ فِيهِ أَخَذَتْهُ بُحَّةٌ شَدِيدَةٌ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏{‏مَعَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ‏}‏ فَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ خُيِّرَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni hawshabin, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ maa min nabiyyin yamradu iilaaa khuyyira bayna alddunyaa waalakhiraai ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana fiy shakwaahu alladhiy qubida fiyhi aakhadhathu buhhaaun shadiydaaun fasami'tuhu yaquwlu ‏{‏ma'a alladhiyna aan'ama alllahu 'alayhim mina alnnabiyyiyna waalssiddiyqiyna waalshhuhadaa'i waalssaalihiyna‏}‏ fa'alimtu aannahu khuyyira‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "No prophet gets sick but he is given the choice to select either this world or the Hereafter." `Aisha added: During his fatal illness, his voice became very husky and I heard him saying: "In the company of those whom is the Grace of Allah, of the prophets, the Siddiqin (those followers of the prophets who were first and foremost to believe in them), the martyrs and the pious.' (4.69) And from this I came to know that he has been given the option
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَنَا وَأُمِّي، مِنَ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, qaala kuntu aanaa waaummiy, mina almustad'afiyna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:My mother and I were among the weak and oppressed (Muslims at Mecca)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، تَلاَ ‏{‏ِلاَّ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ وَالْوِلْدَانِ‏}‏ قَالَ كُنْتُ أَنَا وَأُمِّي مِمَّنْ عَذَرَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ وَيُذْكَرُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ‏{‏حَصِرَتْ‏}‏ ضَاقَتْ ‏{‏تَلْوُوا‏}‏ أَلْسِنَتَكُمْ بِالشَّهَادَةِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ الْمُرَاغَمُ الْمُهَاجَرُ‏.‏ رَاغَمْتُ هَاجَرْتُ قَوْمِي‏.‏ ‏{‏مَوْقُوتًا‏}‏ مُوَقَّتًا وَقْتَهُ عَلَيْهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, aanna abna 'abbaasin, talaa ‏{‏ilaaa almustad'afiyna mina alrrijaali waalnnisaa'i waalwildaani‏}‏ qaala kuntu aanaa waaummiy mimman 'adhara alllahu‏.‏ wayudhkaru 'ani abni 'abbaasin ‏{‏hasirat‏}‏ daaqat ‏{‏talwuwa‏}‏ aalsinatakum bialshhahaadaai‏.‏ waqaala ghayruhu almuraaghamu almuhaajaru‏.‏ raaghamtu haajartu qawmiy‏.‏ ‏{‏mawquwtana‏}‏ muwaqqatana waqtahu 'alayhim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:Ibn `Abbas recited:-- "Except the weak ones among men women and children," (4.98) and said, "My mother and I were among those whom Allah had excused
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِت ٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ ‏{‏فَمَا لَكُمْ فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِئَتَيْنِ‏}‏ رَجَعَ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أُحُدٍ، وَكَانَ النَّاسُ فِيهِمْ فِرْقَتَيْنِ فَرِيقٌ يَقُولُ اقْتُلْهُمْ‏.‏ وَفَرِيقٌ يَقُولُ لاَ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏فَمَا لَكُمْ فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِئَتَيْنِ‏}‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا طَيْبَةُ تَنْفِي الْخَبَثَ كَمَا تَنْفِي النَّارُ خَبَثَ الْفِضَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, wa'abdu alrrahmani, qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni yaziyda, 'an zaydi bni thaabit in rda allh 'nh ‏{‏famaa lakum fiy almunaafiqiyna fiiatayni‏}‏ raja'a naasun min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm min auhudin, wakaana alnnaasu fiyhim firqatayni fariyqun yaquwlu aqtulhum‏.‏ wafariyqun yaquwlu laa fanazalat ‏{‏famaa lakum fiy almunaafiqiyna fiiatayni‏}‏ waqaala ‏"‏ iinnahaa taybaau tanfiy alkhabatha kamaa tanfiy alnnaaru khabatha alfiddaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:Regarding the Verse:-- "Then what is the matter with you that you are divided into two parties about the hypocrites?" (4.88) Some of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from the battle of Uhud (i.e. refused to fight) whereupon the Muslims got divided into two parties; one of them was in favor of their execution and the other was not in favour of it. So there was revealed: "Then what is the matter with you that you are divided into two parties about the hypocrites?" (4.88). Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said "It (i.e. Medina) is Taybah (good), it expels impurities as the fire expels the impurities of silver
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُغِيرَةُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ ‏{‏آيَةٌ‏}‏ اخْتَلَفَ فِيهَا أَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ، فَرَحَلْتُ فِيهَا إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهَا فَقَالَ نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏وَمَنْ يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ‏}‏ هِيَ آخِرُ مَا نَزَلَ وَمَا نَسَخَهَا شَىْءٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu bnu aabiy iiyaasin, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa mughiyraau bnu alnnu'maani, qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna jubayrin, qaala ‏{‏ayaaun‏}‏ akhtalafa fiyhaa aahlu alkuwfaai, farahaltu fiyhaa iilaa abni 'abbaasin fasaaaltuhu 'anhaa faqaala nazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏waman yaqtul muuminana muta'ammidana fajazaauuhu jahannamu‏}‏ hiya akhiru maa nazala wamaa nasakhahaa shaa'un‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:The people of Kufa disagreed (disputed) about the above Verse. So I went to Ibn `Abbas and asked him about it. He said, "This Verse:-- "And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell." was revealed last of all (concerning premeditated murder) and nothing abrogated it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏{‏وَلاَ تَقُولُوا لِمَنْ أَلْقَى إِلَيْكُمُ السَّلاَمَ لَسْتَ مُؤْمِنًا‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ كَانَ رَجُلٌ فِي غُنَيْمَةٍ لَهُ فَلَحِقَهُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ فَقَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ، فَقَتَلُوهُ وَأَخَذُوا غُنَيْمَتَهُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِي ذَلِكَ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏عَرَضَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا‏}‏ تِلْكَ الْغُنَيْمَةُ‏.‏ قَالَ قَرَأَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ السَّلاَمَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma ‏{‏walaa taquwluwa liman aalqaa iilaykumu alssalaama lasta muuminana‏}‏‏.‏ qaala qaala abnu 'abbaasin kaana rajulun fiy ghunaymaain lahu falahiqahu almuslimuwna faqaala alssalaamu 'alaykum, faqataluwhu waaakhadhuwa ghunaymatahu, faaanzala alllahu fiy dhalika iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏'arada alhayaaai alddunyaa‏}‏ tilka alghunaymaau‏.‏ qaala qaraaa abnu 'abbaasin alssalaama‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding the Verse: "And say not to anyone who offers you peace (by accepting Islam), You are not a believer." There was a man amidst his sheep. The Muslims pursued him, and he said (to them) "Peace be on you." But they killed him and took over his sheep. Thereupon Allah revealed in that concern, the above Verse up to:-- "...seeking the perishable good of this life." (4.94) i.e. those sheep
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَهْلُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيُّ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى مَرْوَانَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَأَقْبَلْتُ حَتَّى جَلَسْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَأَخْبَرَنَا أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمْلَى عَلَيْهِ لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَجَاءَهُ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ وَهْوَ يُمِلُّهَا عَلَىَّ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهِ لَوْ أَسْتَطِيعُ الْجِهَادَ لَجَاهَدْتُ ـ وَكَانَ أَعْمَى ـ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَفَخِذُهُ عَلَى فَخِذِي، فَثَقُلَتْ عَلَىَّ حَتَّى خِفْتُ أَنْ تُرَضَّ فَخِذِي، ثُمَّ سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏غَيْرَ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy sahlu bnu sa'din alssaa'idiyyu, aannahu raaaa marwaana bna alhakami fiy almasjidi, faaaqbaltu hattaa jalastu iilaa janbihi, faaakhbaranaa aanna zayda bna thaabitin aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aamlaa 'alayhi laa yastawiy alqaa'iduwna mina almuuminiyna waalmujaahiduwna fiy sabiyli alllahi fajaa'ahu abnu aummi maktuwmin wahwa yumilluhaa 'alaaaa qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, waalllahi law aastatiy'u aljihaada lajaahadtu wakaana aa'maa faaanzala alllahu 'alaa rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm wafakhidhuhu 'alaa fakhidhiy, fathaqulat 'alaaaa hattaa khiftu aan turadda fakhidhiy, thumma surriya 'anhu, faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏ghayra auwliy alddarari‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:That the Prophet (ﷺ) dictated to him: "Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home) and those who strive and fight in the Cause of Allah." Zaid added: Ibn Um Maktum came while the Prophet (ﷺ) was dictating to me and said, "O Allah's Apostle! By Allah, if I had the power to fight (in Allah's Cause), I would," and he was a blind man. So Allah revealed to His Apostle while his thigh was on my thigh, and his thigh became so heavy that I was afraid it might fracture my thigh. Then that state of the Prophet (ﷺ) passed and Allah revealed:-- "Except those who are disabled (by injury or are blind or lame etc)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ‏}‏ دَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْدًا فَكَتَبَهَا، فَجَاءَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَشَكَا ضَرَارَتَهُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏غَيْرَ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa nazalat ‏{‏laa yastawiy alqaa'iduwna mina almuuminiyna‏}‏ da'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm zaydana fakatabahaa, fajaa'a abnu aummi maktuwmin fashakaa daraaratahu, faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏ghayra auwliy alddarari‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:When the Verse:-- "Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home)" (4.95) was revealed, Allah's Apostle called for Zaid who wrote it. In the meantime Ibn Um Maktum came and complained of his blindness, so Allah revealed: "Except those who are disabled (by injury or are blind or lame..." etc)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ‏}‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ادْعُوا فُلاَنًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَاءَهُ وَمَعَهُ الدَّوَاةُ وَاللَّوْحُ أَوِ الْكَتِفُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اكْتُبْ لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَخَلْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَا ضَرِيرٌ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ مَكَانَهَا ‏{‏لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ غَيْرُ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ وَالْمُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala lammaa nazalat ‏{‏laa yastawiy alqaa'iduwna mina almuuminiyna‏}‏ qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ ad'uwa fulaanana ‏"‏‏.‏ fajaa'ahu wama'ahu alddawaaau waalllawhu aawi alkatifu faqaala ‏"‏ aktub laa yastawiy alqaa'iduwna mina almuuminiyna waalmujaahiduwna fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ wakhalfa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm abnu aummi maktuwmin faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aanaa dariyrun‏.‏ fanazalat makaanahaa ‏{‏laa yastawiy alqaa'iduwna mina almuuminiyna ghayru auwliy alddarari waalmujaahiduwna fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:When the Verse:--"Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home)," (4.95) was revealed, the Prophet said, "Call so-and-so." That person came to him with an ink-pot and a wooden board or a shoulder scapula bone. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Write: 'Not equal are those believers who sit (at home) and those who strive and fight in the Cause of Allah." Ibn Um Maktum who was sitting behind the Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am a blind man." So there was revealed in the place of that Verse, the Verse:--"Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home) except those who are disabled (by injury, or are blind or lame etc.) and those who strive and fight in the Cause of Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ ح، وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ، أَنَّ مِقْسَمًا، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ ‏{‏لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ‏}‏ عَنْ بَدْرٍ وَالْخَارِجُونَ إِلَى بَدْرٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, aanna abna jurayjin, aakhbarahum h, wahaddathaniy iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'abdu alkariymi, aanna miqsamana, mawlaa 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi aakhbarahu aanna abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aakhbarahu ‏{‏laa yastawiy alqaa'iduwna mina almuuminiyna‏}‏ 'an badrin waalkhaarijuwna iilaa badrin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Not equal are those believers who sat (at home) and did not join the Badr battle and those who joined the Badr battle
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ، وَغَيْرُهُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَبُو الأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ قُطِعَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ بَعْثٌ فَاكْتُتِبْتُ فِيهِ، فَلَقِيتُ عِكْرِمَةَ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ، فَنَهَانِي عَنْ ذَلِكَ أَشَدَّ النَّهْىِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ نَاسًا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَانُوا مَعَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ يُكَثِّرُونَ سَوَادَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْتِي السَّهْمُ فَيُرْمَى بِهِ، فَيُصِيبُ أَحَدَهُمْ فَيَقْتُلُهُ أَوْ يُضْرَبُ فَيُقْتَلُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ ظَالِمِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏ رَوَاهُ اللَّيْثُ عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda almuqriiu, haddathanaa haywaau, waghayruhu, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani aabuw alaaswadi, qaala quti'a 'alaa aahli almadiynaai ba'thun faaktutibtu fiyhi, falaqiytu 'ikrimaaa mawlaa abni 'abbaasin faaakhbartuhu, fanahaaniy 'an dhalika aashadda alnnahai, thumma qaala aakhbaraniy abnu 'abbaasin aanna naasana mina almuslimiyna kaanuwa ma'a almushrikiyna yukathhiruwna sawaada almushrikiyna 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaatiy alssahmu fayurmaa bihi, fayusiybu aahadahum fayaqtuluhu aaw yudrabu fayuqtalu, faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏iinna alladhiyna tawaffaahumu almalaaiikaau zaalimiy aanfusihim‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏ rawaahu alllaythu 'an aabiy alaaswadi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muhammad bin `Abdur-Rahman Abu Al-Aswad:The people of Medina were forced to prepare an army (to fight against the people of Sham during the caliphate of `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair at Mecca), and I was enlisted in it; Then I met `Ikrima, the freed slave of Ibn `Abbas, and informed him (about it), and he forbade me strongly to do so (i.e. to enlist in that army), and then said, "Ibn `Abbas informed me that some Muslim people were with the pagans, increasing the number of the pagans against Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). An arrow used to be shot which would hit one of them (the Muslims in the company of the pagans) and kill him, or he would be struck and killed (with a sword)." Then Allah revealed:-- "Verily! as for those whom the angels take (in death) while they are wronging themselves (by staying among the disbelievers)" (4.97) Abu AlAswad also narrated it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏{‏إِلاَّ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ‏}‏ قَالَ كَانَتْ أُمِّي مِمَّنْ عَذَرَ اللَّهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma ‏{‏iilaaa almustad'afiyna‏}‏ qaala kaanat aummiy mimman 'adhara alllahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:'"Except the weak ones" (4.98) and added: My mother was one of those whom Allah excused
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الْعِشَاءَ إِذْ قَالَ ‏"‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ نَجِّ عَيَّاشَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ، اللَّهُمَّ نَجِّ سَلَمَةَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، اللَّهُمَّ نَجِّ الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَجِّ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ اشْدُدْ وَطْأَتَكَ عَلَى مُضَرَ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا سِنِينَ كَسِنِي يُوسُفَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala baynaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy al'ishaa'a iidh qaala ‏"‏ sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala qabla aan yasjuda ‏"‏ alllahumma najji 'ayyaasha bna aabiy rabiy'aaa, alllahumma najji salamaaa bna hishaamin, alllahumma najji alwaliyda bna alwaliydi, alllahumma najji almustad'afiyna mina almuuminiyna, alllahumma ashdud wataataka 'alaa mudara, alllahumma aj'alhaa siniyna kasiniy yuwsufa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:While the Prophet (ﷺ) was offering the `Isha' prayer, he said, "Allah hears him who sends his praises to Him," and then said before falling in prostration, "O Allah, save `Aiyash bin Rabi`a. O Allah, save Salama bin Hisham. O Allah, save Al-Walid bin Al-Walid. O Allah, save the weak ones among the believers. O Allah, let Your punishment be severe on the tribe of Mudar. O Allah, inflict upon them years (of famine) like the years of Joseph
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يَعْلَى، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏{‏إِنْ كَانَ بِكُمْ أَذًى مِنْ مَطَرٍ أَوْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضَى‏}‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفِ كَانَ جَرِيحًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin aabuw alhasani, aakhbaranaa hajjaajun, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy ya'laa, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma ‏{‏iin kaana bikum aadhana min matarin aaw kuntum mardaa‏}‏ qaala 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'awfi kaana jariyhana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding the Verse: "Because of the inconvenience of rain or because you are ill." (4.102) (It was revealed in connection with) `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf who was wounded
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ ‏{‏وَيَسْتَفْتُونَكَ فِي النِّسَاءِ قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِيهِنَّ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏وَتَرْغَبُونَ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ هُوَ الرَّجُلُ تَكُونُ عِنْدَهُ الْيَتِيمَةُ، هُوَ وَلِيُّهَا وَوَارِثُهَا، فَأَشْرَكَتْهُ فِي مَالِهِ حَتَّى فِي الْعِذْقِ، فَيَرْغَبُ أَنْ يَنْكِحَهَا، وَيَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُزَوِّجَهَا رَجُلاً، فَيَشْرَكُهُ فِي مَالِهِ بِمَا شَرِكَتْهُ فَيَعْضُلَهَا فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha ‏{‏wayastaftuwnaka fiy alnnisaa'i quli alllahu yuftiykum fiyhinna‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏watarghabuwna aan tankihuwhunna‏}‏‏.‏ qaalat huwa alrrajulu takuwnu 'indahu alyatiymaau, huwa waliyyuhaa wawaarithuhaa, faaashrakathu fiy maalihi hattaa fiy al'idhqi, fayarghabu aan yankihahaa, wayakrahu aan yuzawwijahaa rajulaan, fayashrakuhu fiy maalihi bimaa sharikathu faya'dulahaa fanazalat hadhihi alayaau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Regarding the Verse:--"They ask your instruction concerning the women. Say: Allah instructs you about them and yet whom you desire to marry." (4.127) (has been revealed regarding the case of) a man who has an orphan girl, and he is her guardian and her heir. The girl shares with him all his property, even a date-palm (garden), but he dislikes to marry her and dislikes to give her in marriage to somebody else who would share with him the property she is sharing with him, and for this reason that guardian prevents that orphan girl from marrying. So, this Verse was revealed: (And Allah's statement:) "If a woman fears cruelty or desertion on her husband's part
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ ‏{‏وَإِنِ امْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنْ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوْ إِعْرَاضًا‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَتِ الرَّجُلُ تَكُونُ عِنْدَهُ الْمَرْأَةُ لَيْسَ بِمُسْتَكْثِرٍ مِنْهَا يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُفَارِقَهَا فَتَقُولُ أَجْعَلُكَ مِنْ شَأْنِي فِي حِلٍّ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ فِي ذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha ‏{‏waiini amraaaaun khaafat min ba'lihaa nushuwzana aaw ii'raadana‏}‏‏.‏ qaalati alrrajulu takuwnu 'indahu almaraaau laysa bimustakthirin minhaa yuriydu aan yufaariqahaa fataquwlu aaj'aluka min shaaniy fiy hillin‏.‏ fanazalat hadhihi alayaau fiy dhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Regarding the Verse:--"If a woman fears cruelty or desertion on her husband's part." (4.128) It is about a man who has a woman (wife) and he does not like her and wants to divorce her but she says to him, "I make you free as regards myself." So this Verse was revealed in this connection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ كُنَّا فِي حَلْقَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَجَاءَ حُذَيْفَةُ حَتَّى قَامَ عَلَيْنَا، فَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَ النِّفَاقُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ خَيْرٍ مِنْكُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ الأَسْوَدُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ ‏{‏إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِي الدَّرَكِ الأَسْفَلِ مِنَ النَّارِ‏}‏ فَتَبَسَّمَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، وَجَلَسَ حُذَيْفَةُ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَقَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَتَفَرَّقَ أَصْحَابُهُ، فَرَمَانِي بِالْحَصَا، فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ عَجِبْتُ مِنْ ضَحِكِهِ، وَقَدْ عَرَفَ مَا قُلْتُ، لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَ النِّفَاقُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ كَانُوا خَيْرًا مِنْكُمْ، ثُمَّ تَابُوا فَتَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala haddathaniy iibraahiymu, 'ani alaaswadi, qaala kunnaa fiy halqaai 'abdi alllahi fajaa'a hudhayfaau hattaa qaama 'alaynaa, fasallama thumma qaala laqad aunzila alnnifaaqu 'alaa qawmin khayrin minkum‏.‏ qaala alaaswadu subhaana alllahi, iinna alllaha yaquwlu ‏{‏iinna almunaafiqiyna fiy alddaraki alaasfali mina alnnaari‏}‏ fatabassama 'abdu alllahi, wajalasa hudhayfaau fiy naahiyaai almasjidi, faqaama 'abdu alllahi fatafarraqa aashaabuhu, faramaaniy bialhasaa, faaataytuhu faqaala hudhayfaau 'ajibtu min dahikihi, waqad 'arafa maa qultu, laqad aunzila alnnifaaqu 'alaa qawmin kaanuwa khayrana minkum, thumma taabuwa fataaba alllahu 'alayhim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Aswad:While we were sitting in a circle in `Abdullah's gathering, Hudhaifa came and stopped before us, and greeted us and then said, "People better than you became hypocrites." Al-Aswad said: I testify the uniqueness of Allah! Allah says: "Verily! The hypocrites will be in the lowest depths of the Fire." (4.145) On that `Abdullah smiled and Hudhaifa sat somewhere in the Mosque. `Abdullah then got up and his companions (sitting around him) dispersed. Hudhaifa then threw a pebble at me (to attract my attention). I went to him and he said, "I was surprised at `Abdullah's smile though he understood what I said. Verily, people better than you became hypocrites and then repented and Allah forgave them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا يَنْبَغِي لأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَقُولَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَتَّى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, qaala haddathaniy alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa yanbaghiy laahadin aan yaquwla aanaa khayrun min yuwnusa bni mattaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None has the right to say that I am better than Jonah bin Matta
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِلاَلٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَتَّى فَقَدْ كَذَبَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu sinaanin, haddathanaa fulayhun, haddathanaa hilaalun, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man qaala aanaa khayrun min yuwnusa bni mattaa faqad kadhaba ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever says that I am better than Jonah bin Matta, is a liar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
