verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ كُرْدِيدٍ صَاحِبُ الزِّيَادِيِّ ـ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ ‏{‏اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ هَذَا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةً مِنَ السَّمَاءِ أَوِ ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ‏}‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنْتَ فِيهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ * وَمَا لَهُمْ أَنْ لاَ يُعَذِّبَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alhamiydi huwa abnu kurdiydin saahibu alzziyaadiyyi sami'a aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala aabuw jahlin ‏{‏alllahumma iin kaana hadhaa huwa alhaqqa min 'indika faaamtir 'alaynaa hijaaraaan mina alssamaa'i aawi aitinaa bi'adhaabin aaliymin‏}‏ fanazalat ‏{‏wamaa kaana alllahu liyu'adhhibahum waaanta fiyhim wamaa kaana alllahu mu'adhhibahum wahum yastaghfiruwna * wamaa lahum aan laa yu'adhhibahumu alllahu wahum yasudduwna 'ani almasjidi alharaami‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Jahl said, "O Allah! If this (Qur'an) is indeed the Truth from You, then rain down on us a shower of stones from the sky or bring on us a painful torment." So Allah revealed:-- "But Allah would not punish them while you were amongst them, nor He will punish them while they seek (Allah's) forgiveness..." (8.33) And why Allah should not punish them while they turn away (men) from Al- Masjid-al-Haram (the Sacred Mosque of Mecca)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، صَاحِبِ الزِّيَادِيِّ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ ‏{‏اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ هَذَا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةً مِنَ السَّمَاءِ أَوِ ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ‏}‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنْتَ فِيهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ * وَمَا لَهُمْ أَنْ لاَ يُعَذِّبَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu alnnadri, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alhamiydi, saahibi alzziyaadiyyi sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, qaala qaala aabuw jahlin ‏{‏alllahumma iin kaana hadhaa huwa alhaqqa min 'indika faaamtir 'alaynaa hijaaraaan mina alssamaa'i aawi aitinaa bi'adhaabin aaliymin‏}‏ fanazalat ‏{‏wamaa kaana alllahu liyu'adhhibahum waaanta fiyhim wamaa kaana alllahu mu'adhhibahum wahum yastaghfiruwna * wamaa lahum aan laa yu'adhhibahumu alllahu wahum yasudduwna 'ani almasjidi alharaami‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Abu Jahl said, "O Allah! If this (Qur'an) is indeed the Truth from You), then rain down on us a shower of stones from the sky or bring on us a painful punishment." So there was revealed:-- 'But Allah would not punish them while you (Muhammad) were amongst them, nor will He punish them while they seek (Allah's) Forgiveness. And why Allah should not punish them while they stop (men) from Al-Masjid-al-Haram
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، جَاءَهُ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَلاَ تَسْمَعُ مَا ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ فِي كِتَابِهِ ‏{‏وَإِنْ طَائِفَتَانِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اقْتَتَلُوا‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ، فَمَا يَمْنَعُكَ أَنْ لاَ تُقَاتِلَ كَمَا ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ فِي كِتَابِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي أَغْتَرُّ بِهَذِهِ الآيَةِ وَلاَ أُقَاتِلُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ أَغْتَرَّ بِهَذِهِ الآيَةِ الَّتِي يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَمَنْ يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُتَعَمِّدًا‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِهَا‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ ‏{‏وَقَاتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّى لاَ تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ قَدْ فَعَلْنَا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ كَانَ الإِسْلاَمُ قَلِيلاً، فَكَانَ الرَّجُلُ يُفْتَنُ فِي دِينِهِ، إِمَّا يَقْتُلُوهُ وَإِمَّا يُوثِقُوهُ، حَتَّى كَثُرَ الإِسْلاَمُ، فَلَمْ تَكُنْ فِتْنَةٌ، فَلَمَّا رَأَى أَنَّهُ لاَ يُوَافِقُهُ فِيمَا يُرِيدُ قَالَ فَمَا قَوْلُكَ فِي عَلِيٍّ وَعُثْمَانَ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ مَا قَوْلِي فِي عَلِيٍّ وَعُثْمَانَ أَمَّا عُثْمَانُ فَكَانَ اللَّهُ قَدْ عَفَا عَنْهُ، فَكَرِهْتُمْ أَنْ يَعْفُوَ عَنْهُ، وَأَمَّا عَلِيٌّ فَابْنُ عَمِّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَخَتَنُهُ‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ وَهَذِهِ ابْنَتُهُ أَوْ بِنْتُهُ حَيْثُ تَرَوْنَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu 'abdi al'aziyzi, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa haywaau, 'an bakri bni 'amrinw, 'an bukayrin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rajulaan, jaa'ahu faqaala yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani, aalaa tasma'u maa dhakara alllahu fiy kitaabihi ‏{‏waiin taaiifataani mina almuuminiyna aqtataluwa‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai, famaa yamna'uka aan laa tuqaatila kamaa dhakara alllahu fiy kitaabihi‏.‏ faqaala yaa abna aakhiy aaghtarru bihadhihi alayaai walaa auqaatilu aahabbu iilaaaa min aan aaghtarra bihadhihi alayaai allatiy yaquwlu alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏waman yaqtul muuminana muta'ammidana‏}‏ iilaa akhirihaa‏.‏ qaala faiinna alllaha yaquwlu ‏{‏waqaatiluwhum hattaa laa takuwna fitnaaun‏}‏‏.‏ qaala abnu 'umara qad fa'alnaa 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh kaana aliislaamu qaliylaan, fakaana alrrajulu yuftanu fiy diynihi, iimmaa yaqtuluwhu waiimmaa yuwthiquwhu, hattaa kathura aliislaamu, falam takun fitnaaun, falammaa raaaa aannahu laa yuwaafiquhu fiymaa yuriydu qaala famaa qawluka fiy 'aliyyin wa'uthmaana‏.‏ qaala abnu 'umara maa qawliy fiy 'aliyyin wa'uthmaana aammaa 'uthmaanu fakaana alllahu qad 'afaa 'anhu, fakarihtum aan ya'fuwa 'anhu, waaammaa 'aliyyun faabnu 'ammi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakhatanuhu‏.‏ waaashaara biyadihi wahadhihi abnatuhu aaw bintuhu haythu tarawna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:That a man came to him (while two groups of Muslims were fighting) and said, "O Abu `Abdur Rahman! Don't you hear what Allah has mentioned in His Book: 'And if two groups of believers fight against each other...' (49.9) So what prevents you from fighting as Allah has mentioned in His Book?"' Ibn `Umar said, "O son of my brother! I would rather be blamed for not fighting because of this Verse than to be blamed because of another Verse where Allah says: 'And whoever kills a believer intentionally..." (4.93) Then that man said, "Allah says:-- 'And fight them until there is no more afflictions (worshipping other besides Allah) and the religion (i.e. worship) will be all for Allah (Alone)" (8.39) Ibn `Umar said, "We did this during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when the number of Muslims was small, and a man was put to trial because of his religion, the pagans would either kill or chain him; but when the Muslims increased (and Islam spread), there was no persecution." When that man saw that Ibn `Umar did not agree to his proposal, he said, "What is your opinion regarding `Ali and `Uthman?" Ibn `Umar said, "What is my opinion regarding `Ali and `Uthman? As for `Uthman, Allah forgave him and you disliked to forgive him, and `Ali is the cousin and son-in-law of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." Then he pointed out with his hand and said, "And that is his daughter's (house) which you can see
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا بَيَانٌ، أَنَّ وَبَرَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا أَوْ إِلَيْنَا ابْنُ عُمَرَ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ كَيْفَ تَرَى فِي قِتَالِ الْفِتْنَةِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَهَلْ تَدْرِي مَا الْفِتْنَةُ كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُقَاتِلُ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، وَكَانَ الدُّخُولُ عَلَيْهِمْ فِتْنَةً، وَلَيْسَ كَقِتَالِكُمْ عَلَى الْمُلْكِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa bayaanun, aanna wabaraaa, haddathahu qaala haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu jubayrin, qaala kharaja 'alaynaa aaw iilaynaa abnu 'umara, faqaala rajulun kayfa taraa fiy qitaali alfitnaai‏.‏ faqaala wahal tadriy maa alfitnaau kaana muhammadun sla allh 'lyh wslm yuqaatilu almushrikiyna, wakaana alddukhuwlu 'alayhim fitnaaan, walaysa kaqitaalikum 'alaa almulki‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Ibn `Umar came to us and a man said (to him), "What do you think about 'Qit-alal-Fitnah' (fighting caused by afflictions)." Ibn `Umar said (to him), "And do you understand what an affliction is? Muhammad used to fight against the pagans, and his fighting with them was an affliction, (and his fighting was) not like your fighting which is carried on for the sake of ruling
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏إِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَابِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوا مِائَتَيْنِ‏}‏ فَكُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ لاَ يَفِرَّ وَاحِدٌ مِنْ عَشَرَةٍ ـ فَقَالَ سُفْيَانُ غَيْرَ مَرَّةٍ أَنْ لاَ يَفِرَّ عِشْرُونَ مِنْ مِائَتَيْنِ ـ ثُمَّ نَزَلَتِ ‏{‏الآنَ خَفَّفَ اللَّهُ عَنْكُمُ‏}‏ الآيَةَ، فَكَتَبَ أَنْ لاَ يَفِرَّ مِائَةٌ مِنْ مِائَتَيْنِ ـ زَادَ سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً ـ نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏حَرِّضِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى الْقِتَالِ إِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَابِرُونَ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَقَالَ ابْنُ شُبْرُمَةَ وَأُرَى الأَمْرَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهْىَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ مِثْلَ هَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma lammaa nazalat ‏{‏iin yakun minkum 'ishruwna saabiruwna yaghlibuwa miaiatayni‏}‏ fakutiba 'alayhim aan laa yafirra waahidun min 'asharaain faqaala sufyaanu ghayra marraain aan laa yafirra 'ishruwna min miaiatayni thumma nazalati ‏{‏alana khaffafa alllahu 'ankumu‏}‏ alayaaa, fakataba aan laa yafirra miaiaaun min miaiatayni zaada sufyaanu marraaan nazalat ‏{‏harridi almuuminiyna 'alaa alqitaali iin yakun minkum 'ishruwna saabiruwna‏}‏‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu waqaala abnu shubrumaaa waauraa alaamra bialma'ruwfi waalnnahaa 'ani almunkari mithla hadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Verse:-- "If there are twenty steadfast amongst you, they will overcome two hundred." (8.65) was revealed, then it became obligatory for the Muslims that one (Muslim) should not flee from ten (non-Muslims). Sufyan (the sub-narrator) once said, "Twenty (Muslims) should not flee before two hundred (non Muslims)." Then there was revealed: 'But now Allah has lightened your (task)..' (8.66) So it became obligatory that one-hundred (Muslims) should not flee before two hundred (nonmuslims). (Once Sufyan said extra, "The Verse: 'Urge the believers to the fight. If there are twenty steadfast amongst you (Muslims) ..' was revealed.) Sufyan said, "Ibn Shubruma said, "I see that this order is applicable to the obligation of enjoining good and forbidding evil
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ السُّلَمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الزُّبَيْرُ بْنُ خِرِّيتٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏إِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَابِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوا مِائَتَيْنِ‏}‏ شَقَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ حِينَ فُرِضَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ لاَ يَفِرَّ وَاحِدٌ مِنْ عَشَرَةٍ، فَجَاءَ التَّخْفِيفُ فَقَالَ رالآنَ خَفَّفَ اللَّهُ عَنْكُمْ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضُعْفًا فَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ مِائَةٌ صَابِرَةٌ يَغْلِبُوا مِائَتَيْنِ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا خَفَّفَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ مِنَ الْعِدَّةِ نَقَصَ مِنَ الصَّبْرِ بِقَدْرِ مَا خُفِّفَ عَنْهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu 'abdi alllahi alssulamiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu almubaaraki, aakhbaranaa jariyru bnu haazimin, qaala aakhbaraniy alzzubayru bnu khirriytin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala lammaa nazalat ‏{‏iin yakun minkum 'ishruwna saabiruwna yaghlibuwa miaiatayni‏}‏ shaqqa dhalika 'alaa almuslimiyna hiyna furida 'alayhim aan laa yafirra waahidun min 'asharaain, fajaa'a alttakhfiyfu faqaala ralana khaffafa alllahu 'ankum wa'alima aanna fiykum du'fana faiin yakun minkum miaiaaun saabiraaun yaghlibuwa miaiatayni‏}‏‏.‏ qaala falammaa khaffafa alllahu 'anhum mina al'iddaai naqasa mina alssabri biqadri maa khuffifa 'anhum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Verse:--'If there are twenty steadfast amongst you (Muslims), they will overcome two-hundred (non-Muslims).' was revealed, it became hard on the Muslims when it became compulsory that one Muslim ought not to flee (in war) before ten (non-Muslims). So (Allah) lightened the order by revealing: '(But) now Allah has lightened your (task) for He knows that there is weakness in you. So if there are of you one-hundred steadfast, they will overcome (two-hundred (non-Muslims).' (8.66) So when Allah reduced the number of enemies which Muslims should withstand, their patience and perseverance against the enemy decreased as much as their task was lightened for them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ آخِرُ آيَةٍ نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏يَسْتَفْتُونَكَ قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِي الْكَلاَلَةِ‏}‏ وَآخِرُ سُورَةٍ نَزَلَتْ بَرَاءَةٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a rda allh 'nh yaquwlu akhiru ayaain nazalat ‏{‏yastaftuwnaka quli alllahu yuftiykum fiy alkalaalaai‏}‏ waakhiru suwraain nazalat baraa'aaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:The last Verse that was revealed was: 'They ask you for a legal verdict: Say: Allah directs (thus) about Al-Kalalah (those who leave no descendants or ascendants as heirs).' And the last Sura which was revealed was Baraatun
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، وَأَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَعَثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي تِلْكَ الْحَجَّةِ فِي مُؤَذِّنِينَ، بَعَثَهُمْ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ يُؤَذِّنُونَ بِمِنًى أَنْ لاَ يَحُجَّ بَعْدَ الْعَامِ مُشْرِكٌ، وَلاَ يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ‏.‏ قَالَ حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ثُمَّ أَرْدَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ بِبَرَاءَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَأَذَّنَ مَعَنَا عَلِيٌّ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ فِي أَهْلِ مِنًى بِبَرَاءَةَ، وَأَنْ لاَ يَحُجَّ بَعْدَ الْعَامِ مُشْرِكٌ، وَلاَ يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ufayrin, qaala haddathaniy alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylun, 'ani abni shihaabin, waaakhbaraniy humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala ba'athaniy aabuw bakrin fiy tilka alhajjaai fiy muuadhhiniyna, ba'athahum yawma alnnahri yuuadhhinuwna biminana aan laa yahujja ba'da al'aami mushrikun, walaa yatuwfa bialbayti 'uryaanun‏.‏ qaala humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani thumma aardafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'aliyyi bni aabiy taalibin, waaamarahu aan yuuadhhina bibaraa'aaa‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa faaadhhana ma'anaa 'aliyyun yawma alnnahri fiy aahli minana bibaraa'aaa, waaan laa yahujja ba'da al'aami mushrikun, walaa yatuwfa bialbayti 'uryaanun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Humaid bin `Abdur-Rahman:Abu Huraira said, "During that Hajj (in which Abu Bakr was the chief of the pilgrims) Abu Bakr sent me along with announcers on the Day of Nahr ( 10th of Dhul-Hijja) in Mina to announce: "No pagans shall perform, Hajj after this year, and none shall perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba in a naked state." Humaid bin `Abdur Rahman added: Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent `Ali bin Abi Talib (after Abu Bakr) and ordered him to recite aloud in public Surat Bara'a. Abu Huraira added, "So `Ali, along with us, recited Bara'a (loudly) before the people at Mina on the Day of Nahr and announced; "No pagan shall perform Hajj after this year and none shall perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba in a naked state
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَأَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ بَعَثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فِي تِلْكَ الْحَجَّةِ فِي الْمُؤَذِّنِينَ، بَعَثَهُمْ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ يُؤَذِّنُونَ بِمِنًى أَنْ لاَ يَحُجَّ بَعْدَ الْعَامِ مُشْرِكٌ، وَلاَ يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ‏.‏ قَالَ حُمَيْدٌ ثُمَّ أَرْدَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ بِبَرَاءَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَأَذَّنَ مَعَنَا عَلِيٌّ فِي أَهْلِ مِنًى يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ بِبَرَاءَةَ، وَأَنْ لاَ يَحُجَّ بَعْدَ الْعَامِ مُشْرِكٌ، وَلاَ يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa alllaythu, haddathaniy 'uqaylun, qaala abnu shihaabin faaakhbaraniy humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala ba'athaniy aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh fiy tilka alhajjaai fiy almuuadhhiniyna, ba'athahum yawma alnnahri yuuadhhinuwna biminana aan laa yahujja ba'da al'aami mushrikun, walaa yatuwfa bialbayti 'uryaanun‏.‏ qaala humaydun thumma aardafa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'aliyyi bni aabiy taalibin, faaamarahu aan yuuadhhina bibaraa'aaa‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa faaadhhana ma'anaa 'aliyyun fiy aahli minana yawma alnnahri bibaraa'aaa, waaan laa yahujja ba'da al'aami mushrikun, walaa yatuwfa bialbayti 'uryaanun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Humaid bin `Abdur Rahman:Abu Huraira said, "Abu Bakr sent me in that Hajj in which he was the chief of the pilgrims along with the announcers whom he sent on the Day of Nahr to announce at Mina: "No pagan shall perform Hajj after this year, and none shall perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba in a naked state." Humaid added: That the Prophet (ﷺ) sent `Ali bin Abi Talib (after Abu Bakr) and ordered him to recite aloud in public Surat-Baraa. Abu Huraira added, "So `Ali, along with us, recited Bara'a (loudly) before the people at Mina on the Day of Nahr and announced "No pagan shall perform Hajj after this year and none shall perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba in a naked state
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ حُمَيْدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ بَعَثَهُ فِي الْحَجَّةِ الَّتِي أَمَّرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ فِي رَهْطٍ يُؤَذِّنُ فِي النَّاسِ أَنْ لاَ يَحُجَّنَّ بَعْدَ الْعَامِ مُشْرِكٌ وَلاَ يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ‏.‏ فَكَانَ حُمَيْدٌ يَقُولُ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ يَوْمُ الْحَجِّ الأَكْبَرِ‏.‏ مِنْ أَجْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna humayda bna 'abdi alrrahmani, aakhbarahu aanna aabaa hurayraaa aakhbarahu aanna aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nh ba'athahu fiy alhajjaai allatiy aammarahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alayhaa qabla hajjaai alwadaa'i fiy rahtin yuuadhhinu fiy alnnaasi aan laa yahujjanna ba'da al'aami mushrikun walaa yatuwfa bialbayti 'uryaanun‏.‏ fakaana humaydun yaquwlu yawmu alnnahri yawmu alhajji alaakbari‏.‏ min aajli hadiythi aabiy hurayraaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Humaid bin `Abdur-Rahman:Abu Huraira said that Abu Bakr sent him during the Hajj in which Abu Bakr was made the chief of the pilgrims by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) before (the year of) Hajjat al-Wada` in a group (of announcers) to announce before the people; 'No pagan shall perform the Hajj after this year, and none shall perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba in a naked state. Humaid used to say The Day of Nahr is the day of Al- Hajj Al-Akbar (the Greatest Day) because of the narration of Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ حُذَيْفَةَ فَقَالَ مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ إِلاَّ ثَلاَثَةٌ، وَلاَ مِنَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ إِلاَّ أَرْبَعَةٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِنَّكُمْ أَصْحَابَ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم تُخْبِرُونَا فَلاَ نَدْرِي فَمَا بَالُ هَؤُلاَءِ الَّذِينَ يَبْقُرُونَ بُيُوتَنَا وَيَسْرِقُونَ أَعْلاَقَنَا‏.‏ قَالَ أُولَئِكَ الْفُسَّاقُ، أَجَلْ لَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ أَرْبَعَةٌ‏.‏ أَحَدُهُمْ شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ لَوْ شَرِبَ الْمَاءَ الْبَارِدَ لَمَا وَجَدَ بَرْدَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathanaa zaydu bnu wahbin, qaala kunnaa 'inda hudhayfaaa faqaala maa baqiya min aashaabi hadhihi alayaai iilaaa thalaathaaun, walaa mina almunaafiqiyna iilaaa aarba'aaun‏.‏ faqaala aa'raabiyyun iinnakum aashaaba muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm tukhbiruwnaa falaa nadriy famaa baalu hauulaa'i alladhiyna yabquruwna buyuwtanaa wayasriquwna aa'laaqanaa‏.‏ qaala auwlaiika alfussaaqu, aajal lam yabqa minhum iilaaa aarba'aaun‏.‏ aahaduhum shaykhun kabiyrun law shariba almaa'a albaarida lamaa wajada bardahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Wahb:We were with Hudhaifa and he said, "None remains of the people described by this Verse (9.12), except three, and of the hypocrites except four." A bedouin said, "You the companions of Muhammad! Tell us (things) and we do not know that about those who break open our houses and steal our precious things? ' He (Hudhaifa) replied, "Those are Al Fussaq (rebellious wrongdoers) (not disbelievers or hypocrites). Really, none remains of them (hypocrite) but four, one of whom is a very old man who, if he drinks water, does not feel its coldness
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يَكُونُ كَنْزُ أَحَدِكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ شُجَاعًا أَقْرَعَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhakamu bnu naafi'in, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, aanna 'abda alrrahmani alaa'raja, haddathahu aannahu, qaala haddathaniy aabuw hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yakuwnu kanzu aahadikum yawma alqiyaamaai shujaa'ana aaqra'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Kanz (money, the Zakat of which is not paid) of anyone of you will appear in the form of bald-headed poisonous male snake on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ مَرَرْتُ عَلَى أَبِي ذَرٍّ بِالرَّبَذَةِ فَقُلْتُ مَا أَنْزَلَكَ بِهَذِهِ الأَرْضِ قَالَ كُنَّا بِالشَّأْمِ فَقَرَأْتُ ‏{‏وَالَّذِينَ يَكْنِزُونَ الذَّهَبَ وَالْفِضَّةَ وَلاَ يُنْفِقُونَهَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ‏}‏ قَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ مَا هَذِهِ فِينَا، مَا هَذِهِ إِلاَّ فِي أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ إِنَّهَا لَفِينَا وَفِيهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an husaynin, 'an zaydi bni wahbin, qaala marartu 'alaa aabiy dharrin bialrrabadhaai faqultu maa aanzalaka bihadhihi alaardi qaala kunnaa bialshhaami faqaraatu ‏{‏waalladhiyna yaknizuwna aldhhahaba waalfiddaaa walaa yunfiquwnahaa fiy sabiyli alllahi fabashhirhum bi'adhaabin aaliymin‏}‏ qaala mu'aawiyaau maa hadhihi fiynaa, maa hadhihi iilaaa fiy aahli alkitaabi‏.‏ qaala qultu iinnahaa lafiynaa wafiyhim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Wahb:I passed by (visited ) Abu Dhar at Ar-Rabadha and said to him, "What has brought you to this land?" He said, "We were at Sham and I recited the Verse: "They who hoard up gold and silver and spend them not in the way of Allah; announce to them a painful torment, " (9.34) where upon Muawiya said, 'This Verse is not for us, but for the people of the Scripture.' Then I said, 'But it is both for us (Muslims) and for them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: وَقَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ شَبِيبِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ هَذَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُنْزَلَ، الزَّكَاةُ، فَلَمَّا أُنْزِلَتْ جَعَلَهَا اللَّهُ طُهْرًا لِلأَمْوَالِ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala aahmadu bnu shabiybi bni sa'iydin haddathanaa aabiy, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an khaalidi bni aaslama, qaala kharajnaa ma'a 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara faqaala hadhaa qabla aan tunzala, alzzakaaau, falammaa aunzilat ja'alahaa alllahu tuhrana lilaamwaali‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Khãlid bin Aslam:We went out with 'Abdullãh bin 'Umar and he said, "This (Verse) was revealed before the prescription of Zakat, and when Zakãt was prescribed, Allah made it a means of purifying one's wealth
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الزَّمَانَ قَدِ اسْتَدَارَ كَهَيْئَتِهِ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ، السَّنَةُ اثْنَا عَشَرَ شَهْرًا مِنْهَا، أَرْبَعَةٌ حُرُمٌ، ثَلاَثٌ مُتَوَالِيَاتٌ، ذُو الْقَعْدَةِ وَذُو الْحِجَّةِ وَالْمُحَرَّمُ وَرَجَبُ مُضَرَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ جُمَادَى وَشَعْبَانَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alwahhaabi, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, 'ani abni aabiy bakraaa, 'an aabiy bakraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alzzamaana qadi astadaara kahayiatihi yawma khalaqa alllahu alssamawaati waalaarda, alssanaau athnaa 'ashara shahrana minhaa, aarba'aaun hurumun, thalaathun mutawaaliyaatun, dhuw alqa'daai wadhuw alhijjaai waalmuharramu warajabu mudara alladhiy bayna jumaadaa washa'baana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakr:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Time has come back to its original state which it had when Allah created the Heavens and the Earth; the year is twelve months, four of which are sacred. Three of them are in succession; Dhul-Qa'da, Dhul-Hijja and Al-Muharram, and (the fourth being) Rajab Mudar (named after the tribe of Mudar as they used to respect this month) which stands between Jumad (ath-thani) and Sha'ban
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْغَارِ، فَرَأَيْتُ آثَارَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَهُمْ رَفَعَ قَدَمَهُ رَآنَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا ظَنُّكَ بِاثْنَيْنِ اللَّهُ ثَالِثُهُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa habbaanu, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa thaabitun, haddathanaa aanasun, qaala haddathaniy aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh qaala kuntu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alghaari, faraaaytu athaara almushrikiyna qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, law aanna aahadahum rafa'a qadamahu raanaa‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ maa zannuka biathnayni alllahu thaalithuhumaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakr:I was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) in the cave, and on seeing the traces of the pagans, I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) If one of them (pagans) should lift up his foot, he will see us." He said, "What do you think of two, the third of whom is Allah?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ حِينَ وَقَعَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ قُلْتُ أَبُوهُ الزُّبَيْرُ، وَأُمُّهُ أَسْمَاءُ، وَخَالَتُهُ عَائِشَةُ، وَجَدُّهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَجَدَّتُهُ صَفِيَّةُ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لِسُفْيَانَ إِسْنَادُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنَا، فَشَغَلَهُ إِنْسَانٌ وَلَمْ يَقُلِ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aannahu qaala hiyna waqa'a baynahu wabayna abni alzzubayri qultu aabuwhu alzzubayru, waaummuhu aasmaa'u, wakhaalatuhu 'aaiishaau, wajadduhu aabuw bakrin, wajaddatuhu safiyyaau‏.‏ faqultu lisufyaana iisnaaduhu‏.‏ faqaala haddathanaa, fashaghalahu iinsaanun walam yaquli abnu jurayjin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:When there happened the disagreement between Ibn Az-Zubair and Ibn `Abbas, I said (to the latter), "(Why don't you take the oath of allegiance to him as) his father is Az-Zubair, and his mother is Asma,' and his aunt is `Aisha, and his maternal grandfather is Abu Bakr, and his grandmother is Safiya?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ مَعِينٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ وَكَانَ بَيْنَهُمَا شَىْءٌ فَغَدَوْتُ عَلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْتُ أَتُرِيدُ أَنْ تُقَاتِلَ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، فَتُحِلُّ حَرَمَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ وَبَنِي أُمَيَّةَ مُحِلِّينَ، وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لاَ أُحِلُّهُ أَبَدًا‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ النَّاسُ بَايِعْ لاِبْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ وَأَيْنَ بِهَذَا الأَمْرِ عَنْهُ أَمَّا أَبُوهُ فَحَوَارِيُّ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يُرِيدُ الزُّبَيْرَ، وَأَمَّا جَدُّهُ فَصَاحِبُ الْغَارِ، يُرِيدُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، وَأُمُّهُ فَذَاتُ النِّطَاقِ، يُرِيدُ أَسْمَاءَ، وَأَمَّا خَالَتُهُ فَأُمُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، يُرِيدُ عَائِشَةَ، وَأَمَّا عَمَّتُهُ فَزَوْجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يُرِيدُ خَدِيجَةَ، وَأَمَّا عَمَّةُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَدَّتُهُ، يُرِيدُ صَفِيَّةَ، ثُمَّ عَفِيفٌ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ، قَارِئٌ لِلْقُرْآنِ‏.‏ وَاللَّهِ إِنْ وَصَلُونِي وَصَلُونِي مِنْ قَرِيبٍ، وَإِنْ رَبُّونِي رَبَّنِي أَكْفَاءٌ كِرَامٌ، فَآثَرَ التُّوَيْتَاتِ وَالأُسَامَاتِ وَالْحُمَيْدَاتِ، يُرِيدُ أَبْطُنًا مِنْ بَنِي أَسَدٍ بَنِي تُوَيْتٍ وَبَنِي أُسَامَةَ وَبَنِي أَسَدٍ، إِنَّ ابْنَ أَبِي الْعَاصِ بَرَزَ يَمْشِي الْقُدَمِيَّةَ، يَعْنِي عَبْدَ الْمَلِكِ بْنَ مَرْوَانَ، وَإِنَّهُ لَوَّى ذَنَبَهُ، يَعْنِي ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa bnu ma'iynin, haddathanaa hajjaajun, qaala abnu jurayjin qaala abnu aabiy mulaykaaa wakaana baynahumaa shaa'un faghadawtu 'alaa abni 'abbaasin faqultu aaturiydu aan tuqaatila abna alzzubayri, fatuhillu harama alllahi‏.‏ faqaala ma'aadha alllahi, iinna alllaha kataba abna alzzubayri wabaniy aumayyaaa muhilliyna, waiinniy waalllahi laa auhilluhu aabadana‏.‏ qaala qaala alnnaasu baayi' laibni alzzubayri‏.‏ faqultu waaayna bihadhaa alaamri 'anhu aammaa aabuwhu fahawaariyyu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, yuriydu alzzubayra, waaammaa jadduhu fasaahibu alghaari, yuriydu aabaa bakrin, waaummuhu fadhaatu alnnitaaqi, yuriydu aasmaa'a, waaammaa khaalatuhu faaummu almuuminiyna, yuriydu 'aaiishaaa, waaammaa 'ammatuhu fazawju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, yuriydu khadiyjaaa, waaammaa 'ammaau alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajaddatuhu, yuriydu safiyyaaa, thumma 'afiyfun fiy aliislaami, qaariiun lilqurani‏.‏ waalllahi iin wasaluwniy wasaluwniy min qariybin, waiin rabbuwniy rabbaniy aakfaa'un kiraamun, faathara alttuwaytaati waalausaamaati waalhumaydaati, yuriydu aabtunana min baniy aasadin baniy tuwaytin wabaniy ausaamaaa wabaniy aasadin, iinna abna aabiy al'aasi baraza yamshiy alqudamiyyaaa, ya'niy 'abda almaliki bna marwaana, waiinnahu lawwaa dhanabahu, ya'niy abna alzzubayri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:There was a disagreement between them (i.e. Ibn `Abbas and Ibn Az-Zubair) so I went to Ibn `Abbas in the morning and said (to him), "Do you want to fight against Ibn Az-Zubair and thus make lawful what Allah has made unlawful (i.e. fighting in Mecca)?" Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah forbid! Allah ordained that Ibn Az-Zubair and Bani Umaiya would permit (fighting in Mecca), but by Allah, I will never regard it as permissible." Ibn `Abbas added. "The people asked me to take the oath of allegiance to Ibn Az-Zubair. I said, 'He is really entitled to assume authority for his father, Az-Zubair was the helper of the Prophet, his (maternal) grandfather, Abu Bakr was (the Prophet's) companion in the cave, his mother, Asma' was 'Dhatun-Nitaq', his aunt, `Aisha was the mother of the Believers, his paternal aunt, Khadija was the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) , and the paternal aunt of the Prophet (ﷺ) was his grandmother. He himself is pious and chaste in Islam, well versed in the Knowledge of the Qur'an. By Allah! (Really, I left my relatives, Bani Umaiya for his sake though) they are my close relatives, and if they should be my rulers, they are equally apt to be so and are descended from a noble family
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، دَخَلْنَا عَلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ أَلاَ تَعْجَبُونَ لاِبْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ قَامَ فِي أَمْرِهِ هَذَا فَقُلْتُ لأُحَاسِبَنَّ نَفْسِي لَهُ مَا حَاسَبْتُهَا لأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَلاَ لِعُمَرَ، وَلَهُمَا كَانَا أَوْلَى بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ مِنْهُ، وَقُلْتُ ابْنُ عَمَّةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَابْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَابْنُ أَخِي خَدِيجَةَ، وَابْنُ أُخْتِ عَائِشَةَ فَإِذَا هُوَ يَتَعَلَّى عَنِّي وَلاَ يُرِيدُ ذَلِكَ فَقُلْتُ مَا كُنْتُ أَظُنُّ أَنِّي أَعْرِضُ هَذَا مِنْ نَفْسِي، فَيَدَعُهُ، وَمَا أُرَاهُ يُرِيدُ خَيْرًا، وَإِنْ كَانَ لاَ بُدَّ لأَنْ يَرُبَّنِي بَنُو عَمِّي أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ يَرُبَّنِي غَيْرُهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydi bni maymuwnin, haddathanaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, 'an 'umara bni sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu aabiy mulaykaaa, dakhalnaa 'alaa abni 'abbaasin faqaala aalaa ta'jabuwna laibni alzzubayri qaama fiy aamrihi hadhaa faqultu lauhaasibanna nafsiy lahu maa haasabtuhaa laabiy bakrin walaa li'umara, walahumaa kaanaa aawlaa bikulli khayrin minhu, waqultu abnu 'ammaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, waabnu alzzubayri, waabnu aabiy bakrin, waabnu aakhiy khadiyjaaa, waabnu aukhti 'aaiishaaa faiidhaa huwa yata'allaa 'anniy walaa yuriydu dhalika faqultu maa kuntu aazunnu aanniy aa'ridu hadhaa min nafsiy, fayada'uhu, wamaa auraahu yuriydu khayrana, waiin kaana laa budda laan yarubbaniy banuw 'ammiy aahabbu iilaaaa min aan yarubbaniy ghayruhum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:We entered upon Ibn `Abbas and he said "Are you not astonished at Ibn Az-Zubair's assuming the caliphate?" I said (to myself), "I will support him and speak of his good traits as I did not do even for Abu Bakr and `Umar though they were more entitled to receive all good than he was." I said "He (i.e Ibn Az-Zubair) is the son of the aunt of the Prophet (ﷺ) and the son of Az-Zubair, and the grandson of Abu Bakr and the son of Khadija's brother, and the son of `Aisha's sister." Nevertheless, he considers himself to be superior to me and does not want me to be one of his friends. So I said, "I never expected that he would refuse my offer to support him, and I don't think he intends to do me any good, therefore, if my cousins should inevitably be my rulers, it will be better for me to be ruled by them than by some others
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نُعْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيد ٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بُعِثَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشَىْءٍ، فَقَسَمَهُ بَيْنَ أَرْبَعَةٍ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَأَلَّفُهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مَا عَدَلْتَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ ضِئْضِئِ هَذَا قَوْمٌ يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ الدِّينِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni aabiy nu'min, 'an aabiy sa'iyd in rda allh 'nh qaala bu'itha iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bishaa'in, faqasamahu bayna aarba'aain waqaala ‏"‏ aataaallafuhum ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala rajulun maa 'adalta‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ yakhruju min diidiii hadhaa qawmun yamruquwna mina alddiyni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id:Something was sent to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he distributed it amongst four (men) and said, "I want to attract their hearts,(to Islam thereby)," A man said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "You have not done justice." Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There will emerge from the offspring of this (man) some people who will renounce the religion
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا أُمِرْنَا بِالصَّدَقَةِ كُنَّا نَتَحَامَلُ فَجَاءَ أَبُو عَقِيلٍ بِنِصْفِ صَاعٍ، وَجَاءَ إِنْسَانٌ بِأَكْثَرَ مِنْهُ، فَقَالَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنْ صَدَقَةِ هَذَا، وَمَا فَعَلَ هَذَا الآخَرُ إِلاَّ رِئَاءً‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏الَّذِينَ يَلْمِزُونَ الْمُطَّوِّعِينَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي الصَّدَقَاتِ وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَجِدُونَ إِلاَّ جُهْدَهُمْ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy bishru bnu khaalidin aabuw muhammadin, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an sulaymaana, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin, qaala lammaa aumirnaa bialssadaqaai kunnaa natahaamalu fajaa'a aabuw 'aqiylin binisfi saa'in, wajaa'a iinsaanun biaakthara minhu, faqaala almunaafiquwna iinna alllaha laghaniyyun 'an sadaqaai hadhaa, wamaa fa'ala hadhaa alakharu iilaaa riiaa'an‏.‏ fanazalat ‏{‏alladhiyna yalmizuwna almuttawwi'iyna mina almuuminiyna fiy alssadaqaati waalladhiyna laa yajiduwna iilaaa juhdahum‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:When we were ordered to give alms, we began to work as porters (to earn something we could give in charity). Abu `Aqil came with one half of a Sa` (special measure for food grains) and another person brought more than he did. So the hypocrites said, "Allah is not in need of the alms of this (i.e. Abu `Aqil); and this other person did not give alms but for showing off." Then Allah revealed:-- 'Those who criticize such of the Believers who give charity voluntarily and those who could not find to give in charity except what is available to them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَبِي أُسَامَةَ أَحَدَّثَكُمْ زَائِدَةُ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ شَقِيقٍ عَنْ أَب��ي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُ بِالصَّدَقَةِ، فَيَحْتَالُ أَحَدُنَا حَتَّى يَجِيءَ بِالْمُدِّ، وَإِنَّ لأَحَدِهِمِ الْيَوْمَ مِائَةَ أَلْفٍ‏.‏ كَأَنَّهُ يُعَرِّضُ بِنَفْسِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala qultu laabiy ausaamaaa aahaddathakum zaaiidaau 'an sulaymaana 'an shaqiyqin 'an aab��y mas'uwdin alaansaariyyi qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaamuru bialssadaqaai, fayahtaalu aahadunaa hattaa yajiy'a bialmuddi, waiinna laahadihimi alyawma miaiaaa aalfin‏.‏ kaaannahu yu'arridu binafsihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Shaqiq:Abu Mas`ud Al-Ansari said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), used to order us to give alms. So one of us would exert himself to earn one Mud (special measure of wheat or dates, etc.,) to give in charity; while today one of us may have one hundred thousand." Shaqiq said: As if Abu Masud referred to himself
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ جَاءَ ابْنُهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ أَنْ يُعْطِيَهُ قَمِيصَهُ يُكَفِّنُ فِيهِ أَبَاهُ فَأَعْطَاهُ، ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُصَلِّيَ فَقَامَ عُمَرُ فَأَخَذَ بِثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَقَدْ نَهَاكَ رَبُّكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا خَيَّرَنِي اللَّهُ فَقَالَ ‏{‏اسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ أَوْ لاَ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ إِنْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً‏}‏ وَسَأَزِيدُهُ عَلَى السَّبْعِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهُ مُنَافِقٌ‏.‏ قَالَ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏وَلاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا وَلاَ تَقُمْ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, 'an aabiy ausaamaaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala lammaa tuwuffiya 'abdu alllahi jaa'a abnuhu 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahu aan yu'tiyahu qamiysahu yukaffinu fiyhi aabaahu faaa'taahu, thumma saaalahu aan yusalliya 'alayhi, faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm liyusalliya faqaama 'umaru faaakhadha bithawbi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi tusalliy 'alayhi waqad nahaaka rabbuka aan tusalliya 'alayhi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnamaa khayyaraniy alllahu faqaala ‏{‏astaghfir lahum aaw laa tastaghfir lahum iin tastaghfir lahum sab'iyna marraaan‏}‏ wasaaaziyduhu 'alaa alssab'iyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala iinnahu munaafiqun‏.‏ qaala fasallaa 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏walaa tusalli 'alaa aahadin minhum maata aabadana walaa taqum 'alaa qabrihi‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When `Abdullah bin 'Ubai died, his son `Abdullah bin `Abdullah came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and asked him to give him his shirt in order to shroud his father in it. He gave it to him and then `Abdullah asked the Prophet (ﷺ) to offer the funeral prayer for him (his father). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up to offer the funeral prayer for him, but `Umar got up too and got hold of the garment of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Will you offer the funeral prayer for him though your Lord has forbidden you to offer the prayer for him" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "But Allah has given me the choice by saying: '(Whether you) ask forgiveness for them, or do not ask forgiveness for them; even if you ask forgiveness for them seventy times..' (9.80) so I will ask more than seventy times." `Umar said, "But he (`Abdullah bin 'Ubai) is a hypocrite!" However, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did offer the funeral prayer for him whereupon Allah revealed: 'And never (O Muhammad) pray for anyone of them that dies, nor stand at his grave
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لَمَّا مَاتَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ ابْنُ سَلُولَ دُعِيَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَثَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ، فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَتُصَلِّي عَلَى ابْنِ أُبَىٍّ وَقَدْ قَالَ يَوْمَ كَذَا كَذَا وَكَذَا قَالَ أُعَدِّدُ عَلَيْهِ قَوْلَهُ، فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَخِّرْ عَنِّي يَا عُمَرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَكْثَرْتُ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي خُيِّرْتُ فَاخْتَرْتُ، لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنِّي إِنْ زِدْتُ عَلَى السَّبْعِينَ يُغْفَرْ لَهُ لَزِدْتُ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَلَمْ يَمْكُثْ إِلاَّ يَسِيرًا حَتَّى نَزَلَتِ الآيَتَانِ مِنْ بَرَاءَةَ ‏{‏وَلاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏وَهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ‏}‏ قَالَ فَعَجِبْتُ بَعْدُ مِنْ جُرْأَتِي عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, ‏.‏ waqaala ghayruhu haddathaniy alllaythu, haddathaniy 'uqaylun, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an 'umara bni alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh aannahu qaala lammaa maata 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain abnu saluwla du'iya lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm liyusalliya 'alayhi falammaa qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wathabtu iilayhi, faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, aatusalliy 'alaa abni aubaaain waqad qaala yawma kadhaa kadhaa wakadhaa qaala au'addidu 'alayhi qawlahu, fatabassama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala ‏"‏ aakhhir 'anniy yaa 'umaru ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa aakthartu 'alayhi qaala ‏"‏ iinniy khuyyirtu faakhtartu, law aa'lamu aanniy iin zidtu 'alaa alssab'iyna yughfar lahu lazidtu 'alayhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fasallaa 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma ansarafa falam yamkuth iilaaa yasiyrana hattaa nazalati alayataani min baraa'aaa ‏{‏walaa tusalli 'alaa aahadin minhum maata aabadana‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏wahum faasiquwna‏}‏ qaala fa'ajibtu ba'du min juraatiy 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:When `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul died, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was called in order to offer the funeral prayer for him. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up (to offer the prayer) I jumped towards him and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Do you offer the prayer for Ibn Ubai although he said so-and-so on such-and-such-a day?" I went on mentioning his sayings. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled and said, "Keep away from me, O `Umar!" But when I spoke too much to him, he said, "I have been given the choice, and I have chosen (this) ; and if I knew that if I asked forgiveness for him more than seventy times, he would be forgiven, I would ask it for more times than that." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayer for him and then left, but he did not stay long before the two Verses of Surat-Bara'a were revealed, i.e.:-- 'And never (O Muhammad) pray for anyone of them that dies.... and died in a state of rebellion.' (9.84) Later I was astonished at my daring to speak like that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah and His Apostle know best
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ جَاءَ ابْنُهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَعْطَاهُ قَمِيصَهُ وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُكَفِّنَهُ فِيهِ ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ، فَأَخَذَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ بِثَوْبِهِ فَقَالَ تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَهْوَ مُنَافِقٌ وَقَدْ نَهَاكَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تَسْتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا خَيَّرَنِي اللَّهُ أَوْ أَخْبَرَنِي فَقَالَ ‏{‏اسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ أَوْ لاَ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ إِنْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً فَلَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ‏}‏ فَقَالَ سَأَزِيدُهُ عَلَى سَبْعِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصَلَّيْنَا مَعَهُ ثُمَّ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏{‏وَلاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا وَلاَ تَقُمْ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ إِنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَمَاتُوا وَهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa aanasu bnu 'iyaadin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aannahu qaala lammaa tuwuffiya 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain jaa'a abnuhu 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaa'taahu qamiysahu waaamarahu aan yukaffinahu fiyhi thumma qaama yusalliy 'alayhi, faaakhadha 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi bithawbihi faqaala tusalliy 'alayhi wahwa munaafiqun waqad nahaaka alllahu aan tastaghfira lahum‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa khayyaraniy alllahu aaw aakhbaraniy faqaala ‏{‏astaghfir lahum aaw laa tastaghfir lahum iin tastaghfir lahum sab'iyna marraaan falan yaghfira alllahu lahum‏}‏ faqaala saaaziyduhu 'alaa sab'iyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fasallaa 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasallaynaa ma'ahu thumma aanzala alllahu 'alayhi ‏{‏walaa tusalli 'alaa aahadin minhum maata aabadana walaa taqum 'alaa qabrihi iinnahum kafaruwa bialllahi warasuwlihi wamaatuwa wahum faasiquwna‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When `Abdullah bin Ubai died, his son `Abdullah bin `Abdullah came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who gave his shirt to him and ordered him to shroud his father in it. Then he stood up to offer the funeral prayer for the deceased, but `Umar bin Al-Khattab took hold of his garment and said, "Do you offer the funeral prayer for him though he was a hypocrite and Allah has forbidden you to ask forgiveness for hypocrites?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has given me the choice (or Allah has informed me) saying: "Whether you, O Muhammad, ask forgiveness for them, or do not ask forgiveness for them, even if you ask forgiveness for them seventy times, Allah will not forgive them," (9.80) Then he added, "I will (appeal to Allah for his sake) more than seventy times." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayer for him and we too, offered the prayer along with him. Then Allah revealed: "And never, O Muhammad, pray (funeral prayer) for anyone of them that dies, nor stand at his grave. Certainly they disbelieved in Allah and His Apostle and died in a state of rebellion
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ كَعْبَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، حِينَ تَخَلَّفَ عَنْ تَبُوكَ، وَاللَّهِ، مَا أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَىَّ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَانِي أَعْظَمَ مِنْ صِدْقِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ لاَ أَكُونَ كَذَبْتُهُ فَأَهْلِكَ كَمَا هَلَكَ الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا حِينَ أُنْزِلَ الْوَحْىُ ‏{‏سَيَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ لَكُمْ إِذَا انْقَلَبْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ‏}‏ إِلَى ‏{‏الْفَاسِقِينَ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna ka'bi bni maalikin, qaala sami'tu ka'ba bna maalikin, hiyna takhallafa 'an tabuwka, waalllahi, maa aan'ama alllahu 'alaaaa min ni'maain ba'da iidh hadaaniy aa'zama min sidqiy rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan laa aakuwna kadhabtuhu faaahlika kamaa halaka alladhiyna kadhabuwa hiyna aunzila alwahau ‏{‏sayahlifuwna bialllahi lakum iidhaa anqalabtum iilayhim‏}‏ iilaa ‏{‏alfaasiqiyna‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:I heard Ka`b bin Malik at the time he remained behind and did not join (the battle of) Tabuk, saying, "By Allah, no blessing has Allah bestowed upon me, besides my guidance to Islam, better than that of helping me speak the truth to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) otherwise I would have told the Prophet (ﷺ) a lie and would have been ruined like those who had told a lie when the Divine Inspiration was revealed:-- "They will swear by Allah to you (Muslims) when you return to them.. the rebellious people
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُؤَمَّلٌ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ هِشَامٍ ـ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَحَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَمُرَةُ بْنُ جُنْدُبٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَنَا ‏ "‏ أَتَانِي اللَّيْلَةَ آتِيَانِ فَابْتَعَثَانِي، فَانْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى مَدِينَةٍ مَبْنِيَّةٍ بِلَبِنِ ذَهَبٍ وَلَبِنِ فِضَّةٍ، فَتَلَقَّانَا رِجَالٌ شَطْرٌ مِنْ خَلْقِهِمْ كَأَحْسَنِ مَا أَنْتَ رَاءٍ، وَشَطْرٌ كَأَقْبَحِ مَا أَنْتَ رَاءٍ قَالاَ لَهُمُ اذْهَبُوا فَقَعُوا فِي ذَلِكَ النَّهْرِ‏.‏ فَوَقَعُوا فِيهِ ثُمَّ رَجَعُوا إِلَيْنَا قَدْ ذَهَبَ ذَلِكَ السُّوءُ عَنْهُمْ، فَصَارُوا فِي أَحْسَنِ صُورَةٍ قَالاَ لِي هَذِهِ جَنَّةُ عَدْنٍ، وَهَذَاكَ مَنْزِلُكَ قَالاَ أَمَّا الْقَوْمُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا شَطْرٌ مِنْهُمْ حَسَنٌ وَشَطْرٌ مِنْهُمْ قَبِيحٌ فَإِنَّهُمْ خَلَطُوا عَمَلاً صَالِحًا وَآخَرَ سَيِّئًا تَجَاوَزَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muuammalun huwa abnu hishaamin haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, wahaddathanaa 'awfun, haddathanaa aabuw rajaa'in, haddathanaa samuraau bnu jundubin rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lanaa ‏ "‏ aataaniy alllaylaaa atiyaani faabta'athaaniy, faantahaynaa iilaa madiynaain mabniyyaain bilabini dhahabin walabini fiddaain, fatalaqqaanaa rijaalun shatrun min khalqihim kaaahsani maa aanta raa'in, washatrun kaaaqbahi maa aanta raa'in qaalaa lahumu adhhabuwa faqa'uwa fiy dhalika alnnahri‏.‏ fawaqa'uwa fiyhi thumma raja'uwa iilaynaa qad dhahaba dhalika alssuw'u 'anhum, fasaaruwa fiy aahsani suwraain qaalaa liy hadhihi jannaau 'adnin, wahadhaaka manziluka qaalaa aammaa alqawmu alladhiyna kaanuwa shatrun minhum hasanun washatrun minhum qabiyhun faiinnahum khalatuwa 'amalaan saalihana waakhara sayyiiana tajaawaza alllahu 'anhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Samura bin Jundab:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Tonight two (visitors) came to me (in my dream) and took me to a town built with gold bricks and silver bricks. There we met men who, half of their bodies, look like the most handsome human beings you have ever seen, and the other half, the ugliest human beings you have ever seen. Those two visitors said to those men, 'Go and dip yourselves in that river. So they dipped themselves therein and then came to us, their ugliness having disappeared and they were in the most handsome shape. The visitors said, 'The first is the Garden of Eden and that is your dwelling place.' Then they added, 'As for those people who were half ugly and half handsome, they were those who mixed good deeds and bad deeds, but Allah forgave them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا حَضَرَتْ أَبَا طَالِبٍ الْوَفَاةُ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدَهُ أَبُو جَهْلٍ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَىْ عَمِّ قُلْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ أُحَاجُّ لَكَ بِهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ يَا أَبَا طَالِبٍ، أَتَرْغَبُ عَنْ مِلَّةِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ مَا لَمْ أُنْهَ عَنْكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوا لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَلَوْ كَانُوا أُولِي قُرْبَى مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala lammaa hadarat aabaa taalibin alwafaaau dakhala 'alayhi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'indahu aabuw jahlin wa'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy aumayyaaa, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaa 'ammi qul laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ auhaajju laka bihaa 'inda alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw jahlin wa'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy aumayyaaa yaa aabaa taalibin, aatarghabu 'an millaai 'abdi almuttalibi‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laastaghfiranna laka maa lam aunha 'anka ‏"‏‏.‏ fanazalat ‏{‏maa kaana lilnnabiyyi waalladhiyna amanuwa aan yastaghfiruwa lilmushrikiyna walaw kaanuwa auwliy qurbaa min ba'di maa tabayyana lahum aannahum aashaabu aljahiymi‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Musaiyab:When Abu Talib's death approached, the Prophet (ﷺ) went to him while Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya were present with him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O uncle, say: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, so that I may argue for your case with it before Allah." On that, Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abu Umaiya said, "O Abu Talib! Do you want to renounce `Abdul Muttalib's religion?" Then the Prophet said, "I will keep on asking (Allah for) forgiveness for you unless I am forbidden to do so." Then there was revealed:-- 'It is not fitting for the Prophet (ﷺ) and those who believe that they should invoke (Allah) for forgiveness for pagans even though they be of kin, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of the Fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، قَالَ أَحْمَدُ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْبَسَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ كَعْبٍ ـ وَكَانَ قَائِدَ كَعْبٍ مِنْ بَنِيهِ حِينَ عَمِيَ ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ كَعْبَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏{‏وَعَلَى الثَّلاَثَةِ الَّذِينَ خُلِّفُوا‏}‏ قَالَ فِي آخِرِ حَدِيثِهِ إِنَّ مِنْ تَوْبَتِي أَنْ أَنْخَلِعَ مِنْ مَالِي صَدَقَةً إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمْسِكْ بَعْضَ مَالِكَ، فَهْوَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu saalihin, qaala haddathaniy abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, qaala aahmadu haddathanaa 'anbasaau, haddathanaa yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu ka'bin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu ka'bin wakaana qaaiida ka'bin min baniyhi hiyna 'amiya qaala sami'tu ka'ba bna maalikin, fiy hadiythihi ‏{‏wa'alaa althhalaathaai alladhiyna khullifuwa‏}‏ qaala fiy akhiri hadiythihi iinna min tawbatiy aan aankhali'a min maaliy sadaqaaan iilaa alllahi warasuwlihi‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aamsik ba'da maalika, fahwa khayrun laka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:I heard Ka`b bin Malik talking about the Verse:-- 'And to the three (He also forgave) who remained behind.' (9.118) saying in the last portion of his talk, "(I said), 'As a part (sign) of my repentance, I would like to give up all my property in the cause of Allah and His Apostle,' The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, 'Keep some of your wealth as it is good for you." (To the three (He also forgave) who remained behind till for them the earth, vast as it is, was straitened
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي شُعَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ، أَنَّ الزُّهْرِيَّ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي كَعْبَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ،، وَهْوَ أَحَدُ الثَّلاَثَةِ الَّذِينَ تِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَتَخَلَّفْ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةٍ غَزَاهَا قَطُّ غَيْرَ غَزْوَتَيْنِ غَزْوَةِ الْعُسْرَةِ وَغَزْوَةِ بَدْرٍ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَجْمَعْتُ صِدْقَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضُحًى، وَكَانَ قَلَّمَا يَقْدَمُ مِنْ سَفَرٍ سَافَرَهُ إِلاَّ ضُحًى وَكَانَ يَبْدَأُ بِالْمَسْجِدِ، فَيَرْكَعُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَنَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ كَلاَمِي وَكَلاَمِ صَاحِبَىَّ، وَلَمْ يَنْهَ عَنْ كَلاَمِ أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْمُتَخَلِّفِينَ غَيْرِنَا، فَاجْتَنَبَ النَّاسُ كَلاَمَنَا، فَلَبِثْتُ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى طَالَ عَلَىَّ الأَمْرُ، وَمَا مِنْ شَىْءٍ أَهَمُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ أَمُوتَ فَلاَ يُصَلِّي عَلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ يَمُوتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَكُونَ مِنَ النَّاسِ بِتِلْكَ الْمَنْزِلَةِ، فَلاَ يُكَلِّمُنِي أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ، وَلاَ يُصَلِّي عَلَىَّ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَوْبَتَنَا عَلَى نَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ بَقِيَ الثُّلُثُ الآخِرُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، وَكَانَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ مُحْسِنَةً فِي شَأْنِي مَعْنِيَّةً فِي أَمْرِي، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ تِيبَ عَلَى كَعْبٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ أَفَلاَ أُرْسِلُ إِلَيْهِ فَأُبَشِّرَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذًا يَحْطِمَكُمُ النَّاسُ فَيَمْنَعُونَكُمُ النَّوْمَ سَائِرَ اللَّيْلَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَتَّى إِذَا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الْفَجْرِ آذَنَ بِتَوْبَةِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْنَا، وَكَانَ إِذَا اسْتَبْشَرَ اسْتَنَارَ وَجْهُهُ حَتَّى كَأَنَّهُ قِطْعَةٌ مِنَ الْقَمَرِ، وَكُنَّا أَيُّهَا الثَّلاَثَةُ الَّذِينَ خُلِّفُوا عَنِ الأَمْرِ الَّذِي قُبِلَ مِنْ هَؤُلاَءِ الَّذِينَ اعْتَذَرُوا حِينَ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ لَنَا التَّوْبَةَ، فَلَمَّا ذُكِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْمُتَخَلِّفِينَ، وَاعْتَذَرُوا بِالْبَاطِلِ، ذُكِرُوا بِشَرِّ مَا ذُكِرَ بِهِ أَحَدٌ قَالَ اللَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ ‏{‏يَعْتَذِرُونَ إِلَيْكُمْ إِذَا رَجَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ قُلْ لاَ تَعْتَذِرُوا لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ لَكُمْ قَدْ نَبَّأَنَا اللَّهُ مِنْ أَخْبَارِكُمْ وَسَيَرَى اللَّهُ عَمَلَكُمْ وَرَسُولُهُ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadun, haddathanaa aahmadu bnu aabiy shu'aybin, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu raashidin, aanna alzzuhriyya, haddathahu qaala aakhbaraniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'abdi alllahi bni ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu aabiy ka'ba bna maalikin, , wahwa aahadu althhalaathaai alladhiyna tiyba 'alayhim aannahu lam yatakhallaf 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazwaain ghazaahaa qattu ghayra ghazwatayni ghazwaai al'usraai waghazwaai badrin‏.‏ qaala faaajma'tu sidqa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm duhana, wakaana qallamaa yaqdamu min safarin saafarahu iilaaa duhana wakaana yabdaau bialmasjidi, fayarka'u rak'atayni, wanahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an kalaamiy wakalaami saahibaaaa, walam yanha 'an kalaami aahadin mina almutakhallifiyna ghayrinaa, faajtanaba alnnaasu kalaamanaa, falabithtu kadhalika hattaa taala 'alaaaa alaamru, wamaa min shaa'in aahammu iilaaaa min aan aamuwta falaa yusalliy 'alaaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aaw yamuwta rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakuwna mina alnnaasi bitilka almanzilaai, falaa yukallimuniy aahadun minhum, walaa yusalliy 'alaaaa, faaanzala alllahu tawbatanaa 'alaa nabiyyihi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna baqiya althhuluthu alakhiru mina alllayli, warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'inda aummi salamaaa, wakaanat aummu salamaaa muhsinaaan fiy shaaniy ma'niyyaaan fiy aamriy, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa aumma salamaaa tiyba 'alaa ka'bin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat aafalaa aursilu iilayhi faaubashhirahu qaala ‏"‏ iidhana yahtimakumu alnnaasu fayamna'uwnakumu alnnawma saaiira alllaylaai ‏"‏‏.‏ hattaa iidhaa sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm salaaaa alfajri adhana bitawbaai alllahi 'alaynaa, wakaana iidhaa astabshara astanaara wajhuhu hattaa kaaannahu qit'aaun mina alqamari, wakunnaa aayyuhaa althhalaathaau alladhiyna khullifuwa 'ani alaamri alladhiy qubila min hauulaa'i alladhiyna a'tadharuwa hiyna aanzala alllahu lanaa alttawbaaa, falammaa dhukira alladhiyna kadhabuwa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina almutakhallifiyna, waa'tadharuwa bialbaatili, dhukiruwa bisharri maa dhukira bihi aahadun qaala alllahu subhaanahu ‏{‏ya'tadhiruwna iilaykum iidhaa raja'tum iilayhim qul laa ta'tadhiruwa lan nuumina lakum qad nabbaaanaa alllahu min aakhbaarikum wasayaraa alllahu 'amalakum warasuwluhu‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:I heard Ka`b bin Malik who was one of the three who were forgiven, saying that he had never remained behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in any Ghazwa which he had fought except two Ghazwat Ghazwat- Al-`Usra (Tabuk) and Ghazwat-Badr. He added. "I decided to tell the truth to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the forenoon, and scarcely did he return from a journey he made, except in the forenoon, he would go first to the mosque and offer a two-rak`at prayer. The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade others to speak to me or to my two companions, but he did not prohibit speaking to any of those who had remained behind excepting us. So the people avoided speaking to us, and I stayed in that state till I could no longer bear it, and the only thing that worried me was that I might die and the Prophet (ﷺ) would not offer the funeral prayer for me, or Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) might die and I would be left in that social status among the people that nobody would speak to me or offer the funeral prayer for me. But Allah revealed His Forgiveness for us to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the last third of the night while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was with Um Salama. Um Salama sympathized with me and helped me in my disaster. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'O Um Salama! Ka`b has been forgiven!' She said, 'Shall I send someone to him to give him the good tidings?' He said, 'If you did so, the people would not let you sleep the rest of the night.' So when the Prophet (ﷺ) had offered the Fajr prayer, he announced Allah's Forgiveness for us. His face used to look as bright as a piece of the (full) moon whenever he was pleased. When Allah revealed His Forgiveness for us, we were the three whose case had been deferred while the excuse presented by those who had apologized had been accepted. But when there were mentioned those who had told the Prophet (ﷺ) lies and remained behind (the battle of Tabuk) and had given false excuses, they were described with the worse description one may be described with. Allah said: 'They will present their excuses to you (Muslims) when you return to them. Say: Present no excuses; we shall not believe you. Allah has already informed us of the true state of matters concerning you. Allah and His Apostle will observe your actions
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ وَكَانَ قَائِدَ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ كَعْبَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يُحَدِّثُ حِينَ تَخَلَّفَ عَنْ قِصَّةِ، تَبُوكَ‏.‏ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا أَعْلَمُ أَحَدًا أَبْلاَهُ اللَّهُ فِي صِدْقِ الْحَدِيثِ أَحْسَنَ مِمَّا أَبْلاَنِي، مَا تَعَمَّدْتُ مُنْذُ ذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى يَوْمِي هَذَا كَذِبًا، وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏لَقَدْ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏وَكُونُوا مَعَ الصَّادِقِينَ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdi alllahi bni ka'bi bni maalikin, aanna 'abda alllahi bna ka'bi bni maalikin wakaana qaaiida ka'bi bni maalikin qaala sami'tu ka'ba bna maalikin, yuhaddithu hiyna takhallafa 'an qissaai, tabuwka‏.‏ fawaalllahi maa aa'lamu aahadana aablaahu alllahu fiy sidqi alhadiythi aahsana mimmaa aablaaniy, maa ta'ammadtu mundhu dhakartu dhalika lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa yawmiy hadhaa kadhibana, waaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla 'alaa rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏laqad taaba alllahu 'alaa alnnabiyyi waalmuhaajiriyna‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏wakuwnuwa ma'a alssaadiqiyna‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b:I heard Ka`b bin Malik talking about the story of the battle of Tabuk when he remained behind, "By Allah, I do not know anyone whom Allah has helped for telling the truth more than me since I mentioned that truth to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till today, I have never intended to tell a lie. And Allah revealed to His Apostle: "Verily! Allah has forgiven the Prophet, the Muhajirin............ and be with those who are true (in words and deeds)." (9.117-119) (See Hadith No. 702 Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ السَّبَّاقِ، أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَكَانَ مِمَّنْ يَكْتُبُ الْوَحْىَ قَالَ أَرْسَلَ إِلَىَّ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مَقْتَلَ أَهْلِ الْيَمَامَةِ وَعِنْدَهُ عُمَرُ، فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِنَّ عُمَرَ أَتَانِي فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْقَتْلَ قَدِ اسْتَحَرَّ يَوْمَ الْيَمَامَةِ بِالنَّاسِ، وَإِنِّي أَخْشَى أَنْ يَسْتَحِرَّ الْقَتْلُ بِالْقُرَّاءِ فِي الْمَوَاطِنِ فَيَذْهَبَ كَثِيرٌ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، إِلاَّ أَنْ تَجْمَعُوهُ، وَإِنِّي لأَرَى أَنْ تَجْمَعَ الْقُرْآنَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ قُلْتُ لِعُمَرَ كَيْفَ أَفْعَلُ شَيْئًا لَمْ يَفْعَلْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ عُمَرُ هُوَ وَاللَّهِ خَيْرٌ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ عُمَرُ يُرَاجِعُنِي فِيهِ حَتَّى شَرَحَ اللَّهُ لِذَلِكَ صَدْرِي، وَرَأَيْتُ الَّذِي رَأَى عُمَرُ‏.‏ قَالَ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ وَعُمَرُ عِنْدَهُ جَالِسٌ لاَ يَتَكَلَّمُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِنَّكَ رَجُلٌ شَابٌّ عَاقِلٌ وَلاَ نَتَّهِمُكَ، كُنْتَ تَكْتُبُ الْوَحْىَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَتَبَّعِ الْقُرْآنَ فَاجْمَعْهُ‏.‏ فَوَاللَّهِ لَوْ كَلَّفَنِي نَقْلَ جَبَلٍ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ مَا كَانَ أَثْقَلَ عَلَىَّ مِمَّا أَمَرَنِي بِهِ مِنْ جَمْعِ الْقُرْآنِ قُلْتُ كَيْفَ تَفْعَلاَنِ شَيْئًا لَمْ يَفْعَلْهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ هُوَ وَاللَّهِ خَيْرٌ، فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أُرَاجِعُهُ حَتَّى شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرِي لِلَّذِي شَرَحَ اللَّهُ لَهُ صَدْرَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ، فَقُمْتُ فَتَتَبَّعْتُ الْقُرْآنَ أَجْمَعُهُ مِنَ الرِّقَاعِ وَالأَكْتَافِ وَالْعُسُبِ وَصُدُورِ الرِّجَالِ، حَتَّى وَجَدْتُ مِنْ سُورَةِ التَّوْبَةِ آيَتَيْنِ مَعَ خُزَيْمَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، لَمْ أَجِدْهُمَا مَعَ أَحَدٍ غَيْرِهِ ‏{‏لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِهِمَا، وَكَانَتِ الصُّحُفُ الَّتِي جُمِعَ فِيهَا الْقُرْآنُ عِنْدَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ حَتَّى تَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ عِنْدَ عُمَرَ حَتَّى تَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ عِنْدَ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ عُمَرَ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ وَاللَّيْثُ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ وَقَالَ مَعَ أَبِي خُزَيْمَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُوسَى عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ مَعَ أَبِي خُزَيْمَةَ‏.‏ وَتَابَعَهُ يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو ثَابِتٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَقَالَ مَعَ خُزَيْمَةَ، أَوْ أَبِي خُزَيْمَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu alssabbaaqi, aanna zayda bna thaabitin alaansaariyya rda allh 'nh wakaana mimman yaktubu alwahaa qaala aarsala iilaaaa aabuw bakrin maqtala aahli alyamaamaai wa'indahu 'umaru, faqaala aabuw bakrin iinna 'umara aataaniy faqaala iinna alqatla qadi astaharra yawma alyamaamaai bialnnaasi, waiinniy aakhshaa aan yastahirra alqatlu bialqurraa'i fiy almawaatini fayadhhaba kathiyrun mina alqurani, iilaaa aan tajma'uwhu, waiinniy laaraa aan tajma'a alqurana‏.‏ qaala aabuw bakrin qultu li'umara kayfa aaf'alu shayiana lam yaf'alhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala 'umaru huwa waalllahi khayrun‏.‏ falam yazal 'umaru yuraaji'uniy fiyhi hattaa sharaha alllahu lidhalika sadriy, waraaaytu alladhiy raaaa 'umaru‏.‏ qaala zaydu bnu thaabitin wa'umaru 'indahu jaalisun laa yatakallamu‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin iinnaka rajulun shaabbun 'aaqilun walaa nattahimuka, kunta taktubu alwahaa lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatatabba'i alqurana faajma'hu‏.‏ fawaalllahi law kallafaniy naqla jabalin mina aljibaali maa kaana aathqala 'alaaaa mimmaa aamaraniy bihi min jam'i alqurani qultu kayfa taf'alaani shayiana lam yaf'alhu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aabuw bakrin huwa waalllahi khayrun, falam aazal auraaji'uhu hattaa sharaha alllahu sadriy lilladhiy sharaha alllahu lahu sadra aabiy bakrin wa'umara, faqumtu fatatabba'tu alqurana aajma'uhu mina alrriqaa'i waalaaktaafi waal'usubi wasuduwri alrrijaali, hattaa wajadtu min suwraai alttawbaai ayatayni ma'a khuzaymaaa alaansaariyyi, lam aajidhumaa ma'a aahadin ghayrihi ‏{‏laqad jaa'akum rasuwlun min aanfusikum 'aziyzun 'alayhi maa 'anittum hariysun 'alaykum‏}‏ iilaa akhirihimaa, wakaanati alssuhufu allatiy jumi'a fiyhaa alquranu 'inda aabiy bakrin hattaa tawaffaahu alllahu, thumma 'inda 'umara hattaa tawaffaahu alllahu, thumma 'inda hafsaaa binti 'umara‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara waalllaythu 'an yuwnusa 'ani abni shihaabin‏.‏ waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu khaalidin 'ani abni shihaabin waqaala ma'a aabiy khuzaymaaa alaansaariyyi‏.‏ waqaala muwsaa 'an iibraahiyma haddathanaa abnu shihaabin ma'a aabiy khuzaymaaa‏.‏ wataaba'ahu ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma 'an aabiyhi‏.‏ waqaala aabuw thaabitin haddathanaa iibraahiymu waqaala ma'a khuzaymaaa, aaw aabiy khuzaymaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit Al-Ansari:who was one of those who used to write the Divine Revelation: Abu Bakr sent for me after the (heavy) casualties among the warriors (of the battle) of Yamama (where a great number of Qurra' were killed). `Umar was present with Abu Bakr who said, `Umar has come to me and said, The people have suffered heavy casualties on the day of (the battle of) Yamama, and I am afraid that there will be more casualties among the Qurra' (those who know the Qur'an by heart) at other battle-fields, whereby a large part of the Qur'an may be lost, unless you collect it. And I am of the opinion that you should collect the Qur'an." Abu Bakr added, "I said to `Umar, 'How can I do something which Allah's Apostle has not done?' `Umar said (to me), 'By Allah, it is (really) a good thing.' So `Umar kept on pressing, trying to persuade me to accept his proposal, till Allah opened my bosom for it and I had the same opinion as `Umar." (Zaid bin Thabit added:) `Umar was sitting with him (Abu Bakr) and was not speaking to me. "You are a wise young man and we do not suspect you (of telling lies or of forgetfulness): and you used to write the Divine Inspiration for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Therefore, look for the Qur'an and collect it (in one manuscript). " By Allah, if he (Abu Bakr) had ordered me to shift one of the mountains (from its place) it would not have been harder for me than what he had ordered me concerning the collection of the Qur'an. I said to both of them, "How dare you do a thing which the Prophet has not done?" Abu Bakr said, "By Allah, it is (really) a good thing. So I kept on arguing with him about it till Allah opened my bosom for that which He had opened the bosoms of Abu Bakr and `Umar. So I started locating Qur'anic material and collecting it from parchments, scapula, leaf-stalks of date palms and from the memories of men (who knew it by heart). I found with Khuza`ima two Verses of Surat-at-Tauba which I had not found with anybody else, (and they were):-- "Verily there has come to you an Apostle (Muhammad) from amongst yourselves. It grieves him that you should receive any injury or difficulty He (Muhammad) is ardently anxious over you (to be rightly guided)" (9.128) The manuscript on which the Qur'an was collected, remained with Abu Bakr till Allah took him unto Him, and then with `Umar till Allah took him unto Him, and finally it remained with Hafsa, `Umar's daughter
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
