kathiyrana, wawu'iktu faqultu lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aarsilniy iilaa bayti aabiy‏.‏ faaarsala ma'iy alghulaama, fadakhaltu alddaara fawajadtu aumma ruwmaana fiy alssufli waaabaa bakrin fawqa albayti yaqraau‏.‏ faqaalat aummiy maa jaa'a biki yaa bunayyaau faaakhbartuhaa wadhakartu lahaa alhadiytha, waiidhaa huwa lam yablugh minhaa mithla maa balagha minniy, faqaalat yaa bunayyaau khaffidiy 'alayki alshhaana, faiinnahu waalllahi, laqallamaa kaanati amraaaaun hasnaa'u 'inda rajulin yuhibbuhaa, lahaa daraaiiru, iilaaa hasadnahaa waqiyla fiyhaa‏.‏ waiidhaa huwa lam yablugh minhaa maa balagha minniy, qultu waqad 'alima bihi aabiy qaalat na'am‏.‏ qultu warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat na'am warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waasta'bartu wabakaytu, fasami'a aabuw bakrin sawtiy wahwa fawqa albayti yaqraau, fanazala faqaala laummiy maa shaanuhaa qaalat balaghahaa alladhiy dhukira min shaanihaa‏.‏ fafaadat 'aynaahu, qaala aaqsamtu 'alayki aaa bunayyaau iilaaa raja'ti iilaa baytiki, faraja'tu walaqad jaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm baytiy, fasaaala 'anniy khaadimatiy faqaalat laa waalllahi maa 'alimtu 'alayhaa 'aybana iilaaa aannahaa kaanat tarqudu hattaa tadkhula alshhaaau fataakula khamiyrahaa aaw 'ajiynahaa‏.‏ waantaharahaa ba'du aashaabihi faqaala asduqiy rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa aasqatuwa lahaa bihi faqaalat subhaana alllahi, waalllahi maa 'alimtu 'alayhaa iilaaa maa ya'lamu alssaaiighu 'alaa tibri aldhhahabi alaahmari‏.‏ wabalagha alaamru iilaa dhalika alrrajuli alladhiy qiyla lahu, faqaala subhaana alllahi waalllahi maa kashaftu kanafa aunthaa qattu‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau faqutila shahiydana fiy sabiyli alllahi‏.‏ qaalat waaasbaha aabawaaaa 'indiy, falam yazaalaa hattaa dakhala 'alaaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqad sallaa al'asra, thumma dakhala waqadi aktanafaniy aabawaaaa 'an yamiyniy wa'an shimaaliy, fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ aammaa ba'du yaa 'aaiishaau, iin kunti qaarafti suw'ana aaw zalamti, fatuwbiy iilaa alllahi, faiinna alllaha yaqbalu alttawbaaa min 'ibaadihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat waqad jaa'ati amraaaaun mina alaansaari fahaa jaalisaaun bialbaabi faqultu aalaa tastahiy min hadhihi almaraaai aan tadhkura shayiana‏.‏ fawa'aza rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaltafattu iilaa aabiy faqultu aajibhu‏.‏ qaala famaadhaa aaquwlu faaltafattu iilaa aummiy faqultu aajiybiyhi‏.‏ faqaalat aaquwlu maadhaa falammaa lam yujiybaahu tashahhadtu fahamidtu alllaha waaathnaytu 'alayhi bimaa huwa aahluhu, thumma qultu aammaa ba'du fawaalllahi laiin qultu lakum iinniy lam aaf'al‏.‏ waalllahu 'azza wajalla yashhadu iinniy lasaadiqaaun, maa dhaaka binaafi'iy 'indakum, laqad takallamtum bihi waaushribathu quluwbukum, waiin qultu iinniy fa'altu‏.‏ waalllahu ya'lamu aanniy lam aaf'al, lataquwlunna qad baa'at bihi 'alaa nafsihaa, waiinniy waalllahi maa aajidu liy walakum mathalaan waaltamastu asma ya'quwba falam aaqdir 'alayhi iilaaa aabaa yuwsufa hiyna qaala ‏{‏fasabrun jamiylun waalllahu almusta'aanu 'alaa maa tasifuwna‏}‏ waaunzila 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min saa'atihi fasakatnaa, farufi'a 'anhu waiinniy laatabayyanu alssuruwra fiy wajhihi wahwa yamsahu jabiynahu wayaquwlu ‏"‏ aabshiriy yaa 'aaiishaau, faqad aanzala alllahu baraa'ataki ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat wakuntu aashadda maa kuntu ghadabana faqaala liy aabawaaaa quwmiy iilayhi‏.‏ faqultu waalllahi laa aaquwmu iilayhi, walaa aahmaduhu walaa aahmadukumaa, walakin aahmadu alllaha alladhiy aanzala baraa'atiy, laqad sami'tumuwhu, famaa aankartumuwhu walaa ghayyartumuwhu, wakaanat 'aaiishaau taquwlu aammaa zaynabu abnaau jahshin fa'asamahaa alllahu bidiynihaa, falam taqul iilaaa khayrana, waaammaa aukhtuhaa hamnaau fahalakat fiyman halaka, wakaana alladhiy yatakallamu fiyhi mistahun wahassaanu bnu thaabitin waalmunaafiqu 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain, wahwa alladhiy kaana yastawshiyhi wayajma'uhu, wahwa alladhiy tawallaa kibrahu minhum huwa wahamnaau qaalat fahalafa aabuw bakrin aan laa yanfa'a mistahana binaafi'aain aabadana, faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏walaa yaatali auwluw alfadli minkum‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai ya'niy aabaa bakrin vwaalssa'aai aan yuutuwa auwliy alqurbaa waalmasaakiyna‏}‏ ya'niy mistahana iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏aalaa tuhibbuwna aan yaghfira alllahu lakum waalllahu ghafuwrun rahiymun‏}‏ hattaa qaala aabuw bakrin balaa waalllahi yaa rabbanaa iinnaa lanuhibbu aan taghfira lanaa, wa'aada lahu bimaa kaana yasna'u‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:When there was said about me what was said which I myself was unaware of, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up and addressed the people. He recited Tashah-hud, and after glorifying and praising Allah as He deserved, he said, "To proceed: O people Give me your opinion regarding those people who made a forged story against my wife. By Allah, I do not know anything bad about her. By Allah, they accused her of being with a man about whom I have never known anything bad, and he never entered my house unless I was present there, and whenever I went on a journey, he went with me." Sa`d bin Mu`adh got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Allow me to chop their heads off". Then a man from the Al-Khazraj (Sa`d bin 'Ubada) to whom the mother of (the poet) Hassan bin Thabit was a relative, got up and said (to Sa`d bin Mu`adh), "You have told a lie! By Allah, if those persons were from the Aus Tribe, you would not like to chop their heads off." It was probable that some evil would take place between the Aus and the Khazraj in the mosque, and I was unaware of all that. In the evening of that day, I went out for some of my needs (i.e. to relieve myself), and Um Mistah was accompanying me. On our return, Um Mistah stumbled and said, "Let Mistah. be ruined" I said to her, "O mother Why do you abuse your Son" On that Um Mistah became silent for a while, and stumbling again, she said, "Let Mistah be ruined" I said to her, "Why do you abuse your son?" She stumbled for the third time and said, "Let Mistah be ruined" whereupon I rebuked her for that. She said, "By Allah, I do not abuse him except because of you." I asked her, "Concerning what of my affairs?" So she disclosed the whole story to me. I said, "Has this really happened?" She replied, "Yes, by Allah." I returned to my house, astonished (and distressed) that I did not know for what purpose I had gone out. Then I became sick (fever) and said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Send me to my father's house." So he sent a slave with me, and when I entered the house, I found Um Rum-an (my mother) downstairs while (my father) Abu Bakr was reciting something upstairs. My mother asked, "What has brought you, O (my) daughter?" I informed her and mentioned to her the whole story, but she did not feel it as I did. She said, "O my daughter! Take it easy, for there is never a charming lady loved by her husband who has other wives but that they feel jealous of her and speak badly of her." But she did not feel the news as I did. I asked (her), "Does my father know about it?" She said, "yes" I asked, Does Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) know about it too?" She said, "Yes, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) does too." So the tears filled my eyes and I wept. Abu Bakr, who was reading upstairs heard my voice and came down and asked my mother, "What is the matter with her? " She said, "She has heard what has been said about her (as regards the story of Al-Ifk)." On that Abu- Bakr wept and said, "I beseech you by Allah, O my daughter, to go back to your home". I went back to my home and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had come to my house and asked my maid-servant about me (my character). The maid-servant said, "By Allah, I do not know of any defect in her character except that she sleeps and let the sheep enter (her house) and eat her dough." On that, some of the Prophet's companions spoke harshly to her and said, "Tell the truth to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." Finally they told her of the affair (of the slander). She said, "Subhan Allah! By Allah, I know nothing against her except what goldsmith knows about a piece of pure gold." Then this news reached the man who was accused, and he said, "Subhan Allah! By Allah, I have never uncovered the private parts of any woman." Later that man was martyred in Allah's Cause. Next morning my parents came to pay me a visit and they stayed with me till Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me after he had offered the `Asr prayer. He came to me while my parents were sitting around me on my right and my left. He praised and glorified Allah and said, "Now then O `Aisha! If you have committed a bad deed or you have wronged (yourself), then repent to Allah as Allah accepts the repentance from his slaves." An Ansari woman had come and was sitting near the gate. I said (to the Prophet), "Isn't it improper that you speak in such a way in the presence of this lady? Allah's Apostle then gave a piece of advice and I turned to my father and requested him to answer him (on my behalf). My father said, "What should I say?" Then I turned to my mother and asked her to answer him. She said, "What should I say?" When my parents did not give a reply to the Prophet, I said, "I testify that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and that Muhammad is His Apostle!" And after praising and glorifying Allah as He deserves, I said, "Now then, by Allah, if I were to tell you that I have not done (this evil action) and Allah is a witness that I am telling the truth, that would not be of any use to me on your part because you (people) have spoken about it and your hearts have absorbed it; and if I were to tell you that I have done this sin and Allah knows that I have not done it, then you will say, 'She has confessed herself guilty." By Allah, 'I do not see a suitable example for me and you but the example of (I tried to remember Jacob's name but couldn't) Joseph's father when he said; So (for me) "Patience is most fitting against that which you assert. It is Allah (alone) whose help can be sought.' At that very hour the Divine Inspiration came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we remained silent. Then the Inspiration was over and I noticed the signs of happiness on his face while he was removing (the sweat) from his forehead and saying, "Have the good tidings O ' "Aisha! Allah has revealed your innocence." At that time I was extremely angry. My parents said to me, "Get up and go to him." I said, "By Allah, I will not do it and will not thank him nor thank either of you, but I will thank Allah Who has revealed my innocence. You have heard this story but neither did not deny it nor change it (to defend me)." (Aisha used to say:) "But as regards Zainab bint Jahsh, (the Prophet's wife), Allah protected her because of her piety, so she did not say anything except good (about me), but her sister, Hamna, was ruined among those who were ruined. Those who used to speak evil about me were Mistah, Hassan bin Thabit, and the hypocrite, `Abdullah bin Ubai, who used to spread that news and tempt others to speak of it, and it was he and Hamna who had the greater share therein. Abu Bakr took an oath that he would never do any favor to Mistah at all. Then Allah revealed the Divine Verse: "Let not those among you who are good and wealthy (i.e. Abu Bakr) swear not to give (any sort of help) to their kinsmen, and those in need, (i.e. Mistah) ...Do you not love that Allah should forgive you? And Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful." (24.22) On that, Abu Bakr said, "Yes, by Allah, O our Lord! We wish that You should forgive us." So Abu Bakr again started giving to Mistah the expenditure which he used to give him before
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: وَقَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ يُونُسَ، قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ نِسَاءَ الْمُهَاجِرَاتِ الأُوَلَ، لَمَّا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَى جُيُوبِهِنَّ‏}‏ شَقَّقْنَ مُرُوطَهُنَّ فَاخْتَمَرْنَ بِها‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala aahmadu bnu shabiybin haddathanaa aabiy, 'an yuwnusa, qaala abnu shihaabin 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat yarhamu alllahu nisaa'a almuhaajiraati alauwala, lammaa aanzala alllahu ‏{‏walyadribna bikhumurihinna 'alaa juyuwbihinna‏}‏ shaqqaqna muruwtahunna faakhtamarna biha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aishah:May Allah bestow His Mercy on the early emigrant women. When Allah revealed: "... and to draw their veils all over their Juyubihinna (i.e., their bodies, faces, necks and bosoms)..." (V.24:31) they tore their Murut (woolen dresses or waist-binding clothes or aprons etc.) and covered their heads and faces with those torn Muruts
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ كَانَتْ تَقُولُ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَى جُيُوبِهِنَّ‏}‏ أَخَذْنَ أُزْرَهُنَّ فَشَقَّقْنَهَا مِنْ قِبَلِ الْحَوَاشِي فَاخْتَمَرْنَ بِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu naafi'in, 'ani alhasani bni muslimin, 'an safiyyaaa binti shaybaaa, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha kaanat taquwlu lammaa nazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏walyadribna bikhumurihinna 'alaa juyuwbihinna‏}‏ aakhadhna auzrahunna fashaqqaqnahaa min qibali alhawaashiy faakhtamarna bihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Safiya bint Shaiba:`Aisha used to say: "When (the Verse): "They should draw their veils over their necks and bosoms," was revealed, (the ladies) cut their waist sheets at the edges and covered their heads and faces with those cut pieces of cloth
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْبَغْدَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ‏.‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ يُحْشَرُ الْكَافِرُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلَيْسَ الَّذِي أَمْشَاهُ عَلَى الرِّجْلَيْنِ فِي الدُّنْيَا قَادِرًا عَلَى أَنْ يُمْشِيَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ بَلَى وَعِزَّةِ رَبِّنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu muhammadin albaghdaadiyyu, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh ‏.‏ aanna rajulaan, qaala yaa nabiyya alllahi yuhsharu alkaafiru 'alaa wajhihi yawma alqiyaamaai qaala ‏ "‏ aalaysa alladhiy aamshaahu 'alaa alrrijlayni fiy alddunyaa qaadirana 'alaa aan yumshiyahu 'alaa wajhihi yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qataadaau balaa wa'izzaai rabbinaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man said, "O Allah's Prophet! Will Allah gather the non-believers on their faces on the Day of Resurrection?" He said, "Will not the One Who made him walk on his feet in this world, be able to make him walk on his face on the Day of Resurrection?" (Qatada, a subnarrator, said: Yes, By the Power of Our Lord)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَنْصُورٌ، وَسُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي وَاصِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ـ أَوْ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ أَىُّ الذَّنْبِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ لِلَّهِ نِدًّا وَهْوَ خَلَقَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أَنْ تَقْتُلَ وَلَدَكَ خَشْيَةَ أَنْ يَطْعَمَ مَعَكَ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تُزَانِيَ بِحَلِيلَةِ جَارِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ تَصْدِيقًا لِقَوْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ وَلاَ يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, qaala haddathaniy mansuwrun, wasulaymaanu, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an aabiy maysaraaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, ‏.‏ qaala wahaddathaniy waasilun, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala saaaltu aaw suiila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau aldhhanbi 'inda alllahi aakbaru qaala ‏"‏ aan taj'ala lillahi niddana wahwa khalaqaka ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu thumma aaaaun qaala ‏"‏ thumma aan taqtula waladaka khashyaaa aan yat'ama ma'aka‏"‏‏.‏ qultu thumma aaaaun qaala ‏"‏ aan tuzaaniya bihaliylaai jaarika ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala wanazalat hadhihi alayaau tasdiyqana liqawli rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏waalladhiyna laa yad'uwna ma'a alllahi iilahana akhara walaa yaqtuluwna alnnafsa allatiy harrama alllahu iilaaa bialhaqqi walaa yaznuwna‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:I or somebody, asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Which is the biggest sin in the Sight of Allah?" He said, "That you set up a rival (in worship) to Allah though He Alone created you." I asked, "What is next?" He said, "Then, that you kill your son, being afraid that he may share your meals with you." I asked, "What is next?" He said, "That you commit illegal sexual intercourse with the wife of your neighbor." Then the following Verse was revealed to confirm the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): "Those who invoke not with Allah, any other god, nor kill life as Allah has forbidden except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ أَبِي بَزَّةَ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ هَلْ لِمَنْ قَتَلَ مُؤْمِنًا مُتَعَمِّدًا مِنْ تَوْبَةٍ فَقَرَأْتُ عَلَيْهِ ‏{‏وَلاَ يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ‏}‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ قَرَأْتُهَا عَلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ كَمَا قَرَأْتَهَا عَلَىَّ‏.‏ فَقَالَ هَذِهِ مَكِّيَّةٌ نَسَخَتْهَا آيَةٌ مَدَنِيَّةٌ، الَّتِي فِي سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu yuwsufa, aanna abna jurayjin, aakhbarahum qaala aakhbaraniy alqaasimu bnu aabiy bazzaaa, aannahu saaala sa'iyda bna jubayrin hal liman qatala muuminana muta'ammidana min tawbaain faqaraatu 'alayhi ‏{‏walaa yaqtuluwna alnnafsa allatiy harrama alllahu iilaaa bialhaqqi‏}‏‏.‏ faqaala sa'iydun qaraatuhaa 'alaa abni 'abbaasin kamaa qaraatahaa 'alaaaa‏.‏ faqaala hadhihi makkiyyaaun nasakhathaa ayaaun madaniyyaaun, allatiy fiy suwraai alnnisaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Abi Bazza:That he asked Sa`id bin Jubair, "Is there any repentance of the one who has murdered a believer intentionally?" Then I recited to him:-- "Nor kill such life as Allah has forbidden except for a just cause." Sa`id said, "I recited this very Verse before Ibn `Abbas as you have recited it before me. Ibn `Abbas said, 'This Verse was revealed in Mecca and it has been abrogated by a Verse in Surat-An-Nisa which was later revealed in Medina
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ اخْتَلَفَ أَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ فِي قَتْلِ الْمُؤْمِنِ، فَرَحَلْتُ فِيهِ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فَقَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي آخِرِ مَا نَزَلَ وَلَمْ يَنْسَخْهَا شَىْءٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani almughiyraai bni alnnu'maani, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala akhtalafa aahlu alkuwfaai fiy qatli almuumini, farahaltu fiyhi iilaa abni 'abbaasin, faqaala nazalat fiy akhiri maa nazala walam yansakhhaa shaa'un‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:The people of Kufa differed as regards the killing of a believer so I entered upon Ibn `Abbas (and asked him) about that. Ibn `Abbas said, "The Verse (in Surat-An-Nisa', 4:93) was the last thing revealed in this respect and nothing cancelled its validity
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏فَجَزَاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ‏}‏ قَالَ لاَ تَوْبَةَ لَهُ‏.‏ وَعَنْ قَوْلِهِ جَلَّ ذِكْرُهُ ‏{‏لاَ يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ‏}‏ قَالَ كَانَتْ هَذِهِ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa mansuwrun, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala saaaltu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma 'an qawlihi ta'aalaa ‏{‏fajazaauuhu jahannamu‏}‏ qaala laa tawbaaa lahu‏.‏ wa'an qawlihi jalla dhikruhu ‏{‏laa yad'uwna ma'a alllahi iilahana akhara‏}‏ qaala kaanat hadhihi fiy aljaahiliyyaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I asked Ibn `Abbas about Allah's saying:-- '.. this reward is Hell Fire.' (4.93) He said, "No repentance is accepted from him (i.e. the murderer of a believer)." I asked him regarding the saying of Allah: 'Those who invoke not with Allah any other god.' ...(25.68) He said, "This Verse was revealed concerning the pagans of the pre-Islamic period
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبْزَى سَلِ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَمَنْ يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ‏}‏ وَقَوْلِهِ ‏{‏لاَ يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ‏}‏ حَتَّى بَلَغَ ‏{‏إِلاَّ مَنْ تَابَ‏}‏ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ قَالَ أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ فَقَدْ عَدَلْنَا بِاللَّهِ وَقَتَلْنَا النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَتَيْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏إِلاَّ مَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلاً صَالِحًا‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'du bnu hafsin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala qaala abnu aabzaa sali abna 'abbaasin 'an qawlihi ta'aalaa ‏{‏waman yaqtul muuminana muta'ammidana fajazaauuhu jahannamu‏}‏ waqawlihi ‏{‏laa yaqtuluwna alnnafsa allatiy harrama alllahu iilaaa bialhaqqi‏}‏ hattaa balagha ‏{‏iilaaa man taaba‏}‏ fasaaaltuhu faqaala lammaa nazalat qaala aahlu makkaaa faqad 'adalnaa bialllahi waqatalnaa alnnafsa allatiy harrama alllahu iilaaa bialhaqqi waaataynaa alfawaahisha, faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏iilaaa man taaba waamana wa'amila 'amalaan saalihana‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏ghafuwrana rahiymana‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Ibn Abza said to me, "Ask Ibn `Abbas regarding the Statement of Allah: 'And whoever murders a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell.' (4.69) And also His Statement: '...nor kill such life as Allah has forbidden, except for a just cause .....except those who repent, believe, and do good deeds.' " (25.68-70) So I asked Ibn `Abbas and he said, "When this (25.68-69) was revealed, the people of Mecca said, "We have invoked other gods with Allah, and we have murdered such lives which Allah has made sacred, and we have committed illegal sexual intercourse. So Allah revealed: 'Except those who repent, believe, and do good deeds and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ أَمَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبْزَى أَنْ أَسْأَلَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ هَاتَيْنِ الآيَتَيْنِ، ‏{‏وَمَنْ يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُتَعَمِّدًا‏}‏، فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ لَمْ يَنْسَخْهَا شَىْءٌ‏.‏ وَعَنْ ‏{‏وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ‏}‏ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa aabiy, 'an shu'baaa, 'an mansuwrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala aamaraniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu aabzaa aan aasaala abna 'abbaasin, 'an haatayni alayatayni, ‏{‏waman yaqtul muuminana muta'ammidana‏}‏, fasaaaltuhu faqaala lam yansakhhaa shaa'un‏.‏ wa'an ‏{‏waalladhiyna laa yad'uwna ma'a alllahi iilahana akhara‏}‏ qaala nazalat fiy aahli alshhirki‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:`Abdur-Rahman bin Abza ordered me to ask Ibn `Abbas regarding the two Verses (the first of which was ): "And whosoever murders a believer intentionally." (4.93) So I asked him, and he said, "Nothing has abrogated this Verse." About (the other Verse): 'And those who invoke not with Allah any other god.' he said, "It was revealed concerning the pagans
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ خَمْسٌ قَدْ مَضَيْنَ الدُّخَانُ وَالْقَمَرُ وَالرُّومُ وَالْبَطْشَةُ وَاللِّزَامُ ‏{‏فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًا‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathanaa muslimun, 'an masruwqin, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi khamsun qad madayna alddukhaanu waalqamaru waalrruwmu waalbatshaau waalllizaamu ‏{‏fasawfa yakuwnu lizaamana‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:Five (great events) have passed: the Smoke, the Moon, the Romans, the Mighty grasp and the constant Punishment which occurs in 'So the torment will be yours forever
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ـ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلاَةُ وَالسَّلاَمُ ـ رَأَى أَبَاهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَيْهِ الْغَبَرَةُ وَالْقَتَرَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ الْغَبَرَةُ هِيَ الْقَتَرَةُ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala iibraahiymu bnu tahmaana 'ani abni aabiy dhiibin, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna iibraahiyma 'alayhi alssalaaau waalssalaamu raaaa aabaahu yawma alqiyaamaai 'alayhi alghabaraau waalqataraau ‏"‏‏.‏ alghabaraau hiya alqataraau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection Abraham will see his father covered with Qatara and Ghabara. (i.e. having a dark face)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَخِي، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَلْقَى إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَبَاهُ فَيَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّكَ وَعَدْتَنِي أَنْ لاَ تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ إِنِّي حَرَّمْتُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathanaa aakhiy, 'ani abni aabiy dhiibin, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yalqaa iibraahiymu aabaahu fayaquwlu yaa rabbi iinnaka wa'adtaniy aan laa tukhziniy yawma yub'athuwna fayaquwlu alllahu iinniy harramtu aljannaaa 'alaa alkaafiriyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Abraham will meet his father (on the Day of Resurrection) and will say, 'O my Lord! You promised me that You would not let me in disgrace on the Day when people will be resurrected.' Allah will say, 'I have forbidden Paradise to the non-believers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}‏ صَعِدَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الصَّفَا فَجَعَلَ يُنَادِي ‏"‏ يَا بَنِي فِهْرٍ، يَا بَنِي عَدِيٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ لِبُطُونِ قُرَيْشٍ حَتَّى اجْتَمَعُوا، فَجَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولاً لِيَنْظُرَ مَا هُوَ، فَجَاءَ أَبُو لَهَبٍ وَقُرَيْشٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ لَوْ أَخْبَرْتُكُمْ أَنَّ خَيْلاً بِالْوَادِي تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُغِيرَ عَلَيْكُمْ، أَكُنْتُمْ مُصَدِّقِيَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ، مَا جَرَّبْنَا عَلَيْكَ إِلاَّ صِدْقًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنِّي نَذِيرٌ لَكُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو لَهَبٍ تَبًّا لَكَ سَائِرَ الْيَوْمِ، أَلِهَذَا جَمَعْتَنَا فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏تَبَّتْ يَدَا أَبِي لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ * مَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala haddathaniy 'amruw bnu murraaa, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala lammaa nazalat ‏{‏waaandhir 'ashiyrataka alaaqrabiyna‏}‏ sa'ida alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alssafaa faja'ala yunaadiy ‏"‏ yaa baniy fihrin, yaa baniy 'adiyyin ‏"‏‏.‏ libutuwni qurayshin hattaa ajtama'uwa, faja'ala alrrajulu iidhaa lam yastati' aan yakhruja aarsala rasuwlaan liyanzura maa huwa, fajaa'a aabuw lahabin waqurayshun faqaala ‏"‏ aaraaaytakum law aakhbartukum aanna khaylaan bialwaadiy turiydu aan tughiyra 'alaykum, aakuntum musaddiqiyya ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa na'am, maa jarrabnaa 'alayka iilaaa sidqana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinniy nadhiyrun lakum bayna yadaa 'adhaabin shadiydin ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw lahabin tabbana laka saaiira alyawmi, aalihadhaa jama'tanaa fanazalat ‏{‏tabbat yadaa aabiy lahabin watabba * maa aaghnaa 'anhu maaluhu wamaa kasaba‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Verse:--'And warn your tribe of near-kindred, was revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) ascended the Safa (mountain) and started calling, "O Bani Fihr! O Bani `Adi!" addressing various tribes of Quraish till they were assembled. Those who could not come themselves, sent their messengers to see what was there. Abu Lahab and other people from Quraish came and the Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Suppose I told you that there is an (enemy) cavalry in the valley intending to attack you, would you believe me?" They said, "Yes, for we have not found you telling anything other than the truth." He then said, "I am a warner to you in face of a terrific punishment." Abu Lahab said (to the Prophet) "May your hands perish all this day. Is it for this purpose you have gathered us?" Then it was revealed: "Perish the hands of Abu Lahab (one of the Prophet's uncles), and perish he! His wealth and his children will not profit him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ قُرَيْشٍ ـ أَوْ كَلِمَةً نَحْوَهَا ـ اشْتَرُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، يَا عَبَّاسُ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، وَيَا صَفِيَّةُ عَمَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكِ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَيَا فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ سَلِينِي مَا شِئْتِ مِنْ مَالِي، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكِ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ أَصْبَغُ عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, waaabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna aanzala alllahu ‏{‏waaandhir 'ashiyrataka alaaqrabiyna‏}‏ qaala ‏"‏ yaa ma'shara qurayshin aaw kalimaaan nahwahaa ashtaruwa aanfusakum, laa aughniy 'ankum mina alllahi shayiana, yaa baniy 'abdi manaafin, laa aughniy 'ankum mina alllahi shayiana, yaa 'abbaasu bna 'abdi almuttalibi, laa aughniy 'anka mina alllahi shayiana, wayaa safiyyaau 'ammaaa rasuwli alllahi, laa aughniy 'anki mina alllahi shayiana wayaa faatimaau binta muhammadin saliyniy maa shiiti min maaliy, laa aughniy 'anki mina alllahi shayiana ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu aasbaghu 'ani abni wahbin 'an yuwnusa 'ani abni shihaabin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up when the Verse:--'And warn your tribe of near kindred...." (26.214) was revealed and said, "O Quraish people! (or he said a similar word) Buy yourselves! I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him) O Bani Abd Manaf! I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him). O `Abbas, the son of `Abdul Muttalib! I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him). O Safiya, (the aunt of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him). O Fatima, the daughter of Muhammad! Ask what you wish from my property, but I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا حَضَرَتْ أَبَا طَالِبٍ الْوَفَاةُ جَاءَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَجَدَ عِنْدَهِ أَبَا جَهْلٍ وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَىْ عَمِّ قُلْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، كَلِمَةً أُحَاجُّ لَكَ بِهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ أَتَرْغَبُ عَنْ مِلَّةِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْرِضُهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَيُعِيدَانِهِ بِتِلْكَ الْمَقَالَةِ حَتَّى قَالَ أَبُو طَالِبٍ آخِرَ مَا كَلَّمَهُمْ عَلَى مِلَّةِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، وَأَبَى أَنْ يَقُولُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ لأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ مَا لَمْ أُنْهَ عَنْكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوا لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ‏}‏ وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِي أَبِي طَالِبٍ، فَقَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏إِنَّكَ لاَ تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏{‏أُولِي الْقُوَّةِ‏}‏ لاَ يَرْفَعُهَا الْعُصْبَةُ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ‏.‏ ‏{‏لَتَنُوءُ‏}‏ لَتُثْقِلُ‏.‏ ‏{‏فَارِغًا‏}‏ إِلاَّ مِنْ ذِكْرِ مُوسَى‏.‏ ‏{‏الْفَرِحِينَ‏}‏ الْمَرِحِينَ‏.‏ ‏{‏قُصِّيهِ‏}‏ اتَّبِعِي أَثَرَهُ، وَقَدْ يَكُونُ أَنْ يَقُصَّ الْكَلاَمَ ‏{‏نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ‏}‏‏.‏ ‏{‏عَنْ جُنُبٍ‏}‏ عَنْ بُعْدٍ عَنْ جَنَابَةٍ وَاحِدٌ، وَعَنِ اجْتِنَابٍ أَيْضًا، يَبْطِشُ وَيَبْطُشُ‏.‏ ‏{‏يَأْتَمِرُونَ‏}‏ يَتَشَاوَرُونَ‏.‏ الْعُدْوَانُ وَالْعَدَاءُ وَالتَّعَدِّي وَاحِدٌ‏.‏ ‏{‏آنَسَ‏}‏ أَبْصَرَ‏.‏ الْجِذْوَةُ قِطْعَةٌ غَلِيظَةٌ مِنَ الْخَشَبِ، لَيْسَ فِيهَا لَهَبٌ، وَالشِّهَابُ فِيهِ لَهَبٌ‏.‏ وَالْحَيَّاتُ أَجْنَاسٌ الْجَانُّ وَالأَفَاعِي وَالأَسَاوِدُ‏.‏ ‏{‏رِدْءًا‏}‏ مُعِينًا‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏{‏يُصَدِّقُنِي‏}‏ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ ‏{‏سَنَشُدُّ‏}‏ سَنُعِينُكَ كُلَّمَا عَزَّزْتَ شَيْئًا فَقَدْ جَعَلْتَ لَهُ عَضُدًا‏.‏ مَقْبُوحِينَ مُهْلَكِينَ‏.‏ ‏{‏وَصَّلْنَا‏}‏ بَيَّنَّاهُ وَأَتْمَمْنَاهُ‏.‏ ‏{‏يُجْبَى‏}‏ يُجْلَبُ ‏.‏‏{‏بَطِرَتْ‏}‏ أَشِرَتْ‏.‏ ‏{‏فِي أُمِّهَا رَسُولاً‏}‏ أُمُّ الْقُرَى مَكَّةُ وَمَا حَوْلَهَا‏.‏ ‏{‏تُكِنُّ‏}‏ تُخْفِي‏.‏ أَكْنَنْتُ الشَّىْءَ أَخْفَيْتُهُ، وَكَنَنْتُهُ أَخْفَيْتُهُ وَأَظْهَرْتُهُ‏.‏ ‏{‏وَيْكَأَنَّ اللَّهَ‏}‏ مِثْلُ أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ ‏{‏يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ‏}‏ يُوَسِّعُ عَلَيْهِ وَيُضَيِّقُ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala lammaa hadarat aabaa taalibin alwafaaau jaa'ahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fawajada 'indahi aabaa jahlin wa'abda alllahi bna aabiy aumayyaaa bni almughiyraai, faqaala ‏"‏ aaa 'ammi qul laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu, kalimaaan auhaajju laka bihaa 'inda alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw jahlin wa'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy aumayyaaa aatarghabu 'an millaai 'abdi almuttalibi falam yazal rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'riduhaa 'alayhi, wayu'iydaanihi bitilka almaqaalaai hattaa qaala aabuw taalibin akhira maa kallamahum 'alaa millaai 'abdi almuttalibi, waaabaa aan yaquwlu laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ waalllahi laastaghfiranna laka maa lam aunha 'anka ‏"‏‏.‏ faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏maa kaana lilnnabiyyi waalladhiyna amanuwa aan yastaghfiruwa lilmushrikiyna‏}‏ waaanzala alllahu fiy aabiy taalibin, faqaala lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏iinnaka laa tahdiy man aahbabta walakinna alllaha yahdiy man yashaa'u‏}‏‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin ‏{‏auwliy alquwwaai‏}‏ laa yarfa'uhaa al'usbaau mina alrrijaali‏.‏ ‏{‏latanuw'u‏}‏ latuthqilu‏.‏ ‏{‏faarighana‏}‏ iilaaa min dhikri muwsaa‏.‏ ‏{‏alfarihiyna‏}‏ almarihiyna‏.‏ ‏{‏qussiyhi‏}‏ attabi'iy aatharahu, waqad yakuwnu aan yaqussa alkalaama ‏{‏nahnu naqussu 'alayka‏}‏‏.‏ ‏{‏'an junubin‏}‏ 'an bu'din 'an janaabaain waahidun, wa'ani ajtinaabin aaydana, yabtishu wayabtushu‏.‏ ‏{‏yaatamiruwna‏}‏ yatashaawaruwna‏.‏ al'udwaanu waal'adaa'u waaltta'addiy waahidun‏.‏ ‏{‏anasa‏}‏ aabsara‏.‏ aljidhwaau qit'aaun ghaliyzaaun mina alkhashabi, laysa fiyhaa lahabun, waalshhihaabu fiyhi lahabun‏.‏ waalhayyaatu aajnaasun aljaannu waalaafaa'iy waalaasaawidu‏.‏ ‏{‏rid'ana‏}‏ mu'iynana‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin ‏{‏yusaddiquniy‏}‏ waqaala ghayruhu ‏{‏sanashuddu‏}‏ sanu'iynuka kullamaa 'azzazta shayiana faqad ja'alta lahu 'adudana‏.‏ maqbuwhiyna muhlakiyna‏.‏ ‏{‏wassalnaa‏}‏ bayyannaahu waaatmamnaahu‏.‏ ‏{‏yujbaa‏}‏ yujlabu ‏.‏‏{‏batirat‏}‏ aashirat‏.‏ ‏{‏fiy aummihaa rasuwlaan‏}‏ aummu alquraa makkaau wamaa hawlahaa‏.‏ ‏{‏tukinnu‏}‏ tukhfiy‏.‏ aaknantu alshhaa'a aakhfaytuhu, wakanantuhu aakhfaytuhu waaazhartuhu‏.‏ ‏{‏waykaaanna alllaha‏}‏ mithlu aalam tara aanna alllaha ‏{‏yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashaa'u wayaqdiru‏}‏ yuwassi'u 'alayhi wayudayyiqu 'alayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Musaiyab:When Abu Talib was on his death bed, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to him and found with him, Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya bin Al-Mughira. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O uncle! Say: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, a sentence with which I will defend you before Allah." On that Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya said to Abu Talib, "Will you now leave the religion of `Abdul Muttalib?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on inviting him to say that sentence while the other two kept on repeating their sentence before him till Abu Talib said as the last thing he said to them, "I am on the religion of `Abdul Muttalib," and refused to say: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah. On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Allah, I will keep on asking Allah's forgiveness for you unless I am forbidden (by Allah) to do so." So Allah revealed:-- 'It is not fitting for the Prophet (ﷺ) and those who believe that they should invoke (Allah) for forgiveness for pagans.' (9.113) And then Allah revealed especially about Abu Talib:--'Verily! You (O, Muhammad) guide not whom you like, but Allah guides whom He will
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ الْعُصْفُرِيُّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، ‏{‏لَرَادُّكَ إِلَى مَعَادٍ‏}‏ قَالَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa ya'laa, haddathanaa sufyaanu al'usfuriyyu, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, ‏{‏laraadduka iilaa ma'aadin‏}‏ qaala iilaa makkaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Qur'an 28.85'...will bring you home' means to Mecca
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، وَالأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يُحَدِّثُ فِي كِنْدَةَ فَقَالَ يَجِيءُ دُخَانٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيَأْخُذُ بِأَسْمَاعِ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَأَبْصَارِهِمْ، يَأْخُذُ الْمُؤْمِنَ كَهَيْئَةِ الزُّكَامِ‏.‏ فَفَزِعْنَا، فَأَتَيْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، وَكَانَ مُتَّكِئًا، فَغَضِبَ فَجَلَسَ فَقَالَ مَنْ عَلِمَ فَلْيَقُلْ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَعْلَمْ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَإِنَّ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ أَنْ يَقُولَ لِمَا لاَ يَعْلَمُ لاَ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ لِنَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ‏}‏ وَإِنَّ قُرَيْشًا أَبْطَئُوا عَنِ الإِسْلاَمِ فَدَعَا عَلَيْهِمِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَيْهِمْ بِسَبْعٍ كَسَبْعِ يُوسُفَ، فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ سَنَةٌ حَتَّى هَلَكُوا فِيهَا، وَأَكَلُوا الْمَيْتَةَ وَالْعِظَامَ وَيَرَى الرَّجُلُ مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ كَهَيْئَةِ الدُّخَانِ ‏"‏، فَجَاءَهُ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ جِئْتَ تَأْمُرُنَا بِصِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ، وَإِنَّ قَوْمَكَ قَدْ هَلَكُوا فَادْعُ اللَّهَ، فَقَرَأَ ‏{‏فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏عَائِدُونَ‏}‏ أَفَيُكْشَفُ عَنْهُمْ عَذَابُ الآخِرَةِ إِذَا جَاءَ ثُمَّ عَادُوا إِلَى كُفْرِهِمْ فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَى‏}‏ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ وَلِزَامًا يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ‏{‏الم * غُلِبَتِ الرُّومُ‏}‏ إِلَى ‏{‏سَيَغْلِبُونَ‏}‏ وَالرُّومُ قَدْ مَضَى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa mansuwrun, waalaa'mashu, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, qaala baynamaa rajulun yuhaddithu fiy kindaaa faqaala yajiy'u dukhaanun yawma alqiyaamaai fayaakhudhu biaasmaa'i almunaafiqiyna waaabsaarihim, yaakhudhu almuumina kahayiaai alzzukaami‏.‏ fafazi'naa, faaataytu abna mas'uwdin, wakaana muttakiiana, faghadiba fajalasa faqaala man 'alima falyaqul, waman lam ya'lam falyaquli alllahu aa'lamu‏.‏ faiinna mina al'ilmi aan yaquwla limaa laa ya'lamu laa aa'lamu‏.‏ faiinna alllaha qaala linabiyyihi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏qul maa aasaalukum 'alayhi min aajrin wamaa aanaa mina almutakallifiyna‏}‏ waiinna qurayshana aabtaiuwa 'ani aliislaami fada'aa 'alayhimi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aa'inniy 'alayhim bisab'in kasab'i yuwsufa, faaakhadhathum sanaaun hattaa halakuwa fiyhaa, waaakaluwa almaytaaa waal'izaama wayaraa alrrajulu maa bayna alssamaa'i waalaardi kahayiaai alddukhaani ‏"‏, fajaa'ahu aabuw sufyaana faqaala yaa muhammadu jiita taamurunaa bisilaai alrrahimi, waiinna qawmaka qad halakuwa faad'u alllaha, faqaraaa ‏{‏faartaqib yawma taatiy alssamaa'u bidukhaanin mubiynin‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏'aaiiduwna‏}‏ aafayukshafu 'anhum 'adhaabu alakhiraai iidhaa jaa'a thumma 'aaduwa iilaa kufrihim fadhalika qawluhu ta'aalaa ‏{‏yawma nabtishu albatshaaa alkubraa‏}‏ yawma badrin walizaamana yawma badrin ‏{‏alm * ghulibati alrruwmu‏}‏ iilaa ‏{‏sayaghlibuwna‏}‏ waalrruwmu qad madaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Masruq:While a man was delivering a speech in the tribe of Kinda, he said, "Smoke will prevail on the Day of Resurrection and will deprive the hypocrites their faculties of hearing and seeing. The believers will be afflicted with something like cold only thereof." That news scared us, so I went to (Abdullah) Ibn Mas`ud while he was reclining (and told him the story) whereupon he became angry, sat up and said, "He who knows a thing can say, it, but if he does not know, he should say, 'Allah knows best,' for it is an aspect of knowledge to say, 'I do not know,' if you do not know a certain thing. Allah said to His prophet. 'Say (O Muhammad): No wage do I ask of you for this (Qur'an), nor I am one of the pretenders (a person who pretends things which do not exist.)' (38.86) The Quraish delayed in embracing Islam for a period, so the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked evil on them, saying, 'O Allah! Help me against them by sending seven years of (famine) like those of Joseph.' So they were afflicted with such a severe year of famine that they were destroyed therein and ate dead animals and bones. They started seeing something like smoke between the sky and the earth (because of severe hunger). Abu Sufyan then came (to the Prophet) and said, "O Muhammad! You came to order us for to keep good relations with Kith and kin, and your kinsmen have now perished, so please invoke Allah (to relieve them).' Then Ibn Mas`ud recited:-- 'Then watch you for the day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible....but truly you will return! (to disbelief) (44.10-15) Ibn Mas`ud added, Then the punishment was stopped, but truly, they reverted to heathenism (their old way). So Allah (threatened them thus): 'On the day when we shall seize you with a mighty grasp.' (44.16) And that was the day of the Battle of Badr. Allah's saying- "Lizama" (the punishment) refers to the day of Badr Allah's Statement: Alif-Lam-Mim, the Romans have been defeated, and they, after their defeat, will be victorious,' (30.1- 3) (This verse): Indicates that the defeat of Byzantine has already passed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ إِلاَّ يُولَدُ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ، فَأَبَوَاهُ يُهَوِّدَانِهِ أَوْ يُنَصِّرَانِهِ أَوْ يُمَجِّسَانِهِ، كَمَا تُنْتَجُ الْبَهِيمَةُ بَهِيمَةً جَمْعَاءَ، هَلْ تُحِسُّونَ فِيهَا مِنْ جَدْعَاءَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏{‏فِطْرَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا لاَ تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ ذَلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa min mawluwdin iilaaa yuwladu 'alaa alfitraai, faaabawaahu yuhawwidaanihi aaw yunassiraanihi aaw yumajjisaanihi, kamaa tuntaju albahiymaau bahiymaaan jam'aa'a, hal tuhissuwna fiyhaa min jad'aa'a ‏"‏ thumma yaquwlu ‏{‏fitraaa alllahi allatiy fatara alnnaasa 'alayhaa laa tabdiyla likhalqi alllahi dhalika alddiynu alqayyimu‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No child is born except on Al-Fitra (Islam) and then his parents make him Jewish, Christian or Magian, as an animal produces a perfect young animal: do you see any part of its body amputated?" Then he recited, 'The religion of pure Islamic Faith (Hanifa),(i.e. to worship none but Allah), The pure Allah's Islamic nature with which He (Allah) has created mankind. Let There be no change in Allah's religion (i.e. to join none in Allah's worship). That is the straight religion; but most of men know not
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوا إِيمَانَهُمْ بِظُلْمٍ‏}‏ شَقَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَى أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالُوا أَيُّنَا لَمْ يَلْبِسْ إِيمَانَهُ بِظُلْمٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِذَاكَ، أَلاَ تَسْمَعُ إِلَى قَوْلِ لُقْمَانَ لاِبْنِهِ ‏{‏إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa nazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏alladhiyna amanuwa walam yalbisuwa iiymaanahum bizulmin‏}‏ shaqqa dhalika 'alaa aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaaluwa aayyunaa lam yalbis iiymaanahu bizulmin faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnahu laysa bidhaaka, aalaa tasma'u iilaa qawli luqmaana laibnihi ‏{‏iinna alshhirka lazulmun 'aziymun‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:When there was revealed: 'It is those who believe and confuse not their beliefs with wrong.' (6.82) It was very hard for the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so they said, "Which of us has not confused his belief with wrong?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Verse does not mean this. Don't you hear Luqman's statement to his son: 'Verily! Joining others in worship, with Allah is a great wrong indeed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَوْمًا بَارِزًا لِلنَّاسِ إِذْ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الإِيمَانُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَلِقَائِهِ وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْبَعْثِ الآخِرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الإِسْلاَمُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الإِسْلاَمُ أَنْ تَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تُشْرِكَ بِهِ شَيْئًا، وَتُقِيمَ الصَّلاَةَ، وَتُؤْتِيَ الزَّكَاةَ الْمَفْرُوضَةَ، وَتَصُومَ رَمَضَانَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا الإِحْسَانُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الإِحْسَانُ أَنْ تَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ كَأَنَّكَ تَرَاهُ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ تَرَاهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَرَاكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَتَى السَّاعَةُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا الْمَسْئُولُ عَنْهَا بِأَعْلَمَ مِنَ السَّائِلِ، وَلَكِنْ سَأُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ أَشْرَاطِهَا إِذَا وَلَدَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ رَبَّتَهَا، فَذَاكَ مِنْ أَشْرَاطِهَا، وَإِذَا كَانَ الْحُفَاةُ الْعُرَاةُ رُءُوسَ النَّاسِ فَذَاكَ مِنْ أَشْرَاطِهَا فِي خَمْسٍ لا يَعْلَمُهُنَّ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏{‏إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الأَرْحَامِ‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ رُدُّوا عَلَىَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَخَذُوا لِيَرُدُّوا فَلَمْ يَرَوْا شَيْئًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا جِبْرِيلُ جَاءَ لِيُعَلِّمَ النَّاسَ دِينَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, 'an jariyrin, 'an aabiy hayyaana, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yawmana baarizana lilnnaasi iidh aataahu rajulun yamshiy faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi maa aliiymaanu qaala ‏"‏ aliiymaanu aan tuumina bialllahi wamalaaiikatihi warusulihi waliqaaiihi watuumina bialba'thi alakhiri ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi maa aliislaamu qaala ‏"‏ aliislaamu aan ta'buda alllaha walaa tushrika bihi shayiana, watuqiyma alssalaaaa, watuutiya alzzakaaaa almafruwdaaa, watasuwma ramadaana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, maa aliihsaanu qaala ‏"‏ aliihsaanu aan ta'buda alllaha kaaannaka taraahu, faiin lam takun taraahu faiinnahu yaraaka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi mataa alssaa'aau qaala ‏"‏ maa almasiuwlu 'anhaa biaa'lama mina alssaaiili, walakin saauhaddithuka 'an aashraatihaa iidhaa waladati almaraaau rabbatahaa, fadhaaka min aashraatihaa, waiidhaa kaana alhufaaau al'uraaau ru'uwsa alnnaasi fadhaaka min aashraatihaa fiy khamsin la ya'lamuhunna iilaaa alllahu ‏{‏iinna alllaha 'indahu 'ilmu alssaa'aai wayunazzilu alghaytha waya'lamu maa fiy alaarhaami‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma ansarafa alrrajulu faqaala ‏"‏ rudduwa 'alaaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faaakhadhuwa liyarudduwa falam yarawa shayiana‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ hadhaa jibriylu jaa'a liyu'allima alnnaasa diynahum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:One day while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting with the people, a man came to him walking and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). What is Belief?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Belief is to believe in Allah, His Angels, His Books, His Apostles, and the meeting with Him, and to believe in the Resurrection." The man asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) What is Islam?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Islam is to worship Allah and not worship anything besides Him, to offer prayers perfectly, to pay the (compulsory) charity (i.e. Zakat) and to fast the month of Ramadan." The man again asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) What is Ihsan (i.e. perfection or Benevolence)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ihsan is to worship Allah as if you see Him, and if you do not achieve this state of devotion, then (take it for granted that) Allah sees you." The man further asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) When will the Hour be established?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "The one who is asked about it does not know more than the questioner does, but I will describe to you its portents. When the lady slave gives birth to her mistress, that will be of its portents; when the bare-footed naked people become the chiefs of the people, that will be of its portents. The Hour is one of five things which nobody knows except Allah. Verily, the knowledge of the Hour is with Allah (alone). He sends down the rain, and knows that which is in the wombs." (31.34) Then the man left. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Call him back to me." They went to call him back but could not see him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That was Gabriel who came to teach the people their religion." (See Hadith No. 47 Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ‏"‏ مَفَاتِيحُ الْغَيْبِ خَمْسٌ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, qaala haddathaniy abnu wahbin, qaala haddathaniy 'umaru bnu muhammadi bni zaydi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna aabaahu, haddathahu aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ mafaatiyhu alghaybi khamsun ‏"‏ thumma qaraaa ‏{‏iinna alllaha 'indahu 'ilmu alssaa'aai‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The keys of the Unseen are five." And then he recited: 'Verily, the knowledge of the Hour is with Allah (alone)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِي الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ، وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ، وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏فَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ‏}‏‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ قِيلَ لِسُفْيَانَ رِوَايَةً‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَىُّ شَىْءٍ قَالَ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ قَرَأَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ قُرَّاتِ أَعْيُنٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ qaala alllahu tabaaraka wata'aalaa aa'dadtu li'ibaadiy alssaalihiyna maa laa 'aynun raaat, walaa audhunun sami'at, walaa khatara 'alaa qalbi basharin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa aqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏falaa ta'lamu nafsun maa aukhfiya lahum min qurraai aa'yunin‏}‏‏.‏ wahaddathanaa sufyaanu haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi 'ani alaa'raji 'an aabiy hurayraaa qaala qaala alllahu mithlahu‏.‏ qiyla lisufyaana riwaayaaan‏.‏ qaala faaaaau shaa'in qaala aabuw mu'aawiyaaa 'ani alaa'mashi 'an aabiy saalihin qaraaa aabuw hurayraaa qurraati aa'yunin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'I have prepared for my pious worshipers such things as no eye has ever seen, no ear has ever heard of, and nobody has ever thought of." Abu Huraira added: If you wish you can read:-- 'No soul knows what is kept hidden (in reserve) for them of joy as reward for what they used to do
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِي الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ، وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ، وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ، ذُخْرًا، بَلْهَ مَا أُطْلِعْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏فَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu nasrin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, haddathanaa aabuw saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaquwlu alllahu ta'aalaa aa'dadtu li'ibaadiy alssaalihiyna maa laa 'aynun raaat, walaa audhunun sami'at, walaa khatara 'alaa qalbi basharin, dhukhrana, balha maa autli'tum 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaraaa ‏{‏falaa ta'lamu nafsun maa aukhfiya lahum min qurraai aa'yunin jazaa'an bimaa kaanuwa ya'maluwna‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet, said, "Allah said, 'I have prepared for My pious worshipers such things as no eye has ever seen, no ear has ever heard of, and nobody has ever thought of. All that is reserved, besides which, all that you have seen, is nothing." Then he recited:-- 'No soul knows what is kept hidden (in reserve) for them of joy as a reward for what they used to do
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُلَيْحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مُؤْمِنٍ إِلاَّ وَأَنَا أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏النَّبِيُّ أَوْلَى بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ‏}‏ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ تَرَكَ مَالاً فَلْيَرِثْهُ عَصَبَتُهُ مَنْ كَانُوا، فَإِنْ تَرَكَ دَيْنًا أَوْ ضِيَاعًا فَلْيَأْتِنِي وَأَنَا مَوْلاَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fulayhin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an hilaali bni 'aliyyin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy 'amraaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ maa min muuminin iilaaa waaanaa aawlaa alnnaasi bihi fiy alddunyaa waalakhiraai, aqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏alnnabiyyu aawlaa bialmuuminiyna min aanfusihim‏}‏ faaayyumaa muuminin taraka maalaan falyarithhu 'asabatuhu man kaanuwa, faiin taraka daynana aaw diyaa'ana falyaatiniy waaanaa mawlaahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no believer but I, of all the people, I am the closest to him both in this world and in the Hereafter. Recite if you wish: 'The Prophet (ﷺ) is closer to the believers than their own selves.' (33.6) so if a believer (dies) leaves some property then his relatives will inherit that property; but if he is in debt or he leaves poor children, let those (creditors and children) come to me (that I may pay the debt and provide for the children), for them I am his sponsor (surely)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ حَارِثَةَ، مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا كُنَّا نَدْعُوهُ إِلاَّ زَيْدَ ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى نَزَلَ الْقُرْآنُ ‏{‏ادْعُوهُمْ لآبَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu almukhtaari, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, qaala haddathaniy saalimun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna zayda bna haarithaaa, mawlaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa kunnaa nad'uwhu iilaaa zayda abna muhammadin hattaa nazala alquranu ‏{‏ad'uwhum labaaiihim huwa aaqsatu 'inda alllahi‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:We used not to call Zaid bin Haritha the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except Zaid bin Muhammad till the Qur'anic Verse was revealed: "Call them (adopted sons) by (the names of) their fathers. That is more than just in the Sight of Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ نُرَى هَذِهِ الآيَةَ نَزَلَتْ فِي أَنَسِ بْنِ النَّضْرِ ‏{‏مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyu, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an thumaamaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala nuraa hadhihi alayaaa nazalat fiy aanasi bni alnnadri ‏{‏mina almuuminiyna rijaalun sadaquwa maa 'aahaduwa alllaha 'alayhi‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:We think that the Verse: 'Among the Believers are men who have been true to their covenant with Allah,' was revealed in favor of Anas bin An-Nadr
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي خَارِجَةُ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَسَخْنَا الصُّحُفَ فِي الْمَصَاحِفِ فَقَدْتُ آيَةً مِنْ سُورَةِ الأَحْزَابِ، كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَؤُهَا، لَمْ أَجِدْهَا مَعَ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ مَعَ خُزَيْمَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، الَّذِي جَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَهَادَتَهُ شَهَادَةَ رَجُلَيْنِ ‏{‏مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy khaarijaau bnu zaydi bni thaabitin, aanna zayda bna thaabitin, qaala lammaa nasakhnaa alssuhufa fiy almasaahifi faqadtu ayaaan min suwraai alaahzaabi, kuntu aasma'u rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqrauuhaa, lam aajidhaa ma'a aahadin iilaaa ma'a khuzaymaaa alaansaariyyi, alladhiy ja'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shahaadatahu shahaadaaa rajulayni ‏{‏mina almuuminiyna rijaalun sadaquwa maa 'aahaduwa alllaha 'alayhi‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:When we collected the fragmentary manuscripts of the Qur'an into copies, I missed one of the Verses of Surat al-Ahzab which I used to hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reading. Finally I did not find it with anybody except Khuza`ima Al-Ansari, whose witness was considered by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) equal to the witness of two men. (And that Verse was:) 'Among the believers are men who have been true to their covenant with Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَهَا حِينَ أَمَرَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُخَيِّرَ أَزْوَاجَهُ، فَبَدَأَ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي ذَاكِرٌ لَكِ أَمْرًا فَلاَ عَلَيْكِ أَنْ تَسْتَعْجِلِي حَتَّى تَسْتَأْمِرِي أَبَوَيْكِ ‏"‏، وَقَدْ عَلِمَ أَنَّ أَبَوَىَّ لَمْ يَكُونَا يَأْمُرَانِي بِفِرَاقِهِ، قَالَتْ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لأَزْوَاجِكَ‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ إِلَى تَمَامِ الآيَتَيْنِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فَفِي أَىِّ هَذَا أَسْتَأْمِرُ أَبَوَىَّ فَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الآخِرَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna 'aaiishaaa, rda allh 'nha zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaa'ahaa hiyna aamara alllahu aan yukhayyira aazwaajahu, fabadaaa biy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ iinniy dhaakirun laki aamrana falaa 'alayki aan tasta'jiliy hattaa tastaamiriy aabawayki ‏"‏, waqad 'alima aanna aabawaaaa lam yakuwnaa yaamuraaniy bifiraaqihi, qaalat thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha qaala ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alnnabiyyu qul laazwaajika‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ iilaa tamaami alayatayni faqultu lahu fafiy aaaai hadhaa aastaamiru aabawaaaa faiinniy auriydu alllaha warasuwlahu waalddaara alakhiraaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me when Allah ordered him to give option to his wives. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started with me, saying, "I am going to mention to you something but you should not hasten (to give your reply) unless you consult your parents.' He knew that my parents would not order me to leave him. Then he said, "Allah says:-- "O Prophet! Say to your wives..." (33.28-29) On that I said to him, "Then why should I consult my parents? Verily, I seek Allah, His Apostle and the Home of the Hereafter
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ لَمَّا أُمِرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِتَخْيِيرِ أَزْوَاجِهِ بَدَأَ بِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي ذَاكِرٌ لَكِ أَمْرًا فَلاَ عَلَيْكِ أَنْ لاَ تَعْجَلِي حَتَّى تَسْتَأْمِرِي أَبَوَيْكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَقَدْ عَلِمَ أَنَّ أَبَوَىَّ لَمْ يَكُونَا يَأْمُرَانِي بِفِرَاقِهِ، قَالَتْ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ قَالَ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لأَزْوَاجِكَ إِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا‏}‏ إِلَى ‏{‏أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ فَفِي أَىِّ هَذَا أَسْتَأْمِرُ أَبَوَىَّ فَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الآخِرَةَ، قَالَتْ ثُمَّ فَعَلَ أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ مَا فَعَلْتُ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مُوسَى بْنُ أَعْيَنَ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ وَأَبُو سُفْيَانَ الْمَعْمَرِيُّ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat lammaa aumira rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bitakhyiyri aazwaajihi badaaa biy faqaala ‏"‏ iinniy dhaakirun laki aamrana falaa 'alayki aan laa ta'jaliy hattaa tastaamiriy aabawayki ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat waqad 'alima aanna aabawaaaa lam yakuwnaa yaamuraaniy bifiraaqihi, qaalat thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha jalla thanaauuhu qaala ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alnnabiyyu qul laazwaajika iin kuntunna turidna alhayaaaa alddunyaa waziynatahaa‏}‏ iilaa ‏{‏aajrana 'aziymana‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat faqultu fafiy aaaai hadhaa aastaamiru aabawaaaa faiinniy auriydu alllaha warasuwlahu waalddaara alakhiraaa, qaalat thumma fa'ala aazwaaju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithla maa fa'altu‏.‏ taaba'ahu muwsaa bnu aa'yana 'an ma'marin 'ani alzzuhriyyi qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu alrrazzaaqi waaabuw sufyaana alma'mariyyu 'an ma'marin 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an 'urwaaa 'an 'aaiishaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was ordered to give option to his wives, he started with me, saying, "I am going to mention to you something, but you shall not hasten (to give your reply) unless you consult your parents." The Prophet (ﷺ) knew that my parents would not order me to leave him. Then he said, "Allah says: 'O Prophet (Muhammad)! Say to your wives: If you desire the life of this world and its glitter........a great reward." (33.28-29) I said, "Then why I consult my parents? Verily, I seek Allah, His Apostle and the Home of the Hereafter." Then all the other wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) did the same as I did
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ هَذِهِ، الآيَةَ ‏{‏وَتُخْفِي فِي نَفْسِكَ مَا اللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ‏}‏ نَزَلَتْ فِي شَأْنِ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ جَحْشٍ وَزَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahiymi, haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu mansuwrin, 'an hammaadi bni zaydin, haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna hadhihi, alayaaa ‏{‏watukhfiy fiy nafsika maa alllahu mubdiyhi‏}‏ nazalat fiy shaani zaynaba abnaai jahshin wazaydi bni haarithaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Verse: 'But you did hide in your mind that which Allah was about to make manifest.' (33.37) was revealed concerning Zainab bint Jahsh and Zaid bin Haritha
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ هِشَامٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغَارُ عَلَى اللاَّتِي وَهَبْنَ أَنْفُسَهُنَّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَقُولُ أَتَهَبُ الْمَرْأَةُ نَفْسَهَا فَلَمَّا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏تُرْجِئُ مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُؤْوِي إِلَيْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَمَنِ ابْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ‏}‏ قُلْتُ مَا أُرَى رَبَّكَ إِلاَّ يُسَارِعُ فِي هَوَاكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, qaala hishaamun haddathanaa 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kuntu aaghaaru 'alaa allaaatiy wahabna aanfusahunna lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaaquwlu aatahabu almaraaau nafsahaa falammaa aanzala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏turjiiu man tashaa'u minhunna watuuwiy iilayka man tashaa'u wamani abtaghayta mimman 'azalta falaa junaaha 'alayka‏}‏ qultu maa auraa rabbaka iilaaa yusaari'u fiy hawaaka‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:I used to look down upon those ladies who had given themselves to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I used to say, "Can a lady give herself (to a man)?" But when Allah revealed: "You (O Muhammad) can postpone (the turn of) whom you will of them (your wives), and you may receive any of them whom you will; and there is no blame on you if you invite one whose turn you have set aside (temporarily).' (33.51) I said (to the Prophet), "I feel that your Lord hastens in fulfilling your wishes and desires
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَسْتَأْذِنُ فِي يَوْمِ الْمَرْأَةِ مِنَّا بَعْدَ أَنْ أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏تُرْجِئُ مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُؤْوِي إِلَيْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَمَنِ ابْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ‏}‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا مَا كُنْتِ تَقُولِينَ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَقُولُ لَهُ إِنْ كَانَ ذَاكَ إِلَىَّ فَإِنِّي لاَ أُرِيدُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنْ أُوثِرَ عَلَيْكَ أَحَدًا‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَبَّادُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ سَمِعَ عَاصِمًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hibbaanu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa 'aasimun alaahwalu, 'an mu'aadhaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yastaadhinu fiy yawmi almaraaai minnaa ba'da aan aunzilat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏turjiiu man tashaa'u minhunna watuuwiy iilayka man tashaa'u wamani abtaghayta mimman 'azalta falaa junaaha 'alayka‏}‏‏.‏ faqultu lahaa maa kunti taquwliyna qaalat kuntu aaquwlu lahu iin kaana dhaaka iilaaaa faiinniy laa auriydu yaa rasuwla alllahi aan auwthira 'alayka aahadana‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'abbaadu bnu 'abbaadin sami'a 'aasimana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mu`adha:`Aisha said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to take the permission of that wife with whom he was supposed to stay overnight if he wanted to go to one other than her, after this Verse was revealed:-- "You (O Muhammad) can postpone (the turn of) whom you will of them (your wives) and you may receive any (of them) whom you will; and there is no blame on you if you invite one whose turn you have set aside (temporarily). (33.51) I asked Aisha, "What did you use to say (in this case)?" She said, "I used to say to him, "If I could deny you the permission (to go to your other wives) I would not allow your favor to be bestowed on any other person
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْكَ الْبَرُّ وَالْفَاجِرُ، فَلَوْ أَمَرْتَ أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِالْحِجَابِ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ آيَةَ الْحِجَابِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, 'an yahyaa, 'an humaydin, 'an aanasin, qaala qaala 'umaru rda allh 'nh qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, yadkhulu 'alayka albarru waalfaajiru, falaw aamarta aummahaati almuuminiyna bialhijaabi, faaanzala alllahu ayaaa alhijaabi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Good and bad persons enter upon you, so I suggest that you order the mothers of the Believers (i.e. your wives) to observe veils." Then Allah revealed the Verses of Al- Hijab
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مِجْلَزٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا تَزَوَّجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةَ جَحْشٍ دَعَا الْقَوْمَ، فَطَعِمُوا ثُمَّ جَلَسُوا يَتَحَدَّثُونَ وَإِذَا هُوَ كَأَنَّهُ يَتَهَيَّأُ لِلْقِيَامِ فَلَمْ يَقُومُوا، فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ قَامَ، فَلَمَّا قَامَ قَامَ مَنْ قَامَ، وَقَعَدَ ثَلاَثَةُ نَفَرٍ فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيَدْخُلَ فَإِذَا الْقَوْمُ جُلُوسٌ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ قَامُوا، فَانْطَلَقْتُ فَجِئْتُ فَأَخْبَرْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُمْ قَدِ انْطَلَقُوا، فَجَاءَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ، فَذَهَبْتُ أَدْخُلُ فَأَلْقَى الْحِجَابَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ‏}‏ الآيَةَ
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alrraqaashiyyu, haddathanaa mu'tamiru bnu sulaymaana, qaala sami'tu aabiy yaquwlu, haddathanaa aabuw mijlazin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa tazawwaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm zaynaba abnaaa jahshin da'aa alqawma, fata'imuwa thumma jalasuwa yatahaddathuwna waiidhaa huwa kaaannahu yatahayyaau lilqiyaami falam yaquwmuwa, falammaa raaaa dhalika qaama, falammaa qaama qaama man qaama, waqa'ada thalaathaau nafarin fajaa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm liyadkhula faiidhaa alqawmu juluwsun thumma iinnahum qaamuwa, faantalaqtu fajiitu faaakhbartu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahum qadi antalaquwa, fajaa'a hattaa dakhala, fadhahabtu aadkhulu faaalqaa alhijaaba bayniy wabaynahu faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alladhiyna amanuwa laa tadkhuluwa buyuwta alnnabiyyi‏}‏ alayaaa
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married Zainab bint Jahsh, he invited the people to a meal. They took the meal and remained sitting and talking. Then the Prophet (showed them) as if he is ready to get up, yet they did not get up. When he noticed that (there was no response to his movement), he got up, and the others too, got up except three persons who kept on sitting. The Prophet (ﷺ) came back in order to enter his house, but he went away again. Then they left, whereupon I set out and went to the Prophet (ﷺ) to tell him that they had departed, so he came and entered his house. I wanted to enter along with him, but he put a screen between me and him. Then Allah revealed: 'O you who believe! Do not enter the houses of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
