verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an yuwsufa bni maahaka, qaala kaana marwaanu 'alaa alhijaazi asta'malahu mu'aawiyaau, fakhataba faja'ala yadhkuru yaziyda bna mu'aawiyaaa, likaa yubaayi'a lahu ba'da aabiyhi, faqaala lahu 'abdu alrrahmani bnu aabiy bakrin shayiana, faqaala khudhuwhu‏.‏ fadakhala bayta 'aaiishaaa falam yaqdiruwa ‏{‏'alayhi‏}‏ faqaala marwaanu iinna hadhaa alladhiy aanzala alllahu fiyhi ‏{‏waalladhiy qaala liwaalidayhi auffin lakumaa aata'idaaniniy‏}‏‏.‏ faqaalat 'aaiishaau min waraa'i alhijaabi maa aanzala alllahu fiynaa shayiana mina alqurani iilaaa aanna alllaha aanzala 'udhriy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Yusuf bin Mahak:Marwan had been appointed as the governor of Hijaz by Muawiya. He delivered a sermon and mentioned Yazid bin Muawiya so that the people might take the oath of allegiance to him as the successor of his father (Muawiya). Then `Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr told him something whereupon Marwan ordered that he be arrested. But `Abdur-Rahman entered `Aisha's house and they could not arrest him. Marwan said, "It is he (`AbdurRahman) about whom Allah revealed this Verse:-- 'And the one who says to his parents: 'Fie on you! Do you hold out the promise to me..?'" On that, `Aisha said from behind a screen, "Allah did not reveal anything from the Qur'an about us except what was connected with the declaration of my innocence (of the slander)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ أَبَا النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَاحِكًا حَتَّى أَرَى مِنْهُ لَهَوَاتِهِ، إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَتَبَسَّمُ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَكَانَ إِذَا رَأَى غَيْمًا أَوْ رِيحًا عُرِفَ فِي وَجْهِهِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ النَّاسَ إِذَا رَأَوُا الْغَيْمَ فَرِحُوا، رَجَاءَ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِيهِ الْمَطَرُ، وَأَرَاكَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُ عُرِفَ فِي وَجْهِكَ الْكَرَاهِيَةُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ مَا يُؤْمِنِّي أَنْ يَكُونَ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عُذِّبَ قَوْمٌ بِالرِّيحِ، وَقَدْ رَأَى قَوْمٌ الْعَذَابَ فَقَالُوا ‏{‏هَذَا عَارِضٌ مُمْطِرُنَا‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa 'amrunw, aanna aabaa alnnadri, haddathahu 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat maa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm daahikana hattaa aaraa minhu lahawaatihi, iinnamaa kaana yatabassamu‏.‏ qaalat wakaana iidhaa raaaa ghaymana aaw riyhana 'urifa fiy wajhihi‏.‏ qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna alnnaasa iidhaa raaawua alghayma farihuwa, rajaa'a aan yakuwna fiyhi almataru, waaaraaka iidhaa raaaytahu 'urifa fiy wajhika alkaraahiyaau‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ yaa 'aaiishaau maa yuuminniy aan yakuwna fiyhi 'adhaabun 'udhhiba qawmun bialrriyhi, waqad raaaa qawmun al'adhaaba faqaaluwa ‏{‏hadhaa 'aaridun mumtirunaa‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet), I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) laughing loudly enough to enable me to see his uvula, but he used to smile only. And whenever he saw clouds or winds, signs of deep concern would appear on his face. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! When people see clouds they usually feel happy, hoping that it would rain, while I see that when you see clouds, one could notice signs of dissatisfaction on your face." He said, "O `Aisha! What is the guarantee for me that there will be no punishment in it, since some people were punished with a wind? Verily, some people saw (received) the punishment, but (while seeing the cloud) they said, 'This cloud will give us rain
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَرَّدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْهُ قَامَتِ الرَّحِمُ فَأَخَذَتْ بِحَقْوِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَقَالَ لَهَا مَهْ‏.‏ قَالَتْ هَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ الْقَطِيعَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَلاَ تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ وَأَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ بَلَى يَا رَبِّ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَاكِ لَكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏فهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَنْ تُفْسِدُوا فِي الأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, qaala haddathaniy mu'aawiyaau bnu aabiy muzarradin, 'an sa'iydi bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ khalaqa alllahu alkhalqa, falammaa faragha minhu qaamati alrrahimu faaakhadhat bihaqwi alrrahmani faqaala lahaa mah‏.‏ qaalat hadhaa maqaamu al'aaiidhi bika mina alqatiy'aai‏.‏ qaala aalaa tardayna aan aasila man wasalaki waaaqta'a man qata'aki‏.‏ qaalat balaa yaa rabbi‏.‏ qaala fadhaaki laki ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa aqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏fhal 'asaytum iin tawallaytum aan tufsiduwa fiy alaardi watuqatti'uwa aarhaamakum‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah created His creation, and when He had finished it, the womb, got up and caught hold of Allah whereupon Allah said, "What is the matter?' On that, it said, 'I seek refuge with you from those who sever the ties of Kith and kin.' On that Allah said, 'Will you be satisfied if I bestow My favors on him who keeps your ties, and withhold My favors from him who severs your ties?' On that it said, 'Yes, O my Lord!' Then Allah said, 'That is for you.' " Abu Huraira added: If you wish, you can recite: "Would you then if you were given the authority. do mischief in the land and sever your ties of kinship
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي أَبُو الْحُبَابِ، سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، بِهَذَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu hamzaaa, haddathanaa haatimun, 'an mu'aawiyaaa, qaala haddathaniy 'ammiy aabuw alhubaabi, sa'iydu bnu yasaarin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, bihadhaa, thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏fahal 'asaytum‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:(As above, No. 354, but added) Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Recite if you wish: "Would you then
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمُزَرَّدِ، بِهَذَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa bishru bnu muhammadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa mu'aawiyaau bnu aabiy almuzarradi, bihadhaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ waaqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏fahal 'asaytum‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muawiya bin Abi Al-Muzarrad:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), said, "Recite if you wish: Would you then if you were given the authority
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَسِيرُ فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ وَعُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَسِيرُ مَعَهُ لَيْلاً، فَسَأَلَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ شَىْءٍ، فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ، ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ فُلَمْ يُجِبْهُ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ثَكِلَتْ أُمُّ عُمَرَ، نَزَرْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، كُلَّ ذَلِكَ لاَ يُجِيبُكَ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ فَحَرَّكْتُ بَعِيرِي، ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمْتُ أَمَامَ النَّاسِ، وَخَشِيتُ أَنْ يُنْزَلَ فِيَّ الْقُرْآنُ، فَمَا نَشِبْتُ أَنْ سَمِعْتُ صَارِخًا يَصْرُخُ بِي فَقُلْتُ لَقَدْ خَشِيتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ نَزَلَ فِيَّ قُرْآنٌ‏.‏ فَجِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَىَّ اللَّيْلَةَ سُورَةٌ لَهِيَ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏"‏‏{‏إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yasiyru fiy ba'di aasfaarihi wa'umaru bnu alkhattaabi yasiyru ma'ahu laylaan, fasaaalahu 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi 'an shaa'in, falam yujibhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma saaalahu falam yujibhu, thumma saaalahu fulam yujibhu, faqaala 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi thakilat aummu 'umara, nazarta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thalaatha marraatin, kulla dhalika laa yujiybuka‏.‏ qaala 'umaru faharraktu ba'iyriy, thumma taqaddamtu aamaama alnnaasi, wakhashiytu aan yunzala fiyya alquranu, famaa nashibtu aan sami'tu saarikhana yasrukhu biy faqultu laqad khashiytu aan yakuwna nazala fiyya quranun‏.‏ fajiitu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallamtu 'alayhi faqaala ‏"‏ laqad aunzilat 'alaaaa alllaylaaa suwraaun lahiya aahabbu iilaaaa mimmaa tala'at 'alayhi alshhamsu ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaraaa ‏"‏‏{‏iinnaa fatahnaa laka fathana mubiynana‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aslam:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was proceeding at night during one of his journeys and `Umar bin Al-Khattab was traveling beside him, `Umar asked him about something but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not reply. He asked again, but he did not reply, and then he asked (for the third time) but he did not reply. On that, `Umar bin Al-Khattab said to himself, "Thakilat Ummu `Umar (May `Umar's mother lose her son)! I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) three times but he did not reply." `Umar then said, "I made my camel run faster and went ahead of the people, and I was afraid that some Qur'anic Verses might be revealed about me. But before getting involved in any other matter. I heard somebody calling me. I said to myself, 'I fear that some Qur'anic Verses have been revealed about me,' and so I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and greeted him. He (Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ) said, 'Tonight a Sura has been revealed to me, and it is dearer to me than that on which the sun rises (i.e. the world)' Then he recited: "Verily, We have given you a manifest victory
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ ‏{‏إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا‏}‏ قَالَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, sami'tu qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh ‏{‏iinnaa fatahnaa laka fathana mubiynana‏}‏ qaala alhudaybiyaau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:"Verily, We have given you (O Muhammad) a manifest victory.' refers to Al-Hudaibiya Peace treaty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ قُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ، قَالَ قَرَأَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ سُورَةَ الْفَتْحِ فَرَجَّعَ فِيهَا‏.‏ قَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ لَوْ شِئْتُ أَنْ أَحْكِيَ لَكُمْ قِرَاءَةَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَفَعَلْتُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu qurraaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mughaffalin, qaala qaraaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma fathi makkaaa suwraaa alfathi farajja'a fiyhaa‏.‏ qaala mu'aawiyaau law shiitu aan aahkiya lakum qiraa'aaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm lafa'altu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:On the Day of the Conquest of Mecca, the Prophet (ﷺ) recited Surat Al-Fath in a vibrating and pleasant voice. (Muawiya, the sub-narrator said, "If I could imitate the recitation of the Prophet (ﷺ) I would do so
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادٌ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْمُغِيرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى تَوَرَّمَتْ قَدَمَاهُ فَقِيلَ لَهُ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَفَلاَ أَكُونُ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sadaqaau bnu alfadli, aakhbaranaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, haddathanaa ziyaadun, aannahu sami'a almughiyraaa, yaquwlu qaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa tawarramat qadamaahu faqiyla lahu ghafara alllahu laka maa taqaddama min dhanbika wamaa taaakhhara qaala ‏ "‏ aafalaa aakuwnu 'abdana shakuwrana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Mughira:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer night prayers till his feet became swollen. Somebody said, to him," "Allah has forgiven you, your faults of the past and those to follow." On that, he said, "Shouldn't I be a thankful slave of Allah)?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا حَيْوَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، سَمِعَ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُومُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ حَتَّى تَتَفَطَّرَ قَدَمَاهُ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ لِمَ تَصْنَعُ هَذَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَقَدْ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَفَلاَ أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَكُونَ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا كَثُرَ لَحْمُهُ صَلَّى جَالِسًا فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ قَامَ، فَقَرَأَ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu 'abdi al'aziyzi, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa haywaau, 'an aabiy alaaswadi, sami'a 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwmu mina alllayli hattaa tatafattara qadamaahu faqaalat 'aaiishaau lima tasna'u hadhaa yaa rasuwla alllahi waqad ghafara alllahu laka maa taqaddama min dhanbika wamaa taaakhhara qaala ‏ "‏ aafalaa auhibbu aan aakuwna 'abdana shakuwrana ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa kathura lahmuhu sallaa jaalisana faiidhaa aaraada aan yarka'a qaama, faqaraaa thumma raka'a‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer prayer at night (for such a long time) that his feet used to crack. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why do you do it since Allah has forgiven you your faults of the past and those to follow?" He said, "Shouldn't I love to be a thankful slave (of Allah)?' When he became old, he prayed while sitting, but if he wanted to perform a bowing, he would get up, recite (some other verses) and then perform the bowing
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ هَذِهِ، الآيَةَ الَّتِي فِي الْقُرْآنِ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا‏}‏ قَالَ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَحِرْزًا لِلأُمِّيِّينَ، أَنْتَ عَبْدِي وَرَسُولِي سَمَّيْتُكَ الْمُتَوَكِّلَ لَيْسَ بِفَظٍّ وَلاَ غَلِيظٍ وَلاَ سَخَّابٍ بِالأَسْوَاقِ وَلاَ يَدْفَعُ السَّيِّئَةَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ وَلَكِنْ يَعْفُو وَيَصْفَحُ وَلَنْ يَقْبِضَهُ اللَّهُ حَتَّى يُقِيمَ بِهِ الْمِلَّةَ الْعَوْجَاءَ بِأَنْ يَقُولُوا لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ فَيَفْتَحَ بِهَا أَعْيُنًا عُمْيًا وَآذَانًا صُمًّا وَقُلُوبًا غُلْفًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy salamaaa, 'an hilaali bni aabiy hilaalin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amriw bni al'aasi rda allh 'nhma aanna hadhihi, alayaaa allatiy fiy alqurani ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alnnabiyyu iinnaa aarsalnaaka shaahidana wamubashhirana wanadhiyrana‏}‏ qaala fiy alttawraaai yaa aayyuhaa alnnabiyyu iinnaa aarsalnaaka shaahidana wamubashhirana wahirzana lilaummiyyiyna, aanta 'abdiy warasuwliy sammaytuka almutawakkila laysa bifazzin walaa ghaliyzin walaa sakhhaabin bialaaswaaqi walaa yadfa'u alssayyiiaaa bialssayyiiaai walakin ya'fuw wayasfahu walan yaqbidahu alllahu hattaa yuqiyma bihi almillaaa al'awjaa'a biaan yaquwluwa laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu fayaftaha bihaa aa'yunana 'umyana waadhaanana summana waquluwbana ghulfana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-As:This Verse: 'Verily We have sent you (O Muhammad) as a witness, as a bringer of glad tidings and as a warner.' (48.8) which is in the Qur'an, appears in the Torah thus: 'Verily We have sent you (O Muhammad) as a witness, as a bringer of glad tidings and as a warner, and as a protector for the illiterates (i.e., the Arabs.) You are my slave and My Apostle, and I have named you Al-Mutawakkil (one who depends upon Allah). You are neither hard-hearted nor of fierce character, nor one who shouts in the markets. You do not return evil for evil, but excuse and forgive. Allah will not take you unto Him till He guides through you a crooked (curved) nation on the right path by causing them to say: "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah." With such a statement He will cause to open blind eyes, deaf ears and hardened hearts
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ، وَفَرَسٌ لَهُ مَرْبُوطٌ فِي الدَّارِ، فَجَعَلَ يَنْفِرُ، فَخَرَجَ الرَّجُلُ فَنَظَرَ فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا، وَجَعَلَ يَنْفِرُ، فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ ذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ تِلْكَ السَّكِينَةُ تَنَزَّلَتْ بِالْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i rda allh 'nh qaala baynamaa rajulun min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau, wafarasun lahu marbuwtun fiy alddaari, faja'ala yanfiru, fakharaja alrrajulu fanazara falam yara shayiana, waja'ala yanfiru, falammaa aasbaha dhakara dhalika lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ tilka alssakiynaau tanazzalat bialqurani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:While a man from the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) was reciting (Qur'an) and his horse was tied in the house, the horse got startled and started jumping. The man came out, looked around but could not find anything, yet the horse went on jumping. The next morning he mentioned that to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That was the tranquility (calmness) which descended because of the recitation of the Qur'an
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعَمِائَةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an jaabirin, qaala kunnaa yawma alhudaybiyaai aalfana waaarba'amiaiaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:We were one thousand and four hundred on the Day of Al-Hudaibiya
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ صُهْبَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ، إِنِّي مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ الشَّجَرَةَ، نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْخَذْفِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa shabaabaau, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, qaala sami'tu 'uqbaaa bna suhbaana, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mughaffalin almuzaniyyi, iinniy mimman shahida alshhajaraaa, nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alkhadhfi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Uqba bin Suhban:`Abdullah bin Mughaffal Al-Muzani who was one of those who witnessed (the event of) the tree, said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the throwing of small stones (with two fingers)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: وَعَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ صُهْبَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْمُغَفَّلِ الْمُزَنِيِّ، فِي الْبَوْلِ فِي الْمُغْتَسَلِ‏.‏
verses.translit: wa'an 'uqbaaa bni suhbaana, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna almughaffali almuzaniyyi, fiy albawli fiy almughtasali‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah bin Al-Mughaffal Al-Muzani also said:"The Prophet (ﷺ) also forbade urinating at the place where one takes a bath
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ الضَّحَّاكِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الشَّجَرَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu alwaliydi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an khaalidin, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an thaabiti bni alddahhaaki rda allh 'nh wakaana min aashaabi alshhajaraai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak:who was one of the companions of the tree (those who swore allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) beneath the tree at Al-Hudaibiya):
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ السُّلَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ سِيَاهٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ أَسْأَلُهُ فَقَالَ كُنَّا بِصِفِّينَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَهْلُ بْنُ حُنَيْفٍ اتَّهِمُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنَا يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ ـ يَعْنِي الصُّلْحَ الَّذِي كَانَ بَيْنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ ـ وَلَوْ نَرَى قِتَالاً لَقَاتَلْنَا، فَجَاءَ عُمَرُ فَقَالَ أَلَسْنَا عَلَى الْحَقِّ وَهُمْ عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ أَلَيْسَ قَتْلاَنَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَقَتْلاَهُمْ فِي النَّارِ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَفِيمَ أُعْطِي الدَّنِيَّةَ فِي دِينِنَا، وَنَرْجِعُ وَلَمَّا يَحْكُمِ اللَّهُ بَيْنَنَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ إِنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَلَنْ يُضَيِّعَنِي اللَّهُ أَبَدًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ مُتَغَيِّظًا، فَلَمْ يَصْبِرْ حَتَّى جَاءَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَلَسْنَا عَلَى الْحَقِّ وَهُمْ عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ قَالَ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ إِنَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَنْ يُضَيِّعَهُ اللَّهُ أَبَدًا‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ سُورَةُ الْفَتْحِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu iishaaqa alssulamiyyu, haddathanaa ya'laa, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu siyaahin, 'an habiybi bni aabiy thaabitin, qaala aataytu aabaa waaiilin aasaaluhu faqaala kunnaa bisiffiyna faqaala rajulun aalam tara iilaa alladhiyna yud'awna iilaa kitaabi alllahi‏.‏ faqaala 'aliyyun na'am‏.‏ faqaala sahlu bnu hunayfin attahimuwa aanfusakum falaqad raaaytunaa yawma alhudaybiyaai ya'niy alssulha alladhiy kaana bayna alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalmushrikiyna walaw naraa qitaalaan laqaatalnaa, fajaa'a 'umaru faqaala aalasnaa 'alaa alhaqqi wahum 'alaa albaatili aalaysa qatlaanaa fiy aljannaai waqatlaahum fiy alnnaari qaala ‏"‏ balaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fafiyma au'tiy alddaniyyaaa fiy diyninaa, wanarji'u walammaa yahkumi alllahu baynanaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ yaa abna alkhattaabi iinniy rasuwlu alllahi walan yudayyi'aniy alllahu aabadana ‏"‏‏.‏ faraja'a mutaghayyizana, falam yasbir hattaa jaa'a aabaa bakrin faqaala yaa aabaa bakrin aalasnaa 'alaa alhaqqi wahum 'alaa albaatili qaala yaa abna alkhattaabi iinnahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walan yudayyi'ahu alllahu aabadana‏.‏ fanazalat suwraau alfathi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Habib bin Abi Thabit:I went to Abu Wail to ask him (about those who had rebelled against `Ali). On that Abu Wail said, "We were at Siffin (a city on the bank of the Euphrates, the place where the battle took place between `Ali and Muawiya) A man said, "Will you be on the side of those who are called to consult Allah's Book (to settle the dispute)?" `Ali said, 'Yes (I agree that we should settle the matter in the light of the Qur'an)." ' Some people objected to `Ali's agreement and wanted to fight. On that Sahl bin Hunaif said, 'Blame yourselves! I remember how, on the day of Al-Hudaibiya (i.e. the peace treaty between the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Quraish pagans), if we had been allowed to choose fighting, we would have fought (the pagans). At that time `Umar came (to the Prophet) and said, "Aren't we on the right (path) and they (pagans) in the wrong? Won't our killed persons go to Paradise, and theirs in the Fire?" The Prophet replied, "Yes." `Umar further said, "Then why should we let our religion be degraded and return before Allah has settled the matter between us?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O the son of Al-Khattab! No doubt, I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah will never neglect me." So `Umar left the place angrily and he was so impatient that he went to Abu Bakr and said, "O Abu Bakr! Aren't we on the right (path) and they (pagans) on the wrong?" Abu Bakr said, "O the son of Al-Khattab! He is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Allah will never neglect him." Then Sura Al-Fath (The Victory) was revealed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَسَرَةُ بْنُ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ جَمِيلٍ اللَّخْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ كَادَ الْخَيِّرَانِ أَنْ يَهْلِكَا ـ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ رَفَعَا أَصْوَاتَهُمَا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ قَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ رَكْبُ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ، فَأَشَارَ أَحَدُهُمَا بِالأَقْرَعِ بْنِ حَابِسٍ أَخِي بَنِي مُجَاشِعٍ، وَأَشَارَ الآخَرُ بِرَجُلٍ آخَرَ ـ قَالَ نَافِعٌ لاَ أَحْفَظُ اسْمَهُ ـ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ لِعُمَرَ مَا أَرَدْتَ إِلاَّ خِلاَفِي‏.‏ قَالَ مَا أَرَدْتُ خِلاَفَكَ‏.‏ فَارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمَا فِي ذَلِكَ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَرْفَعُوا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ فَمَا كَانَ عُمَرُ يُسْمِعُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ حَتَّى يَسْتَفْهِمَهُ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ذَلِكَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، يَعْنِي أَبَا بَكْرٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yasaraau bnu safwaana bni jamiylin alllakhmiyyu, haddathanaa naafi'u bnu 'umara, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, qaala kaada alkhayyiraani aan yahlikaa aabaa bakrin wa'umara rda allh 'nhma rafa'aa aaswaatahumaa 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna qadima 'alayhi rakbu baniy tamiymin, faaashaara aahaduhumaa bialaaqra'i bni haabisin aakhiy baniy mujaashi'in, waaashaara alakharu birajulin akhara qaala naafi'un laa aahfazu asmahu faqaala aabuw bakrin li'umara maa aaradta iilaaa khilaafiy‏.‏ qaala maa aaradtu khilaafaka‏.‏ faartafa'at aaswaatuhumaa fiy dhalika, faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alladhiyna amanuwa laa tarfa'uwa aaswaatakum‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏ qaala abnu alzzubayri famaa kaana 'umaru yusmi'u rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da hadhihi alayaai hattaa yastafhimahu‏.‏ walam yadhkur dhalika 'an aabiyhi, ya'niy aabaa bakrin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:The two righteous persons were about to be ruined. They were Abu Bakr and `Umar who raised their voices in the presence of the Prophet (ﷺ) when a mission from Bani Tamim came to him. One of the two recommended Al-Aqra' bin Habis, the brother of Bani Mujashi (to be their governor) while the other recommended somebody else. (Nafi`, the sub-narrator said, I do not remember his name). Abu Bakr said to `Umar, "You wanted nothing but to oppose me!" `Umar said, "I did not intend to oppose you." Their voices grew loud in that argument, so Allah revealed: 'O you who believe! Raise not your voices above the voice of the Prophet.' (49.2) Ibn Az-Zubair said, "Since the revelation of this Verse, `Umar used to speak in such a low tone that the Prophet (ﷺ) had to ask him to repeat his statements." But Ibn Az-Zubair did not mention the same about his (maternal) grandfather (i.e. Abu Bakr)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم افْتَقَدَ ثَابِتَ بْنَ قَيْسٍ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ لَكَ عِلْمَهُ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ فَوَجَدَهُ جَالِسًا فِي بَيْتِهِ مُنَكِّسًا رَأْسَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَا شَأْنُكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ شَرٌّ‏.‏ كَانَ يَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَدْ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ، وَهْوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ‏.‏ فَأَتَى الرَّجُلُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ـ فَقَالَ مُوسَى ـ فَرَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ الْمَرَّةَ الآخِرَةَ بِبِشَارَةٍ عَظِيمَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اذْهَبْ إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْ لَهُ إِنَّكَ لَسْتَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَلَكِنَّكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa aazharu bnu sa'din, aakhbaranaa abnu 'awnin, qaala aanbaaaniy muwsaa bnu aanasin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aftaqada thaabita bna qaysin faqaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi aanaa aa'lamu laka 'ilmahu‏.‏ faaataahu fawajadahu jaalisana fiy baytihi munakkisana raasahu faqaala lahu maa shaanuka‏.‏ faqaala sharrun‏.‏ kaana yarfa'u sawtahu fawqa sawti alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqad habita 'amaluhu, wahwa min aahli alnnaari‏.‏ faaataa alrrajulu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarahu aannahu qaala kadhaa wakadhaa faqaala muwsaa faraja'a iilayhi almarraaa alakhiraaa bibishaaraain 'aziymaain faqaala ‏ "‏ adhhab iilayhi faqul lahu iinnaka lasta min aahli alnnaari, walakinnaka min aahli aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) missed Thabit bin Qais for a period (So he inquired about him). A man said. "O Allah's Apostle! I will bring you his news." So he went to Thabit and found him sitting in his house and bowing his head. The man said to Thabit, " 'What is the matter with you?" Thabit replied that it was an evil affair, for he used to raise his voice above the voice of the Prophet (ﷺ) and so all his good deeds had been annulled, and he considered himself as one of the people of the Fire. Then the man returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) and told him that Thabit had said, so-and-so. (Musa bin Anas) said: The man returned to Thabit with great glad tidings. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to the man. "Go back to him and say to him: "You are not from the people of the Hell Fire, but from the people of Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ أَنَّهُ، قَدِمَ رَكْبٌ مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَمِّرِ الْقَعْقَاعَ بْنَ مَعْبَدٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُمَرُ بَلْ أَمِّرِ الأَقْرَعَ بْنَ حَابِسٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مَا أَرَدْتَ إِلَى ـ أَوْ إِلاَّ ـ خِلاَفِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ مَا أَرَدْتُ خِلاَفَكَ‏.‏ فَتَمَارَيَا حَتَّى ارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمَا، فَنَزَلَ فِي ذَلِكَ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَىِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ‏}‏ حَتَّى انْقَضَتِ الآيَةُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa hajjaajun, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu aabiy mulaykaaa, aanna 'abda alllahi bna alzzubayri, aakhbarahum aannahu, qadima rakbun min baniy tamiymin 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aabuw bakrin aammiri alqa'qaa'a bna ma'badin‏.‏ waqaala 'umaru bal aammiri alaaqra'a bna haabisin‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin maa aaradta iilaa aaw iilaaa khilaafiy‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru maa aaradtu khilaafaka‏.‏ fatamaarayaa hattaa artafa'at aaswaatuhumaa, fanazala fiy dhalika ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alladhiyna amanuwa laa tuqaddimuwa bayna yadaai alllahi warasuwlihi‏}‏ hattaa anqadati alayaau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair:A group of Bani Tamim came to the Prophet (and requested him to appoint a governor for them). Abu Bakr said, "Appoint Al-Qaqa bin Mabad." `Umar said, "Appoint Al-Aqra' bin Habis." On that Abu Bakr said (to `Umar). "You did not want but to oppose me!" `Umar replied "I did not intend to oppose you!" So both of them argued till their voices grew loud. So the following Verse was revealed: 'O you who believe! Be not forward
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرَمِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ‏.‏ حَتَّى يَضَعَ قَدَمَهُ فَتَقُولُ قَطِ قَطِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy alaaswadi, haddathanaa haramiyyun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yulqaa fiy alnnaari wataquwlu hal min maziydin‏.‏ hattaa yada'a qadamahu fataquwlu qati qati ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people will be thrown into the (Hell) Fire and it will say: "Are there any more (to come)?' (50.30) till Allah puts His Foot over it and it will say, 'Qati! Qati! (Enough Enough)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْقَطَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سُفْيَانَ الْحِمْيَرِيُّ، سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ مَهْدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، رَفَعَهُ وَأَكْثَرُ مَا كَانَ يُوقِفُهُ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ ‏ "‏ يُقَالُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ فَيَضَعُ الرَّبُّ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى قَدَمَهُ عَلَيْهَا فَتَقُولُ قَطِ قَطِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muwsaa alqattaanu, haddathanaa aabuw sufyaana alhimyariyyu, sa'iydu bnu yahyaa bni mahdiyyin haddathanaa 'awfun, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, rafa'ahu waaaktharu maa kaana yuwqifuhu aabuw sufyaana ‏ "‏ yuqaalu lijahannama hali amtalati wataquwlu hal min maziydin fayada'u alrrabbu tabaaraka wata'aalaa qadamahu 'alayhaa fataquwlu qati qati ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:(that the Prophet (ﷺ) said) "It will be said to the Hell, 'Are you filled?' It will say, 'Are there any more (to come)?' On that Allah will put His Foot on it, and it will say 'Qati! Qati! (Enough! Enough)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَحَاجَّتِ الْجَنَّةُ وَالنَّارُ فَقَالَتِ النَّارُ أُوثِرْتُ بِالْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ وَالْمُتَجَبِّرِينَ‏.‏ وَقَالَتِ الْجَنَّةُ مَا لِي لاَ يَدْخُلُنِي إِلاَّ ضُعَفَاءُ النَّاسِ وَسَقَطُهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى لِلْجَنَّةِ أَنْتِ رَحْمَتِي أَرْحَمُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِي‏.‏ وَقَالَ لِلنَّارِ إِنَّمَا أَنْتِ عَذَابٌ أُعَذِّبُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِي‏.‏ وَلِكُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا مِلْؤُهَا، فَأَمَّا النَّارُ فَلاَ تَمْتَلِئُ حَتَّى يَضَعَ رِجْلَهُ فَتَقُولُ قَطٍ قَطٍ قَطٍ‏.‏ فَهُنَالِكَ تَمْتَلِئُ وَيُزْوَى بَعْضُهَا إِلَى بَعْضٍ، وَلاَ يَظْلِمُ اللَّهُ ـ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ـ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ أَحَدًا، وَأَمَّا الْجَنَّةُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يُنْشِئُ لَهَا خَلْقًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaamin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tahaajjati aljannaau waalnnaaru faqaalati alnnaaru auwthirtu bialmutakabbiriyna waalmutajabbiriyna‏.‏ waqaalati aljannaau maa liy laa yadkhuluniy iilaaa du'afaa'u alnnaasi wasaqatuhum‏.‏ qaala alllahu tabaaraka wata'aalaa liljannaai aanti rahmatiy aarhamu biki man aashaa'u min 'ibaadiy‏.‏ waqaala lilnnaari iinnamaa aanti 'adhaabun au'adhhibu biki man aashaa'u min 'ibaadiy‏.‏ walikulli waahidaain minhumaa miluuhaa, faaammaa alnnaaru falaa tamtaliiu hattaa yada'a rijlahu fataquwlu qatin qatin qatin‏.‏ fahunaalika tamtaliiu wayuzwaa ba'duhaa iilaa ba'din, walaa yazlimu alllahu 'azza wajalla min khalqihi aahadana, waaammaa aljannaau faiinna alllaha 'azza wajalla yunshiiu lahaa khalqana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Paradise and the Fire (Hell) argued, and the Fire (Hell) said, "I have been given the privilege of receiving the arrogant and the tyrants.' Paradise said, 'What is the matter with me? Why do only the weak and the humble among the people enter me?' On that, Allah said to Paradise. 'You are My Mercy which I bestow on whoever I wish of my servants.' Then Allah said to the (Hell) Fire, 'You are my (means of) punishment by which I punish whoever I wish of my slaves. And each of you will have its fill.' As for the Fire (Hell), it will not be filled till Allah puts His Foot over it whereupon it will say, 'Qati! Qati!' At that time it will be filled, and its different parts will come closer to each other; and Allah will not wrong any of His created beings. As regards Paradise, Allah will create a new creation to fill it with
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا جُلُوسًا لَيْلَةً مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَظَرَ إِلَى الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكُمْ سَتَرَوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ كَمَا تَرَوْنَ هَذَا، لاَ تُضَامُونَ فِي رُؤْيَتِهِ، فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُغْلَبُوا عَلَى صَلاَةٍ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا فَافْعَلُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an jariyrin, 'an iismaa'iyla, 'an qaysi bni aabiy haazimin, 'an jariyri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala kunnaa juluwsana laylaaan ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fanazara iilaa alqamari laylaaa aarba'a 'ashraaa faqaala ‏"‏ iinnakum satarawna rabbakum kamaa tarawna hadhaa, laa tudaamuwna fiy ruuyatihi, faiini astata'tum aan laa tughlabuwa 'alaa salaaain qabla tuluw'i alshhamsi waqabla ghuruwbihaa faaf'aluwa ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaraaa ‏{‏wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tuluw'i alshhamsi waqabla alghuruwbi‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jarir bin `Abdullah:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a fourteenth night (of the lunar month), and he looked at the (full) moon and said, "You will see your Lord as you see this moon, and you will have no trouble in looking at Him. So, whoever can, should not miss the offering of prayers before sunrise (Fajr prayer) and before sunset (`Asr prayer)." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited: 'And celebrate the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُسَبِّحَ، فِي أَدْبَارِ الصَّلَوَاتِ كُلِّهَا‏.‏ يَعْنِي قَوْلَهُ ‏{‏وَأَدْبَارَ السُّجُودِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa warqaa'u, 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, 'an mujaahidin, qaala abnu 'abbaasin aamarahu aan yusabbiha, fiy aadbaari alssalawaati kullihaa‏.‏ ya'niy qawlahu ‏{‏waaadbaara alssujuwdi‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mujahid:Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah ordered His Prophet to celebrate Allah's praises after all prayers." He refers to His Statement: 'After the prayers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ شَكَوْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِّي أَشْتَكِي فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ طُوفِي مِنْ وَرَاءِ النَّاسِ، وَأَنْتِ رَاكِبَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَطُفْتُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي إِلَى جَنْبِ الْبَيْتِ يَقْرَأُ بِالطُّورِ وَكِتَابٍ مَسْطُورٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni nawfalin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an zaynaba abnaai aabiy salamaaa, 'an aummi salamaaa, qaalat shakawtu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanniy aashtakiy faqaala ‏ "‏ tuwfiy min waraa'i alnnaasi, waaanti raakibaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ fatuftu warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy iilaa janbi albayti yaqraau bialttuwri wakitaabin mastuwrin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:I complained to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that I was sick, so he said, "Perform the Tawaf (of Ka`ba at Mecca) while riding behind the people (who are performing the Tawaf on foot)." So I performed the Tawaf while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was offering the prayer by the side of the Ka`ba and was reciting: 'By the Mount (Sinai) and by a Decree Inscribed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثُونِي عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِالطُّورِ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏{‏أَمْ خُلِقُوا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ الْخَالِقُونَ * أَمْ خَلَقُوا السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ بَلْ لاَ يُوقِنُونَ * أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ الْمُسَيْطِرُونَ‏}‏ كَادَ قَلْبِي أَنْ يَطِيرَ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ فَأَمَّا أَنَا فَإِنَّمَا سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِالطُّورِ‏.‏ لَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ زَادَ الَّذِي قَالُوا لِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala haddathuwniy 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an muhammadi bni jubayri bni mut'imin, 'an aabiyhi rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy almaghribi bialttuwri falammaa balagha hadhihi alayaaa ‏{‏aam khuliquwa min ghayri shaa'in aam humu alkhaaliquwna * aam khalaquwa alssamawaati waalaarda bal laa yuwqinuwna * aam 'indahum khazaaiinu rabbika aam humu almusaytiruwna‏}‏ kaada qalbiy aan yatiyra‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu faaammaa aanaa faiinnamaa sami'tu alzzuhriyya yuhaddithu 'an muhammadi bni jubayri bni mut'imin 'an aabiyhi sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy almaghribi bialttuwri‏.‏ lam aasma'hu zaada alladhiy qaaluwa liy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting Surat at-Tur in the Maghrib prayer, and when he reached the Verse: 'Were they created by nothing, Or were they themselves the creators, Or did they create the Heavens and the Earth? Nay, but they have no firm belief Or do they own the treasures of Your Lord? Or have they been given the authority to do as they like...' (52.35-37) my heart was about to fly (when I realized this firm argument)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ يَا أُمَّتَاهْ هَلْ رَأَى مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَبَّهُ فَقَالَتْ لَقَدْ قَفَّ شَعَرِي مِمَّا قُلْتَ، أَيْنَ أَنْتَ مِنْ ثَلاَثٍ مَنْ حَدَّثَكَهُنَّ فَقَدْ كَذَبَ، مَنْ حَدَّثَكَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى رَبَّهُ فَقَدْ كَذَبَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَتْ ‏{‏لاَ تُدْرِكُهُ الأَبْصَارُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ الأَبْصَارَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ‏}‏ ‏{‏وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَنْ يُكَلِّمَهُ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ وَحْيًا أَوْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ‏}‏ وَمَنْ حَدَّثَكَ أَنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي غَدٍ فَقَدْ كَذَبَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَتْ ‏{‏وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا‏}‏ وَمَنْ حَدَّثَكَ أَنَّهُ كَتَمَ فَقَدْ كَذَبَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَتْ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ‏}‏ الآيَةَ، وَلَكِنَّهُ رَأَى جِبْرِيلَ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ فِي صُورَتِهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'an 'aamirin, 'an masruwqin, qaala qultu li'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha yaa aummataah hal raaaa muhammadun sla allh 'lyh wslm rabbahu faqaalat laqad qaffa sha'ariy mimmaa qulta, aayna aanta min thalaathin man haddathakahunna faqad kadhaba, man haddathaka aanna muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa rabbahu faqad kadhaba‏.‏ thumma qaraaat ‏{‏laa tudrikuhu alaabsaaru wahuwa yudriku alaabsaara wahuwa alllatiyfu alkhabiyru‏}‏ ‏{‏wamaa kaana libasharin aan yukallimahu alllahu iilaaa wahyana aaw min waraa'i hijaabin‏}‏ waman haddathaka aannahu ya'lamu maa fiy ghadin faqad kadhaba thumma qaraaat ‏{‏wamaa tadriy nafsun maadhaa taksibu ghadana‏}‏ waman haddathaka aannahu katama faqad kadhaba thumma qaraaat ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alrrasuwlu balligh maa aunzila iilayka min rabbika‏}‏ alayaaa, walakinnahu raaaa jibriyla 'alayhi alssalaamu fiy suwratihi marratayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Masruq:I said to `Aisha, "O Mother! Did Prophet Muhammad see his Lord?" Aisha said, "What you have said makes my hair stand on end ! Know that if somebody tells you one of the following three things, he is a liar: Whoever tells you that Muhammad saw his Lord, is a liar." Then Aisha recited the Verse: 'No vision can grasp Him, but His grasp is over all vision. He is the Most Courteous Well-Acquainted with all things.' (6.103) 'It is not fitting for a human being that Allah should speak to him except by inspiration or from behind a veil.' (42.51) `Aisha further said, "And whoever tells you that the Prophet knows what is going to happen tomorrow, is a liar." She then recited: 'No soul can know what it will earn tomorrow.' (31.34) She added: "And whoever tells you that he concealed (some of Allah's orders), is a liar." Then she recited: 'O Apostle! Proclaim (the Message) which has been sent down to you from your Lord..' (5.67) `Aisha added, "But the Prophet (ﷺ) saw Gabriel in his true form twice
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زِرًّا، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، ‏{‏فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَى * فَأَوْحَى إِلَى عَبْدِهِ مَا أَوْحَى‏}‏ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ أَنَّهُ رَأَى جِبْرِيلَ لَهُ سِتُّمِائَةِ جَنَاحٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa alshhaybaaniyyu, qaala sami'tu zirrana, 'an 'abdi alllahi, ‏{‏fakaana qaaba qawsayni aaw aadnaa * faaawhaa iilaa 'abdihi maa aawhaa‏}‏ qaala haddathanaa abnu mas'uwdin aannahu raaaa jibriyla lahu sittumiaiaai janaahin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:Regarding the Verses: 'And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer; So did (Allah) convey the Inspiration to His slave (Gabriel) and then he Gabriel) conveyed (that to Muhammad...' (53.9-10) Ibn Mas`ud narrated to us that the Prophet (ﷺ) had seen Gabriel with six hundred wings
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا طَلْقُ بْنُ غَنَّامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ زِرًّا عَنْ قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَى * فَأَوْحَى إِلَى عَبْدِهِ مَا أَوْحَى‏}‏ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى جِبْرِيلَ لَهُ سِتُّمِائَةِ جَنَاحٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa talqu bnu ghannaamin, haddathanaa zaaiidaau, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, qaala saaaltu zirrana 'an qawlihi ta'aalaa ‏{‏fakaana qaaba qawsayni aaw aadnaa * faaawhaa iilaa 'abdihi maa aawhaa‏}‏ qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi aanna muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa jibriyla lahu sittumiaiaai janaahin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ash-Shaibani:I asked Zirr about the Statement of Allah: 'And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer. So did Allah convey the Inspiration to His slave (Gabriel) and then he (Gabriel) conveyed that to Muhammad.' (53.10) He said, "Abdullah (bin Mas`ud) informed us that Muhammad had seen Gabriel with six hundred wings
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه – ‏{‏لَقَدْ رَأَى مِنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرَى‏}‏ قَالَ رَأَى رَفْرَفًا أَخْضَرَ قَدْ سَدَّ الأُفُقَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh – ‏{‏laqad raaaa min ayaati rabbihi alkubraa‏}‏ qaala raaaa rafrafana aakhdara qad sadda alaufuqa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:(regarding the revelation) Truly he (Muhammad) did see of the signs of his Lord; the Greatest!' (53.18) The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a green screen covering the horizon
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَشْهَبِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْجَوْزَاءِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، رضى الله عنهما فِي قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏اللاَّتَ وَالْعُزَّى‏}‏ كَانَ الَّلاَتُ رَجُلاً يَلُتُّ سَوِيقَ الْحَاجِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, haddathanaa aabuw alaashhabi, haddathanaa aabuw aljawzaa'i, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, rda allh 'nhma fiy qawlihi ‏{‏allaaata waal'uzzaa‏}‏ kaana allalaatu rajulaan yaluttu sawiyqa alhaajji‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(regarding His Statement about the Lat and the `Uzza: Lat was originally a man who used to mix Sawiq for the pilgrim)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ فَقَالَ فِي حَلِفِهِ وَاللاَّتِ وَالْعُزَّى‏.‏ فَلْيَقُلْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ وَمَنْ قَالَ لِصَاحِبِهِ تَعَالَ أُقَامِرْكَ‏.‏ فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man halafa faqaala fiy halifihi waallaaati waal'uzzaa‏.‏ falyaqul laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ waman qaala lisaahibihi ta'aala auqaamirka‏.‏ falyatasaddaq ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whomever takes an oath in which he mentions Lat and `Uzza (forgetfully), should say: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and whoever says to his companion. 'Come along, let us gamble' must give alms (as an expiation)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ، قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّمَا كَانَ مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِمَنَاةَ الطَّاغِيَةِ الَّتِي بِالْمُشَلَّلِ لاَ يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ‏}‏ فَطَافَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ مَنَاةُ بِالْمُشَلَّلِ مِنْ قُدَيْدٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ نَزَلَتْ فِي الأَنْصَارِ كَانُوا هُمْ وَغَسَّانُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسْلِمُوا يُهِلُّونَ لِمَنَاةَ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مَعْمَرٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ مِمَّنْ كَانَ يُهِلُّ لِمَنَاةَ ـ وَمَنَاةُ صَنَمٌ بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ـ قَالُوا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ كُنَّا لاَ نَطُوفُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ تَعْظِيمًا لِمَنَاةَ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, sami'tu 'urwaaa, qultu li'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha faqaalat iinnamaa kaana man aahalla bimanaaaa alttaaghiyaai allatiy bialmushallali laa yatuwfuwna bayna alssafaa waalmarwaai, faaanzala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏iinna alssafaa waalmarwaaa min sha'aaiiri alllahi‏}‏ fataafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalmuslimuwna‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu manaaau bialmushallali min qudaydin‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu alrrahmani bnu khaalidin 'ani abni shihaabin qaala 'urwaau qaalat 'aaiishaau nazalat fiy alaansaari kaanuwa hum waghassaanu qabla aan yuslimuwa yuhilluwna limanaaaa‏.‏ mithlahu‏.‏ waqaala ma'marun 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an 'urwaaa 'an 'aaiishaaa kaana rijaalun mina alaansaari mimman kaana yuhillu limanaaaa wamanaaau sanamun bayna makkaaa waalmadiynaai qaaluwa yaa nabiyya alllahi kunnaa laa natuwfu bayna alssafaa waalmarwaai ta'ziymana limanaaaa‏.‏ nahwahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa:I asked `Aisha (regarding the Sai between As Safa and Al-Marwa). She said, "Out of reverence to the idol Manat which was placed in Al-Mushallal, those who used to assume Ihram in its name, used not to perform Sai between As-Safa and Al-Marwa, so Allah revealed: 'Verily! The As-Safa and Al-Marwa (two mountains at Mecca) are among the symbols of Allah.' (2.158). Thereupon, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the Muslims used to perform Sai (between them)." Sufyan said: The (idol) Manat was at Al-Mushallal in Qudaid. `Aisha added, "The Verse was revealed in connection with the Ansar. They and (the tribe of) Ghassan used to assume Ihram in the name of Manat before they embraced Islam." `Aisha added, "There were men from the Ansar who used to assume Ihram in the name of Manat which was an idol between Mecca and Medina. They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We used not to perform the Tawaf (Sai) between As-Safa and Al-Marwa out of reverence to Manat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَجَدَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالنَّجْمِ وَسَجَدَ مَعَهُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَالْمُشْرِكُونَ وَالْجِنُّ وَالإِنْسُ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ ابْنُ طَهْمَانَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala sajada alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bialnnajmi wasajada ma'ahu almuslimuwna waalmushrikuwna waaljinnu waaliinsu‏.‏ taaba'ahu abnu tahmaana 'an aayyuwba‏.‏ walam yadhkuri abnu 'ulayyaaa abna 'abbaasin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) performed a prostration when he finished reciting Surat-an-Najm, and all the Muslims and pagans and Jinns and human beings prostrated along with him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَوَّلُ سُورَةٍ أُنْزِلَتْ فِيهَا سَجْدَةٌ ‏{‏وَالنَّجْمِ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَجَدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَجَدَ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ، إِلاَّ رَجُلاً رَأَيْتُهُ أَخَذَ كَفًّا مِنْ تُرَابٍ فَسَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ، فَرَأَيْتُهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قُتِلَ كَافِرًا، وَهْوَ أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin, aakhbaraniy aabuw aahmada, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani alaaswadi bni yaziyda, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala aawwalu suwraain aunzilat fiyhaa sajdaaun ‏{‏waalnnajmi‏}‏‏.‏ qaala fasajada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasajada man khalfahu, iilaaa rajulaan raaaytuhu aakhadha kaffana min turaabin fasajada 'alayhi, faraaaytuhu ba'da dhalika qutila kaafirana, wahwa aumayyaau bnu khalafin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The first Sura in which a prostration was mentioned, was Sura An-Najm (The Star). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prostrated (while reciting it), and everybody behind him prostrated except a man whom I saw taking a hand-full of dust in his hand and prostrated on it. Later I saw that man killed as an infidel, and he was Umaiya bin Khalaf
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، وَسُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِرْقَتَيْنِ، فِرْقَةً فَوْقَ الْجَبَلِ وَفِرْقَةً دُونَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اشْهَدُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an shu'baaa, wasufyaana, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an aabiy ma'marin, 'ani abni mas'uwdin, qaala anshaqqa alqamaru 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm firqatayni, firqaaan fawqa aljabali wafirqaaan duwnahu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ashhaduwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Masud:During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the moon was split into two parts; one part remained over the mountain, and the other part went beyond the mountain. On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Witness this miracle
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ وَنَحْنُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَارَ فِرْقَتَيْنِ، فَقَالَ لَنَا ‏ "‏ اشْهَدُوا، اشْهَدُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy najiyhin, 'an mujaahidin, 'an aabiy ma'marin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala anshaqqa alqamaru wanahnu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaara firqatayni, faqaala lanaa ‏ "‏ ashhaduwa, ashhaduwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The moon was cleft asunder while we were in the company of the Prophet, and it became two parts. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Witness, witness (this miracle)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بَكْرٌ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ فِي زَمَانِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, qaala haddathaniy bakrun, 'an ja'farin, 'an 'iraaki bni maalikin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala anshaqqa alqamaru fiy zamaani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The moon was cleft asunder during the lifetime of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَأَلَ أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ أَنْ يُرِيَهُمْ آيَةً فَأَرَاهُمُ انْشِقَاقَ الْقَمَرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala saaala aahlu makkaaa aan yuriyahum ayaaan faaaraahumu anshiqaaqa alqamari‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The people of Mecca asked the Prophet (ﷺ) to show them a sign (miracle). So he showed them (the miracle) of the cleaving of the moon
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ فِرْقَتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala anshaqqa alqamaru firqatayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The moon was cleft asunder into two parts
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau ‏{‏fahal min muddakirin‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite: "Fahal-min-Maddakir (then is there any that will receive admonition?)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, 'an yahyaa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ aannahu kaana yaqraau ‏{‏fahal min muddakirin‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite: "Fahal-min-Maddakir (then is there any that will receive admonition?)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ الأَسْوَدَ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ أَوْ مُذَّكِرٍ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ يَقْرَؤُهَا ‏{‏فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ‏}‏ قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَؤُهَا ‏{‏فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ‏}‏ دَالاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa zuhayrun, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, aannahu sami'a rajulaan, saaala alaaswada fahal min muddakirin aaw mudhhakirin faqaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi yaqrauuhaa ‏{‏fahal min muddakirin‏}‏ qaala wasami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqrauuhaa ‏{‏fahal min muddakirin‏}‏ daalaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:A man asked Al-Aswad, 'is it 'Fahal min-Muddakir' or'..Mudhdhakir?" Al Aswad replied, 'I have heard `Abdullah bin Masud reciting it, 'Fahal-min Muddakir'; I too, heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting it 'Fahal-min-Muddakir' with 'd
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَرَأَ ‏{‏فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa aabiy, 'an shu'baaa, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaraaa ‏{‏fahal min muddakirin‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite: "Fahal-min-Maddakir (then is there any that will receive admonition?)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَرَأَ ‏{‏فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ‏، ولقد أهلكنا أشياعكم فهل من مُدَّكِرٍ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaraaa ‏{‏fahal min muddakirin‏, wlqd ahlkna ashya'km fhl mn muddakirin‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) recited: 'Fahal-min Muddakir': 'And verily, We have destroyed nations like unto you; then is there any that will receive admonition?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَهَلْ مِنْ مُذَّكِرٍ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani alaaswadi bni yaziyda, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaraatu 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fahal min mudhhakirin faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏fahal min muddakirin‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:I recited before the Prophet (ﷺ) 'Fahal-min-Mudhdhakir'. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is Fahal-min Muddakir
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ وُهَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَهْوَ فِي قُبَّةٍ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَنْشُدُكَ عَهْدَكَ وَوَعْدَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ تَشَأْ لاَ تُعْبَدْ بَعْدَ الْيَوْمِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ حَسْبُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَلْحَحْتَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ‏.‏ وَهْوَ يَثِبُ فِي الدِّرْعِ، فَخَرَجَ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ ‏{‏سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ‏}‏‏.‏‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni hawshabin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, ‏.‏ wahaddathaniy muhammadun, haddathanaa 'affaanu bnu muslimin, 'an wuhaybin, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala wahwa fiy qubbaain yawma badrin ‏"‏ alllahumma iinniy aanshuduka 'ahdaka wawa'daka, alllahumma iin tashaa laa tu'bad ba'da alyawmi ‏"‏‏.‏ faaakhadha aabuw bakrin biyadihi faqaala hasbuka yaa rasuwla alllahi, aalhahta 'alaa rabbika‏.‏ wahwa yathibu fiy alddir'i, fakharaja wahwa yaquwlu ‏"‏ ‏{‏sayuhzamu aljam'u wayuwalluwna alddubura‏}‏‏.‏‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while in a tent on the day of the Battle of Badr, said, "O Allah! I request you (to fulfill) Your promise and contract! O Allah! If You wish that you will not be worshipped henceforth.." On that Abu Bakr held the Prophet (ﷺ) by the hand and said, "That is enough, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) You have appealed to your Lord too pressingly," while the Prophet (ﷺ) was putting on his armor. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out, reciting Their multitude will be put to flight, and they will show their backs
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُوسُفُ بْنُ مَاهَكَ، قَالَ إِنِّي عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَالَتْ لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَكَّةَ، وَإِنِّي لَجَارِيَةٌ أَلْعَبُ ‏{‏بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَى وَأَمَرُّ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu yuwsufa, aanna abna jurayjin, aakhbarahum qaala aakhbaraniy yuwsufu bnu maahaka, qaala iinniy 'inda 'aaiishaaa aummi almuuminiyna qaalat laqad aunzila 'alaa muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm bimakkaaa, waiinniy lajaariyaaun aal'abu ‏{‏bali alssaa'aau maw'iduhum waalssaa'aau aadhaa waaamarru‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Yusuf bin Mahak:I was in the house of `Aisha, the mother of the Believers. She said, "This revelation: "Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time (for their full recompense); and the Hour will be more previous and most bitter." (54.46) was revealed to Muhammad at Mecca while I was a playful little girl
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَهْوَ فِي قُبَّةٍ لَهُ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ‏"‏ أَنْشُدُكَ عَهْدَكَ وَوَعْدَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ شِئْتَ لَمْ تُعْبَدْ بَعْدَ الْيَوْمِ أَبَدًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ بِيَدِهِ وَقَالَ حَسْبُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ أَلْحَحْتَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ‏.‏ وَهْوَ فِي الدِّرْعِ فَخَرَجَ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ ‏{‏سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ * بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَى وَأَمَرُّ‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an khaalidin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala wahwa fiy qubbaain lahu yawma badrin ‏"‏ aanshuduka 'ahdaka wawa'daka, alllahumma iin shiita lam tu'bad ba'da alyawmi aabadana ‏"‏‏.‏ faaakhadha aabuw bakrin biyadihi waqaala hasbuka yaa rasuwla alllahi faqad aalhahta 'alaa rabbika‏.‏ wahwa fiy alddir'i fakharaja wahwa yaquwlu ‏"‏ ‏{‏sayuhzamu aljam'u wayuwalluwna alddubura * bali alssaa'aau maw'iduhum waalssaa'aau aadhaa waaamarru‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While in his tent on the day the Battle of Badr, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! I request You (to fulfill) Your promise and contract. O Allah! It You wish that the Believers be destroyed). You will never be worshipped henceforth." On that, Abu Bakr held the Prophet (ﷺ) by the hand and said, "That is enough, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have appealed to your Lord too pressingly" The Prophet (ﷺ) was wearing his armor and then went out reciting: 'Their multitude will be put to flight and they will show their backs. Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour will be more previous and most bitter
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ جَنَّتَانِ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ، آنِيَتُهُمَا وَمَا فِيهِمَا وَجَنَّتَانِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ آنِيَتُهُمَا وَمَا فِيهِمَا، وَمَا بَيْنَ الْقَوْمِ وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَنْظُرُوا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ إِلاَّ رِدَاءُ الْكِبْرِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فِي جَنَّةِ عَدْنٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy alaaswadi, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alssamadi al'ammiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'imraana aljawniyyu, 'an aabiy bakri bni 'abdi alllahi bni qaysin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ jannataani min fiddaain, aniyatuhumaa wamaa fiyhimaa wajannataani min dhahabin aniyatuhumaa wamaa fiyhimaa, wamaa bayna alqawmi wabayna aan yanzuruwa iilaa rabbihim iilaaa ridaa'u alkibri 'alaa wajhihi fiy jannaai 'adnin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Qais:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Two gardens, the utensils and the contents of which are of silver, and two other gardens, the utensils and contents of which are of gold. And nothing will prevent the people who will be in the Garden of Eden from seeing their Lord except the curtain of Majesty over His Face
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْمَةً مِنْ لُؤْلُؤَةٍ مُجَوَّفَةٍ، عَرْضُهَا سِتُّونَ مِيلاً، فِي كُلِّ زَاوِيَةٍ مِنْهَا أَهْلٌ، مَا يَرَوْنَ الآخَرِينَ يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ‏"‏ وَجَنَّتَانِ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ، آنِيَتُهُمَا وَمَا فِيهِمَا، وَجَنَّتَانِ مِنْ كَذَا آنِيَتُهُمَا، وَمَا فِيهِمَا، وَمَا بَيْنَ الْقَوْمِ وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَنْظُرُوا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ إِلاَّ رِدَاءُ الْكِبْرِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فِي جَنَّةِ عَدْنٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alssamadi, haddathanaa aabuw 'imraana aljawniyyu, 'an aabiy bakri bni 'abdi alllahi bni qaysin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna fiy aljannaai khaymaaan min luuluuaain mujawwafaain, 'arduhaa sittuwna miylaan, fiy kulli zaawiyaain minhaa aahlun, maa yarawna alakhariyna yatuwfu 'alayhimu almuuminuwna ‏"‏‏.‏ ‏"‏ wajannataani min fiddaain, aniyatuhumaa wamaa fiyhimaa, wajannataani min kadhaa aniyatuhumaa, wamaa fiyhimaa, wamaa bayna alqawmi wabayna aan yanzuruwa iilaa rabbihim iilaaa ridaa'u alkibri 'alaa wajhihi fiy jannaai 'adnin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Qais:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "In Paradise there is a pavilion made of a single hollow pearl sixty miles wide, in each corner of which there are wives who will not see those in the other corners; and the believers will visit and enjoy them. And there are two gardens, the utensils and contents of which are made of silver; and two other gardens, the utensils and contents of which are made of so-and-so (i.e. gold) and nothing will prevent the people staying in the Garden of Eden from seeing their Lord except the curtain of Majesty over His Face
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 65 — Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ شَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ لاَ يَقْطَعُهَا، وَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏وَظِلٍّ مَمْدُودٍ‏}‏‏"‏‏.‏
