verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:Abu Bakr sent for me and said, "You used to write the Divine Revelations for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) : So you should search for (the Qur'an and collect) it." I started searching for the Qur'an till I found the last two Verses of Surat at-Tauba with Abi Khuza`ima Al-Ansari and I could not find these Verses with anybody other than him. (They were): 'Verily there has come unto you an Apostle (Muhammad) from amongst yourselves. It grieves him that you should receive any injury or difficulty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ‏}‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ادْعُ لِي زَيْدًا وَلْيَجِئْ بِاللَّوْحِ وَالدَّوَاةِ وَالْكَتِفِ ـ أَوِ الْكَتِفِ وَالدَّوَاةِ ـ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اكْتُبْ لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ ‏"‏ وَخَلْفَ ظَهْرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَمْرُو بْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ الأَعْمَى قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَمَا تَأْمُرُنِي فَإِنِّي رَجُلٌ ضَرِيرُ الْبَصَرِ فَنَزَلَتْ مَكَانَهَا ‏{‏لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ‏}‏ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏{‏غَيْرُ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala lammaa nazalat ‏{‏laa yastawiy alqaa'iduwna mina almuuminiyna waalmujaahiduwna fiy sabiyli alllahi‏}‏ qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ ad'u liy zaydana walyajii bialllawhi waalddawaaai waalkatifi aawi alkatifi waalddawaaai thumma qaala ‏"‏ aktub laa yastawiy alqaa'iduwna ‏"‏ wakhalfa zahri alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'amruw bnu aummi maktuwmin alaa'maa qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi famaa taamuruniy faiinniy rajulun dariyru albasari fanazalat makaanahaa ‏{‏laa yastawiy alqaa'iduwna mina almuuminiyna‏}‏ fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏{‏ghayru auwliy alddarari‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:There was revealed: 'Not equal are those believers who sit (at home) and those who strive and fight in the Cause of Allah.' (4.95) The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Call Zaid for me and let him bring the board, the inkpot and the scapula bone (or the scapula bone and the ink pot)."' Then he said, "Write: 'Not equal are those Believers who sit..", and at that time `Amr bin Um Maktum, the blind man was sitting behind the Prophet (ﷺ) . He said, "O Allah's Apostle! What is your order For me (as regards the above Verse) as I am a blind man?" So, instead of the above Verse, the following Verse was revealed: 'Not equal are those believers who sit (at home) except those who are disabled (by injury or are blind or lame etc.) and those who strive and fight in the cause of Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقْرَأَنِي جِبْرِيلُ عَلَى حَرْفٍ فَرَاجَعْتُهُ، فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أَسْتَزِيدُهُ وَيَزِيدُنِي حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَى سَبْعَةِ أَحْرُفٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ufayrin, qaala haddathaniy alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylun, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma haddathahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aaqraaaniy jibriylu 'alaa harfin faraaja'tuhu, falam aazal aastaziyduhu wayaziyduniy hattaa antahaa iilaa sab'aai aahrufin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Gabriel recited the Qur'an to me in one way. Then I requested him (to read it in another way), and continued asking him to recite it in other ways, and he recited it in several ways till he ultimately recited it in seven different ways
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ الْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، وَعَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيَّ، حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّهُمَا، سَمِعَا عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ بْنَ حَكِيمٍ، يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ فِي حَيَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَمَعْتُ لِقِرَاءَتِهِ فَإِذَا هُوَ يَقْرَأُ عَلَى حُرُوفٍ كَثِيرَةٍ لَمْ يُقْرِئْنِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكِدْتُ أُسَاوِرُهُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَتَصَبَّرْتُ حَتَّى سَلَّمَ فَلَبَّبْتُهُ بِرِدَائِهِ فَقُلْتُ مَنْ أَقْرَأَكَ هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ الَّتِي سَمِعْتُكَ تَقْرَأُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَقْرَأَنِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ كَذَبْتَ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ أَقْرَأَنِيهَا عَلَى غَيْرِ مَا قَرَأْتَ، فَانْطَلَقْتُ بِهِ أَقُودُهُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ هَذَا يَقْرَأُ بِسُورَةِ الْفُرْقَانِ عَلَى حُرُوفٍ لَمْ تُقْرِئْنِيهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرْسِلْهُ اقْرَأْ يَا هِشَامُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَرَأَ عَلَيْهِ الْقِرَاءَةَ الَّتِي سَمِعْتُهُ يَقْرَأُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَذَلِكَ أُنْزِلَتْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ يَا عُمَرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَرَأْتُ الْقِرَاءَةَ الَّتِي أَقْرَأَنِي، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَذَلِكَ أُنْزِلَتْ، إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ أُنْزِلَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَحْرُفٍ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ufayrin, qaala haddathaniy alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylun, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna almiswara bna makhramaaa, wa'abda alrrahmani bna 'abdin alqaariyya, haddathaahu aannahumaa, sami'aa 'umara bna alkhattaabi, yaquwlu sami'tu hishaama bna hakiymin, yaqraau suwraaa alfurqaani fiy hayaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faastama'tu liqiraa'atihi faiidhaa huwa yaqraau 'alaa huruwfin kathiyraain lam yuqriiniyhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakidtu ausaawiruhu fiy alssalaaai fatasabbartu hattaa sallama falabbabtuhu biridaaiihi faqultu man aaqraaaka hadhihi alssuwraaa allatiy sami'tuka taqraau‏.‏ qaala aaqraaaniyhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faqultu kadhabta faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad aaqraaaniyhaa 'alaa ghayri maa qaraata, faantalaqtu bihi aaquwduhu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu iinniy sami'tu hadhaa yaqraau bisuwraai alfurqaani 'alaa huruwfin lam tuqriiniyhaa‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aarsilhu aqraa yaa hishaamu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaraaa 'alayhi alqiraa'aaa allatiy sami'tuhu yaqraau‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ kadhalika aunzilat ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ aqraa yaa 'umaru ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaraatu alqiraa'aaa allatiy aaqraaaniy, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ kadhalika aunzilat, iinna hadhaa alqurana aunzila 'alaa sab'aai aahrufin faaqra'uwa maa tayassara minhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:I heard Hisham bin Hakim reciting Surat Al-Furqan during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I listened to his recitation and noticed that he recited in several different ways which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not taught me. I was about to jump over him during his prayer, but I controlled my temper, and when he had completed his prayer, I put his upper garment around his neck and seized him by it and said, "Who taught you this Sura which I heard you reciting?" He replied, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) taught it to me." I said, "You have told a lie, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has taught it to me in a different way from yours." So I dragged him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said (to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)), "I heard this person reciting Surat Al-Furqan in a way which you haven't taught me!" On that Allah's Apostle said, "Release him, (O `Umar!) Recite, O Hisham!" Then he recited in the same way as I heard him reciting. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It was revealed in this way," and added, "Recite, O `Umar!" I recited it as he had taught me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "It was revealed in this way. This Qur'an has been revealed to be recited in seven different ways, so recite of it whichever (way) is easier for you (or read as much of it as may be easy for you)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُوسُفُ بْنُ مَاهَكَ، قَالَ إِنِّي عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ إِذْ جَاءَهَا عِرَاقِيٌّ فَقَالَ أَىُّ الْكَفَنِ خَيْرٌ قَالَتْ وَيْحَكَ وَمَا يَضُرُّكَ قَالَ يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَرِينِي مُصْحَفَكِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ لِمَ قَالَ لَعَلِّي أُوَلِّفُ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّهُ يُقْرَأُ غَيْرَ مُؤَلَّفٍ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَمَا يَضُرُّكَ أَيَّهُ قَرَأْتَ قَبْلُ، إِنَّمَا نَزَلَ أَوَّلَ مَا نَزَلَ مِنْهُ سُورَةٌ مِنَ الْمُفَصَّلِ فِيهَا ذِكْرُ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ حَتَّى إِذَا ثَابَ النَّاسُ إِلَى الإِسْلاَمِ نَزَلَ الْحَلاَلُ وَالْحَرَامُ، وَلَوْ نَزَلَ أَوَّلَ شَىْءٍ لاَ تَشْرَبُوا الْخَمْرَ‏.‏ لَقَالُوا لاَ نَدَعُ الْخَمْرَ أَبَدًا‏.‏ وَلَوْ نَزَلَ‏.‏ لاَ تَزْنُوا‏.‏ لَقَالُوا لاَ نَدَعُ الزِّنَا أَبَدًا‏.‏ لَقَدْ نَزَلَ بِمَكَّةَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَإِنِّي لَجَارِيَةٌ أَلْعَبُ ‏{‏بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَى وَأَمَرُّ‏}‏ وَمَا نَزَلَتْ سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ وَالنِّسَاءِ إِلاَّ وَأَنَا عِنْدَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَخْرَجَتْ لَهُ الْمُصْحَفَ فَأَمْلَتْ عَلَيْهِ آىَ السُّوَرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu yuwsufa, aanna abna jurayjin, aakhbarahum qaala waaakhbaraniy yuwsufu bnu maahaka, qaala iinniy 'inda 'aaiishaaa aummi almuuminiyna rda allh 'nha iidh jaa'ahaa 'iraaqiyyun faqaala aaaau alkafani khayrun qaalat wayhaka wamaa yadurruka qaala yaa aumma almuuminiyna aariyniy mushafaki‏.‏ qaalat lima qaala la'alliy auwallifu alqurana 'alayhi faiinnahu yuqraau ghayra muuallafin‏.‏ qaalat wamaa yadurruka aayyahu qaraata qablu, iinnamaa nazala aawwala maa nazala minhu suwraaun mina almufassali fiyhaa dhikru aljannaai waalnnaari hattaa iidhaa thaaba alnnaasu iilaa aliislaami nazala alhalaalu waalharaamu, walaw nazala aawwala shaa'in laa tashrabuwa alkhamra‏.‏ laqaaluwa laa nada'u alkhamra aabadana‏.‏ walaw nazala‏.‏ laa taznuwa‏.‏ laqaaluwa laa nada'u alzzinaa aabadana‏.‏ laqad nazala bimakkaaa 'alaa muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm waiinniy lajaariyaaun aal'abu ‏{‏bali alssaa'aau maw'iduhum waalssaa'aau aadhaa waaamarru‏}‏ wamaa nazalat suwraau albaqaraai waalnnisaa'i iilaaa waaanaa 'indahu‏.‏ qaala faaakhrajat lahu almushafa faaamlat 'alayhi aaa alssuwari‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Yusuf bin Mahk:While I was with Aisha, the mother of the Believers, a person from Iraq came and asked, "What type of shroud is the best?" `Aisha said, "May Allah be merciful to you! What does it matter?" He said, "O mother of the Believers! Show me (the copy of) your Qur'an," She said, "Why?" He said, "In order to compile and arrange the Qur'an according to it, for people recite it with its Suras not in proper order." `Aisha said, "What does it matter which part of it you read first? (Be informed) that the first thing that was revealed thereof was a Sura from Al-Mufassal, and in it was mentioned Paradise and the Fire. When the people embraced Islam, the Verses regarding legal and illegal things were revealed. If the first thing to be revealed was: 'Do not drink alcoholic drinks.' people would have said, 'We will never leave alcoholic drinks,' and if there had been revealed, 'Do not commit illegal sexual intercourse, 'they would have said, 'We will never give up illegal sexual intercourse.' While I was a young girl of playing age, the following Verse was revealed in Mecca to Muhammad: 'Nay! But the Hour is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour will be more grievous and more bitter.' (54.46) Sura Al-Baqara (The Cow) and Surat An-Nisa (The Women) were revealed while I was with him." Then `Aisha took out the copy of the Qur'an for the man and dictated to him the Verses of the Suras (in their proper order)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، يَقُولُ فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَالْكَهْفِ وَمَرْيَمَ وَطَهَ وَالأَنْبِيَاءِ إِنَّهُنَّ مِنَ الْعِتَاقِ الأُوَلِ وَهُنَّ مِنْ تِلاَدِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu 'abda alrrahmani bna yaziyda, sami'tu abna mas'uwdin, yaquwlu fiy baniy iisraaiiyla waalkahfi wamaryama wataha waalaanbiyaa'i iinnahunna mina al'itaaqi alauwali wahunna min tilaadiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:Surat Bani-lsrael, Al-Kahf (The Cave), Maryam, Taha, Al-Anbiya' (The prophets) are amongst my first earnings and my old property, and (in fact) they are my old property
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، سَمِعَ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ تَعَلَّمْتُ ‏{‏سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ‏}‏ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْدَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, aanbaaanaa aabuw iishaaqa, sami'a albaraa'a rda allh 'nh qaala ta'allamtu ‏{‏sabbihi asma rabbika‏}‏ qabla aan yaqdama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara':I learnt, 'Glorify the Name of your Lord the Most High' (Surat al-A'la) No 87, before the Prophet (ﷺ) came (to Medina)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ النَّظَائِرَ الَّتِي كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَؤُهُنَّ اثْنَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ‏.‏ فَقَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ عَلْقَمَةُ وَخَرَجَ عَلْقَمَةُ فَسَأَلْنَاهُ فَقَالَ عِشْرُونَ سُورَةً مِنْ أَوَّلِ الْمُفَصَّلِ عَلَى تَأْلِيفِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ آخِرُهُنَّ الْحَوَامِيمُ حم الدُّخَانُ وَعَمَّ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, 'an aabiy hamzaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi qad 'alimtu alnnazaaiira allatiy kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqrauuhunna athnayni athnayni fiy kulli rak'aain‏.‏ faqaama 'abdu alllahi wadakhala ma'ahu 'alqamaau wakharaja 'alqamaau fasaaalnaahu faqaala 'ishruwna suwraaan min aawwali almufassali 'alaa taaliyfi abni mas'uwdin akhiruhunna alhawaamiymu hm alddukhaanu wa'amma yatasaa'aluwna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Shaqiq:`Abdullah said, "I learnt An-Naza'ir which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite in pairs in each rak`a." Then `Abdullah got up and Alqama accompanied him to his house, and when Alqama came out, we asked him (about those Suras). He said, "They are twenty Suras that start from the beginning of Al- Mufassal, according to the arrangement done be Ibn Mas`ud, and end with the Suras starting with Ha Mim, e.g. Ha Mim (the Smoke). and "About what they question one another?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَجْوَدَ النَّاسِ بِالْخَيْرِ، وَأَجْوَدُ مَا يَكُونُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ لأَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ كَانَ يَلْقَاهُ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ حَتَّى يَنْسَلِخَ يَعْرِضُ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْقُرْآنَ، فَإِذَا لَقِيَهُ جِبْرِيلُ كَانَ أَجْوَدَ بِالْخَيْرِ مِنَ الرِّيحِ الْمُرْسَلَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aajwada alnnaasi bialkhayri, waaajwadu maa yakuwnu fiy shahri ramadaana laanna jibriyla kaana yalqaahu fiy kulli laylaain fiy shahri ramadaana hattaa yansalikha ya'ridu 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alqurana, faiidhaa laqiyahu jibriylu kaana aajwada bialkhayri mina alrriyhi almursalaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was the most generous person, and he used to become more so (generous) particularly in the month of Ramadan because Gabriel used to meet him every night of the month of Ramadan till it elapsed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to recite the Qur'an for him. When Gabriel met him, he used to become more generous than the fast wind in doing good
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ يَعْرِضُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْقُرْآنَ كُلَّ عَامٍ مَرَّةً، فَعَرَضَ عَلَيْهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الْعَامِ الَّذِي قُبِضَ، وَكَانَ يَعْتَكِفُ كُلَّ عَامٍ عَشْرًا فَاعْتَكَفَ عِشْرِينَ فِي الْعَامِ الَّذِي قُبِضَ ‏{‏فِيهِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khaalidu bnu yaziyda, haddathanaa aabuw bakrin, 'an aabiy hasiynin, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kaana ya'ridu 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alqurana kulla 'aamin marraaan, fa'arada 'alayhi marratayni fiy al'aami alladhiy qubida, wakaana ya'takifu kulla 'aamin 'ashrana faa'takafa 'ishriyna fiy al'aami alladhiy qubida ‏{‏fiyhi‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu-Huraira:Gabriel used to repeat the recitation of the Qur'an with the Prophet (ﷺ) once a year, but he repeated it twice with him in the year he died. The Prophet (ﷺ) used to stay in I`tikaf for ten days every year (in the month of Ramadan), but in the year of his death, he stayed in I`tikaf for twenty days
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، ذَكَرَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ فَقَالَ لاَ أَزَالُ أُحِبُّهُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ خُذُوا الْقُرْآنَ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ وَسَالِمٍ وَمُعَاذٍ وَأُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amrinw, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an masruwqin, dhakara 'abdu alllahi bnu 'amrinw 'abda alllahi bna mas'uwdin faqaala laa aazaalu auhibbuhu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ khudhuwa alqurana min aarba'aain min 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin wasaalimin wamu'aadhin waaubaaai bni ka'bin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Masriq:`Abdullah bin `Amr mentioned `Abdullah bin Masud and said, "I shall ever love that man, for I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'Take (learn) the Qur'an from four: `Abdullah bin Masud, Salim, Mu`adh and Ubai bin Ka`b
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا شَقِيقُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَخَذْتُ مِنْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِضْعًا وَسَبْعِينَ سُورَةً، وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ عَلِمَ أَصْحَابُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِّي مِنْ أَعْلَمِهِمْ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَمَا أَنَا بِخَيْرِهِمْ‏.‏ قَالَ شَقِيقٌ فَجَلَسْتُ فِي الْحِلَقِ أَسْمَعُ مَا يَقُولُونَ فَمَا سَمِعْتُ رَادًّا يَقُولُ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathanaa shaqiyqu bnu salamaaa, qaala khatabanaa 'abdu alllahi faqaala waalllahi laqad aakhadhtu min fiy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bid'ana wasab'iyna suwraaan, waalllahi laqad 'alima aashaabu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanniy min aa'lamihim bikitaabi alllahi wamaa aanaa bikhayrihim‏.‏ qaala shaqiyqun fajalastu fiy alhilaqi aasma'u maa yaquwluwna famaa sami'tu raaddana yaquwlu ghayra dhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Shaqiq bin Salama:Once `Abdullah bin Mas`ud delivered a sermon before us and said, "By Allah, I learnt over seventy Suras direct from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . By Allah, the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) came to know that I am one of those who know Allah's Book best of all of them, yet I am not the best of them." Shaqiq added: I sat in his religious gathering and I did not hear anybody opposing him (in his speech)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا بِحِمْصَ فَقَرَأَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ سُورَةَ يُوسُفَ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مَا هَكَذَا أُنْزِلَتْ قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَحْسَنْتَ‏.‏ وَوَجَدَ مِنْهُ رِيحَ الْخَمْرِ فَقَالَ أَتَجْمَعُ أَنْ تُكَذِّبَ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَتَشْرَبَ الْخَمْرَ‏.‏ فَضَرَبَهُ الْحَدَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, qaala kunnaa bihimsa faqaraaa abnu mas'uwdin suwraaa yuwsufa, faqaala rajulun maa hakadhaa aunzilat qaala qaraatu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aahsanta‏.‏ wawajada minhu riyha alkhamri faqaala aatajma'u aan tukadhhiba bikitaabi alllahi watashraba alkhamra‏.‏ fadarabahu alhadda‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Alqama:While we were in the city of Hims (in Syria), Ibn Mas`ud recited Surat Yusuf. A man said to him), "It was not revealed in this way." Then Ibn Mas`ud said, "I recited it in this way before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he confirmed my recitation by saying, 'Well done!' " Ibn Mas`ud detected the smell of wine from the man's mouth, so he said to him, "Aren't you ashamed of telling a lie about Allah's Book and (along with this) you drink alcoholic liquors too?" Then he lashed him according to the law
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُهُ مَا أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ أَيْنَ أُنْزِلَتْ وَلاَ أُنْزِلَتْ آيَةٌ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ فِيمَ أُنْزِلَتْ، وَلَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَحَدًا أَعْلَمَ مِنِّي بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ تُبَلِّغُهُ الإِبِلُ لَرَكِبْتُ إِلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathanaa muslimun, 'an masruwqin, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi rda allh 'nh waalllahi alladhiy laa iilaha ghayruhu maa aunzilat suwraaun min kitaabi alllahi iilaaa aanaa aa'lamu aayna aunzilat walaa aunzilat ayaaun min kitaabi alllahi iilaaa aanaa aa'lamu fiyma aunzilat, walaw aa'lamu aahadana aa'lama minniy bikitaabi alllahi tuballighuhu aliibilu larakibtu iilayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud):By Allah other than Whom none has the right to be worshipped! There is no Sura revealed in Allah's Book but I know at what place it was revealed; and there is no Verse revealed in Allah's Book but I know about whom it was revealed. And if I know that there is somebody who knows Allah's Book better than I, and he is at a place that camels can reach, I would go to him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ مَنْ جَمَعَ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَرْبَعَةٌ كُلُّهُمْ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ وَمُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ، وَزَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، وَأَبُو زَيْدٍ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ الْفَضْلُ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, qaala saaaltu aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh man jama'a alqurana 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala aarba'aaun kulluhum mina alaansaari aubaaau bnu ka'bin wamu'aadhu bnu jabalin, wazaydu bnu thaabitin, waaabuw zaydin‏.‏ taaba'ahu alfadlu 'an husayni bni waaqidin 'an thumaamaaa 'an aanasin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas bin Malik: "Who collected the Qur'an at the time of the Prophet (ﷺ) ?" He replied, "Four, all of whom were from the Ansar: Ubai bin Ka`b, Mu`adh bin Jabal, Zaid bin Thabit and Abu Zaid
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ثَابِتٌ الْبُنَانِيُّ، وَثُمَامَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ مَاتَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَمْ يَجْمَعِ الْقُرْآنَ غَيْرُ أَرْبَعَةٍ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ وَمُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ وَأَبُو زَيْدٍ‏.‏ قَالَ وَنَحْنُ وَرِثْنَاهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathaniy thaabitun albunaaniyyu, wathumaamaau, 'an aanasin, qaala maata alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm walam yajma'i alqurana ghayru aarba'aain aabuw alddardaa'i wamu'aadhu bnu jabalin wazaydu bnu thaabitin waaabuw zaydin‏.‏ qaala wanahnu warithnaahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:When the Prophet (ﷺ) died, none had collected the Qur'an but four persons;: Abu Ad-Darda'. Mu`adh bin Jabal, Zaid bin Thabit and Abu Zaid. We were the inheritor (of Abu Zaid) as he had no offspring
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ أُبَىٌّ أَقْرَؤُنَا وَإِنَّا لَنَدَعُ مِنْ لَحَنِ أُبَىٍّ، وَأُبَىٌّ يَقُولُ أَخَذْتُهُ مِنْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ أَتْرُكُهُ لِشَىْءٍ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏مَا نَنْسَخْ مِنْ آيَةٍ أَوْ نَنْسَأْهَا نَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ مِنْهَا أَوْ مِثْلِهَا‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sadaqaau bnu alfadli, aakhbaranaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, 'an habiybi bni aabiy thaabitin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaala 'umaru aubaaaun aaqrauunaa waiinnaa lanada'u min lahani aubaaain, waaubaaaun yaquwlu aakhadhtuhu min fiy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falaa aatrukuhu lishaa'in qaala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏maa nansakh min ayaain aaw nansaahaa naati bikhayrin minhaa aaw mithlihaa‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:`Umar said, Ubai was the best of us in the recitation (of the Qur'an) yet we leave some of what he recites.' Ubai says, 'PI have taken it from the mouth of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and will not leave for anything whatever." But Allah said "None of Our Revelations do We abrogate or cause to be forgotten but We substitute something better or similar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي خُبَيْبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُعَلَّى، قَالَ كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي فَدَعَانِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ أُجِبْهُ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ يَقُلِ اللَّهُ ‏{‏اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ‏}‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَلاَ أُعَلِّمُكَ أَعْظَمَ سُورَةٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْرُجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي فَلَمَّا أَرَدْنَا أَنْ نَخْرُجَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ قُلْتَ لأُعَلِّمَنَّكَ أَعْظَمَ سُورَةٍ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏‏{‏الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ‏}‏ هِيَ السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي أُوتِيتُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathaniy khubaybu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimin, 'an aabiy sa'iydi bni almu'allaa, qaala kuntu ausalliy fada'aaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm falam aujibhu qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy kuntu ausalliy‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aalam yaquli alllahu ‏{‏astajiybuwa lillahi walilrrasuwli iidhaa da'aakum‏}‏ thumma qaala aalaa au'allimuka aa'zama suwraain fiy alqurani qabla aan takhruja mina almasjidi ‏"‏‏.‏ faaakhadha biyadiy falammaa aaradnaa aan nakhruja qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaka qulta lau'allimannaka aa'zama suwraain mina alqurani‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏‏{‏alhamdu lillahi rabbi al'aalamiyna‏}‏ hiya alssab'u almathaaniy waalquranu al'aziymu alladhiy auwtiytuhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Mu'alla:While I was praying, the Prophet (ﷺ) called me but I did not respond to his call. Later I said, "O Allah's Apostle! I was praying." He said, "Didn't Allah say: 'O you who believe! Give your response to Allah (by obeying Him) and to His Apostle when he calls you'?" (8.24) He then said, "Shall I not teach you the most superior Surah in the Qur'an?" He said, '(It is), 'Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds. ' (i.e., Surat Al-Fatiha) which consists of seven repeatedly recited Verses and the Magnificent Qur'an which was given to me
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ مَعْبَدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ كُنَّا فِي مَسِيرٍ لَنَا فَنَزَلْنَا فَجَاءَتْ جَارِيَةٌ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ سَيِّدَ الْحَىِّ سَلِيمٌ، وَإِنَّ نَفَرَنَا غُيَّبٌ فَهَلْ مِنْكُمْ رَاقٍ فَقَامَ مَعَهَا رَجُلٌ مَا كُنَّا نَأْبُنُهُ بِرُقْيَةٍ فَرَقَاهُ فَبَرَأَ فَأَمَرَ لَهُ بِثَلاَثِينَ شَاةً وَسَقَانَا لَبَنًا فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ قُلْنَا لَهُ أَكُنْتَ تُحْسِنُ رُقْيَةً أَوْ كُنْتَ تَرْقِي قَالَ لاَ مَا رَقَيْتُ إِلاَّ بِأُمِّ الْكِتَابِ‏.‏ قُلْنَا لاَ تُحْدِثُوا شَيْئًا حَتَّى نَأْتِيَ ـ أَوْ نَسْأَلَ ـ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ ذَكَرْنَاهُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ وَمَا كَانَ يُدْرِيهِ أَنَّهَا رُقْيَةٌ اقْسِمُوا وَاضْرِبُوا لِي بِسَهْمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ حَدَّثَنِي مَعْبَدُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ بِهَذَا
verses.translit: hadaathaniy muhamaadu bnu almuthanaaa, hadaathanaa wahbun, hadaathanaa hishaamun, 'an muhamaadin, 'an ma'badin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyii, qaala kunaaa fiy masiyrin lanaa fanazalnaa fajaa'at jaariyaaun faqaalat iinaa sayiida alhaaii saliymun, waiinaa nafaranaa ghuyaabun fahal minkum raaqin faqaama ma'ahaa rajulun maa kunaaa naabunuhu biruqyaain faraqaahu fabaraaa faaamara lahu bithalaathiyna shaaaan wasaqaanaa labanana falamaaa raja'a qulnaa lahu aakunta tuhsinu ruqyaaan aaw kunta tarqiy qaala laa maa raqaytu iilaaa biaumii alkitaabi‏.‏ qulnaa laa tuhdithuwa shayiana hataaa naatiya aaw nasaala alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm falamaaa qadimnaa almadiynaaa dhakarnaahu lilnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ wamaa kaana yudriyhi aanaahaa ruqyaaun aqsimuwa waadribuwa liy bisahmin ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala aabuw ma'marin hadaathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi hadaathanaa hishaamun hadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu siyriyna hadaathaniy ma'badu bnu siyriyna 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyii bihadhaa
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:While we were on one of our journeys, we dismounted at a place where a slave girl came and said, "The chief of this tribe has been stung by a scorpion and our men are not present; is there anybody among you who can treat him (by reciting something)?" Then one of our men went along with her though we did not think that he knew any such treatment. But he treated the chief by reciting something, and the sick man recovered whereupon he gave him thirty sheep and gave us milk to drink (as a reward). When he returned, we asked our friend, "Did you know how to treat with the recitation of something?" He said, "No, but I treated him only with the recitation of the Mother of the Book (i.e., Al-Fatiha)." We said, "Do not say anything (about it) till we reach or ask the Prophet (ﷺ) so when we reached Medina, we mentioned that to the Prophet (in order to know whether the sheep which we had taken were lawful to take or not). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "How did he come to know that it (Al-Fatiha) could be used for treatment? Distribute your reward and assign for me one share thereof as well
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ مَنْ قَرَأَ بِالآيَتَيْنِ‏.‏ ‏.‏‏.‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an sulaymaana, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala man qaraaa bialayatayni‏.‏ ‏.‏‏.‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Mas'ud:Whoever recites two verses ... (text as in the following hadith)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَرَأَ بِالآيَتَيْنِ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ كَفَتَاهُ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man qaraaa bialayatayni min akhiri suwraai albaqaraai fiy laylaain kafataahu‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Mas'ud: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody recited the last two Verses of Surat Al-Baqara at night, that will be sufficient for him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: وَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ وَكَّلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِحِفْظِ زَكَاةِ رَمَضَانَ فَأَتَانِي آتٍ فَجَعَلَ يَحْثُو مِنَ الطَّعَامِ فَأَخَذْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ لأَرْفَعَنَّكَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ فَقَالَ إِذَا أَوَيْتَ إِلَى فِرَاشِكَ فَاقْرَأْ آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ لَنْ يَزَالَ مَعَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ حَافِظٌ وَلاَ يَقْرَبُكَ شَيْطَانٌ حَتَّى تُصْبِحَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صَدَقَكَ وَهْوَ كَذُوبٌ ذَاكَ شَيْطَانٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala 'uthmaanu bnu alhaythami haddathanaa 'awfun, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala wakkalaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihifzi zakaaai ramadaana faaataaniy atin faja'ala yahthuw mina altta'aami faaakhadhtuhu faqultu laarfa'annaka iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqassa alhadiytha faqaala iidhaa aawayta iilaa firaashika faaqraa ayaaa alkursiyyi lan yazaala ma'aka mina alllahi haafizun walaa yaqrabuka shaytaanun hattaa tusbiha‏.‏ waqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ sadaqaka wahwa kadhuwbun dhaaka shaytaanun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered me to guard the Zakat revenue of Ramadan. Then somebody came to me and started stealing from the foodstuff. I caught him and said, "I will take you to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Then Abu Huraira described the whole narration and said: That person said (to me), "(Please don't take me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I will tell you a few words by which Allah will benefit you.) When you go to your bed, recite Ayat-al-Kursi, (2.255) for then there will be a guard from Allah who will protect you all night long, and Satan will not be able to come near you till dawn." (When the Prophet (ﷺ) heard the story) he said (to me), "He (who came to you at night) told you the truth although he is a liar; and it was Satan
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَجُلٌ يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْكَهْفِ وَإِلَى جَانِبِهِ حِصَانٌ مَرْبُوطٌ بِشَطَنَيْنِ فَتَغَشَّتْهُ سَحَابَةٌ فَجَعَلَتْ تَدْنُو وَتَدْنُو وَجَعَلَ فَرَسُهُ يَنْفِرُ فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ تِلْكَ السَّكِينَةُ تَنَزَّلَتْ بِالْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala kaana rajulun yaqraau suwraaa alkahfi waiilaa jaanibihi hisaanun marbuwtun bishatanayni fataghashhathu sahaabaaun faja'alat tadnuw watadnuw waja'ala farasuhu yanfiru falammaa aasbaha aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara dhalika lahu faqaala ‏ "‏ tilka alssakiynaau tanazzalat bialqurani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara':A man was reciting Surat Al-Kahf and his horse was tied with two ropes beside him. A cloud came down and spread over that man, and it kept on coming closer and closer to him till his horse started jumping (as if afraid of something). When it was morning, the man came to the Prophet, and told him of that experience. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That was As-Sakina (tranquility) which descended because of (the recitation of) the Qur'an
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَسِيرُ فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ وَعُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَسِيرُ مَعَهُ لَيْلاً فَسَأَلَهُ عُمَرُ عَنْ شَىْءٍ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ثَكِلَتْكَ أُمُّكَ نَزَرْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ كُلَّ ذَلِكَ لاَ يُجِيبُكَ، قَالَ عُمَرُ فَحَرَّكْتُ بَعِيرِي حَتَّى كُنْتُ أَمَامَ النَّاسِ وَخَشِيتُ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ فِيَّ قُرْآنٌ فَمَا نَشِبْتُ أَنْ سَمِعْتُ صَارِخًا يَصْرُخُ ـ قَالَ ـ فَقُلْتُ لَقَدْ خَشِيتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ نَزَلَ فِيَّ قُرْآنٌ ـ قَالَ ـ فَجِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَىَّ اللَّيْلَةَ سُورَةٌ لَهِيَ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yasiyru fiy ba'di aasfaarihi wa'umaru bnu alkhattaabi yasiyru ma'ahu laylaan fasaaalahu 'umaru 'an shaa'in falam yujibhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma saaalahu falam yujibhu thumma saaalahu falam yujibhu, faqaala 'umaru thakilatka aummuka nazarta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thalaatha marraatin kulla dhalika laa yujiybuka, qaala 'umaru faharraktu ba'iyriy hattaa kuntu aamaama alnnaasi wakhashiytu aan yanzila fiyya quranun famaa nashibtu aan sami'tu saarikhana yasrukhu qaala faqultu laqad khashiytu aan yakuwna nazala fiyya quranun qaala fajiitu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallamtu 'alayhi faqaala ‏"‏ laqad aunzilat 'alaaaa alllaylaaa suwraaun lahiya aahabbu iilaaaa mimmaa tala'at 'alayhi alshhamsu ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaraaa ‏{‏iinnaa fatahnaa laka fathana mubiynana‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aslam:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was traveling on one of his journeys, and `Umar bin Al-Khattab was traveling along with him at night. `Umar asked him about something, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not answer him. He asked again, but he did not answer. He asked for the third time, but he did not answer. On that, `Umar said to himself, "May your mother lose you! You have asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) three times, but he did not answer at all!" `Umar said, "So I made my camel go fast till I was ahead of the people, and I was afraid that something might be revealed about me. After a little while I heard a call maker calling me, I said, 'I was afraid that some Qur'anic Verse might be revealed about me.' So I went to Allah's Apostle and greeted him. He said, 'Tonight there has been revealed to me a Surah which is dearer to me than that on which the sun shines (i.e. the world).' Then he recited: 'Verily! We have given you (O Muhammad), a manifest victory.' " (Surat al-Fath) No
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَمِعَ رَجُلاً، يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ‏}‏ يُرَدِّدُهَا فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ وَكَأَنَّ الرَّجُلَ يَتَقَالُّهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنَّهَا لَتَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy sa'sa'aaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rajulaan, sami'a rajulaan, yaqraau ‏{‏qul huwa alllahu aahadun‏}‏ yuraddiduhaa falammaa aasbaha jaa'a iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara dhalika lahu wakaaanna alrrajula yataqaalluhaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi iinnahaa lata'dilu thulutha alqurani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Said Al-Khudri: A man heard another man reciting (Surat-Al-Ikhlas) 'Say He is Allah, (the) One.' (112. 1) repeatedly. The next morning he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him about it as if he thought that it was not enough to recite. On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my life is, this Surah is equal to one-third of the Qur'an
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: وَزَادَ أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَخِي، قَتَادَةُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَامَ فِي زَمَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ مِنَ السَّحَرِ ‏{‏قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ‏}‏ لاَ يَزِيدُ عَلَيْهَا، فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحْنَا أَتَى رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: wazaada aabuw ma'marin haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy sa'sa'aaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aakhbaraniy aakhiy, qataadaau bnu alnnu'maani aanna rajulaan, qaama fiy zamani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau mina alssahari ‏{‏qul huwa alllahu aahadun‏}‏ laa yaziydu 'alayhaa, falammaa aasbahnaa aataa rajulun alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahwahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Said Al-Khudri:My brother, Qatada bin An-Nau'man said, "A man performed the night prayer late at night in the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he read: 'Say: He is Allah, (the) One,' (112.1) and read nothing besides that. The next morning a man went to the Prophet (ﷺ) ,~ and told him about that . (The Prophet (ﷺ) replied the same as (in Hadith 532) above
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، وَالضَّحَّاكُ الْمَشْرِقِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَصْحَابِهِ ‏"‏ أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَشَقَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَقَالُوا أَيُّنَا يُطِيقُ ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الصَّمَدُ ثُلُثُ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُرْسَلٌ وَعَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ الْمَشْرِقِيِّ مُسْنَدٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathanaa iibraahiymu, waalddahhaaku almashriqiyyu, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm laashaabihi ‏"‏ aaya'jizu aahadukum aan yaqraaa thulutha alqurani fiy laylaain ‏"‏‏.‏ fashaqqa dhalika 'alayhim waqaaluwa aayyunaa yutiyqu dhalika yaa rasuwla alllahi faqaala ‏"‏ alllahu alwaahidu alssamadu thuluthu alqurani ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi 'an iibraahiyma mursalun wa'ani alddahhaaki almashriqiyyi musnadun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to his companions, "Is it difficult for any of you to recite one third of the Qur'an in one night?" This suggestion was difficult for them so they said, "Who among us has the power to do so, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Allah's Apostle replied: " Allah (the) One, the Self-Sufficient Master Whom all creatures need.' (Surat Al-Ikhlas 112.1--to the End) is equal to one third of the Qur'an
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَكَى يَقْرَأُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالْمُعَوِّذَاتِ وَيَنْفُثُ، فَلَمَّا اشْتَدَّ وَجَعُهُ كُنْتُ أَقْرَأُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَمْسَحُ بِيَدِهِ رَجَاءَ بَرَكَتِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu allaahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, rda allh 'nha aanaa rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa ashtakaa yaqraau 'alaa nafsihi bialmu'awiidhaati wayanfuthu, falamaaa ashtadaa waja'uhu kuntu aaqraau 'alayhi waaamsahu biyadihi rajaa'a barakatihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became sick, he would recite Mu'awwidhat (Surat Al-Falaq and Surat An- Nas) and then blow his breath over his body. When he became seriously ill, I used to recite (these two Suras) and rub his hands over his body hoping for its blessings
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُفَضَّلُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ جَمَعَ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ نَفَثَ فِيهِمَا فَقَرَأَ فِيهِمَا ‏{‏قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ‏}‏ وَ‏{‏قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ‏}‏ وَ‏{‏قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ‏}‏ ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا أَقْبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, hadaathanaa almufadaalu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanaa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa aawaa iilaa firaashihi kulaa laylaain jama'a kafaayhi thumaa nafatha fiyhimaa faqaraaa fiyhimaa ‏{‏qul huwa allaahu aahadun‏}‏ wa‏{‏qul aa'uwdhu birabii alfalaqi‏}‏ wa‏{‏qul aa'uwdhu birabii alnaaasi‏}‏ thumaa yamsahu bihimaa maa astataa'a min jasadihi yabdaau bihimaa 'alaa raasihi wawajhihi wamaa aaqbala min jasadihi yaf'alu dhalika thalaatha maraaatin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Aisha: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to bed every night, he used to cup his hands together and blow over it after reciting Surat Al-Ikhlas, Surat Al-Falaq and Surat An-Nas, and then rub his hands over whatever parts of his body he was able to rub, starting with his head, face and front of his body. He used to do that three times
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ الْهَادِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أُسَيْدِ بْنِ حُضَيْرٍ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا هُوَ يَقْرَأُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ وَفَرَسُهُ مَرْبُوطٌ عِنْدَهُ إِذْ جَالَتِ الْفَرَسُ فَسَكَتَ فَسَكَتَتْ فَقَرَأَ فَجَالَتِ الْفَرَسُ، فَسَكَتَ وَسَكَتَتِ الْفَرَسُ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ فَجَالَتِ الْفَرَسُ، فَانْصَرَفَ وَكَانَ ابْنُهُ يَحْيَى قَرِيبًا مِنْهَا فَأَشْفَقَ أَنْ تُصِيبَهُ فَلَمَّا اجْتَرَّهُ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ حَتَّى مَا يَرَاهَا فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ حَدَّثَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ يَا ابْنَ حُضَيْرٍ اقْرَأْ يَا ابْنَ حُضَيْرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَشْفَقْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنْ تَطَأَ يَحْيَى وَكَانَ مِنْهَا قَرِيبًا فَرَفَعْتُ رَأْسِي فَانْصَرَفْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَرَفَعْتُ رَأْسِي إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَإِذَا مِثْلُ الظُّلَّةِ فِيهَا أَمْثَالُ الْمَصَابِيحِ فَخَرَجَتْ حَتَّى لاَ أَرَاهَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَتَدْرِي مَا ذَاكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تِلْكَ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ دَنَتْ لِصَوْتِكَ وَلَوْ قَرَأْتَ لأَصْبَحَتْ يَنْظُرُ النَّاسُ إِلَيْهَا لاَ تَتَوَارَى مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ الْهَادِ وَحَدَّثَنِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خَبَّابٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ عَنْ أُسَيْدِ بْنِ حُضَيْرٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy yaziydu bnu alhaadi, 'an muhammadi bni iibraahiyma, 'an ausaydi bni hudayrin, qaala baynamaa huwa yaqraau mina alllayli suwraaa albaqaraai wafarasuhu marbuwtun 'indahu iidh jaalati alfarasu fasakata fasakatat faqaraaa fajaalati alfarasu, fasakata wasakatati alfarasu thumma qaraaa fajaalati alfarasu, faansarafa wakaana abnuhu yahyaa qariybana minhaa faaashfaqa aan tusiybahu falammaa ajtarrahu rafa'a raasahu iilaa alssamaa'i hattaa maa yaraahaa falammaa aasbaha haddatha alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aqraa yaa abna hudayrin aqraa yaa abna hudayrin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faaashfaqtu yaa rasuwla alllahi aan tataaa yahyaa wakaana minhaa qariybana farafa'tu raasiy faansaraftu iilayhi farafa'tu raasiy iilaa alssamaa'i faiidhaa mithlu alzzullaai fiyhaa aamthaalu almasaabiyhi fakharajat hattaa laa aaraahaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ watadriy maa dhaaka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala laa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ tilka almalaaiikaau danat lisawtika walaw qaraata laasbahat yanzuru alnnaasu iilayhaa laa tatawaaraa minhum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala abnu alhaadi wahaddathaniy hadhaa alhadiytha 'abdu alllahi bnu khabbaabin 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi 'an ausaydi bni hudayrin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usaid bin Hudair: That while he was reciting Surat Al-Baqara (The Cow) at night, and his horse was tied beside him, the horse was suddenly startled and troubled. When he stopped reciting, the horse became quiet, and when he started again, the horse was startled again. Then he stopped reciting and the horse became quiet too. He started reciting again and the horse was startled and troubled once again. Then he stopped reciting and his son, Yahya was beside the horse. He was afraid that the horse might trample on him. When he took the boy away and looked towards the sky, he could not see it. The next morning he informed the Prophet who said, "Recite, O Ibn Hudair! Recite, O Ibn Hudair!" Ibn Hudair replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My son, Yahya was near the horse and I was afraid that it might trample on him, so I looked towards the sky, and went to him. When I looked at the sky, I saw something like a cloud containing what looked like lamps, so I went out in order not to see it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you know what that was?" Ibn Hudair replied, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Those were Angels who came near to you for your voice and if you had kept on reciting till dawn, it would have remained there till morning when people would have seen it as it would not have disappeared
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَشَدَّادُ بْنُ مَعْقِلٍ، عَلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضى الله عنهما فَقَالَ لَهُ شَدَّادُ بْنُ مَعْقِلٍ أَتَرَكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ شَىْءٍ قَالَ مَا تَرَكَ إِلاَّ مَا بَيْنَ الدَّفَّتَيْنِ‏.‏ قَالَ وَدَخَلْنَا عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ فَسَأَلْنَاهُ فَقَالَ مَا تَرَكَ إِلاَّ مَا بَيْنَ الدَّفَّتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni rufay'in, qaala dakhaltu aanaa washaddaadu bnu ma'qilin, 'alaa abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma faqaala lahu shaddaadu bnu ma'qilin aataraka alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm min shaa'in qaala maa taraka iilaaa maa bayna alddaffatayni‏.‏ qaala wadakhalnaa 'alaa muhammadi abni alhanafiyyaai fasaaalnaahu faqaala maa taraka iilaaa maa bayna alddaffatayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdul `Aziz bin Rufai':Shaddad bin Ma'qil and I entered upon Ibn `Abbas. Shaddad bin Ma'qil asked him, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) leave anything (besides the Qur'an)?" He replied. "He did not leave anything except what is Between the two bindings (of the Qur'an)." Then we visited Muhammad bin Al-Hanafiyya and asked him (the same question). He replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) did not leave except what is between the bindings (of the Qur'an)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ أَبُو خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَالأُتْرُجَّةِ طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَرِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَالتَّمْرَةِ طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَلاَ رِيحَ لَهَا، وَمَثَلُ الْفَاجِرِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَمَثَلِ الرَّيْحَانَةِ رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَطَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ، وَمَثَلُ الْفَاجِرِ الَّذِي لاَ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَمَثَلِ الْحَنْظَلَةِ طَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ وَلاَ رِيحَ لَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hudbaau bnu khaalidin aabuw khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, haddathanaa aanasun, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mathalu alladhiy yaqraau alqurana kaalautrujjaai ta'muhaa tayyibun wariyhuhaa tayyibun waalladhiy laa yaqraau alqurana kaalttamraai ta'muhaa tayyibun walaa riyha lahaa, wamathalu alfaajiri alladhiy yaqraau alqurana kamathali alrrayhaanaai riyhuhaa tayyibun wata'muhaa murrun, wamathalu alfaajiri alladhiy laa yaqraau alqurana kamathali alhanzalaai ta'muhaa murrun walaa riyha lahaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of him (a believer) who recites the Qur'an is like that of a citron which tastes good and smells good. And he (a believer) who does not recite the Qur'an is like a date which is good in taste but has no smell. And the example of a dissolute wicked person who recites the Qur'an is like the Raihana (sweet basil) which smells good but tastes bitter. And the example of a dissolute wicked person who does not recite the Qur'an is like the colocynth which tastes bitter and has no smell
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا أَجَلُكُمْ فِي أَجَلِ مَنْ خَلاَ مِنَ الأُمَمِ كَمَا بَيْنَ صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ وَمَغْرِبِ الشَّمْسِ، وَمَثَلُكُمْ وَمَثَلُ الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ اسْتَعْمَلَ عُمَّالاً، فَقَالَ مَنْ يَعْمَلُ لِي إِلَى نِصْفِ النَّهَارِ عَلَى قِيرَاطٍ فَعَمِلَتِ الْيَهُودُ فَقَالَ مَنْ يَعْمَلُ لِي مِنْ نِصْفِ النَّهَارِ إِلَى الْعَصْرِ فَعَمِلَتِ النَّصَارَى، ثُمَّ أَنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ مِنَ الْعَصْرِ إِلَى الْمَغْرِبِ بِقِيرَاطَيْنِ قِيرَاطَيْنِ، قَالُوا نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ عَمَلاً وَأَقَلُّ عَطَاءً، قَالَ هَلْ ظَلَمْتُكُمْ مِنْ حَقِّكُمْ قَالُوا لاَ قَالَ فَذَاكَ فَضْلِي أُوتِيهِ مَنْ شِئْتُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, 'an yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu diynaarin, qaala sami'tu abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa aajalukum fiy aajali man khalaa mina alaumami kamaa bayna salaaai al'asri wamaghribi alshhamsi, wamathalukum wamathalu alyahuwdi waalnnasaaraa kamathali rajulin asta'mala 'ummaalaan, faqaala man ya'malu liy iilaa nisfi alnnahaari 'alaa qiyraatin fa'amilati alyahuwdu faqaala man ya'malu liy min nisfi alnnahaari iilaa al'asri fa'amilati alnnasaaraa, thumma aantum ta'maluwna mina al'asri iilaa almaghribi biqiyraatayni qiyraatayni, qaaluwa nahnu aaktharu 'amalaan waaaqallu 'ataa'an, qaala hal zalamtukum min haqqikum qaaluwa laa qaala fadhaaka fadliy auwtiyhi man shiitu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your life in comparison to the lifetime of the past nations is like the period between the time of `Asr prayer and sunset. Your example and the example of the Jews and Christians is that of person who employed laborers and said to them, "Who will work for me till the middle of the day for one Qirat (a special weight)?' The Jews did. He then said, "Who will work for me from the middle of the day till the `Asr prayer for one Qirat each?" The Christians worked accordingly. Then you (Muslims) are working from the `Asr prayer till the Maghrib prayer for two Qirats each. They (the Jews and the Christians) said, 'We did more labor but took less wages.' He (Allah) said, 'Have I wronged you in your rights?' They replied, 'No.' Then He said, 'This is My Blessing which I give to whom I wish
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى أَوْصَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لاَ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ كَيْفَ كُتِبَ عَلَى النَّاسِ الْوَصِيَّةُ، أُمِرُوا بِهَا وَلَمْ يُوصِ قَالَ أَوْصَى بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa maaliku bnu mighwalin, haddathanaa talhaau, qaala saaaltu 'abda alllahi bna aabiy aawfaa aawsaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala laa‏.‏ faqultu kayfa kutiba 'alaa alnnaasi alwasiyyaau, aumiruwa bihaa walam yuwsi qaala aawsaa bikitaabi alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Talha:I asked `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) make a will (to appoint his successor or bequeath wealth)?" He replied, "No." I said, "How is it prescribed then for the people to make wills, and they are ordered to do so while the Prophet (ﷺ) did not make any will?" He said, "He made a will wherein he recommended Allah's Book
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَمْ يَأْذَنِ اللَّهُ لِشَىْءٍ مَا أَذِنَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَغَنَّى بِالْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ صَاحِبٌ لَهُ يُرِيدُ يَجْهَرُ بِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, qaala haddathaniy alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aannahu kaana yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ lam yaadhani alllahu lishaa'in maa aadhina lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yataghannaa bialqurani ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala saahibun lahu yuriydu yajharu bihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah does not listen to a prophet as He listens to a prophet who recites the Qur'an in a pleasant tone." The companion of the sub-narrator (Abu Salama) said, "It means, reciting it aloud
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ لِشَىْءٍ مَا أَذِنَ لِلنَّبِيِّ أَنْ يَتَغَنَّى بِالْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ تَفْسِيرُهُ يَسْتَغْنِي بِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa aadhina alllahu lishaa'in maa aadhina lilnnabiyyi aan yataghannaa bialqurani ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu tafsiyruhu yastaghniy bihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah does not listen to a prophet as He listens to a prophet who recites the Qur'an in a loud and pleasant tone." Sufyan said, "This saying means: a prophet who regards the Qur'an as something that makes him dispense with many worldly pleasures
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ حَسَدَ إِلاَّ عَلَى اثْنَتَيْنِ، رَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ الْكِتَابَ وَقَامَ بِهِ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ، وَرَجُلٌ أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً فَهْوَ يَتَصَدَّقُ بِهِ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa hasada iilaaa 'alaa athnatayni, rajulun ataahu alllahu alkitaaba waqaama bihi anaa'a alllayli, warajulun aa'taahu alllahu maalaan fahwa yatasaddaqu bihi anaa'a alllayli waalnnahaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Not to wish to be the like except of two men. A man whom Allah has given the knowledge of the Book and he recites it during the hours of the night, and a man whom Allah has given wealth, and he spends it in charity during the night and the hours of the day
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، سَمِعْتُ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ حَسَدَ إِلاَّ فِي اثْنَتَيْنِ رَجُلٌ عَلَّمَهُ اللَّهُ الْقُرْآنَ فَهُوَ يَتْلُوهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَآنَاءَ النَّهَارِ فَسَمِعَهُ جَارٌ لَهُ فَقَالَ لَيْتَنِي أُوتِيتُ مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيَ فُلاَنٌ فَعَمِلْتُ مِثْلَ مَا يَعْمَلُ، وَرَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً فَهْوَ يُهْلِكُهُ فِي الْحَقِّ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لَيْتَنِي أُوتِيتُ مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيَ فُلاَنٌ فَعَمِلْتُ مِثْلَ مَا يَعْمَلُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sulaymaana, sami'tu dhakwaana, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa hasada iilaaa fiy athnatayni rajulun 'allamahu alllahu alqurana fahuwa yatluwhu anaa'a alllayli waanaa'a alnnahaari fasami'ahu jaarun lahu faqaala laytaniy auwtiytu mithla maa auwtiya fulaanun fa'amiltu mithla maa ya'malu, warajulun ataahu alllahu maalaan fahwa yuhlikuhu fiy alhaqqi faqaala rajulun laytaniy auwtiytu mithla maa auwtiya fulaanun fa'amiltu mithla maa ya'malu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Not to wish to be the like of except two men: A man whom Allah has taught the Qur'an and he recites it during the hours of the night and during the hours of the day, and his neighbor listens to him and says, 'I wish I had been given what has been given to so-and-so, so that I might do what he does; and a man whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it on what is just and right, whereupon an other man May say, 'I wish I had been given what so-and-so has been given, for then I would do what he does
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَلْقَمَةُ بْنُ مَرْثَدٍ، سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَقْرَأَ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فِي إِمْرَةِ عُثْمَانَ حَتَّى كَانَ الْحَجَّاجُ، قَالَ وَذَاكَ الَّذِي أَقْعَدَنِي مَقْعَدِي هَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy 'alqamaau bnu marthadin, sami'tu sa'da bna 'ubaydaaa, 'an aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani alssulamiyyi, 'an 'uthmaana rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ khayrukum man ta'allama alqurana wa'allamahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala waaaqraaa aabuw 'abdi alrrahmani fiy iimraai 'uthmaana hattaa kaana alhajjaaju, qaala wadhaaka alladhiy aaq'adaniy maq'adiy hadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Uthman:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best among you (Muslims) are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَفْضَلَكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'alqamaaa bni marthadin, 'an aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani alssulamiyyi, 'an 'uthmaana bni 'affaana, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna aafdalakum man ta'allama alqurana wa'allamahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Uthman bin `Affan:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most superior among you (Muslims) are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم امْرَأَةٌ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّهَا قَدْ وَهَبَتْ نَفْسَهَا لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لِي فِي النِّسَاءِ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ زَوِّجْنِيهَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَعْطِهَا ثَوْبًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ أَجِدُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَعْطِهَا وَلَوْ خَاتَمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَاعْتَلَّ لَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَقَدْ زَوَّجْتُكَهَا بِمَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'awnin, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, qaala aatati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm amraaaaun faqaalat iinnahaa qad wahabat nafsahaa lillahi walirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ maa liy fiy alnnisaa'i min haajaain ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala rajulun zawwijniyhaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aa'tihaa thawbana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala laa aajidu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aa'tihaa walaw khaatamana min hadiydin ‏"‏‏.‏ faa'talla lahu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ maa ma'aka mina alqurani ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala kadhaa wakadhaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faqad zawwajtukahaa bimaa ma'aka mina alqurani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A lady came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and declared that she had decided to offer herself to Allah and His Apostle. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am not in need of women." A man said (to the Prophet) "Please marry her to me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Give her a garment." The man said, "I cannot afford it." The Prophet said, "Give her anything, even if it were an iron ring." The man apologized again. The Prophet then asked him, "What do you know by heart of the Qur'an?" He replied, "I know such-andsuch portion of the Qur'an (by heart)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then I marry her to you for that much of the Qur'an which you know by heart
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، جَاءَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ جِئْتُ لأَهَبَ لَكَ نَفْسِي فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ إِلَيْهَا وَصَوَّبَهُ ثُمَّ طَأْطَأَ رَأْسَهُ، فَلَمَّا رَأَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَقْضِ فِيهَا شَيْئًا جَلَسَتْ، فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ بِهَا حَاجَةٌ فَزَوِّجْنِيهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ إِلَى أَهْلِكَ فَانْظُرْ هَلْ تَجِدُ شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَقَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا وَجَدْتُ شَيْئًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ انْظُرْ وَلَوْ خَاتَمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَقَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلاَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ وَلَكِنْ هَذَا إِزَارِي ـ قَالَ سَهْلٌ مَا لَهُ رِدَاءٌ ـ فَلَهَا نِصْفُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا تَصْنَعُ بِإِزَارِكَ إِنْ لَبِسْتَهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهَا مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ وَإِنْ لَبِسَتْهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْكَ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَلَسَ الرَّجُلُ حَتَّى طَالَ مَجْلِسُهُ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَرَآهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُوَلِّيًا فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَدُعِيَ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَاذَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مَعِي سُورَةُ كَذَا وَسُورَةُ كَذَا وَسُورَةُ كَذَا عَدَّهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَقْرَؤُهُنَّ عَنْ ظَهْرِ قَلْبِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ فَقَدْ مَلَّكْتُكَهَا بِمَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, aanna amraaaaan, jaa'at rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi jiitu laahaba laka nafsiy fanazara iilayhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasa''ada alnnazara iilayhaa wasawwabahu thumma taataaa raasahu, falammaa raaati almaraaau aannahu lam yaqdi fiyhaa shayiana jalasat, faqaama rajulun min aashaabihi faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iin lam yakun laka bihaa haajaaun fazawwijniyhaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ hal 'indaka min shaa'in ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala laa waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ adhhab iilaa aahlika faanzur hal tajidu shayiana ‏"‏‏.‏ fadhahaba thumma raja'a faqaala laa waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi maa wajadtu shayiana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ anzur walaw khaatamana min hadiydin ‏"‏‏.‏ fadhahaba thumma raja'a faqaala laa waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi walaa khaatamana min hadiydin walakin hadhaa iizaariy qaala sahlun maa lahu ridaa'un falahaa nisfuhu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa tasna'u biiizaarika iin labistahu lam yakun 'alayhaa minhu shaa'un waiin labisathu lam yakun 'alayka shaa'un ‏"‏‏.‏ fajalasa alrrajulu hattaa taala majlisuhu thumma qaama faraahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm muwalliyana faaamara bihi fadu'iya falammaa jaa'a qaala ‏"‏ maadhaa ma'aka mina alqurani ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala ma'iy suwraau kadhaa wasuwraau kadhaa wasuwraau kadhaa 'addahaa qaala ‏"‏ aataqrauuhunna 'an zahri qalbika ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ adhhab faqad mallaktukahaa bimaa ma'aka mina alqurani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:A lady came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have come to you to offer myself to you." He raised his eyes and looked at her and then lowered his head. When the lady saw that he did not make any decision, she sat down. On that, a man from his companions got up and said. "O Allah's Apostle! If you are not in need of this woman, then marry her to me." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do you have anything to offer her?" He replied. "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Go to your family and see if you can find something.' The man went and returned, saying, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have not found anything." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Try to find something, even if it is an iron ring.'' He went again and returned, saying, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), not even an iron ring, but I have this waist sheet of mine." The man had no upper garment, so he intended to give her, half his waist sheet. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, ''What would she do with your waist sheet? If you wear it, she will have nothing of it over her body, and if she wears it, you will have nothing over your body." So that man sat for a long period and then got up, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him going away, so he ordered somebody to call him. When he came, the Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, " How much of the Qur'an do you know?" He replied, "I know such Surat and such Surat and such Surat," and went on counting it, The Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Can you recite it by heart?" he replied, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Go, I have married this lady to you for the amount of the Qur'an you know by heart
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ صَاحِبِ الْقُرْآنِ كَمَثَلِ صَاحِبِ الإِبِلِ الْمُعَقَّلَةِ إِنْ عَاهَدَ عَلَيْهَا أَمْسَكَهَا وَإِنْ أَطْلَقَهَا ذَهَبَتْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa mathalu saahibi alqurani kamathali saahibi aliibili almu'aqqalaai iin 'aahada 'alayhaa aamsakahaa waiin aatlaqahaa dhahabat ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The example of the person who knows the Qur'an by heart is like the owner of tied camels. If he keeps them tied, he will control them, but if he releases them, they will run away
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ بِئْسَ مَا لأَحَدِهِمْ أَنْ يَقُولَ نَسِيتُ آيَةَ كَيْتَ وَكَيْتَ بَلْ نُسِّيَ، وَاسْتَذْكِرُوا الْقُرْآنَ فَإِنَّهُ أَشَدُّ تَفَصِّيًا مِنْ صُدُورِ الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النَّعَمِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ar'araaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ biisa maa laahadihim aan yaquwla nasiytu ayaaa kayta wakayta bal nussiya, waastadhkiruwa alqurana faiinnahu aashaddu tafassiyana min suduwri alrrijaali mina alnna'ami ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is a bad thing that some of you say, 'I have forgotten such-and-such verse of the Qur'an,' for indeed, he has been caused (by Allah) to forget it. So you must keep on reciting the Qur'an because it escapes from the hearts of men faster than camel do
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ بِشْرٌ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ،‏.‏ وَتَابَعَهُ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَبْدَةَ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, mithlahu‏.‏ taaba'ahu bishrun 'ani abni almubaaraki, 'an shu'baaa, ‏.‏ wataaba'ahu abnu jurayjin 'an 'abdaaa, 'an shaqiyqin, sami'tu 'abda alllahi, sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying... (as above, no)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ تَعَاهَدُوا الْقُرْآنَ فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَهُوَ أَشَدُّ تَفَصِّيًا مِنَ الإِبِلِ فِي عُقُلِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ta'aahaduwa alqurana fawaalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi lahuwa aashaddu tafassiyana mina aliibili fiy 'uqulihaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Commit yourself to the Qur'an, for by Him in whose Hand is my soul, it is surely more prone to break away than a camel in its bind
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو إِيَاسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مُغَفَّلٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ وَهْوَ يَقْرَأُ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ سُورَةَ الْفَتْحِ‏.‏
