verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw iiyaasin, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna mughaffalin, qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma fathi makkaaa wahwa yaqraau 'alaa raahilatihi suwraaa alfathi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reciting Surat-al-Fath on his she-camel on the day of the Conquest of Mecca
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ إِنَّ الَّذِي تَدْعُونَهُ الْمُفَصَّلَ هُوَ الْمُحْكَمُ، قَالَ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا ابْنُ عَشْرِ سِنِينَ وَقَدْ قَرَأْتُ الْمُحْكَمَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala iinna alladhiy tad'uwnahu almufassala huwa almuhkamu, qaala waqaala abnu 'abbaasin tuwuffiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa abnu 'ashri siniyna waqad qaraatu almuhkama‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Those Suras which you people call the Mufassal, are the Muhkam. And Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah's Apostle died when I was a boy of ten years, and I had learnt the Muhkam (of the Qur'an)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ جَمَعْتُ الْمُحْكَمَ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ لَهُ وَمَا الْمُحْكَمُ قَالَ الْمُفَصَّلُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa aabuw bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma jama'tu almuhkama fiy 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu lahu wamaa almuhkamu qaala almufassalu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:Ibn `Abbas said, "I have learnt all the Muhkam Suras during the life time of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." I said to him, 'What is meant by the Muhkam?" He replied, "The Mufassal
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا رَبِيعُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ سَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَرْحَمُهُ اللَّهُ لَقَدْ أَذْكَرَنِي كَذَا وَكَذَا آيَةً مِنْ سُورَةِ كَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa rabiy'u bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa zaaiidaau, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat sami'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulaan yaqraau fiy almasjidi faqaala ‏ "‏ yarhamuhu alllahu laqad aadhkaraniy kadhaa wakadhaa ayaaan min suwraai kadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) heard a man reciting the Qur'an in the mosque and said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on him, as he has reminded me of such-and-such Verses of such a Surah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، وَقَالَ، أَسْقَطْتُهُنَّ مِنْ سُورَةِ كَذَا‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ وَعَبْدَةُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydi bni maymuwnin, haddathanaa 'iysaa, 'an hishaamin, waqaala, aasqattuhunna min suwraai kadhaa‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'aliyyu bnu mushirin wa'abdaau 'an hishaamin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hisham:(The same Hadith as 6.556, adding): which I missed (modifying the Verses)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَمِعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً يَقْرَأُ فِي سُورَةٍ بِاللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَرْحَمُهُ اللَّهُ لَقَدْ أَذْكَرَنِي كَذَا وَكَذَا آيَةً كُنْتُ أُنْسِيتُهَا مِنْ سُورَةِ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu aabiy rajaa'in, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat sami'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulaan yaqraau fiy suwraain bialllayli faqaala ‏ "‏ yarhamuhu alllahu laqad aadhkaraniy kadhaa wakadhaa ayaaan kuntu aunsiytuhaa min suwraai kadhaa wakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard a man reciting the Qur'an at night, and said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on him, as he has reminded me of such-and-such Verses of such-and-such Suras, which I was caused to forget
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا لأَحَدِهِمْ يَقُولُ نَسِيتُ آيَةَ كَيْتَ وَكَيْتَ‏.‏ بَلْ هُوَ نُسِّيَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa laahadihim yaquwlu nasiytu ayaaa kayta wakayta‏.‏ bal huwa nussiya ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Why does anyone of the people say, 'I have forgotten such-and-such Verses (of the Qur'an)?' He, in fact, is caused (by Allah) to forget
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الآيَتَانِ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ مَنْ قَرَأَ بِهِمَا فِي لَيْلَةٍ كَفَتَاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala haddathaniy iibraahiymu, 'an 'alqamaaa, wa'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin alaansaariyyi, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alayataani min akhiri suwraai albaqaraai man qaraaa bihimaa fiy laylaain kafataahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Mas`ud al-Ansari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If one recites the last two verses of Surat al-Baqarah at night, it is sufficient for him (for that night)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، عَنْ حَدِيثِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيِّ، أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ بْنَ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ، يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ فِي حَيَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَمَعْتُ لِقِرَاءَتِهِ فَإِذَا هُوَ يَقْرَؤُهَا عَلَى حُرُوفٍ كَثِيرَةٍ لَمْ يُقْرِئْنِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكِدْتُ أُسَاوِرُهُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَانْتَظَرْتُهُ حَتَّى سَلَّمَ فَلَبَبْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ مَنْ أَقْرَأَكَ هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ الَّتِي سَمِعْتُكَ تَقْرَأُ قَالَ أَقْرَأَنِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ كَذَبْتَ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَهُوَ أَقْرَأَنِي هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ الَّتِي سَمِعْتُكَ، فَانْطَلَقْتُ بِهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقُودُهُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ هَذَا يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ عَلَى حُرُوفٍ لَمْ تُقْرِئْنِيهَا وَإِنَّكَ أَقْرَأْتَنِي سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا هِشَامُ اقْرَأْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَرَأَهَا الْقِرَاءَةَ الَّتِي سَمِعْتُهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَكَذَا أُنْزِلَتْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ يَا عُمَرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَرَأْتُهَا الَّتِي أَقْرَأَنِيهَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَكَذَا أُنْزِلَتْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْقُرْآنَ أُنْزِلَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَحْرُفٍ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau, 'an hadiythi almiswari bni makhramaaa, wa'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdin alqaariyyi, aannahumaa sami'aa 'umara bna alkhattaabi, yaquwlu sami'tu hishaama bna hakiymi bni hizaamin, yaqraau suwraaa alfurqaani fiy hayaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faastama'tu liqiraa'atihi faiidhaa huwa yaqrauuhaa 'alaa huruwfin kathiyraain lam yuqriiniyhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakidtu ausaawiruhu fiy alssalaaai faantazartuhu hattaa sallama falababtuhu faqultu man aaqraaaka hadhihi alssuwraaa allatiy sami'tuka taqraau qaala aaqraaaniyhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faqultu lahu kadhabta fawaalllahi iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lahuwa aaqraaaniy hadhihi alssuwraaa allatiy sami'tuka, faantalaqtu bihi iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaquwduhu faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy sami'tu hadhaa yaqraau suwraaa alfurqaani 'alaa huruwfin lam tuqriiniyhaa waiinnaka aaqraataniy suwraaa alfurqaani‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ yaa hishaamu aqraahaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaraaahaa alqiraa'aaa allatiy sami'tuhu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hakadhaa aunzilat ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ aqraa yaa 'umaru ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaraatuhaa allatiy aaqraaaniyhaa, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hakadhaa aunzilat ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna alqurana aunzila 'alaa sab'aai aahrufin faaqra'uwa maa tayassara minhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar bin Khattab:I heard Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam reciting Surat-al-Furqan during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and I listened to his recitation and noticed that he recited it in several ways which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not taught me. So I was on the point of attacking him in the prayer, but I waited till he finished his prayer, and then I seized him by the collar and said, "Who taught you this Surah which I have heard you reciting?" He replied, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) taught it to me." I said, "You are telling a lie; By Allah! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) taught me (in a different way) this very Surah which I have heard you reciting." So I took him, leading him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I heard this person reciting Surat-al-Furqan in a way that you did not teach me, and you have taught me Surat-al-Furqan." The Prophet said, "O Hisham, recite!" So he recited in the same way as I heard him recite it before. On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It was revealed to be recited in this way." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Recite, O `Umar!" So I recited it as he had taught me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "It was revealed to be recited in this way." Allah" Apostle added, "The Qur'an has been revealed to be recited in several different ways, so recite of it that which is easier for you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ آدَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ سَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَارِئًا يَقْرَأُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَرْحَمُهُ اللَّهُ لَقَدْ أَذْكَرَنِي كَذَا وَكَذَا آيَةً، أَسْقَطْتُهَا مِنْ سُورَةِ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa bishru bnu adama, aakhbaranaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat sami'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaariiana yaqraau mina alllayli fiy almasjidi faqaala ‏ "‏ yarhamuhu alllahu laqad aadhkaraniy kadhaa wakadhaa ayaaan, aasqattuhaa min suwraai kadhaa wakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) heard a reciter reciting, the Qur'an in the mosque at night. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on him, as he has remind ed me of such-and-such Verses of such and-such Suras, which I missed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَاصِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ غَدَوْنَا عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ قَرَأْتُ الْمُفَصَّلَ الْبَارِحَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ هَذًّا كَهَذِّ الشِّعْرِ، إِنَّا قَدْ سَمِعْنَا الْقِرَاءَةَ وَإِنِّي لأَحْفَظُ الْقُرَنَاءَ الَّتِي كَانَ يَقْرَأُ بِهِنَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَمَانِيَ عَشْرَةَ سُورَةً مِنَ الْمُفَصَّلِ وَسُورَتَيْنِ مِنْ آلِ حم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa mahdiyyu bnu maymuwnin, haddathanaa waasilun, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala ghadawnaa 'alaa 'abdi alllahi faqaala rajulun qaraatu almufassala albaarihaaa‏.‏ faqaala hadhhana kahadhhi alshhi'ri, iinnaa qad sami'naa alqiraa'aaa waiinniy laahfazu alquranaa'a allatiy kaana yaqraau bihinna alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm thamaaniya 'ashraaa suwraaan mina almufassali wasuwratayni min ali hm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Wail:We went to `Abdullah in the morning and a man said, "Yesterday I recited all the Mufassal Suras." On that `Abdullah said, "That is very quick, and we have the (Prophet's) recitation, and I remember very well the recitation of those Suras which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite, and they were eighteen Suras from the Mufassal, and two Suras from the Suras that start with Ha Mim
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ فِي قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ‏}‏ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا نَزَلَ جِبْرِيلُ بِالْوَحْىِ وَكَانَ مِمَّا يُحَرِّكُ بِهِ لِسَانَهُ وَشَفَتَيْهِ فَيَشْتَدُّ عَلَيْهِ وَكَانَ يُعْرَفُ مِنْهُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ الآيَةَ الَّتِي فِي ‏{‏لاَ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ‏}‏ ‏{‏لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ * إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ * فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ‏}‏ فَإِذَا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فَاسْتَمِعْ ‏{‏ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ‏}‏ قَالَ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا أَنْ نُبَيِّنَهُ بِلِسَانِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ أَطْرَقَ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ قَرَأَهُ كَمَا وَعَدَهُ اللَّهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an muwsaa bni aabiy 'aaiishaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma fiy qawlihi ‏{‏laa tuharrik bihi lisaanaka lita'jala bihi‏}‏ qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa nazala jibriylu bialwahai wakaana mimmaa yuharriku bihi lisaanahu washafatayhi fayashtaddu 'alayhi wakaana yu'rafu minhu, faaanzala alllahu alayaaa allatiy fiy ‏{‏laa auqsimu biyawmi alqiyaamaai‏}‏ ‏{‏laa tuharrik bihi lisaanaka lita'jala bihi * iinna 'alaynaa jam'ahu waquranahu * faiidhaa qaraanaahu faattabi' quranahu‏}‏ faiidhaa aanzalnaahu faastami' ‏{‏thumma iinna 'alaynaa bayaanahu‏}‏ qaala iinna 'alaynaa aan nubayyinahu bilisaanika‏.‏ qaala wakaana iidhaa aataahu jibriylu aatraqa, faiidhaa dhahaba qaraaahu kamaa wa'adahu alllahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Regarding His (Allah's) Statement:-- 'Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste therewith.' (75.16) And whenever Gabriel descended to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the Divine Inspiration, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to move his tongue and lips, and that used to be hard for him, and one could easily recognize that he was being inspired Divinely. So Allah revealed the Verse which occurs in the Surah starting with "I do swear by the Day of Resurrection.' (75.1) i.e. 'Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste then with. It is for Us to collect it (in your mind) (O Muhammad) an give you the ability to recite it 'by heart.' (75.16-17) which means: It is for us to collect it (in your mind) and give you the ability to recite it by heart. And when We have recited it to you (O Muhammad) through Gabriel then follow you its recital. (75.18) means: 'When We reveal it (the Qur'an) to you, Listen to it.' for then: It is for Us to explain it and make it clear to you' (75.19) i.e. It is up to Us to explain it through your tongue. So, when Gabriel came to him, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would listen to him attentively, and as soon as Gabriel left, he would recite the Revelations, as Allah had promised him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ الأَزْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ عَنْ قِرَاءَةِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ كَانَ يَمُدُّ مَدًّا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin alaazdiyyu, haddathanaa qataadaau, qaala saaaltu aanasa bna maalikin 'an qiraa'aai alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala kaana yamuddu maddana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas bin Malik about the recitation of the Prophet. He said, "He used to pray long (certain sounds) very much
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سُئِلَ أَنَسٌ كَيْفَ كَانَتْ قِرَاءَةُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَقَالَ كَانَتْ مَدًّا‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ، يَمُدُّ بِبِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَيَمُدُّ بِالرَّحْمَنِ، وَيَمُدُّ بِالرَّحِيمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aasimin, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an qataadaaa, qaala suiila aanasun kayfa kaanat qiraa'aau alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faqaala kaanat maddana‏.‏ thumma qaraaa bismi alllahi alrrahmani alrrahiymi, yamuddu bibismi alllahi, wayamuddu bialrrahmani, wayamuddu bialrrahiymi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qatada:Anas was asked, "How was the recitation (of the Qur'an) of the Prophet?' He replied, "It was characterized by the prolongation of certain sounds." He then recited: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful prolonging the pronunciation of 'In the Name of Allah, 'the most Beneficent,' and 'the Most Merciful
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِيَاسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مُغَفَّلٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ وَهْوَ عَلَى نَاقَتِهِ ـ أَوْ جَمَلِهِ ـ وَهْىَ تَسِيرُ بِهِ وَهْوَ يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفَتْحِ أَوْ مِنْ سُورَةِ الْفَتْحِ قِرَاءَةً لَيِّنَةً يَقْرَأُ وَهْوَ يُرَجِّعُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu bnu aabiy iiyaasin, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa aabuw iiyaasin, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna mughaffalin, qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau wahwa 'alaa naaqatihi aaw jamalihi wahaa tasiyru bihi wahwa yaqraau suwraaa alfathi aaw min suwraai alfathi qiraa'aaan layyinaaan yaqraau wahwa yurajji'u‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting (Qur'an) while he was riding on his she camel or camel which was moving, carrying him. He was reciting Surat Fath or part of Surat Fath very softly and in an Attractive vibrating tone
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يَحْيَى الْحِمَّانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بُرَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهُ ‏ "‏ يَا أَبَا مُوسَى لَقَدْ أُوتِيتَ مِزْمَارًا مِنْ مَزَامِيرِ آلِ دَاوُدَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu khalafin aabuw bakrin, haddathanaa aabuw yahyaa alhimmaaniyyu, haddathanaa buraydu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy burdaaa, 'an jaddihi aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lahu ‏ "‏ yaa aabaa muwsaa laqad auwtiyta mizmaarana min mazaamiyri ali daawuda ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him' "O Abu Musa! You have been given one of the mazamir (sweet melodious voices) of the family of David
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ قَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ عَلَىَّ الْقُرْآنَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ آقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَيْكَ أُنْزِلَ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَسْمَعَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'ani alaa'mashi, qaala haddathaniy iibraahiymu, 'an 'abiydaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, rda allh 'nh qaala qaala liy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aqraa 'alaaaa alqurana ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu aqraau 'alayka wa'alayka aunzila qaala ‏"‏ iinniy auhibbu aan aasma'ahu min ghayriy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Recite the Qur'an to me." `Abdullah said, "Shall I recite (the Qur'an) to you while it has been revealed to you?" He said, "I like to hear it from others
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ عَلَىَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ آقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَيْكَ أُنْزِلَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَرَأْتُ سُورَةَ النِّسَاءِ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُ إِلَى هَذِهِ الآيَةِ ‏{‏فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ شَهِيدًا‏}‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَسْبُكَ الآنَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَالْتَفَتُّ إِلَيْهِ فَإِذَا عَيْنَاهُ تَذْرِفَانِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'abiydaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, qaala qaala liy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aqraa 'alaaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aqraau 'alayka wa'alayka aunzila qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaraatu suwraaa alnnisaa'i hattaa aataytu iilaa hadhihi alayaai ‏{‏fakayfa iidhaa jiinaa min kulli aummaain bishahiydin wajiinaa bika 'alaa hauulaa'i shahiydana‏}‏ qaala ‏"‏ hasbuka alana ‏"‏‏.‏ faaltafattu iilayhi faiidhaa 'aynaahu tadhrifaani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Recite (the Qur'an) to me." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Shall I recite (the Qur'an) to you while it has been revealed to you?" He said, "Yes." So I recited Surat-An-Nisa' (The Women), but when I recited the Verse: 'How (will it be) then when We bring from each nation a witness and We bring you (O Muhammad) as a witness against these people.' (4.41) He said, "Enough for the present," I looked at him and behold! His eyes were overflowing with tears
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ لِي ابْنُ شُبْرُمَةَ نَظَرْتُ كَمْ يَكْفِي الرَّجُلَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ فَلَمْ أَجِدْ سُورَةً أَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثِ آيَاتٍ، فَقُلْتُ لاَ يَنْبَغِي لأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ أَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثِ آيَاتٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala liy abnu shubrumaaa nazartu kam yakfiy alrrajula mina alqurani falam aajid suwraaan aaqalla min thalaathi ayaatin, faqultu laa yanbaghiy laahadin aan yaqraaa aaqalla min thalaathi ayaatin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sufyan: Ibn Shubruma said, "I wanted to see how much of the Qur'an can be enough (to recite in prayer) and I could not find a Surah containing less than three Verses, therefore I said to myself), "One ought not to recite less than three (Quranic) Verses (in prayer)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: قَالَ عَلِيٌّ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ أَخْبَرَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَلْقَمَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، وَلَقِيتُهُ، وَهْوَ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ فَذَكَرَ قَوْلَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَنَّ مَنْ قَرَأَ بِالآيَتَيْنِ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ كَفَتَاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala 'aliyyun qaala sufyaanu aakhbaranaa mansuwrun, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, aakhbarahu 'alqamaau, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin, walaqiytuhu, wahwa yatuwfu bialbayti fadhakara qawla alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aanna man qaraaa bialayatayni min akhiri suwraai albaqaraai fiy laylaain kafataahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Mas'ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody recites the last two Verses of Surat al-Baqara at night, it will be sufficient for him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ أَنْكَحَنِي أَبِي امْرَأَةً ذَاتَ حَسَبٍ فَكَانَ يَتَعَاهَدُ كَنَّتَهُ فَيَسْأَلُهَا عَنْ بَعْلِهَا فَتَقُولُ نِعْمَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ رَجُلٍ لَمْ يَطَأْ لَنَا فِرَاشًا وَلَمْ يُفَتِّشْ لَنَا كَنَفًا مُذْ أَتَيْنَاهُ فَلَمَّا طَالَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ ذَكَرَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ الْقَنِي بِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَقِيتُهُ بَعْدُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كَيْفَ تَصُومُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَكَيْفَ تَخْتِمُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ كُلَّ لَيْلَةً‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ صُمْ فِي كُلِّ شَهْرٍ ثَلاَثَةً وَاقْرَإِ الْقُرْآنَ فِي كُلِّ شَهْرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ أُطِيقُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ صُمْ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ أُطِيقُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفْطِرْ يَوْمَيْنِ وَصُمْ يَوْمًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ أُطِيقُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ صُمْ أَفْضَلَ الصَّوْمِ صَوْمِ دَاوُدَ صِيَامَ يَوْمٍ وَإِفْطَارَ يَوْمٍ وَاقْرَأْ فِي كُلِّ سَبْعِ لَيَالٍ مَرَّةً ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَيْتَنِي قَبِلْتُ رُخْصَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَذَاكَ أَنِّي كَبِرْتُ وَضَعُفْتُ فَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ عَلَى بَعْضِ أَهْلِهِ السُّبْعَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ بِالنَّهَارِ وَالَّذِي يَقْرَؤُهُ يَعْرِضُهُ مِنَ النَّهَارِ لِيَكُونَ أَخَفَّ عَلَيْهِ بِاللَّيْلِ وَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَتَقَوَّى أَفْطَرَ أَيَّامًا وَأَحْصَى وَصَامَ مِثْلَهُنَّ كَرَاهِيةَ أَنْ يَتْرُكَ شَيْئًا فَارَقَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ فِي ثَلاَثٍ وَفِي خَمْسٍ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ عَلَى سَبْعٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an mughiyraaa, 'an mujaahidin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, qaala aankahaniy aabiy amraaaaan dhaata hasabin fakaana yata'aahadu kannatahu fayasaaluhaa 'an ba'lihaa fataquwlu ni'ma alrrajulu min rajulin lam yataa lanaa firaashana walam yufattish lanaa kanafana mudh aataynaahu falammaa taala dhalika 'alayhi dhakara lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ alqaniy bihi ‏"‏‏.‏ falaqiytuhu ba'du faqaala ‏"‏ kayfa tasuwmu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala kulla yawmin‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ wakayfa takhtimu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala kulla laylaaan‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ sum fiy kulli shahrin thalaathaaan waaqraii alqurana fiy kulli shahrin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qultu autiyqu aakthara min dhalika‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ sum thalaathaaa aayyaamin fiy aljumu'aai ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu autiyqu aakthara min dhalika‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aaftir yawmayni wasum yawmana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qultu autiyqu aakthara min dhalika‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ sum aafdala alssawmi sawmi daawuda siyaama yawmin waiiftaara yawmin waaqraa fiy kulli sab'i layaalin marraaan ‏"‏‏.‏ falaytaniy qabiltu rukhsaaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wadhaaka aanniy kabirtu wada'uftu fakaana yaqraau 'alaa ba'di aahlihi alssub'a mina alqurani bialnnahaari waalladhiy yaqrauuhu ya'riduhu mina alnnahaari liyakuwna aakhaffa 'alayhi bialllayli waiidhaa aaraada aan yataqawwaa aaftara aayyaamana waaahsaa wasaama mithlahunna karaahiyaa aan yatruka shayiana faaraqa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alayhi‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi waqaala ba'duhum fiy thalaathin wafiy khamsin waaaktharuhum 'alaa sab'in‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al `As:My father got me married to a lady of a noble family, and often used to ask my wife about me, and she used to reply, "What a wonderful man he is! He never comes to my bed, nor has he approached me since he married me." When this state continued for a long period, my father told the story to the Prophet who said to my father, "Let me meet him." Then I met him and he asked me, "How do you fast?" I replied, "I fast daily," He asked, "How long does it take you to finish the recitation of the whole Qur'an?" I replied, "I finish it every night." On that he said, "Fast for three days every month and recite the Qur'an (and finish it) in one month." I said, "But I have power to do more than that." He said, "Then fast for three days per week." I said, "i have the power to do more than that." He said, "Therefore, fast the most superior type of fasting, (that is, the fasting of (prophet) David who used to fast every alternate day; and finish the recitation of the whole Qur'an In seven days." I wish I had accepted the permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as I have become a weak old man. It is said that `Abdullah used to recite one-seventh of the Qur'an during the day-time to some of his family members, for he used to check his memorization of what he would recite at night during the daytime so that it would be easier for him to read at night. And whenever he wanted to gain some strength, he used to give up fasting for some days and count those days to fast for a similar period, for he disliked to leave those things which he used to do during the lifetime of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ فِي كَمْ تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'du bnu hafsin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, qaala liy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ fiy kam taqraau alqurana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) asked me, "How long does it take you to finish the recitation of the whole Qur'an?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، مَوْلَى بَنِي زُهْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ـ قَالَ وَأَحْسِبُنِي قَالَ ـ سَمِعْتُ أَنَا مِنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اقْرَإِ الْقُرْآنَ فِي شَهْرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ إِنِّي أَجِدُ قُوَّةً حَتَّى قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاقْرَأْهُ فِي سَبْعٍ وَلاَ تَزِدْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an shaybaana, 'an yahyaa, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, mawlaa baniy zuhraaa 'an aabiy salamaaa qaala waaahsibuniy qaala sami'tu aanaa min aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aqraii alqurana fiy shahrin ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu iinniy aajidu quwwaaan hattaa qaala ‏"‏ faaqraahu fiy sab'in walaa tazid 'alaa dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Recite the whole Qur'an in one month's time." I said, "But I have power (to do more than that)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Then finish the recitation of the Qur'an in seven days, and do not finish it in less than this period
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ يَحْيَى بَعْضُ الْحَدِيثِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ ـ حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ الأَعْمَشُ وَبَعْضُ الْحَدِيثِ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ عَلَىَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ أَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَيْكَ أُنْزِلَ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي أَشْتَهِي أَنْ أَسْمَعَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَرَأْتُ النِّسَاءَ حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغْتُ ‏{‏فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ شَهِيدًا‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ لِي ‏"‏ كُفَّ ـ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ ـ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَأَيْتُ عَيْنَيْهِ تَذْرِفَانِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sadaqaau, aakhbaranaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, 'an sulaymaana, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'abiydaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala yahyaa ba'du alhadiythi 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, qaala liy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ haddathanaa musaddadun 'an yahyaa 'an sufyaana 'ani alaa'mashi 'an iibraahiyma 'an 'abiydaaa 'an 'abdi alllahi qaala alaa'mashu waba'du alhadiythi haddathaniy 'amruw bnu murraaa 'an iibraahiyma wa'an aabiyhi 'an aabiy aldduhaa 'an 'abdi alllahi qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aqraa 'alaaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qultu aaqraau 'alayka wa'alayka aunzila qaala ‏"‏ iinniy aashtahiy aan aasma'ahu min ghayriy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faqaraatu alnnisaa'a hattaa iidhaa balaghtu ‏{‏fakayfa iidhaa jiinaa min kulli aummaain bishahiydin wajiinaa bika 'alaa hauulaa'i shahiydana‏}‏‏.‏ qaala liy ‏"‏ kuffa aaw aamsik ‏"‏‏.‏ faraaaytu 'aynayhi tadhrifaani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to me), "Recite the Qur'an to me." I said, "Shall I recite (it) to you while it has been revealed to you?" He said, "I like to hear it from another person." So I recited Surat An-Nisa (The Women) till I reached the Verse: 'How (will it be) then when We bring from each nation a witness, and We bring you (O Muhammad) as a witness against these people.' (4.41) Then he said to me, "Stop!" Thereupon I saw his eyes overflowing with tears
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ السَّلْمَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ عَلَىَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَيْكَ أُنْزِلَ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَسْمَعَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qaysu bnu hafsin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'abiydaaa alssalmaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala qaala liy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aqraa 'alaaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu aaqraau 'alayka wa'alayka aunzila qaala ‏"‏ iinniy auhibbu aan aasma'ahu min ghayriy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Recite Qur'an to me." I said to him. "Shall I recite (it) to you while it has been revealed to you?" He said, "I like to hear it from another person
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ غَفَلَةَ، قَالَ عَلِيٌّ رضى الله عنه سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يَأْتِي فِي آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ قَوْمٌ حُدَثَاءُ الأَسْنَانِ، سُفَهَاءُ الأَحْلاَمِ، يَقُولُونَ مِنْ خَيْرِ قَوْلِ الْبَرِيَّةِ، يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ الإِسْلاَمِ كَمَا يَمْرُقُ السَّهْمُ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ، لاَ يُجَاوِزُ إِيمَانُهُمْ حَنَاجِرَهُمْ، فَأَيْنَمَا لَقِيتُمُوهُمْ فَاقْتُلُوهُمْ، فَإِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ لِمَنْ قَتَلَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an khaythamaaa, 'an suwaydi bni ghafalaaa, qaala 'aliyyun rda allh 'nh sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yaatiy fiy akhiri alzzamaani qawmun hudathaa'u alaasnaani, sufahaa'u alaahlaami, yaquwluwna min khayri qawli albariyyaai, yamruquwna mina aliislaami kamaa yamruqu alssahmu mina alrramiyyaai, laa yujaawizu iiymaanuhum hanaajirahum, faaaynamaa laqiytumuwhum faaqtuluwhum, faiinna qatlahum aajrun liman qatalahum yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "In the last days (of the world) there will appear young people with foolish thoughts and ideas. They will give good talks, but they will go out of Islam as an arrow goes out of its game, their faith will not exceed their throats. So, wherever you find them, kill them, for there will be a reward for their killers on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يَخْرُجُ فِيكُمْ قَوْمٌ تَحْقِرُونَ صَلاَتَكُمْ مَعَ صَلاَتِهِمْ، وَصِيَامَكُمْ مَعَ صِيَامِهِمْ، وَعَمَلَكُمْ مَعَ عَمَلِهِمْ، وَيَقْرَءُونَ الْقُرْآنَ لاَ يُجَاوِزُ حَنَاجِرَهُمْ، يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ الدِّينَ كَمَا يَمْرُقُ السَّهْمُ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ، يَنْظُرُ فِي النَّصْلِ فَلاَ يَرَى شَيْئًا، وَيَنْظُرُ فِي الْقِدْحِ فَلاَ يَرَى شَيْئًا، وَيَنْظُرُ فِي الرِّيشِ فَلاَ يَرَى شَيْئًا، وَيَتَمَارَى فِي الْفُوقِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an muhammadi bni iibraahiyma bni alhaarithi alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh aannahu qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yakhruju fiykum qawmun tahqiruwna salaatakum ma'a salaatihim, wasiyaamakum ma'a siyaamihim, wa'amalakum ma'a 'amalihim, wayaqra'uwna alqurana laa yujaawizu hanaajirahum, yamruquwna mina alddiyna kamaa yamruqu alssahmu mina alrramiyyaai, yanzuru fiy alnnasli falaa yaraa shayiana, wayanzuru fiy alqidhi falaa yaraa shayiana, wayanzuru fiy alrriyshi falaa yaraa shayiana, wayatamaaraa fiy alfuwqi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "There will appear some people among you whose prayer will make you look down upon yours, and whose fasting will make you look down upon yours, but they will recite the Qur'an which will not exceed their throats (they will not act on it) and they will go out of Islam as an arrow goes out through the game whereupon the archer would examine the arrowhead but see nothing, and look at the unfeathered arrow but see nothing, and look at the arrow feathers but see nothing, and finally he suspects to find something in the lower part of the arrow
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمُؤْمِنُ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَيَعْمَلُ بِهِ كَالأُتْرُجَّةِ، طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَرِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ، وَالْمُؤْمِنُ الَّذِي لاَ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَيَعْمَلُ بِهِ كَالتَّمْرَةِ، طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَلاَ رِيحَ لَهَا، وَمَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَالرَّيْحَانَةِ، رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَطَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ، وَمَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ الَّذِي لاَ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَالْحَنْظَلَةِ، طَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ ـ أَوْ خَبِيثٌ ـ وَرِيحُهَا مُرٌّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ almuuminu alladhiy yaqraau alqurana waya'malu bihi kaalautrujjaai, ta'muhaa tayyibun wariyhuhaa tayyibun, waalmuuminu alladhiy laa yaqraau alqurana waya'malu bihi kaalttamraai, ta'muhaa tayyibun walaa riyha lahaa, wamathalu almunaafiqi alladhiy yaqraau alqurana kaalrrayhaanaai, riyhuhaa tayyibun wata'muhaa murrun, wamathalu almunaafiqi alladhiy laa yaqraau alqurana kaalhanzalaai, ta'muhaa murrun aaw khabiythun wariyhuhaa murrun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of a believer who recites the Qur'an and acts on it, like a citron which tastes nice and smells nice. And the example of a believer who does not recite the Qur'an but acts on it, is like a date which tastes good but has no smell. And the example of a hypocrite who recites the Qur'an is like a Raihana (sweet basil) which smells good but tastes bitter And the example of a hypocrite who does not recite the Qur'an is like a colocynth which tastes bitter and has a bad smell
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ جُنْدَبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ مَا ائْتَلَفَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ، فَإِذَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فَقُومُوا عَنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aabiy 'imraana aljawniyyi, 'an jundabi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aqra'uwa alqurana maa aitalafat quluwbukum, faiidhaa akhtalaftum faquwmuwa 'anhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Recite (and study) the Qur'an as long as you agree about its interpretation, but if you have any difference of opinion (as regards to its interpretation and meaning) then you should stop reciting it (for the time being)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلاَّمُ بْنُ أَبِي مُطِيعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ مَا ائْتَلَفَتْ عَلَيْهِ قُلُوبُكُمْ فَإِذَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فَقُومُوا عَنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ وَلَمْ يَرْفَعْهُ حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ وَأَبَانُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ غُنْدَرٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ سَمِعْتُ جُنْدَبًا قَوْلَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ عَنْ عُمَرَ قَوْلَهُ، وَجُنْدَبٌ أَصَحُّ وَأَكْثَرُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa salaaamu bnu aabiy mutiy'in, 'an aabiy 'imraana aljawniyyi, 'an jundabin, qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aqra'uwa alqurana maa aitalafat 'alayhi quluwbukum faiidhaa akhtalaftum faquwmuwa 'anhu ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu alhaarithu bnu 'ubaydin wasa'iydu bnu zaydin 'an aabiy 'imraana walam yarfa'hu hammaadu bnu salamaaa waaabaanu‏.‏ waqaala ghundarun 'an shu'baaa 'an aabiy 'imraana sami'tu jundabana qawlahu‏.‏ waqaala abnu 'awnin 'an aabiy 'imraana 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alssaamiti 'an 'umara qawlahu, wajundabun aasahhu waaaktharu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jundub:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Recite (and study) the Qur'an as long as you agree about its interpretation, but when you have any difference of opinion (as regards its interpretation and meaning) then you should stop reciting it (for the time being)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 66 — Virtues of the Qur'an
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنِ النَّزَّالِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَجُلاً، يَقْرَأُ آيَةً، سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خِلاَفَهَا، فَأَخَذْتُ بِيَدِهِ فَانْطَلَقْتُ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ كِلاَكُمَا مُحْسِنٌ فَاقْرَآ ـ أَكْبَرُ عِلْمِي قَالَ ـ فَإِنَّ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمُ اخْتَلَفُوا فَأَهْلَكَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni maysaraaa, 'ani alnnazzaali bni sabraaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, aannahu sami'a rajulaan, yaqraau ayaaan, sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm khilaafahaa, faaakhadhtu biyadihi faantalaqtu bihi iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ kilaakumaa muhsinun faaqraa aakbaru 'ilmiy qaala faiinna man kaana qablakumu akhtalafuwa faaahlakahum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:That he heard a man reciting a Quranic Verse which he had heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting in a different way. So he took that man to the Prophet (and told him the story). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Both of you are reciting in a correct way, so carry on reciting." The Prophet (ﷺ) further added, "The nations which were before you were destroyed (by Allah) because they differed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
